prompt: Identify all patients who received a hematopoietic stem cell transplant AND had a skin biopsy.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t2"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t2"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t2"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t2"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Date of Death", "t2"."PT_SEX" AS "Gender", YEAR("t3"."DT_DTE"-"t2"."PT_BIRTH_DTE") AS "Age at Transplant", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Transplant Date", "t4"."PCC_CODE" AS "Transplant ICD-9 Procedure Code", "t4"."PCC_DESC" AS "Transplant ICD-9 Procedure Desc", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Skin Biopsy Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICD9_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t4" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t3" ON "t4"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t6" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t5" ON "t6"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE "t4"."PROC_ID" IN (6154, 6489, 6490, 6156, 6157, 6493, 6494) AND "t6"."PROC_ID" IN (1458, 1793) AND DAYS("t5"."DT_DTE") - DAYS("t3"."DT_DTE") > 0

prompt: Which patients in Yr2022 had surgery for brain tumors and determine whether they had a Neurology consultation prior or after the surgery.
completion: WITH DIAGNOSIS_0 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_DEID, SUBJECT_ID, DIAGNOSIS_DATE, ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC FROM (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, MIN(DIAGNOSIS_DATE."DT_DTE") AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE, TRIM(ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, TRIM(ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE") || '-' || TRIM(ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG" AS ICD_CODE_DESC ON "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE ON "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_DATE_ID" = DIAGNOSIS_DATE."DT_DATE_ID" GROUP BY "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID", CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID") AS VARCHAR), ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE", ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC") WHERE DIAGNOSIS_DATE BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' AND ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE IN ('C71.0', 'C71.1', 'C71.2', 'C71.3', 'C71.4', 'C71.5', 'C71.6', 'C71.7', 'C71.8', 'C71.9')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_0)), COHORT_DIAGNOSIS AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, DIAGNOSIS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_DIAGNOSIS ON COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"), DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_DEID, SUBJECT_ID, DIAGNOSIS_DATE, ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC FROM (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, MIN(DIAGNOSIS_DATE."DT_DTE") AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE, TRIM(ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, TRIM(ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE") || '-' || TRIM(ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG" AS ICD_CODE_DESC ON "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE ON "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_DATE_ID" = DIAGNOSIS_DATE."DT_DATE_ID" GROUP BY "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID", CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID") AS VARCHAR), ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE", ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC", ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE", ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC")) SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.DIAGNOSIS_DATE AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE, DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE AS ICD_CODE, DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC AS ICD_CODE_DESCRIPTION FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID LEFT OUTER JOIN DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS ON DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.SUBJECT_ID = KEYS.COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_SUBJECT_ID; WITH DIAGNOSIS_0 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_DEID, SUBJECT_ID, DIAGNOSIS_DATE, ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC FROM (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, MIN(DIAGNOSIS_DATE."DT_DTE") AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE, TRIM(ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, TRIM(ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE") || '-' || TRIM(ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG" AS ICD_CODE_DESC ON "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE ON "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_DATE_ID" = DIAGNOSIS_DATE."DT_DATE_ID" GROUP BY "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID", CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID") AS VARCHAR), ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE", ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC") WHERE DIAGNOSIS_DATE BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' AND ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE IN ('C71.0', 'C71.1', 'C71.2', 'C71.3', 'C71.4', 'C71.5', 'C71.6', 'C71.7', 'C71.8', 'C71.9')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_0)), COHORT_DIAGNOSIS AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, DIAGNOSIS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_DIAGNOSIS ON COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"), PROCEDURES_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_LOG_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_SURG_DTE" AS PROC_SURG_DATE, "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD" AS PROC_CODE, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD") AS VARCHAR) || ' - ' || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC") AS VARCHAR) AS PROC_CODE_DESC, "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_LOG_STS" AS SSE_LOG_STS, "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_SURG_SVC_CD" AS PROC_SURG_SERVICE, "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_SURG_LOC" AS SSE_SURG_LOC, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_SURG_LAST_NM") AS VARCHAR) || ', ' || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM") AS VARCHAR) AS SURGEON, "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_LOG_ID" AS SSE_LOG_ID, "IDB"."VISIT"."VIS_ADM_DTE" AS SRG_ADM_DTE, "IDB"."VISIT"."VIS_DSCH_DTE" AS SRG_DSCH_DTE, DAYS("IDB"."VISIT"."VIS_DSCH_DTE") - DAYS("IDB"."VISIT"."VIS_ADM_DTE") AS SRG_LOS FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE" ON "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_LOG_ID" = "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_LOG_ID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."VISIT" ON "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_MRN" = "IDB"."VISIT"."VIS_MRN" AND "IDB"."VISIT"."VIS_VISIT_STATUS" IN ('2', '3') AND "IDB"."VISIT"."VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND" = 'I' AND "IDB"."VISIT"."VIS_ADM_DTE" <= "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_SURG_DTE" AND COALESCE("IDB"."VISIT"."VIS_DSCH_DTE", '2999-12-31') >= "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_SURG_DTE") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, PROCEDURES_COLUMNS.PROC_SURG_DATE AS PROC_SURG_DATE, PROCEDURES_COLUMNS.PROC_CODE AS PROC_CODE, PROCEDURES_COLUMNS.PROC_CODE_DESC AS PROC_CODE_DESC, PROCEDURES_COLUMNS.SSE_LOG_STS AS SSE_LOG_STS, PROCEDURES_COLUMNS.PROC_SURG_SERVICE AS PROC_SURG_SERVICE, PROCEDURES_COLUMNS.SSE_SURG_LOC AS SSE_SURG_LOC, PROCEDURES_COLUMNS.SURGEON AS SURGEON, PROCEDURES_COLUMNS.SSE_LOG_ID AS SSE_LOG_ID, PROCEDURES_COLUMNS.SRG_ADM_DTE AS SRG_ADM_DTE, PROCEDURES_COLUMNS.SRG_DSCH_DTE AS SRG_DSCH_DTE, PROCEDURES_COLUMNS.SRG_LOS AS SRG_LOS FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID LEFT OUTER JOIN PROCEDURES_COLUMNS ON PROCEDURES_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID;

prompt: Patients with pathology proven ovarian metastases from other primary cancers including lymphoma, who also had imaging studies (CT, MRI, US, OR PET/CT). Patients' medical record numbers, pathology diagnoses and dates, surgery dates, and dates of imaging studies (only need CT, MRI, US, OR PET/CT). One year's data depending on how many cases(last or the year before would be good).
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t11"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-9 Code", "t2"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-9 MSK code description", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "ICD-9 First Dx Date", "t4"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t6"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "DE-ID Pathology Report Type", "t7"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t7"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Desc", "t7"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t7"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Desc", "t8"."DT_DTE" AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", "t9"."PCC_CODE" AS "CPT Procedure Code - PBD", "t9"."PCC_DESC" AS "CPT Procedure Desc - PBD", "t10"."DT_DTE" AS "CPT Procedure Date - PBD" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t11" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t11"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICD9_V" "t2" ON "t11"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN (SELECT PD.PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID, PD.PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, MIN(PD.PDX_DX_DATE_ID) AS FIRST_DIAGNOSIS_DATE_ID, MAX(PD.PDX_DX_DATE_ID) AS LAST_DIAGNOSIS_DATE_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS PD, DV.DIAGNOSIS_ATTRIBUTE DA, DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG DCC WHERE PD.PDX_DIAGNOSIS_ATTRIBUTE_ID = DA.DXA_ATTRIBUTE_ID AND PD.PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DCC.DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID AND DA.DXA_CLSF_TYPE like 'DF%' AND DCC.DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD9' AND UPPER(DA.DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT) = 'YES' GROUP BY PD.PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID, PD.PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID) "t12" ON "t11"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t12"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" AND "t11"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t12"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t3" ON "t12"."FIRST_DIAGNOSIS_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t5" ON "t4"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t6" ON "t4"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t6"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_ICDO_DIAGNOSIS_V" "t7" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t8" ON "t7"."PDX_DX_DATE_ID" = "t8"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t9" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t10" ON "t9"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "t10"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t11" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t11"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE ("t11"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" IN (5861) AND ("t3"."DT_DTE" >= '1997-1-1' AND ("t6"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" IN ('Surgical Pathology') AND "t9"."PROC_ID" IN (10591, 10257, 10592, 10640, 10306, 10641, 10718, 11053, 10719, 10720, 11055, 10721, 10307, 10643, 10309, 22970, 23305, 22971, 23306, 11862)))) AND ABS(DAYS("t5"."DT_DTE") - DAYS("t3"."DT_DTE")) <= 30 AND "t10"."DT_DTE" < "t5"."DT_DTE"

prompt: A list of patients that have ever been on AKT1/PI3K inhibitors and all available pathology information
completion: SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN MRN , PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PT_DEID FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('ALPELISIB', 'BUPARLISIB (BKM120)', 'CAPIVASERTIB (AZD5363)', 'GDC-0077', 'GDC-0980', 'IPATASERTIB', 'LY3023414', 'MK-2206', 'PERIFOSINE', 'TASELISIB (GDC-0032)') ; SELECT APR_MRN MRN , CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME DRUG_NAME , MIN(APR_START_DTE) FIRST_ADMIN , MAX(APR_START_DTE) LAST_ADMIN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('ALPELISIB', 'BUPARLISIB (BKM120)', 'CAPIVASERTIB (AZD5363)', 'GDC-0077', 'GDC-0980', 'IPATASERTIB', 'LY3023414', 'MK-2206', 'PERIFOSINE', 'TASELISIB (GDC-0032)') GROUP BY APR_MRN , CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('ALPELISIB', 'BUPARLISIB (BKM120)', 'CAPIVASERTIB (AZD5363)', 'GDC-0077', 'GDC-0980', 'IPATASERTIB', 'LY3023414', 'MK-2206', 'PERIFOSINE', 'TASELISIB (GDC-0032)') ) , STUDY AS (SELECT ACD_MRN , ACD_IRB_NO , ACD_CONS_DTE , ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN PTS ON ACD_MRN = MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '16-1556', '20-039', '13-027', '13-246', '13-251', '14-057', '14-097', '16-740', '18-076', '11-117', '12-233', '12-290', '14-214', '16-1336', '17-322', '17-637', '18-357', '12-029', '14-085', '13-149', '15-020', '15-111', '13-149', '15-020') ) SELECT MRN , ACD_IRB_NO IRB_NO , ACD_CONS_DTE CONSENT_DTE , ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE OFF_STUDY_DTE FROM PTS LEFT JOIN STUDY ON MRN = ACD_MRN ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('ALPELISIB', 'BUPARLISIB (BKM120)', 'CAPIVASERTIB (AZD5363)', 'GDC-0077', 'GDC-0980', 'IPATASERTIB', 'LY3023414', 'MK-2206', 'PERIFOSINE', 'TASELISIB (GDC-0032)') ) SELECT MRN , COALESCE(PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, DV.REGEXSTR('(?<=Date of Collection\/Procedure\/Outside Report: ).*', PRPT_REPORT)) PROCEDURE_DTE , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO ACCESSION_NO , PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC PATH_TYPE , PRPT_REPORT PATH_REPORT FROM PTS LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON MRN = PRPT_MRN

prompt: Please provide list of oral cavity patients who underwent fibula flap mandible reconstructions.
completion: SELECT SSE_MRN , PT_SEX , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH , SSE_SURG_DTE , SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD , SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , PRPT_REPORT FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON SSE_MRN = PRPT_MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE = PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like 'S%' WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD = '20969' AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '2022-01-01'

prompt: Provide a one-time list of patients who have undergone PRRT treatment between January 1, 2021 through May 1, 2022.
completion: WITH MEDS AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, CDG_THERAPEUTIC_CATEGORY, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE, APR_ROUTE, APR_FREQ, APR_PROVIDER_NAME, APR_TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_DOSE_UOM, APR_DISPENSE_CNT, APR_SET_NAME FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE 1=1 AND CDG_DRUG_TYPE = 'Radioimmunotherapy' AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME like '%LU%177%DOTA%' AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' ) , MEDS_LISTAGG AS (SELECT APR_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(VARCHAR_FORMAT(APR_START_DTE, 'mm/dd/yyyy'), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(CAST(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS VARCHAR(2000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(APR_DRUG_NAME), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY APR_START_DTE) AS "PPRT" FROM MEDS GROUP BY APR_MRN) , TARGET_DXS AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS "Initial Effective Date" FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN MEDS ON APR_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('209', 'C4A', 'C7A', 'D3A', 'C25') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) , TARGET_DX_LISTAGG AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(VARCHAR_FORMAT("Initial Effective Date", 'mm/dd/yyyy'), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(CC_CLSF_CD), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY "Initial Effective Date") AS "Target Diagnoses" FROM TARGET_DXS GROUP BY CC_MRN) , MEDS_OUTPUT AS (SELECT MEDS.* FROM MEDS MEDS JOIN TARGET_DX_LISTAGG ON MRN = APR_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", CASE WHEN "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE") END AS "Cur Age", "t1"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS "Vital Status", "t1"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender", "t1"."PT_RACE_DESC" AS "Race", "t2"."CORE_ETHNICITY_DESC" AS "Ethnicity", "t3"."PLA_LAST_DRVST_DTE" AS "Last Dr Visit Date" , "Target Diagnoses" , "PPRT" FROM TARGET_DX_LISTAGG DX LEFT JOIN MEDS_LISTAGG MEDS ON APR_MRN = MRN JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t1" ON "t1"."PT_MRN" = DX.MRN LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t2" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" ; WITH MEDS AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE, APR_ROUTE, APR_QTY, APR_FREQ, APR_PROVIDER_NAME, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC, APR_TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_DOSE_UOM, APR_DISPENSE_CNT, APR_SET_NAME, CDG_THERAPEUTIC_CATEGORY FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE 1=1 AND CDG_DRUG_TYPE = 'Radioimmunotherapy' AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME like '%LU%177%DOTA%' AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' ) , MEDS_LISTAGG AS (SELECT APR_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(VARCHAR_FORMAT(APR_START_DTE, 'mm/dd/yyyy'), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(CAST(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS VARCHAR(2000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(APR_DRUG_NAME), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY APR_START_DTE) AS "PPRT" FROM MEDS GROUP BY APR_MRN) , TARGET_DXS AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS "Initial Effective Date" FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN MEDS ON APR_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('209', 'C4A', 'C7A', 'D3A', 'C25') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) , TARGET_DX_LISTAGG AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(VARCHAR_FORMAT("Initial Effective Date", 'mm/dd/yyyy'), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(CC_CLSF_CD), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY "Initial Effective Date") AS "Target Diagnoses" FROM TARGET_DXS GROUP BY CC_MRN) , MEDS_OUTPUT AS (SELECT MEDS.* FROM MEDS MEDS JOIN TARGET_DX_LISTAGG ON MRN = APR_MRN) SELECT * FROM MEDS_OUTPUT ORDER BY CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, CDG_THERAPEUTIC_CATEGORY ;

prompt: Patients with mantle cell lymphoma who have been prescribed ibrutinib
completion: WITH MEDS AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE, APR_START_DTE, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_DOSE_UOM, APR_DISPENSE_CNT, APR_TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE, APR_ROUTE, APR_ORAL_FLAG, APR_QTY, APR_PROVIDER_NAME, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) IN ('IBRUTINIB', 'ACALABRUTINIB', 'ZANUBRUTINIB') AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2013-11-01' AND '2020-07-31' ) SELECT MRN , AGE_AT_DX, PT_NAME, DOB, DOD, SEX, DX_DTE, DX_CD, DX_DESC, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE, APR_START_DTE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT T1.APR_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH DOD, PT_SEX_DESC SEX, YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_DX , DX.CC_EFF_DTE DX_DTE , DX.CC_CLSF_CD DX_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC , APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE, APR_START_DTE , ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY DX.CC_MRN ORDER BY DX.CC_EFF_DTE) RN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF DX JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN MEDS T1 ON T1.APR_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_EFF_DTE >= '1998-01-01' AND (CC_CLSF_CD IN('C83.10', 'C83.11', 'C83.12', 'C83.13', 'C83.14', 'C83.15', 'C83.16', 'C83.17', 'C83.18', 'C83.19') OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '200.4%') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'D%' AND (CC_FINALIZED_IND= 'Y' OR CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') ) AS A WHERE RN = 1

prompt: Provide a list of RadOnc Brachy procedures performed only in the O.R. that required anesthesia.
completion: WITH ETO AS (SELECT ARS_AN_EPISODE_ID, ARS_AN_CL_PT_ID, ARS_AN_CASELOG_ID, ARS_AN_DTE, ARS_AN_START_DT, ARS_AN_STOP_DT, ARS_AN_PROC_NAME FROM IDB.AN_RECORD_SUMMARY WHERE ARS_AN_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2019-03-31' AND UPPER(ARS_AN_PROC_NAME) LIKE '%BRACHY%' ) SELECT SSE_ENC_CSN_ID CSN_ID, SSE_LOG_ID LOGID, SSE_SURG_STRT_DT SURG_STRT_DT, SSE_SURG_END_DT SURG_END_DT, ARS_AN_START_DT AN_START_DT, ARS_AN_STOP_DT AN_STOP_DT, ARS_AN_PROC_NAME AN_PROC_NAME, SSE_MRN MRN, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD CPT_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC CPT_DESC, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD SURG_SVC_CD FROM ETO JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON ARS_AN_CASELOG_ID = SSE_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'RAD ONC' AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD LIKE '777%'

prompt: Drs. Harding & Connell will use this data to study outcomes and treatment paradigms for patients with hepatocellular carcinoma and portal vein thrombosis.
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT TEXTTABLE.*, CONTAINS("PRPT_DEID_REPORT", '"HEPATOCELLULAR"') AS "HitCol1" FROM "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" TEXTTABLE), "cte2" AS (SELECT DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_CODE)) DXCC_ICD_CODE, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC)) DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_CODE)) || ' - ' || LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC)) AS DXCC_CODE_AND_MSK_DESC, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_NATIONAL_DESC)) DXCC_ICD_NATIONAL_DESC, DXCC_DESC_LONG, CASE WHEN DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '196' AND '196.99' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '197' AND '197.99' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '198' AND '198.99' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS DXCC_METS_INDICATOR, DXCC_CREATED_DT, DXCC_CREATED_BY, DXCC_MODIFIED_DT FROM DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG WHERE DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD9' ), "cte3" AS (SELECT TEXTTABLE.*, CONTAINS("RRPT_DEID_RPT_TXT", '("PORTAL" & "VEIN" & "THROMBOSIS")') AS "HitCol1" FROM "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" TEXTTABLE) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" AS "DE-ID Pathology Report", "t3"."DT_YEAR" AS "Pathology Report Year", "t4"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-9 Final Dx Code", "t4"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-9 Final Dx Description", "t5"."RRPT_RPT_ID" AS "DE-ID Radiology Report", "t6"."DT_YEAR" AS "Tumor Diagnosis Year", "t7"."DT_YEAR" AS "ICD-9 First Final Diagnosis Year", YEAR("t5"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE") AS "Radiology Performed Year" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t8" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t2" ON "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t9" ON "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte2" "t4" ON "t9"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t4"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_DATES_V" "t10" ON "t9"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t10"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" AND "t9"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t10"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t7" ON "t10"."FIRST_DIAGNOSIS_DATE_ID" = "t7"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte3" "t5" ON "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t11" ON "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t11"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t6" ON "t11"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t6"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t12" ON "t11"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t12"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" WHERE ((("t12"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('M8170/3', 'M8170/6', 'M8171/3', 'M8172/3', 'M8173/3', 'M8174/3', 'M8175/3', 'M8180/3') AND "t6"."DT_YEAR" >= 2008) AND ("t2"."HitCol1" <> 0 AND "t3"."DT_YEAR" >= 2008)) AND (("t4"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('452') AND "t7"."DT_YEAR" >= 2008) OR ("t5"."HitCol1" <> 0 AND YEAR("t5"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE") >= 2008)))

prompt: Schedule a weekly report of inpatient discharges from the previous week with a 'Pain APS Telemedicine on Discharge' order.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", VIS_VISIT_ID, VIS_ADM_NUM, OO_ADM_NUM, VIS_ADM_DTE AS "Admission Date", VIS_DSCH_DTE AS "Discharge Date", VISIT_STATUS_DESC, OO_ENTER_DTE AS "Order Date", OO_ORD_ID, STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME) AS "Order Name" FROM IDB.VISIT_V JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN = VIS_MRN AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000014114100730' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND VIS_DSCH_DTE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON VIS_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_DSCH_DTE >= CURRENT date - 7 DAY ) , CMP AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Nurse Practitioner') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'ANS' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'PAIN' AND CPE_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) ) , SCH AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Nurse Practitioner') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'ANS' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'PAIN' AND CPE_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) ) SELECT DISTINCT X.*, CMP.CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Last Anes Pain Clinic Appt", STRIP(CMP.CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Last Anes Pain Clinic LIP", SCH.CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Next Anes Pain Clinic Appt", STRIP(SCH.CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Next Anes Pain Clinic LIP", CPP_HOME_PHONE AS "Home Phone", CPP_MOBILE_PHONE AS "Mobile Phone" FROM X LEFT JOIN CMP ON X.MRN = CMP.MRN AND CMP.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN SCH ON X.MRN = SCH.MRN AND SCH.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON X.MRN = CPP_MRN

prompt: Modify and update current Clintrac EM coders publication, modify and update source report , modify index report to reflect latest changes
completion: SELECT CV_MRN, CV_ADM_DTE, CV_SVC, CV_ACCT_NO, DAYS_DELQ, LOS, DAYS_HELD, ADMIT_DX, ADM_DX_DESC, CV_DSCH_DTE, RPT_PAT_NAME, RFD_FSC_NAME AS PRIM_INS, PRIORITY, INCOMPLETE_DOCUMENTS, TDO, X.TDORANGE, X.TDO_CODER_LOGON, X.TDO_CODER_NAME, X.TDO_CODER_EMAIL, BEGDTE, ENDDTE, DAYEND, RUNDTE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT A.CV_MRN, A.CV_ADM_DTE, A.CV_SVC, CASE WHEN A.CV_ACCT_NO > ' ' THEN A.CV_ACCT_NO ELSE A.CV_CTC_VISIT_NO END AS CV_ACCT_NO, DAYS(CURRENT_DATE) - 7 - DAYS(VALUE(A.CV_DSCH_DTE, A.CV_ADM_DTE)) AS DAYS_DELQ, DAYS(A.CV_DSCH_DTE) - DAYS(A.CV_ADM_DTE) AS LOS, DAYS(CURRENT_DATE) - DAYS(A.CV_DSCH_DTE) AS DAYS_HELD, A.CV_ADM_DX AS ADMIT_DX, SUBSTR(CLM_CTC_DESC, 1, 50) AS ADM_DX_DESC, A.CV_DSCH_DTE, RPT_PAT_NAME, RFD_FSC_NAME, MAX(CASE WHEN CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE 'Cell Infusion%' OR EAD_DOCTYPE IN ('KS1', 'F58', 'F59') THEN 'B' WHEN DAYS(CURRENT_DATE) - 14 - DAYS(A.CV_ADM_DTE) >= 0 THEN '*' END) AS PRIORITY, CHAR(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN A.CV_ADM_DTE AND A.CV_DSCH_DTE THEN CDD_DOC_GUID END)) AS INCOMPLETE_DOCUMENTS, SUBSTR(A.CV_MRN, 6, 3) AS TDO, CASE WHEN A.CV_SVC IN ('UCC', 'UCO') THEN 'UCC-UCO' WHEN INTEGER(SUBSTR(A.CV_MRN, 6, 3)) BETWEEN 0 AND 70 THEN '000-070' WHEN INTEGER(SUBSTR(A.CV_MRN, 6, 3)) BETWEEN 71 AND 141 THEN '071-141' WHEN INTEGER(SUBSTR(A.CV_MRN, 6, 3)) BETWEEN 142 AND 212 THEN '142-212' WHEN INTEGER(SUBSTR(A.CV_MRN, 6, 3)) BETWEEN 213 AND 283 THEN '213-283' WHEN INTEGER(SUBSTR(A.CV_MRN, 6, 3)) BETWEEN 284 AND 354 THEN '284-354' WHEN INTEGER(SUBSTR(A.CV_MRN, 6, 3)) BETWEEN 355 AND 425 THEN '355-425' WHEN INTEGER(SUBSTR(A.CV_MRN, 6, 3)) BETWEEN 426 AND 496 THEN '426-496' WHEN INTEGER(SUBSTR(A.CV_MRN, 6, 3)) BETWEEN 497 AND 567 THEN '497-567' WHEN INTEGER(SUBSTR(A.CV_MRN, 6, 3)) BETWEEN 568 AND 639 THEN '568-639' WHEN INTEGER(SUBSTR(A.CV_MRN, 6, 3)) BETWEEN 640 AND 711 THEN '640-711' WHEN INTEGER(SUBSTR(A.CV_MRN, 6, 3)) BETWEEN 712 AND 783 THEN '712-783' WHEN INTEGER(SUBSTR(A.CV_MRN, 6, 3)) BETWEEN 784 AND 855 THEN '784-855' WHEN INTEGER(SUBSTR(A.CV_MRN, 6, 3)) BETWEEN 856 AND 927 THEN '856-927' WHEN INTEGER(SUBSTR(A.CV_MRN, 6, 3)) BETWEEN 928 AND 999 THEN '928-999' END AS TDORANGE, CURRENT_DATE - 12 MONTHS AS BEGDTE, CURRENT_DATE - 1 DAY AS ENDDTE, CURRENT_DATE - 1 DAY AS DAYEND, CURRENT_DATE AS RUNDTE FROM IDB.CTC_VISIT A LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.CTC_VISIT C ON A.CV_MRN = C.CV_MRN AND A.CV_SVC = 'UCC' AND C.CV_SVC = 'UCO' AND C.CV_CTC_VISIT_TYPE = 'E' AND A.CV_ADM_DTE = C.CV_ADM_DTE LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT ON RV_MRN = A.CV_MRN AND RV_ADM_NUM = A.CV_ADM_NUM LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.RMS_FSC_DICT_DN19 ON RV_PRIMARY_VISIT_FSC_REC_NO = RFD_RECORD_NUMBER LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.RMS_PATIENT ON RPT_MRN = A.CV_MRN LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = A.CV_ADM_DX LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = A.CV_MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= A.CV_ADM_DTE - 60 DAYS AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND (CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE 'Cell Infusion%' OR CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '1') LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.EMR_AA_DOCUMENT ON EAD_MRN = A.CV_MRN AND EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE >= A.CV_ADM_DTE - 60 DAYS AND EAD_DOCTYPE IN ('KS1', 'F58', 'F59') LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = A.CV_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE = A.CV_ADM_DTE AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_DEPT_ID = 230 AND A.CV_SVC = 'UCC' WHERE NOT (VALUE(RV_DSCH_TYPE_REC_NO, 0) = 2 OR A.CV_CODING_STS IN ('X', 'O') OR (TIMESTAMP(A.CV_ADM_DTE, A.CV_ADM_TME) =TIMESTAMP(A.CV_DSCH_DTE, A.CV_DSCH_TME) AND A.CV_SVC <> 'UCC')) AND (A.CV_SVC <> 'UCC' OR CPE_MRN IS NOT NULL) AND A.CV_CTC_VISIT_TYPE = 'E' AND A.CV_FINALIZED_IND = 'N' AND A.CV_ADM_DTE >= CURRENT_DATE - 12 MONTHS AND COALESCE(A.CV_CODING_STS, ' ') <> 'R' AND C.CV_MRN IS NULL GROUP BY RPT_PAT_NAME, A.CV_MRN, A.CV_ACCT_NO, A.CV_ADM_DTE, A.CV_SVC, RFD_FSC_NAME, A.CV_CTC_VISIT_NO, A.CV_DSCH_DTE, A.CV_ADM_DX, SUBSTR(CLM_CTC_DESC, 1, 50)) AS HIMIP JOIN IDCIC.HIMVP_TDORANGE_D_PY X ON HIMIP.TDORANGE = X.TDORANGE

prompt: Provide a list of patients admitted with diagnosis of cellulitis; and respective discharge diagnoses for these patients; as well as annotation for patients who had an alternate discharge diagnosis.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CV_MRN, CV_VISIT_NO, MIN(CV_ADM_DTE) OVER(PARTITION BY CV_VISIT_NO) AS CV_ADM_DTE, MIN(TIMESTAMP(CV_ADM_DTE, CV_ADM_TME)) OVER(PARTITION BY CV_VISIT_NO) AS CV_ADM_DT, MAX(CV_DSCH_DTE) OVER(PARTITION BY CV_VISIT_NO) AS CV_DSCH_DTE, MAX(TIMESTAMP(CV_DSCH_DTE, CV_DSCH_TME)) OVER(PARTITION BY CV_VISIT_NO) AS CV_DSCH_DT, CV_CTC_VISIT_TYPE, CC_CLSF_TYPE, D.AV_DESC AS DX_TYPE, CC_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC AS DX_DESC, CV_RMS_VISIT_TYPE FROM IDB.CTC_VISIT JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CV_VISIT_ID = CC_VISIT_ID JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS D ON D.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLSF_TYPE' AND D.AV_CODE = CC_CLSF_TYPE WHERE CV_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND (CV_CTC_VISIT_TYPE = 'I' OR CV_SVC IN ('UCC', 'UCO')) ) , LAB AS (SELECT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_PERFORMED_DT, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LTL_TEXT_RESULT FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('WBC', 'Neutrophil') AND LR_RESULT_VALUE <> 'NOT MEASURED' AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' ) SELECT PT_MRN , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , YEAR(C.CV_ADM_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE_AT_ADMIT , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) CONCAT ', ' CONCAT TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME , C.CV_VISIT_NO AS VISIT_ID , C.CV_ADM_DTE AS ADMISSION_DATE , C.CV_DSCH_DTE AS DISCHARGE_DATE , TRIM(D.DX_CODE) AS DX_CODE , TRIM(D.DX_DESC) AS DX_DESC , W.LR_RESULT_VALUE AS WBC , W.LR_PERFORMED_DT AS WBC_TIME , N.LR_RESULT_VALUE AS ANC , N.LR_PERFORMED_DT AS ANC_TIME FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN DX C ON PT_MRN = C.CV_MRN AND C.CC_CLSF_TYPE = 'DA' AND SUBSTR(C.DX_CODE, 1, 3) = 'L03' JOIN DX D ON PT_MRN = D.CV_MRN AND C.CV_VISIT_NO = D.CV_VISIT_NO AND SUBSTR(D.CC_CLSF_TYPE, 1, 2) = 'DF' LEFT JOIN LAB W ON PT_MRN = W.LR_MRN AND W.LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN C.CV_ADM_DTE AND C.CV_DSCH_DTE AND W.LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'WBC' LEFT JOIN LAB N ON PT_MRN = N.LR_MRN AND N.LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN C.CV_ADM_DTE AND C.CV_DSCH_DTE AND N.LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Neutrophil' ; SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_AUTHORED_DTE, SUBSTR(STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 255) AS TEMPERATURE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME like '%Vital%' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Temperature F' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' ; SELECT OO_MRN, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_CTLG_CLASS_TYP HVC ON HVC.OCCT_MST_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND HVC.OCCT_CLASS_TYPE_CD ='HVC-OrderCategory' WHERE (HVC.OCCT_VALUE = 'Anti-Infectives' OR OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000007599200730', '9000008145100730', '9000006598100730', '9000006188200730', '4813073029')) AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OOC_ITEM_NAME NOT LIKE '%Placebo%' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2018-12-31'

prompt: Count of the Lab and Radiology orders that were requested by a Head and Neck Surgeons for 2009.
completion: SELECT DOCSVC, PROVIDER, SETNAME, ORDNAME, DEPT, COUNT(*) CNT FROM (SELECT OO_MRN MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE ENTERDATE, OO_ORD_STS_CD ORDSTS , OP_DISPLAY_NAME PROVIDER, STRIP(OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE) PVDRROLE , DOC_SVC DOCSVC, OO_SET_NAME SETNAME , OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT DEPT, SUBSTR(STRIP(CASE WHEN OO_ORD_NAME = 'Outside Radiology Order' THEN CASE WHEN RO.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE = 'Other' AND RI.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE IS NOT NULL THEN RI.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE COALESCE(RO.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, OO_ORD_NAME) END WHEN COALESCE(MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN COALESCE(MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%:%' THEN COALESCE(MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) ELSE STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME)||': '|| COALESCE(MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) END ELSE OO_ORD_NAME END), 1, 155) AS ORDNAME FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = OO_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = OU_USER_GUID AND OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE = 'Attending' JOIN IDB.DOC ON OP_PVDR_NO = DOC_DR_NO AND DOC_SVC = 'HNS' JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT IN ('Laboratory', 'Radiology') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA CR ON CR.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA CR ON CR.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND CR.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Order - Current' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA MD ON MD.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND MD.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Order - Modified' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA RO ON RO.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND RO.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Rad_Outside_Test' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA RI ON RI.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND RI.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RDR_Info' WHERE OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2009-12-31' AND OO_ACCT_NO NOT LIKE '84%' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3', 'HOLD', 'DISC') ) ORDS GROUP BY DOCSVC, PROVIDER, SETNAME, ORDNAME, DEPT

prompt: Provide mets, latest tx and fold change for MDM2 mutated pts
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V EX ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = EX.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AND EX.GENE IN ('TP53') JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-score' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-type' , TMB_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score' , TMB_COUNT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb-count', COSMIC_ID VARCHAR(5000) PATH 'cosmic_id') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('NSCLC,GRC,BLAD,UA,UAD,PAAD,MEL', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = TRIM(X.TTC) WHERE 1=1 AND (INC.GENE IN ('MDM2') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('MDM2')) AND INC.FOLD_CHANGE <= 5 AND INC.FOLD_CHANGE >= 2 AND EX.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID IS NULL ) , DT_3 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') AND YEAR(COALESCE(PT_DEATH_DTE, CURRENT date) - PT_BIRTH_DTE) >= 18 ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P_ID) FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3 ) ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V EX ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = EX.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AND EX.GENE IN ('TP53') JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-score' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-type' , TMB_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score' , TMB_COUNT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb-count', COSMIC_ID VARCHAR(5000) PATH 'cosmic_id') T LEFT JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('BRAIN', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = TRIM(X.TTC) WHERE 1=1 AND (' ' || LOWER(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) || ' ' like '%' || LOWER(' sarcoma ') || '%') AND (INC.GENE IN ('MDM2') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('MDM2')) AND INC.FOLD_CHANGE > 0 AND EX.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID IS NULL AND X.TTC IS NULL ) , DT_3 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') AND YEAR(COALESCE(PT_DEATH_DTE, CURRENT date) - PT_BIRTH_DTE) >= 18 ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P_ID) FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3 ); WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V EX ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = EX.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AND EX.GENE IN ('TP53') JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-score' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-type' , TMB_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score' , TMB_COUNT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb-count', COSMIC_ID VARCHAR(5000) PATH 'cosmic_id') T LEFT JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('BRAIN', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = TRIM(X.TTC) WHERE 1=1 AND NOT(' ' || LOWER(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) || ' ' like '%' || LOWER(' sarcoma ') || '%') AND (INC.GENE IN ('MDM2') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('MDM2')) AND INC.FOLD_CHANGE >= 6 AND CASE WHEN LOCATE('heme', LOWER(INC.METHOD)) > 0 OR LOCATE('liquid', LOWER(INC.METHOD)) > 0 OR LOCATE('RDTB', INC.METHOD) >0 THEN 'liquid' ELSE 'solid' END IN ('solid') AND EX.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID IS NULL AND X.TTC IS NULL ) , DT_3 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') AND YEAR(COALESCE(PT_DEATH_DTE, CURRENT date) - PT_BIRTH_DTE) >= 18 ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P_ID) FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3 )

prompt: Patients who underwent hip surgery from January 1, 1995 to February 1, 2020.
completion: WITH SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2019-11-14' AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('27235', '27244', '27245', '27248', '27187', '27125', '27130') ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) FIRST_START_DTE, MAX(APR_START_DTE) LAST_START_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN SRG ON SSE_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) = 'BEVACIZUMAB' GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_SEX "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of Death", PLA_LST_APPT_DTE "Last Appt Date", SSE_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD "CPT Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC "CPT Description", TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) "Surgeon", CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME "Chemo Name", FIRST_START_DTE "Chemo First Start Date", LAST_START_DTE "Chemo Last Start Date" FROM SRG JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON SSE_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON SSE_MRN = APR_MRN ORDER BY PT_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE ; WITH SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2019-11-14' AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('27235', '27244', '27245', '27248', '27187', '27125', '27130') ) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME "Chemo Name", APR_START_DTE "Chemo Start Date", APR_END_DTE "Chemo End Date", APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE "Prescribed Dose" FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN SRG ON SSE_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) = 'BEVACIZUMAB' ORDER BY APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE ; WITH SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2019-11-14' AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('27235', '27244', '27245', '27248', '27187', '27125', '27130') ) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN SRG ON TM_MRN = SSE_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", SSE_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD "CPT Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC "CPT Description", TM_DX_DTE "Tumor Dx Date", TM_HIST_CD "Histology Code", HIST_DESC "Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD "Site Code", SITE_DESC "Site Description" FROM SRG JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON SSE_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN DX ON SSE_MRN = TM_MRN ORDER BY PT_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, TM_DX_DTE

prompt: Provide a Darwin Notification every week of patients who are scheduled for lab appointments in the upcoming 3 weeks that carry an NRG1 fusion aberration.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT A.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V A JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS B ON A.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = B.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND (GENE = 'NRG1' OR GENE2 = 'NRG1') AND PT_VITAL_STATUS = 'ALIVE' ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT P_ID FROM PTS)

prompt: Basic and complete metabolic counts for locally advanced non-small cell lung cancer.
Provide a list of patients scheduled for a radical prostatectomy within the next 3 weeks.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT OC_CASE_ID, OC_MRN, OC_SURG_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CPX_PROC_CD, CPX_PROC_NAME, OP_OR_PROC_ID, OP_PROC_NAME, OCP_OR_PROC_ID, OCP_LINE_NO, OCP_PROC_ID FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID WHERE OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 21 DAYS AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND(CPX_PROC_CD IN ('55801', '55810', '55812', '55815', '55821', '55831', '55840', '55842', '55845', '55862', '55865', '55866') OR CPX_PROC_NAME LIKE '%PROSTATECTOMY%' OR CPX_PROC_NAME LIKE '%PRSTECT%' OR OP_PROC_NAME LIKE '%PROSTATECTOMY%') AND CRE_RES_NAME IN ('DONAHUE, TIMOTHY FRANCIS', 'EASTHAM, JAMES', 'EHDAIE, BEHFAR', 'GOH, ALVIN CHUN CHIN', 'LAUDONE, VINCENT P', 'PIETZAK, EUGENE', 'SMITH, ROBERT CHARLES', 'TOUIJER, KARIM A', 'MATULEWICZ, RICHARD STEVEN') ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(OC_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", OC_SURG_DTE AS "Prostatectomy Date", STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Surgeon Name" FROM X JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OC_MRN = PT_MRN) , LAST_APPT1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM Y JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_NAME = 'RES UROLOGY SURG' ) , LAST_APPT2 AS (SELECT * FROM LAST_APPT1 WHERE RN = 1 ) , NEXT_APPT1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM Y JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND(CRE_RES_NAME = 'RES UROLOGY SURG' OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'URO') ) , NEXT_APPT2 AS (SELECT * FROM NEXT_APPT1 ) , AC AS (SELECT AC_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '11-096' THEN 'Y' END) AS "11-096", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN 'Y' END) AS "06-107" FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PT_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE AC_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM Y) AND AC_IRB_NO IN ('11-096', '06-107') GROUP BY AC_MRN ) , ARM1 AS (SELECT SUBJECT_MRN, PROTOCOL_NO, STEP_CODE, STRIP(ARM_DESCRIPTION) || ' (' || STRIP(ARM_CODE) || ')' AS ARM_DESC, DATE(ON_ARM_DATE) AS ON_ARM_DATE, DATE(ON_TREATMENT_DATE) AS ON_TX_DATE, DATE(OFF_ARM_DATE) AS OFF_ARM_DATE FROM NN.SV_SUB_TREATMENT WHERE SUBJECT_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM Y) AND PROTOCOL_NO IN ('11-096', '06-107') ORDER BY SUBJECT_MRN, PROTOCOL_NO, ARM_DESCRIPTION ) , ARM2 AS (SELECT SUBJECT_MRN, LISTAGG(TRIM(PROTOCOL_NO) || ' ' || TRIM(ARM_DESC), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) AS ARM FROM ARM1 GROUP BY SUBJECT_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT Y.*, LA2.CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Last URO SRG Appt Date", STRIP(LA2.CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Last URO Physician", NA2.CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Next URO SRG Appt Date", STRIP(NA2.CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Next URO Physician", STRIP(NA2.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Next URO Visit Type", STRIP(NA2.CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS "Next URO Dept", "11-096", "06-107", ARM FROM Y LEFT JOIN LAST_APPT2 LA2 ON MRN = LA2.CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN NEXT_APPT2 NA2 ON MRN = NA2.CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN AC ON MRN = AC_MRN LEFT JOIN ARM2 ON MRN = SUBJECT_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of inpatient and outpatient procedures performed (excluding BMM, Anesthesia Services) and presence/absence of Brief Op Note and Operative Report.
completion: WITH SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME)||','||TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, SSE_PT_TYPE, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM)||','||TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) AS SURGEON_NAME, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE SSE_SURG_DTE = CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD NOT IN ('ANES', 'BMM') ), BOP AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS OP_NOTE_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DT AS OP_NOTE_DATE, CDD_SIGNED_DT AS BOP_SIGNED_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME AS OP_NOTE_DOC_NAME, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)Primary:[\w\W]*(?=Procedure Details:)', UPPER(CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT)) AS "Provider" FROM SURG JOIN DV.CLINDOC_FULL_TEXT_V ON SSE_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE 'BRIEF OPERATIVE NOTE%' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE = SSE_SURG_DTE ) , OPR AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS OP_REPORT_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DT AS OP_REPORT_DATE, CDD_SIGNED_DT AS OP_SIGNED_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME AS OP_REPORT_DOC_NAME FROM SURG JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON SSE_MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE 'OPERATIVE REPORT%' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE = SSE_SURG_DTE ) , POR AS (SELECT DISTINCT PATIENT_MRN, CASE_OPERATING_ROOM_ABRV, TOES_OUT_TIME_ACTUAL FROM SURG JOIN IDB.PERIOP_CASE_EVENT_V ON SSE_MRN = PATIENT_MRN AND CASE_SURGERY_DTE = SSE_SURG_DTE) , ENDO AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN ENDO_MRN, MRPT_PERFORMED_DTE ENDOSCOPY_PERFORMED_DATE, RCI_ITEM_NAME ENDOSCOPY_DOC_NAME, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)Attending Participation:[\w\W]*(?=Number of Addenda:)', UPPER(MRPT_MED_REPORT_TXT)) AS "ENDO Report Signed Date/Time", VARCHAR(MRPT_MED_REPORT_TXT, 32000) ENDOSCOPY_REPORT_TEXT FROM DV.MEDICAL_REPORTS JOIN DV.RESULT_CATALOG_ITEM ON MPRT_RESULT_CATALOG_ITEM_ID = RCI_RESULT_CATALOG_ITEM_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON MRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN SURG ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE (RCI_MASTER_CATEGORY = 'Endoscopy' OR RCI_ITEM_NAME = 'Pulm-Bronchoscopy') AND MRPT_PERFORMED_DTE = SSE_SURG_DTE ) , IR AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN IR_MRN, MRPT_PERFORMED_DTE IR_PERFORMED_DATE, RCI_ITEM_NAME IR_DOC_NAME, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)Electronically Signed By:[\w\W]*(?=ACC NUMBER:)', UPPER(MRPT_MED_REPORT_TXT)) AS "IR Report Signed Date/Time", VARCHAR(MRPT_MED_REPORT_TXT, 32000) IR_REPORT_TEXT FROM DV.MEDICAL_REPORTS JOIN DV.RESULT_CATALOG_ITEM ON MPRT_RESULT_CATALOG_ITEM_ID = RCI_RESULT_CATALOG_ITEM_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON MRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN SURG ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE RCI_ITEM_NAME = 'IR' AND MRPT_PERFORMED_DTE = SSE_SURG_DTE ) SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN AS MRN, PATIENT_NAME AS "Patient Name", SSE_PT_TYPE AS "Patient Type", SSE_SURG_DTE AS "Surgery Date", SSP_SURG_SVC_CD AS "Surgery Service Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS "Surgery Procedure Description", SURGEON_NAME AS "Surgeon Name", CASE WHEN OP_NOTE_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Brief Op Note Indicator(Y/N)", OP_NOTE_DATE AS "Brief Op Note Service Date", OP_NOTE_DOC_NAME AS "Brief Op Note Document Name", BOP_SIGNED_DTE AS "Brief Op Note Signed Date/Time", "Provider" AS "Brief Op Note Provider Information", CASE WHEN OP_REPORT_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Operative Report Indicator(Y/N)", OP_REPORT_DATE AS "Operative Report Service Date", OP_REPORT_DOC_NAME AS "Operative Report Document Name", OP_SIGNED_DTE AS "Operative Report Signed Date/Time", CASE_OPERATING_ROOM_ABRV AS "Operating Room Location", TOES_OUT_TIME_ACTUAL AS "Patient out of Room", CASE WHEN ENDO_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Endoscopy Indicator(Y/N)", ENDOSCOPY_PERFORMED_DATE AS "Endoscopy Performed Date", ENDOSCOPY_DOC_NAME AS "Endoscopy Doc Name", "ENDO Report Signed Date/Time", CASE WHEN IR_PERFORMED_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Interventional Radiology Indicator(Y/N)", IR_PERFORMED_DATE AS "Interventional Radiology Performed Date", IR_DOC_NAME AS "Interventional Radiology Doc Name", "IR Report Signed Date/Time" FROM SURG LEFT JOIN BOP ON OP_NOTE_MRN = SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN OPR ON OP_REPORT_MRN = SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN POR ON PATIENT_MRN = SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN ENDO ON ENDO_MRN = SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN IR ON IR_MRN = SSE_MRN ORDER BY SSE_MRN

prompt: All new or return patients treated for testicular cancer in the department of Urology or department of Medical oncology receive the survey "Testicular Cancer Questionnaire" via MSKEngage.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT EPI_MRN, STRIP(EPI_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(EPI_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", A.EA_ASSESS_ID AS "Assessment ID", EA_SURV_ID AS "Survery ID", STRIP(ES_SURV_NAME) AS "Survey Name", STRIP(EAS_ASSESS_STS) AS "Assessment Status", CASE WHEN EAS_ASSESS_STS = 'To Do' THEN 'Not yet opened' WHEN EAS_ASSESS_STS = 'Missed' THEN 'Survey expired because the patientd did not complete it' WHEN EAS_ASSESS_STS = 'In Progress' THEN 'They started it but not yet completed' WHEN EAS_ASSESS_STS = 'Cancelled 'THEN 'The appointment was cancelled which would then mean the survey is cancelled' WHEN EAS_ASSESS_STS = 'Read Only' THEN 'Just opened and read it' WHEN EAS_ASSESS_STS = 'Completed' THEN 'Completed and Submitted' END AS STATUS, DATE(EA_SUBM_DT) AS "Submission Date", DATE(EA_ASSIGN_DT) AS "Assignment Date", DATE(EA_EXPIRY_DT) AS "Expiry Date" FROM IDB.EF_PATIENT_INFO PT JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT A ON A.EA_PT_INFO_ID = PT.EPI_PT_INFO_ID JOIN IDB.EF_SURVEY S ON A.EA_SURV_ID = S.ES_SURV_ID JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT_STS AS STS ON A.EA_STS_ID = STS.EAS_ASSESS_STS_ID WHERE 1=1 AND ES_SURV_NAME IN ('Testicular Cancer Questionnaire'); SELECT DISTINCT EPI_MRN, STRIP(EPI_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(EPI_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", EA_SURV_ID AS "Survery ID", STRIP(ES_SURV_NAME) AS "Survey Name", EF.EF_FORM_ALIAS AS "Survey Alias Name", STRIP(EAS_ASSESS_STS) AS "Assessment Status", EFI_ITEM_TEXT AS "QUESTIONS", LEFT(EFI_VALUE, 400) AS "ANSWERS", CASE WHEN EAS_ASSESS_STS = 'To Do' THEN 'Not yet opened' WHEN EAS_ASSESS_STS = 'Missed' THEN 'Survey expired because the patientd did not complete it' WHEN EAS_ASSESS_STS = 'In Progress' THEN 'They started it but not yet completed' WHEN EAS_ASSESS_STS = 'Cancelled 'THEN 'The appointment was cancelled which would then mean the survey is cancelled' WHEN EAS_ASSESS_STS = 'Read Only' THEN 'Just opened and read it' WHEN EAS_ASSESS_STS = 'Completed' THEN 'Completed and Submitted' END AS STATUS, STRIP(EC_COHORT_DESC) AS "Cohort Description", DATE(EA_SUBM_DT) AS "Submission Date", DATE(EA_ASSIGN_DT) AS "Assignment Date", DATE(EA_EXPIRY_DT) AS "Expiry Date" FROM IDB.EF_PATIENT_INFO PT JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT A ON A.EA_PT_INFO_ID = PT.EPI_PT_INFO_ID JOIN IDB.EF_SURVEY S ON A.EA_SURV_ID = S.ES_SURV_ID JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT_STS AS STS ON A.EA_STS_ID = STS.EAS_ASSESS_STS_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON EPI_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM EF ON A.EA_SURV_ID = EF.EF_SURVEY_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM EI ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT_DTL AD ON A.EA_ASSESS_DTL_ID = AD.EAD_ASSESS_DTL_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_SCHEDULING_RULE B ON ESR_SCHED_RULE_ID = EA_SCHED_RULE_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_COHORT C ON ESR_COHORT_ID = EC_COHORT_ID WHERE 1=1 AND ES_SURV_NAME IN ('Testicular Cancer Questionnaire') AND EAS_ASSESS_STS = 'Completed' ; WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT EPI_MRN, STRIP(EPI_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(EPI_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", EA_SURV_ID AS "Survery ID", STRIP(ES_SURV_NAME) AS "Survey Name", EF.EF_FORM_ALIAS AS "Survey Alias Name", STRIP(EAS_ASSESS_STS) AS "Assessment Status", EFI_ITEM_TEXT AS "QUESTIONS", LEFT(EFI_VALUE, 400) AS "ANSWERS", CASE WHEN EAS_ASSESS_STS = 'To Do' THEN 'Not yet opened' WHEN EAS_ASSESS_STS = 'Missed' THEN 'Survey expired because the patientd did not complete it' WHEN EAS_ASSESS_STS = 'In Progress' THEN 'They started it but not yet completed' WHEN EAS_ASSESS_STS = 'Cancelled 'THEN 'The appointment was cancelled which would then mean the survey is cancelled' WHEN EAS_ASSESS_STS = 'Read Only' THEN 'Just opened and read it' WHEN EAS_ASSESS_STS = 'Completed' THEN 'Completed and Submitted' END AS STATUS, STRIP(EC_COHORT_DESC) AS "Cohort Description", DATE(EA_SUBM_DT) AS "Submission Date", DATE(EA_ASSIGN_DT) AS "Assignment Date", DATE(EA_EXPIRY_DT) AS "Expiry Date" FROM IDB.EF_PATIENT_INFO PT JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT A ON A.EA_PT_INFO_ID = PT.EPI_PT_INFO_ID JOIN IDB.EF_SURVEY S ON A.EA_SURV_ID = S.ES_SURV_ID JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT_STS AS STS ON A.EA_STS_ID = STS.EAS_ASSESS_STS_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON EPI_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM EF ON A.EA_SURV_ID = EF.EF_SURVEY_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM EI ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT_DTL AD ON A.EA_ASSESS_DTL_ID = AD.EAD_ASSESS_DTL_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_SCHEDULING_RULE B ON ESR_SCHED_RULE_ID = EA_SCHED_RULE_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_COHORT C ON ESR_COHORT_ID = EC_COHORT_ID WHERE 1=1 AND ES_SURV_NAME IN ('Testicular Cancer Questionnaire') AND EAS_ASSESS_STS = 'Completed' ) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, "Name", "Survey Alias Name", APR_START_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME FROM X LEFT JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON EPI_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME;

prompt: Identify patients diagnosed within the past 10 years who match the diagnoses of 10 case patients.
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_CODE)) DXCC_ICD_CODE, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC)) DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_CODE)) || ' - ' || LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC)) AS DXCC_CODE_AND_MSK_DESC, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_NATIONAL_DESC)) DXCC_ICD_NATIONAL_DESC, DXCC_DESC_LONG, CASE WHEN DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '196' AND '196.99' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '197' AND '197.99' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '198' AND '198.99' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS DXCC_METS_INDICATOR, DXCC_CREATED_DT, DXCC_CREATED_BY, DXCC_MODIFIED_DT FROM DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG WHERE DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD9' ) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-9 Final Dx Code", "t2"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-9 Final Dx Description", "t1"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "ICD-9 Final Diagnosis Date", DV.TBS_AVAIL("t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") AS "Tissue Bank Sample Available", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "First Order Start Date", "t6"."DT_DTE" AS "Last Order Stop Date", "t7"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" AS "Generic Drug Name", "t8"."POA_ROUTE_DESC" AS "Route of Administration" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t9" ON "t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t2" ON "t9"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t9"."PDX_DX_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t10" ON "t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t10"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t10"."FIST_START_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t6" ON "t10"."LAST_STOP_DATE_ID" = "t6"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t11" ON "t10"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t11"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t10"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t11"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t7" ON "t11"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t7"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_ATTR" "t8" ON "t11"."POD_PHARMA_ORD_ATTR_ID" = "t8"."POA_PHARMA_ORDER_ATTR_ID" WHERE ("t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('189', '189.0', '189.1', '189.2', '189.3', '189.4', '189.8', '189.9') AND ("t1"."PT_SEX_DESC" = 'MALE' AND ("t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" BETWEEN '1953-1-1' AND '1963-12-31' AND ("t3"."DT_DTE" >= '2004-1-15' AND DV.TBS_AVAIL("t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") = 'YES'))))

prompt: New patients/consultations seen in the pediatric oncology department between 07/01/2020-09/30/2021 with filter for patients who continued care at MSK Kids. List of weight, height and BMI with corresponding dates for filtered patients.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS CPE_MRN1 FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('PED') AND CLD_DEPT_NAME IN (UCASE('Peds Leu Lym 1275'), UCASE('Peds Neuroblast 1275'), UCASE('Peds Sarcoma 1275'), UCASE('Peds Neuro Onc 1275')) AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-07-01' AND '2021-09-30' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') ), PTS2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN PTS ON CPE_MRN=CPE_MRN1 WHERE CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('PED') AND CLD_DEPT_NAME IN (UCASE('Peds Leu Lym 1275'), UCASE('Peds Neuroblast 1275'), UCASE('Peds Sarcoma 1275'), UCASE('Peds Neuro Onc 1275')) AND NOT (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-07-01' AND '2021-09-30' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived')) , MEASURES AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, PMH_MEASURE_DTE, PMH_WT_KG, PMH_HT_CM, PMH_BMI FROM PTS2 LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX ON CPE_MRN=PMH_MRN AND PMH_MEASURE_DTE BETWEEN '2020-07-01' AND '2021-09-30') SELECT * FROM MEASURES ORDER BY 1, 2

prompt: Requesting a monthly list of English-speaking patients treated in one of the MSK outpatient regional sites who are completing radiation oncology treatment, or are starting hormonal therapy, as identified by the PEDF notes "Radiation Therapy - Completed" or "Hormonal Therapy-initiated" I was not able to identify a note type indicating end of chemotherapy, though that would be desirable.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END AS AGE, CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS VITAL_STATUS, AV_DESC AS PRIMARY_LANG, PLA_LST_ACTV_DTE AS LAST_ACTIVE_DATE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS DEPARTMENT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS SERVICE_TYPE, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER AS CENTER, AV_DESC AS PRIMARY_LANG, VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON PT_MRN = VIS_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_CODE = PT_PRIMARY_LANG AND AV_ELEMENT = 'PRIMARY_LANG' LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID WHERE 1 = 1 AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RDO' AND UPPER(CLD_CLD_CENTER)IN ('WES', 'CMK', 'BER', 'MON', 'NAS') AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'O' AND PT_PRIMARY_LANG = 'ENG' AND (CDD_DOC_NAME = 'PEDF - Hormonal Therapy-Completed' OR CDD_DOC_NAME = 'PEDF - Hormonal Therapy-Initiated') AND YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 AND PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A'), 'MON', 'NAS'

prompt: Breast Examination Center of Harlem patients not seen since December 31st 2002
completion: SELECT * FROM (SELECT MRN, CL_LAST_NAME, CL_FIRST_NAME, CL_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CL_DEATH_IND, MAX(APPT_DTE) AS LAST_APPT FROM (SELECT APPT_MRN AS MRN, APPT_SCH_DTE AS APPT_DTE FROM IDB.APPOINTMENT WHERE APPT_RES_SVC = 'BECH' AND APPT_APPT_STS_CD IN (50, 55) UNION SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'BECH' WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') ) AS X JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CL_MRN = MRN GROUP BY MRN, CL_LAST_NAME, CL_FIRST_NAME, CL_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CL_DEATH_IND) AS Y WHERE LAST_APPT < '2003-01-01' OR CL_DEATH_IND IN ('C', 'D', 'X')

prompt: We are identifying all patients who had a primary nodal diffuse large B cell lymphoma and then had a secondary Central nervous system relapse and have tissue available (with consent available) for sequencing to see if there is molecular evolution between nodal tissue and brain or spinal tissue at relapse.
completion: WITH DEMOGRAPHICS AS (SELECT DISTINCT IDB.PATIENT_V.PT_MRN ,(TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME)) CONCAT ', ' CONCAT (TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME)) PT_NAME, CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) ELSE YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END "PT_CURR/DEATH_AGE", PT_SEX_DESC PT_GENDER, PT_RACE_DESC PT_RACE , PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC PT_ETHNICITY , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') THEN 'ALIVE' ELSE 'DECEASED' END AS PT_VITAL_STS , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, CASE WHEN AC_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END "CONSENTED_12-245", CASE WHEN DMP.PT_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END IMPACT_TESTING FROM IDB.PATIENT_V JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON IDB.PATIENT_V.PT_MRN = AC_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON IDB.PATIENT_V.PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT PT_MRN, PDWS_NAME FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT') DMP ON IDB.PATIENT_V.PT_MRN = DMP.PT_MRN WHERE 1 = 1 AND AC_CONS_DTE BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE ), CNS_LYMP AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT, PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME, PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC_DESC FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE 1 = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("central nervous system lymphoma")') > 0 ) SELECT DEMOGRAPHICS.* FROM DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN CNS_LYMP ON PT_MRN = PRPT_MRNRVOUS SYSTEM LYMPHOMA")') > 0

prompt: Provide a weekly list of patients who are consented to 12-245, have upcoming chemo appointments in thoracic oncology, and have been seen by a thoracic surgeon.
completion: SELECT TRIM(P.CPE_MRN) AS "MRN", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) AS "Last Name", TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "DOB", TRIM(T.CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Thoracic Oncologist", TRIM(SP.CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Thoracic Surgeon", P.CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Scheduled Chemo Appt Date", TRIM(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Impression:') THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 2000)) END)) AS "Impression", TRIM(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_SECTION IN ('General', 'Stage') AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Lung T:', 'T:', 'SUR_THR_Path Stage 1 Lng T RES', 'SUR_THR_Path Stage 2 Lng T RES', 'SUR_THR_Path Stage 3 Lng T RES', 'SUR_THR_Path Stage 4 Lng T RES') THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 2000)) END)) AS "Stage", TRIM(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_SECTION IN ('General', 'Stage') AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Lung N:', 'N:', 'SUR_THR_Path Stage 1 Lng N RES', 'SUR_THR_Path Stage 2 Lng N RES', 'SUR_THR_Path Stage 3 Lng N RES', 'SUR_THR_Path Stage 4 Lng N RES') THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 2000)) END)) AS "Lymph Nodes" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER P JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON P.CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R ON P.CPE_VST_RES_ID = R.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON P.CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RECENCY FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'THR' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND AC_IRB_NO = '12-245') SP ON P.CPE_MRN = SP.CPE_MRN AND SP.RECENCY = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RECENCY2 FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'THR' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp')) T ON P.CPE_MRN = T.CPE_MRN AND T.RECENCY2 = 1 JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON P.CPE_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON P.CPE_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Initial Consult/Initial Visit - Thoracic Surgery', 'Follow Up - Thoracic Surgery') AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' WHERE P.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'CHM' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'THR' AND SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C34', '162') AND P.CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE + 2 DAY AND CURRENT DATE + 8 DAY GROUP BY P.CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, T.CRE_RES_NAME, SP.CRE_RES_NAME, P.CPE_ENC_DTE, R.CRE_RES_NAME ORDER BY P.CPE_ENC_DTE ASC ; SELECT TRIM(CPE_MRN) AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", TRIM(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6) AS "Department", TRIM(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8) AS "Service", TRIM(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS "Department Name", TRIM(CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Provider Name", TRIM(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'THR' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 8 DAYS AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%IR%')

prompt: requesting summary of race and ethnicity distribution in pediatric and young adult patients
completion: WITH DEMOGRAPHICS_0 AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, YEAR(CURRENT_DATE - IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH") AS AGE, IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH" AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_DESC" AS ETHNICITY, ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_DESC" AS RACE, CASE WHEN (IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_DEATH" IS NULL) THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS VITAL_STATS FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_PT_ETHNICITY" = ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_ELEMENT" = 'PT_ETHNICITY' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_RACE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_RACE" = ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_ELEMENT" = 'RACE' WHERE YEAR(CURRENT_DATE - IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH") BETWEEN 0 AND 30 AND IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH" BETWEEN '1993-01-01' AND '2023-12-14' AND ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_DESC" IN ('HISPANIC OR LATINO', 'NO VALUE ENTERED', 'NOT HISPANIC', 'UNKNOWN') AND ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_DESC" IN ('ASIAN-FAR EAST/INDIAN SUBCONT', 'BLACK HISPANIC', 'BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN', 'NATIVE AMERICAN-AM IND/ALASKA', 'NATIVE HAWAIIAN OR PACIFIC ISL', 'NO VALUE ENTERED', 'OTHER', 'PT REFUSED TO ANSWER', 'UNKNOWN', 'WHITE', 'WHITE HISPANIC') AND CASE WHEN (IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_DEATH" IS NULL) THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END IN ('Alive', 'Deceased')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DEMOGRAPHICS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DEMOGRAPHICS_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID FROM COHORT), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_DESC" AS RACE, ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_DESC" AS ETHNICITY, IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH" AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_DEATH" AS DATE_OF_DEATH FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_RACE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_RACE" = ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_ELEMENT" = 'RACE' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_PT_ETHNICITY" = ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_ELEMENT" = 'PT_ETHNICITY') SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.RACE AS RACE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.ETHNICITY AS ETHNICITY, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_DEATH AS DATE_OF_DEATH FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID; WITH DEMOGRAPHICS_0 AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, YEAR(CURRENT_DATE - IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH") AS AGE, IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH" AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_DESC" AS ETHNICITY, ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_DESC" AS RACE, CASE WHEN (IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_DEATH" IS NULL) THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS VITAL_STATS FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_PT_ETHNICITY" = ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_ELEMENT" = 'PT_ETHNICITY' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_RACE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_RACE" = ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_ELEMENT" = 'RACE' WHERE YEAR(CURRENT_DATE - IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH") BETWEEN 0 AND 30 AND IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH" BETWEEN '1993-01-01' AND '2023-12-14' AND ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_DESC" IN ('HISPANIC OR LATINO', 'NO VALUE ENTERED', 'NOT HISPANIC', 'UNKNOWN') AND ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_DESC" IN ('ASIAN-FAR EAST/INDIAN SUBCONT', 'BLACK HISPANIC', 'BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN', 'NATIVE AMERICAN-AM IND/ALASKA', 'NATIVE HAWAIIAN OR PACIFIC ISL', 'NO VALUE ENTERED', 'OTHER', 'PT REFUSED TO ANSWER', 'UNKNOWN', 'WHITE', 'WHITE HISPANIC') AND CASE WHEN (IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_DEATH" IS NULL) THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END IN ('Alive', 'Deceased')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DEMOGRAPHICS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DEMOGRAPHICS_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID FROM COHORT), DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN) AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE) AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE) AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE, BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, TRIM(BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE) || '-' || TRIM("IDB"."CLM"."CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC, YEAR(BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE - "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_BIRTH_DTE") AS AGE_AT_ICD_CODE_DATE FROM (SELECT "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_CD" AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, MIN("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_EFF_DTE") AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE FROM "IDB"."CTC_CLSF" WHERE "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_TYPE" LIKE 'DF%' AND ("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_PT_TYPE" = 'I' OR ("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_PT_TYPE" =
