'O' AND "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_FINALIZED_IND" = 'Y')) GROUP BY "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_MRN", "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_CD") AS BASE_QUERY JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."CLM" ON BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE = "IDB"."CLM"."CLM_CLSF_CD"), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID, DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.DIAGNOSIS_DATE AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE, DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE AS ICD_CODE, DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC AS ICD_CODE_DESCRIPTION, DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.AGE_AT_ICD_CODE_DATE AS AGE_AT_ICD_CODE_DATE FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS ON DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID;

prompt: Identify annual counts of breast cancer patients dispensed Adriamycin (doxorubicin), Herceptin (trastuzumab), or both.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS DEID, CASE WHEN "t2"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" IN ('BR96-DOXORUBICIN CONJUGATE', 'DOXORUBICIN', 'DOXOrubicin HCl') THEN 'Doxorubicin' ELSE 'Trastuzumab' END AS DRUG, "t3"."DT_DTE" AS STRT_DTE FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t4" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t2" ON "t4"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t2"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t5" ON "t4"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t4"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t5"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t3" ON "t5"."POD_START_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t6" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t7" ON "t6"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t7"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" WHERE ("t2"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" IN ('BR96-DOXORUBICIN CONJUGATE', 'DOXORUBICIN', 'DOXOrubicin HCl', 'TRASTUZUMAB', 'TRASTUZUMAB (INV)', 'TRASTUZUmab', 'TRASTUZUmab-MCC- DM1 (PRO132365)') AND "t7"."ICSC_SITE_CD" IN ('C500', 'C501', 'C502', 'C503', 'C504', 'C505', 'C506', 'C508', 'C509')) ), CTE2 AS (SELECT A.DEID, A.STRT_DTE, MAX(CASE WHEN B.DEID IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) AS TX_STRT FROM CTE A LEFT JOIN CTE B ON A.DEID = B.DEID AND B.STRT_DTE BETWEEN A.STRT_DTE - 120 DAYS AND A.STRT_DTE - 1 DAY GROUP BY A.DEID, A.STRT_DTE), CTE3 AS (SELECT A.DEID, A.STRT_DTE, MAX(B.STRT_DTE) AS TX_STRT_DTE FROM CTE2 A JOIN CTE2 B ON A.DEID = B.DEID AND B.STRT_DTE <= A.STRT_DTE AND B.TX_STRT = 'Y' GROUP BY A.DEID, A.STRT_DTE), CTE4 AS (SELECT DEID, TX_STRT_DTE, MAX(STRT_DTE) AS TX_END_DTE FROM CTE3 GROUP BY DEID, TX_STRT_DTE), CTE5 AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.DEID, A.TX_STRT_DTE, A.TX_END_DTE, CASE WHEN B.DEID IS NOT NULL AND C.DEID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Both' WHEN B.DEID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Doxorubicin' ELSE 'Trastuzumab' END AS REGIMEN FROM CTE4 A LEFT JOIN CTE B ON A.DEID = B.DEID AND B.STRT_DTE BETWEEN A.TX_STRT_DTE AND A.TX_END_DTE AND B.DRUG = 'Doxorubicin' LEFT JOIN CTE C ON A.DEID = C.DEID AND C.STRT_DTE BETWEEN A.TX_STRT_DTE AND A.TX_END_DTE AND C.DRUG = 'Trastuzumab') SELECT REGIMEN, YEAR(TX_STRT_DTE) AS YR, COUNT(DISTINCT DEID) AS PTS FROM CTE5 GROUP BY REGIMEN, YEAR(TX_STRT_DTE) WITH CTE AS (SELECT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS DEID, CASE WHEN "t2"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" IN ('BR96-DOXORUBICIN CONJUGATE', 'DOXORUBICIN', 'DOXOrubicin HCl') THEN 'Doxorubicin' ELSE 'Trastuzumab' END AS DRUG, "t3"."DT_DTE" AS STRT_DTE FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t4" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t2" ON "t4"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t2"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t5" ON "t4"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t4"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t5"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t3" ON "t5"."POD_START_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t6" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t7" ON "t6"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t7"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" WHERE ("t2"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" IN ('BR96-DOXORUBICIN CONJUGATE', 'DOXORUBICIN', 'DOXOrubicin HCl', 'TRASTUZUMAB', 'TRASTUZUMAB (INV)', 'TRASTUZUmab', 'TRASTUZUmab-MCC- DM1 (PRO132365)') AND "t7"."ICSC_SITE_CD" IN ('C500', 'C501', 'C502', 'C503', 'C504', 'C505', 'C506', 'C508', 'C509')) ), CTE2 AS (SELECT A.DEID, A.STRT_DTE, MAX(CASE WHEN B.DEID IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) AS TX_STRT FROM CTE A LEFT JOIN CTE B ON A.DEID = B.DEID AND B.STRT_DTE BETWEEN A.STRT_DTE - 120 DAYS AND A.STRT_DTE - 1 DAY GROUP BY A.DEID, A.STRT_DTE), CTE3 AS (SELECT A.DEID, A.STRT_DTE, MAX(B.STRT_DTE) AS TX_STRT_DTE FROM CTE2 A JOIN CTE2 B ON A.DEID = B.DEID AND B.STRT_DTE <= A.STRT_DTE AND B.TX_STRT = 'Y' GROUP BY A.DEID, A.STRT_DTE), CTE4 AS (SELECT DEID, TX_STRT_DTE, MAX(STRT_DTE) AS TX_END_DTE FROM CTE3 GROUP BY DEID, TX_STRT_DTE), CTE5 AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.DEID, A.TX_STRT_DTE, A.TX_END_DTE, CASE WHEN B.DEID IS NOT NULL AND C.DEID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Both' WHEN B.DEID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Doxorubicin' ELSE 'Trastuzumab' END AS REGIMEN FROM CTE4 A LEFT JOIN CTE B ON A.DEID = B.DEID AND B.STRT_DTE BETWEEN A.TX_STRT_DTE AND A.TX_END_DTE AND B.DRUG = 'Doxorubicin' LEFT JOIN CTE C ON B.DEID = C.DEID AND C.STRT_DTE BETWEEN A.TX_STRT_DTE AND A.TX_STRT_DTE + 120 DAYS AND C.DRUG = 'Trastuzumab') SELECT REGIMEN, YEAR(TX_STRT_DTE) AS YR, COUNT(DISTINCT DEID) AS PTS FROM CTE5 GROUP BY REGIMEN, YEAR(TX_STRT_DTE)

prompt: Provide a cohort of patients with MSI-H or MSI-indeterminant endometrial or ovarian cancer
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID, PT_MRN, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, MSI_SCORE, MSI_TYPE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-score' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-type' , TMB_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score' , TMB_COUNT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb-count', COSMIC_ID VARCHAR(5000) PATH 'cosmic_id') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('UCEC,OOVC,OVT', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = TRIM(X.TTC) WHERE 1=1 AND MSI_TYPE IN ('Indeterminate', 'Instable') ) , CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN MRN, TM_DX_DTE DX_DTE, YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_DX, TM_SITE_CD SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS BEST_STAGE, TM_CA_SURG_DTE SURGERY_DATE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON TM_MRN = P.PT_MRN JOIN PTS ON P.PT_MRN = PTS.PT_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD BETWEEN 'C510' AND 'C589' ) SELECT APR_MRN, PTS.PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) FIRST_START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) LAST_END_DATE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_IMMUNOTHERAPY_FLAG = 'Y' OR CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND APR_START_DTE >= PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE GROUP BY APR_MRN, PTS.PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients with a diagnosis of "gliomatosis cerebri". This would be found a text phrase in the pathology report.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE, CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(6000)) REPORT_TEXT, CASE WHEN LOWER(PRPT_REPORT) like '%giant%cell%' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS GIANT_CELL_IND FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML ON PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("gliomatosis cerebri" )') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("giant cell glioblastoma" )') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("giant cell GBM" )') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("glioblastoma with giant cells" )') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("giant-cell glioblastoma" )') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("giant-cell GBM" )') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("glioblastoma with giant-cells" )') = 1)

prompt: Identify all patients who were diagnosed with ovarian cancer from 01/01/2001 to present, and among those patients, those with MRI within 6 months before hysterectomy and those with CT within 6 months before hysterectomy.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) AS "MRN", "Case Status", "Tumor Diagnosis Date", "ICD-9 Dx Code", "ICD-9 Dx Description", "Min ICD-9 Dx Effective Date", "Ever CIC-Coded" FROM (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS "Case Status", TM_DX_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD = 'C569' AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2001-01-01') AS CDB FULL JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD AS "ICD-9 Dx Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "ICD-9 Dx Description", MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS "Min ICD-9 Dx Effective Date", MAX(CASE WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y') THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) AS "Ever CIC-Coded" FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '183%' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CC_EFF_DTE >= '2001-01-01' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS ICD9 ON TM_MRN = CC_MRN), HYST AS (SELECT PBD_MRN AS HYST_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE AS HYST_DTE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON MRN = PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('56308', '58150', '58180', '58200', '58210', '58550', '58552', '58554', '58260') AND PBD_SVC_DTE >= '2001-01-01'), MRI AS (SELECT PBD_MRN AS IMAGING_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE AS IMAGING_DTE, HYST_DTE FROM HYST JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON PBD_MRN = HYST_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN HYST_DTE - 6 MONTHS AND HYST_DTE JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('72195', '72196', '72197', '74181', '74182', '74183') AND PBD_SVC_DTE >= '2001-01-01'), CT AS (SELECT PBD_MRN AS IMAGING_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE AS IMAGING_DTE, HYST_DTE FROM HYST JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON PBD_MRN = HYST_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN HYST_DTE - 6 MONTHS AND HYST_DTE JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('72192', '72193', '72194', '74150', '74160', '74170') AND PBD_SVC_DTE >= '2001-01-01') SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", MAX(IMAGING_DTE) AS "CT Date", HYST_DTE AS "Hysterectomy Date" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN PTS ON PT_MRN = MRN JOIN CT ON PT_MRN = IMAGING_MRN GROUP BY PT_MRN, HYST_DTE

prompt: Search Physical Therapy ClinDoc notes between Oct 1 and Dec 31, 2011, identify what percentage of notes were signed on the service date or the next day, and provide data on those notes that were not signed within that timeframe.
completion: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Initial Evaluation/Re-Evaluation - Lymphedema Therapy', 'Group Note - PT OT', 'Initial/Re-Eval - Physical Therapy', 'Initial/Re-Eval, Lymphedema Therapy - Rehabilitation', 'Progress Note - Lymphedema', 'Progress Note - Physical Therapy') AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE BETWEEN '2011-10-01' AND '2011-12-31' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND DAYS(CDD_ENTER_DTE) - DAYS(CDD_AUTHORED_DTE) <= 1 SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_AUTHORED_DTE, CDD_ENTER_DTE, OP_DISPLAY_NAME FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Initial Evaluation/Re-Evaluation - Lymphedema Therapy', 'Group Note - PT OT', 'Initial/Re-Eval - Physical Therapy', 'Initial/Re-Eval, Lymphedema Therapy - Rehabilitation', 'Progress Note - Lymphedema', 'Progress Note - Physical Therapy') AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE BETWEEN '2011-10-01' AND '2011-12-31' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND DAYS(CDD_ENTER_DTE) - DAYS(CDD_AUTHORED_DTE) > 1

prompt: Provide a list of patients assigned "National Chemotherapy Project  Survey" in MSK Engage on ad hoc basis  that is in TODO status with a cancelled chemo appointment
completion: WITH CAN_APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN CAN_MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CPE_CANCEL_DTE, CLD_CLD_CENTER, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, EA_ASSIGN_DT, EAS_ASSESS_STS, EF_FORM_NAME, EF_SUBMISSION_DT FROM IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT_STS ON EA_STS_ID = EAS_ASSESS_STS_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM ON EF_FORM_EXTERNAL_ID = EA_ASSESS_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CHAR(EA_SOURCE_ID) = CPE_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE EA_SURV_ID = 53 AND CPE_CANCEL_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 1 DAYS AND CURRENT date AND EAS_ASSESS_STS = 'To Do' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Can', 'CxlSameDay', 'No Show') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'CHM' ) , RESCHED AS (SELECT CA.CAN_MRN RESCH_MRN, CA.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CA.CPE_ENC_DTE, CA.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CA.CPE_CANCEL_DTE, CA.CLD_CLD_CENTER, CA.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, EA_ASSIGN_DT, EAS_ASSESS_STS, EF_FORM_NAME, EF_SUBMISSION_DT, CPE.CPE_ENC_DTE "Rescheduled Appt Date", CLD.CLD_DEPT_NAME "Rescheduled Dept Name", CLD.CLD_CLD_CENTER "Rescheduled Location" FROM CAN_APPT CA JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER CPE ON CAN_MRN = CPE_MRN AND CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE BETWEEN CA.CPE_CANCEL_DTE AND CA.CPE_CANCEL_DTE + 14 DAYS AND CPE.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT CLD ON CPE.CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'CHM') SELECT CAN_MRN MRN, CA.PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", CA.PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", CA.CPE_ENC_DTE "Cancelled Appt Date", CA.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS "Cancelled Appt Status", CA.CPE_CANCEL_DTE "Cancelled Appt Cancelled Date", CA.CLD_CLD_CENTER "Cancelled Appt Location", CA.EA_ASSIGN_DT "MSK Engage Assigned Date", CA.EAS_ASSESS_STS "MSK Engage Status", "Rescheduled Appt Date", "Rescheduled Location" FROM CAN_APPT CA LEFT JOIN RESCHED RES ON CA.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID = RES.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID

prompt: Patients with implants scheduled for Radonc Dept
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", TRIM(CPE_MRN) AS "MRN", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) "Last Name", TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) "First Name", TRIM(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Visit Type", TRIM(OHI_HI_DESCRIPTION) AS "Implant Device", TRIM(OHI_SHORT_NAME) AS "Implant Device 2", TRIM(OHI_HI_TEXT) AS "Implant Description" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.OMS_HEALTH_ISSUE ON CPE_MRN = OHI_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1 ON 1 = 1 WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE = CURRENT date AND CRE_RES_NAME IN ('KOCH-MR SIMULATOR', 'KOCH-MR LINAC', 'RO MR SIMULATOR') AND OHI_TYPE_CD = 'Implanted Dev' AND OHI_STS_CD = 'Active' ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE, TRIM(CPE_MRN), TRIM(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME), TRIM(OHI_HI_DESCRIPTION) ;

prompt:
Inquiry on total number of patients with associated MRN with the below adverse events noted: 

"postoperative atrial fibrillation" or "new atrial fibrillation" (captured in HIS under "surgery adverse events")
completion: SELECT SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD AS SERVICE, A.SAE_ADV_EVENT_NO AS ADVERSE_EVENT_NO, A.SAE_SOURCE_TYPE AS ADVERSE_EVENT_SOURCE, A.SAE_TOXICITY_ID AS TOXICITY_ID, A.SAE_TOXICITY_NAME AS TOXICITY_NAME, A.SAE_TOX_CAT_NAME AS TOXICITY_CATEGORY, A.SAE_TOX_GRADE_NAME AS TOXICITY_GRADE, A.SAE_TOX_GRADE AS GRADE, COUNT(DISTINCT SSE_MRN) AS NO_OF_PATIENTS FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.SRG_ADVERSE_EVENT A ON SSE_LOG_ID = SAE_SURG_LOG_ID AND SAE_PROC_SEQ_NO = SSP_PROC_SEQ_NO WHERE 1=1 AND SAE_TOXICITY_ID = '563' GROUP BY SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, SAE_ADV_EVENT_NO, SAE_SOURCE_TYPE, SAE_TOXICITY_ID, SAE_TOXICITY_NAME, SAE_TOX_CAT_NAME, SAE_TOX_GRADE_NAME, SAE_TOX_GRADE

prompt: A cohort of men with prostate cancer that had a PSMA or fluciclovine scan before AND after radiotherapy
completion: WITH PSMA AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN , RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE , MIN(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) OVER(PARTITION BY RRPT_MRN) MIN_PSMA_DTE , MAX(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) OVER(PARTITION BY RRPT_MRN) MAX_PSMA_DTE FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME IN ('NM PET/CT INVESTIGATIONAL ISOTOPE', 'NM PET/CT NECK/CAP - GaPSMA') AND CONTAINS("RRPT_REPORT_TXT", '("PSMA")') = 1 ) , RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN , RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE , MIN_PSMA_DTE , MAX_PSMA_DTE , RAD_TYPE , RTC_TX_START_DTE , RTC_TX_STOP_DTE FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN IDB.RADIATION_CHARGES_V ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN AND RTC_TX_START_DTE = SVC_DTE JOIN PSMA ON RTC_TX_MRN = RRPT_MRN AND RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN MIN_PSMA_DTE AND MAX_PSMA_DTE) SELECT RTC_TX_MRN , LISTAGG(CHAR(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE), ' | ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) AS PSMA_DATES , MIN_PSMA_DTE , MAX_PSMA_DTE , RAD_TYPE , RTC_TX_START_DTE , RTC_TX_STOP_DTE FROM RT GROUP BY RTC_TX_MRN , MIN_PSMA_DTE , MAX_PSMA_DTE , RAD_TYPE , RTC_TX_START_DTE , RTC_TX_STOP_DTE ; WITH AXU AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN , RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE , MIN(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) OVER(PARTITION BY RRPT_MRN) MIN_AXUMIN_DTE , MAX(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) OVER(PARTITION BY RRPT_MRN) MAX_AXUMIN_DTE FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME = 'NM PET/CT NECK/CAP - AXUMIN' ) , RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN , RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE , MIN_AXUMIN_DTE , MAX_AXUMIN_DTE , RAD_TYPE , RTC_TX_START_DTE , RTC_TX_STOP_DTE FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN IDB.RADIATION_CHARGES_V ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN AND RTC_TX_START_DTE = SVC_DTE JOIN AXU ON RTC_TX_MRN = RRPT_MRN AND RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN MIN_AXUMIN_DTE AND MAX_AXUMIN_DTE) SELECT RTC_TX_MRN , LISTAGG(CHAR(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE), ' | ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) AS PSMA_DATES , MIN_AXUMIN_DTE , MAX_AXUMIN_DTE , RAD_TYPE , RTC_TX_START_DTE , RTC_TX_STOP_DTE FROM RT GROUP BY RTC_TX_MRN , MIN_AXUMIN_DTE , MAX_AXUMIN_DTE , RAD_TYPE , RTC_TX_START_DTE , RTC_TX_STOP_DTE

prompt: Requesting numbers for allogeneic transplant patients that have been tested for adenovirus (AdV). This data is not currently captured in the departmental CRDB database (MED-HCT).
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT * FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE WHERE CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE <= '2023-09-01' AND CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE = 'ALLO' ) , OUTPATIENT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS "MRN", CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name" FROM X LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CBM_MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Follow Up, AMB - BMT/CTS', 'Follow Up - BMT', 'Follow Up, AMB - BMT/CTS-BMT', 'Follow Up, AMB - BMT/CTS-CTS') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2022-06-01' AND '2023-09-01' AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NOT NULL ) , TEST AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, LTL_LINE_NO, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LR_RESULT_TYPE_CD, LR_RESULT_STS_CD, LTL_TEXT_RESULT FROM X LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON CBM_MRN = LR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE UPPER(LR_TEST_NAME) LIKE ('ADENOVIRUS QUA%') AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE <= '2023-09-01' ) , POSPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT LPC_MRN FROM X JOIN IDB.LAB_POSITIVE_CULTURES ON CBM_MRN = LPC_MRN WHERE(UPPER(LPC_ORGANISM_OBSERVATION) like '%ADENOVIRUS%QUA%' OR UPPER(LPC_ORGANISM_OBSERVATION) like '%ADV%') ) , DRUG AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OOC_ITEM_DESC, OSTS_STS_DESC FROM TEST JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON LR_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OSTS_ORD_STS_CD = OO_ORD_STS_CD WHERE UPPER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%CIDO%VIR%' ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CBM_MRN) TOTAL_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT "MRN") OUTPATIENT_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT LR_MRN) TEST_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT LPC_MRN) POSITIVE_PT_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT OO_MRN)DRUG_STARTED_PT_COUNT FROM X LEFT JOIN OUTPATIENT V ON X.CBM_MRN = "MRN" LEFT JOIN TEST T ON X.CBM_MRN = T.LR_MRN LEFT JOIN POSPT ON X.CBM_MRN =LPC_MRN LEFT JOIN DRUG ON X.CBM_MRN = OO_MRN; WITH X AS (SELECT * FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS WHERE CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE <= '2023-09-01' AND CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE = 'ALLO' ) , OUTPATIENT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS "MRN", CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name" FROM X LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CBP_MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Follow Up, AMB - BMT/CTS', 'Follow Up - BMT', 'Follow Up, AMB - BMT/CTS-BMT', 'Follow Up, AMB - BMT/CTS-CTS') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2022-06-01' AND '2023-09-01' AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NOT NULL ) , TEST AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, LTL_LINE_NO, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LR_RESULT_TYPE_CD, LR_RESULT_STS_CD, LTL_TEXT_RESULT FROM X LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON CBP_MRN = LR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE UPPER(LR_TEST_NAME) LIKE ('ADENOVIRUS QUA%') AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE <= '2023-09-01' ) , POSPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT LPC_MRN FROM X JOIN IDB.LAB_POSITIVE_CULTURES ON CBP_MRN = LPC_MRN WHERE(UPPER(LPC_ORGANISM_OBSERVATION) like '%ADENOVIRUS%QUA%' OR UPPER(LPC_ORGANISM_OBSERVATION) like '%ADV%') ) , DRUG AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OOC_ITEM_DESC, OSTS_STS_DESC FROM TEST JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON LR_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OSTS_ORD_STS_CD = OO_ORD_STS_CD WHERE UPPER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%CIDO%VIR%' ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CBP_MRN) TOTAL_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT "MRN") OUTPATIENT_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT LR_MRN) TEST_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT LPC_MRN) POSITIVE_PT_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT OO_MRN)DRUG_STARTED_PT_COUNT FROM X LEFT JOIN OUTPATIENT V ON X.CBP_MRN = "MRN" LEFT JOIN TEST T ON X.CBP_MRN = T.LR_MRN LEFT JOIN POSPT ON X.CBP_MRN =LPC_MRN LEFT JOIN DRUG ON X.CBP_MRN = OO_MRN;

prompt: Patients scheduled under the chemotherapy Westchester umbrella department that have scalp cooling orders.
completion: WITH SCH_VST AS (SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, PT_SEX_DESC SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE APPT_MADE_DTE, CPE_ENC_DTE SCH_VST_DATE, VD.CLD_DEPT_ID DEPT_ID, VD.CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME, VD.CLD_CLD_CENTER CLD_CENTER , CPE_APPT_DT APPT_DT, VT.CRE_RES_NAME VST_MD, REF.CRE_RES_NAME REF_MD, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME VST_NAME , CVT_EXT_NAME VST_TYPE , CLN1.CCH_CHEMO_NAME TREATMENT1, CLN1.CCH_DURATION_MIN DURATION1, CLN2.CCH_CHEMO_NAME TREATMENT2, CLN2.CCH_DURATION_MIN DURATION2 FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT VD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = VD.CLD_DEPT_ID AND CPE_DEPT_ID IN (855) JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VT ON VT.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT LN1 ON LN1.CPA_CL_PT_ID = CPE_CL_PT_ID AND LN1.CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_CHEMO PCLN1 ON PCLN1.CPC_CL_PT_ID = LN1.CPA_CL_PT_ID AND PCLN1.CPC_ENC_DTE_SEQ = LN1.CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND PCLN1.CPC_LINE_NO = 1 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CHEMO CLN1 ON CLN1.CCH_CHEMO_ID = PCLN1.CPC_CHEMO_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT LN2 ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = LN2.CPA_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = LN2.CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ JOIN IDB.CL_PT_CHEMO PCLN2 ON PCLN2.CPC_CL_PT_ID = LN2.CPA_CL_PT_ID AND PCLN2.CPC_ENC_DTE_SEQ = LN2.CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND PCLN2.CPC_LINE_NO = 2 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CHEMO CLN2 ON CLN2.CCH_CHEMO_ID = PCLN2.CPC_CHEMO_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF ON REF.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_REF_RES_ID AND REF.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist', 'PhD', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE SR ON SR.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 30 DAY AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 ) , COOL_ENROLL AS (SELECT MRN AS ENROLL_MRN, OUO_ORD_NAME ORDNAME, OUO_ORD_ID ORDERID, OUO_ENTER_DTE ORD_ENTERDTE, OUO_STS_DESC ORDSTATUS, OUO_ATN_PVDR_NAME PROVIDER, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "PAXMAN THERAPY START", ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY MRN ORDER BY OUO_ENTER_DTE DESC) RN FROM SCH_VST JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OUO_MRN = MRN AND OUO_ENTER_DTE <= CURRENT date LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Paxman_Therapy_Start' WHERE OUO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000011661100730' AND OUO_ORD_STS_CD NOT LIKE 'CA%' ) SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, SEX, DOB, APPT_MADE_DTE, SCH_VST_DATE, DEPT_NAME, APPT_DT, VST_MD, REF_MD, VST_NAME, VST_TYPE, TREATMENT1, DURATION1, TREATMENT2, DURATION2, ORDNAME, ORD_ENTERDTE, ORDERID, ORDSTATUS, PROVIDER, "PAXMAN THERAPY START" FROM SCH_VST JOIN COOL_ENROLL ON MRN = ENROLL_MRN AND RN = 1

prompt: Please add referring LIP to the report in between columns D and E
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", TRIM(CPE_MRN) AS "MRN", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) "Last Name", TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) "First Name", TRIM(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Visit Type", TRIM(OHI_HI_DESCRIPTION) AS "Implant Device", TRIM(OHI_HI_TEXT) AS "Implant Description", TRIM(R1.CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Referring Resource", TRIM(R1.CRE_RES_TYP) AS "Referring Resource Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = R.CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R1 ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = R1.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.OMS_HEALTH_ISSUE ON CPE_MRN = OHI_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1 ON 1 = 1 WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 7 DAYS AND R.CRE_RES_NAME IN ('MRI 1275-CIGI', 'MRI 1275-CIGI2', 'MRI 1275-1', 'MRI 1275-2', 'MRI 1275-3', 'MRI 1275-4', 'MRI 1275-53') AND OHI_TYPE_CD = 'Implanted Dev' AND OHI_STS_CD = 'Active' ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE, TRIM(CPE_MRN), TRIM(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME), TRIM(OHI_HI_DESCRIPTION);

prompt: All GYN patients who underwent a total pelvic exenteration from August 2022 to present.
completion: WITH SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_LOG_ID, SSP_PROC_SEQ_NO, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ',' || STRIP(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) AS SURGEON, DATE(SSE_SURG_STRT_DT) AS SURG_START_DTE, DATE(SSE_SURG_END_DT) AS SURG_END_DTE, TIME(SSE_PT_IN_DT) AS PT_IN_DT, TIME(SSE_PT_OUT_DT) AS PT_OUT_DT, TIME(SSE_SURG_STRT_DT) AS SURG_START_TIME, TIME(SSE_SURG_END_DT) AS SURG_END_TIME FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND UPPER(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) LIKE '%PELVIC%EXENTERATION%' AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'GYN' AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '08-1-2022' AND CURRENT DATE ) , READMIT AS (SELECT VIS_MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM, VIS_VISIT_STATUS, VISIT_STATUS_DESC, SSE_SURG_DTE, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_DAYS_STAY AS LOS, VIS_HOSP_SVC, HOSP_SVC_DESC, VIS_NURS_STA, NURS_STA_DESC FROM SURG JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON SSE_MRN = VIS_MRN WHERE VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_ADM_DTE > SSE_SURG_DTE ) SELECT * FROM READMIT , COMPLICATION AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN AS MRN, DATE(SAE_TOX_OCCR_DT) AS COMPLICATION_DATE, SAE_TOXICITY_NAME AS COMPLICATION_NAME, SAE_TOX_GRADE AS COMPLICATION_GRADE, SAE_TOX_GRADE_NAME AS TOXICITY_GRADE_NAME FROM SURG LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_ADVERSE_EVENT ON SSE_LOG_ID = SAE_SURG_LOG_ID AND SAE_PROC_SEQ_NO = SSP_PROC_SEQ_NO AND SAE_TOX_GRADE > '0') , DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC, CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS STAGE FROM SURG LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON SSE_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) , EBL AS (SELECT OL_MRN, OL_LOG_ID, ARS_AN_PROC_NAME, CAST(STRIP(AIFM_MEAS_VALUE) AS DECIMAL(9, 2)) AS EBL FROM SURG JOIN IDB.OR_LOG ON SSE_MRN = OL_MRN JOIN IDB.AN_RECORD_SUMMARY ON OL_LOG_ID = ARS_AN_CASELOG_ID AND OL_CL_PT_ID = ARS_AN_CL_PT_ID JOIN IDB.AN_IP_DATA_STORE ON ARS_AN_CL_PT_ID = AIDS_CL_PT_ID AND AIDS_ENC_CSN_ID = ARS_AN_52_ENC_CSN_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.AN_IP_FLOWSHEET_REC ON AIFRC_INPATIENT_DATA_ID = AIDS_INPATIENT_DATA_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.AN_IP_FLOWSHEET_MEAS ON AIFRC_FSD_ID = AIFM_FSD_ID WHERE AIFM_MEAS_VALUE > ' ' AND AIFM_FLO_MEAS_ID = '400620' ) SELECT * FROM EBL

prompt: Provide the MRNs of patients who had a CPT of 53445.
completion: SELECT * FROM OPENQUERY(DB2PIDB, ' select PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE, DOC_NAME from idb.PBD_DTL INNER JOIN idb.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD INNER JOIN idb.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO AND PBI_MRN = PBD_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE PBC_CPT_CD = ''53445'' ')

prompt: We want to run a report of URO Surv pts that go back to the URO service clinics. Similar to the Thoracic report we ran, though not running the second recurrence report. Just looking at pts seen in Surv URO Jan 1, 2017-Dec 31, 2021 that had a subsequent visit after the surv vist date with URO. We can go based on the first URO survivorship visit date and first time pt goes back to URO service.
completion: WITH URO_SVP AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN SVP_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "SVP_APPOINTMENT_DATE", CRE_RES_NAME AS "SVP_PROVIDER", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) FIRST_APT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' AND TRIM(CLD_DEPT_NAME) IN ('URO 68-3 SURVIVORSHIP', 'URO 68-C SURVIVORSHIP', 'URO 68-1 SURVIVORSHIP', 'URO 16 E60-3 SVRSHP') ) WHERE FIRST_APT =1 ) , SRG AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", "SVP_APPOINTMENT_DATE", "SVP_PROVIDER", CRE_RES_NAME AS "URO_SURGEON", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "URO_SRG_APPT_DT", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) SRG_DT FROM URO_SVP JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON SVP_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'URO' AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CLD_DEPT_NAME NOT IN ('URO 68-3 SURVIVORSHIP', 'URO 68-C SURVIVORSHIP', 'URO 68-1 SURVIVORSHIP', 'URO 16 E60-3 SVRSHP') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= SVP_APPOINTMENT_DATE ) SELECT "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", SVP_APPOINTMENT_DATE, SVP_PROVIDER, URO_SRG_APPT_DT "URO SRG Appt Date", URO_SURGEON FROM SRG S JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON "MRN" = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON "MRN" = PLA_MRN WHERE SRG_DT = 1

prompt: Design a monthly report of PET procedure patients who present with a blood glucose of >=200 or <70.
completion: WITH X_TMP AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(CPE_MRN) AS MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_RIS_EXTERNAL_ORD_ID, CPE_CPE_IP_IND, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS "Appt Time", STRIP(CPE_CPE_APPT_STS) AS "Appt Status", STRIP(CPE_CPE_CANCEL_RSN) AS "Cancel Reason", STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Visit Type", STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS CRE_RES_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE ORDER BY CPE_CPE_APPT_STS DESC) AS APPT_RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-10-01' AND '2021-03-31' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%FDG%' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Can', 'Comp') ) , X AS (SELECT X_TMP.* FROM X_TMP LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON MRN = VIS_MRN AND "Appt Date" BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DTE, CURRENT date) AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' WHERE VIS_MRN IS NULL ) , GL AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(LR_MRN) AS MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS PERFORMED_DTE, TIME(LR_PERFORMED_DT) AS PERFORMED_TIME, STRIP(LR_TEST_NAME) AS TEST_NAME, STRIP(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) AS SUBTEST_NAME, STRIP(LR_RESULT_VALUE) AS RESULT_VALUE, STRIP(LR_UNIT_MEASURE) AS UNIT_MEASURE FROM X JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_MRN = MRN AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE = "Appt Date" LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%GLUCOSE%BEDSIDE%' AND UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) NOT LIKE '%URINE%' AND LR_RESULT_VALUE <> '' AND LR_RESULT_VALUE NOT IN ('Normal', 'Indeterminate') AND LR_RESULT_VALUE NOT LIKE '%<%' AND LR_RESULT_VALUE NOT LIKE '%>%' UNION SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(LR_MRN) AS MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS PERFORMED_DTE, TIME(LR_PERFORMED_DT) AS PERFORMED_TIME, STRIP(LR_TEST_NAME) AS TEST_NAME, STRIP(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) AS SUBTEST_NAME, STRIP(LR_RESULT_VALUE) AS RESULT_VALUE, STRIP(LR_UNIT_MEASURE) AS UNIT_MEASURE FROM X JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_MRN = MRN AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE = "Appt Date" LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%GLUCOSE%BEDSIDE%' AND UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) NOT LIKE '%URINE%' AND(LR_RESULT_VALUE LIKE '%<%' OR LR_RESULT_VALUE LIKE '%>%') ) , Y_TMP AS (SELECT X.*, PERFORMED_DTE, PERFORMED_TIME, TEST_NAME, SUBTEST_NAME, RESULT_VALUE, UNIT_MEASURE FROM X JOIN GL ON X.MRN = GL.MRN AND X.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID = GL.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID AND PERFORMED_DTE = "Appt Date" WHERE 1=1 AND(RESULT_VALUE like '%<%' OR RESULT_VALUE like '%>%') UNION SELECT X.*, PERFORMED_DTE, PERFORMED_TIME, TEST_NAME, SUBTEST_NAME, RESULT_VALUE, UNIT_MEASURE FROM X JOIN GL ON X.MRN = GL.MRN AND X.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID = GL.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID AND PERFORMED_DTE = "Appt Date" WHERE 1=1 AND NOT(RESULT_VALUE like '%<%' OR RESULT_VALUE like '%>%') AND NOT RESULT_VALUE BETWEEN 70 AND 200 ) , Y AS (SELECT Y_TMP.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_ENC_CSN_ID ORDER BY PERFORMED_DTE, PERFORMED_TIME) AS RN FROM Y_TMP) , Z1 AS (SELECT MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, PERFORMED_TIME, TEST_NAME, SUBTEST_NAME, RESULT_VALUE, UNIT_MEASURE FROM Y WHERE RN = 1 ) , Z2 AS (SELECT MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, PERFORMED_TIME, TEST_NAME, SUBTEST_NAME, RESULT_VALUE, UNIT_MEASURE FROM Y WHERE RN = 2 ) , Z3 AS (SELECT MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(PERFORMED_TIME), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(RESULT_VALUE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(UNIT_MEASURE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, PERFORMED_TIME) AS GLUCOSE_VALUES_OTHER FROM Y WHERE RN >= 3 GROUP BY MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) SELECT DISTINCT Y.MRN, Y.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_RIS_EXTERNAL_ORD_ID, CPE_CPE_IP_IND, "Appt Date", "Appt Time", "Appt Status", "Cancel Reason", "Visit Type", CRE_RES_NAME, Z1.PERFORMED_TIME AS FIRST_GLUCOSE_TIME, Z1.RESULT_VALUE AS FIRST_GLUCOSE_VALUE, Z1.UNIT_MEASURE AS FIRST_GLUCOSE_UNIT, Z2.PERFORMED_TIME AS SECOND_GLUCOSE_TIME, Z2.RESULT_VALUE AS SECOND_GLUCOSE_VALUE, Z2.UNIT_MEASURE AS SECOND_GLUCOSE_UNIT, GLUCOSE_VALUES_OTHER FROM Y LEFT JOIN Z1 ON Y.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID = Z1.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID LEFT JOIN Z2 ON Y.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID = Z2.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID LEFT JOIN Z3 ON Y.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID = Z3.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE APPT_RN = 1

prompt: List of in clinic patients that was seen in a previous week with their proposed ALL “clinical/test/radiology and appointment/referral orders” from CIS; Dr. Moskowitz is in clinic 2 days a week – Tuesdays in Westchester and Thursdays at Koch Building
completion: WITH A AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||' , '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Patient's Name", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CPE_CPE_APPT_STS "Appt Status", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND (CPE_ENC_DTE = CURRENT DATE- 1 DAYS OR CPE_ENC_DTE= CURRENT DATE-6 DAYS) AND CRE_RES_NAME ='MOSKOWITZ, ALISON' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER IN ('WES', 'KOCH')), B AS (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN", "Patient's Name", "Appt Date", "Appt Status", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", OOC_ITEM_NAME AS "Order Name", OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Order Entered", OO_ENTER_DTE AS "Order Enter Date" FROM A LEFT JOIN (SELECT OO_MRN, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OU_DISPLAY_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OO_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND (OO_ENTER_DTE = CURRENT DATE- 1 DAYS OR OO_ENTER_DTE= CURRENT DATE-6 DAYS) AND OU_DISPLAY_NAME='Moskowitz, Alison' ) AS X ON OO_MRN = MRN), C AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Future Appt Date", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Future Appt Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS ='Sch' AND CRE_RES_NAME ='MOSKOWITZ, ALISON' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER IN ('WES', 'KOCH') ), D AS (SELECT B.*, "Future Appt Date", "Future Appt Type" FROM B LEFT JOIN C ON MRN=CPE_MRN) SELECT * FROM D ORDER BY 11

prompt: To pull clinical data elements and survey responses in Rise clinic pts to complete analysis as described in IRB#23-359
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT 'Webcore' AS SOURCE , WMUK_USER_KEY_VALUE AS MRN FROM IDB.WC_SURVEY_ASSIGN_PROD WSAP LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.WC_MAP_USER_KEY WMUK ON WSAP_USER_ID = WMUK_USER_ID AND WMUK_USER_KEY_ID = 1 LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.WC_SURVEY_RESULT_PROD WSRP ON WSAP_ASSIGN_PROD_ID = WSRP_ASSIGNED_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.WC_SURVEY_CONTENT_PROD WSCP_Q ON WSAP_LIST_ID = WSCP_Q.WSCP_LIST_ID AND WSRP_QUESTION_ALIAS = WSCP_Q.WSCP_ALIAS WHERE WSAP_SITE_ID = 111 AND date (WSAP_COMPLETED_ON_DT) < '2020-11-24' UNION SELECT DISTINCT 'Engage' AS SOURCE, EF_MRN FROM IDB.EF_FORM WHERE EF_FORM_NAME = 'RISE Program Questionnaire' ) , HARM AS (SELECT APR_MRN, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS TX_START, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS TX_END FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN PTS ON MRN = APR_MRN AND CDG_HORMONE_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY APR_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR (CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) CURRENT_AGE, CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') THEN 'ALIVE' ELSE 'DECEASED' END AS VITAL_STATUS, TRIM(R.AV_DESC) AS RACE, TRIM(E.AV_DESC) AS ETHNICITY, CASE WHEN APR_MRN <> '' THEN 'Y' END AS HARMONE_TX_FLAG, TX_START AS "Harmone Therapy Start", TX_END AS "Harmone Therapy End" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN HARM ON APR_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY ; WITH SRV1 AS (SELECT EF_SUBMISSION_DT, EF_FORM_ID, EF_MRN, EF_FORM_NAME, TRIM(EFI_ITEM_TEXT) AS EFI_ITEM_TEXT, TRIM(EFI_ITEM_ALIAS) AS EFI_ITEM_ALIAS, TRIM(EFI_VALUE) AS EFI_VALUE FROM IDB.EF_FORM LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID WHERE EF_FORM_NAME = 'RISE Program Questionnaire' AND TRIM(EFI_ITEM_ALIAS) <> '' ), BMI AS (SELECT PMH_MRN, PMH_MEASURE_DTE, PMH_WT_KG, PMH_HT_CM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PMH_MRN ORDER BY ABS(PMH_MEASURE_DTE - date (EF_SUBMISSION_DT)) ASC) AS RN, PMH_BMI FROM IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX JOIN SRV1 ON EF_MRN = PMH_MRN) , SRV AS (SELECT DISTINCT S.*, PMH_MEASURE_DTE, PMH_WT_KG, PMH_HT_CM, PMH_BMI FROM BMI JOIN SRV1 S ON EF_MRN = PMH_MRN AND RN =1) , HARM AS (SELECT APR_MRN, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS TX_START, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS TX_END FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN SRV1 W ON EF_MRN = APR_MRN AND CDG_HORMONE_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY APR_MRN) SELECT EF_MRN AS MRN, PMH_MEASURE_DTE AS BMI_MEASURED_DATE, PMH_WT_KG AS WEIGHT_IN_KG, PMH_HT_CM AS HEIGHT_IN_CM, PMH_BMI AS BMI, EF_SUBMISSION_DT AS SUBMISSION_DATE, MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'brcatstq' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "Have you ever been tested for BRCA1 or BRCA2?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'PET_menstrual_period' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "Date of last menstrual period:", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'PET_menstrual_period' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "Date of last menstrual period:", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'PET_menstrual_period' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "Date of your last menstrual period:", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'Smokhx_begindaily' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "At what age did you begin smoking daily?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'Smokhx_cigsaday' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "When you smoke/smoked, about how many cigarettes do you (or did you) smoke a day?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'Smokhx_daily' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "Have you ever smoked cigarettes daily?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'Smokhx_days2' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "Number of days since last cigarette:", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'Smokhx_months3' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "Number of months since last cigarette:", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'Smokhx_othertobacco' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "In the past 30 days, which of the following other tobacco products have you used?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'Smokhx_plsdescribe' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "Please list the other tobacco product(s) you used:", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'Smokhx_totalyears' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "How many total years have you smoked or (did you smoke) cigarettes?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'Smokhx_years' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "Number of years since last cigarette:", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'alcoholq' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "In a typical week, how many alcoholic drinks do you have? .", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'bonedensityscan_y_n' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "Have you ever had a bone density scan?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'brca_result' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "What were the results?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'breast_biopsy_info' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "In the table below, please specify date, which breast, type of biopsy..", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'brst_bxq' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "Have you ever had a breast biopsy?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'column_0' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "Date", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'column_1' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "Which Breast", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'column_2' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "Biopsy Type", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'column_3' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "Biopsy Result", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'ex_mild_durq' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "About how many minutes?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'ex_mild_freqq' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "About how many times per week (0 to 7)?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'ex_mod_durq' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "About how many minutes?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'ex_mod_freqq' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "About how many times per week (0-7)?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'ex_stren_durq' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "About how many minutes?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'ex_stren_freqq' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "About how many times per week (0 to 7)", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'ex_stren_freqq' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "About how many times per week (0 to 7)?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'fhq_system' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "FHQ", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'mam_ttq' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "When was your most recent mammogram?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'mammo_often' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "In the past 5 years how often have you had a mammogram?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'mamq' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "Have you ever had a mammogram?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'menstrbegin' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "At what age did your menstrual periods begin?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'pap_ttq' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "When was your most recent pap smear?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'papq' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "Have you ever had a pap smear?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'ptcare_who_completed' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "Who completed this assessment?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'ptcare_who_completed_other' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "Please describe:", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'rise_IVF' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "Have you ever had any form of gamete transfer or in vitro fertilization (IVF)?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'rise_abortion_age_first' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "How old were you the first time you had an abortion?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'rise_abortion_age_last' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "How old were you the last time you had an abortion?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'rise_abortion_numbers' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "How many times have your pregnancies resulted in abortion?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'rise_age_mammogram' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "How old were you when you had your first mammogram?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'rise_bc_currently' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "Are you currently using hormonal birth control?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'rise_bc_firstuse' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "How old were you when you first used hormonal birth control?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'rise_bc_lastused' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "How old were you when you last used hormonal birth control?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'rise_bc_total' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "In your lifetime, how many years in total have you used hormonal birth control?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'rise_birth_age_first' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "How old were you the first time you gave birth?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'rise_birth_age_last' THEN TRIM(EFI_VALUE) END) AS "How old were you the last time you gave birth?" FROM SRV LEFT JOIN HARM ON EF_MRN = APR_MRN GROUP BY EF_MRN, EF_SUBMISSION_DT , PMH_MEASURE_DTE, PMH_WT_KG, PMH_HT_CM , PMH_BMI ;

prompt: Provide a list of controlled substances prescribed through Prescription Writer at JRSC in 2018 YTD separated by service.
completion: WITH GENDRUG AS (SELECT DISTINCT HGN_GENERIC_NAME, OCDX_DRUG_KEY CAT_DRUG_KEY, CASE WHEN (C2.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME = ' ' OR C2.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME IS NULL) THEN C1.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME WHEN (C3.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME = ' ' OR C3.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME IS NULL) THEN C2.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME CONCAT ' | ' CONCAT C1.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME ELSE C3.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME CONCAT ' | ' CONCAT C2.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME END AS CATEGORY_NAME FROM IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME JOIN IDB.OMS_CATEGORY_DRUG_XREF ON HGN_DRUG_CATALOG_KEY = OCDX_DRUG_KEY JOIN IDB.OMS_DRUG_CATEGORIES C1 ON C1.ODC_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = OCDX_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CATEGORY_SUB_XREF L2 ON C1.ODC_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = L2.OCSX_SUB_CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_DRUG_CATEGORIES C2 ON C2.ODC_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = L2.OCSX_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CATEGORY_SUB_XREF L3 ON L2.OCSX_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = L3.OCSX_SUB_CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_DRUG_CATEGORIES C3 ON C3.ODC_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = L3.OCSX_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID), DRUGRN AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAT_DRUG_KEY, HGN_GENERIC_NAME, CATEGORY_NAME , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CAT_DRUG_KEY ORDER BY CATEGORY_NAME) RN FROM GENDRUG), DRUGCAT AS (SELECT CAT_DRUG_KEY, HGN_GENERIC_NAME GENERIC_NAME , MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN CATEGORY_NAME END)|| MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 2 THEN '; '||STRIP(CATEGORY_NAME) ELSE '' END)|| MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 3 THEN '; '||STRIP(CATEGORY_NAME) ELSE '' END)|| MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 4 THEN '; '||STRIP(CATEGORY_NAME) ELSE '' END) THERAP_CATEGORY FROM DRUGRN GROUP BY CAT_DRUG_KEY, HGN_GENERIC_NAME) , RX AS (SELECT HCPR_MRN , CHAR(HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_ID) "Rx ID" , HCPR_STATUS_TYPE_DESC AS "Rx Status" , HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE_DESC AS "Rx Type" , HCPR_CREATED_DTE AS "Rx Create Date" , DATE(HCPR_START_DT) AS "Rx Start Date" , DATE(HCPR_END_DT) AS "Rx End Date" , HCPR_DRUG_NAME AS "Drug Name" , HGN_GENERIC_NAME AS "Generic Name" , THERAP_CATEGORY , HCPR_DOSE_AMT AS "Dose" , UOM.HRUM_NAME AS "UoM" , HCPR_ROUTE AS "Route" , CHAR(INT(HCPR_QTY_AMT)) AS QTY, HSF_ABBREVIATIION AS "Freq" , CHAR(INT(HCPR_DURATION_AMT)) AS "Duration" , CHAR(INT(HCPR_REFILLS)) AS "Refills" , HCPR_INSTRUCTIONS AS "Instructions" , OS_SVC_DESC AS "Client Visit SVC" , OS_SVC_GRP_CD AS "Client Visit SVC Code" , OCV_CURR_LOC , CASE WHEN OCV_CURR_LOC LIKE THEN 'Y' END AS "JRSC" FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON HCPR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = HCPR_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER USR ON USR.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER REQ ON REQ.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER REQ2 ON REQ2.OP_PVDR_GUID = HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC D1 ON REQ2.OP_PVDR_NO = DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE UOM ON UOM.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE PKG ON PKG.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_INNER_PACKAGE_SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_SCRIPT_FREQUENCY ON HSF_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID = HCPR_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.RXW_PHARMACY ON HCPR_PHARMACY_ID = RPH_PHARMACY_ID LEFT JOIN DRUGCAT ON CAT_DRUG_KEY = HGN_DRUG_CATALOG_KEY WHERE HCPR_STATUS_TYPE NOT IN (4, 8) AND((HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 2, 5) ) OR HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3) AND HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE_DESC = 'eRx' AND DATE(HCPR_START_DT) >= '2018-01-01' AND THERAP_CATEGORY = 'central nervous system agents | analgesics' AND HGN_GENERIC_NAME IN ('acetaminophen-codeine', 'acetaminophen-hydrocodone', 'acetaminophen-oxycodone', 'belladonna-opium', 'buprenorphine', 'buprenorphine-naloxone', 'fentaNYL', 'fentanyl topical', 'hydrocodone-ibuprofen', 'HYDROmorphone', 'ibuprofen-oxycodone', 'levorphanol', 'meperidine', 'methadone', 'morphine', 'morphine-naltrexone', 'opium', 'oxyCODONE', 'oxyMORphone') ) SELECT * FROM RX WHERE "JRSC" = 'Y'

prompt: Provide a Tableau dashboard that shows a monthly trend of patients that died at MSK with Social Work, Chaplaincy, and Goals of Care documentation.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH DOD FROM IDB.PATIENT WHERE PT_DEATH_IND IN ('C', 'D') AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' ) , SW AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2021-01-01' AND CDD_DOC_NAME like '%Social Work%' AND CASE WHEN (LOCATE('Bereavement', CDO_VALUE_TEXT) > 1 OR LOCATE('Palliative/Supportive', CDO_VALUE_TEXT) > 1 OR LOCATE('End-of-life', CDO_VALUE_TEXT) > 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 1 ) , CHAPLAINCY AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2021-01-01' AND (LOWER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like '%chaplaincy%' OR LOWER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like '%spiritual care%') AND CASE WHEN (LOCATE('annointing', CDO_VALUE_TEXT) > 1 OR LOCATE('end of life', CDO_VALUE_TEXT) > 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 1 ) , GOALS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2021-01-01' AND LOWER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like '%goals of care%' ) SELECT P.*, CASE WHEN SW.CDD_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END "Social Work Note", CASE WHEN C.CDD_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END "Chaplaincy Note", CASE WHEN G.CDD_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END "Goals of Care Note" FROM PTS P LEFT JOIN SW ON MRN = SW.CDD_MRN AND SW.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN CHAPLAINCY C ON MRN = C.CDD_MRN AND C.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN GOALS G ON MRN = G.CDD_MRN AND G.RN = 1

prompt: Identify all female patients who had a breast MRI from September 2009-July 2010 at the BAIC on a 3T magnet and determine the total number of female patients who had a breast MRI from September 2008-June 2009 at the main hospital or 55th St. on a 1.5T magnet.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CLD_DEPT_ID = CPE_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE PT_SEX = 'F' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2009-09-01' AND '2010-07-31' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'RADIOLOGY ADV 300 E66' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('MR 3T BREAST BILAT W/O CONTR', 'MR 3T BREAST UNILAT W/O CONT,L', 'MR 3T BREAST UNILAT W/O CONT,R', 'MR 3T BREAST UNILATERAL, LEFT', 'MR 3T BREAST UNILATERAL, RIGHT', 'MR 3T BREAST W/CONTRAST BILAT', 'MR 3T BREAST W/CONTRAST LEFT', 'MR 3T BREAST W/CONTRAST RIGHT', 'MR 3T BREAST, BILATERAL')

completion: WITH XML_DATA AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PDWS_NAME, PT_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID, PT_SEX, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_DEATH_DTE, T.* FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'dt_procedure', SITE1_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site1_gene', SITE2_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site2_gene', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', EXON_NUM VARCHAR(100) PATH 'exon_num', AA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'aa_change', CDNA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'cDNA_change', MAFREQ VARCHAR(100) PATH 'mafreq_1000g', GENE_FOLD_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_fold_change', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_type_code', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID IN ('P-0007861', 'P-0000913', 'P-0001832', 'P-0010945', 'P-0023614', 'P-0026050', 'P-0004103', 'P-0025699', 'P-0031735', 'P-0027762', 'P-0003303', 'P-0031704', 'P-0009483', 'P-0012993', 'P-0018347', 'P-0041459', 'P-0000302', 'P-0000702', 'P-0002886', 'P-0003785', 'P-0004201', 'P-0005543', 'P-0005707', 'P-0006395', 'P-0007051', 'P-0007114', 'P-0007790', 'P-0012001', 'P-0013306', 'P-0015081', 'P-0016365', 'P-0017722', 'P-0022291', 'P-0023265', 'P-0026136', 'P-0028498', 'P-0028809', 'P-0029158', 'P-0038091', 'P-0038269', 'P-0040065', 'P-0040510', 'P-0015510', 'P-0039988', 'P-0021709', 'P-0019323', 'P-0020406', 'P-0021544', 'P-0025107', 'P-0032270', 'P-0037983', 'P-0001722', 'P-0005523', 'P-0007643', 'P-0019950', 'P-0024649', 'P-0026042', 'P-0028385', 'P-0029152', 'P-0029874', 'P-0033889', 'P-0034646', 'P-0013509', 'P-0021349', 'P-0024673', 'P-0035379', 'P-0041637', 'P-0016524') ) , DT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID, PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PT_MRN, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, PT_SEX, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_DEATH_DTE, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PRIMARY_SITE FROM XML_DATA ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN XML_DATA ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('DABRAFENIB', 'TRAMETINIB', 'VEMURAFENIB', 'ENCORAFENIB', 'BINIMETINIB') ) SELECT A.PT_MRN "MRN", PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID "DMPID", PT_SEX "Gender", PT_BIRTH_DTE "DOB", PT_DEATH_DTE "DOD", PLA_LST_CON_DTE "Last Contact Date", PRIMARY_SITE "Primary Site", TUMOR_TYPE_NAME "Tumor Type Name", MAX(CASE WHEN CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS "VEMURAFENIB", MAX(CASE WHEN CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'ENCORAFENIB' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS "ENCORAFENIB", MAX(CASE WHEN CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'BINIMETINIB' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS "BINIMETINIB" FROM DT A LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN GROUP BY A.PT_MRN, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PT_SEX, PT_BIRTH_DTE, prompt: Provide a daily report for upcoming appointments for 12-245 patients and a weekly report for 12-245 patients with missing orders/accession dates
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN TM_MRN FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR_V ON CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V ON CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID = TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID JOIN DV.SEERGROUPING ON DV.SEERF_ICDO(ICSC_SITE_CD, DXCC_ICD_CODE) = RECODE WHERE CATEGORY2 IN ('Esophagus', 'Stomach') ) , IRB AS (SELECT PT_MRN IRB_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DV.ACCRUALS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PROTOCOL ON AC_PROTOCOL_ID = PRO_PROTOCOL_ID WHERE PRO_IRB_NO = '12-245' ) SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", DT_DTE AS "Encounter Date", DEPT.EDC_DEPT_DESC AS "Clinical Department", SVC.EDC_DEPT_DESC AS "Clinical Service", ENDP_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", ENR_RES_NAME AS "Primary Resource Name" FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON PENC_ENC_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT ON PENC_DEPT_ID = ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES ON PENC_PT_ENC_ID = ENSR_PT_ENC_ID AND ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE ON ENSR_RES_ID = ENR_ENC_RES_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE ON PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID = ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID prompt: Provide a list of all patients receiving asciminib (ABL001) and their Dermatologic   Toxicity Info.
completion: WITH MED AS (SELECT APR_MRN, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS FIRST_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS LAST_DATE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS DRUG_NAME FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE APR_START_DTE >= '2019-01-01' AND APR_END_DTE <= CURRENT DATE AND (LOWER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%scemblix%' OR LOWER (APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%asciminib%') GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) SELECT APR_MRN AS MRN, PT_SEX AS "Gender", TRIM(R.AV_DESC) AS "Race", TRIM(E.AV_DESC) AS "Ethnicity", DRUG_NAME AS "Drug Generic Name", FIRST_DATE AS "Date of First Dose", LAST_DATE AS "Date of Last Dose" FROM MED M JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY GROUP BY APR_MRN, PT_SEX, R.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC, DRUG_NAME, FIRST_DATE, LAST_DATE ORDER BY 1 ; WITH MED AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE APR_START_DTE >= '2019-01-01' AND APR_END_DTE <= CURRENT DATE AND (LOWER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%scemblix%' OR LOWER (APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%asciminib%') ) , ICD_MIN AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_EFF_DTE, CASE WHEN DAY(CC_EFF_DTE - APR_START_DTE) BETWEEN 0 AND 30 THEN 'Y' END AS FLAG_30_START, CASE WHEN DAY(CC_EFF_DTE - APR_END_DTE) >= 0 THEN 'Y' END AS FLAG_MED_STOP, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN MED ON APR_MRN = CC_MRN AND CC_EFF_DTE >= APR_START_DTE WHERE (SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('141', '142', '143', '144', '145', '146', '147', '148', '149', '171', '172', '173', '176', '287', '680', '681', '682', '683', '684', '685', '686', '687', '688', '689', '690', '691', '692', '693', '694', '695', '696', '697', '698', '699', '700', '701', '702', '703', '704', '705', '706', '707', '708', '709', '723', '729', '782', '910', '911', '912', '913', '914', '915', '916', '917', '918', '919', 'C00', 'C01', 'C02', 'C03', 'C04', 'C05', 'C06', 'C07', 'C08', 'C09', 'C10', 'C11', 'C12', 'C13', 'C14', 'C43', 'C44', 'C46', 'C49', 'D69', 'E65', 'L00-L99', 'M05', 'M30', 'M31', 'M32', 'M33', 'M34', 'M35', 'M36', 'M50', 'M51', 'M52', 'M53', 'M54', 'M70', 'M71', 'M72', 'M73', 'M74', 'M75', 'M76', 'M77', 'M78', 'M79', 'R20', 'R21', 'R22', 'R23') OR SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) BETWEEN 'L00' AND 'L99') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN AS MRN, APR_START_DTE AS "Drug Start Date", APR_END_DTE AS "Drug Stop Date", FLAG_30_START AS "Toxicity within First 30 days", FLAG_MED_STOP AS "Toxicity after Drug Stop Date", CC_EFF_DTE AS "ICD Effective Date", ICD_CODE AS "ICD Code", ICD_DESC AS "ICD Description" FROM MED LEFT JOIN ICD_MIN ON CC_MRN = APR_MRN ORDER BY APR_MRN, CC_EFF_DTE ;

prompt: Identify CIS orders requested by a pulmonary physician in an outpatient visit between August 2008 and July 2009.
completion: SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) IS NOT NULL THEN STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME)||': '||COALESCE(MD.OUD_USER_DI_CD, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) ELSE OO_ORD_NAME END AS ORDER_NAME, STRIP(OO_ORD_STS_CD)||'-'||STRIP(OSTS_STS_DESC) AS STATUS, OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS REQESTED_BY, OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS ENTERED_BY, OU_OCCUPATION AS OCCUPATION, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE AS ROLE_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS ORDER_COUNT FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OSTS_ORD_STS_CD = OO_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'O' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = OO_PVDR_GUID AND OP_PVDR_NO IN ('004879', '014340', '000992', '003913', '004366', '008607', '013904') JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OU_USER_GUID = OO_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA CR ON CR.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND CR.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Order - Current' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA MD ON MD.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND MD.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Order - Modified' WHERE OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2008-08-01' AND '2009-07-31' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP') AND UCASE(OO_CREATE_BY) NOT LIKE '%INTERFACES%' GROUP BY CASE WHEN COALESCE(MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) IS NOT NULL THEN STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME)||': '||COALESCE(MD.OUD_USER_DI_CD, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) ELSE OO_ORD_NAME END, OO_ORD_STS_CD, OSTS_STS_DESC, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, OU_DISPLAY_NAME, OU_OCCUPATION, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE ORDER BY 7 DESC, 1, 3

H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD prompt: Revision of RON10291 to identify the melanoma patients with neurotropism feature
completion: WITH RPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE ((CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '((("melanoma" | "melanocytic") & ("Neurotropism" | "Neurotropism: identified" | "Neurotropism: present"| "Neurotropic" | "Neurotropic features" | "With neurotropism" | "Perineural melanocytes" | "Intraneural melanocytes" | "Neurotropic melanocytic tumor" | "Perineural involvement" | "Intraneural involvement" | "Perineural invasion is identified" | "Perineural invasion is seen" | "There is perineural involvement" | "There is perineural invasion" | "Perineural invasion: identified" | "Perineural invasion: present" | "Tumor is neurotropic" | "Involves nerves" | "Involves several nerves" | "Involves several peripheral nerves")) & (NOT "Perineural invasion not identified" & NOT "Perineural invasion: not identified" & NOT "Perineural invasion is not identified" & NOT "No perineural invasion is seen" & NOT "No perineural invasion is identified" & NOT "There is no perineural invasion" & NOT "There is no perineural involvement" & NOT "There is no perineural invasion seen" & NOT "No neurotropism" & NOT "Not neurotropism" & NOT "No neurotropic" & NOT "Not neurotropic" & NOT "Without neurotropism" & NOT "No perineural involvement" & NOT "No intraneural involvement" & NOT "Not involves nerves" & NOT "Not involving nerves" & NOT "Neurotropism: Not identified"))') = 1 AND "t3"."DT_DTE" >= CURRENT date - 7 DAYS) AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL ) ) SELECT DISTINCT DEMO.PT_MRN AS "MRN", RPT_DT.DT_DTE AS "Pathology Report Date", RPT_DT.DT_YEAR AS "Pathology Report Year", RPT.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Pathology Report", "t7"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", CASE WHEN LENGTH(RPT.PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(RPT.PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(RPT.PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END "path_prpt_p1", CASE WHEN LENGTH(RPT.PRPT_REPORT) > 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(RPT.PRPT_REPORT, 15001, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE '' END "path_prpt_p2" FROM RPTS RPTS INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V RPT ON RPTS."Pathology Report" = RPT.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO INNER JOIN DV.DATE_V RPT_DT ON RPT.PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = RPT_DT.DT_DATE_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V DEMO ON RPT.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t7" ON RPT.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE = "t7"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD"

prompt: presurgical testing/OR surgery cancellation
completion: WITH ALL_PST AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%PST%' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE ) SELECT YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) AS "PST Appts" FROM ALL_PST GROUP BY YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) ORDER BY 1 ; WITH ALL_PST AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS MIN_CPE_ENC_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%PST%' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE GROUP BY CPE_MRN) , SRG1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, OC_CASE_ID, COALESCE(OL_LOG_STS, OC_OR_CASE_STS) AS SURGSTATUS , MIN_CPE_ENC_DTE, OC_SURG_DTE, SSE_PT_IN_DT, SSE_PT_OUT_DT, SSE_SURG_STRT_DT FROM ALL_PST LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_CASE ON CPE_MRN = OC_MRN AND OC_SURG_DTE >= MIN_CPE_ENC_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OC_CASE_ID AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD IN ('2', '5') LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCAP_OR_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAS_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD IN ('2', '5') LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R2 ON OCAS_RES_ID = R2.CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LOG ON OL_LOG_ID = OC_CASE_ID AND OL_SURG_DTE >= MIN_CPE_ENC_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R1 ON OC_REF_RES_ID = R1.CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON OC_CASE_ID = SSE_LOG_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID) , SRG2 AS (SELECT * FROM SRG1 WHERE SURGSTATUS ='Can' AND YEAR(OC_SURG_DTE) <> 2024 ) SELECT YEAR(OC_SURG_DTE) AS YEAR, COUNT(OC_CASE_ID) AS "Case/Surgery Cancellations" FROM SRG2 GROUP BY YEAR(OC_SURG_DTE) ORDER BY 1
