PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH 'dt_procedure', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', PART_DESCRIPTION varchar (264) PATH 'part_description', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('LNM,MNM', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = X.TTC WHERE 1=1 AND A.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2022-03-07' AND CONTAINS(A."PRPT_REPORT", '("MSK-IMPACT")') = 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(PT_MRN) "MRN", TBA_PROCUREMENT_DTE "Procurement Date", TRIM(TBA_ACCESSION_NUM) "Accession Number", TRIM(TBA_PART_NUM) "Part Number", TRIM(TBA_SUB_PART_NUM) "Sub Part Number", TBD_BANK_NUM "Bank Number", TRIM(TBA_TISSUE_TYPE_DESC) "Tissue Type", TBA_DISEASE_DESC "Disease", TBA_SITE_DESC "Site", TBD_CATEGORY_DESC "Description", TBD_UNIT_DESC "Unit Description", TBD_SPECIMEN_TYPE_DESC "Specimen Type", TBD_QUALITY_DESC "Quality Description" FROM DV.TISSUE_BANK_ACCESSION JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON TBA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN PATH A ON PT_MRN = "MRN" LEFT JOIN DV.TISSUE_BANK_DETAIL ON TBA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = TBD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND TBA_ACCESSION_NUM = TBD_ACCESSION_NUM AND TBA_PART_NUM = TBD_PART_NUM AND TBA_SUB_PART_NUM = TBD_SUB_PART_NUM WHERE 1=1 AND (TBD_RESERVED_REQUEST_ID IS NULL OR TBD_RESERVED_REQUEST_ID IN ('', '1036', '1234')) AND (TBD_DISTRIBUTION_DT IS NULL OR TBD_REQUEST_ID = '1234') AND TBD_BANK_NUM IS NOT NULL AND TBA_PROCUREMENT_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2022-03-07'

prompt: List of patients diagnosed with rectal cancer that are seeing radiation oncology physicians and Dr. Iris Wei (Surgeon). Report will be emailed Mondays at 8am and Thursdays at 3pm
completion: WITH CLINTRAC AS (SELECT CC_MRN, LISTAGG(TRIM(CC_CLSF_CD), ' / ') WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) "ICD-10", LISTAGG(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, ' / ') WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) "Diagnosis" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) = 'C20' OR SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) = 'C21.8') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) GROUP BY CC_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", "ICD-10", "Diagnosis", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN CLINTRAC ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND (CURRENT DATE + 7 DAYS) AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RDO' AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Simulator') ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE

prompt: Create cohort of patients with inflammatory bowel disease to be used in Darwin ad-hoc query tool.
completion: SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_DX_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_10_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_10_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('K50', 'K51', '555', '556') OR CC_CLSF_CD = 'K52.3') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK

prompt: Collect insurance data for SES project under 16-1119 for a list of MRNs.
Provide a list of transplanted patients seen in BMT that did not end up with a survivorship appoinment
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE + 1 DAYS - DAY(CURRENT DATE) DAYS + 1 MONTHS AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE + 1 MONTHS) AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BMT' AND NOT (CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%SVR%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%SURVIVOR%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%SNP %' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like 'SAPP %') AND CPE_MRN <> '' ) , BMT AS (SELECT CBM_MRN, CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE, CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CBM_MRN ORDER BY CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE DESC) RN FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN" FROM APPTS) A JOIN IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE ON "MRN" = CBM_MRN) , CIS_R AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OO_MRN ORDER BY OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE DESC) RN FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN" FROM APPTS) A JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON "MRN" = OO_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID WHERE OO_SET_NAME IN ('Discharge_MD/NP/PA_Auto/Heme Order Set', 'Discharge_MD/NP/PA_Allograft/BMT Order Set') AND OO_SET_HEADING = 'Follow Up Visit' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') ) , CIS AS (SELECT C.OO_MRN, C.OO_ORD_GUID, C.OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, MAX(CASE WHEN OO_SET_NAME = 'Discharge_MD/NP/PA_Auto/Heme Order Set' AND OUD_USER_DI_VALUE = '6 Months' THEN 'Y' END) "6 Month Auto Referral", MAX(CASE WHEN OO_SET_NAME = 'Discharge_MD/NP/PA_Auto/Heme Order Set' AND OUD_USER_DI_VALUE = '12 Months' THEN 'Y' END) "12 Month Auto Referral", MAX(CASE WHEN OO_SET_NAME = 'Discharge_MD/NP/PA_Allograft/BMT Order Set' AND OUD_USER_DI_VALUE = '6 Months' THEN 'Y' END) "6 Month Allo Referral", MAX(CASE WHEN OO_SET_NAME = 'Discharge_MD/NP/PA_Allograft/BMT Order Set' AND OUD_USER_DI_VALUE = '12 Months' THEN 'Y' END) "12 Month Allo Referral" FROM CIS_R C JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER O ON C.OO_MRN = O.OO_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON C.OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID WHERE OO_SET_NAME IN ('Discharge_MD/NP/PA_Auto/Heme Order Set', 'Discharge_MD/NP/PA_Allograft/BMT Order Set') AND OO_SET_HEADING = 'Follow Up Visit' AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Bre Med Survivor Return V' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') GROUP BY C.OO_MRN, C.OO_ORD_GUID, C.OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE ) , SVP AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN SVP_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CPE_CPE_CANCEL_RSN "Cancellation Reason", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) RN FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN" FROM APPTS) A JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON "MRN" = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('BMTMED 1275 SURVIVORSP', 'BMTMED 205 E64-LC SVR', 'BMTMED KOCH-12 SVR') ) SELECT "MRN", "Last Name", "First Name", "Appt Date", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", "6 Month Auto Referral", "12 Month Auto Referral", "6 Month Allo Referral", "12 Month Allo Referral", CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE "Transplant Type", CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE "Transplant Date", CASE WHEN DAYS(CURRENT date) - DAYS(CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE) BETWEEN 120 AND 180 THEN '4-6 months post transplant' WHEN DAYS(CURRENT date) - DAYS(CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE) BETWEEN 300 AND 365 THEN '10-12 months post transplant' END "Post transplant category", SVP_OTHER_STS.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS "Other Svp appt status", SVP_OTHER_STS.CPE_ENC_DTE "Other Svp appt date", SVP_OTHER_STS."Cancellation Reason" FROM APPTS JOIN BMT BMT ON "MRN" = CBM_MRN LEFT JOIN SVP SVP_COMP ON "MRN" = SVP_COMP.SVP_MRN AND SVP_COMP.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') LEFT JOIN SVP SVP_OTHER_STS ON "MRN" = SVP_OTHER_STS.SVP_MRN AND SVP_OTHER_STS.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS NOT IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND SVP_OTHER_STS.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN CIS ON "MRN" = OO_MRN WHERE BMT.RN = 1 AND SVP_COMP.SVP_MRN IS NULL AND (DAYS(CURRENT date) - DAYS(CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE) BETWEEN 120 AND 180 OR DAYS(CURRENT date) - DAYS(CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE) BETWEEN 300 AND 365)

prompt: Provide an excel spreadsheet of patients with blastic/blastoid or pleomorphic variant MCL
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, CC_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE LOWER(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) like '%mantle%cell%' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE ) SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT FROM X LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON CC_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("blastic morphology" OR "blastoid morphology" OR "blastic variant" OR "blastoid variant")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("pleomorphic morphology" OR "pleomorphic variant")') = 1)

prompt: Provide the number of procedures billed for each CPT code, for each month, by MD for 2011 in GMT.
completion: SELECT SURGEON, STRIP(CPT_CD)||' - '||MAX(PBC_PBD_DESC) AS CPT_DESC, MTH , SVC_LOC, COUNT(*) CNT FROM (SELECT PBD_MRN, PBD_ACCT_NO, PBD_SVC_DTE, PBC_CPT_CD CPT_CD , DOC_NAME SURGEON, SUBSTR(CHAR(PBD_SVC_DTE), 1, 7) MTH , PBI_SVC_LOC SVC_LOC FROM IDB.PBD_DTL_CHARGES JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBI_MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBI_ACCT_NO = PBD_ACCT_NO AND PBI_INV_NO = PBD_INV_NO AND PBI_INV_STS = ' ' AND PBI_SVC_LOC = 'O53' JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.DOC ON DOC_DR_NO = PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2011-01-01' AND '2011-12-01' AND DOC_DR_NO IN ('000190', '001404', '004671', '010470', '012567', '014514', '015776') AND PBC_PBD_DESC LIKE 'GMT%' AND PBC_CPT_CD BETWEEN '10021' AND '69999' ) X JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBC_CPT_CD = CPT_CD AND PBC_INACTV_DTE IS NULL AND PBC_PBD_DESC LIKE 'GMT%' GROUP BY SURGEON, CPT_CD, MTH, SVC_LOC

prompt: Search for breast cancer with SMARCD1 mutation by IMPACT
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT PT_MRN, TUMOR_REG_DATA, ICD_DATA FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, LISTAGG(TM_DX_DTE || ' | ' || TRIM(SITE_DESC) || ' | ' || TRIM(HIST_DESC), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE) AS TUMOR_REG_DATA FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C50%' ) A GROUP BY TM_MRN) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, LISTAGG(MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE || ' | ' || TRIM(ICD_CD) || ' | ' || TRIM(ICD_DESC), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE) AS ICD_DATA FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1=1 AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C50', '174', '175') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) A GROUP BY CC_MRN) AS ICD ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ) , DX_FINAL AS (SELECT PT_MRN DX_MRN, TUMOR_REG_DATA, ICD_DATA FROM DX) , GENES AS (SELECT PT_MRN GENE_MRN, LISTAGG(TRIM(COALESCE(PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, '')) || ' | ' || TRIM(COALESCE(PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID, '')) || ' | ' || TRIM(COALESCE(GENE, '')) || ' | ' || TRIM(COALESCE(GENE2, '')), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) AS GENE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID, GENE, GENE2 FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN DX_FINAL ON DX_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE GENE IN ('SMARCD1') OR GENE2 IN ('SMARCD1') AND METHOD like 'IMPACT%' )A GROUP BY PT_MRN) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(NAME "c", '| '||DATE(APR_START_DTE) || ' | ' || DATE(APR_END_DTE) || ' | ' || TRIM(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) || ' | ' || TRIM(APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE)||' |'|| CHR(13) || CHR(10)) ORDER BY DATE(APR_START_DTE)) AS CLOB(32000)) AS VARCHAR(32000)), '<c>', ','), '</c>', ''), '', ''), '<c/>', ''), ',', ''), 1) AS CHEMO_TX FROM (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN DX_FINAL ON DX_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE 1=1 ) A GROUP BY APR_MRN) , RADONC AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN DX_FINAL ON DX_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN WHERE 1=1 ) SELECT DISTINCT DX_MRN "MRN", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of Death", GENE "Accession No | Report ID | Gene1 | Gene2", CHEMO_TX "Chemo Tx", CASE WHEN RTC_TX_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Radonc Tx" FROM DX_FINAL JOIN GENES ON DX_MRN = GENE_MRN LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON DX_MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN RADONC ON RTC_TX_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON DX_MRN = PT_MRN

prompt: Provide a recurring report identifying desmoid tumor patients with recent appointments.
completion: SELECT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", PRPT_REPORT, "t3"."PLA_LAST_APPT_DTE" AS "Last Appointment Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE ((CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("desmoid" OR "fibromatosis")') = 1 AND "t3"."PLA_LAST_APPT_DTE" >= '2021-02-01') AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL)

prompt: Path Report Search for a list of MRNs in the past 10 years
completion: SELECT PRPT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '2009-01-01' AND CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '("nodular lymphocyte-predominant hodgkin" | "nodular lymphocyte predominant hodgkin")') = 1; SELECT PRPT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '2009-01-01' AND CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '("t-cell/histiocyte-rich" | "t cell histiocyte rich")') = 1 AND CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '("lymphoma")') = 1;

prompt: Historical Data Report for patients/employees who have been administered either a COVID PCR or COVID antibody test from March 10, 2020 until present.  We will also be requesting an on going report.
completion: WITH LOC_MAPPING AS (SELECT DISTINCT CCV_CURRENT_LOCATION AS LOWER_LEVEL_LOCATION, OL_LOC_NAME AS HIGHER_LEVEL_LOCATION FROM IDB.COVID19_CLIENT_VISIT JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON CCV_CURRENT_LOCATION_GUID = OL_LOC_GUID) SELECT COR_PATIENT_NAME AS PATIENT_NAME , COR_MRN AS MRN , DATE(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) AS TEST_DATE , COR_ORDER_NAME AS TEST_NAME , COR_RESULT_TEXT AS RESULT_TEXT , CASE WHEN UPPER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'DETECTED%' OR UPPER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'POSITIVE%' THEN 'Positive' WHEN UPPER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) LIKE 'NEGATIVE%' OR UPPER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) LIKE 'NOT DETECTED%' THEN 'Negative' WHEN LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'inconclusive%' OR LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like '%invalid%' OR LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'presumptive%' OR COR_ABNORMALITY_CODE IS NULL THEN 'Pending' ELSE 'Pending' END AS TEST_RESULT , COR_PATIENT_TYPE AS PATIENT_TYPE , COR_CURRENT_LOCATION AS PT_LOCATION , HIGHER_LEVEL_LOCATION AS PT_LOC_UNIT , LGR_LOC_GRP AS PT_LOC_SITE , OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS ORD_PROV , OP_PROV_TYPE AS ORD_PROV_TYPE , OO_ANCIL_REF_CD AS ACCESSION_NO FROM IDB.COVID19_ORDER_AND_RESULT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON COR_ORDER_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.LOCATION_GROUPS_REFERENCE A ON COR_CURRENT_LOCATION = A.LGR_LOC_NAME LEFT JOIN LOC_MAPPING ON LGR_LOC_NAME = LOWER_LEVEL_LOCATION WHERE COR_ORDER_NAME IN ('COVID-19 antiBODY Qualitative IgG', 'COVID-19 Qualitative RNA', 'COVID-19 Rapid Qualitative RNA') AND STRIP(COR_MRN) NOT IN ('11111111', '22222222') AND COR_ORDER_STATUS_CODE IN ('RESC', 'RESF') AND DATE(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 7 DAY AND CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY ORDER BY DATE(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT)

prompt: Create a daily Darwin cohort of patients that meet the criteria for this study.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, DXCC_ICD_CODE AS ICD_CODE, DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC AS ICD_DESC, MIN(DT_DTE) AS DX_DTE FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V ON PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON PDX_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG ON PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID WHERE SUBSTR(DXCC_ICD_CODE, 1, 3) IN ('191', 'C71') AND PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL GROUP BY PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, DXCC_ICD_CODE, DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC ) , MGMT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN DX ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE GENE = 'MGMT' ) , IMPACT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN MGMT ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = P_ID WHERE METHOD = 'IMPACT' ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN IMPACT ON MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'TEMOZOLOMIDE' ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN CHEMO ON RTC_TX_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON RTC_TX_MRN = PT_MRN)

prompt: Provide a list of patients with primary bone sarcomas who have had an extracurricular tumor excision between 1/1/2000 to 11/14/2019.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C41.9', '170.9') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) , CPT AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, SSE_LOG_ID FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('27076', '27078', '27365', '23220') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2019-11-14' ) SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", RTRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Patient first name", RTRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) AS "Patient last name", PT_SEX AS "Patient gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Patient DOB", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Patient DOD", SSP_SURG_LAST_NM AS "Provider", SSE_SURG_DTE AS "Service Date", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS "CPT Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS "CPT Description", ICD9_CD AS "ICD Code", ICD9_DESC AS "ICD Code Description" FROM DX JOIN CPT ON CC_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN ; WITH DOC_GUID AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_DOC_GUID AS GUID FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.DOC ON OP_PVDR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2019-11-14' AND (LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%extra-articular%' OR LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%extraarticular%' OR LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%tikhoff-tinberg%' OR LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%tikhoff tinberg%') AND DOC_ACDMC_SVC = 'ORTHOPEDIC' ) SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS "MRN", RTRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Patient first name", RTRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) AS "Patient last name", PT_SEX AS "Patient gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Patient DOB", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Patient DOD", OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Provider", CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", CDO_SECTION AS "Section", CDO_ITEM_NAME AS "Item", CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Value" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.DOC ON OP_PVDR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN DOC_GUID ON GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND LEFT(CDD_DOC_NAME, 16) = 'Operative Report' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Indications', 'Nature of Operation', 'Procedures Performed', 'PostOp Diagnosis', 'PreOp Diagnosis') ;

prompt: : Provide a list of patient consented to IRB protocol 06-107 and has specimen entered into the pathology using the keyword "Metastatic Breast Cancer".
completion: WITH PATHOLOGY_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE" AS PROCEDURE_DATE, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC" AS PATH_RPT_TYPE, CAST("DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT" AS VARCHAR(32500)) AS PATH_RPT_TEXT FROM "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" WHERE "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE" BETWEEN '2006-01-01' AND '2023-01-24' AND "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC" IN ('Surgical Pathology') AND LOCATE('osteosarcoma', LOWER(CAST("DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT" AS VARCHAR(32500)))) > 0), PROTOCOL_1 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_CONS_DTE") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_MRN") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO" AS AC_IRB_NO FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."ACCRUALS" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_MRN" WHERE "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_NON_MSK_INST" = '' AND "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO" IN ('06-107', '15-021', '97-094')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PATHOLOGY_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PATHOLOGY_0 INTERSECT SELECT PROTOCOL_1.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PROTOCOL_1)), COHORT_PATHOLOGY AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PATHOLOGY_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PATHOLOGY_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PATHOLOGY_0)), COHORT_PROTOCOL AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PROTOCOL_1.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PROTOCOL_1.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PROTOCOL_1)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_PATHOLOGY.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_PATHOLOGY_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_PATHOLOGY.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PATHOLOGY_PT_DEID, COHORT_PROTOCOL.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_PROTOCOL_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_PROTOCOL.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PROTOCOL_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_PATHOLOGY ON COHORT_PATHOLOGY.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_PROTOCOL ON COHORT_PROTOCOL.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, DMP_ID_TBL."PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID" AS DMP_ID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS GENDER, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS VITAL_STATS, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS DATE_OF_DEATH, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_RACE_DESC" AS RACE, ETHNICITY."CORE_ETHNICITY_DESC" AS ETHNICITY, ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_DESC" AS PRIMARY_LANGUAGE, LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE."PLA_LAST_ACTV_DTE" AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" LEFT OUTER JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML" AS DMP_ID_TBL ON DMP_ID_TBL."PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS" AS ETHNICITY ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = ETHNICITY."CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_PRIMARY_LANG" = ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_ELEMENT" = 'PRIMARY_LANG' LEFT OUTER JOIN "DV".PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE."PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DMP_ID AS DMP_ID, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.GENDER AS GENDER, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.VITAL_STATS AS VITAL_STATUS, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_DEATH AS DATE_OF_DEATH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.RACE AS RACE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.ETHNICITY AS ETHNICITY, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PRIMARY_LANGUAGE AS PRIMARY_LANGUAGE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID; WITH PATHOLOGY_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE" AS PROCEDURE_DATE, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC" AS PATH_RPT_TYPE, CAST("DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT" AS VARCHAR(32500)) AS PATH_RPT_TEXT FROM "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" WHERE "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE" BETWEEN '2006-01-01' AND '2023-01-24' AND "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC" IN ('Surgical Pathology') AND LOCATE('osteosarcoma', LOWER(CAST("DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT" AS VARCHAR(32500)))) > 0), PROTOCOL_1 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_CONS_DTE") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_MRN") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO" AS AC_IRB_NO FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."ACCRUALS" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_MRN" WHERE "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_NON_MSK_INST" = '' AND "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO" IN ('06-107', '15-021', '97-094')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PATHOLOGY_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PATHOLOGY_0 INTERSECT SELECT PROTOCOL_1.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PROTOCOL_1)), COHORT_PATHOLOGY AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PATHOLOGY_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PATHOLOGY_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PATHOLOGY_0)), COHORT_PROTOCOL AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PROTOCOL_1.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PROTOCOL_1.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PROTOCOL_1)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_PATHOLOGY.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_PATHOLOGY_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_PATHOLOGY.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PATHOLOGY_PT_DEID, COHORT_PROTOCOL.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_PROTOCOL_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_PROTOCOL.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PROTOCOL_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_PATHOLOGY ON COHORT_PATHOLOGY.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_PROTOCOL ON COHORT_PROTOCOL.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), PATHOLOGY_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" AS REPORT_ID, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS ACCESSION_NO, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC" AS PATH_RPT_TYPE, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT_DTE" AS REPORT_DATE, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE" AS PROCEDURE_DATE, CAST("DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT" AS VARCHAR(32500)) AS PATH_RPT_TEXT FROM "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, PATHOLOGY_COLUMNS.REPORT_ID AS PATH_REPORT_ID, PATHOLOGY_COLUMNS.ACCESSION_NO AS ACCESSION_NO, PATHOLOGY_COLUMNS.PATH_RPT_TYPE AS PATH_RPT_TYPE, PATHOLOGY_COLUMNS.REPORT_DATE AS REPORT_DATE, PATHOLOGY_COLUMNS.PROCEDURE_DATE AS PROCEDURE_DATE, PATHOLOGY_COLUMNS.PATH_RPT_TEXT AS PATH_RPT_TEXT FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN PATHOLOGY_COLUMNS ON PATHOLOGY_COLUMNS.SUBJECT_ID = KEYS.COHORT_PATHOLOGY_SUBJECT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID;

prompt: Provide a Daily list of upcoming scheduled primary breast surgeries for the following month
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN, OC_SURG_LOC_ID, LOC_LOC_NAME, OC_SURG_DTE, SUBSTR(MD.CRE_RES_NAME, 1, 35) SURGEON, OP_PROC_NAME OR_PROC_NAME, CPX_PROC_CD CPT, CPX_PROC_NAME CPT_DESC FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON OC_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE MD ON OCAS_RES_ID = MD.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE V ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = V.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION ON OC_SURG_LOC_ID = LOC_LOC_ID WHERE OC_OR_CASE_STS = 'Sch' AND OC_SURG_SVC = 'BRE' AND OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE +28 DAYS ), APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "NA_MRN", MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS "Next LAB Appt Date" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'LAB' GROUP BY CPE_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN MRN, OC_SURG_LOC_ID, LOC_LOC_NAME LOC_NAME, OC_SURG_DTE SURGERY_DATE, SURGEON, OR_PROC_NAME, CPT, CPT_DESC , "Next LAB Appt Date" FROM X LEFT JOIN APPT ON OC_MRN ="NA_MRN"

prompt: To provide all CMV Quant PCR (Plasma) Lab information based on given MRN’s.
provide a daily snapshot of Cadence related visit utilization (scheduled, completed, cancel/no-show, appt comments)
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ, CPE_CL_PT_ID, CPE_PRK AS "PRK", CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CPE_CPE_APPT_STS "Appt Status", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", D.CAV_TITLE AS "Department Desc", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", S.CAV_TITLE AS "Service Desc", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CLD_CLD_CENTER "Appt Location", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CVT_EXT_NAME "Visit Dec", CLE_NAME "Appt Entered By", FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CL_PRK = CPE_PRK JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPAN_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE = CPAN_ENC_DTE AND CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_USER ON CPE_ENTER_USER_ID = CLE_USER_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY D ON D.CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_6' AND D.CAV_ABBR = CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY S ON S.CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_8' AND S.CAV_ABBR = CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 WHERE 1 = 1 AND (UPPER(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8) IN ('OT', 'PT') OR (UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) LIKE 'OT %' OR UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) LIKE 'PT %')) AND CPE_ENC_DTE = CURRENT date - 1 ORDER BY CPE_MRN

prompt:
Retrospective patient cohort of patients diagnosed with ovarian cancer between 2014 and 2018.

Prospective cohort of patients accrued to protocol 15-200.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN "MRN", SITE_DESC, HIST_DESC, ICD_DESC FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C569') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND CURRENT date) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) ICDDATE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C56.1', 'C56.2', 'C56.9') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-12-31') AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V

prompt: Provide a list of Dermatology UCC Consult Orders placed in 2018.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "PT Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "PT First Name", OO_ENTER_DTE "Order Entered Date", OSTS_STS_DESC "Order Status", DOC_NAME "Requested by", OUO_ATN_PVDR_NAME "Attending MD", OCV_CURR_LOC "Order Location", VIS_DAYS_STAY "Visit Length (Days)" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON OL_LOC_GUID = OCV_CURR_LOC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT_V A ON OO_ADM_NUM = VIS_ADM_NUM LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OUO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OUO_PVDR_NO = OP_PVDR_NO WHERE 1=1 AND OOC_ITEM_NAME IN('Dermatology Inpatient / Urgent Care Center Consult') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND OSTS_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP') ;

prompt: any self administered drug (RMS charge master therapeutic category) Sample of the most recent MRN/DOS for each drug,
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT RMS_MRN, RMS_DOS, RMS_CHARGE_CD, RMS_CHARGE_DESC, RMS_HCPCS, RMS_HCPCS_DESC , MAX(RMS_SITE) RMS_SITE, MIN(RMS_IP_OP) RMS_IP_OP, MAX(RMS_SVC) RMS_SVC , SUM(RMS_UNITS) RMS_QTY FROM (SELECT RVCD_MRN RMS_MRN, RVCD_SVC_DTE RMS_DOS, RCDD_CHARGE_CD RMS_CHARGE_CD, CHG.RCDD_CHARGE_DESCRIPTION RMS_CHARGE_DESC, RVCD_UNITS RMS_UNITS, RVCD_VISIT_ID, RVCD_LINE_NO, COALESCE(MAX(RVD.RSTD_MSK_CENTER), MAX(RV.RSTD_MSK_CENTER), 'MAIN') RMS_SITE, MIN(RV_IP_OP_IND) RMS_IP_OP , MIN(RSVD_MSK_ADT_SYNONYM) RMS_SVC, TRIM(MAX(RMHD_MEDICARE_HCPCS_CODE)) RMS_HCPCS, TRIM(MAX(RMHD_MEDICARE_HCPCS_DESC)) RMS_HCPCS_DESC FROM IDB.RMS_VISIT JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT_CHARGE_DTL CHRG ON RV_VISIT_ID = RVCD_VISIT_ID JOIN IDB.RMS_CHARGE_CODE_DICT_DN1240 CHG ON CHRG.RVCD_CHARGE_CODE_REC_NO = CHG.RCDD_RECORD_NUMBER JOIN IDB.RMS_PATIENT_TYPE_DICT_DN1260 ON RV_PATIENT_TYPE_REC_NO = RPTD_RECORD_NUMBER JOIN IDB.RMS_SERVICE_DICT_DN37 ON RSVD_RECORD_NUMBER = RV_CURR_SVC_REC_NO JOIN IDB.RMS_MEDICARE_HCPCS_DICT_DN1280 ON RMHD_RECORD_NUMBER = RCDD_CPT4_HCPCS_CD_REC_NO AND RMHD_THERAPEUTIC_CLASS = 'SAD' LEFT JOIN IDB.RMS_PERF_SITE_DICT_DN7209 RVD ON RVCD_PERF_SITE_REC_NO = RVD.RSTD_RECORD_NUMBER LEFT JOIN IDB.RMS_PERF_SITE_DICT_DN7209 RV ON RV_CURR_NURSE_STATION_REC_NO = RV.RSTD_RECORD_NUMBER WHERE RV_ADM_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 24 MONTH AND RVCD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2023-05-01' AND '2023-05-31' GROUP BY RVCD_MRN, RVCD_SVC_DTE, RCDD_CHARGE_CD, CHG.RCDD_CHARGE_DESCRIPTION , CHRG.RVCD_UNITS, RVCD_VISIT_ID, RVCD_LINE_NO) AS RMS1 GROUP BY RMS_MRN, RMS_DOS, RMS_CHARGE_CD, RMS_CHARGE_DESC, RMS_HCPCS, RMS_HCPCS_DESC HAVING SUM(RMS_UNITS) <> 0) SELECT * FROM (SELECT RMS_MRN, RMS_DOS, RMS_CHARGE_CD, RMS_CHARGE_DESC, RMS_HCPCS, RMS_HCPCS_DESC , RMS_SITE, RMS_IP_OP, RMS_SVC, RMS_QTY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RMS_CHARGE_CD ORDER BY RMS_DOS DESC) RN FROM CTE) WHERE RN = 1

prompt: Provide total number of inpatients and outpatients with a disease of a pituitary tumor seen by Dr. Viviane Tabar in the year 2009.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN PBD_ACCT_NO LIKE '84%' THEN 'IP' WHEN PBD_ACCT_NO LIKE '00%' THEN 'IP' ELSE 'OP' END AS PTYPE, PBD_MRN AS MRN, PBD_ACCT_NO AS ACCT_NO, PBD_SVC_DTE AS DATE FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBI_MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBI_ACCT_NO = PBD_ACCT_NO AND PBI_INV_NO = PBD_INV_NO AND PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = '009910' JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = PBD_MRN AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('07.13', '07.14', '07.15', '07.68', '07.69', '07.71', '07.72', '194.3', '227.3', '237.0', '253', '253.3', '253.4', '253.8', '253.9', '628.1') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2009-12-31'

prompt: Provide MRNs based upon a list of de-identified patient ids provided by the requester
A list of H- and S- cases with "follicular lymphoma" or "follicle center" in diagnosis text from 01/01/2013 to present.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT DMP.PRPT_MRN AS MRN , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_VITAL_STATUS, PT_DEATH_DTE , CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) END AS "Current Age" , DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession No" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Report Date" , DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS "Procedure Date" , SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS RELATED_ACC_NO , SRG_DATE.DT_DTE AS RELATED_PROC_DTE , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS "Report Type" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)diag[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', DMP.PRPT_REPORT) AS DIAGNOSIS_TEXT , VARCHAR(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "Report Text (first 32000 characters)" , (SELECT VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXTFROM FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT WHERE PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V DMP LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_REFERENCES ON PRPTR_CHILD_PATH_RPT_ID = DMP.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT SRG ON SRG.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPTR_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V SRG_DATE ON SRG_DATE.DT_DATE_ID = SRG.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = DMP.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SUBSTR(DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 1, 1) IN ('H', 'S') AND (DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '01/01/2013' OR DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE >= '01/01/2013') AND CONTAINS(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, '("follicular lymphoma" OR "follicle center")') = 1 AND DMP.PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1, 9, 8

prompt: Amendment to the original request SKI29326.
completion: WITH SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('32096', '32609', '32666', '32667', '32662', '32100', '32440', '32445', '39010', '21601') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2023-05-31' AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'PEDS' ) SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END AS AGE, G.AV_DESC AS GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", R.AV_DESC AS RACE, E.AV_DESC AS ETHNICITY, TM_DX_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", TM_HIST_CD AS "Histology Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD AS "Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Site Description", TM_CLIN_TNM_T AS "Clinical T Stage", TM_CLIN_TNM_N AS "Clinical N Stage", TM_CLIN_TNM_M AS "Clinical M Stage", TM_CLIN_STG_GRP AS "Clinical Group Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_T AS "Pathologic T Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_N AS "Pathologic N Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_M AS "Pathologic M Stage", TM_PATH_STG_GRP AS "Pathologic Group Stage", SSE_SURG_DTE AS "Surgery Date", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS "Surgery CPT Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS "Surgery CPT Description", SSP_SURG_SVC_CD AS "Surgery Service Code" FROM SURG JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' AND G.AV_CODE = PT_SEX LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ORDER BY TM_MRN ; WITH SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('49203', '49204', '49205') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2023-05-31' AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'PEDS' ), DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM SURG JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON SSE_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C74.90', 'C74.91', 'C74.92', '194.0') AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN AS MRN, CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END AS AGE, G.AV_DESC AS GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", R.AV_DESC AS RACE, E.AV_DESC AS ETHNICITY, SSE_SURG_DTE AS "Surgery Date", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS "Surgery CPT Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS "Surgery CPT Description", SSP_SURG_SVC_CD AS "Surgery Service Code", MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE AS "ICD Date", ICD_CD AS "ICD Code", ICD_DESC AS "ICD Description" FROM SURG JOIN DX ON SSE_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' AND G.AV_CODE = PT_SEX LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY ORDER BY CC_MRN ; WITH SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('49203', '49204', '49205') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2023-05-31' AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'PEDS' ), DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM SURG JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON SSE_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C74.90', 'C74.91', 'C74.92', '194.0') AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN, TM_CLIN_TNM_T AS "Clinical T Stage", TM_CLIN_TNM_N AS "Clinical N Stage", TM_CLIN_TNM_M AS "Clinical M Stage", TM_CLIN_STG_GRP AS "Clinical Group Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_T AS "Pathologic T Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_N AS "Pathologic N Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_M AS "Pathologic M Stage", TM_PATH_STG_GRP AS "Pathologic Group Stage" FROM DX JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ORDER BY TM_MRN ;

prompt: Need the total number of smoking cessation patients seen for 2020 and 2021 separately that Marta Sales, DNP and Claudia Ortiz, DNP have seen at the RLC center.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN , CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DTE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR AS VT_ABBR , RHFD_FSC_CATEGORY_NAME, RFD_FSC_NAME, RPF_INS_COMP_NAME , CPAN_NOTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT DPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = DPT.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE MD ON MD.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CPE_PRK = CL_PRK LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPAN_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ JOIN IDB.RMS_PATIENT_FSC ON CPE_MRN = RPF_MRN JOIN IDB.RMS_PATIENT_FSC_PRIORITY ON RPF_PATIENT_ID = RPFP_PATIENT_ID AND RPF_FSC_REC_NO = RPFP_FSC_REC_NO AND RPF_LINE_NO = RPFP_LINE_NO JOIN IDB.RMS_FSC_DICT_DN19 ON RPFP_FSC_REC_NO = RFD_RECORD_NUMBER JOIN IDB.RMS_HPA_FSC_DICT_DN1257 ON RFD_FSC_CAT_REC_NO = RHFD_RECORD_NUMBER WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' AND DPT.CLD_CLD_CENTER = '1919' AND CPE_VST_RES_ID IN ('083097' ,'083113') AND LOWER(CPAN_NOTE) like '%smok%'

prompt: Provide a list of patients with pediatric germ cell tumors diagnosed from 1975 to present.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", "t1"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS "Vital Status", "t1"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender", "t2"."DT_DTE" AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", "t3"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t3"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Description", "t4"."CDTM_CA_SURG_DTE" AS "Tumor Surgery Date", "t5"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t5"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Description", YEAR("t2"."DT_DTE" - "t6"."DT_DTE") AS "Age at Tumor Diagnosis Date - years" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t7" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t4" ON "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t2" ON "t4"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t2"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t3" ON "t4"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t3"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t5" ON "t4"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t5"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" = "t6"."DT_DTE" WHERE 1=1 AND "t5"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('M9060/3' ,'M9061/3' ,'M9062/3' ,'M9063/3' ,'M9064/3' ,'M9070/3' ,'M9071/3' ,'M9072/3' ,'M9073/1' ,'M9080/0' ,'M9080/1' ,'M9080/3' ,'M9081/3' ,'M9082/3' ,'M9083/3' ,'M9085/3' ,'M9100/3' ,'M9101/3' ,'M9102/3' , 'M9064/2' , 'M9065/3' , 'M9084/0' , 'M9084/3') AND "t2"."DT_DTE" >= '1975-1-1' AND YEAR("t2"."DT_DTE" - "t6"."DT_DTE") <= 22 ORDER BY PT_MRN, "t2"."DT_DTE"

prompt: Provide weekly report of surgeries performed on the past weekend with surgeon name and role (fellows)
completion: WITH LAPAROSCOPIC_SRG AS (SELECT LOG_NUMBER, PATIENT_MRN, PATIENT_NAME, PATIENT_AGE, PATIENT_SEX, OL_SURG_DTE SURG_DTE , LOG_NUMBER_OF_PANELS, LOG_PRIMARY_SERVICE, LOG_PRIMARY_SURGEON, LOG_LOCATION, LOG_CAMPUS FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN IDB.PERIOP_CASE_EVENT_V ON PATIENT_MRN = OL_MRN AND LOG_NUMBER = OL_LOG_ID WHERE OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 2 DAY AND CURRENT DATE AND NOT (OL_LOG_STS_CD IN ('4 ', '6 ')) ) , PNLTIME AS (SELECT OLAP_LOG_ID, OLAP_MRN , OLAP_PNL_NO PANEL_NO, MIN(S.OLPT_EVNT_IN_DT) PANEL_START_DT, MAX(E.OLPT_EVNT_IN_DT) PANEL_END_DT FROM LAPAROSCOPIC_SRG SRG JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_PROC ON LOG_NUMBER = OLAP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_PANEL_TIMES S ON S.OLPT_LOG_ID = LOG_NUMBER AND S.OLPT_PNL_NO = OLAP_PNL_NO AND S.OLPT_PNL_EVNT_CD = '100' JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_PANEL_TIMES E ON E.OLPT_LOG_ID = LOG_NUMBER AND E.OLPT_PNL_NO = OLAP_PNL_NO AND E.OLPT_PNL_EVNT_CD = '300' GROUP BY OLAP_LOG_ID, OLAP_MRN , OLAP_PNL_NO) , SURGEONS AS (SELECT A.OLAS_LOG_ID, A.OLAS_MRN, OLAS_PNL_NO, A.OLAS_LINE_NO LINE_NO, A.OLAS_SURG_ROLE SURG_ROLE, CRE_RES_NAME SURGEON_NAME FROM PNLTIME JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG A ON OLAP_LOG_ID = A.OLAS_LOG_ID AND PANEL_NO = A.OLAS_PNL_NO JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON OLAS_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID) SELECT LOG_NUMBER, PATIENT_MRN, PATIENT_NAME, SURG_DTE , LOG_PRIMARY_SERVICE, LOG_PRIMARY_SURGEON, LOG_LOCATION, LOG_CAMPUS, SURG_ROLE, SURGEON_NAME FROM LAPAROSCOPIC_SRG SRG JOIN PNLTIME ON LOG_NUMBER = OLAP_LOG_ID JOIN SURGEONS ON OLAS_LOG_ID = OLAP_LOG_ID AND OLAS_PNL_NO = PANEL_NO

prompt: Provide a report of Josie and outpatient surgical patients who were prescribed oxycodone anytime within 2 weeks prior to surgery.
completion: WITH SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN AS MRN, SSE_LOG_ID, SSE_PT_TYPE, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSE_SURG_LOC, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || STRIP(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) AS SURGEON FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2023-07-01' AND '2023-10-01' AND(SSE_PT_TYPE = 'OP' OR SSE_PT_TYPE = 'Outpatient' OR SSE_SURG_LOC like '%JR%') ) , X AS (SELECT MRN, SSE_LOG_ID, SSE_SURG_DTE, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS VARCHAR(1000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(SURGEON AS VARCHAR(1000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(SSP_SURG_SVC_CD AS VARCHAR(1000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(SSE_SURG_LOC AS VARCHAR(1000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD) AS SURGERIES FROM SRG GROUP BY MRN, SSE_LOG_ID, SSE_SURG_DTE) , ERX AS (SELECT X.* , DAYS(SSE_SURG_DTE) - DAYS(HCPR_CREATED_DTE) AS CREATE_DAYDIFF , HCPR_CREATED_DTE RX_CREATE_DATE , DATE(HCPR_START_DT) START_DATE , HCPR_DRUG_NAME AS DRUG_NAME , HGN_GENERIC_NAME AS GENERIC_NAME , HCPR_STATUS_TYPE_DESC AS PRESCRIPTION_STATUS , HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE_DESC AS RX_TYPE FROM X JOIN IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION ON HCPR_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = HCPR_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER USR ON USR.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER REQ ON REQ.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE UOM ON UOM.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE PKG ON PKG.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_INNER_PACKAGE_SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_SCRIPT_FREQUENCY ON HSF_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID = HCPR_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID WHERE HCPR_STATUS_TYPE NOT IN (4, 5, 8) AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE IS NOT NULL AND(HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 2, 5)) AND (UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%OXYCODONE%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%OXYCODONE%') AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE <= SSE_SURG_DTE AND DATE(HCPR_START_DT) >= SSE_SURG_DTE AND DAYS(SSE_SURG_DTE) - DAYS(HCPR_CREATED_DTE) BETWEEN 0 AND 14 ) , Y AS (SELECT * FROM ERX) SELECT SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT SRG.SSE_LOG_ID) FROM SRG JOIN Y ON SRG.MRN = Y.MRN GROUP BY SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC

prompt: Provide a list of all prostate cancer patients and GYN cancer patients with appointments between 2018-09-01 and 2021-09-01.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TM_MRN ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE DESC) RN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND CATEGORY1 = 'Female Genital System' ) SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, CPP_EMAIL_ADDR EMAIL FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN PTS ON TM_MRN = CPE_MRN AND RN = 1 JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CPE_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = CPP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY ON CAV_CATEGORY = 'LANG' AND CPP_LANG = CAV_ABBR WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-09-01' AND '2021-09-01' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') AND PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND <> 'Y' AND CPP_EMAIL_ADDR <> '' AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician'

prompt: The number of nursing notes submitted per month per MD from Gastroenteroly and Nutrition departments from January 2018-June 2019.
completion: SELECT OP_DISPLAY_NAME , CDD_DOC_NAME , COUNT(CPCD_NAME) "Document Count" , SUBSTR(CHAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE), 1, 7) "Service Date" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_CNFG_PAT_CARE_DOCUMENT ON CPCD_GUID = CDD_PTCAREDOC_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) >= YEAR(CURRENT date) - 1 AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2019-06-01' AND (UPPER(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) like '%GAMBARIN%' OR UPPER(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) like '%GAMBARIN%' OR UPPER(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) like '%SCHATTNER%' OR UPPER(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) like '%GERDES%' OR UPPER(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) like '%CALO%' OR UPPER(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) like '%LUDWIG%' OR UPPER(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) like '%MARKOWITZ%' OR UPPER(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) like '%FALECK%' OR UPPER(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) like '%NISHIMURA%' OR UPPER(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) like '%KURTZ%' OR UPPER(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) like '%MENDELSOHN%' OR UPPER(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) like '%SHIKE%' OR UPPER(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) like '%SHAH%' ) AND UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like '%NURS%' GROUP BY OP_DISPLAY_NAME, CDD_DOC_NAME, SUBSTR(CHAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE), 1, 7) ; SELECT OP_DISPLAY_NAME , CDD_DOC_NAME , COUNT(CPCD_NAME) "Document Count" , SUBSTR(CHAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE), 1, 7) "Service Date" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_CNFG_PAT_CARE_DOCUMENT ON CPCD_GUID = CDD_PTCAREDOC_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) >= YEAR(CURRENT date) - 1 AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2019-06-01' AND (UPPER(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) like '%GAMBARIN%' OR UPPER(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) like '%GAMBARIN%' OR UPPER(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) like '%SCHATTNER%' OR UPPER(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) like '%GERDES%' OR UPPER(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) like '%CALO%' OR UPPER(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) like '%LUDWIG%' OR UPPER(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) like '%MARKOWITZ%' OR UPPER(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) like '%FALECK%' OR UPPER(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) like '%NISHIMURA%' OR UPPER(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) like '%KURTZ%' OR UPPER(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) like '%MENDELSOHN%' OR UPPER(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) like '%SHIKE%' OR UPPER(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) like '%SHAH%' ) AND UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like '%NURS%' GROUP BY OP_DISPLAY_NAME, CDD_DOC_NAME, SUBSTR(CHAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE), 1, 7) ;

prompt: All patients consented to 02-060 in Jun 2021 to Dec 2022.
completion: WITH CONSENT AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('02-060') AND YEAR(AC_CONS_DTE) = '2022' ) SELECT AC_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM CONSENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON AC_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients with lentigo maligna treated with imiquimod or aldara by the dermatology department.
completion: WITH CTE2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" WHERE (CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '"lentigo maligna"') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL) ) , RX AS (SELECT HCPR_MRN AS MRN, HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_ID RX_ID , HCPR_CREATED_DTE RX_CREATE_DATE , DATE(HCPR_START_DT) START_DATE , HCPR_END_DT AS END_DATE , DATE(HCPR_DISCONTINUE_DT) AS DISCONTINUE_DATE , HCPR_DRUG_NAME AS DRUG_NAME , HGN_GENERIC_NAME AS GENERIC_NAME , HCPR_STATUS_TYPE_DESC AS PRESCRIPTION_STATUS , HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE_DESC AS RX_TYPE , HCPR_DOSE_AMT AS DOSE_AMT , UOM.HRUM_NAME UOM , UOM.HRUM_DESCRIPTION UOM_DESC , HCPR_ROUTE AS ROUTE , HCPR_NDC AS NDC FROM CTE2 JOIN IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION ON HCPR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = HCPR_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER USR ON USR.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER REQ ON REQ.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE UOM ON UOM.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE PKG ON PKG.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_INNER_PACKAGE_SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_SCRIPT_FREQUENCY ON HSF_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID = HCPR_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID WHERE HCPR_STATUS_TYPE NOT IN (4, 5, 8) AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE IS NOT NULL AND(HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 2, 5) OR HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3) AND (UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%IMIQUIMOD%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%ALDARA%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%IMIQUIMOD%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%ALDARA') ) SELECT HCPR_MRN AS MRN, HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_ID RX_ID , HCPR_CREATED_DTE RX_CREATE_DATE , DATE(HCPR_START_DT) START_DATE , HCPR_END_DT AS END_DATE , DATE(HCPR_DISCONTINUE_DT) AS DISCONTINUE_DATE , HCPR_DRUG_NAME AS DRUG_NAME , HGN_GENERIC_NAME AS GENERIC_NAME , HCPR_STATUS_TYPE_DESC AS PRESCRIPTION_STATUS , HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE_DESC AS RX_TYPE , HCPR_DOSE_AMT AS DOSE_AMT , UOM.HRUM_NAME UOM , UOM.HRUM_DESCRIPTION UOM_DESC , HCPR_ROUTE AS ROUTE , HCPR_NDC AS NDC FROM RX JOIN IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION ON HCPR_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = HCPR_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER USR ON USR.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER REQ ON REQ.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE UOM ON UOM.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE PKG ON PKG.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_INNER_PACKAGE_SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_SCRIPT_FREQUENCY ON HSF_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID = HCPR_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID WHERE HCPR_STATUS_TYPE NOT IN (4, 5, 8) AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE IS NOT NULL AND(HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 2, 5) OR HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3) AND COALESCE(DATE(HCPR_START_DT), HCPR_CREATED_DTE) >= COALESCE(DATE(START_DATE), RX_CREATE_DATE) AND NOT (UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%IMIQUIMOD%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%ALDARA%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%IMIQUIMOD%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%ALDARA') SELECT DISTINCT PT.PT_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, "Pathology Report", "Pathology Procedure Date", "Pathology Report Date", "Pathology Report Type" FROM CTE2 JOIN RX ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT PT ON CTE2.PT_MRN = PT.PT_MRN SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN RX ON MRN = TM_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN RX ON CDD_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE '%DERM%' AND CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('MED_DERM_Impression Plan_FT', 'MED_DERM_PE_Skin Examination_RES', 'MED_DERM_PE_Skin Examinaton Positive_FT')

prompt: Please provide a list of patients with adrenal cortical carcinoma (ACC) treated with ablation, embolization or radioembolization in the Interventional Radiology department
completion: WITH CANCER AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M8370/3' UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) = 'C74.0' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) , SURG AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN CANCER ON SSE_MRN = MRN WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC LIKE '%ABLATION%' OR SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC IN ('THREE DOSE THERASPHERE TREATMENT', 'THERASPHERE TREATMENT', 'TWO DOSE THERASPHERE TREATMENT', 'SIRSPHERE TREATMENT WITH 3 DOSES', 'SIRSPHERE TREATMENT WITH 2 DOSES', 'SIRSPHERE TREATMENT SINGLE DOSE', 'EMBOLIZATION, ARTERIAL TUMOR HEPATIC') ) , LAST_RAD AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_ACCESSION_NO, RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY RRPT_MRN ORDER BY RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN SURG ON RRPT_MRN = SSE_MRN) SELECT SSE_MRN AS MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_SEX AS SEX, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_CON_DTE AS LAST_CONTACT_DTE, SSE_SURG_DTE AS PROCEDURE_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS PROCEDURE_NAME, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE AS LAST_RAD_DTE, RRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS LAST_RAD_ACC_NO, RRPT_ORDER_GROUP AS LAST_RAD_TYPE, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME AS LAST_RAD_NAME FROM SURG JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN LAST_RAD ON SSE_MRN = RRPT_MRN AND RN = 1 ; WITH CANCER AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M8370/3' UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) = 'C74.0' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) , SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN CANCER ON SSE_MRN = MRN WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC LIKE '%ABLATION%' OR SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC IN ('THREE DOSE THERASPHERE TREATMENT', 'THERASPHERE TREATMENT', 'TWO DOSE THERASPHERE TREATMENT', 'SIRSPHERE TREATMENT WITH 3 DOSES', 'SIRSPHERE TREATMENT WITH 2 DOSES', 'SIRSPHERE TREATMENT SINGLE DOSE', 'EMBOLIZATION, ARTERIAL TUMOR HEPATIC') ) SELECT PRPT_MRN AS MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS PATH_TYPE, PRPT_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN SURG ON PRPT_MRN = SSE_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE ; WITH CANCER AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M8370/3' UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) = 'C74.0' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) , SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN CANCER ON SSE_MRN = MRN WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC LIKE '%ABLATION%' OR SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC IN ('THREE DOSE THERASPHERE TREATMENT', 'THERASPHERE TREATMENT', 'TWO DOSE THERASPHERE TREATMENT', 'SIRSPHERE TREATMENT WITH 3 DOSES', 'SIRSPHERE TREATMENT WITH 2 DOSES', 'SIRSPHERE TREATMENT SINGLE DOSE', 'EMBOLIZATION, ARTERIAL TUMOR HEPATIC') ) SELECT APR_MRN AS MRN, APR_START_DTE AS ADMIN_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS CHEMO_NAME FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN SURG ON APR_MRN = SSE_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' ; WITH CANCER AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M8370/3' UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) = 'C74.0' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) , SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN CANCER ON SSE_MRN = MRN WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC LIKE '%ABLATION%' OR SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC IN ('THREE DOSE THERASPHERE TREATMENT', 'THERASPHERE TREATMENT', 'TWO DOSE THERASPHERE TREATMENT', 'SIRSPHERE TREATMENT WITH 3 DOSES', 'SIRSPHERE TREATMENT WITH 2 DOSES', 'SIRSPHERE TREATMENT SINGLE DOSE', 'EMBOLIZATION, ARTERIAL TUMOR HEPATIC') ) SELECT SSE_MRN AS MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE AS PROCEDURE_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS PROCEDURE_NAME FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN SURG ON SSE_MRN = MRN WHERE SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E' AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC NOT LIKE '%ABLATION%'

prompt: Provide a list of all patients with MGUS from 2000-2019.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('273.1', '273.2', 'D47.2') AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' GROUP BY CC_MRN, R.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT MRN, "Race", "Ethnicity", MAX(CASE WHEN DX_CODE = '273.1' THEN DX_DATE END) AS "273.1 (MONOCLON PARAPROTEINEMIA)", MAX(CASE WHEN DX_CODE = '273.2' THEN DX_DATE END) AS "273.2 (PARAPROTEINEMIA)", MAX(CASE WHEN DX_CODE = 'D47.2' THEN DX_DATE END) AS "D47.2 (MONOCLONAL GAMMOPATHY)" FROM X GROUP BY MRN, "Race", "Ethnicity" WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t4"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t5" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t4"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" WHERE ((CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '"MGUS"') = 1 AND "t3"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2000-1-1' AND '2019-12-31') AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL) ) SELECT MRN, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", "Pathology Report", "Pathology Procedure Date", "Pathology Report Type" FROM X JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY'

prompt: provide a list of prostate SBRT patients from 2018-2021
completion: WITH RADIATION_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE"."RTC_TX_COURSE_NO") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE"."RTC_TX_PLANSETUP_NO") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE"."RTC_TX_START_DTE" AS RADONC_START_DATE, "IDB"."RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE"."RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME" AS PLAN_NAME FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT)', UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT CEVV_MRN, DATE(CEVV_VISIT_DT) CEVV_VISIT_DTE, CEVV_MSK_VISIT_TYPE, CEVV_VISIT_STATUS FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_VISIT WHERE CEVV_VISIT_STATUS IN ('ADM', 'DSC') AND (CEVV_MSK_VISIT_TYPE LIKE '%DOSE 1%' OR CEVV_MSK_VISIT_TYPE LIKE '%FIRST%') ) SELECT CEVV_MRN AS MRN, CEVV_VISIT_DTE AS DOSE1_VISIT_DTE, CEVV_MSK_VISIT_TYPE AS DOSE1_VISIT_TYPE, CEVV_VISIT_STATUS AS DOSE1_VISIT_STATUS, DATE(CPVV_VISIT_DT) AS DOSE2_VISIT_DTE, CPVV_MSK_VISIT_TYPE AS DOSE2_VISIT_TYPE, CPVV_VISIT_STATUS AS DOSE2_VISIT_STATUS FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_CP_VACCINE_VISIT JOIN CTE ON CPVV_MRN = CEVV_MRN WHERE CPVV_VISIT_STATUS = 'PRE' AND (CPVV_MSK_VISIT_TYPE LIKE '%2ND%' OR CPVV_MSK_VISIT_TYPE LIKE '%SECOND%') ; WITH CTE AS (SELECT CPVV_MRN, DATE(CPVV_VISIT_DT) CPVV_VISIT_DTE, CPVV_MSK_VISIT_TYPE, CPVV_VISIT_STATUS FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_CP_VACCINE_VISIT WHERE CPVV_VISIT_STATUS IN ('ADM', 'DSC') AND CPVV_MSK_VISIT_TYPE LIKE '%FIRST%' ) SELECT CPVV_MRN AS MRN, CPVV_VISIT_DTE AS DOSE1_VISIT_DTE, CPVV_MSK_VISIT_TYPE AS DOSE1_VISIT_TYPE, CPVV_VISIT_STATUS AS DOSE1_VISIT_STATUS, DATE(CEVV_VISIT_DT) AS DOSE2_VISIT_DTE, CEVV_MSK_VISIT_TYPE AS DOSE2_VISIT_TYPE, CEVV_VISIT_STATUS AS DOSE2_VISIT_STATUS FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_VISIT JOIN CTE ON CEVV_MRN = CPVV_MRN WHERE CEVV_VISIT_STATUS = 'PRE' AND (CEVV_MSK_VISIT_TYPE LIKE '%DOSE 2%' OR CEVV_MSK_VISIT_TYPE LIKE '%SECOND%')

prompt:
Request to add Batch Description to IDB.RMS_VISIT_CHARGE_DETAIL_V, IDB.RMS_VISIT_CHARGE_DTL_V, IDB.VISIT_V
