prompt: Review number of 65 and older patients coming to transplant in the last 6 months who have had a geriatric consult before the transplant
completion: WITH ETO AS (SELECT CBM_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME AS PT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH BIRTH_DATE, PT_SEX_DESC GENDER, PT_RACE_DESC RACE, YEAR(CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_BMT, CBM_INDICATION_DESC, CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE, CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON CBM_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 6 MONTH AND YEAR(CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 65 ) , CDD AS (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID DOCGUID, CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_NAME DOCUMENT_NAME, CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE CDD_TRANSPLANT_DTE, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_AUTHORED_DT AUTHORED_DT, OU_DISPLAY_NAME AUTHOREDBY FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN ETO ON MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE - 365 DAY AND CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OU_USER_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE '%GERIATRICS%' ), VST AS (SELECT ENC.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, ENC.CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ , CPE_MRN, CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE CPE_TRANSPLANT_DTE, ENC.CPE_ENC_DTE VISIT_DATE, VD.CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME, VT.CRE_RES_NAME VST_MD, VT.CRE_RES_TYP MD_TYPE, CVT_EXT_NAME VISIT_TYPE, RES1.CRE_RES_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ENC JOIN ETO ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT APPT1 ON ENC.CPE_CL_PT_ID = APPT1.CPA_CL_PT_ID AND ENC.CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = APPT1.CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND APPT1.CPA_LINE_NO = 2 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE RES1 ON APPT1.CPA_RES_ID = RES1.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT VD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = VD.CLD_DEPT_ID AND VD.CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('GERIATRICS 53-3', 'GERIATRICS 53-7', 'GERIATRICS 16 E60-4', 'GERIATRICS KOCH-17') JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VT ON VT.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE - 365 DAY AND CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 ) SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, BIRTH_DATE, GENDER, RACE, AGE_AT_BMT, CBM_INDICATION_DESC, CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE, CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE, VISIT_DATE, DEPT_NAME, VST_MD, MD_TYPE, VISIT_TYPE, CRE_RES_NAME, DOCUMENT_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, AUTHORED_DT, AUTHOREDBY FROM ETO LEFT JOIN CDD ON CDD_MRN = MRN AND CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE = CDD_TRANSPLANT_DTE LEFT JOIN VST ON MRN = CPE_MRN AND CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE = CPE_TRANSPLANT_DTE

prompt: Provide an on demand report for protocol registrations and questionnaire answers for 06-107, 12-245, BRPs and RRPs.
completion: WITH ARM AS (SELECT DISTINCT TREATMENT_TYPE_DESC, P.PROTOCOL_NO, STEP_CODE, ARM_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_MRN FROM NN.SV_SUB_TREATMENT S JOIN NN.SV_PROTOCOL P ON S.PROTOCOL_ID = P.PROTOCOL_ID WHERE (P.PROTOCOL_NO IN ('06-107', '12-245') OR TREATMENT_TYPE_DESC IN ('Biospecimen Research Protocol', 'Retrospective Research Protocol')) ) , RAW AS (SELECT PT_MRN CA_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PROTOCOL_NO CA_IRB_NO, CASE WHEN CQD_REG_ID IN (1, 2) THEN CQD_REG_ID*100 ELSE COALESCE(CQD_REG_ID, STEP_CODE) END CA_REG_ID, STEP_CODE, ARM_DESCRIPTION, ACD_CONS_DTE CA_CONSENT_DTE, AC_CONS_STAFF_NAME, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE, CA_QUESTION_ID, CQD_QUESTION_DESC, CA_ANSWER_DESC, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CA_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CA_IRB_NO, CA_REG_ID ORDER BY CA_REG_ENTRY_START_DT DESC) RNK FROM ARM A LEFT JOIN IDB.CONSENT_ANSWERS CA ON CA.CA_MRN = A.SUBJECT_MRN AND CA_IRB_NO = PROTOCOL_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.CONSENT_QUESTION_DEFINITION ON CA_IRB_NO = CQD_IRB_NO AND CA_REG_ID = CQD_REG_ID AND CA_QUESTION_ID = CQD_QUESTION_ID AND CASE WHEN A.STEP_CODE = 5555 THEN A.STEP_CODE WHEN CQD_REG_ID IN (1, 2) THEN CQD_REG_ID*100 ELSE CQD_REG_ID END = A.STEP_CODE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON A.SUBJECT_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON A.SUBJECT_MRN = ACD_MRN AND PROTOCOL_NO = ACD_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON ACD_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO AND ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO = AC_SUBJ_ID_NO AND ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO WHERE 1=1 ) SELECT CA_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", CA_IRB_NO "Protocol", CA_REG_ID "Registration ID", ARM_DESCRIPTION "Arm", CA_CONSENT_DTE "Consent Date", TRIM(AC_CONS_STAFF_NAME) "Consenting Professional", ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE "Off Study Date", MAX(CASE WHEN CA_QUESTION_ID = 1 THEN CQD_QUESTION_DESC END) "Question 1", MAX(CASE WHEN CA_QUESTION_ID = 1 THEN CA_ANSWER_DESC END) "Question 1 Answer", MAX(CASE WHEN CA_QUESTION_ID = 2 THEN CQD_QUESTION_DESC END) "Question 2", MAX(CASE WHEN CA_QUESTION_ID = 2 THEN CA_ANSWER_DESC END) "Question 2 Answer", MAX(CASE WHEN CA_QUESTION_ID = 3 THEN CQD_QUESTION_DESC END) "Question 3", MAX(CASE WHEN CA_QUESTION_ID = 3 THEN CA_ANSWER_DESC END) "Question 3 Answer", MAX(CASE WHEN CA_QUESTION_ID = 4 THEN CQD_QUESTION_DESC END) "Question 4", MAX(CASE WHEN CA_QUESTION_ID = 4 THEN CA_ANSWER_DESC END) "Question 4 Answer", MAX(CASE WHEN CA_QUESTION_ID = 5 THEN CQD_QUESTION_DESC END) "Question 5", MAX(CASE WHEN CA_QUESTION_ID = 5 THEN CA_ANSWER_DESC END) "Question 5 Answer", MAX(CASE WHEN CA_QUESTION_ID = 6 THEN CQD_QUESTION_DESC END) "Question 6", MAX(CASE WHEN CA_QUESTION_ID = 6 THEN CA_ANSWER_DESC END) "Question 6 Answer", MAX(CASE WHEN CA_QUESTION_ID = 7 THEN CQD_QUESTION_DESC END) "Question 7", MAX(CASE WHEN CA_QUESTION_ID = 7 THEN CA_ANSWER_DESC END) "Question 7 Answer" FROM RAW GROUP BY CA_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CA_IRB_NO, CA_REG_ID, STEP_CODE, ARM_DESCRIPTION, CA_CONSENT_DTE, AC_CONS_STAFF_NAME, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE

prompt: Identify which of the specified patients have had IMPACT testing or have a radiology report documenting a fracture.
completion: WITH PT AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.PATIENT WHERE PT_MRN IN () ) , RAD AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."RRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Radiology Accession Number", "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" AS "Radiology Performed Date", "t2"."RRPT_REPORT_DTE" AS "Radiology Report Date", "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS "Radiology Order Group", "t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" AS "Radiology Procedure Name", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(RRPT_REPORT_TXT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS "PRPT_REPORT" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE "t4"."PI_SOURCE_SYSTEM_PT_ID" IN (SELECT MRN FROM PT) ) SELECT * FROM RAD WHERE 1=1 AND UPPER("PRPT_REPORT") like '%FRACTURE%' SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PDWS_NAME like '%IMPACT%' AND PT_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM PT)

prompt: Provide clinical data for a list of patients who received SGLT2 inhibitors, ACE inhibitor, or ARB during treatment for renal cell carcinoma.
completion: WITH TUMOR AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_HIST_CD, TM_HIST_TXT, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG, TM_ADM_DTE, TM_FIRST_MSK_DTE, TM_CASE_STS, TM_CHEMO_STRT_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8312/3') ) , MEDICATION AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, POD_RX_NO, PINC_GENERIC_NAME AS GENERIC_NAME , POD_ITEM_DESC DRUG_NAME, MAX(INT(POD_NET_ACCUM_DOSE), 1) DISPENSE_CNT , SD.DT_DTE AS START_DATE, SPD.DT_DTE STOP_DATE, POA_ROUTE_ABBR ROUTE , CASE WHEN POD_IV_VOL > 0 THEN POD_IV_VOL ELSE POD_DOSE END DOSE , CASE WHEN POD_IV_VOL > 0 THEN POD_IV_VOL_UNIT ELSE POD_DOSE_UNIT END AS DOSE_UNIT , MAX(INT(POD_NET_ACCUM_DOSE), 1)*(CASE WHEN POD_IV_VOL > 0 THEN POD_IV_VOL ELSE POD_DOSE END) TOTAL_DOSE , CASE WHEN POD_SRX_ORD_GUID > 0 THEN POD_ORD_FREQ ELSE POSA_SCH_CD END AS FREQ , POSA_ORD_DUR_TXT ORD_DUR, POA_DISP_LOC_NAME RX_LOC , CASE WHEN POD_IVVH_ORD_IND = 'Y' THEN 'N' ELSE POD_PRIMARY_IND END PRIMARY_IND , MP_SERVICE_CD SERVICE_CD, MP_SERVICE_DESC SERVICE_DESC , MP_FULL_NM PROVIDER_NAME, MP_SOURCE_PROVIDER_NO PROVIDER_NO , POD_PLACER_ID_TXT CIS_ORDER_ID, POD_SRX_ORD_ID SRX_ORD_ID , POD_CR_DT ORD_CREATE_DT, POD_ORD_STRT_DT ORD_STRT_DT, POD_STOP_DT STOP_DT , POD_DIRECTIONS DIRECTIONS , CASE WHEN POD_SRX_ORD_ID > 0 THEN POA_MED_FORM_CD ELSE PINC_DOSE_FORM_CD END MED_FORM , POD_HVC_CATEGORY HVC_CATEGORY, POD_SRX_CATEGORY SRX_CATEGORY , CASE WHEN PINC_NDC > ' ' THEN PINC_NDC ELSE POD_NDC_CD END NDC , PINC_AHFS, PINC_THERAPEUTIC_CLASS_CD THERAPEUTIC_CLASS FROM DV.PHM_ORDER_DTL JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG ON PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PHM_ORDER_ATTR ON POA_PHARMA_ORDER_ATTR_ID = POD_PHARMA_ORD_ATTR_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PHM_ORDER_SCHED_ATTR ON POSA_PHARMA_ORD_SCH_ATTR_ID = POD_PHARMA_ORD_SCH_ATTR_ID LEFT JOIN DV.MEDPRO ON POD_ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_ID = MP_MEDPRO_ID JOIN DV.DATE SD ON SD.DT_DATE_ID = POD_START_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DATE SPD ON SPD.DT_DATE_ID = POD_STOP_DATE_ID JOIN TUMOR T ON PT_MRN = T.TM_MRN WHERE (UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%CANAGLIFLOZIN%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%INVOKANA%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%FORXIGA%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%JARDIANCE%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%STEGLARTO%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%ENTRESTO%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%SACUBITRIL/VALSARTAN%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%BENAZEPRIL%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%CAPTOPRIL%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%CILAZAPRIL%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%ENALAPRIL%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%ENALAPRILAT%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%FOSINOPRIL%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%LISINOPRIL%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%MOEXIPRIL%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%PERINDOPRIL%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%QUINAPRIL%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%RAMIPRIL%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%TRANDOLAPRIL%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%LOTENSIN%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%VASOTEC%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%PRINIVIL%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%QBRELIS%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%ALTACE%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%AZILSARTAN%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%CANDESARTAN%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%EPROSARTAN%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%IRBESARTAN%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%LOSARTAN%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%OLMESARTAN%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%TELMISARTAN%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%VALSARTAN%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%ATACAND%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%AVAPRO%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%COZAAR%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%BENICAR%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%MICARDIS%' OR UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%DIOVAN%') ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT N.MRN, TM_MRN, TM_HIST_CD, TM_HIST_TXT, GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME FROM MEDICATION N JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ATV ON N.MRN = ATV.APR_MRN JOIN TUMOR ON TM_MRN = N.MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' ) , DEMO AS (SELECT PT_MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_SEX , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH , E.AV_DESC ETHNICITY_REG, PFA_FST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE FROM TUMOR LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN= PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CP_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTIVITY ON PFA_MRN= TM_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = TM_MRN) , DMP AS (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM (SELECT A.PT_MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, DT_DTE REPORT_DATE, PRIMARY_SITE, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, MAX(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) OVER (PARTITION BY A.PT_MRN, DT_DTE ORDER BY TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) MAX_TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PART_DESCRIPTION, GENE, LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, ABERRATIONTYPE, DV.TODATE(DV.REGEXSTR('[0-9]*[\-|\.|\/][0-9]*[\-|\.|\/][0-9]*', T.DT_PROCEDURE)) AS PROCEDUREDATE, MAINRPT.DT_DTE REPORT_DTE FROM TUMOR T INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS A ON T.TM_MRN= PT_MRN INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V B ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = B.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V MAINPATH ON MAINPATH.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V MAINRPT ON MAINRPT.DT_DATE_ID = MAINPATH.PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH 'tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH 'is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'metastasis_site', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH 'part_description', DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH 'dt_procedure') T) WHERE TUMOR_TYPE_NAME = MAX_TUMOR_TYPE_NAME ) SELECT DISTINCT T.TM_MRN MRN , D.PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name" , D.PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name" , D.PT_SEX AS "Gender" , D.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth" , D.PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death" , D.ETHNICITY_REG, T.TM_HIST_CD HISTOLOGY_CD, T.HIST_DESC HISTOLOGY_DESC, V.TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, D.PFA_FST_APPT_DTE FIRST_VISIT_MSK, D.PLA_LST_APPT_DTE LAST_VISIT_MSK, N.GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE CHEMO_START_DATE, APR_END_DTE CHEMO_END_DATE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME CHEMO_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME FROM TUMOR T JOIN MEDICATION N ON T.TM_MRN =N.MRN LEFT JOIN DEMO D ON T.TM_MRN = D.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN DMP V ON V.PT_MRN=T.TM_MRN LEFT JOIN CHEMO O ON T.TM_MRN =O.MRN ; WITH TUMOR AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_HIST_CD, TM_HIST_TXT, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG, TM_ADM_DTE, TM_FIRST_MSK_DTE, TM_CASE_STS, TM_CHEMO_STRT_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8312/3') ), LAB AS (SELECT TUMOR.TM_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE LAB_TEST_DATE, LR_TEST_NAME LAB_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME LAB_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE LAB_RESULT FROM TUMOR JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON TM_MRN = LR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID JOIN IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTIVITY ON LR_MRN = PFA_MRN AND PFA_FST_CHEMO_MSK_DTE < LR_PERFORMED_DTE WHERE ((LR_TEST_NAME = 'Complete Blood Count (CBC), WITH Differential' AND LOWER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) IN prompt: Provide a monthly report on patient admissions with ConnectiCare insurance.
completion: WITH VISIT_DATA AS (SELECT VIS_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, RVPF_CERTIFICATE_NUMBER AS MEMBER_ID, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_VISIT_ID, VIS_ADM_NUM, TREATMENT_PLAN_DESC FROM IDB.VISIT_V JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT_PLAN ON VIS_VISIT_ID = RVP_VISIT_ID JOIN IDB.RMS_FSC_DICT_DN19 ON RVP_PLAN_FSC_REC_NO = RFD_RECORD_NUMBER JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT_PLAN_FOLLOWUP ON RVP_VISIT_ID = RVPF_VISIT_ID AND RVP_PLAN_NO = RVPF_PLAN_NUMBER JOIN IDB.RMS_INSURANCE_COMPANY_DICT_DN120 ON RVPF_INS_COMP_DICT_ENTR_REC_NO = RICD_RECORD_NUMBER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON VIS_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND RVP_PLAN_NO = '1' AND RICD_COMPANY_NAME IN ('CONNECTICARE INC (D48)', 'CONNECTICARE MEDICARE ADVANTAGE') AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND YEAR(VIS_ADM_DTE) = YEAR(CURRENT date) ) , DX AS (SELECT RAD_MRN AS DX_MRN, RAD_VISIT_ID AS DX_VISIT_ID, VIS_ADM_NUM AS DX_ADM_NUM, RDXD_DX_CD AS DX_CD, RDXD_DX_DESCRIPTION AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.RMS_ADM_DX JOIN VISIT_DATA ON VIS_VISIT_ID = RAD_VISIT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.RMS_DX_DICT_DN36 ON RDXD_RECORD_NUMBER = RAD_DX_REC_NO) SELECT PT_LAST_NAME "PT Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "PT First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", MEMBER_ID "Member ID", VIS_ADM_DTE "Admit Date", VIS_DSCH_DTE "Discharge Date", DX_CD "Admitting Dx Code", DX_DESC "Admitting Dx Code Desc", TREATMENT_PLAN_DESC "Admit Bed Type" FROM VISIT_DATA LEFT JOIN DX ON VIS_VISIT_ID = DX_VISIT_ID ;

prompt: Identify repetitive charge posting in RMS

prompt:
1.  All patients having a lumpectomy + sentinel node biopsy procedure ( cpt 19301+ 38525) at JRSC each week starting august 1st 2019.



2.  Any medications that were prescribed to these patients in CIS on the day of surgery and within 7 days of the procedure
completion: WITH MEDS AS (SELECT OO_MRN , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE , CASE WHEN NFN.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE IS NOT NULL THEN NFN.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME)||' '||STRIP(OO_ORD_MODIFIER) END ORD_NAME , CASE WHEN UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%CODEINE%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%FENTANYL%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%HYDROCODONE%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%HYDROPMORPHONE%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%MEPERIDINE%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%METHADONE%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%MORPHINE%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%OXYCODONE%' THEN 'OPIOID' END AS OPIOID_FLAG , OUO_ATN_PVDR_NAME ORDERING_MD , CAST(OMD_DOSE_LOW AS DECIMAL(10, 4)) RX_DOSE , OMD_DOSE_UNIT RX_UNIT , OMD_ORD_ROUTE ORD_ROUTE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OMD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' LEFT JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA NFN ON NFN.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND NFN.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Rx-INVEST_Meds_Form', 'Rx-Invest_Non-Formulary', 'Rx-NF_Med_Name') WHERE(OO_ORD_STS_CD IN ('COMP', 'AUC1', 'COMPT') OR(OO_ORD_STS_CD IN ('DISC', 'DISCD', 'AUA2') AND OCIT_LEVEL_NO = 0)) UNION SELECT HCPR_MRN AS OO_MRN, DATE(HCPR_START_DT) AS OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, HGN_GENERIC_NAME AS ORD_NAME, CASE WHEN UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%CODEINE%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%FENTANYL%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%HYDROCODONE%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%HYDROPMORPHONE%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%MEPERIDINE%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%METHADONE%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%MORPHINE%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%OXYCODONE%' THEN 'OPIOID' END AS OPIOID_FLAG, OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS ORDERING_MD, CAST(HCPR_DOSE_AMT AS DECIMAL(10, 4)) AS RX_DOSE, HRUM_NAME AS RX_UNIT, HCPR_ROUTE AS ORD_ROUTE FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE ON HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID = HRUM_RXUOM_ID WHERE HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 ) SELECT SSE_MRN AS MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", SSP_SURG_LAST_NM "Surgeon Last Name", SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM "Surgeon First Name", SSE_SURG_LOC "Surgery Location", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE "Med Admin Date", ORD_NAME "Med Order Name", OPIOID_FLAG, ORDERING_MD "Med Ord Provider", RX_DOSE "Dose", RX_UNIT "Unit", ORD_ROUTE "Route" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSE_SURG_LOC, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, ORD_NAME, OPIOID_FLAG, ORDERING_MD, RX_DOSE, RX_UNIT, ORD_ROUTE, MIN(CASE WHEN SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD = '19301' THEN 'Y' END) AS "19301", MIN(CASE WHEN SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD = '38525' THEN 'Y' END) AS "38525" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('19301', '38525') LEFT JOIN MEDS ON SSE_MRN = OO_MRN AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN SSE_SURG_DTE AND (SSE_SURG_DTE + 7 DAY) WHERE SSE_SURG_DTE >= '2019-08-01' AND (SUBSTR(SSE_SURG_LOC, 1, 2) = 'JR' OR SUBSTR(SSE_SURG_LOC, 1, 4) = 'MAIN' OR SUBSTR(SSE_SURG_LOC, 1, 8) = 'MONMOUTH') GROUP BY SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSE_SURG_LOC, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, ORD_NAME, OPIOID_FLAG, ORDERING_MD, RX_DOSE, RX_UNIT, ORD_ROUTE ) WHERE "19301" IS NOT NULL AND "38525" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY SSE_SURG_DTE, SSE_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of patient's most recent  Dual Energy CAT Scan of the Abdomen/ Liver since 2015 that have a diagnosis of Neuroendocrine Tumors.
completion: WITH NEW_TUMORS AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('209', 'C7A', 'C7B', 'D3A') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2018-12-31') SELECT * FROM NEW_TUMORS JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V ON CC_MRN = RRPT_MRN AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE AND MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE + 2 YEARS WHERE RRPT_ORDER_GROUP = 'CT' AND (RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME IN ('CT DUAL ENERGY NECK W CONTRAST', 'Dual Energy Neck w/ Con') OR (CONTAINS(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, '"dual energy"') <> 0 OR CONTAINS(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, '"dxa"') <> 0))

prompt: Provide a weekly report of completed new visit appointments, with a 1-week delay, for myeloma and lymphoma patients.
completion: WITH PARMS_PRE AS (SELECT 2 AS P_DOW , (CURRENT date - 14 DAYS) - (DAYOFWEEK_ISO(CURRENT date - 7 DAYS) - 1) AS START2 , (CURRENT date - 14 DAYS) + (7-(DAYOFWEEK_ISO((CURRENT date - 7 DAYS)))) DAYS AS END2 FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1) SELECT DISTINCT T1.PT_MRN AS "MRN", T2.DT_DTE AS "Encounter Date", T3.EDC_DEPT_DESC AS "Encounter Status", T4.ENDP_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", T5.ENDP_DEPT_NAME AS "Primary Resource Dept Name", T4.ENDP_CENTER_ABBR AS "Department Site", T6.ENR_RES_NAME AS "Primary Resource Name", T6.ENR_RES_TYP AS "Primary Resource Type", T7.ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR AS "Visit Type Abbrev", T7.ENVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type Name", T7.ENVT_EXT_NAME AS "Visit Type External Name", CASE WHEN UPPER(T4.ENDP_REG_DEPT_GRP1) IN ('REG') THEN 'Regional' ELSE 'New York City' END AS "Regional Site Indicator", T4.ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6 AS "Clinical Department (Group 6)", T8.EDC_DEPT_DESC AS "Clinical Dept Desc (Group 6)", T4.ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8 AS "Clinical Service (Group 8)", T10.EDC_DEPT_DESC AS "Clinical Service Desc (Group 8)", T4.ENDP_PHY_LOC AS "Physical Location", T11.PENC_RM_NO AS "Room Number" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V T1 LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED T14 ON T1.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = T14.PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER T11 ON T14.PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = T11.PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V T2 ON T11.PENC_ENC_DATE_ID = T2.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG T3 ON T11.PENC_APPT_STS = T3.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV AND T3.EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS' LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT T4 ON T11.PENC_DEPT_ID = T4.ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES T15 ON T11.PENC_PT_ENC_ID = T15.ENSR_PT_ENC_ID AND T15.ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' LEFT JOIN DV.MEDPRO_V T13A ON T15.ENSR_MEDPRO_ID = T13A.MP_MEDPRO_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC IDOC ON T13A.MP_SOURCE_PROVIDER_NO = IDOC.DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT T5 ON T15.ENSR_DEPT_ID = T5.ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG T8 ON T5.ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6 = T8.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV AND T8.EDC_GROUP_ID = '6' LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG T10 ON T5.ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8 = T10.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV AND T10.EDC_GROUP_ID = '8' LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE T6 ON T15.ENSR_RES_ID = T6.ENR_ENC_RES_ID LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE T7 ON T11.PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID = T7.ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT T12 ON T11.PENC_REF_DEPT_ID = T12.ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.MEDPRO_V T13 ON T11.PENC_REF_PROVIDER_ID = T13.MP_MEDPRO_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V T16 ON T1.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = T16.PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID , PARMS_PRE WHERE 1=1 AND T2.DT_DTE BETWEEN START2 AND END2 AND T4.ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8 IN ('LYM', 'MYL') AND T4.ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND T3.EDC_DEPT_DESC IN ('Arrived', 'Completed', 'Treatment/Exam Held') AND (ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%NV%' OR ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%IR%' ) ORDER BY "Encounter Date", MRN ;

prompt: Provide a weekly cumulative listing of non-small cell lung cancer patients with KEAP1 or NFEL2L mutations.
completion: WITH CHT AS (SELECT CHT_COHORT_ID FROM DVCMS.COHORT WHERE CHT_COHORT_ID = 9727) , PTS AS (SELECT CHP_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS COHORT_PID, PT_MRN AS CHT_MRN, CHT_COHORT_ID, DATE(CHP_CREATED_DT) ID_DATE, DAYS(CURRENT date) - DAYS(CHP_CREATED_DT) AS DAYS_ON_COHORT FROM DVCMS.COHORT_PATIENT JOIN CHT ON CHP_COHORT_ID = CHT_COHORT_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON CHP_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID ) , GENE_MATCH AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS GENE_PID , PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AS GENE_RID , PRPT_MODIFIED_DT, PATH_RPT_DATE , PT_MRN, GENE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, ABERRATIONTYPE, LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, NUCLEOTIDE, SEARCH_HIT2, METHOD, SEARCH_HIT1 FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN PTS ON COHORT_PID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND GENE IN ('NFE2L2', 'KEAP1') ) , DMP_DX_PRE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID, T.*, GENE_RID , PRPT_MODIFIED_DT, PATH_RPT_DATE , PT_MRN AS MRN, GENE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, ABERRATIONTYPE, LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, NUCLEOTIDE, SEARCH_HIT2, METHOD, SEARCH_HIT1 , PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name' , GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/gene-panel' , PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/part_description' , DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure') T JOIN GENE_MATCH ON GENE_RID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID) , DMP_DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT DMP.* FROM DMP_DX_PRE DMP ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) AS "Last Name", TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "First Name", TRIM(PT_BIRTH_DTE) AS "Date of Birth", TRIM(PT_DEATH_DTE) AS "Deceased Date", TRIM(PT_VITAL_STATUS) AS "Vital Status", TRIM(PT_SEX_DESC) AS "Gender" , PATH_RPT_DATE AS "Report Date" , DATE(PRPT_MODIFIED_DT) AS "Modified Date" , TRIM(GENE) AS "Gene" , TRIM(PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) AS "Accession No" , TRIM(ABERRATIONTYPE) AS "Aberration Type" , TRIM(LOCUS) AS "Locus" , TRIM(AA_CHANGE) AS "Amino Acid Change" , TRIM(NUCLEOTIDE) AS "Nucleotide" , TRIM(SEARCH_HIT2) AS "Search Hit2" , TRIM(PART_DESCRIPTION) AS "Part Description" , TRIM(GENE_PANEL) AS "Gene Panel" , TRIM(DT_PROCEDURE) AS "dt_procedure" , TRIM(METHOD) AS "Method" , TRIM(SEARCH_HIT1) AS "Search Hit1" , PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID AS DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID AS DMP_SAMPLE_ID , DAYS_ON_COHORT AS "Days Pt on Cohort" FROM DMP_DX JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = P_ID LEFT JOIN PTS ON COHORT_PID = P_ID ORDER BY MRN, PATH_RPT_DATE, DATE(PRPT_MODIFIED_DT), "Gene", "Locus", "Amino Acid Change" ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients with pancreatic cancer who received adjuvant mFOLFIRINOX (modified FOLFIRINOX) at the center between 1/1/2015 and 1/1/2022.
completion: WITH RES AS (SELECT PT_MRN, CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C25%' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2022-01-01') AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C25%' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2022-01-01') AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ) , FIN AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN AS MRN, APR_START_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_SET_NAME APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE FROM RES JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE APR_SET_NAME = 'STGI_mFOLFIRINOX' ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM FIN

prompt: Pediatric protocol details that are open to accrual
completion: SELECT PRO_IRB_NO "IRB", PRO_AMND_NO "Amendment Number", PRO_IRB_TITLE "Title", PRO_IRB_STS_DESC "Status", PRO_IRB_STS_DTE "Status Date", PRO_PROTO_PHASE "Phase", PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE "Type", PRO_OPEN_DTE "Open Date", PRO_MIN_AGE "Min Age", PRO_MAX_AGE "Max Age", PRO_CHILDREN_FLAG "Children Flag", PRO_INVST_DVCE_TST "Investigational Device", PRO_INVST_DRGS_TST "Investigational Drug", PRO_SPON_NAME "Sponsor Name", PRO_SPON_DPT_NAME "Sponsor Dept", MGMT_GROUP_DESCRIPTION "Management Group", PRIMARY "Primary Management Group", PRO_PTS_PLND "Patients Planned", PRO_PTS_ACCRD "Patients Accrued" FROM IDB.PROTOCOL JOIN NN.SV_PCL_MGMT_MGMTGROUP ON PRO_IRB_NO = PROTOCOL_NO WHERE PRO_IRB_STS_DESC ='Open for Accrual' AND MGMT_GROUP_DESCRIPTION like 'Pediatrics%'

prompt: Provide Oxygen Treatment  Orders placed in the last 6 months
completion: SELECT OUO_ORD_GUID , OUO_PVDR_NAME "Provider", OUO_PVDR_ROLE_TYPE "Pvdr Role", OO_REQUESTED_DT, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT "Start Datetime", OO_STOP_DT "Stop DateTime", (DAYS(COALESCE(OO_STOP_DT, CURRENT TIMESTAMP))*24*60 + HOUR(COALESCE(OO_STOP_DT, CURRENT TIMESTAMP))*60 + MINUTE(COALESCE(OO_STOP_DT, CURRENT TIMESTAMP)))/1440 - (DAYS(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT)*24*60 + HOUR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT)*60 + MINUTE(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT))/1440 "Order Duration in Days", OUO_USER_NAME "Enter By", OUO_USER_ROLE_TYPE "Enter By Role", OUO_ENTER_DTE "Order Enter Date", OUO_ORD_ID "Ord ID", OUO_ORD_NAME "Order Name", OUO_REQ_TME_PRIO "Time Priority" , STRIP(OUO_ORD_STS_CD)||'-'||STRIP(OUO_STS_DESC) "Ord Status" , OUO_MRN, OUO_CURR_LOC "Ord Location", INT(STRIP(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE)) AS "Oxigen Concentration %", CASE WHEN OUO_CURR_LOC LIKE '.NACU%' THEN 'NACU' WHEN OUO_CURR_LOC LIKE 'CDU%' THEN 'CDU' WHEN OUO_CURR_LOC LIKE 'UCC%' THEN 'UCC' WHEN OUO_CURR_LOC LIKE 'Peds%' THEN 'PED' WHEN OUO_CURR_LOC LIKE 'M2E%' THEN 'M2E%' WHEN OUO_CURR_LOC LIKE 'M 4%' THEN 'M4' WHEN OUO_CURR_LOC LIKE 'M 5%' THEN 'M5' WHEN OUO_CURR_LOC LIKE 'M6 PACU%' THEN 'M6 PACU' WHEN OUO_CURR_LOC LIKE 'M 7%' THEN 'M7' WHEN OUO_CURR_LOC LIKE 'M 8%' THEN 'M8' WHEN OUO_CURR_LOC LIKE 'M 9%' THEN 'M9' WHEN OUO_CURR_LOC LIKE 'M 10%' THEN 'M10' WHEN OUO_CURR_LOC LIKE 'M 12%' THEN 'M12' WHEN OUO_CURR_LOC LIKE 'M 14%' THEN 'M14' WHEN OUO_CURR_LOC LIKE 'M 15%' THEN 'M15' WHEN OUO_CURR_LOC LIKE 'M 16%' THEN 'M16' WHEN OUO_CURR_LOC LIKE 'M 17%' THEN 'M17' WHEN OUO_CURR_LOC LIKE 'M 18%' THEN 'M18' WHEN OUO_CURR_LOC LIKE 'M 19%' THEN 'M19' ELSE 'OTHER' END "Location GRP", CASE WHEN INT(STRIP(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE)) BETWEEN 0 AND 19 THEN '<20' WHEN INT(STRIP(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE)) BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20-29%' WHEN INT(STRIP(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE)) BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30-39%' WHEN INT(STRIP(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE)) BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40-49%' WHEN INT(STRIP(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE)) BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50-59%' WHEN INT(STRIP(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE)) BETWEEN 60 AND 69 THEN '60-69%' WHEN INT(STRIP(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE)) BETWEEN 70 AND 79 THEN '70-79%' WHEN INT(STRIP(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE)) BETWEEN 80 AND 89 THEN '80-89%' WHEN INT(STRIP(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE)) BETWEEN 90 AND 99 THEN '90-99%' WHEN INT(STRIP(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE)) = 100 THEN '100%' ELSE 'Other' END "Oxigen Grp" FROM IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Resp_Oxygen_Concentration' WHERE OUO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('1000004094073029', '9000004904100730') AND OUO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 6 MONTH AND CURRENT DATE AND OUO_CURR_LOC NOT LIKE '%ICU%'

prompt: Please provide a list of patients who underwent biopsy procedures at our suburban outpatient centers (West Harrison/Westchester, Commack, Monmouth)
completion: SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = SSE_MRN WHERE SSE_SURG_LOC IN ('COMMACK IR', 'MONMOUTH IR 01', 'MONMOUTH OR 01', 'MONMOUTH OR 02', 'WESTCHESTER IR') AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC LIKE '%BIOP%' ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN MRN FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = SSE_MRN WHERE SSE_SURG_LOC IN ('COMMACK IR', 'MONMOUTH IR 01', 'MONMOUTH OR 01', 'MONMOUTH OR 02', 'WESTCHESTER IR') AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC LIKE '%BIOP%' ) SELECT TM_MRN MRN, AV_DESC AS "Case Status", TM_DX_DTE "Diagnosis Date", TM_HIST_CD "Histology Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD "Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Sire Description" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') ; WITH BIOPSIES AS (SELECT SSE_MRN MRN, SSE_SURG_LOC "Biopsy Location", SSE_SURG_DTE "Biopsy Date", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC "Procedure Description", SSP_SURG_SVC_CD "Surgery Service Code" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE SSE_SURG_LOC IN ('COMMACK IR', 'MONMOUTH IR 01', 'MONMOUTH OR 01', 'MONMOUTH OR 02', 'WESTCHESTER IR') AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC LIKE '%BIOP%' ) SELECT DISTINCT BIOPSIES.*, MIN(VIS_DTE) AS "Admission within 30 Days" FROM BIOPSIES LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT ON VIS_MRN = MRN AND VIS_DTE BETWEEN "Biopsy Date" AND "Biopsy Date" + 30 DAYS GROUP BY MRN, "Biopsy Location", "Biopsy Date", "Procedure Description", "Surgery Service Code" ; WITH PTS_PROCS AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE SSE_SURG_LOC IN ('COMMACK IR', 'MONMOUTH IR 01', 'MONMOUTH OR 01', 'MONMOUTH OR 02', 'WESTCHESTER IR') AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC LIKE '%BIOP%' ) SELECT RAD.RRPT_MRN MRN , SSE_SURG_DTE "Biopsy Date" , RAD.RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME "Procedure Name" , RAD.RRPT_REPORT_TXT "Radiology Report" , CASE WHEN CORE.RRPT_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Contains Core?" , CASE WHEN FNA.RRPT_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Conatins FNA?" FROM PTS_PROCS JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V RAD ON RAD.RRPT_MRN = SSE_MRN AND RAD.RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE = SSE_SURG_DTE AND RAD.RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME LIKE '%BIOP%' LEFT JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V CORE ON RAD.RRPT_MRN = CORE.RRPT_MRN AND RAD.RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE = CORE.RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE AND CONTAINS(CORE.RRPT_REPORT_TXT, '"core"') <> 0 LEFT JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V FNA ON RAD.RRPT_MRN = FNA.RRPT_MRN AND RAD.RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE = FNA.RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE AND CONTAINS(FNA.RRPT_REPORT_TXT, '"fna"') <> 0 ; WITH PTS_PROCS AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE SSE_SURG_LOC IN ('COMMACK IR', 'MONMOUTH IR 01', 'MONMOUTH OR 01', 'MONMOUTH OR 02', 'WESTCHESTER IR') AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC LIKE '%BIOP%' ) SELECT PT_MRN MRN , PATH.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Accession Number" , SSE_SURG_DTE "Biopsy Date" , PATH.PRPT_REPORT "Pathology Report" , CASE WHEN CORE.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Contains Core?" , CASE WHEN FNA.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Conatins FNA?" FROM PTS_PROCS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS DEMO ON PT_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V PATH ON DEMO.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PATH.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID AND SSE_SURG_DTE = DT_DTE LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V CORE ON PATH.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND PATH.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = CORE.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AND CONTAINS(CORE.PRPT_REPORT, '"core"') <> 0 LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V FNA ON PATH.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = FNA.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND PATH.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = FNA.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AND CONTAINS(FNA.PRPT_REPORT, '"fna"') <> 0 ;

prompt: Please provide a list patient results from May 1st, 2018 to April 1st, 2019 for all electrophoresis laboratory tests in which Dr. Patrick Erdman is listed as the billing physician for the laboratory interpretation.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PT_DEID, PBD_SVC_DTE SVC_DTE, PBD_PBD_CD SVC_CD, PBC_PBD_DESC SVC_DESC, PBI_BILLING_AREA BILLING_AREA, PBI_SVC_LOC SVC_LOC , PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO PERFORM_DR_NO, DOC_NAME , CASE WHEN YEAR(PBD_SVC_DTE) - YEAR(PT_BIRTH_DTE) > 89 THEN 'OVER 89' ELSE CHAR(YEAR(PBD_SVC_DTE) - YEAR(PT_BIRTH_DTE)) END PT_AGE, DX_CLSF_CD DX_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK DX_DESC FROM IDB.PBD_DTL_CHARGES JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN = PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_MRN = PBI_MRN AND PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO AND PBD_ACCT_NO = PBI_ACCT_NO JOIN IDB.PBD_DX ON DX_MRN = PBI_MRN AND DX_ACCT_NO = PBI_ACCT_NO AND DX_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO AND DX_CLSF_PRIO = '001' JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = DX_CLSF_CD WHERE PBI_BILLING_AREA = '504469' AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-05-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND PBC_PBD_CD IN ('4684165', '4684167', '4686334', '4686335') AND PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = '023754' ORDER BY PBD_SVC_DTE, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PBD_PBD_CD

prompt: List of small cell lung cancer patients seen at MSKCC in 2018 that were referred to radiation oncology.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, PDI_DMP_PATIENT_ID, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(NAME "c", '| '||TM_DX_DTE||' | '||TRIM(TM_ICD9_CD)||' | '||TRIM(TM_SITE_CD)||' | '||TRIM(TM_SITE_TXT)||' | '||TRIM(TM_HIST_CD)||' | '||TRIM(TM_CLIN_STG_GRP)||' | '||TRIM(TM_PATH_STG_GRP)||' | '||TRIM(TM_BEST_AJCC_STG)||' |'|| CHR(13) || CHR(10)) ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE) AS CLOB(32000)) AS VARCHAR(32000)), '<c>', ','), '</c>', ''), '', ''), '<c/>', ''), ',', ''), 1) AS "Dx Date|ICD|Site CD|Site Txt|Hist CD|Clin Stg|Path Stg|AJCC Stg" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_IDENTIFIERS ON PT_MRN = PDI_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8041/2', 'M8041/3', 'M8042/3', 'M8043/3', 'M8045/3') GROUP BY TM_MRN, PDI_DMP_PATIENT_ID, AV_DESC, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH) , APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' ) , RADONC_REFERRAL AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OOC_ITEM_DESC, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OSTS_STS_DESC, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Requested MD' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) AS REQUESTED_MD, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Rad_Onc_Attending_MD' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) AS RADONC_ATTENDING FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Requested MD', 'Rad_Onc_Attending_MD', 'Consult_RO_Referring MD', 'Consult_RO_Contact Name') WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Radiation Oncology Consult', 'Rad Onc Internal Referral', 'Radiation Oncology Metastatic Disease Outpatient Consult', 'Rad Onc Post Tx Visit', 'Radiation_Oncology_SIM_Orderset') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') GROUP BY OO_MRN, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OOC_ITEM_DESC, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OSTS_STS_DESC) , RADONC_TX AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_COURSE_ID, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE WHERE LOWER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) like '%whole brain%' OR LOWER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) like '%brain%' OR LOWER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) like '%pci%' OR LOWER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) like '%wbrt%' ) SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN "MRN", PDI_DMP_PATIENT_ID "DMP-ID", PT_LAST_NAME "PT Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "PT First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "DOD", HIST_DESC "Histology", SITE_DESC "Site", MAX(COALESCE(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), COALESCE(PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE)) "Last Follow Up Date", CASE WHEN OO_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Radonc Referral?", COALESCE(RADONC_ATTENDING, REQUESTED_MD) "RadOnc MD", RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME "Radiation Treatment Name", "Dx Date|ICD|Site CD|Site Txt|Hist CD|Clin Stg|Path Stg|AJCC Stg" FROM DX JOIN APPTS ON TM_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN RADONC_REFERRAL ON TM_MRN = OO_MRN LEFT JOIN RADONC_TX ON TM_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON TM_MRN = PLA_MRN

prompt: Patients with positive NPM1 mutation
completion: WITH GENE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE GENE = 'NPM1' OR GENE2 = 'NPM1' ) SELECT PRPT_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE "Date of Birth", YEAR(PRPT_REPORT_DTE - PT_BIRTH_DTE) "Age during Report", PRPT_REPORT_DTE "Report Date", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC "Report Type", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Accession No", PRPT_REPORT "Report Text" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN GENE ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PID WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '2012-01-01' AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("myelodysplasia" | "myelodysplastic syndrome")') = 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC, 6

prompt: Patients who have a breast reconstruction with autologous free tissue transfer and returned to the OR within 30 days.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE SRG_DTE FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') ) SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN "MRN", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", SSE_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD "CPT Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC "CPT Description", SRG_DTE "Returned to OR within 30 days" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN CTE ON SSE_MRN = MRN AND SRG_DTE BETWEEN SSE_SURG_DTE + 1 DAY AND SSE_SURG_DTE + 30 DAYS WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD = '19364' AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '2020-01-31' ORDER BY 1, 3, 6

prompt: Provide a list of patients who underwent knee arthroplasty between January 1, 2000 to December 31, 2019.
completion: WITH SRG AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, SSE_LOG_ID FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('27445', '27447', '27403') AND YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE) BETWEEN 2000 AND 2019 AND SSE_SURG_DTE <= '2019-11-14' ) SELECT PT_MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_SEX , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH , PLA_LST_CON_DTE , SSP_SURG_LAST_NM , SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM , SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD , SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN SRG ON PT_MRN = SSE_MRN ; WITH SRG AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, SSE_LOG_ID FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('27445', '27447', '27403') AND YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE) BETWEEN 2000 AND 2019 AND SSE_SURG_DTE <= '2019-11-14' ) , ABX AS (SELECT OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AS MSTR_ITEM_GUID , OOC_ITEM_NAME , OOC_THERAPEUTIC_CAT FROM IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG JOIN IDB.OMS_CTLG_CLASS_TYP HVC ON HVC.OCCT_MST_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND HVC.OCCT_CLASS_TYPE_CD ='HVC-OrderCategory' WHERE (HVC.OCCT_VALUE = 'Anti-Infectives' OR OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000007599200730', '9000008145100730', '9000006598100730', '9000006188200730', '4813073029')) AND OOC_THERAPEUTIC_CAT NOT LIKE 'topical%' ) SELECT MRN , SSE_LOG_ID AS LOG_ID , ABX_NAME , START_DTE , DOSE , DOSE_UNIT FROM (SELECT HCPR_MRN AS MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSE_LOG_ID, DATE(HCPR_START_DT) AS START_DTE, HGN_GENERIC_NAME AS ABX_NAME, CHAR(HCPR_DOSE_AMT) AS DOSE, HRUM_NAME AS DOSE_UNIT, CASE WHEN (C2.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME = ' ' OR C2.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME IS NULL) THEN C1.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME WHEN (C3.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME = ' ' OR C3.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME IS NULL) THEN C2.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME CONCAT ' | ' CONCAT C1.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME ELSE C3.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME CONCAT ' | ' CONCAT C2.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME END AS CATEGORY_NAME FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION JOIN SRG ON HCPR_MRN = SSE_MRN AND DATE(HCPR_START_DT) BETWEEN SSE_SURG_DTE AND SSE_SURG_DTE + 30 DAY JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID JOIN IDB.OMS_CATEGORY_DRUG_XREF ON HGN_DRUG_CATALOG_KEY = OCDX_DRUG_KEY JOIN IDB.OMS_DRUG_CATEGORIES C1 ON C1.ODC_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = OCDX_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE ON HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID = HRUM_RXUOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CATEGORY_SUB_XREF L2 ON C1.ODC_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = L2.OCSX_SUB_CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_DRUG_CATEGORIES C2 ON C2.ODC_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = L2.OCSX_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CATEGORY_SUB_XREF L3 ON L2.OCSX_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = L3.OCSX_SUB_CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_DRUG_CATEGORIES C3 ON C3.ODC_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = L3.OCSX_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID WHERE YEAR(HCPR_START_DT) BETWEEN 2000 AND 2019 AND DATE(HCPR_START_DT) <= '2019-11-14' ) JOIN ABX ON CATEGORY_NAME = OOC_THERAPEUTIC_CAT UNION SELECT SSE_MRN MRN , SSE_LOG_ID AS LOG_ID , OOC_ITEM_NAME ABX_NAME , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE START_DTE , OMD_DOSE_LOW DOSE , OMD_DOSE_UNIT DOSE_UNIT FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN ABX ON MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OMD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OMD_ORD_ROUTE <> 'topical' JOIN SRG ON SSE_MRN = OO_MRN AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN SSE_SURG_DTE AND SSE_SURG_DTE + 30 DAYS WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) BETWEEN 2000 AND 2019 AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE <= '2019-11-14'

prompt: Provide a weekly list of patients with esophagogastric cancers scheduled for surgeries.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, LISTAGG(CHAR(ICD_EFF_DTE, ISO) || ' | ' || TRIM(ICD_CD) || ' | ' || TRIM(ICD_DESC), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY ICD_EFF_DTE) AS DX FROM (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('150', 'C15', '151', 'C16', '152', 'C17', '159', 'C26') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) A GROUP BY CC_MRN) , ACCRUALS AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN AC_IRB_NO END) AS "12-245" , MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN AC_IRB_NO END) AS "06-107" , AC_MRN FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE 1=1 AND AC_IRB_NO IN ('12-245', '06-107') GROUP BY AC_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN "MRN" , PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name" , OC_SURG_DTE "Procedure Date" , R.CRE_RES_NAME "Surgeon" , CPX_PROC_CD "Procedure Code" , CPX_PROC_NAME "Procedure Name" , OCAS_SURG_SVC "Service" , REF.CRE_RES_NAME "Referring MD" , CASE WHEN "12-245" = '12-245' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "12-245 Consent" , CASE WHEN "06-107" = '06-107' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "06-107 Consent" , DX AS "Diagnoses" FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R ON R.CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID JOIN IDB.DOC ON R.CRE_RES_ID = DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF ON REF.CRE_RES_ID = OC_REF_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION ON OC_SURG_LOC_ID = LOC_LOC_ID JOIN DX ON CC_MRN = OC_MRN LEFT JOIN ACCRUALS ON OC_MRN = AC_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE OC_MRN <> '' AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 8 DAYS AND CURRENT date + 12 DAYS AND DOC_LICENSE IN ('197610', '153839-1', '256288', '271465', '283285', '111137', '244425', '220505', '286971', '177054', '213310') ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients with positive BRCA result in their EMR, either via IMPACT or outside pathology. These patients should have or have had pancreatic cancer. Ideally we would like this to be narrowed to germline BRCA mutations.
completion: WITH GI AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE "Date of next visit", CLD_DEPT_NAME "Department", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE RES ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE UPPER(CPE_CPE_APPT_STS) IN ('SCH') AND (UPPER(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8) IN ('GI') OR UPPER(CLD_DEPT_NAME) LIKE '%ST GI%') ) WHERE RN = 1 ) , IMPACT_1 AS (SELECT Y.PT_MRN, GENE, RESULT, METHOD, T.*, GI.* FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS X JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V Y ON X.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = Y.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND(GENE like '%BRCA%') JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN GI ON CPE_MRN = Y.PT_MRN CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site') T WHERE 1=1 AND (UPPER(PRIMARY_SITE) LIKE '%PANCREAS%' OR UPPER(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) LIKE '%PANCR%') AND PT_VITAL_STATUS = 'ALIVE' AND METHOD = 'IMPACT' ) SELECT DISTINCT IMPACT.PT_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Provider", "Department", IMPACT.TUMOR_TYPE_NAME "Cancer Type", IMPACT.GENE "Genetic Testing Result", "Date of next visit" FROM IDB.PATIENT P JOIN IMPACT_1 IMPACT ON IMPACT.PT_MRN = P.PT_MRN WITH UR

prompt: MRN, First Name and Last Name of patients who have been dispensed RITUXImab between 1/1/2002 and 12/31/2007 and who have not been dispensed any other chemo drug within 30 days following the RITUXImab dispense date.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT R_MRN FROM (SELECT CM_MRN R_MRN, 'RITUXIMAB' R, CM_ORD_STRT_DTE R_START_DATE FROM IDB.CHEMO WHERE CM_ORD_SUBDPT IN ('300', '400') AND CM_ORD_STRT_DTE BETWEEN '2002-05-01' AND '2999-09-30' AND CM_SVM_DESC LIKE '%RITUXIMAB%' UNION ALL SELECT PO_MRN R_MRN, 'RITUXIMAB' R, POD_STRT_DTE R_START_DATE FROM IDB.PHM_ORDER JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL ON PO_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_INV ON POD_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ AND POD_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO JOIN IDB.PHM_INVENTORY ON POI_INV_SEQ = PIN_INV_SEQ WHERE PO_ORD_STS <> 'X' AND POD_STRT_DTE BETWEEN '1900-09-01' AND '2007-05-24' AND POD_ATT_FLAG LIKE '%CHEMO%' AND UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%RITUXIMAB%' ) T WHERE R_MRN NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN (SELECT CM_MRN A_MRN , 'Non-RITUXImab' C, CM_ORD_STRT_DTE C_START_DATE FROM IDB.CHEMO WHERE CM_ORD_SUBDPT IN ('300', '400') AND CM_ORD_STRT_DTE BETWEEN '2002-05-01' AND '2999-09-30' AND CM_SVM_DESC not LIKE '%RITUXIMAB%' UNION ALL SELECT PO_MRN A_MRN, 'Non-RITUXImab' C, POD_STRT_DTE C_START_DATE FROM IDB.PHM_ORDER JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL ON PO_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_INV ON POD_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ AND POD_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO JOIN IDB.PHM_INVENTORY ON POI_INV_SEQ = PIN_INV_SEQ WHERE PO_ORD_STS <> 'X' AND POD_STRT_DTE BETWEEN '1900-09-01' AND '2007-05-24' AND POD_ATT_FLAG LIKE '%CHEMO%' AND UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) not LIKE '%RITUXIMAB%' ) AS A ON A_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN (SELECT CM_MRN R_MRN, 'RITUXIMAB' R, CM_ORD_STRT_DTE R_START_DATE FROM IDB.CHEMO WHERE CM_ORD_SUBDPT IN ('300', '400') AND CM_ORD_STRT_DTE BETWEEN '2002-05-01' AND '2999-09-30' AND CM_SVM_DESC LIKE '%RITUXIMAB%' UNION ALL SELECT PO_MRN R_MRN, 'RITUXIMAB' R, POD_STRT_DTE R_START_DATE FROM IDB.PHM_ORDER JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL ON PO_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_INV ON POD_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ AND POD_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO JOIN IDB.PHM_INVENTORY ON POI_INV_SEQ = PIN_INV_SEQ WHERE PO_ORD_STS <> 'X' AND POD_STRT_DTE BETWEEN '1900-09-01' AND '2007-12-31' AND POD_ATT_FLAG LIKE '%CHEMO%' AND UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%RITUXIMAB%' ) AS R ON R_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE A.C_START_DATE BETWEEN R.R_START_DATE AND (R.R_START_DATE + 30 DAYS) )

prompt: Metastatic breast cancer patients getting a biopsy or a surgery
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT CC_MRN DX_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C50', '174') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN DX_MRN, MIN(TM_DX_DTE) DX_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C50%' GROUP BY TM_MRN ) , DX AS (SELECT DX_MRN, MIN(DX_DTE) DX_DTE FROM CTE GROUP BY DX_MRN) , METS AS (SELECT CC_MRN METS_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS METS_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN DX ON CC_MRN = DX_MRN WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C78', 'C79', '197', '198') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN, DX_DTE, METS_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, OC_SURG_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME SURGEON, CPX_PROC_CD, CPX_PROC_NAME FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION ON OC_SURG_LOC_ID = LOC_LOC_ID JOIN DX ON OC_MRN = DX_MRN JOIN METS ON DX_MRN = METS_MRN WHERE OC_SURG_DTE >= CURRENT date AND LOC_LOC_NAME not like '%ENDO%' AND OC_OR_CASE_STS = 'Sch' ) , SCH AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Appt Department", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Appt Provider", CRE_RES_TYP FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN SRG ON OC_MRN = CPE_MRN AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP ) , SCHB AS (SELECT SCH.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) ROWNUM FROM SCH) SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", DX_DTE "Diagnosis Date", METS_DTE "METS Coding Date", CC_CLSF_CD "METS ICD Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "METS ICD Descritpion", OC_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", CPX_PROC_CD "CPT Code", CPX_PROC_NAME "CPT Description", SURGEON "Surgeon", CPE_ENC_DTE "Next Appt Date", "Appt Department", "Appt Provider", CRE_RES_TYP "Provider Type" FROM SRG JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OC_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN SCHB ON OC_MRN = CPE_MRN AND ROWNUM = 1 ORDER BY OC_MRN DESC

prompt: Provide two scheduled reports identifying patients who are deceased in PIDX and alive in FMS and patients who are alive in PIDX and deceased in FMS.
completion: SELECT PA_MRN, PA_ACCT_NO, PA_ACCT_TYPE, AV_DESC AS PA_ACCT_TYPE_DESC, PA_LAST_UNIT_DTE, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PT_DEATH_IND, PA_DEATH_IND, PA_RESP_BL_CD, PA_CR_BL_CD, PA_LAST_SVC_DTE, PA_LAST_BL_DTE, PA_ACCT_BAL, PA_FC FROM IDB.ACCOUNT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PA_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'ACCT_TYPE' AND AV_CODE = PA_ACCT_TYPE WHERE PA_DEATH_IND <> 'D' AND PA_RESP_BL_CD <> 'F' AND PA_CR_BL_CD <> 'F' AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NOT NULL AND (PA_LAST_SVC_DTE > CURRENT DATE - 6 MONTHS OR PA_ACCT_BAL > 0) SELECT PA_MRN, PA_ACCT_NO, PA_ACCT_TYPE, AV_DESC AS PA_ACCT_TYPE_DESC, PA_LAST_UNIT_DTE, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PT_DEATH_IND, PA_DEATH_IND, PA_RESP_BL_CD, PA_CR_BL_CD, PA_LAST_SVC_DTE, PA_LAST_BL_DTE, PA_ACCT_BAL, PA_FC FROM IDB.ACCOUNT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PA_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'ACCT_TYPE' AND AV_CODE = PA_ACCT_TYPE WHERE (PA_DEATH_IND = 'D' OR PA_RESP_BL_CD = 'F' OR PA_CR_BL_CD = 'F') AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL AND (PA_LAST_SVC_DTE > CURRENT DATE - 6 MONTHS OR PA_ACCT_BAL > 0)

prompt: Provide an ad-hoc report for 12-245 Consent status based on pathology report accession numbers.
completion: SELECT PRPT_MRN AS MRN, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS ACCESSION_NO , PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID AS DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID AS DMP_SAMPLE_ID , "Part A Consent Date", "Part C Consent Date" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML ON PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CRDB.PT_MRN , MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE END) "Part A Consent Date" , MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '300' THEN CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE END) "Part C Consent Date" FROM NN.CRDB_DASH_PT_REG CRDB LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS DEM ON CRDB.PT_MRN = DEM.PT_MRN WHERE CRDB.PRT_ID = '12-245' AND REG_ID IN ('100', '300') AND SUBSTR(CRDB.PT_MRN, 1, 1) IN ('0', '3') AND CRNT_ELGBL_STATUS_DSCRP NOT IN ('Ineligible', 'Cancel') GROUP BY CRDB.PT_MRN ) PART_A_AND_C ON PT_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE PRPT_ACCESSION_NO IN (#PROMPTMANY('GENE_LIST')#) ORDER BY PRPT_MRN, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients seen greater than one time with LAMN (low-grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm) between 2000-present.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, P.DT_DTE AS PATH_PROC_DTE, R.DT_DTE AS PATH_RPT_DTE, MP_FULL_NM AS ORD_PROVIDER, MP_SERVICE_DESC AS ORD_PROVIDER_SVC_DESC, PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC AS PATH_RPT_TYPE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS PATH_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT AS PATH_RPT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE P ON P.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.MEDPRO ON PRPT_ORDERING_MEDPRO_ID = MP_MEDPRO_ID WHERE CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("LAMN" | "low grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm" | "low-grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm")') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ), VISITS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, COUNT(*) NUM_VISITS FROM PTS LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN=MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') GROUP BY CPE_MRN HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) SELECT TM_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM VISITS JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=TM_MRN

prompt: Provide updated date of death and last follow up info for a database of about ~1100 patients who underwent an esophagectomy/EMR.
completion: SELECT TRIM(PT_MRN) MRN , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH , PLA_LST_APPT_DTE LAST_APPT_DTE , PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE LAST_DSCH_DTE , MIN(TM_FIRST_RECUR_DTE) FIRST_RECUR_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE PT_MRN IN ({}) GROUP BY PT_MRN , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH , PLA_LST_APPT_DTE , PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE

prompt: Patients who were diagnosed with plexiform neurofibroma since 2013
completion: SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", A.PRPT_REPORT AS REPORT_TEXT, A.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession No", PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC AS "Report Type", DT_DTE AS "Report Date" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT A JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON A.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE = PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD JOIN DV.DATE ON DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE CONTAINS(A.PRPT_REPORT, '"plexiform" & "neurofibroma"') = 1 AND PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC ='Surgical Pathology' AND DT_DTE >= '2013-01-01'

prompt: All patients with DLBCL who received polatuzumab between 6/1/2019 to 9/10/2020.
completion: WITH ETO AS (SELECT CPO_MRN, CPO_ORD_NAME, CPO_FST_ADMIN_DT, CPO_ORD_GUID, CPO_SET_NAME , CPO_REV_CATEGORY, CPO_TIME_PRIORITY , CPO_LOC_NAME, CPO_FREQ, CPO_SUMMARY_LINE, CPO_DOSE, CPO_DOSE_UNIT , CPO_MED_FORM, CPO_ROUTE, CPO_ADMIN_CNT, CPO_INVESTIGATIVE_FLAG FROM IDB.CHEMO_PERFORMED_ORDERS WHERE CPO_ORD_NAME IN ('pOLAtuzumab vedotin INVEST', 'pOLAtuzumab vedotin or Placebo INVEST', 'pOLAtuzumab vedotin-piiq INJ') AND CPO_START_DTE BETWEEN '6/1/2019' AND '9/10/2020' ) , DLBCL AS (SELECT CC_MRN, FIRST_DX_DTE, DX_CDE, DX_DESC FROM (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD DX_CDE, CC_EFF_DTE FIRST_DX_DTE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK DX_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CC_MRN ORDER BY CC_EFF_DTE) RN FROM ETO JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CPO_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CPO_INVESTIGATIVE_FLAG = 'N' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'D%' AND CC_CLSF_CD IN('C83.30', 'C83.31', 'C83.32', 'C83.33', 'C83.34', 'C83.35', 'C83.36', 'C83.37', 'C83.38', 'C83.39') AND (CC_FINALIZED_IND= 'Y' OR CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') ) AS A WHERE RN = 1 ) SELECT PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX_DESC SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_RACE_DESC RACE, PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC ETHNICITY, FIRST_DX_DTE, DX_CDE, DX_DESC , CPO_FST_ADMIN_DT ADMIN_DT, CPO_ORD_NAME ORD_NAME, CPO_SET_NAME SETNAME, CPO_TIME_PRIORITY TIME_PRIORITY , CPO_FREQ FREQ, CPO_SUMMARY_LINE ORDER_SUMMARY, CPO_DOSE DOSE, CPO_DOSE_UNIT DOSE_UNIT, CPO_ROUTE ROUTE, CPO_INVESTIGATIVE_FLAG INVESTIGATIVE_FLAG FROM DLBCL JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN ETO ON CC_MRN = CPO_MRN ;

prompt: Identify patients with urothelial carcinomas who were treated with intravesical BCG and had genomic analysis performed by IMPACT
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, T.* FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS SITE1_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site1_gene', SITE2_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site2_gene', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH '../meta-data/is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site', DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure') T WHERE 1=1 AND TUMOR_TYPE_NAME = 'Bladder Urothelial Carcinoma' ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, DT_PROCEDURE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE FROM X JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON APR_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = MRN WHERE 1=1 AND(UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%BCG%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%BCG%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%BCG%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%BCG%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%BCG%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%BCG%')

prompt: Identify all CIS orders which have been requested by a Hematology physician from 10/08 to 10/09.
completion: SELECT STRIP(SUBSTR(CASE WHEN COALESCE(MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN SUBSTR(COALESCE(MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE), 3, 1) = ':' THEN COALESCE(MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) ELSE STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME)||': '||COALESCE(MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) END ELSE OO_ORD_NAME END, 1, 125)) AS ORDER_NAME, STRIP(OO_ORD_STS_CD)||'-'||STRIP(OSTS_STS_DESC) AS STATUS, OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS REQESTED_BY, OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS ENTERED_BY, OU_OCCUPATION AS OCCUPATION, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE AS ROLE_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS ORDER_COUNT FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OSTS_ORD_STS_CD = OO_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'O' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = OO_PVDR_GUID AND OP_PVDR_NO IN ('004770', '010660', '014548', '015206', '014639', '005629', '013748', '014753') JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OU_USER_GUID = OO_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA CR ON CR.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND CR.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Order - Current' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA MD ON MD.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND MD.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Order - Modified' WHERE OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2008-10-01' AND '2009-10-31' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP') AND UCASE(OO_CREATE_BY) NOT LIKE '%INTERFACES%' GROUP BY STRIP(SUBSTR(CASE WHEN COALESCE(MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN SUBSTR(COALESCE(MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE), 3, 1) = ':' THEN COALESCE(MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) ELSE STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME)||': '||COALESCE(MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) END ELSE OO_ORD_NAME END, 1, 125)), OO_ORD_STS_CD, OSTS_STS_DESC, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, OU_DISPLAY_NAME, OU_OCCUPATION, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE ORDER BY 7 DESC, 1, 3

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with metastatic phyllodes and/or recurrent phyllodes tumor between 1990 and 2015.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t4"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", "t5"."PLA_LAST_APPT_DTE" AS "Last Appointment Date", "t6"."DT_DTE" AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", "t7"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t8" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t4"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t7" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t7"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t9" ON "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t6" ON "t9"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t6"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY" "t5" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE ((CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("metastatic phyllodes" | "recurrent phyllodes")') = 1 AND ("t3"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '1990-1-1' AND '2015-6-1' AND "t4"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" IN ('Surgical Pathology', 'Surgical Pathology Breast'))) AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL)

prompt: Provide a weekly report of new patients and external provider information.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CL_LAST_NAME, CL_FIRST_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DATE , A.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT, B.CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VT_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR AS VT_ABBR, MADE.CLE_NAME AS APPT_ENTER_USER , CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE AS APPT_MADE_DATE , REF.CRE_RES_NAME AS REF_MD , PER_RES_ROLE AS ROLE, PER_EXT_REF_DEPT AS REF_DEPT, PER_EXT_REF_SRC AS HOW_REFERRED, CPP_REC_CR_DT PATIENT_CREATE_DATE , PT.CLE_NAME AS PATIENT_CREATE_USER FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT A ON CPE_DEPT_ID = A.CLD_DEPT_ID AND A.CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('PEDS BMT 1275', 'PEDS LEU LYM 1275', 'PEDS NEURO ONC 1275', 'PEDS SURG 1275', 'PEDS SARCOMA 1275', 'PEDS NEUROBLAST 1275', 'PEDS NEUROSURG 1275') JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE B ON B.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CPE_PRK = CL_PRK JOIN IDB.CL_USER MADE ON MADE.CLE_USER_ID = CPE_ENTER_USER_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.PAS_EXT_REFERRING ON PER_CL_PT_ID = CPE_CL_PT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF ON PER_RES_ID = REF.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPP_MRN = CL_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_USER PT ON PT.CLE_USER_ID = CPP_USER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 7 AND CURRENT DATE AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_MRN

prompt: Provide a monthly list of patient metrics within the leukemia service. The list will contain patient age, gender, race/ethnicity, disease subtype (AML, CLL, CMML, MDS, MF). We would also like to see a breakdown of relapsed/refractory vs. newly diagnosed
completion: WITH DMP AS (SELECT A.PT_MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_SEX_DESC GENDER, PT_RACE_DESC, PT_RELIGION_DESC, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, DT_DTE REPORT_DATE, PRIMARY_SITE, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PART_DESCRIPTION, GENE, LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, ABERRATIONTYPE, DV.TODATE(DV.REGEXSTR('[0-9]*[\-|\.|\/][0-9]*[\-|\.|\/][0-9]*', T.DT_PROCEDURE)) AS PROCEDUREDATE, MAINRPT.DT_DTE REPORT_DTE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS A ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V B ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = B.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V MAINPATH ON MAINPATH.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V MAINRPT ON MAINRPT.DT_DATE_ID = MAINPATH.PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH 'tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH 'is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'metastasis_site', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH 'part_description', DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH 'dt_procedure') T WHERE (TUMOR_TYPE_CODE LIKE 'AML%' OR TUMOR_TYPE_CODE LIKE 'CLL%' OR TUMOR_TYPE_CODE LIKE 'CMML%' OR TUMOR_TYPE_CODE LIKE 'MDS%' OR TUMOR_TYPE_CODE LIKE 'MF%') AND DT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 5 YEARS AND CURRENT date ) SELECT DISTINCT YEAR(CURRENT date)- YEAR(PT_BIRTH_DTE) AGE, GENDER, PT_RACE_DESC, PT_RELIGION_DESC, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE DISEASE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME DISEASE_NAME, CASE WHEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%refractory%' THEN 'Refractory' WHEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%relapsed%' THEN 'Relapsed' WHEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%newly diagnosed%' THEN 'Newly Diagnosed' END AS STATUS FROM DMP JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON PT_MRN=CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit,%' AND CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM = 'History of Present Illness'

,'E10.618' ,'E10.620' ,'E10.621' ,'E10.622' ,'E10.628' ,'E10.630' ,'E10.638' ,'E10.641' ,'E10.649' ,'E10.65' ,'E10.69' ,'E10.8' ,'E10.9' ,'E11.00' ,'E11.01' ,'E11.10' ,'E11.11' ,'E11.21' ,'E11.29' LOWER(GENERIC_NAME) like '%xarelto%' THEN START_DATE END) AS "Xarelto", MAX(CASE WHEN LOWER(GENERIC_NAME) like '%eliquis%' THEN START_DATE END) AS "Eliquis", MAX(CASE WHEN LOWER(GENERIC_NAME) like
