RECORD_ID int PATH 'record_id' , MRN VARCHAR(12) PATH 'substring(concat("00000000",mrn),(string-length(mrn)+1),8)' , COLLECTION_SETTING_NEOA VARCHAR(256) PATH 'collection_setting___0' , COLLECTION_SETTING_ADJ VARCHAR(256) PATH 'collection_setting___1' , COLLECTION_SETTING_MET VARCHAR(256) PATH 'collection_setting___2' , DISEASE_STATUS VARCHAR(256) PATH 'disease_status' , LIQUID_BIOPSY_DATE VARCHAR(256) PATH 'liquid_biopsy_date' , COLLECTION_STATUS VARCHAR(256) PATH 'collection_status' , MISSED_REASON VARCHAR(2056) PATH 'missed_reason' , TREATMENT_REGIMEN VARCHAR(2056) PATH 'treatment_regimen' , START_DT VARCHAR(2056) PATH 'start_dt' , ENDDT VARCHAR(2056) PATH 'enddt') T2 ) , PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT RECORD_ID, PT_MRN, COLLECTION_SETTING_NEOA, COLLECTION_SETTING_ADJ, COLLECTION_SETTING_MET , DISEASE_STATUS , TRIM(DV.REGEXSTR('(?<= '||DISEASE_STATUS||',)[^|]*', DS.SELECT_CHOICES_OR_CALCULATIONS)) DISEASE_STATUS_DISP FROM DT JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN LKUPS DS ON DS.FIELD_NAME = 'disease_status') , LIQUID_BIOPSY AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT RECORD_ID, ROWNUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RECORD_ID ORDER BY LIQUID_BIOPSY_DATE DESC) RNK , LIQUID_BIOPSY_DATE , MISSED_REASON , TRIM(DV.REGEXSTR('(?<= '||MISSED_REASON||',)[^|]*', MR.SELECT_CHOICES_OR_CALCULATIONS)) MISSED_REASON_DISP , COLLECTION_STATUS , TRIM(DV.REGEXSTR('(?<= '||COLLECTION_STATUS||',)[^|]*', CS.SELECT_CHOICES_OR_CALCULATIONS)) COLLECTION_STATUS_DISP FROM DT JOIN LKUPS CS ON CS.FIELD_NAME = 'collection_status' JOIN LKUPS MR ON MR.FIELD_NAME = 'missed_reason' WHERE LIQUID_BIOPSY_DATE <> '' ) T WHERE RNK = 1 ) , TX AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT RECORD_ID, ROWNUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RECORD_ID ORDER BY START_DT DESC) RNK , START_DT, ENDDT , TREATMENT_REGIMEN , TRIM(DV.REGEXSTR('(?<= '||TREATMENT_REGIMEN||',)[^|]*', TR.SELECT_CHOICES_OR_CALCULATIONS)) TREATMENT_REGIMEN_DISP FROM DT JOIN LKUPS TR ON TR.FIELD_NAME = 'treatment_regimen' WHERE START_DT <> '' ) T WHERE RNK = 1 ) SELECT PTS.*, LIQUID_BIOPSY_DATE, MISSED_REASON, MISSED_REASON_DISP, COLLECTION_STATUS, COLLECTION_STATUS_DISP, START_DT, ENDDT, TREATMENT_REGIMEN, TREATMENT_REGIMEN_DISP FROM PTS JOIN LIQUID_BIOPSY B ON PTS.RECORD_ID = B.RECORD_ID LEFT JOIN TX ON PTS.RECORD_ID = TX.RECORD_ID

prompt: Provide a weekly list of cancer patients admitted to M16.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN "MRN" , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) "LAST NAME" , TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) "FIRST NAME" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DATE OF BIRTH" , VV.VIS_ADM_DT "ADMIT DATE/TIME" , VV.VIS_DSCH_DT "DISCHARGE DATE/TIME" , SR.CATEGORY1 "DX_CATEGORY" , SR.CATEGORY2 "DX_SUBCATEGORY" FROM IDB.VISIT_V VV JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = VIS_MRN JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING SR ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) WHERE 1 = 1 AND VV.VIS_NURS_STA = 'NS16' AND VV.VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND ((VV.VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 7 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE - 1 DAYS) OR (VV.VIS_ADM_DTE <= CURRENT DATE -7 DAYS AND VV.VIS_DSCH_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 7 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE - 1 DAYS))

prompt: Create a report that lists patients treated at MSKCC with a diagnosis of renal cell carcinoma between 1999-2010
completion: WITH ICD9 AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF INNER JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '1999-01-01' AND '2010-12-31' AND CC_CLSF_CD = '189.0' ), ICDO AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, AV_DESC AS LATERALITY FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR INNER JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD INNER JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON TM_LATERALITY_CD = AV_CODE AND AV_ELEMENT = 'LATERALITY_CD' WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1999-01-01' AND '2010-12-31' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8312/3', 'M8316/3', 'M8317/3', 'M8318/3', 'M8319/3', 'M8260/3', 'M8310/3') AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C649') ), ALL_DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(CC_MRN, TM_MRN) AS MRN, DX_CODE, DX_DESC, HIST_CODE, HIST_DESC, SITE_CODE, SITE_DESC, LATERALITY FROM ICD9 FULL OUTER JOIN ICDO ON CC_MRN = TM_MRN), PATIENT_INFO AS (SELECT MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_TX_DTE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, DX_CODE, DX_DESC, HIST_CODE, HIST_DESC, SITE_CODE, SITE_DESC, LATERALITY FROM ALL_DX INNER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE PLA_LST_TX_DTE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_TX_DTE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, DX_CODE, DX_DESC, HIST_CODE, HIST_DESC, SITE_CODE, SITE_DESC, LATERALITY ), MRI_SPINE_INFO AS (SELECT MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_TX_DTE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, DX_CODE, DX_DESC, HIST_CODE, HIST_DESC, SITE_CODE, SITE_DESC, LATERALITY, PBD_PBD_CD, PBD_SVC_DTE FROM PATIENT_INFO LEFT JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL_CHARGES ON MRN = PBD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD AND CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%MRI%SPINE%' GROUP BY MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_TX_DTE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, DX_CODE, DX_DESC, HIST_CODE, HIST_DESC, SITE_CODE, SITE_DESC, LATERALITY, PBD_PBD_CD, PBD_SVC_DTE HAVING SUM(PBD_SVC_QTY) > 0) SELECT MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_TX_DTE, MAX(PBD_SVC_DTE) AS LAST_MRI_SPINE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, DX_CODE, DX_DESC, HIST_CODE, HIST_DESC, SITE_CODE, SITE_DESC, LATERALITY FROM MRI_SPINE_INFO GROUP BY MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_TX_DTE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, DX_CODE, DX_DESC, HIST_CODE, HIST_DESC, SITE_CODE, SITE_DESC, LATERALITY

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with osteoblastoma in MSK.
completion: WITH PATHOLOGY_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, CAST("DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT" AS VARCHAR(32500)) AS PATH_RPT_TEXT FROM "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE SYSIBM.REGEXP_LIKE("DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT", 'osteoblastoma', 'i')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PATHOLOGY_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PATHOLOGY_0)), COHORT_PATHOLOGY AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PATHOLOGY_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PATHOLOGY_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PATHOLOGY_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_PATHOLOGY.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_PATHOLOGY_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_PATHOLOGY.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PATHOLOGY_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_PATHOLOGY ON COHORT_PATHOLOGY.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, DMP_ID_TBL."PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID" AS DMP_ID, TRIM(IDB_PATIENT."PT_LAST_NAME") || ', ' || TRIM(IDB_PATIENT."PT_FIRST_NAME") AS PT_NAME, ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_DESC" AS SEX, CASE WHEN (IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_DEATH" IS NULL) THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS VITAL_STATS, IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH" AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_DEATH" AS DATE_OF_DEATH, ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_DESC" AS RACE, ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_DESC" AS ETHNICITY, ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_DESC" AS PRIMARY_LANGUAGE, LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE."PLA_LST_ACTV_DTE" AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, LAST_CONTACT_DATE."PLA_LST_CON_DTE" AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML" AS DMP_ID_TBL ON DMP_ID_TBL."PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_SEX ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_SEX" = ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_ELEMENT" = 'SEX' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_RACE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_RACE" = ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_ELEMENT" = 'RACE' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_PT_ETHNICITY" = ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_ELEMENT" = 'PT_ETHNICITY' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_PRIMARY_LANG" = ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_ELEMENT" = 'PRIMARY_LANG' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB".PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE."PLA_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB".PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = LAST_CONTACT_DATE."PLA_MRN") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DMP_ID AS DMP_ID, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_NAME AS PT_NAME, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.SEX AS SEX, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.VITAL_STATS AS VITAL_STATUS, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_DEATH AS DATE_OF_DEATH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.RACE AS RACE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.ETHNICITY AS ETHNICITY, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PRIMARY_LANGUAGE AS PRIMARY_LANGUAGE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.LAST_CONTACT_DATE AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID; WITH PATHOLOGY_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, CAST("DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT" AS VARCHAR(32500)) AS PATH_RPT_TEXT FROM "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE SYSIBM.REGEXP_LIKE("DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT", 'osteoblastoma', 'i')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PATHOLOGY_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PATHOLOGY_0)), COHORT_PATHOLOGY AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PATHOLOGY_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PATHOLOGY_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PATHOLOGY_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_PATHOLOGY.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_PATHOLOGY_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_PATHOLOGY.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PATHOLOGY_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_PATHOLOGY ON COHORT_PATHOLOGY.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN"), PATHOLOGY_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" AS REPORT_ID, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS ACCESSION_NO, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC" AS PATH_RPT_TYPE, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT_DTE" AS REPORT_DATE, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE" AS PROCEDURE_DATE, CAST("DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT" AS VARCHAR(32500)) AS PATH_RPT_TEXT FROM "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, PATHOLOGY_COLUMNS.REPORT_ID AS PATH_REPORT_ID, PATHOLOGY_COLUMNS.ACCESSION_NO AS ACCESSION_NO, PATHOLOGY_COLUMNS.PATH_RPT_TYPE AS PATH_RPT_TYPE, PATHOLOGY_COLUMNS.REPORT_DATE AS REPORT_DATE, PATHOLOGY_COLUMNS.PROCEDURE_DATE AS PROCEDURE_DATE, PATHOLOGY_COLUMNS.PATH_RPT_TEXT AS PATH_RPT_TEXT FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID LEFT OUTER JOIN PATHOLOGY_COLUMNS ON PATHOLOGY_COLUMNS.SUBJECT_ID = KEYS.COHORT_PATHOLOGY_SUBJECT_ID;

prompt: Provide a list of patients with follicular lymphoma  who were seen by a lymphoma attending in 2018 and have future visit scheduled with a lymphoma attending.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9595/3', 'M9597/3', 'M9690/3', 'M9691/3', 'M9695/3', 'M9698/3') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C82%' ) , CTE AS (SELECT MRN AS DX_MRN, STRIP(DX_CODE) || ' - ' || STRIP(DX_DESC) AS DX_CODE FROM DX) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_CODE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_CODE) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(6000)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , X AS (SELECT T2.MRN, RN, DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) , COMP_APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM X JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'LYM' ) , COMP_APPT_COUNT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) AS COMPLETED_VISITS FROM COMP_APPT GROUP BY CPE_MRN) , SCH_APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM X JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'LYM' ) , SCH_APPT_COUNT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CRE_RES_NAME, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) AS SCHEDULED_VISITS FROM SCH_APPT GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) SELECT DISTINCT X.*, COMPLETED_VISITS, SAC.CRE_RES_NAME, SAC.CLD_DEPT_NAME, SAC.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, SCHEDULED_VISITS FROM X JOIN COMP_APPT CA ON X.MRN = CA.CPE_MRN JOIN SCH_APPT SA ON X.MRN = SA.CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN COMP_APPT_COUNT CAC ON X.MRN = CAC.MRN LEFT JOIN SCH_APPT_COUNT SAC ON X.MRN = SAC.MRN

prompt: Please provide a a list of lymphoma patients who received 20Gy or less to the stomach/duodenum.
completion: WITH PATIENT AS (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(PT_MRN) AS PT_MRN, (TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME)) AS PATIENTS_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX AS SEX, TRIM(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) AS SITE_DESCRIPTION, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_TXT AS TREATMENT_HISTORY, TM_CASE_STS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE AS PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE AS DELIVEDERED_DOSE, TM_DX_DTE AS DATE_OF_DIAGNOSIS, RTC_TX_START_DTE AS DATE_RADIATION_THERAPY_BEGAN, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE AS DATE_RADIATION_THERAPY_END, TM_LOC_RAD_TX AS LOCATION_OF_RADIATION, CATEGORY1, CATEGORY2, STPI_DEFINITION, CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS VITAL_STATUS FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON TM_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND CATEGORY1 = 'Lymphoma' AND (UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) LIKE ('%STOMACH%') OR UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) LIKE ('%DUODENUM%') OR UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) LIKE ('%ABDOMEN%')) AND RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE <= 2000), RADIATION_THERAPY AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS RDO_DEPARTMENT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS SERVICE, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE AS ENC_DATES FROM PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RDO' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2022-03-07') SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PATIENTS_NAME, DATE_OF_BIRTH, SEX, VITAL_STATUS, DATE_OF_DIAGNOSIS, SITE_DESCRIPTION, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, CATEGORY1, DATE_RADIATION_THERAPY_BEGAN, DATE_RADIATION_THERAPY_END, PLANNED_DOSE, DELIVEDERED_DOSE, LOCATION_OF_RADIATION, RDO_DEPARTMENT FROM PATIENT JOIN RADIATION_THERAPY AS R ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN

prompt:
List of patients with either Penicillin or amoxicillin allergy. 



Patients are:

* Current Inpatient OR BMT, Leukemia Outpatient

* Scheduled appointment in next 7 days

* Amoxicillin or Penicillin allergy
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, IP_OP, VIS_ADM_DTE DTE, ATN_DR_NAME, VIS_ROOM_NUM, VIS_BED, HOSP_SVC_DESC FROM (SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND IP_OP, VIS_ADM_DTE, ATN_DR_NAME, VIS_ROOM_NUM, VIS_BED, HOSP_SVC_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY VIS_MRN, HOSP_SVC_DESC ORDER BY VIS_ADM_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.VISIT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=VIS_MRN WHERE VIS_VISIT_STATUS = 2 AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND IN ('I') ) A WHERE RN=1 UNION SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, 'Future Visit' IP_OP, CPE_ENC_DTE DTE, CRE_RES_NAME ATN_DR_NAME, '' VIS_ROOM_NUM, '' VIS_BED, CLD_DEPT_NAME HOSP_SVC_DESC FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_MRN <> ' ' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 28 DAYS UNION SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, 'Future Surg' IP_OP, OC_SURG_DTE DTE, DR.CRE_RES_NAME ATN_DR_NAME, RM.CRE_RES_NAME VIS_ROOM_NUM, '' VIS_BED, SVC.AV_DESC HOSP_SVC_DESC FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=OC_MRN JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE DR ON DR.CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE RM ON RM.CRE_RES_ID = OC_ROOM_RES_ID JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS SVC ON AV_ELEMENT = 'SVC' AND AV_CODE = OC_SURG_SVC WHERE OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 28 DAYS AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') ) , ALLERGIES AS (SELECT PTS.*, OPA_ALRGN_CD ALLERGEN, OPA_ALGY_TYP_DESC ALLERGEN_TYPE, CHAR(OPA_CREATE_DT) ALLERGEN_CREATE_DT, OPA_ALGY_SEVERITY ALLERGEN_SEVERITY, OPA_ALGY_REACT ALLERGEN_REACTION, OPA_ALRGN_TYPE ALLERGEN_FORM, OPA_ALGY_STS ALLERGEN_STATUS FROM PTS JOIN IDB.OMS_PT_ALLERGY ON MRN=OPA_MRN AND OPA_ALGY_STS = 'Active' WHERE OPA_ALRGN_CD IN ('Penicillin', 'Amoxicillin', 'Amoxicillin-clavulanate') ) SELECT DISTINCT * FROM ALLERGIES

prompt: Identify the counts of new patients with submitted slides by service and year since 2007.
completion: SELECT DT_YEAR AS "Encounter Year", CASE WHEN "Clinical Service Desc" <> '' THEN "Clinical Service Desc" ELSE "Clinical Dept Desc" END AS "Service", CASE WHEN "Clinical Service Desc" <> '' THEN 'Service' ELSE 'Dept' END AS "Type", COUNT(DISTINCT PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID) AS PTS FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPT_REPORT_TYPE = PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD JOIN DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON PENC_ENC_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN (SELECT EDC_DEPT_ABBREV, EDC_DEPT_DESC FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG WHERE EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS') T4 ON PENC_APPT_STS = EDC_DEPT_ABBREV LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT ON PENC_DEPT_ID = ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT EDC_DEPT_DESC AS "Clinical Service Desc", EDC_DEPT_ABBREV FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG WHERE EDC_GROUP_ID = '8') T6 ON ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8 = T6.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV LEFT JOIN (SELECT EDC_DEPT_DESC AS "Clinical Dept Desc", EDC_DEPT_ABBREV FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG WHERE EDC_GROUP_ID = '6') T8 ON ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6 = T8.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE ON PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID = ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID WHERE PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC = 'Surgical Submitted Slides' AND DT_YEAR >= 2007 AND EDC_DEPT_DESC IN ('Arrived', 'Completed') AND ENVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%NV%' GROUP BY DT_YEAR, CASE WHEN "Clinical Service Desc" <> '' THEN "Clinical Service Desc" ELSE "Clinical Dept Desc" END, CASE WHEN "Clinical Service Desc" <> '' THEN 'Service' ELSE 'Dept' END

prompt: Provide list of COVID+ survivorship or ALTFU patients.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) CURRENT_AGE, CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('X', 'C', 'D') THEN 'Deceased' ELSE 'Alive' END VITAL_STATUS, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PT_SEX, R.AV_DESC AS RACE, E.AV_DESC AS ETHNICITY, PLA_LST_DRVST_DTE "Last Dr Visit Date", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "SVP Appt Date", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_INFO ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CPE_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND (CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%SVR%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%SURVIVOR%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%SNP %' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like 'SAPP %' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'GEN INT MED 53-5 APP') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-02-01' AND '2020-05-13' AND RESULT IN ('Positive', 'Resolved') ) , RT AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_START_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RTC_TX_MRN ORDER BY RTC_TX_START_DTE DESC) RN FROM PTS JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON "MRN" = RTC_TX_MRN) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY APR_MRN ORDER BY APR_START_DTE DESC) RN FROM PTS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON "MRN" = APR_MRN) SELECT P.*, RTC_TX_START_DTE LAST_RT_START_DATE, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME LAST_RT_PLAN_NAME, APR_START_DTE LAST_CHEMO_START_DATE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME LAST_CHEMO_DRUG FROM PTS P LEFT JOIN RT R ON "MRN" = RTC_TX_MRN AND R.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN CHEMO C ON "MRN" = APR_MRN AND C.RN = 1

prompt: Identify patients with T-cell lymphoma since 1/1/2000 and provide a PDF of their pathology reports.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, MIN_ICD9_DATE FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_DX_DTE >= '2000-01-01' AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9590/3', 'M9700/3', 'M9701/3', 'M9702/3', 'M9703/3', 'M9704/3', 'M9705/3', 'M9706/3', 'M9707/3', 'M9708/3', 'M9709/3', 'M9713/3', 'M9714/3', 'M9716/3', 'M9717/3', 'M9718/3', 'M9719/3') ) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_DATE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('200.6', '200.60', '200.61', '200.62', '200.63', '200.64', '200.65', '200.66', '200.67', '200.68', '200.7', '200.70', '200.71', '200.72', '200.73', '200.74', '200.75', '200.76', '200.77', '200.78') GROUP BY CC_MRN HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) >= '2000-01-01') AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL

prompt: Summary of weekly cases that use omnipaque / contrast material for 2022.
completion: SELECT RCDD_CHARGE_CD, RCDD_CHARGE_DESCRIPTION FROM IDB.RMS_CHARGE_CODE_DICT_DN1240 WHERE (UPPER(RCDD_CHARGE_DESCRIPTION) like '%IOHEXOL%' OR UPPER(RCDD_CHARGE_DESCRIPTION) like '%OMNIPAQUE%') ; WITH CONTRAST AS (SELECT MRN, SVC_DTE, SVC_CD, SVC_DESC, DPT_CD, DPT_DESC, IP_OP_IND, SUM(AMT) AS SVC_AMT, SUM(QTY) AS SVC_QTY, RMS_VISIT_ID, RMS_ADM_NUM, SMS_ACCT_NO FROM (SELECT RVCD_MRN AS MRN, RVCD_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DTE , RCDD_CHARGE_CD AS SVC_CD, RCDD_CHARGE_DESCRIPTION AS SVC_DESC, RDPD_DEPARTMENT_MNEMONIC AS DPT_CD , RDPD_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DPT_DESC, VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND AS IP_OP_IND, RVCD_AMT AS AMT, RVCD_UNITS AS QTY, VIS_VISIT_ID AS RMS_VISIT_ID, VIS_ADM_NUM AS RMS_ADM_NUM, ' ' AS SMS_ACCT_NO FROM IDB.RMS_VISIT_CHARGE_DTL LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT ON RVCD_VISIT_ID = VIS_VISIT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.RMS_CHARGE_CODE_DICT_DN1240 ON RVCD_CHARGE_CODE_REC_NO = RCDD_RECORD_NUMBER LEFT JOIN IDB.RMS_DEPARTMENT_DICT_DN1301 ON RVCD_CHARGE_DEPT_REC_NO = RDPD_RECORD_NUMBER LEFT JOIN IDB.RADIATION_TYPES ON RAD_SVC_CD = RCDD_CHARGE_CD AND RAD_SOURCE = 'RMS' WHERE 1=1 AND RCDD_CHARGE_CD IN ('PHM006661' ,'RAD001663' ,'RAD001664' ,'RAD001665' ,'RAD001666' ,'RAD001667' ,'RAD001668' ,'RAD001672' ,'RAD001673' ,'RAD001674' ,'RAD001675' ,'RAD001676' ,'RAD001687' ,'RAD001688' ,'PHM007338' ,'RAD001712' ,'RAD001707' ,'RAD001711' ,'RAD001725' ,'PHM003301' ,'PHM005158' ,'PHM005159' ,'PHM005160' ,'PHM005161' ,'PHM005162' ,'PHM006661' ,'PHM006821' ,'PHM007338') ) GROUP BY MRN, SVC_DTE , SVC_CD, SVC_DESC, DPT_CD, DPT_DESC, IP_OP_IND, RMS_VISIT_ID, RMS_ADM_NUM, SMS_ACCT_NO HAVING SUM(QTY) > 0) SELECT DISTINCT CONT.*, SSE_LOG_ID, SSE_SURG_DTE AS "Surgery Date" , SSE_SURG_LOC, SSE_VISIT_TYPE_NAME FROM CONTRAST CONT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE = SVC_DTE JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 ;

prompt: Grant IDRAD select access to IDB.OMS_ORDER
completion: SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ANCIL_REF_CD, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_REQUESTED_DT, OO_PERFORMED_DT, OO_SCHEDULED_DT, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_STS_CD, OO_SUMMARY_LINE , OO_ORD_TYPE_CD, OO_ENTER_ROLE, OO_USER_GUID, OO_PVDR_GUID, OO_AUTOCOMPLETE, OO_AUC_COMP_STS, OO_PERFORMED_DTE, OO_REQ_DR_NO FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER WHERE OO_ORD_NAME IN ('CT', 'MRI', 'NM') AND OO_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND CURRENT date

prompt: Provide a list of MRN's and procedure dates meeting free text search criteria patients for patients with renal tumors who are FH-deficient or SDH-deficient.
