prompt: Provide a monthly report of all the orders entered into CIS by specified pharmacists.
completion: SELECT OO_MRN MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE ENTER_DATE, OO_ORD_ID ORDID , OCV_CURR_LOC LOCATION, OS_SVC_DESC AS SERVICE , CASE WHEN NFN.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE IS NOT NULL THEN NFN.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME)||' '||STRIP(OO_ORD_MODIFIER) END DRUG_NAME , OMD_DOSE_LOW DOSE, OMD_DOSE_UNIT DOSE_UOM , OMD_ORD_ROUTE ROUTE, OO_ORD_FREQ FREQ, OMD_MED_FORM MED_FORM , OO_IS_PRN PRN_FLAG, OSD_PRN_REASON_TXT PRN_REASON , STRIP(OO_ORD_STS_CD)||' - '||OSTS_STS_DESC ORD_STS , OO_SET_HEADING SET_HEADING, OO_SET_NAME SET_NAME , USR.OU_DISPLAY_NAME USER_NAME, OO_ENTER_ROLE USER_ROLE , USR.OU_OCCUPATION OCCUPATION , PDR.OU_DISPLAY_NAME REQUESTER_NAME, PDR.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE REQUESTER_ROLE , DOC_SVC SMS_SVC, OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT ORD_DEPT , OC.OCCT_VALUE HVC_CATEGORY, OOC_THERAPEUTIC_CAT THERAPEUTIC_CAT , OCV_IP_OP_IND IP_OP_IND, OO_IS_FOR_DSCH IS_FOR_DSCH , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT REQUESTED_DT , STRIP(CHAR(OSD_STOP_AFTER_VALUE))||' '|| CASE WHEN OSD_STOP_AFTER_OPT = 2 THEN 'Hours' WHEN OSD_STOP_AFTER_OPT = 1 THEN 'Days' WHEN OSD_STOP_AFTER_OPT = 4 THEN 'Doses' ELSE ' ' END AS STOP_AFTER , CASE WHEN OSD_STOP_AFTER_OPT IN (1, 4) THEN OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT + (OSD_STOP_AFTER_VALUE - 1) DAY WHEN OSD_STOP_AFTER_OPT = 2 THEN OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT + OSD_STOP_AFTER_VALUE HOUR ELSE OO_STOP_DT END AS STOP_DT , OO_REQ_TME_PRIO TIME_PRIORITY, OO_SUMMARY_LINE ORD_SUMMARY FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER PDR ON PDR.OU_USER_GUID = OO_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER USR ON USR.OU_USER_GUID = OO_USER_GUID AND OO_USER_GUID IN ('6000007855119029', '7000007855119029', '9000008551401190' , '9000009102801190', '9000014615101190', '9000014615401190', '9000014793101190' , '9000021291201190', '9000071610201190') JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_SYS_DATA ON OSD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OMD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CTLG_CLASS_TYP OC ON OC.OCCT_MST_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND OC.OCCT_CLASS_TYPE_CD = 'HVC-OrderCategory' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA NFN ON NFN.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND NFN.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Rx - Nonformulary Med' LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO AND DOC_SOURCE_DESC = 'SMS' WHERE OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 2 MONTH) + 1 DAY AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH) AND OO_ORD_TYPE_CD = 'Medication'

prompt: List of patients consented to protocols with appointments in the upcoming week.
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS "Appt Time", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date + 1 DAY AND CURRENT date + 7 DAY ) , IRB AS (SELECT ACD_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", CASE WHEN ACD_IRB_NO = '16-042' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "16-042", CASE WHEN ACD_IRB_NO = '16-1347' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "16-1347", CASE WHEN ACD_IRB_NO = '19-297' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "19-297", CASE WHEN ACD_IRB_NO = '18-377' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "18-377", CASE WHEN ACD_IRB_NO = '16-1542' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "16-1542", CASE WHEN ACD_IRB_NO = '18-393' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "18-393", CASE WHEN ACD_IRB_NO = '18-147' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "18-147", CASE WHEN ACD_IRB_NO = '19-086' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "19-086", CASE WHEN ACD_IRB_NO = '20-461' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "20-461", CASE WHEN A.MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "12-245" FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ACD_MRN MRN FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES WHERE ACD_IRB_NO IN ('12-245')) A ON ACD_MRN = A.MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON ACD_MRN = P.PT_MRN WHERE ACD_MRN NOT IN (SELECT ACD_MRN FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES WHERE ACD_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '09-141')) AND (ACD_IRB_NO IN ('16-042', '16-1347', '19-297', '18-377', '16-1542', '18-393', '18-147', '19-086', '20-461') OR ACD_MRN IN ('35513584', '35467588', '35490617', '35579326', '35402999', '35589095', '35591818', '35008213', '35507071', '00808617', '38002427', '35503672', '38009936', '35134390', '35533029', '35543152', '35548480', '38009137', '35357793', '35459866', '38003024', '35421345', '38024180', '35594872', '35490683', '38025747', '35502371', '38042576', '38047288', '38055385', '38025105', '35537662', '00322475', '38007074')) ) SELECT DISTINCT "MRN", "Last Name", "First Name", "Date of Birth", "12-245", APPTS."Appt Date", APPTS."Appt Time", APPTS."Department", APPTS."Service", APPTS."Department Name", APPTS."Provider Name", APPTS."Visit Type" FROM IRB JOIN APPTS ON IRB."MRN" = APPTS.CPE_MRN ORDER BY APPTS."Appt Date", APPTS."Appt Time" ; WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS "Appt Time", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date + 1 DAY AND CURRENT date + 7 DAY ) SELECT ACD_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", MIN("Appt Date") AS MIN_APPT_DTE, MIN("Appt Time") AS MIN_APPT_TIME, MIN(CASE WHEN ACD_IRB_NO = '16-042' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) AS "16-042", MIN(CASE WHEN ACD_IRB_NO = '16-1347' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) AS "16-1347", MIN(CASE WHEN ACD_IRB_NO = '19-297' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) AS "19-297", MIN(CASE WHEN ACD_IRB_NO = '18-377' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) AS "18-377", MIN(CASE WHEN ACD_IRB_NO = '16-1542' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) AS "16-1542", MIN(CASE WHEN ACD_IRB_NO = '18-393' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) AS "18-393", MIN(CASE WHEN ACD_IRB_NO = '18-147' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) AS "18-147", MIN(CASE WHEN ACD_IRB_NO = '19-086' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) AS "19-086", MIN(CASE WHEN ACD_IRB_NO = '14-023' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) AS "14-023", MIN(CASE WHEN ACD_IRB_NO = '20-461' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) AS "20-461", MIN(CASE WHEN A.MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) AS "12-245" FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ACD_MRN MRN FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES WHERE ACD_IRB_NO IN ('12-245')) A ON ACD_MRN = A.MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON ACD_MRN = P.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN APPTS ON APPTS.CPE_MRN = ACD_MRN WHERE ACD_MRN NOT IN (SELECT ACD_MRN FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES WHERE ACD_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '09-141')) AND (ACD_IRB_NO IN ('16-042', '16-1347', '19-297', '18-377', '16-1542', '18-393', '18-147', '19-086', '20-461') OR ACD_MRN IN ('35513584', '35467588', '35490617', '35579326', '35402999', '35589095', '35591818', '35008213', '35507071', '00808617', '38002427', '35503672', '38009936', '35134390', '35533029', '35543152', '35548480', '38009137', '35357793', '35459866', '38003024', '35421345', '38024180', '35594872', '35490683', '38025747', '35502371', '38042576', '38047288', '38055385', '38025105', '35537662', '00322475', '38007074')) GROUP BY ACD_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH

prompt: List of deceased patients from the prior month that had visited M14 in the past year.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT UC_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", MIN(UC_TRANSFER_DTE) "Min xfer Date", MAX(UC_TRANSFER_DTE) "Max xfer Date", UC_VISIT_ID "Visit ID", UC_HOSP_SVC "Service", AV_DESC AS "Service Description", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of Death", LAD_DONOT_CON_IND "Do Not Contact Indicator" FROM IDB.UNIFIED_CENSUS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON UC_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON UC_HOSP_SVC = AV_CODE AND AV_ELEMENT = 'HOSP_SVC' LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTV_DTL ON UC_MRN = LAD_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND UC_NURS_STA = 'NS14' AND UC_HOSP_SVC IN ('LYM', 'LYG', 'LYK', 'LYR', 'MYL', 'MYK', 'HMA', 'HMB') AND UC_TRANSFER_DTE >= (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 13 MONTHS) AND UC_TRANSFER_DTE < (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 1 MONTHS) AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH >= (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 2 MONTHS) AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH < (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 1 MONTHS) GROUP BY UC_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, UC_VISIT_ID, UC_HOSP_SVC, AV_DESC, LAD_DONOT_CON_IND ORDER BY PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME

prompt: Provide a one-time list of all patients receiving Bone Marrow Transplant (allogeneic or autologous) in 2022 or 2023 including several specified data elements as below.
completion: WITH TRANSPLANT AS (SELECT CB.CBM_MRN AS MRN, CB.CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS TRANSPLANT_TYPE, CB.CBM_INDICATION_DESC AS INDICATION_DESC, CB.CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS TRANSPLANT_DTE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE CB WHERE CB.CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE IN ('ALLO', 'AUTO') AND CB.CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' UNION SELECT CP.CBP_MRN AS MRN, CP.CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS TRANSPLANT_TYPE, CP.CBP_INDICATION_DESC AS INDICATION_DESC, CP.CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS TRANSPLANT_DTE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS CP WHERE CP.CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE IN ('ALLO', 'AUTO') AND CP.CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' ) , PT AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN AS PATIENT_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME)||','||TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Patient Name", G.AV_DESC AS GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", R.AV_DESC AS RACE, E.AV_DESC AS ETHNICITY, TRANSPLANT_TYPE, INDICATION_DESC, TRANSPLANT_DTE FROM TRANSPLANT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' AND G.AV_CODE = PT_SEX LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY), ICU AS (SELECT DISTINCT ICU_MRN, ICU_ICU_ADM_DTE FROM IDB.ICU_CENSUS JOIN PT ON ICU_MRN = PATIENT_MRN) , CD AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM PT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON PATIENT_MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Assessment, Patient Personal Values' ) , ENGAGE AS (SELECT DISTINCT EF_MRN, EF_SUBMISSION_DT, EF_FORM_ID, EF_FORM_NAME, EFI_ITEM_ALIAS, EFI_ITEM_TEXT, EFI_VALUE FROM PT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM ON PATIENT_MRN = EF_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID WHERE EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'ptcare_sogi' ) SELECT * FROM ENGAGE

prompt: Pathology reports from 2010-02-25 to 2020-02-25 containing the terms "nevus" and/or "melanoma" and ordered by Dr. Ashfaq A. Marghoob
Provide a one time list of patients who have gone cryoablation of the breast by Yolanda Bryce
completion: WITH ABL AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SSE_SURG_DTE >= '2016-01-01' AND UPPER(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) LIKE '%ABLATION SOFT TISSUE%' AND TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) = 'BRYCE' AND TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) = 'YOLANDA C' ) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_LYMPH_VASC_INV , AV_DESC AS HIST_GRADE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'HIST_CD_GRADE' AND AV_CODE = TM_HIST_CD_GRADE JOIN ABL ON SSE_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C500', 'C501', 'C502', 'C503', 'C504', 'C505', 'C506', 'C508', 'C509') ) , BRPR AS (SELECT DISTINCT BP_MRN, CASE WHEN COALESCE(BP_ESTRG_RCR_DESC, '') = 'Positive' THEN 'Yes' WHEN COALESCE(BP_ESTRG_RCR_DESC, '') = 'Negative' THEN 'No' END AS "ER Positive", CASE WHEN COALESCE(BP_PRGSTR_RCP_DESC, '') = 'Positive' THEN 'Yes' WHEN COALESCE(BP_PRGSTR_RCP_DESC, '') = 'Negative' THEN 'No' END AS "PR Positive", CASE WHEN COALESCE(BP_HER2_DESC, '') = 'Positive' THEN 'Yes' WHEN COALESCE(BP_HER2_DESC, '') = 'Negative' THEN 'No' END AS "HER2 Positive" , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BP_MRN ORDER BY 1 DESC) BRN FROM IDB.BR_PRIMARY JOIN ABL ON SSE_MRN = BP_MRN ) , DISEASE AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'I50' AND 'I50.99' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '428' AND '428.99' THEN 'Y' END) AS "CHF", MAX(CASE WHEN CC_CLSF_CD IN ('I25.10', 'I25.11', 'I25.110', 'I25.111', 'I25.118', 'I25.119', '414', '414.0', '414.00', '414.01', '414.02', '414.03', '414.04', '414.05', '414.06', '414.07', '414.2', '414.3', '414.4', '414.8', '414.9' ,'411.1', '413.9', '414.00', '414.01', '429.2' ) OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'I50' AND 'I50.99' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '428' AND '428.99' THEN 'Y' END) AS "History of coronary artery disease", MAX(CASE WHEN (CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%DEMENTIA%' OR CC_CLSF_CD IN ('290.3', '290.8', '290.9', '290.10', '290.11', '290.12', '290.13', '290.20', '291.1', '291.2')) THEN 'Y' END) AS "Dementia", MAX(CASE WHEN (CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%HEART FAILUR%' AND INSTR(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, 'WITHOUT') =0) OR (CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%W HF' AND INSTR(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, 'W/O') =0) OR CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%HRT FAIL%' THEN 'Y' END) AS "Heart Failure" FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN ABL ON SSE_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM A ON A.CLM_CLSF_CD = CC_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND((CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%HEART FAILUR%' AND INSTR(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, 'WITHOUT') =0) OR (CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%W HF' AND INSTR(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, 'W/O') =0) OR CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%HRT FAIL%' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'I50' AND 'I50.99' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '428' AND '428.99' OR CC_CLSF_CD IN ('I25.10', 'I25.11', 'I25.110', 'I25.111', 'I25.118', 'I25.119', '414', '414.0', '414.00', '414.01', '414.02', '414.03', '414.04', '414.05', '414.06', '414.07', '414.2', '414.3', '414.4', '414.8', '414.9', '411.1', '413.9', '414.00', '414.01', '429.2' ) OR CC_CLSF_CD IN ('290.3', '290.8', '290.9', '290.10', '290.11', '290.12', '290.13', '290.20', '291.1', '291.2') OR CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%DEMENTIA%') GROUP BY CC_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT A.SSE_MRN MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, PT_SEX AS "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth" , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Age as on Procedure Date", TRIM(R.AV_DESC) AS "Race" , TRIM(E.AV_DESC) AS "Ethnicity", PLA_LST_CON_DTE "Patient Last Contact Date", SSE_SURG_DTE AS "Procedure Date", HIST_DESC AS "Histology Desc", TM_DX_DTE AS "Diagnosis Date", TM_LYMPH_VASC_INV "Lymph-vascular Invasion", HIST_GRADE AS "Hist Grade", TRIM(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) AS "Procedure", "ER Positive", "PR Positive", "HER2 Positive", "History of coronary artery disease", "Heart Failure", "Dementia" FROM ABL A LEFT JOIN DX ON TM_MRN = SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN BRPR ON BP_MRN = SSE_MRN AND BRN =1 LEFT JOIN DISEASE ON CC_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY

prompt: Provide a list of MRN and MRI brain reports for all patients with pathological diagnosis of endometrial cancer between 2000 to 2023 in order to identify patients with endometrial cancer brain metastasis.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_SITE_CD AS DX_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = DV.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2023-06-01' AND CATEGORY2 IN ('Cervix Uteri', 'Corpus and Uterus, NOS') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD AND CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('179', '180', '180.0', '180.1', '180.8', '180.9', '182', '182.0', '182.1', '182.8', 'C53', 'C53.0', 'C53.1', 'C53.8', 'C53.9', 'C54', 'C54.0', 'C54.1', 'C54.2', 'C54.3', 'C54.8', 'C54.9', 'C55', 'C55.') WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2023-06-01') , Y AS (SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(1000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(1000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DESC AS VARCHAR(1000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, DX_DATE) AS DX FROM X GROUP BY MRN) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", DX, "t2"."RRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Radiology Accession Number", "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" AS "Radiology Performed Date", "t2"."RRPT_REPORT_DTE" AS "Radiology Report Date", "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS "Radiology Order Group", "t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" AS "Radiology Procedure Name", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)IMPRESSION:[\w\W]*(?=DICTATED BY:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT)) AS IMPRESSION, UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(RRPT_REPORT_TXT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS "PRPT_REPORT" FROM Y JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON PT_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" = 'MR' AND(UPPER("t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME") like '%BRAIN%' OR UPPER("t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME") like '%BRN%' OR UPPER("t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME") like '%HEAD%' OR UPPER("t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME") like '%SELLA%')

prompt: Patients seen at MSK with the diagnosis of intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma
completion: SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of Death", TM_DX_DTE "Dx Date", AV_DESC "Case Status", TM_HIST_CD "Hist Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Hist Description", TM_SITE_CD "Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Site Description", TM_CA_SURG_DTE "Cancer Surgery", TM_NON_CA_SURG_DTE "Non Cancer Surgery", TM_RAD_STRT_DTE "Radiation Start", TM_RAD_END_DTE "Radiation End", TM_SYST_STRT_DTE "Chemo Start" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8160/3', 'M8180/3') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND TM_SITE_CD = 'C221' ; WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of Death", TM_DX_DTE "Dx Date", AV_DESC "Case Status", TM_HIST_CD "Hist Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Hist Description", TM_SITE_CD "Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Site Description", TM_CA_SURG_DTE "Cancer Surgery", TM_NON_CA_SURG_DTE "Non Cancer Surgery", TM_RAD_STRT_DTE "Radiation Start", TM_RAD_END_DTE "Radiation End", TM_SYST_STRT_DTE "Chemo Start" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8160/3', 'M8180/3') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND TM_SITE_CD = 'C221') SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, R.DT_DTE AS PATH_RPT_DTE, PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC AS PATH_RPT_TYPE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS PATH_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT AS PATH_RPT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE P ON P.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.MEDPRO ON PRPT_ORDERING_MEDPRO_ID = MP_MEDPRO_ID WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PT_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM CTE)

prompt: Identify patients with pathology reports referencing specified proteins, with and without requiring reference to absence of stain.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", "t3"."PLA_LAST_APPT_DTE" AS "Last Appointment Date", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", "t8"."TCA_CASE_STS_DESC" AS "Case Status", "t6"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t6"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Description", "t7"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t7"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Description" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t9" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t9"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t10" ON "t9"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t10"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t10"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t6" ON "t10"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t6"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t7" ON "t10"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t7"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V" "t8" ON "t10"."CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID" = "t8"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '(("mlh1" | "msh2" | "msh6" | "pms2") & "stain% absent")') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL

prompt: Requesting the total number of CLL (Chronic lymphocytic leukemia ) patients seen in the Leukemia Service starting January 1, 2017
completion: WITH CLL AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY3 IN ('Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia') JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C91.1', 'C91.10', 'C91.11', 'C91.12', '204.1', '204.10', '204.11', '204.12') ) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPP_PT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RN FROM CLL JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPP_PRK = CPE_PRK JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'LEU' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 <> 'REG' AND(CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%') ) , Z AS (SELECT X.CPE_MRN, MAX(Y.CPE_ENC_DTE) AS "Late Visit Date" FROM X JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER Y ON Y.CPE_MRN = X.CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON Y.CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON Y.CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON Y.CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE Y.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'LEU' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 <> 'REG' GROUP BY X.CPE_MRN ) SELECT DISTINCT X.*, "Late Visit Date" FROM X LEFT JOIN Z ON X.CPE_MRN = Z.CPE_MRN

prompt: This will be an update of SKI 15703 with new pediatric patients since 2018.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OL_MRN AS MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR(OL_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, OL_SURG_DTE AS BIOPSY_DATE, LOC_LOC_NAME AS SURGERY_LOCATION FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LNLG_DX ON OLAS_LOG_ID = OLLD_LOG_ID AND OLAS_PNL_NO = OLLD_DX_PROC_PNL LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLLD_DX_OR_PROC = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=OL_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = OL_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION ON OL_SURG_LOC_ID = LOC_LOC_ID WHERE OL_LOG_STS IN ('Posted', 'Unposted') AND OP_PROC_NAME like '%BIOPSY%' AND OL_SURG_DTE >= '2018-01-01' AND YEAR(OL_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 18 AND (LOC_LOC_NAME = 'IR' OR LOC_LOC_NAME LIKE '%IR') UNION SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, CPE_ENC_DTE AS BIOPSY_DATE, CRE_RES_NAME AS SURGERY_LOCATION FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID=CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID=CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID=CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN=PT_MRN WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2018-01-01' AND (CPE_CPE_APPT_STS ='Comp' OR CPE_CPE_APPT_STS ='Arrived') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%BIOP%' AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2018-01-01' AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 18 AND CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%IR%' ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT OL_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LNLG_DX ON OLAS_LOG_ID = OLLD_LOG_ID AND OLAS_PNL_NO = OLLD_DX_PROC_PNL LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLLD_DX_OR_PROC = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=OL_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = OL_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION ON OL_SURG_LOC_ID = LOC_LOC_ID WHERE OL_LOG_STS IN ('Posted', 'Unposted') AND OP_PROC_NAME like '%BIOPSY%' AND OL_SURG_DTE >= '2018-01-01' AND YEAR(OL_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 18 AND (LOC_LOC_NAME = 'IR' OR LOC_LOC_NAME LIKE '%IR') UNION SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID=CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID=CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID=CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN=PT_MRN WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2018-01-01' AND (CPE_CPE_APPT_STS ='Comp' OR CPE_CPE_APPT_STS ='Arrived') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%BIOP%' AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2018-01-01' AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 18 AND CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%IR%' ) SELECT PT_MRN, CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC FROM PTS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN=PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') ) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with Multiple Myeloma who received the drug Daratumumab (Darzalex) from 2016 to 2019.
completion: WITH MM AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9731/3', 'M9732/3', 'M9734/3') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('203', '203.0', '203.00', '203.01', '203.02', '238.6', 'C90.0', 'C90.00', 'C90.01', 'C90.02', 'C90.2', 'C90.20', 'C90.21', 'C90.22', 'C90.30', 'C90.31', 'C90.32') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC ) , CTE AS (SELECT MRN AS DX_MRN, DX_DATE, STRIP(DX_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(DX_DESC) AS DX_CODE FROM MM) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(6000))||' | '||CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(100))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN, RN, DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) , D AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) AS APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS APR_START_DTE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS APR_END_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%DARATUMUMAB%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%DARATUMUMAB%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%DARATUMUMAB%' AND APR_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM T4) GROUP BY APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME), APR_ORD_RX_TYPE ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_SEX AS GENDER, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, DX, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, PLA_LST_CON_DTE, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN T4 ON PT_MRN = MRN JOIN D ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' OR APR_END_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' OR(APR_START_DTE < '2016-01-01' AND (APR_END_DTE IS NULL OR APR_END_DTE > '2019-12-31'))

prompt: Provide a weekly list of 360 photos captured in Dermatology on a weekly basis
completion: SELECT "CL_PT_ENCOUNTER"."CPE_MRN", "CL_PT_ENCOUNTER"."CPE_ENC_DTE", "CL_PATIENT"."CL_LAST_NAME", "CL_PATIENT"."CL_FIRST_NAME", "CL_DEPT"."CLD_DEPT_NAME", "CL_RESOURCE"."CRE_RES_NAME", "CL_VISIT_TYPE"."CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME", "CL_DEPT"."CLD_CLD_CENTER", "CL_PT_ENCOUNTER"."CPE_CPE_APPT_STS" FROM ((("IDB"."CL_PT_ENCOUNTER" "CL_PT_ENCOUNTER" INNER JOIN "IDB"."CL_DEPT" "CL_DEPT" ON "CL_PT_ENCOUNTER"."CPE_DEPT_ID"="CL_DEPT"."CLD_DEPT_ID") INNER JOIN "IDB"."CL_RESOURCE" "CL_RESOURCE" ON "CL_PT_ENCOUNTER"."CPE_VST_RES_ID"="CL_RESOURCE"."CRE_RES_ID") INNER JOIN "IDB"."CL_VISIT_TYPE" "CL_VISIT_TYPE" ON "CL_PT_ENCOUNTER"."CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID"="CL_VISIT_TYPE"."CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID") INNER JOIN "IDB"."CL_PATIENT" "CL_PATIENT" ON "CL_PT_ENCOUNTER"."CPE_PRK"="CL_PATIENT"."CL_PRK" WHERE ("CL_VISIT_TYPE"."CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME"='DERM 3D PHOTO' OR "CL_VISIT_TYPE"."CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME"='DERM TBI FR' OR "CL_VISIT_TYPE"."CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME"='DERM TBI SIMPLE' OR "CL_VISIT_TYPE"."CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME"='DERM TOTAL BODY') AND ("CL_PT_ENCOUNTER"."CPE_ENC_DTE">={D '2021-06-13'} AND "CL_PT_ENCOUNTER"."CPE_ENC_DTE"<={D '2021-06-19'}) ORDER BY "CL_PT_ENCOUNTER"."CPE_MRN", "CL_PT_ENCOUNTER"."CPE_ENC_DTE"

prompt: Revise SUR24479 for “External Transfer to MSK” order instead of "Pediatric Admission Request" orders
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OUO_ORD_NAME AS ORDER_NAME, OUO_MRN AS MRN, OUO_CURR_LOC AS LOCATION, OUO_ORD_ID AS ORDERID, OUO_PVDR_NAME AS REQUESTING_PROVIDER, OUO_USER_NAME AS ENTEREDBY, OUO_USER_ROLE_TYPE AS ENTERROLE, OUO_ENTER_DTE AS ENTERED_DTE, OUO_STS_DESC AS STATUS , A.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "Admitting Service" , B.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "Admitting MD" , C.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "Admit Reason", YEAR (CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS CURRENT_AGE FROM IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA A ON OUO_ORD_GUID = A.OUD_ORD_GUID AND A.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Ext_Trans_MSK_Service' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA B ON OUO_ORD_GUID = B.OUD_ORD_GUID AND B.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Ext_Trans_MSK_Admitting_MD' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA C ON OUO_ORD_GUID = C.OUD_ORD_GUID AND C.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Ext_Trans_Ext_Reason for Transfer' JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OUO_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND OUO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 2 MONTH) + 1 DAY AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH) AND OUO_ORD_NAME = 'External Transfer to MSK' AND YEAR (CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 18

prompt: Provide a list of flex sigs happening in the colorectal service for 2022.
completion: WITH MAIN AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%FR%') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'COL' AND UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) NOT LIKE ('TELEHEALTH%') AND UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) NOT LIKE ('PHONE%') ), SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE "SURGERY DATE", PBC_CPT_CD "SURGERY CPT CODE", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, DOC_NAME FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN MAIN ON PBD_MRN = "MRN" JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND PBC_CPT_CD IN ('45300', '45305', '45330', '45330', '45331', '45333', '45342') ), COHORT AS (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN", "Appt Date", "Department", "Service", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", "SURGERY DATE", "SURGERY CPT CODE", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, DOC_NAME FROM MAIN JOIN SRG ON "MRN" = PBD_MRN AND "Appt Date" = "SURGERY DATE") , INS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN , INS1.INS_PLAN_PRIO INS1_PRIO, INS1.INS_PLAN_CD INS1_CD, INS1.INS_PLAN_DESC INS1_DESC , INS2.INS_PLAN_PRIO INS2_PRIO, INS2.INS_PLAN_CD INS2_CD, INS2.INS_PLAN_DESC INS2_DESC FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN COHORT ON PT_MRN = "MRN" LEFT JOIN IDB.INSURANCE INS1 ON INS1.INS_MRN = PT_MRN AND INS1.INS_PLAN_PRIO = '1' AND INS1.INS_VERIFY_IND = 'Y' LEFT JOIN IDB.INSURANCE INS2 ON INS2.INS_MRN = PT_MRN AND INS2.INS_PLAN_PRIO = '2' AND INS2.INS_VERIFY_IND = 'Y') SELECT DISTINCT "MRN", "Appt Date", "Department", "Department Name", "Service", "Visit Type", "SURGERY CPT CODE", INS1_DESC "PRIMARY INSURANCE", INS2_DESC "SECONDARY INSURANCE" FROM COHORT JOIN INS ON "MRN" = PT_MRN ;

prompt: Please provide a query of all CIS medication orders placed 1/1/2023 to 12/31/2023.  Please include ALL typical order details including if it was placed from an orderset or alacarte.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE AS "Order Enter Date", OO_ORD_ID AS "Order ID" , OCV_CURR_LOC AS "Location", OS_SVC_DESC AS "Order Service Description" , CASE WHEN NFN.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE IS NOT NULL THEN NFN.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME)||' '||STRIP(OO_ORD_MODIFIER) END AS "Drug Name" , OO_ORD_NAME AS "Order Name", OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT AS "Order Department" , OMD_DOSE_LOW DOSAGE_LOW, OMD_DOSE_HIGH DOSAGE_HIGH, OMD_DOSE_UNIT DOSE_UOM , OMD_ORD_ROUTE ROUTE, OO_ORD_FREQ FREQ , OMD_NO_REFILL NO_REFILL, OMD_MED_FORM MED_FORM , MST.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE MED_STRENGTH , BASE_DOSE.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE BASE_DOSE , BASE_UOM.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE BASE_DOSE_UOM , INS.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE RX_INSTRUCTION , NFI.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE NF_INDICATION , OO_IS_PRN PRN_FLAG, OSD_PRN_REASON_TXT PRN_REASON , STRIP(OO_ORD_STS_CD)||' - '||OSTS_STS_DESC ORD_STS , OO_SET_GUID, OO_SET_HEADING SET_HEADING, OO_SET_NAME ORDER_SET_NAME , OU_DISPLAY_NAME REQUESTER_NAME, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE REQUESTER_ROLE , OC.OCCT_VALUE HVC_CATEGORY, OOC_THERAPEUTIC_CAT THERAPEUTIC_CAT , OCV_IP_OP_IND IP_OP_IND, OO_IS_FOR_DSCH IS_FOR_DSCH , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT REQUESTED_DT , STRIP(CHAR(OSD_STOP_AFTER_VALUE))||' '|| CASE WHEN OSD_STOP_AFTER_OPT = 2 THEN 'Hours' WHEN OSD_STOP_AFTER_OPT = 1 THEN 'Days' WHEN OSD_STOP_AFTER_OPT = 4 THEN 'Doses' ELSE ' ' END AS STOP_AFTER , CASE WHEN OSD_STOP_AFTER_OPT IN (1, 4) THEN OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT + (OSD_STOP_AFTER_VALUE - 1) DAY WHEN OSD_STOP_AFTER_OPT = 2 THEN OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT + OSD_STOP_AFTER_VALUE HOUR ELSE COALESCE(OO_STOP_DT, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT) END AS STOPDT , OO_REQ_TME_PRIO TIME_PRIORITY, OO_SUMMARY_LINE ORD_SUMMARY , OO_ORD_GUID ORD_GUID , SUBSTR(WT.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 7) AS PT_WT , SUBSTR(HT.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 7) AS PT_HT , CASE WHEN OO_REQ_TME_PRIO IN ('NYS Paper', 'Outside Order', 'Fill at MSK', 'Medicaid') OR OO_IS_FOR_DSCH = 'Y' OR(OO_REQ_TME_PRIO = 'Routine' AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'O' AND OCV_CARE_LVL NOT IN ('AXR', 'UCO', 'OR', 'UCC')) THEN 'Rx' ELSE OCV_IP_OP_IND||'P' END AS ORD_TYPE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OU_USER_GUID = OO_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_SYS_DATA ON OSD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OMD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CTLG_CLASS_TYP OC ON OC.OCCT_MST_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND OC.OCCT_CLASS_TYPE_CD = 'HVC-OrderCategory' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_FORM_FIELD ON OO_ENTRY_FRM_GUID = OFF_ENTRY_FRM_GUID AND OFF_FLD_LABEL IN ('Non-Formulary Medication Name:', 'Medication Name:') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA NFN ON NFN.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OFF_DI_CD = NFN.OUD_USER_DI_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA INS ON INS.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND INS.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Rx - Instructions' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA MST ON MST.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND MST.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Rx - Med Strength' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA NFI ON NFI.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND NFI.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Rx - NonForm Indication' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA BASE_DOSE ON BASE_DOSE.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND BASE_DOSE.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'CalcActualDose' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA BASE_UOM ON BASE_UOM.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND BASE_UOM.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'CalcUOMPer' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA WT ON OO_ORD_GUID = WT.OUD_ORD_GUID AND WT.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Weight' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA HT ON OO_ORD_GUID = HT.OUD_ORD_GUID AND HT.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Height' LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO AND DOC_SOURCE_DESC = 'SMS' JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_ENTRY_FORM ON OO_ENTRY_FRM_GUID = OEF_ENTRY_FRM_GUID WHERE OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN (SELECT OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID FROM IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG WHERE OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT IN ('Pharmacy', 'Chemotherapy', 'IV Fluids')) ORDER BY OO_MRN

prompt: Run Dataline report NRS29100 for Jan 1, 2021- Dec 31, 2021
completion: SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(OO_MRN) AS MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS "Significant Date", CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) = 1 THEN 'Sunday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) = 2 THEN 'Monday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) = 3 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) = 4 THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) = 5 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) = 6 THEN 'Friday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) = 7 THEN 'Saturday' ELSE '' END AS "DoW", STRIP(OCV_CURR_LOC) AS "Location", STRIP(OO_SET_NAME) AS "Set Name" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' AND(UPPER(OO_SET_NAME) LIKE '%STGI_HAI_MEDTRONIC%' OR UPPER(OO_SET_NAME) LIKE '%STGI_HAI_INTERA%') AND(OCV_CURR_LOC like 'M %' OR UPPER(OCV_CURR_LOC) like '%PACU%' OR UPPER(OCV_CURR_LOC) like '%NACU%' OR UPPER(OCV_CURR_LOC) like '%ICU%' OR UPPER(OCV_CURR_LOC) like '%UCC%' OR UPPER(OCV_CURR_LOC) like '%CDU%' OR UPPER(OCV_CURR_LOC) like '%CLINICAL DECISION UNIT%')

prompt: Provide an update of RAD3895 with the spectroscopy codes from RAD5290.
completion: WITH SPEC AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, C.DT_DTE AS "Spectroscopy Date" FROM DV.CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE A JOIN DV.DATE C ON A.PTX_PROC_DATE_ID = C.DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE B ON A.PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = B.PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND A.PTX_PROC_DATE_ID = B.PTX_PROC_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DATE D ON B.PTX_PROC_DATE_ID = D.DT_DATE_ID WHERE A.PROC_ID IN (10558, 10224) AND B.PROC_ID = 11288), CDB AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, DT_DTE AS "CDB Tumor Diagnosis Date", TCA_CASE_STS_DESC AS "Case Status" FROM SPEC JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR_V ON PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES ON CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID = TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID WHERE DXCC_ICD_CODE IN ('M9380/3', 'M9382/3', 'M9400/3') AND DT_DTE BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '2011-02-28'), ICD9 AS (SELECT A.PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, MIN(DT_DTE) AS "ICD-9 First Dx Date", MAX(DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT) AS "ICD-9 CIC-Coded Indicator" FROM SPEC JOIN DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V A ON PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = A.PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICD9_V ON A.PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_DATES_V B ON A.PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = B.PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID AND A.PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = B.PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON FIRST_DIAGNOSIS_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID WHERE A.PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID IN (5830, 5887, 5831, 5888, 5832, 5889, 5833, 5890, 5834, 5891, 5835) GROUP BY A.PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID HAVING MIN(DT_DTE) BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '2011-02-28'), BEVACIZUMAB AS (SELECT DISTINCT POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS BEV_DEID, MIN(A.DT_DTE) AS "Bevacizumab First Order Start Date", MAX(B.DT_DTE) AS "Bevacizumab Last Order Stop Date" FROM SPEC JOIN DV.PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT ON PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG ON POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID JOIN DV.DATE A ON FIST_START_DATE_ID = A.DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DATE B ON LAST_STOP_DATE_ID = B.DT_DATE_ID WHERE PINC_GENERIC_NAME IN ('BEVACIZUMAB', 'BEVACIZUMAB OR PLACEBO', 'BEVACIZUmab ', 'BEVACIZUmab or Placebo ') GROUP BY POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID), TEMOZOLOMIDE AS (SELECT DISTINCT POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS TEM_DEID, MIN(A.DT_DTE) AS "Temozolomide First Order Start Date", MAX(B.DT_DTE) AS "Temozolomide Last Order Stop Date" FROM SPEC JOIN DV.PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT ON PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG ON POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID JOIN DV.DATE A ON FIST_START_DATE_ID = A.DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DATE B ON LAST_STOP_DATE_ID = B.DT_DATE_ID WHERE PINC_GENERIC_NAME IN ('TEMOZOLOMIDE', 'TEMOZOLOMIDE OR PLACEBO', 'Temozolomide ', 'Temozolomide or Placebo ') GROUP BY POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID), METHYLATED AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS METH_DEID, CASE WHEN CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '"POSITIVE: Methylated MGMT promoter is detected"') <> 0 THEN 'Positive' WHEN CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '"NEGATIVE: No evidence of methylated MGMT promoter is detected"') <> 0 THEN 'Negative' ELSE 'Other' END AS "MGMT Status" FROM SPEC JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '"%methylated%"') <> 0), EGFR AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS EGFR_DEID, 'Y' AS "EGFR" FROM SPEC JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '"%EGFR%"') <> 0), LOH AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS LOH_DEID, 'Y' AS "LOH" FROM SPEC JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '"%LOH%"') <> 0) SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_SEX AS "Gender", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "Date of Birth", PT_DEATH_DTE AS "Deceased Date", PLA_LAST_APPT_DTE AS "Last Appointment Date", "CDB Tumor Diagnosis Date", "Case Status", "ICD-9 First Dx Date", "ICD-9 CIC-Coded Indicator", "Spectroscopy Date", "Bevacizumab First Order Start Date", "Bevacizumab Last Order Stop Date", "Temozolomide First Order Start Date", "Temozolomide Last Order Stop Date", "MGMT Status", "EGFR", "LOH", PLA_LAST_RT_DTE AS "Last MSK Radiation Therapy Date" FROM SPEC JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN CDB ON PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN ICD9 ON PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN BEVACIZUMAB ON PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = BEV_DEID LEFT JOIN TEMOZOLOMIDE ON PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = TEM_DEID LEFT JOIN METHYLATED ON PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = METH_DEID LEFT JOIN EGFR ON PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = EGFR_DEID LEFT JOIN LOH ON PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = LOH_DEID WHERE COALESCE(CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID) IS NOT NULL

prompt: Please add clinical stage date and diagnosis date to the report created for SKI24983.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_CLIN_TNM_T, TM_CLIN_TNM_M, TM_CLIN_TNM_N, TM_CLIN_STG_DTE CLINICAL_STAGE_DATE , TM_DX_DTE AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS C ON C.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND C.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C500', 'C501', 'C502', 'C503', 'C504', 'C505', 'C506', 'C507', 'C508', 'C509') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2022-02-14'

prompt:
Results routing project

Notification of Pathology Results
completion: WITH PATH AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE , PRPT_REPORT_DTE , DATE(PRPT_CONTENT_CREATED_DT) PRPT_CONTENT_CREATED_DT , PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND DATE(PRPT_CONTENT_CREATED_DT) = CURRENT date - 1 DAY ) , CTE_1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN , PT_NAME , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE , PRPT_REPORT_DTE , PRPT_CONTENT_CREATED_DT , COALESCE(PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, OOC_ITEM_NAME) AS PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC , OOC_ITEM_NAME , OUD_USER_DI_VALUE , B.PDF_FILE_URL FROM PATH JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON PRPT_MRN = OO_MRN AND PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = OO_ANCIL_REF_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN COPATH.C_SPECIMEN A ON PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = SPECNUM_FORMATTED JOIN COPATH.Y_MSK_SPEC_PDF_URL B ON A.SPECIMEN_ID = B.SPECIMEN_ID AND OO_ORD_ID = ORDER_ENTRY_NUM WHERE 1=1 AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'PPATH_Send Extra Copy To:' ) , CTE_2 (PRPT_MRN, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, REST, PRODUCT, LEV) AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , OUD_USER_DI_VALUE || ';' AS REST , '' AS PRODUCT , 0 AS LEV FROM CTE_1 UNION ALL SELECT PRPT_MRN , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , SUBSTRING(REST, INSTR(REST, ';') + 1) , LEFT(REST, INSTR(REST, ';') - 1) , LEV + 1 FROM CTE_2 WHERE REST <> '' ) , CTE_3 AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , TRIM(PRODUCT) PRODUCT FROM CTE_2 WHERE LEV > 0 ) , CTE_4 AS (SELECT A.PRPT_MRN , A.PT_NAME , A.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , A.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE , A.PRPT_REPORT_DTE , A.PRPT_CONTENT_CREATED_DT , A.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC , A.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE , REPLACE((REGEXP_SUBSTR(B.PRODUCT, '/(\w+)')) , '/', '') AS REF_PROV_NO , PDF_FILE_URL FROM CTE_1 A JOIN CTE_3 B ON A.PRPT_MRN = B.PRPT_MRN AND A.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = B.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) , FINAL_CTE AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN , PT_NAME , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE , PRPT_REPORT_DTE , PRPT_CONTENT_CREATED_DT , PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC , PDF_FILE_URL , OUD_USER_DI_VALUE , REF_PROV_NO , OU_DISPLAY_NAME , OU_EMAIL_ADDR FROM CTE_4 LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON REF_PROV_NO = OP_PVDR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = OU_USER_GUID) SELECT * FROM FINAL_CTE ! WITH PATH AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE , PRPT_REPORT_DTE , DATE(PRPT_CONTENT_CREATED_DT) PRPT_CONTENT_CREATED_DT , PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND DATE(PRPT_CONTENT_CREATED_DT) = CURRENT date - 1 DAY ) , CTE_1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN , PT_NAME , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE , PRPT_REPORT_DTE , PRPT_CONTENT_CREATED_DT , COALESCE(PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, OOC_ITEM_NAME) AS PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC , OOC_ITEM_NAME , OUD_USER_DI_VALUE , B.PDF_FILE_URL FROM PATH JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON PRPT_MRN = OO_MRN AND PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = OO_ANCIL_REF_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN COPATH.C_SPECIMEN A ON PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = SPECNUM_FORMATTED JOIN COPATH.Y_MSK_SPEC_PDF_URL B ON A.SPECIMEN_ID = B.SPECIMEN_ID AND OO_ORD_ID = ORDER_ENTRY_NUM WHERE 1=1 AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'PPATH_Send Extra Copy To:' ) , CTE_2 (PRPT_MRN, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, REST, PRODUCT, LEV) AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , OUD_USER_DI_VALUE || ';' AS REST , '' AS PRODUCT , 0 AS LEV FROM CTE_1 UNION ALL SELECT PRPT_MRN , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , SUBSTRING(REST, INSTR(REST, ';') + 1) , LEFT(REST, INSTR(REST, ';') - 1) , LEV + 1 FROM CTE_2 WHERE REST <> '' ) , CTE_3 AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , TRIM(PRODUCT) PRODUCT FROM CTE_2 WHERE LEV > 0 ) , CTE_4 AS (SELECT A.PRPT_MRN , A.PT_NAME , A.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , A.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE , A.PRPT_REPORT_DTE , A.PRPT_CONTENT_CREATED_DT , A.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC , A.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE , REPLACE((REGEXP_SUBSTR(B.PRODUCT, '/(\w+)')) , '/', '') AS REF_PROV_NO , PDF_FILE_URL FROM CTE_1 A JOIN CTE_3 B ON A.PRPT_MRN = B.PRPT_MRN AND A.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = B.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) , FINAL_CTE AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN , PT_NAME , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE , PRPT_REPORT_DTE , PRPT_CONTENT_CREATED_DT , PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC , PDF_FILE_URL , OUD_USER_DI_VALUE , REF_PROV_NO , OU_DISPLAY_NAME , OU_EMAIL_ADDR FROM CTE_4 LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON REF_PROV_NO = OP_PVDR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = OU_USER_GUID) SELECT REF_PROV_NO , OU_DISPLAY_NAME , OU_EMAIL_ADDR , COUNT(DISTINCT OU_EMAIL_ADDR) AS "Number of emails" , COUNT(DISTINCT PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) AS "Reports in email count" FROM FINAL_CTE GROUP BY REF_PROV_NO , OU_DISPLAY_NAME , OU_EMAIL_ADDR

prompt: Provide a monthly report of patients who died within 30 days of the last radiation therapy treatment.
completion: WITH PT_DEATHS AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || PT_FIRST_NAME AS "Name" FROM IDB.PATIENT WHERE 1=1 AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH >= '2023-06-01' ) , RADONC_ALL AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", DAYS(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH) - DAYS(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS "Days Btw", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Referring Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" , CRE_RES_TYP , CLD_DEPT_ABBR , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN PT_DEATHS ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= PT_DATE_OF_DEATH - 30 DAY JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RDO' AND CLD_DEPT_NAME like '%TREAT%' ) SELECT MRN, VARCHAR_FORMAT("Date of Death", 'MM/DD/YYYY') AS "Death Date", VARCHAR_FORMAT("Appt Date", 'MM/DD/YYYY') AS "Appoint Date", "Department Name", "Referring Provider Name", "Visit Type", "Days Btw" FROM RADONC_ALL WHERE RN = 1 ORDER BY MRN

prompt: Patients with a completed NV or IR visit in the Lymphoma service, their diagnosis, and whether they are newly diagnosed or relapsed (from Cancer Registry)
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME , B.CRE_RES_NAME AS PHYSICIAN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DATE , CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR AS VISIT_TYPE, Y.CC_CLSF_CD AS DX, D.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC, CDB_AV_DESC AS CLASSOFCASE , AV_DESC AS CLASSOFCASE7 , TM_ICD9_CD TUMOR_DX, TM_DX_DTE AS TUMOR_DXDATE, STRIP(TM_SITE_CD)||'-'||SUBSTR(S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, 1, 45) SITE_DESC , STRIP(TM_HIST_CD)||'-'||SUBSTR(H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, 1, 55) HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT A ON CPE_DEPT_ID = A.CLD_DEPT_ID AND A.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'LYM' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE B ON B.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician' , 'PhD') JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF Y ON Y.CC_MRN = CPE_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE = Y.CC_EFF_DTE AND CPE_VST_RES_ID = Y.CC_RESP_PARTY AND Y.CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (Y.CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (Y.CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND Y.CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND Y.CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '140' AND '239.99' LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM D ON D.CLM_CLSF_CD = Y.CC_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN AND TM_CASE_STS = '3' AND TM_HIST_CD BETWEEN 'M9590/3' AND 'M9729/3' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON TM_CLASS_OF_CASE_7 = AV_CODE AND AV_ELEMENT = 'CLASS_OF_CASE_7' LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_ALLOWVALS ON TM_CLASS_OF_CASE = CDB_AV_CODE AND CDB_AV_ELEMENT = 'CLASS_OF_CASE' AND CDB_AV_CD_STS = 'A' LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2012-06-30' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived')

prompt: Provide a data set for the microbiology panel and IgG/IgA/IgM results for patients who had treatment on IRB#s 17-569, 20-322, and 21-076. The panels and results only needed for the dates surrounding start of treatment - end of treatment.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN "MRN" , AC_IRB_NO "IRB NO" , TRIM(LPC_ACCESSION_NO) "ACCESSION NUMBER" , LPC_PERFORMED_DTE "COLLECTION DATE" , LPC_FINAL_DTE "FINAL DATE OF RESULT" , TRIM(LPC_SPECIMEN_LOC_ABBR) "SPECIMEN COLLECTED" , LPC_SPECIMEN_DESC "SPECIMEN DESC" , TRIM(LPC_DRUG_NAME) "DRUG NAME" , LPC_DRUG_RESULT "DRUG RESULT" , LPC_RESULT_TEXT "TEST RESULT" , LPC_RESULT_TYPE "RESULT TYPE" FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN IDB.LAB_POSITIVE_CULTURES ON AC_MRN = LPC_MRN JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON ACD_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO AND ACD_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE (AC_IRB_NO = '17-569' OR AC_IRB_NO = '20-322' OR AC_IRB_NO ='21-076') AND LPC_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN ACD_TX_ST_DTE AND ACD_TX_END_DTE ; SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN "MRN" , AC_IRB_NO "IRB NO" , LR_PERFORMED_DTE "PERFORMED DATE" , TRIM(LR_TEST_NAME) "TEST NAME" , TRIM(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) "SUBTEST NAME" , LR_RESULT_VALUE "RESULT VALUE" , LR_UNIT_MEASURE "UNIT MEASURE" FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON AC_MRN = LR_MRN AND LR_TEST_NAME IN ('Immunoglobulin G', 'Immunoglobulin A', 'Immunoglobulin M', 'IgG / IgA / IgM') AND LR_RESULT_VALUE <> '' JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON ACD_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO AND ACD_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE (AC_IRB_NO = '17-569' OR AC_IRB_NO = '20-322' OR AC_IRB_NO ='21-076') AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN ACD_TX_ST_DTE AND ACD_TX_END_DTE ;

prompt: Provide list of patients who had a completed Clinical Genetics appointment in 1Q 2012 with the specified referring MDs.
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN MRN , STRIP(CL_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(CL_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME , CPE_ENC_DTE VST_DTE , CPE_CPE_APPT_STS VST_STS , CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME, CPE_REF_RES_ID , VST_REF.CRE_RES_NAME REF_MD, VST_REF.CRE_RES_TYP , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CVT_EXT_NAME VST_NAME , VST_RES.CRE_RES_NAME VST_MD FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_DEPT_ID IN (55, 363, 450, 642, 682, 710) AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2012-03-31' JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = CL_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VST_RES ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = VST_RES.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VST_REF ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = VST_REF.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_REF_RES_ID IN ('002618', '003285', '003715', '004135', '004812', '004861', '005314', '006403', '006825', '006890', '008128', '008292', '008771', '009936', '012294', '013151', '014589', '014696', '015370', '015511', '016121', '016246', '080085', '080226', '080838', '081067')

prompt: We need a list of patients who underwent surgery for newly diagnosed vulvar cancer at MSKCC. We need all patients who had a lymph node dissection for vuvlar cancer during primary surgery, either sentinel lymph node mapping or standard lymphadenectomy.
completion: WITH PT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, CASE_STS, COALESCE(TM_DX_DTE, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DTE, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS "Vital Status", CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END AS "AGE", TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C51%') AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C51.0', 'C51.1', 'C51.2', 'C51.8', 'C51.9', '184.1', '184.2', '184.3', '184.4', '184.8') AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ) , SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, ARS_AN_CASELOG_ID AS LOG_ID, SSE_SURG_STRT_DT, SSE_SURG_END_DT, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, SUM(CASE WHEN AIFM_FLO_MEAS_ID = '400620' THEN CAST(STRIP(AIFM_MEAS_VALUE) AS DECIMAL(9, 2)) END) AS AN_EBL_ML, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_DAYS_STAY FROM PT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON PT_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.AN_RECORD_SUMMARY ON SSE_LOG_ID=ARS_AN_CASELOG_ID JOIN IDB.AN_IP_DATA_STORE ON ARS_AN_CL_PT_ID = AIDS_CL_PT_ID JOIN IDB.AN_HSB_LINKED_DOC_CSN ON ARS_AN_EPISODE_ID = AHLDC_SUMMARY_BLOCK_ID AND AHLDC_LINKED_DOC_CSN = AIDS_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.AN_IP_FLOWSHEET_REC ON AIFRC_INPATIENT_DATA_ID = AIDS_INPATIENT_DATA_ID JOIN IDB.AN_IP_FLOWSHEET_MEAS ON AIFRC_FSD_ID = AIFM_FSD_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.AN_IP_FLOWSHEET_GP_DATA ON AIFM_FLO_MEAS_ID = AIFGD_FLO_MEAS_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT ON VIS_MRN = SSE_MRN AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_ADM_DTE <= SSE_SURG_DTE AND COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DTE, '2999-12-31') >= SSE_SURG_DTE WHERE AIFM_FLO_MEAS_ID = '400620' AND AIFM_MEAS_VALUE > ' ' AND (UPPER(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) LIKE '%LYMPHADENECTOMY%' OR UPPER(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) LIKE '%SENTINEL%LYMPH%') GROUP BY SSE_MRN, ARS_AN_CASELOG_ID, SSE_SURG_STRT_DT, SSE_SURG_END_DT, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_DAYS_STAY) , BMI AS (SELECT DISTINCT PMH_MRN AS BMI_MRN, PMH_MEASURE_DTE AS "Last BMI Date", PMH_BMI AS "Last BMI" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PMH_MRN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY PMH_MRN ORDER BY PMH_MEASURE_DTE DESC) AS RN, PMH_MEASURE_DTE, PMH_BMI FROM SURG JOIN IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX ON PMH_MRN = SSE_MRN) A WHERE RN=1 ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN MRN, "Date of Birth", "Date of Death", "Vital Status", "AGE", "Last BMI Date", "Last BMI", COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS "DATE OF LAST FOLLOW UP", TM_DX_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", TM_HIST_CD AS "Histology Code", HIST_DESC AS "Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD AS "Site Code", SITE_DESC AS "Site Description", MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE AS "ICD Date", ICD9_CD AS "ICD Code", ICD9_DESC AS "ICD Description", SSE_SURG_DTE AS "Surgery Date", TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(TIMESTAMP(SSE_SURG_END_DT) - TIMESTAMP(SSE_SURG_STRT_DT))) AS "Operation Length in Minutes", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS "Surgery CPT Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS "Surgery CPT Description", SSP_SURG_SVC_CD AS "Surgery Service Code", AN_EBL_ML AS "EBL(ml)", VIS_ADM_DTE AS "Admission Date", VIS_DSCH_DTE AS "Discharge Date", VIS_DAYS_STAY AS "Visit Days Stay" FROM PT JOIN SURG ON PT_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN BMI ON SSE_MRN = BMI_MRN ORDER BY PT_MRN

prompt: Provide a report of whether the specified patients have had IMPACT sequencing done.
Provide a list of Tobacco Cessation appointments for Dr. Kotsen, Dr. Carter- Harris, and Dr. Ostroff
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('024927', '086850', '006387', '100743', '17138', '081638') JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2020-04-01' ) , TUMOR AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS TM_HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS TM_SITE_DESC, RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY TM_MRN ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN PTS ON TM_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) , ICD AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN PTS ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'C76' OR SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) BETWEEN 'C80' AND 'C97') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) >= 2020 GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, TM_HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, TM_SITE_DESC, ICD_CD, ICD_DESC, MIN_ICD_DX_DTE FROM PTS LEFT JOIN TUMOR ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN AND RN=1 LEFT JOIN ICD ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN WITH UR ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('024927', '086850', '006387', '100743', '17138', '081638') JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2020-04-01' ) SELECT CDD_DOC_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN PTS ON CDD_MRN = CPE_MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= CPE_ENC_DTE JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID AND OP_PVDR_GUID IN ('2000001020119001', '9000925226001190', '9001061126101190', '3000005596119029', '5000001402119001', '9000009953401190', '9000239658701190') WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Treatment Visit, Psychotherapy - Psychiatry', 'Initial Evaluation - Psychiatry', 'Telephone/Electronic Communication, Nursing-Care Coordinate', 'Follow Up, Tobacco Treatment - Psychiatry', 'Follow Up Note - Psychiatry', 'Telephone/Electronic Comm, Tobacco Treatment - Psychiatry', 'Intake, Tobacco Treatment - Psychiatry', 'Follow Up, Tobacco Treatment - Psychiatry') WITH UR

prompt: Provide a darwin cohort of living MYC amplification patients
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V EX ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = EX.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AND EX.GENE IN ('TP53') JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-score' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-type' , TMB_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score' , TMB_COUNT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb-count', COSMIC_ID VARCHAR(5000) PATH 'cosmic_id') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('NSCLC,GRC,BLAD,UA,UAD,PAAD,MEL', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = TRIM(X.TTC) WHERE 1=1 AND (INC.GENE IN ('MDM2') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('MDM2')) AND INC.FOLD_CHANGE <= 5 AND INC.FOLD_CHANGE >= 2 AND EX.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID IS NULL ) , DT_3 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') AND YEAR(COALESCE(PT_DEATH_DTE, CURRENT date) - PT_BIRTH_DTE) >= 18 ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P_ID) FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3 ) ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V EX ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = EX.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AND EX.GENE IN ('TP53') JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-score' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-type' , TMB_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score' , TMB_COUNT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb-count', COSMIC_ID VARCHAR(5000) PATH 'cosmic_id') T LEFT JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('BRAIN', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = TRIM(X.TTC) WHERE 1=1 AND (' ' || LOWER(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) || ' ' like '%' || LOWER(' sarcoma ') || '%') AND (INC.GENE IN ('MDM2') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('MDM2')) AND INC.FOLD_CHANGE > 0 AND EX.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID IS NULL AND X.TTC IS NULL ) , DT_3 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') AND YEAR(COALESCE(PT_DEATH_DTE, CURRENT date) - PT_BIRTH_DTE) >= 18 ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P_ID) FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3 ); WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V EX ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = EX.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AND EX.GENE IN ('TP53') JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-score' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-type' , TMB_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score' , TMB_COUNT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb-count', COSMIC_ID VARCHAR(5000) PATH 'cosmic_id') T LEFT JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('BRAIN', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = TRIM(X.TTC) WHERE 1=1 AND NOT(' ' || LOWER(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) || ' ' like '%' || LOWER(' sarcoma ') || '%') AND (INC.GENE IN ('MDM2') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('MDM2')) AND INC.FOLD_CHANGE >= 6 AND CASE WHEN LOCATE('heme', LOWER(INC.METHOD)) > 0 OR LOCATE('liquid', LOWER(INC.METHOD)) > 0 OR LOCATE('RDTB', INC.METHOD) >0 THEN 'liquid' ELSE 'solid' END IN ('solid') AND EX.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID IS NULL AND X.TTC IS NULL ) , DT_3 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') AND YEAR(COALESCE(PT_DEATH_DTE, CURRENT date) - PT_BIRTH_DTE) >= 18 ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P_ID) FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3 )

prompt: Darwin Cohort notification identifying GU Medical Oncology patients who have tested positive for COVID-19 RNA or IgG.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, CRE_RES_NAME, RESULT, POSITIVE_SOURCES, MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT, MAX_IDENTIFIED_DT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.DOC ON CRE_RES_ID = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT_COVID_INFO_V ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND DOC_NPI IN ('1841432903', '1255302055', '1518101096', '1194168955', '1952467649', '1942403837', '1245277078', '1831327212', '1144491390', '1952460172', '1154740058', '1750552055', '1922324193', '1689792756', '1801999685', '1235107871', '1396159703', '1659477743', '1871859728', '1942268073', '1134678451', '1437423290', '1164493961', '1518284611', '1992142046', '1447221353', '1689645533', '1194084053', '1841261559', '1578534285', '1932575370', '1972761294', '1194705533', '1750720595') AND RESULT IN ('Positive', 'Resolved') AND PT_VITAL_STATUS = 'ALIVE' ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM CTE) SELECT * FROM DEID ;

prompt: Provide a list of H- and S- cases with ["myeloproliferative neoplasm" OR "MPN"] AND ["myelodysplastic syndrome" OR "MDS"] in Diagnosis section from 01/01/2014 to present.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_MRN "MRN", PT_BIRTH_DTE "DOB", STRIP(PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) "H/S NUMBER", PRPT_REPORT, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=BONE MARROW BIOPSY)', PRV.PRPT_REPORT) DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT1, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=MORPHOLOGY)', PRV.PRPT_REPORT) DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT2, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRV.PRPT_REPORT) DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT3, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRV.PRPT_REPORT) DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT4 FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS PD JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V PRV ON PT_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND SUBSTR(PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 1, 1) IN ('H', 'S') AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("myeloproliferative neoplasm" OR "MPN")') = 1 AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("myelodysplastic syndrome" OR "MDS")') = 1 AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE ), DX2 AS (SELECT DX.*, CASE WHEN DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT1 <> '' THEN DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT1 WHEN DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT2 <> '' THEN DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT2 WHEN DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT3 <> '' THEN DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT3 WHEN DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT4 <> '' THEN DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT4 END AS DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT FROM DX) SELECT FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, "MRN", "DOB", "H/S NUMBER", PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE PROCEDURE_DATE, PRPT_REPORT FROM DX2 WHERE 1=1 AND(UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) LIKE '%MYELOPROLIFERATIVE NEOPLASM%' OR UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) LIKE '%MPN%') AND (UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) LIKE '%MYELODYSPLASTIC SYNDROME%' OR UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) LIKE '%MDS%') AND UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) NOT LIKE '%NO DEFINITIVE MORPHOLOGIC OR IMMUNOPHENOTYPIC EVIDENCE OF RESIDUAL%' AND UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) NOT LIKE '%NO DIAGNOSTIC MORPHOLOGIC EVIDENCE OF MYELOID%' AND UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) NOT LIKE '%COMPLETE REMISSION%' AND UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) NOT LIKE '%NO MORPHOLOGIC EVIDENCE OF MPN%' AND UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) NOT LIKE '%NO MORPHOLOGIC EVIDENCE OF MDS%' AND UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) NOT LIKE '%NO MORPHOLOGIC EVIDENCE OF MDS/MPN%' AND UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) NOT LIKE '%NO MORPHOLOGIC OR IMMUNOPHENOTYPIC EVIDENCE OF MYELOID%' AND UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) NOT LIKE '%NO MORPHOLOGIC OR IMMUNOPHENOTYPIC EVIDENCE OF INVOLVEMENT BY%' AND UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) NOT LIKE '%NO DIAGNOSTIC MORPHOLOGIC OR REPORTED IMMUNOPHENOTYPIC EVIDENCE OF%' AND UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) NOT LIKE '%NO DIAGNOSTIC MORPHOLOGIC OR IMMUNOPHENOTYPIC INVOLVEMENT%' AND UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) NOT LIKE '%NO DIAGNOSTIC MORPHOLOGIC OR IMMUNOPHENOTYPIC EVIDENCE OF%'

prompt: Request for nursing to be able to run or have access to a daily report that captures patients who are scheduled for same-day K15 quick treatment and/or chemo and K7 Radiology.
completion: WITH INIT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || PT_FIRST_NAME AS PATIENT_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, TRIM(TIME(CPE_APPT_DT))|| '| '||TRIM(CLD_DEPT_NAME)||'| '||TRIM(CRE_RES_NAME)||'| '|| TRIM(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS APPT_DETAILS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE ((CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'CHM' AND CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'CHEMO KOCH-15' AND CRE_RES_NAME IN ('TX NURSE KOCH-15', 'TX NURSE KOCH-16', 'CHEMO KOCH NORTHEAST', 'CHEMO KOCH NORTHWEST', 'CHEMO KOCH SOUTHEAST', 'CHEMO KOCH SOUTHWEST')) OR (CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6= 'RAD' AND CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'RADIOLOGY (ADV) KOCH' AND CRE_RES_NAME IN ('CT KOCH-1', 'CT KOCH-2', 'CT KOCH-3', 'MRI KOCH-3T', 'MRI KOCH-1.5T')) OR (CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'NUC' AND CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'NUCLEAR MEDICINE KOCH' AND CRE_RES_NAME IN ('PET KOCH-1', 'PET KOCH-2'))) AND CPE_ENC_DTE = CURRENT DATE ), FINAL AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.CPE_MRN AS CPE_MRN, A.PATIENT_NAME A_PATIENT_NAME, A.APPT_DETAILS FIRST_APPT, B.APPT_DETAILS RAD_APPT, NULL AS CHEMO_RAD_NUC FROM INIT AS A INNER JOIN INIT AS B ON A.CPE_MRN = B.CPE_MRN WHERE A.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'CHM' AND B.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6= 'RAD' UNION SELECT DISTINCT A.CPE_MRN AS A_CPE_MRN, A.PATIENT_NAME A_PATIENT_NAME, A.APPT_DETAILS CHEMO_APPT, B.APPT_DETAILS NUC_APPT, NULL AS CHEMO_RAD_NUC FROM INIT AS A INNER JOIN INIT AS B ON A.CPE_MRN = B.CPE_MRN WHERE A.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'CHM' AND B.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6= 'NUC' UNION SELECT DISTINCT A.CPE_MRN AS A_CPE_MRN, A.PATIENT_NAME A_PATIENT_NAME, A.APPT_DETAILS NUC_APPT, B.APPT_DETAILS RAD_APPT, NULL AS CHEMO_RAD_NUC FROM INIT AS A INNER JOIN INIT AS B ON A.CPE_MRN = B.CPE_MRN WHERE A.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'NUC' AND B.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6= 'RAD' UNION SELECT DISTINCT A.CPE_MRN AS A_CPE_MRN, A.PATIENT_NAME A_PATIENT_NAME, A.APPT_DETAILS NUC_APPT, B.APPT_DETAILS RAD_APPT, C.APPT_DETAILS CHEMO_APPT FROM INIT A INNER JOIN INIT B ON A.CPE_MRN = B.CPE_MRN INNER JOIN INIT C ON A.CPE_MRN = C.CPE_MRN WHERE A.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'NUC' AND B.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6= 'RAD' AND C.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6= 'CHM' ) SELECT * FROM FINAL ORDER BY CPE_MRN

prompt: IS21381: Prod Bi-Weekly
