prompt: Provide a monthly report with new pathology information for patients in the Clinical Genetics TP53 Database and patients listed as "no surv" who had an appt with an attending in clinical genetics
completion: WITH PROJECTS AS (SELECT RP_PROJECT_ID, RP_APP_TITLE FROM REDCAP.REDCAP_PROJECTS WHERE RP_APP_TITLE = 'Clinical Genetics TP53 Database' ) , METADATA_R AS (SELECT RM_PROJECT_ID, RM_FORM_NAME, RM_FIELD_NAME, RM_ELEMENT_LABEL, RM_FIELD_PHI, RM_FIELD_ORDER, RM_ELEMENT_ENUM FROM PROJECTS JOIN REDCAP.REDCAP_METADATA ON RP_PROJECT_ID = RM_PROJECT_ID ORDER BY RM_FIELD_ORDER) , METADATA AS (SELECT RP_PROJECT_ID, RP_APP_TITLE, RM_FORM_NAME, RM_FIELD_NAME, RM_ELEMENT_LABEL, RM_FIELD_PHI, RM_FIELD_ORDER, RM_ELEMENT_ENUM FROM PROJECTS LEFT JOIN METADATA_R ON RP_PROJECT_ID = RM_PROJECT_ID) , PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT RD_RECORD_CODE MRN FROM METADATA JOIN REDCAP.REDCAP_DATA_VAR ON RP_PROJECT_ID = RD_PROJECT_ID AND RM_FIELD_NAME = RD_FIELD_NAME) SELECT MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE PROCEDURE_DATE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE REPORT_DATE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC REPORT_TYPE, PRPT_REPORT REPORT FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON MRN = PRPT_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= CURRENT date - 30 DAYS ; WITH PROJECTS AS (SELECT RP_PROJECT_ID, RP_APP_TITLE FROM REDCAP.REDCAP_PROJECTS WHERE RP_APP_TITLE = 'Clinical Genetics TP53 Database' ) , METADATA_R AS (SELECT RM_PROJECT_ID, RM_FORM_NAME, RM_FIELD_NAME, RM_ELEMENT_LABEL, RM_FIELD_PHI, RM_FIELD_ORDER, RM_ELEMENT_ENUM FROM PROJECTS JOIN REDCAP.REDCAP_METADATA ON RP_PROJECT_ID = RM_PROJECT_ID ORDER BY RM_FIELD_ORDER) , METADATA AS (SELECT RP_PROJECT_ID, RP_APP_TITLE, RM_FORM_NAME, RM_FIELD_NAME, RM_ELEMENT_LABEL, RM_FIELD_PHI, RM_FIELD_ORDER, RM_ELEMENT_ENUM FROM PROJECTS LEFT JOIN METADATA_R ON RP_PROJECT_ID = RM_PROJECT_ID) , PTS AS (SELECT RD_RECORD_CODE MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN RD_FIELD_NAME = 'surv' THEN RD_VALUE END) SURV FROM METADATA JOIN REDCAP.REDCAP_DATA_VAR ON RP_PROJECT_ID = RD_PROJECT_ID AND RM_FIELD_NAME = RD_FIELD_NAME WHERE RD_FIELD_NAME = 'surv' GROUP BY RD_RECORD_CODE ) SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE APPT_DATE, CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME PROVIDER, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME VISIT_TYPE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND UPPER(SURV) = 'NO SURV' AND CRE_RES_NAME IN ('WALSH, MICHAEL F', 'LATHAM, ALICIA JILL') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date - 30 DAYS ;

prompt: Provide an on-demand report which accepts MRNs that will extract two customized lab reports.
completion: WITH DATA AS (SELECT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" AS "Lab-Test Name", "t3"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" AS "Lab-Subtest Name", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Lab-Performed Date", "t5"."PLR_RESULT_VALUE" AS "Lab-Test Result Value", "t5"."PLR_UNIT_MEASURE" AS "Lab-Unit Measure", CAST ("t5"."PLR_TEXT_RESULT" AS VARCHAR(3000)) AS "Lab-Test Result Notes" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LAB_RESULT" "t5" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PLR_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."LAB_TEST_CATALOG_V" "t2" ON "t5"."PLR_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."LTC_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."LAB_TEST_CATALOG_V" "t3" ON "t5"."PLR_LAB_SUBTEST_CATALOG_ID" = "t3"."LTC_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t5"."PLR_PERFORMED_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t7" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t7"."PI_SOURCE_SYSTEM_PT_ID" IN ('35586045') AND UPPER("t2"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME") IN ('PLATELETS ISSUED', 'PLATELETS ISSUED (OLD)', 'PLATELETS ORDER STATUS', 'PLATELETS RETURNED', 'PLATELETS TRANSFUSED') AND "t3"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('Issue Date/Time', 'Status Information') ) SELECT MRN, "Lab-Test Name", "Lab-Performed Date" , MAX(CASE WHEN "Lab-Subtest Name" = 'Status Information' THEN "Lab-Test Result Notes" END) AS "Status Info" , MAX(CASE WHEN "Lab-Subtest Name" = 'Issue Date/Time' THEN "Lab-Test Result Notes" END) AS "Issue Date" FROM DATA GROUP BY MRN, "Lab-Test Name", "Lab-Performed Date" ORDER BY MRN, "Lab-Test Name", "Lab-Performed Date" SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" AS "Lab-Test Name", "t3"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" AS "Lab-Subtest Name", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Lab-Performed Date", "t5"."PLR_RESULT_VALUE" AS "Lab-Test Result Value", "t5"."PLR_UNIT_MEASURE" AS "Lab-Unit Measure", CAST ("t5"."PLR_TEXT_RESULT" AS VARCHAR(3000)) AS "Lab-Test Result Notes" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LAB_RESULT" "t5" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PLR_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."LAB_TEST_CATALOG_V" "t2" ON "t5"."PLR_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."LTC_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."LAB_TEST_CATALOG_V" "t3" ON "t5"."PLR_LAB_SUBTEST_CATALOG_ID" = "t3"."LTC_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t5"."PLR_PERFORMED_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t7" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t7"."PI_SOURCE_SYSTEM_PT_ID" IN ('35586045') AND UPPER("t3"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME") IN ('PLATELET COUNT', 'PLATELETS', 'PLATELETS, QUEST', 'PLATELETS.', 'ABS NEUT', 'ABSOLUTE NEUTROPHIL COUNT, QUEST', 'NEUTROPHILS ABSOLUTE, QUEST', 'NEUTROPHILS, ABSOLUTE, QUEST') ORDER BY "t1"."PT_MRN", "t2"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME", "t3"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME", "t4"."DT_DTE", "t5"."PLR_RESULT_VALUE", "t5"."PLR_UNIT_MEASURE"

prompt: Need to capture information on Unique patients per day per site to determine average throughput for each site
completion: WITH APPOINTMENTS_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER"."PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_CSN_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_DTE" AS APPT_DATE, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_CPE_APPT_STS" AS APPT_STATUS, CASE WHEN (CL_VISIT_TYPE_TH."CVT_CVT_RPT_GRP_17" = 'TELEHEALTH' OR (UPPER(CL_VISIT_TYPE_TH."CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME") LIKE '%' || 'PHONE' || '%') OR CL_DEPT_TH."CLD_DEPT_ID" IN (1382, 1354) OR UPPER(CL_VISIT_TYPE_TH."CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME") IN ('IC BUNDLED SERVICES', 'IC INTEG MED REVIEW', 'IC MEDICAL RECORDS REVIEW', 'IC MSK IMPACT', 'IC RADIOLOGY REVIEW', 'IC VIDEO CONSULT')) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS TELE_HEALTH FROM "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER" JOIN "IDB"."CL_PT_ENCOUNTER" AS CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER"."PENC_ENC_CSN_ID" = CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_CSN_ID" JOIN "IDB"."CL_VISIT_TYPE" AS CL_VISIT_TYPE_TH ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID" = CL_VISIT_TYPE_TH."CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID" JOIN "IDB"."CL_DEPT" AS CL_DEPT_TH ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_DEPT_ID" = CL_DEPT_TH."CLD_DEPT_ID" WHERE CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_DTE" BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - 4 MONTHS AND CURRENT_DATE AND CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_CPE_APPT_STS" IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CASE WHEN (CL_VISIT_TYPE_TH."CVT_CVT_RPT_GRP_17" = 'TELEHEALTH' OR (UPPER(CL_VISIT_TYPE_TH."CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME") LIKE '%' || 'PHONE' || '%') OR CL_DEPT_TH."CLD_DEPT_ID" IN (1382, 1354) OR UPPER(CL_VISIT_TYPE_TH."CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME") IN ('IC BUNDLED SERVICES', 'IC INTEG MED REVIEW', 'IC MEDICAL RECORDS REVIEW', 'IC MSK IMPACT', 'IC RADIOLOGY REVIEW', 'IC VIDEO CONSULT')) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END IN ('No')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT APPOINTMENTS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM APPOINTMENTS_0)), COHORT_APPOINTMENTS AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT APPOINTMENTS_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, APPOINTMENTS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM APPOINTMENTS_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_APPOINTMENTS.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_APPOINTMENTS_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_APPOINTMENTS.PT_DEID AS COHORT_APPOINTMENTS_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_APPOINTMENTS ON COHORT_APPOINTMENTS.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"), APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER"."PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_CSN_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_DTE" AS APPT_DATE, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_CPE_APPT_STS" AS APPT_STATUS, CL_VISIT_TYPE_AT."CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME" AS APPT_TYPE_NAME, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_CSN_ID" AS CSN_ID, CASE WHEN (CL_VISIT_TYPE_NV_IR."CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR" LIKE '%' || 'NV' || '%') THEN 'New visit' WHEN (CL_VISIT_TYPE_NV_IR."CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR" LIKE '%' || 'IR' || '%') THEN 'Internal referral' ELSE 'Non new visit/Internal referral' END AS NV_VS_IR, CL_DEPT_DEPT_NAME."CLD_DEPT_NAME" AS DEPT_NAME, CL_CATEGORY_DPT_CAT."CAV_NAME" AS DEPARTMENT, CL_RESOURCE_REF_PROV."CRE_RES_NAME" AS REFERRING_PROV, CL_CATEGORY_SVC."CAV_NAME" AS SERVICE, CL_CATEGORY_CENTER."CAV_NAME" AS CENTER, CL_RESOURCE_RES_TYPE."CRE_RES_TYP" AS RESOURCE_TYPE, CL_RESOURCE_PROV."CRE_RES_NAME" AS PROVIDER, CASE WHEN (CL_VISIT_TYPE_TH."CVT_CVT_RPT_GRP_17" = 'TELEHEALTH' OR (UPPER(CL_VISIT_TYPE_TH."CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME") LIKE '%' || 'PHONE' || '%') OR CL_DEPT_TH."CLD_DEPT_ID" IN (1382, 1354) OR UPPER(CL_VISIT_TYPE_TH."CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME") IN ('IC BUNDLED SERVICES', 'IC INTEG MED REVIEW', 'IC MEDICAL RECORDS REVIEW', 'IC MSK IMPACT', 'IC RADIOLOGY REVIEW', 'IC VIDEO CONSULT')) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS TELE_HEALTH FROM "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER" JOIN "IDB"."CL_PT_ENCOUNTER" AS CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER"."PENC_ENC_CSN_ID" = CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_CSN_ID" JOIN "IDB"."CL_VISIT_TYPE" AS CL_VISIT_TYPE_AT ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID" = CL_VISIT_TYPE_AT."CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."CL_VISIT_TYPE" AS CL_VISIT_TYPE_NV_IR ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID" = CL_VISIT_TYPE_NV_IR."CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID" JOIN "IDB"."CL_DEPT" AS CL_DEPT_DEPT_NAME ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_DEPT_ID" = CL_DEPT_DEPT_NAME."CLD_DEPT_ID" JOIN "IDB"."CL_DEPT" AS CL_DEPT_DEPT ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_DEPT_ID" = CL_DEPT_DEPT."CLD_DEPT_ID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."CL_CATEGORY" AS CL_CATEGORY_DPT_CAT ON CL_DEPT_DEPT."CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6" = CL_CATEGORY_DPT_CAT."CAV_ABBR" AND CL_CATEGORY_DPT_CAT."CAV_CATEGORY" = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_6' JOIN "IDB"."CL_RESOURCE" AS CL_RESOURCE_REF_PROV ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_REF_RES_ID" = CL_RESOURCE_REF_PROV."CRE_RES_ID" JOIN "IDB"."CL_DEPT" AS CL_DEPT_SVC ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_DEPT_ID" = CL_DEPT_SVC."CLD_DEPT_ID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."CL_CATEGORY" AS CL_CATEGORY_SVC ON CL_DEPT_SVC."CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8" = CL_CATEGORY_SVC."CAV_ABBR" AND CL_CATEGORY_SVC."CAV_CATEGORY" = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_8' JOIN "IDB"."CL_DEPT" AS CL_DEPT_CENTER ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_DEPT_ID" = CL_DEPT_CENTER."CLD_DEPT_ID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."CL_CATEGORY" AS CL_CATEGORY_CENTER ON CL_CATEGORY_CENTER."CAV_ABBR" = CL_DEPT_CENTER."CLD_CLD_CENTER" AND CL_CATEGORY_CENTER."CAV_CATEGORY" = 'CLD_CENTER' JOIN "IDB"."CL_RESOURCE" AS CL_RESOURCE_RES_TYPE ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_VST_RES_ID" = CL_RESOURCE_RES_TYPE."CRE_RES_ID" JOIN "IDB"."CL_RESOURCE" AS CL_RESOURCE_PROV ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_VST_RES_ID" = CL_RESOURCE_PROV."CRE_RES_ID" JOIN "IDB"."CL_VISIT_TYPE" AS CL_VISIT_TYPE_TH ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID" = CL_VISIT_TYPE_TH."CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID" JOIN "IDB"."CL_DEPT" AS CL_DEPT_TH ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_DEPT_ID" = CL_DEPT_TH."CLD_DEPT_ID") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.APPT_DATE AS APPT_DATE, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.APPT_STATUS AS APPT_STATUS, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.APPT_TYPE_NAME AS APPT_TYPE, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.CSN_ID AS CSN_ID, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.NV_VS_IR AS NEW_VISIT_INTERNAL_REF, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.DEPT_NAME AS APPT_DEPARTMENT, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.DEPARTMENT AS APPT_DEPARTMENT_GRP6, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.REFERRING_PROV AS REFERRING_PROV, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.SERVICE AS APPT_SERVICE_GRP8, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.CENTER AS APPT_CENTER, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.RESOURCE_TYPE AS APPT_RESOURCE_TYPE, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.PROVIDER AS APPT_PROVIDER, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.TELE_HEALTH AS APPT_TELE_HEALTH FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID LEFT OUTER JOIN APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS ON APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.SUBJECT_ID = KEYS.COHORT_APPOINTMENTS_SUBJECT_ID;

prompt: Provide Cadence wait list data for WES Breast APP
completion: SELECT CPW_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CPW_ENC_DTE APPT_DATE, CPW_WAIT_START_DTE WAIT_START_DATE, CPW_WAIT_END_DTE WAIT_END_DATE, CPW_WAIT_STS WAIT_STS, D.CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME, R.CRE_RES_NAME RESOURCE, V.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME VISIT_TYPE FROM IDB.CL_PT_WT_LIST JOIN IDB.CL_PT_WT_LIST_DEPT ON CPW_CL_PT_ID = CWD_CL_PT_ID AND CPW_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CWD_ENC_DTE_SEQ JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT D ON CWD_DEPT_ID = D.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R ON CWD_RES_ID = R.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE V ON CPW_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPW_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE D.CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'BRE MED WES APP' AND R.CRE_RES_NAME IN ('STEED, REBECCA', 'KEENAN, KATHLEEN', 'DUNNE, MEGAN', 'DONOVAN-GRECO, MARY') AND CPW_MRN <> ''

prompt: Patient Lab results for HLA chimerism test post transplant results  for a select group of Pediatric MRNs  for a retrospective research project.
Provide historical data for Physical/Occupational/Lymphedema Therapy Outpatient Consult orders.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN "MRN", OO_ORD_ID "Order ID", OO_ENTER_DTE "Order Entered Date", OSTS_STS_DESC "Order Status", OO_REQUESTED_DTE "Order Requested Date", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Rehab_PT_OP Reason', 'Rehab_Reson2') THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) AS "Reason for Referral", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Rehab_PT_Site Requested', 'Rehab_PT_OP Site 1', 'Rehab_PT_OP Site 2', 'Rehab_PT_OP Site 3', 'Rehab_PT_OP Site 4', 'Rehab_PT_OP Site 5', 'Rehab_PT_OP Site 6') THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) AS "Requested Site", DOC_NAME "Requesting Doctor" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Physical Therapy Outpatient Consult') AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= CURRENT date - 1 YEAR GROUP BY OO_MRN, OO_ORD_ID, OSTS_STS_DESC, OO_REQUESTED_DTE, OO_ENTER_DTE, DOC_NAME ; SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN "MRN", OO_ORD_ID "Order ID", OO_ENTER_DTE "Order Entered Date", OSTS_STS_DESC "Order Status", OO_REQUESTED_DTE "Order Requested Date", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Rehab_OT_OP Reason', 'REHAB_Reason_OT_Outpatient') THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) AS "Reason for Referral", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Rehab_OT_Site', 'Rehab_OT_OP Site') THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) AS "Requested Site", DOC_NAME "Requesting Doctor" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Occupational Therapy Outpatient Consult') AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= CURRENT date - 1 YEAR GROUP BY OO_MRN, OO_ORD_ID, OSTS_STS_DESC, OO_REQUESTED_DTE, OO_ENTER_DTE, DOC_NAME ; SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN "MRN", OO_ORD_ID "Order ID", OO_ENTER_DTE "Order Entered Date", OSTS_STS_DESC "Order Status", OO_REQUESTED_DTE "Order Requested Date", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Rehab_Lymph_515', 'Rehab_Lymph_BAIC', 'Rehab_Lymph_Bergen', 'Rehab_Lymph_BSK', 'Rehab_Lymph_CMK', 'Rehab_Lymph_Monmouth', 'Rehab_Lymph_Nassau', 'Rehab_Lymph_WEST') THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) AS "Reason for Referral", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Rehab_Lymphedema Site') THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) AS "Site Requested", DOC_NAME "Requesting Doctor" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Lymphedema Therapy Outpatient Consult') AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= CURRENT date - 1 YEAR GROUP BY OO_MRN, OO_ORD_ID, OSTS_STS_DESC, OO_REQUESTED_DTE, OO_ENTER_DTE, DOC_NAME ;

prompt: Identify all patients treated with lorlatinib at MSKCC
completion: SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'LORLATINIB'

prompt: Provide a report on lymphoma patients, ages 15 to 39, who had a LYM or PED visit from 1/1/2000 - 9/1/2020, broken down by visit type.
completion: WITH LYM AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY1 = 'Lymphoma' JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) , APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, DX_CODE, DX_DESC, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR FROM LYM JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2020-09-01' AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 15 AND 39 AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('PED', 'LYM') ) SELECT CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS SERVICE, DX_CODE, DX_DESC, CASE WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%' THEN 'NV/IR' ELSE 'F/U' END AS VISIT_TYPE, COUNT(DISTINCT MRN) FROM APPTS GROUP BY CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, DX_CODE, DX_DESC, CASE WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%' THEN 'NV/IR' ELSE 'F/U' END

prompt: Provide a bi-weekly list of patients who are scheduled for Breast Conserving surgery with Axillary Node Dissection surgery for the month, who have not undergone neo-adjuvant chemotherapy.
completion: WITH NEOADJUVANT AS (SELECT APR_MRN, MAX(APR_START_DTE) MAX_START_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG ='Y' OR CDG_TARGETED_FLAG = 'Y' OR CDG_HORMONE_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY APR_MRN) , CTE AS (SELECT PATIENT_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENT_NAME, CASE_PRIMARY_SURGEON, CASE_SURGERY_DTE , LISTAGG(TRIM(CPX_PROC_CD), ' | ') PROC_CODES, LISTAGG(TRIM(CPX_PROC_NAME), ' | ') PROC_NAMES, COUNT(DISTINCT CPX_PROC_CD) PROC_CT FROM IDB.PERIOP_CASE_EVENT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON PT_MRN = PATIENT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.OR_CASE ON OC_CASE_ID = CASE_NUMBER JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON (OCAP_OR_PROC_ID=OCP_OR_PROC_ID) JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON (OCP_PROC_ID=CPX_PROC_ID) JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_DX_CODES LN1 ON LN1.OCD_CASE_ID = OC_CASE_ID AND LN1.OCD_LINE_NO = 1 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DX DX1 ON DX1.CDX_DX_ID = LN1.OCD_DX_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_DX_CODES LN2 ON LN2.OCD_CASE_ID = OC_CASE_ID AND LN2.OCD_LINE_NO = 2 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DX DX2 ON DX2.CDX_DX_ID = LN2.OCD_DX_ID WHERE CASE_SURGERY_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 30 DAYS AND CPX_PROC_CD IN ('19301', '38745') AND PATIENT_MRN NOT IN (SELECT APR_MRN FROM NEOADJUVANT) GROUP BY PATIENT_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) , CASE_PRIMARY_SURGEON, CASE_SURGERY_DTE) SELECT PATIENT_MRN, PATIENT_NAME, CASE_PRIMARY_SURGEON, CASE_SURGERY_DTE, PROC_CODES, PROC_NAMES FROM CTE WHERE PROC_CT > 1 ;

prompt: Patients diagnosed with T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma
completion: SELECT PRPT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_SEX "Gender", PT_BIRTH_DTE "Date of Birth", YEAR(PRPT_REPORT_DTE - PT_BIRTH_DTE) "Age", PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "Procedure Date", PRPT_REPORT_DTE "Report Date", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC "Report Type", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Accession No", PRPT_REPORT "Report Text" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '2000-01-01' AND YEAR(PRPT_REPORT_DTE - PT_BIRTH_DTE) >= 18 AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("t-cell" & "rich" & "histiocyte")') = 1

prompt: Provide a monthly list of patients who have had a stem cell transplant at MSK one year ago.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT STRIP(CBM_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE) AS BMT_TYPE, CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS BMT_DATE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CBM_MRN = PT_MRN AND YEAR(CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 WHERE CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 12 MONTHS - (DAY(CURRENT DATE) - 1) DAYS - 1 MONTH AND CURRENT DATE - 12 MONTHS - (DAY(CURRENT DATE)) DAYS UNION SELECT STRIP(CBP_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE) AS BMT_TYPE, CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS BMT_DATE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CBP_MRN = PT_MRN AND YEAR(CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 WHERE CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 12 MONTHS - (DAY(CURRENT DATE) - 1) DAYS - 1 MONTH AND CURRENT DATE - 12 MONTHS - (DAY(CURRENT DATE)) DAYS ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT X.*, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, STRIP(CPP_EMAIL_ADDR) AS "Email Address", CPP_HOME_PHONE AS "Phone# (h)", CPP_MOBILE_PHONE AS "Phone# (c)" FROM X JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON X.MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON MRN = CPP_MRN WHERE PT_PRIMARY_LANG = 'ENG' ) , PBD1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN AS MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD AS CPT_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS CPT_DESC, PBC_PBD_DESC AS PBD_DESC, PBD_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DATE, PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO, STRIP(DOC_NAME) AS DOC_NAME FROM Y JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON MRN = PBD_MRN AND BMT_DATE = PBD_SVC_DTE JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBI_INV_NO = PBD_INV_NO AND PBI_MRN = PBD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1=1 AND PBC_CPT_CD LIKE '3824%' ) , PBD AS (SELECT MRN, SVC_DATE, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DOC_NAME AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, SVC_DATE) AS "Performing Physician" FROM PBD1 GROUP BY MRN, SVC_DATE ) SELECT DISTINCT Y.*, "Performing Physician" FROM Y LEFT JOIN PBD ON PBD.MRN = Y.MRN AND SVC_DATE = BMT_DATE

prompt: Daily list of patients in Adult BMT prescribed with specific steroids.
completion: WITH ETO AS (SELECT CBM_MRN , PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, CBM_INDICATION_DESC HCT_DESC, CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE , CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE HCT_DATE, CBM_EXTRACT_DT , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CBM_MRN ORDER BY CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE DESC) RN FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CBM_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND (UPPER(CBM_INDICATION_DESC) LIKE '%ALLO%' OR UPPER(CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE) = 'ALLO') ) , VST AS (SELECT CV_MRN, CV_ADM_DTE, CV_ADM_TME, CV_DSCH_DTE, CV_DSCH_TME, CV_RMS_VISIT_TYPE, CV_CTC_VISIT_TYPE, CC_CLSF_CD, CC_EFF_DTE, CC_VISIT_DTE , CC_RESP_PARTY, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK , DOC_NAME, DOC_SVC, DOC_ACDMC_SVC, DOC_ACDMC_DPT FROM (SELECT CV_MRN , CV_ADM_DTE, CV_ADM_TME, CV_DSCH_DTE, CV_DSCH_TME, CV_RMS_VISIT_TYPE, CV_CTC_VISIT_TYPE, CC_CLSF_CD, CC_EFF_DTE, CC_VISIT_DTE , CC_RESP_PARTY, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK , DOC_NAME, DOC_SVC, DOC_ACDMC_SVC, DOC_ACDMC_DPT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CV_MRN ORDER BY CC_EFF_DTE DESC) RN FROM ETO JOIN IDB.CTC_VISIT ON CBM_MRN = CV_MRN JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CV_VISIT_ID = CC_VISIT_ID AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN HCT_DATE - 30 DAY AND CURRENT DATE JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = CC_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.DOC ON CC_RESP_PARTY = DOC_DR_NO AND DOC_ACDMC_SVC IN ('BONE MARROW TRANSPLANT', 'LEUKEMIA') WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C00%' AND 'D49%') AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' ) AS A WHERE RN= 1 ) , SRX AS (SELECT MRN , LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DOB, HCT_DATE, ORD_NAME, DRUG_NAME, START_DATE, DOSE, DOSE_UOM, ROUTE, ORD_FREQ, IP_OP_IND, ORDERING_PVDR_NAME, VISIT_ATT_NAME FROM (SELECT MRN , LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DOB, HCT_DATE, ORD_NAME, DRUG_NAME, START_DATE, DOSE, DOSE_UOM, ROUTE, ORD_FREQ, IP_OP_IND , ORDERING_PVDR_NAME, VISIT_ATT_NAME FROM ETO JOIN IDB.SRX_PHARMACY_SUM ON MRN = CBM_MRN AND START_DATE >= CURRENT DATE - 14 DAY LEFT JOIN VST ON CV_MRN = MRN WHERE UPPER(DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%PREDNISO%' OR UPPER(DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%METHYLPREDNI%' OR UPPER(DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%DEXAMETHAZ%' UNION SELECT HCPR_MRN MRN , LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DOB, HCT_DATE, HCPR_DRUG_NAME ORD_NAME, HGN_GENERIC_NAME DRUG_NAME , COALESCE(DATE(HCPR_START_DT), RX.HCPR_CREATED_DTE) START_DATE, HCPR_DOSE_AMT DOSE, UOM.HRUM_DESCRIPTION DOSE_UOM, HCPR_ROUTE ROUTE , HSF_DESCRIPTION ORD_FREQ, OCV_IP_OP_IND AS IP_OP_IND, OCV_PVDR_NAME AS ORDERING_PVDR_NAME, VST.DOC_NAME VISIT_ATT_NAME FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION RX JOIN ETO ON CBM_MRN = HCPR_MRN LEFT JOIN VST ON CV_MRN = HCPR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = HCPR_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OCV_ATT_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER REQ ON REQ.OP_PVDR_GUID = HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE UOM ON UOM.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE PKG ON PKG.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_INNER_PACKAGE_SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_SCRIPT_FREQUENCY ON HSF_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID = HCPR_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.RXW_PHARMACY ON HCPR_PHARMACY_ID = RPH_PHARMACY_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT HCPX_PRESCRIPTION_ID, DATE(MAX(HCPX_UPD_DT)) AS NO_LONGER_TAKING_DTE , MAX(HCPX_UPD_DT) AS NO_LONGER_TAKING_DT FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION_HX WHERE HCPX_FIELD_NAME = 'StatusType' AND HCPX_FROM_VALUE = '1' AND HCPX_MODIFICATION_REASON LIKE 'Med Review - No Longer%' GROUP BY HCPX_PRESCRIPTION_ID) X ON HCPX_PRESCRIPTION_ID = HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_ID AND HCPR_STATUS_TYPE_DESC = 'NoLongerTaking' WHERE HCPR_STATUS_TYPE NOT IN (4, 8, 5) AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 14 DAY AND COALESCE(DATE(HCPR_START_DT), RX.HCPR_CREATED_DTE) >= CURRENT DATE - 14 DAY AND(HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 2, 5) OR HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3) AND(LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) like '%predniso%' OR LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) like '%methylpredni%' OR LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) like '%dexamethaz%') ) AS A) SELECT DISTINCT MRN , LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DOB, HCT_DATE, ORD_NAME, DRUG_NAME, START_DATE, DOSE, DOSE_UOM, ROUTE, ORD_FREQ, IP_OP_IND, ORDERING_PVDR_NAME, VISIT_ATT_NAME, DX_CODE, DX_DESC FROM (SELECT MRN , LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DOB, HCT_DATE, ORD_NAME, DRUG_NAME, START_DATE, DOSE, DOSE_UOM, ROUTE, ORD_FREQ, IP_OP_IND, ORDERING_PVDR_NAME, VISIT_ATT_NAME, CC_CLSF_CD DX_CODE , CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK DX_DESC FROM SRX LEFT JOIN VST ON MRN = CV_MRN WHERE START_DATE IS NOT NULL ) AS A WHERE START_DATE >= CURRENT DATE - (CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT DATE) = 2 THEN 3 ELSE 1 END) DAY ;

prompt: Create an ADR report on oxaliplatin reactions that occur after the drug has been administered.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME, OCV_CURR_LOC AS "LOCATION", CDD_DOC_GUID AS DOC_GUID, CDD_AUTHORED_DTE AS AUTHORED_DTE, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME AS DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION AS "SECTION", CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM AS CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME AS ITEM_NAME, STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) AS VALUE_TEXT, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM AS MSTR_ITEM_NM FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2022-10-01' AND '2023-04-01' AND CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('NUR_ADR_Date DTM', 'NUR_ADR_Drug Name 1 RES', 'NUR_ADR_Drug Name (Other) FT', 'NUR_ADR_Systems RES', 'NUR_ADR_Systems Other FT', 'NUR_ADR_Intervention RES', 'NUR_ADR_Intervention 2 SUG', 'NUR_ADR_Case Details FT', 'NUR_ADR_Paient Sent to RES', 'NUR_ADR_Cardiovascular RES', 'NUR_ADR_General RES', 'NUR_ADR_GI RES', 'NUR_ADR_Musculoskeletal RES', 'NUR_ADR_Neurology RES', 'NUR_ADR_Psych RES', 'NUR_ADR_Respiratory RES', 'NUR_ADR_Skin RES' ) ) , EVENT_DATE AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_ADR_Date DTM' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS EVENT_DATE FROM CTE GROUP BY DOC_GUID) , CASE_DETAILS AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_ADR_Case Details FT' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS CASE_DETAILS FROM CTE GROUP BY DOC_GUID) , DRUG_NAME AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_ADR_Drug Name 1 RES' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS DRUG_NAME FROM CTE GROUP BY DOC_GUID) , DRUG_NAME_OTHER AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_ADR_Drug Name (Other) FT' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS DRUG_NAME_OTHER FROM CTE GROUP BY DOC_GUID) , SYSTEMS AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_ADR_Systems RES' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS SYSTEMS FROM CTE GROUP BY DOC_GUID) , SYSTEMS_OTHER AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_ADR_Systems Other FT' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS SYSTEMS_OTHER FROM CTE GROUP BY DOC_GUID) , INTERVENTION AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_ADR_Intervention RES' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS INTERVENTION FROM CTE GROUP BY DOC_GUID) , INTERVENTION_OTHER AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_ADR_Intervention 2 SUG' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS INTERVENTION_OTHER FROM CTE GROUP BY DOC_GUID) , CARDIOVASCULAR AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_ADR_Cardiovascular RES' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS CARDIOVASCULAR FROM CTE GROUP BY DOC_GUID) , GENERAL AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_ADR_General RESS' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS GENERAL FROM CTE GROUP BY DOC_GUID) , GI AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_ADR_GI RES' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS GI FROM CTE GROUP BY DOC_GUID) , MUSCULOSKELETAL AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_ADR_Musculoskeletal RES' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS MUSCULOSKELETAL FROM CTE GROUP BY DOC_GUID) , NEUROLOGY AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_ADR_Neurology RES' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS NEUROLOGY FROM CTE GROUP BY DOC_GUID) , PSYCH AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_ADR_Psych RES' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS PSYCH FROM CTE GROUP BY DOC_GUID) , RESPIRATORY AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_ADR_Respiratory RES' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS RESPIRATORY FROM CTE GROUP BY DOC_GUID) , SKIN AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_ADR_Skin RES' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS SKIN FROM CTE GROUP BY DOC_GUID) , PATIENT_SENT_TO AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_ADR_Paient Sent to RES' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS PATIENT_SENT_TO FROM CTE GROUP BY DOC_GUID) SELECT DISTINCT CTE.MRN, CTE.PT_NAME, CTE."LOCATION", CTE.DOC_GUID, CTE.AUTHORED_DTE, CTE.SERVICE_DTE, CTE.DOC_NAME, CTE."SECTION", EVENT_DATE, CASE_DETAILS, DRUG_NAME FROM CTE LEFT JOIN EVENT_DATE ON CTE.DOC_GUID = EVENT_DATE.DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN CASE_DETAILS ON CTE.DOC_GUID = CASE_DETAILS.DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN DRUG_NAME ON CTE.DOC_GUID = DRUG_NAME.DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN DRUG_NAME_OTHER ON CTE.DOC_GUID = DRUG_NAME_OTHER.DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN SYSTEMS ON CTE.DOC_GUID = SYSTEMS.DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN SYSTEMS_OTHER ON CTE.DOC_GUID = SYSTEMS_OTHER.DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN INTERVENTION ON CTE.DOC_GUID = prompt:
patient contact list needed to market an educational CME event on April 5, 2024 with special sessions designed for pituitary patients/caregivers

https://mskcc.cloud-cme.com/course/courseoverview?P=5&EID=42751
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPP_PT_TITLE PT_TITLE, STRIP(CPP_PT_FIRST_NAME) FIRST_NAME, CPP_PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, CPP_PT_NAME_SUFFIX NAME_SUFFIX, CPP_ADDR1 ADDR1, CPP_ADDR2 ADDR2, CPP_CITY CITY, CPP_STATE STATE, CPP_ZIP_CD ZIPCD, CPP_EMAIL_ADDR EMAIL_ADDR, MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) LAST_VST_DATE , CRE_RES_NAME MD_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = CPP_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CPE_MRN = PLA_MRN AND PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND = ' ' JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('009910', '022020', '448324') JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE UPPER(CPE_CPE_APPT_STS) IN ('ARRIVED', 'COMP') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 3 YEAR AND CURRENT DATE GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CPP_PT_TITLE , STRIP(CPP_PT_FIRST_NAME), CPP_PT_LAST_NAME, CPP_PT_NAME_SUFFIX , CPP_ADDR1, CPP_ADDR2, CPP_CITY, CPP_STATE, CPP_COUNTY, CPP_ZIP_CD, CPP_EMAIL_ADDR, CRE_RES_NAME) , DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN , MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DTE , CC_CLSF_CD AS DX_CD , CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN CTE ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN('C75.1' , 'D35.2', 'D44.3', 'D44.4', 'E22.0', 'E22.1' , 'E22.2' , 'E22.8', 'E22.9', 'E23' , 'E23.0', 'E23.1', 'E23.2', 'E23.3', 'E23.6', 'E23.7', 'E24.0', 'E24.1', 'E24.2', 'E24.3', 'E24.4', 'E24.8', 'E24.9' ) AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '1970-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD , CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN MRN, FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, ADDR1, ADDR2, CITY, STATE, ZIPCD, EMAIL_ADDR FROM DX JOIN CTE ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN;

prompt: Provide a list of "myeloproliferative neoplasm" or "essential thrombocytosis" or "essential thrombocythemia" or "polycythemia vera" or "primary myelofibrosis" cases from 01/01/2020 to present day.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB, PT_SEX_DESC AS GENDER, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE AS REPORT_TYPE, "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT, UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) AS "SPECIMENS SUBMITTED", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=COMMENT)', PRPT_REPORT)) AS "DIAGNOSIS" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("myeloproliferative neoplasm" | "essential thrombocytosis" | "essential thrombocythemia" | "polycythemia vera" | "primary myelofibrosis")') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND "t4"."DT_DTE" >= '2020-01-01' AND("t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" LIKE 'H%' OR "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" LIKE 'S%') ) SELECT DISTINCT X.* FROM X JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON MRN = AC_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO IN ('13-037', '06-107', '12-245', '09-141')

prompt: I would like to submit a Dataline request for a one time report of Muslim patients who are 18 years of age or older, are currently in treatment at MSKCC, including surveillance, for a confirmed diagnosis of stage III or IV cancer (solid or liquid), and are able to speak and read English OR Arabic (self-reported preference or on the MSKCC EMR system).
completion: WITH BASE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENT_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB , YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE , R.AV_DESC RELIGION , PT_SEX SEX , L.AV_DESC LANGUAGE , CPE_ENC_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN AND PT_RELIGION = 'MOS' JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RELIGION' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RELIGION JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS L ON L.AV_ELEMENT = 'PRIMARY_LANG' AND L.AV_CODE = PT_PRIMARY_LANG WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS ='Sch' AND YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 AND (L.AV_DESC like 'ARABIC%' OR L.AV_DESC = 'ENGLISH') ) , TM AS (SELECT TM_MRN , AV_DESC AS CASE_STS , LISTAGG(CAST(TM_DX_DTE AS CHAR(10)), ', ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE) TUMOR_DX_DTE , LISTAGG(TRIM(TM_HIST_CD), ', ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD) HISTOLOGY_CODE , LISTAGG(TRIM(H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK), ', ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD) AS HISTOLOGY_DESC , LISTAGG(TRIM(TM_SITE_CD), ', ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, TM_SITE_CD) AS SITE_CODE , LISTAGG(TRIM(S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK), ', ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, TM_SITE_CD) AS SITE_DESC , LISTAGG(TRIM(TM_BEST_AJCC_STG), ', ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, TM_SITE_CD) BEST_STAGE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN FROM BASE) BASE ON TM_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND (TM_BEST_AJCC_STG LIKE '3%' OR TM_BEST_AJCC_STG LIKE '4%') GROUP BY TM_MRN , AV_DESC ) SELECT CPE_MRN MRN , PATIENT_NAME , DOB , AGE , RELIGION , SEX , LANGUAGE , TUMOR_DX_DTE , BEST_STAGE , HISTOLOGY_CODE , HISTOLOGY_DESC , SITE_CODE , SITE_DESC , CASE_STS , LISTAGG(CAST(CPE_ENC_DTE AS CHAR(10)), ', ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) UPCOMING_APPTS FROM BASE JOIN TM ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN GROUP BY CPE_MRN , PATIENT_NAME , DOB , AGE , RELIGION , SEX , LANGUAGE , TUMOR_DX_DTE , BEST_STAGE , HISTOLOGY_CODE , HISTOLOGY_DESC , SITE_CODE , SITE_DESC , CASE_STS

prompt: Provide a list of patients who underwent bronchoscopy with foreign body removal (CPT 31635) from 2008-2022
completion: WITH PROCEDURES AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2022-03-31' AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD = '31635' ) , DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, C.AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, SM.AV_DESC AS SMOKING_HX FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS C ON C.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND C.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS SM ON SM.AV_ELEMENT = 'SMOKING_HX' AND SM.AV_CODE = TM_SMOKING_HX JOIN PROCEDURES ON SSE_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2000-01-01' ) SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN "MRN", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "DOD", SSE_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at Surgery", SSP_SURG_LAST_NM "Surgeon Last Name", SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM "Surgeon First Name", SSP_SURG_SVC_CD "Service", SITE_DESC "Dx Site", HIST_DESC "Dx Histology", SMOKING_HX "Smoking History" FROM PROCEDURES JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN DX ON SSE_MRN = TM_MRN ORDER BY SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SITE_DESC

prompt: Provide list of current inpatients who have never tested or have not tested for COVID-19: 72+ hours ago, 96+ hours ago
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT CCV_MRN, OL_LOC_NAME, CCV_CURRENT_LOCATION, CCV_ADMIT_DT, CCV_PROVIDER_NAME FROM IDB.COVID19_CLIENT_VISIT JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON CCV_CURRENT_LOCATION_GUID = OL_LOC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT_COVID_INFO_V ON CCV_MRN = MRN AND RESULT = 'Positive' WHERE CCV_CARE_LEVEL_CODE <> 'Inpt Schedule' AND CCV_VISIT_STATUS = 'ADM' AND CCV_VISIT_TYPE = 'Inpatient' AND MRN IS NULL AND DATE(CCV_ADMIT_DT) >= '2019-12-30' ) , PTS2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CCV_MRN FROM PTS LEFT JOIN (SELECT COR_MRN FROM IDB.COVID19_ORDER_AND_RESULT WHERE 1=1 AND COR_ORDER_STATUS_CODE NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'HOLD', 'AUC3') GROUP BY COR_MRN HAVING MAX(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) >= CURRENT timestamp - 72 HOURS) B ON CCV_MRN = B.COR_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND B.COR_MRN IS NULL ) SELECT A.CCV_MRN "MRN" , PT_LAST_NAME "PT Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME "PT First Name" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB" , YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Age" , CCV_ADMIT_DT "Admit Date" , OL_LOC_NAME "Current Unit" , CCV_CURRENT_LOCATION "Room Number" , CCV_PROVIDER_NAME "Current Attending" , MAX(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) "Last COVID19 Test Date" FROM PTS A JOIN PTS2 B ON A.CCV_MRN = B.CCV_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON A.CCV_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.COVID19_ORDER_AND_RESULT ON A.CCV_MRN = COR_MRN AND COR_ORDER_STATUS_CODE NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'HOLD', 'AUC3') LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT_COVID_INFO_V ON A.CCV_MRN = MRN WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY A.CCV_MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) , CCV_ADMIT_DT , OL_LOC_NAME , CCV_CURRENT_LOCATION , CCV_PROVIDER_NAME ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT CCV_MRN, OL_LOC_NAME, CCV_CURRENT_LOCATION, CCV_ADMIT_DT, CCV_PROVIDER_NAME FROM IDB.COVID19_CLIENT_VISIT JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON CCV_CURRENT_LOCATION_GUID = OL_LOC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT_COVID_INFO_V ON CCV_MRN = MRN AND RESULT = 'Positive' WHERE CCV_CARE_LEVEL_CODE <> 'Inpt Schedule' AND CCV_VISIT_STATUS = 'ADM' AND CCV_VISIT_TYPE = 'Inpatient' AND MRN IS NULL AND DATE(CCV_ADMIT_DT) >= '2019-12-30' ) , PTS2 AS (SELECT CCV_MRN FROM PTS LEFT JOIN (SELECT COR_MRN FROM IDB.COVID19_ORDER_AND_RESULT WHERE 1=1 AND COR_ORDER_STATUS_CODE NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'HOLD', 'AUC3') GROUP BY COR_MRN HAVING MAX(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) >= CURRENT timestamp - 96 HOURS) B ON CCV_MRN = B.COR_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND B.COR_MRN IS NULL ) SELECT A.CCV_MRN "MRN" , PT_LAST_NAME "PT Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME "PT First Name" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB" , YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Age" , CCV_ADMIT_DT "Admit Date" , OL_LOC_NAME "Current Unit" , CCV_CURRENT_LOCATION "Room Number" , CCV_PROVIDER_NAME "Current Attending" , MAX(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) "Last COVID19 Test Date" FROM PTS A JOIN PTS2 B ON A.CCV_MRN = B.CCV_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON A.CCV_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.COVID19_ORDER_AND_RESULT ON A.CCV_MRN = COR_MRN AND COR_ORDER_STATUS_CODE NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'HOLD', 'AUC3') LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT_COVID_INFO_V ON A.CCV_MRN = MRN WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY A.CCV_MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) , CCV_ADMIT_DT , OL_LOC_NAME , CCV_CURRENT_LOCATION , CCV_PROVIDER_NAME

prompt: Provide a 1 time list of discharges from inpatient and how many of the total discharges had a documented "discharge summary" note in the patient chart prior to the patient returning for their outpatient follow-up visit
completion: WITH DSCH AS (SELECT VIS_VISIT_ID, VIS_ADM_NUM, VIS_MRN, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DISP, VIS_ACCOMMODATION_TYPE FROM IDB.VISIT WHERE VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('3') AND VIS_DSCH_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' ) , VST AS (SELECT MRN, MD_NAME, RES_TYP , VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_ADM_NUM, APPT_DATE, DEPT , VISIT_TYPE FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, CRE_RES_NAME AS MD_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP AS RES_TYP , VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_ADM_NUM, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DATE , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VISIT_TYPE, CLD_CLD_CENTER AS SITE , CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'ACM' THEN 'Anticoag' WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'IR' THEN 'IR' WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'CYT' THEN 'Cytology' WHEN CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('BSK APP-1', 'BSK APP-3') THEN 'BSK APP' WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_20 = '' THEN CLD_DEPT_NAME ELSE CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_20 END AS DEPT , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) RN FROM DSCH JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = VIS_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN VIS_DSCH_DTE AND VIS_DSCH_DTE + 365 DAY AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') ) AS A WHERE RN = 1 ) SELECT MRN, CDD_ADM_NUM, VIS_ADM_NUM, DOCUMENT_NAME, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, CDD_AUTHORED_DTE, APPT_DATE, MD_NAME, RES_TYP, DEPT, VISIT_TYPE FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN MRN, CDD_ADM_NUM, VIS_ADM_NUM, CDD_DOC_NAME DOCUMENT_NAME, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, CDD_AUTHORED_DTE, APPT_DATE, MD_NAME, RES_TYP, DEPT, VISIT_TYPE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN, CDD_ADM_NUM ORDER BY CASE WHEN CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Discharge Summary' THEN '1' ELSE CDD_DOC_GUID END) RN FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN VST ON MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_ADM_NUM = VIS_ADM_NUM WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE BETWEEN VIS_DSCH_DTE AND APPT_DATE AND CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE 'Discharge Summary%' ) AS A WHERE RN = 1

prompt: Requesting equesting a list of patients who have had this endoscopic imaging procedures. this request is URGENT and small list of patients is requested ASAP
completion: WITH PROCEDURES_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_LOG_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD") AS VARCHAR) || ' - ' || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC") AS VARCHAR) AS PROC_CODE_DESC FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE" ON "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_LOG_ID" = "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_LOG_ID" WHERE "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD" IN ('31576')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PROCEDURES_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PROCEDURES_0)), COHORT_PROCEDURES AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PROCEDURES_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PROCEDURES_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PROCEDURES_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_PROCEDURES.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_PROCEDURES_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_PROCEDURES.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PROCEDURES_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_PROCEDURES ON COHORT_PROCEDURES.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, TRIM(IDB_PATIENT."PT_LAST_NAME") || ', ' || TRIM(IDB_PATIENT."PT_FIRST_NAME") AS PT_NAME, ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_DESC" AS SEX, IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH" AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_DEATH" AS DATE_OF_DEATH FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_SEX ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_SEX" = ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_ELEMENT" = 'SEX') SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_NAME AS PT_NAME, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.SEX AS SEX, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_DEATH AS DATE_OF_DEATH FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID;

prompt: Provide inpatient and outpatient Psych visit data with Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale and corresponding risk level identified
completion: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Count", OCV_IP_OP_IND "IP/OP Indicator", "NV/FU" AS "Initial/Progress", "Columbia Screener", "Columbia Screener Value", "Risk Assessment Formulation" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", CDD_MRN AS "MRN", CDD_DOC_GUID AS "Document Guid", OCV_IP_OP_IND, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Suicide Risk Factor', 'Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale') AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS "Columbia Screener", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Suicide Risk Factor', 'Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale') THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 255) END) AS "Columbia Screener Value", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Risk Assessment Details' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS "Risk Assessment Formulation", MAX(CASE WHEN CDD_DOC_NAME like '%Initial%' THEN 'Initial' ELSE 'Progress' END) AS "NV/FU" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' AND (CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Suicide Risk Factor', 'Risk Assessment Details') OR (CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT = 'Unable to assess.') ) JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = CDD_VISIT_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME like '%Psychiatry%' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 4 MONTHS) AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE < (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 1 MONTHS) GROUP BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, OCV_IP_OP_IND) A GROUP BY OCV_IP_OP_IND, "NV/FU", "Columbia Screener", "Columbia Screener Value", "Risk Assessment Formulation" ; SELECT CDD_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "PT Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "PT First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", PT_SEX "Gender", CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", OCV_IP_OP_IND "IP/OP Indicator", MAX(CASE WHEN CDD_DOC_NAME like '%Initial%' THEN 'Initial' ELSE 'Progress' END) AS "NV/FU", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Suicide Risk Factor', 'Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale') AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS "Columbia Screener", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Suicide Risk Factor', 'Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale') THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 255) END) AS "Columbia Screener Value", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Risk Assessment Details' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS "Risk Assessment Formulation" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' AND (CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Suicide Risk Factor', 'Risk Assessment Details') OR (CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT = 'Unable to assess.') ) LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = CDD_VISIT_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME like '%Psychiatry%' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 4 MONTHS) AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE < (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 1 MONTHS) GROUP BY CDD_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, OCV_IP_OP_IND ;

prompt: Provide further detail on report IM4603 (patients who have been diagnosed with aspiration pneumonitis in the past two calendar years).
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-9 Code", "t2"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-9 MSK code description", YEAR("t3"."DT_DTE") AS "ICD-9 Diagnosis Year", "t4"."PCC_CODE" AS "CPT Procedure Code - OR", "t4"."PCC_DESC" AS "CPT Procedure Desc - OR", "t5"."MP_FULL_NM" AS "CPT Procedure Physician - OR", "t5"."MP_SERVICE_CD" AS "CPT Physician Service CD - OR", "t5"."MP_SERVICE_DESC" AS "CPT Physician Service Desc c1", "t6"."DT_DTE" AS "CPT Procedure Date - OR", "t7"."HSA_ADM_PRIO" AS "Admission Priority Code", "t7"."HSA_ADM_PRIO_DESC" AS "Admission Priority", "t7"."HSA_DSCH_DISP" AS "Discharge Disposition Code", "t7"."HSA_DSCH_DISP_DESC" AS "Discharge Disposition", "t8"."DT_DTE" AS "Admission Date", "t9"."DT_DTE" AS "Discharge Date", "t10"."HS_ACCT_NO" AS "Account Number", "t10"."HS_NO_OF_DAYS_STAY" AS "Length of Stay" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS" "t11" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t11"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" INNER JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_ATTRIBUTE_V DA ON "t11".PDX_DIAGNOSIS_ATTRIBUTE_ID = DA.DXA_ATTRIBUTE_ID LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICD9_V" "t2" ON "t11"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t3" ON "t11"."PDX_DX_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CPT_OR_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t4" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."MEDPRO_V" "t5" ON "t4"."PTX_MEDPRO_ID" = "t5"."MP_MEDPRO_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t6" ON "t4"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "t6"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."HOSPITAL_STAY" "t10" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t10"."HS_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."HOSPITAL_STAY_ATTRIBUTES" "t7" ON "t10"."HS_HOSP_STAY_ATTR_ID" = "t7"."HSA_HOSP_STAY_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t8" ON "t10"."HS_ADM_DATE_ID" = "t8"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t9" ON "t10"."HS_DSCH_DATE_ID" = "t9"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE ("t11"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" IN (9822) AND YEAR("t3"."DT_DTE") BETWEEN 2008 AND 2009) AND "t11".PDX_ACCT_NO = "t10"."HS_ACCT_NO" AND "t6"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN "t8"."DT_DTE" AND "t9"."DT_DTE" AND DA.DXA_CLSF_TYPE IN ('DFN', 'DF2', 'DFY', 'DF1', 'DA')

prompt: For the 2 time periods Jan 2006-Dec. 2006 and Jan 2007-Dec 2008, provide the following information for  H&N cancer  - tonsils, soft palate, and base of tongue.
completion: SELECT TM_MRN, TM_ICD9_CD , TM_CASE_STS, A.AV_DESC AS CASE_STS , TM_DX_DTE , YEAR(TM_DX_DTE) AS DX_YEAR , TM_SITE_CD, X.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC , TM_HIST_CD, Y.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC , TM_AJCC, C.AV_DESC AS STAGE , TM_CA_SURG_DTE, TM_CA_SURG_03, AVSITE_DESC AS SURGERY , TM_RAD_STRT_DTE, TM_RAD_END_DTE, TM_RAD_TX_MOD, D.CDB_AV_DESC AS RAD_MOD , TM_SYST_STRT_DTE, TM_CHEM_SUM_MSK, TM_CHEM_SUM, F.CDB_AV_DESC AS CHEM_SUM , TM_RAD_SURG_SEQ, B.CDB_AV_DESC AS RAD_SURG_SEQ FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM AS X ON TM_SITE_CD = X.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM AS Y ON TM_HIST_CD = Y.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AS C ON TM_AJCC = C.AV_CODE AND C.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND C.AV_CD_STS = 'A' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AS A ON A.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND A.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND A.AV_CD_STS = 'A' LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_ALLOWVALS AS B ON TM_RAD_SURG_SEQ = B.CDB_AV_CODE AND B.CDB_AV_ELEMENT = 'RAD_SURG_SEQ' AND B.CDB_AV_CD_STS = 'A' LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_ALLOWVALS_SITE ON AVSITE_CODE = TM_CA_SURG_03 AND AVSITE_ELEMENT = 'CA_SURG_SUM_03' AND TM_SITE_CD BETWEEN AVSITE_LOW_SITE AND AVSITE_HIGH_SITE AND AVSITE_CD_STS = 'A' LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_ALLOWVALS AS D ON TM_RAD_TX_MOD = D.CDB_AV_CODE AND D.CDB_AV_ELEMENT = 'RAD_TX_MOD' AND D.CDB_AV_CD_STS = 'A' LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_ALLOWVALS AS F ON TM_CHEM_SUM = F.CDB_AV_CODE AND F.CDB_AV_ELEMENT = 'CHEM_SUM' AND F.CDB_AV_CD_STS = 'A' WHERE TM_SITE_CD IN ('C019', 'C099', 'C051') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2006-01-01' AND '2008-12-31' AND TM_CASE_STS NOT IN ('5', '8')

prompt: Darwin cohort notification of patients with Recurrent Low Grade Serous Ovarian Cancer (LGSOC) with KRAS mutant tumors
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID , PRIMARY_SITE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID , PT_MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('LGSOC', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = X.TTC WHERE 1=1 ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT P_ID FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V A ON P_ID = A.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS B ON P_ID = B.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND (GENE = 'KRAS' OR GENE2 = 'KRAS') AND PT_VITAL_STATUS = 'ALIVE' ) ;

prompt: Provide diagnosis, antineoplastic, and demographic data for patients diagnosed with renal cell carcinoma.
completion: WITH CDB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t2"."PT_MRN" AS MRN, "t2"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t2"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t2"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t2"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", CASE WHEN "t2"."PT_DEATH_DTE" IS NULL THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS "Vital Status", PT_SEX AS "Gender", "t2"."PT_RACE_DESC" AS "Race", "t5"."CORE_ETHNICITY_DESC" AS "Ethnicity", PLA_LAST_DRVST_DTE AS "Last Dr Visit Date", "t7"."DT_DTE" AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", "t3"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t3"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Description", "t4"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t4"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Description", CDTM_LATERALITY_DESC AS "Laterality", CDTM_SMOKING_HX_DESC AS "Smoking Hx", CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS "Best Stage", "t9"."CDTM_CA_SURG_DTE" AS "Cancer Surgery Date", "t6"."TCA_CASE_STS_DESC" AS "Case Status" , "t7"."TCLSA_CLIN_TNM_T" AS "Clinical Tumor", "t7"."TCLSA_CLIN_TNM_N" AS "Clinical Nodes", "t7"."TCLSA_CLIN_TNM_M" AS "Clinical Metastases", "t8"."TPSA_PATH_TNM_T" AS "Path Tumor", "t8"."TPSA_PATH_TNM_N" AS "Path Nodes", "t8"."TPSA_PATH_TNM_M" AS "Path Metastases" , G.AV_DESC AS "Grade" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t9" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t3" ON "t9"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t3"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t4" ON "t9"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t4"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t7" ON "t9"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t7"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t5" ON "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V" "t6" ON "t9"."CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID" = "t6"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_CLINICAL_STAGE_ATTRIBUTES_V" "t7" ON "t9"."CDTM_CLINICAL_STAGE_ATTR_ID" = "t7"."TCLSA_TM_CLIN_STAGE_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_PATH_STAGE_ATTRIBUTES_V" "t8" ON "t9"."CDTM_PATH_STAGE_ATTR_ID" = "t8"."TPSA_TM_PATH_STAGE_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = "t2"."PT_MRN" AND TM_CDB_SEQ_NO = CDTM_CDB_SEQ_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_ELEMENT = 'HIST_CD_GRADE' AND G.AV_CODE = TM_HIST_CD_GRADE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE 1=1 AND DXCC_ICD_CODE IN ('M8312/3' ,'M8312/6' ,'M8317/3' ,'M8318/3' ,'M8319/3' ) AND (TM_CLIN_TNM_T like '%3C%' OR TM_CLIN_TNM_T like '%3B%' ) AND "t6"."TCA_CASE_STS_DESC" <> 'Non-Index tumor' ) , ANTINEO_PRE AS (SELECT APR_MRN , APR_GENERIC_NAME , MIN(COALESCE(APR_START_DTE, APR_ORD_CREATE_DTE)) AS MIN_START_DTE_VAR , MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS MAX_END_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM CDB) CDB ON MRN = APR_MRN WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY APR_MRN , APR_GENERIC_NAME) , ANTINEO_LISTAGG AS (SELECT APR_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(TRIM(APR_GENERIC_NAME), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(CAST(MIN_START_DTE_VAR AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(MAX_END_DTE), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MIN_START_DTE_VAR) AS "Antineoplastic Source" FROM ANTINEO_PRE GROUP BY APR_MRN) SELECT CDB.* , "Antineoplastic Source" FROM CDB CDB LEFT JOIN ANTINEO_LISTAGG ON APR_MRN = MRN ; WITH CDB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t2"."PT_MRN" AS MRN, "t2"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t2"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t2"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t2"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", CASE WHEN "t2"."PT_DEATH_DTE" IS NULL THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS "Vital Status", PT_SEX AS "Gender", "t2"."PT_RACE_DESC" AS "Race", "t5"."CORE_ETHNICITY_DESC" AS "Ethnicity", PLA_LAST_DRVST_DTE AS "Last Dr Visit Date", "t7"."DT_DTE" AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", "t3"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t3"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Description", "t4"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t4"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Description", CDTM_LATERALITY_DESC AS "Laterality", CDTM_SMOKING_HX_DESC AS "Smoking Hx", CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS "Best Stage", "t9"."CDTM_CA_SURG_DTE" AS "Cancer Surgery Date", "t6"."TCA_CASE_STS_DESC" AS "Case Status" , "t7"."TCLSA_CLIN_TNM_T" AS "Clinical Tumor", "t7"."TCLSA_CLIN_TNM_N" AS "Clinical Nodes", "t7"."TCLSA_CLIN_TNM_M" AS "Clinical Metastases", "t8"."TPSA_PATH_TNM_T" AS "Path Tumor", "t8"."TPSA_PATH_TNM_N" AS "Path Nodes", "t8"."TPSA_PATH_TNM_M" AS "Path Metastases" , G.AV_DESC AS "Grade" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t9" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t3" ON "t9"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t3"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t4" ON "t9"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t4"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t7" ON "t9"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t7"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t5" ON "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V" "t6" ON "t9"."CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID" = "t6"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_CLINICAL_STAGE_ATTRIBUTES_V" "t7" ON "t9"."CDTM_CLINICAL_STAGE_ATTR_ID" = "t7"."TCLSA_TM_CLIN_STAGE_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_PATH_STAGE_ATTRIBUTES_V" "t8" ON "t9"."CDTM_PATH_STAGE_ATTR_ID" = "t8"."TPSA_TM_PATH_STAGE_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = "t2"."PT_MRN" AND TM_CDB_SEQ_NO = CDTM_CDB_SEQ_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_ELEMENT = 'HIST_CD_GRADE' AND G.AV_CODE = TM_HIST_CD_GRADE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE 1=1 AND DXCC_ICD_CODE IN ('M8312/3' ,'M8312/6' ,'M8317/3' ,'M8318/3' ,'M8319/3' ) AND ((TM_CLIN_TNM_T like '%3C%' OR TM_CLIN_TNM_T like '%3B%' ) OR (TPSA_PATH_TNM_T like '%3C%' OR TPSA_PATH_TNM_T like '%3B%' ) ) AND "t6"."TCA_CASE_STS_DESC" <> 'Non-Index tumor' ) , ANTINEO_PRE AS (SELECT APR_MRN , APR_GENERIC_NAME , MIN(COALESCE(APR_START_DTE, APR_ORD_CREATE_DTE)) AS MIN_START_DTE_VAR , MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS MAX_END_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM CDB) CDB ON MRN = APR_MRN WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY APR_MRN , APR_GENERIC_NAME) , ANTINEO_LISTAGG AS (SELECT APR_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(TRIM(APR_GENERIC_NAME), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(CAST(MIN_START_DTE_VAR AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(MAX_END_DTE), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MIN_START_DTE_VAR) AS "Antineoplastic Source" FROM ANTINEO_PRE GROUP BY APR_MRN) SELECT CDB.* , "Antineoplastic Source" FROM CDB CDB LEFT JOIN ANTINEO_LISTAGG ON APR_MRN = MRN ;

prompt: Update RRM27635 to include 12-245 and 02-060 patients from the specified list of consenting professionals
completion: WITH PRO AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRO_IRB_NO FROM IDB.PROTOCOL WHERE PRO_IRB_NO IN ('18-014', '21-216') ) , PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.PRO_IRB_NO AS IRB_NO, B.ACD_MRN AS MRN, B.ACD_CONS_DTE AS CONSENT_DTE FROM PRO A JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES B ON B.ACD_IRB_NO = A.PRO_IRB_NO AND B.ACD_TX_ST_DTE IS NOT NULL AND B.ACD_TX_END_DTE IS NULL UNION SELECT DISTINCT AC_IRB_NO AS IRB_NO, ACD_MRN AS MRN, ACD_CONS_DTE AS CONSENT_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON ACD_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO AND ACD_MRN = AC_MRN AND ACD_TX_ST_DTE IS NOT NULL AND ACD_TX_END_DTE IS NULL WHERE 1=1 AND ACD_IRB_NO IN ('02-060', '12-245') AND AC_CONS_STAFF_NAME IN ('ATHANASIAN,EDWARD A', 'BARTELSTEIN,MEREDITH', 'BOLAND,PATRICK J', 'CHAPMAN,TALIA', 'CHEN,LINDA', 'FORSBERG,JONATHAN', 'HEALEY,JOHN H', 'MANALO,GRACE', 'METVINER,LAUREN', 'MORRIS,CAROL', 'PRINCE,DANIEL', 'PRINCE,DANIEL EDUARDO', 'VAYNRUB,MAKSIM', 'RAMESH,BHAVANI') ) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN , CL_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, CL_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME , IRB_NO, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DTE, TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS APPT_TIME , CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT, CRE_RES_NAME AS RESOURCE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR AS VT_ABBR , CPE_CPE_APPT_STS AS STATUS, CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE AS MADE_DATE, CPE_CANCEL_DTE AS CANCEL_DATE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = CL_MRN WHERE CONSENT_DTE <= CPE_ENC_DTE AND(CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 3 DAY AND CURRENT date - 1 DAY OR CPE_CANCEL_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 3 DAY AND CURRENT date - 1 DAY) ORDER BY IRB_NO, MRN, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME ) , AC AS (SELECT AC_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '02-060' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "02-060 Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '02-060' THEN AC_CONS_STAFF_NAME END) AS "02-060 Consenting Professional", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "12-245 Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN AC_CONS_STAFF_NAME END) AS "12-245 Consenting Professional" FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('02-060', '12-245') AND AC_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM X) GROUP BY AC_MRN ) SELECT DISTINCT X.*, "02-060 Consent Date", "02-060 Consenting Professional", "12-245 Consent Date", "12-245 Consenting Professional" FROM X LEFT JOIN AC ON MRN = AC_MRN

prompt: Identify all patients with germ cell tumor and a diagnosis of brain metastasis between January 1, 1990 and December 31, 2010.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, AV_DESC AS TM_CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, PFA_FST_APPT_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTIVITY ON PFA_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD BETWEEN 'M9060/3' AND 'M9105/3' GROUP BY PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, AV_DESC, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, PFA_FST_APPT_DTE ) SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, TM_CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_METS_DTE, PFA_FST_APPT_DTE FROM CTE JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_CD = '198.3' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2010-12-31' GROUP BY PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, TM_CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, PFA_FST_APPT_DTE

prompt: Provide report for all Oncotype orders placed by Breast surgeons for patients who had Breast Medicine appointments within the last 3 months , identify if patients have Emblem Health Insurance.
completion: SELECT ORD.OO_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME , ORD.OO_ENTER_DTE ORDER_ENTER_DTE, ORD.OO_ORD_ID ORDERID, ORD.OO_ORD_NAME ORDERNAME, OCV_CURR_LOC VISIT_LOCATION, OCV_VISIT_DTE VISIT_DTE, PVDR.OP_DISPLAY_NAME VISIT_PROVIDER, PVDR.OP_TASK_ROLE_TYPE PVDR_ROLE, DOC.DOC_ACDMC_DPT ACDMC_DPT, DOC.DOC_ACDMC_SVC ACDMC_SVC, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE APPT_MADE_DTE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME VISIT_TYPE, CVT_EXT_NAME VISIT_TYPE_NAME, FSC_CAT_NAME FINANCIAL_CLASS_CATEGORY, INS_COMP_NAME INSURANCE_COMPANY_NAME FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER ORD JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON OCV_ENC_CSN_ID = CPE_ENC_CSN_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE = OCV_VISIT_DTE AND OCV_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER PVDR ON ORD.OO_PVDR_GUID= PVDR.OP_PVDR_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC DOC ON PVDR.OP_PVDR_NO= DOC.DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT_INSURANCE_V ON OO_MRN = MRN AND FSC_CAT_NAME like 'EMBLEM%' WHERE NOT (ORD.OO_ORD_STS_CD='CANC' OR ORD.OO_ORD_STS_CD='CANP') AND ORD.OO_ORD_NAME IN ('Oncotype Request Order', 'Oncotype Request Order - Additional Specimen') AND ORD.OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 3 MONTH AND CURRENT DATE

prompt: Identify which patients in a provided cohort (if any) participated in POLO trial.
Provide list of patients with samples in HOTB with diagnosis and transplant data.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE, CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE, HDC_DESEASE_CODE_DESC, DXCC_ICD_CODE AS "ICD-O Histology Code", DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-O Histology Description", ICSC_SITE_CD AS "ICD-O Site Code", ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-O Site Description", HS_SUBJECT_ID, HS_SPECIMEN_ID, HCTC_CELL_TYPE_CODE_DESC, HSDC_SOURCE_DETAIL_CODE_DESC, HS_SPECIMENT_CELL_COUNT, HS_VAIL_CELLS_COUNT, DATE(HS_COLLECTION_DT) COLLECTION_DTE FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.HOTB_SPECIMEN ON PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = HS_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON HS_COLLECTION_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.HOTB_SOURCE_DETAIL_CODES ON HS_SOURCE_DETAIL_CODE_ID = HSDC_SOURCE_DETAIL_CODE_ID JOIN DV.HOTB_CELL_TYPE_CODES ON HS_CELL_TYPE_CODE_ID = HCTC_CELL_TYPE_CODE_ID JOIN DV.HOTB_STATUS_CODES ON HS_STATUS_CODE_ID = HSC_STATUS_CODE_ID JOIN DV.HOTB_TREATMENT_CODES ON HS_TREATMENT_CODE_ID = HTC_TREATMENT_CODE_ID JOIN DV.HOTB_DESEASE_CODES ON HS_DESEASE_CODE_ID = HDC_DESEASE_CODE_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT CBM_MRN, CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE, CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE UNION SELECT CBP_MRN CBM_MRN, CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE, CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS) A ON PT_MRN = CBM_MRN LEFT JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR_V ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID LEFT JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID LEFT JOIN DV.TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V ON CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID = TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID WHERE DATE(HS_COLLECTION_DT) >= CURRENT date - 30 DAYS AND PT_MRN = '38078369'

prompt: List of Clintrac visits discharged < 2/24/2018 which have been definalized or finalized the day prior, along with their coding (i.e. diagnoses and procedures).
completion: WITH NON_EDIT_VISITS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CRH_VISIT_ID VIS_ID FROM IDB.CTC_REC_HX JOIN IDB.CTC_VISIT ON CRH_VISIT_ID=CV_VISIT_ID WHERE CRH_TYPE <> 'EDIT' AND CRH_DTE = CURRENT date - 1 DAY AND CV_DSCH_DTE <= '2018-02-23' ), LAST_ACTION AS (SELECT CRH_VISIT_ID LST_VST_ID, CRH_TYPE FROM (SELECT CRH_VISIT_ID, CRH_TYPE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CRH_VISIT_ID ORDER BY CRH_DT DESC) AS RN FROM NON_EDIT_VISITS JOIN IDB.CTC_REC_HX ON VIS_ID=CRH_VISIT_ID WHERE CRH_TYPE <> 'EDIT' ) A WHERE RN=1 ) SELECT PT_MRN MRN, RTRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) ||', '|| PT_FIRST_NAME "Patient Name", CV_CTC_VISIT_NO "Visit No", CV_CTC_VISIT_TYPE "I/O", CV_ACCT_NO "Acct No", CHAR(CV_ADM_DTE) "Adm Date", CHAR(CV_DSCH_DTE) "Dsch Date", CV_CODING_STS "Code Sts", CRH_TYPE "Last Action", CC_CLSF_TYPE "CLSF Type", CC_CLSF_PRIO "Prio", CC_CLSF_CD "Code", CC_RESP_PARTY "MD", CHAR(CC_EFF_DTE) "DoS" FROM NON_EDIT_VISITS JOIN IDB.CTC_VISIT ON VIS_ID=CV_VISIT_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=CV_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_VISIT_ID=VIS_ID LEFT JOIN LAST_ACTION ON LST_VST_ID = VIS_ID ORDER BY VIS_ID, CC_EFF_DTE DESC ;

"Service Hour", CHAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) AS "Service Date ..", CHAR(CDD_SERVICE_DT) AS "Service DT ..", CHAR(TIME(CDD_SERVICE_DT)) AS "Service Time..", CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) = 1 THEN 'Sunday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) = 2 THEN 'Monday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) = 3 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) = 4 THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) = 5
