prompt: Provide a report of patients to evaluate craniocaudal retroperitoneal lymph node length as a risk factor for germ cell tumors.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, AJCC7.AV_DESC AS AJCC7_STAGE, CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS BEST_STAGE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9061/3', 'M9062/3', 'M9063/3', 'M9064/3', 'M9065/3', 'M9085/3') AND AJCC7.AV_DESC IN ('IA', 'IB', 'IIA') ) , SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSE_SURG_LOC , CASE WHEN SSE_SURG_LOC LIKE 'MAIN OR%' THEN 'MAIN' WHEN SSE_SURG_LOC LIKE 'JR OR%' THEN 'JR' WHEN SSE_SURG_LOC LIKE 'ENDO OR%' THEN 'ENDO' WHEN SSE_SURG_LOC LIKE '%IR%' THEN 'IR' WHEN SSE_SURG_LOC LIKE '%SDH%' THEN 'SDH' WHEN SSE_SURG_LOC LIKE 'MON%' THEN 'MON' ELSE SSE_SURG_LOC END AS "Surgery Location" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SSE_MRN IN (SELECT TM_MRN FROM DX) AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2010-02-01' AND '2017-10-31' AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('38780', '54520', '54530') ) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT DX.*, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, "Surgery Location", PLA_LST_CON_DTE, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE FROM DX JOIN SRG ON TM_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON TM_MRN = PLA_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."RRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Radiology Accession Number", "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" AS "Radiology Performed Date", "t2"."RRPT_REPORT_DTE" AS "Radiology Report Date", "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS "Radiology Order Group", "t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" AS "Radiology Procedure Name", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(RRPT_REPORT_TXT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS "PRPT_REPORT" FROM X JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON "t1"."PT_MRN" = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" BETWEEN SSE_SURG_DTE - 90 DAYS AND SSE_SURG_DTE + 90 DAYS AND "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" = 'CT' AND "t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" IN ('Abdomen w/ Con', 'Abdomen/Pelvis w/ Con', 'Abdomen/Pelvis w/o Con', 'Chest PE w/ Abdomen/Pelvis', 'Chest R/O PE', 'Chest w/ Con', 'Chest w/o Con', 'Chest/Abdomen/Pelvis w/ Con', 'CT AB/PEL W/ CON', 'CT AB/PEL W/O CON', 'CT ABDOMEN W/ CON', 'CT CH/ABD/PEL W/ CON', 'CT CHEST W/ CON', 'CT CHEST W/O CON', 'Pelvis w/o Con')

prompt:
Add new DTU locations for Regional sites, rerun for 2 QTR and July 2017

DTU WES and MON DTU.
completion: SELECT APPT.MRN, APPT.LST_APPT_DT , APPT.DEPT_ID, APPT.DEPT_NAME , IRB.LST_CONS_DTE , CASE WHEN IRB.IRB_NO IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE IRB.IRB_NO END IRB_NO , CASE WHEN IRB.IRB_TITLE IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE IRB.IRB_TITLE END IRB_TITLE FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, MAX(CPE_APPT_DT) AS LST_APPT_DT , CLD_DEPT_ID DEPT_ID , CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', ' Comp') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 AND CPE_DEPT_ID IN (346, 361, 392, 670) AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH - DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTHS)DAYS + 1 DAYS AND CPE_ENC_DTE <= LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTHS) GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CLD_DEPT_ID, CLD_DEPT_NAME) APPT LEFT JOIN (SELECT MRN, LST_CONS_DTE, PRO_IRB_NO IRB_NO , PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE, PRO_IRB_TITLE IRB_TITLE FROM (SELECT MRN , MAX(AC_CONS_DTE) AS LST_CONS_DTE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', ' Comp') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 AND CPE_DEPT_ID IN (346, 361, 392, 670) AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH - DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTHS)DAYS + 1 DAYS AND CPE_ENC_DTE <= LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTHS) ) AS APPT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.PROTOCOL ON AC_IRB_NO = PRO_IRB_NO AND PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE LIKE 'Therapeutic%' GROUP BY MRN) AS CONS JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = MRN AND AC_CONS_DTE = LST_CONS_DTE JOIN IDB.PROTOCOL ON AC_IRB_NO = PRO_IRB_NO AND PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE LIKE 'Therapeutic%') AS IRB ON APPT.MRN = IRB.MRN

prompt: Provide a monthly list of patients with translocation RCC/ TFE3 retained
completion: WITH GENE_ALIVE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PSR.PT_MRN AS GENE_MRN, PSR.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS GENE_PID, PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AS GENE_RID, GENE, GENE2, AA_CHANGE , LOCUS, NUCLEOTIDE, ABERRATIONTYPE, FOLD_CHANGE, SEARCH_HIT1, SEARCH_HIT2 FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V PSR JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS PD ON PD.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PSR.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND PT_VITAL_STATUS = 'ALIVE' WHERE (GENE = 'TFE3' OR GENE2 = 'TFE3') ) , DMP_DX_PRE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_BIRTH_DTE, CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) END AS "Cur Age", PLA_LAST_DSCH_DTE AS "Last Discharge Date", RPT.DT_DTE AS REPORT_DATE , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID , DV.TODATE(DT_PROCEDURE) AS "Procedure Date" , PRIMARY_SITE , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE , TUMOR_TYPE_NAME , METASTASIS_SITE , PDWS_NAME, PDWS_DESCRIPTION , GENE_PANEL , PART_DESCRIPTION , GENE, GENE2, AA_CHANGE , LOCUS, NUCLEOTIDE, ABERRATIONTYPE, FOLD_CHANGE, SEARCH_HIT1, SEARCH_HIT2 FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT JOIN GENE_ALIVE ON GENE_RID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site' , GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/gene-panel' , PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/part_description') T JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V PRV ON PRV.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V RPT ON RPT.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND TUMOR_TYPE_NAME ='Translocation-Associated Renal Cell Carcinoma' AND YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) > 18 ) SELECT * FROM DMP_DX_PRE ORDER BY 1

prompt: CCNE1 amplification excluding CDKN2A/B/C
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC WHERE 1=1 AND (INC.GENE IN ('CCNE1') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('CCNE1')) AND (INC.ABERRATIONTYPE IN ('copy number gain') OR CASE WHEN 'fusion' IN ('copy number gain') AND (UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%FUSION%' OR UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%TRANSLOCATION%' OR UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%REARRAN%' OR UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%INVERSION%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 1) AND CASE WHEN INC.METHOD = 'IMPACT' THEN 'IMPACT' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'IMPACTv%' THEN 'IMPACT' WHEN INC.METHOD = 'ArcherHeme' THEN 'ArcherHeme' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'ArcherHemeV%' THEN 'ArcherHeme' WHEN LOWER(INC.METHOD) like LOWER('ArcherPanHemeV%') THEN 'ArcherPanHeme' WHEN INC.METHOD = 'Archer' THEN 'Archer' WHEN LOWER(INC.METHOD) like 'archerv%' THEN 'Archer' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'ACCESSv%' THEN 'ACCESS' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'IMPACTHv%' THEN 'IMPACTHeme' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'RDTB%' THEN 'RDTB' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'RDTS%' THEN 'RDTS' ELSE INC.METHOD END IN ('IMPACT') ) , DT_3 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') ) , DT_4 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC WHERE 1=1 AND (INC.GENE IN ('CDKN2A', 'CDKN2B', 'CDKN2C') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('CDKN2A', 'CDKN2B', 'CDKN2C')) AND CASE WHEN INC.METHOD = 'IMPACT' THEN 'IMPACT' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'IMPACTv%' THEN 'IMPACT' WHEN INC.METHOD = 'ArcherHeme' THEN 'ArcherHeme' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'ArcherHemeV%' THEN 'ArcherHeme' WHEN LOWER(INC.METHOD) like LOWER('ArcherPanHemeV%') THEN 'ArcherPanHeme' WHEN INC.METHOD = 'Archer' THEN 'Archer' WHEN LOWER(INC.METHOD) like 'archerv%' THEN 'Archer' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'ACCESSv%' THEN 'ACCESS' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'IMPACTHv%' THEN 'IMPACTHeme' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'RDTB%' THEN 'RDTB' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'RDTS%' THEN 'RDTS' ELSE INC.METHOD END IN ('IMPACT') ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT P_ID FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3 EXCEPT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_4 ))

prompt: would like a monthly summary report of unique appts appearing on each of these lists
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT CHT_COHORT_TITLE, PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME FROM DVCMS.COHORT_PATIENT JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CHP_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DVCMS.COHORT ON CHT_COHORT_ID = CHP_COHORT_ID WHERE CHP_COHORT_ID IN (10899, 10898, 10897, 10894, 9696, 9695, 9667) ) , OMS AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CHT_COHORT_TITLE, OO_MRN ORDER BY OO_ENTER_DT DESC) RN, CHT_COHORT_TITLE COHORT, OO_MRN, OO_ORD_NAME ORDER_NAME, OSTS_STS_DESC ORDER_STATUS, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ENTER_DT, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE ORDER_SIGNIFICANT_DATE, OO_SUMMARY_LINE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN PTS ON MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000010830200730' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') ) WHERE RN = 1 ) , APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CHT_COHORT_TITLE COHORT, CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE APPT_DATE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 APPT_DEPT , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CHT_COHORT_TITLE, CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT DESC) RN FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('LAB', 'CHM') ) SELECT P.*, APPT_DATE, APPT_DEPT, ORDER_SIGNIFICANT_DATE, ORDER_STATUS, ORDER_NAME FROM PTS P JOIN APPTS A ON CHT_COHORT_TITLE = A.COHORT AND P.MRN = A.MRN AND A.RN = 1 AND APPT_DATE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 1 MONTH AND CURRENT date - 1 DAY LEFT JOIN OMS O ON CHT_COHORT_TITLE = O.COHORT AND P.MRN = O.OO_MRN AND O.RN = 1 AND ORDER_SIGNIFICANT_DATE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 1 MONTH AND CURRENT date - 1 DAY

prompt: MRNs of adults with stage IV and/or metastatic solid tumors seen by supportive care as a new patient in 2021.
completion: WITH NV AS (SELECT MRN FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE , MONTHS_BETWEEN (CPE_ENC_DTE, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH)/12 AS "AGE_ASON_APPT" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('SUP' ) AND CVT_IN_OUT_PT = 'Outpatient' AND CPE_MRN <> '' AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%IR%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%NEW%') AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) = '2021' ) WHERE AGE_ASON_APPT >= 18 ) , TUMOR AS (SELECT TM_MRN MRN, 'Stage4 -Non-Lympoma,Non-Leukemi, Non-Myeloma' AS CATEG_NAME FROM (SELECT TM_MRN, RECODE, CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS "STAGE" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR T JOIN NV A ON TM_MRN = A.MRN JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING SG ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = SG.RECODE JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON TM_MRN = CPP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND (RECODE NOT IN ('33042', '34000', '35011') AND RECODE < '37000') ) WHERE STAGE LIKE 'IV%' OR STAGE LIKE '4%' ) , PANC AS (SELECT TM_MRN MRN, 'PANCREATIC CANCER ALL STAGES' AS CATEG_NAME FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN NV ON MRN = TM_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C259%' ) , LUNG AS (SELECT TM_MRN MRN, 'LUNG CANCER STAGES 3 AND 4' AS CATEG_NAME FROM (SELECT TM_MRN , CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS "STAGE" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR T JOIN NV A ON TM_MRN = A.MRN JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING SG ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE AND CATEGORY2 = 'Lung and Bronchus' AND CATEGORY1 = 'Respiratory System' JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON TM_MRN = CPP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) WHERE STAGE LIKE 'III%' OR STAGE LIKE 'IV%' OR STAGE LIKE '3%' OR STAGE LIKE '4%' ) , BILL AS (SELECT PBD_MRN MRN, 'Billed for Metastatic Disease' AS CATEG_NAME FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN NV ON NV.MRN = PBD_MRN WHERE (CLM_CLSF_CD >= '196' AND CLM_CLSF_CD <= '199') OR (CLM_CLSF_CD >= 'C77' AND CLM_CLSF_CD <= 'C79' ) ) SELECT MRN, CATEG_NAME FROM TUMOR UNION SELECT MRN, CATEG_NAME FROM PANC UNION SELECT MRN, CATEG_NAME FROM LUNG UNION SELECT MRN, CATEG_NAME FROM BILL

prompt: Provide monthly report of RRT/codes and ICU consults in Main, SDH and Koch PACU
completion: WITH PACU AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT UC_MRN, UC_TRANSFER_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY UC_ADM_NUM ORDER BY TIMESTAMP(UC_END_DTE, UC_END_TME) DESC) AS RANK, TIMESTAMP(UC_END_DTE, UC_END_TME) AS TIME_DEPART, UC_ADM_NUM, UC_NURS_STA, UC_BED FROM IDB.UNIFIED_CENSUS WHERE UC_END_DTE BETWEEN (CURRENT DATE - DAY(CURRENT DATE) DAYS + 1 DAY - 1 MONTH) AND (CURRENT DATE - DAY(CURRENT DATE) DAYS) AND UC_NURS_STA = 'M02' ) WHERE RANK=1 ) , ICU_CONSULT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_ADM_NUM, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_SERVICE_DT, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN PACU ON CDD_MRN = UC_MRN AND CDD_ADM_NUM = UC_ADM_NUM JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Initial Evaluation, Adult Team - Critical Care', 'Initial Evaluation, Adult Team-Critical Care') AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Reason for Call: Visit Initiated' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' ) , SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, OCV_ADM_NUM, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) SURGEON, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = OCV_ENC_CSN_ID AND SSE_MRN = OCV_MRN JOIN PACU ON OCV_ADM_NUM = UC_ADM_NUM AND SSE_MRN = UC_MRN JOIN ICU_CONSULT ON SSE_MRN = CDD_MRN AND OCV_ADM_NUM = CDD_ADM_NUM WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC <> 'DO NOT CODE' ) SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Patient Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "Patient First Name", VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND "IP/OP", TIME_DEPART "Date/Time SDH PACU Depart", UC_NURS_STA "Unit", UC_BED "Bed", CDO_VALUE_TEXT "Call Type", CDD_SERVICE_DT "Call Date/Time", SSE_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", LISTAGG(TRIM(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC), '; ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) "Surgery Name", SURGEON "Surgeon", SSP_SURG_SVC_CD "Surgery Svc" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN PACU ON PT_MRN = UC_MRN JOIN ICU_CONSULT ON UC_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_ADM_NUM = UC_ADM_NUM JOIN IDB.VISIT ON PT_MRN = VIS_MRN AND VIS_ADM_NUM = UC_ADM_NUM LEFT JOIN SRG ON PT_MRN = SSE_MRN AND CDD_ADM_NUM = OCV_ADM_NUM WHERE TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(CDD_SERVICE_DT - TIME_DEPART)) BETWEEN 0 AND 2880 GROUP BY PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND, TIME_DEPART, UC_NURS_STA, UC_BED, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, CDD_SERVICE_DT, SSE_SURG_DTE, SURGEON, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD ^ WITH PACU AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT UC_MRN, UC_TRANSFER_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY UC_ADM_NUM ORDER BY TIMESTAMP(UC_END_DTE, UC_END_TME) DESC) AS RANK, TIMESTAMP(UC_END_DTE, UC_END_TME) AS TIME_DEPART, UC_ADM_NUM, UC_NURS_STA, UC_BED FROM IDB.UNIFIED_CENSUS WHERE UC_END_DTE BETWEEN (CURRENT DATE - DAY(CURRENT DATE) DAYS + 1 DAY - 1 MONTH) AND (CURRENT DATE - DAY(CURRENT DATE) DAYS) AND UC_NURS_STA = 'M06' ) WHERE RANK=1 ) , ICU_CONSULT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_ADM_NUM, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_SERVICE_DT, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN PACU ON CDD_MRN = UC_MRN AND CDD_ADM_NUM = UC_ADM_NUM JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Initial Evaluation, Adult Team - Critical Care', 'Initial Evaluation, Adult Team-Critical Care') AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Reason for Call: Visit Initiated' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' ) , SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, OCV_ADM_NUM, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) SURGEON, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = OCV_ENC_CSN_ID AND SSE_MRN = OCV_MRN JOIN PACU ON OCV_ADM_NUM = UC_ADM_NUM AND SSE_MRN = UC_MRN JOIN ICU_CONSULT ON SSE_MRN = CDD_MRN AND OCV_ADM_NUM = CDD_ADM_NUM WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC <> 'DO NOT CODE' ) SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Patient Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "Patient First Name", VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND "IP/OP", TIME_DEPART "Date/Time SDH PACU Depart", UC_NURS_STA "Unit", UC_BED "Bed", CDO_VALUE_TEXT "Call Type", CDD_SERVICE_DT "Call Date/Time", SSE_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", LISTAGG(TRIM(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC), '; ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) "Surgery Name", SURGEON "Surgeon", SSP_SURG_SVC_CD "Surgery Svc" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN PACU ON PT_MRN = UC_MRN JOIN ICU_CONSULT ON UC_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_ADM_NUM = UC_ADM_NUM JOIN IDB.VISIT ON PT_MRN = VIS_MRN AND VIS_ADM_NUM = UC_ADM_NUM LEFT JOIN SRG ON PT_MRN = SSE_MRN AND CDD_ADM_NUM = OCV_ADM_NUM WHERE TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(CDD_SERVICE_DT - TIME_DEPART)) BETWEEN 0 AND 2880 GROUP BY PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND, TIME_DEPART, UC_NURS_STA, UC_BED, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, CDD_SERVICE_DT, SSE_SURG_DTE, SURGEON, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD ^ WITH PACU AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT UC_MRN, UC_TRANSFER_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY UC_ADM_NUM ORDER BY TIMESTAMP(UC_END_DTE, UC_END_TME) DESC) AS RANK, TIMESTAMP(UC_END_DTE, UC_END_TME) AS TIME_DEPART, UC_ADM_NUM, UC_NURS_STA, UC_BED FROM IDB.UNIFIED_CENSUS WHERE UC_END_DTE BETWEEN (CURRENT DATE - DAY(CURRENT DATE) DAYS + 1 DAY - 1 MONTH) AND (CURRENT DATE - DAY(CURRENT DATE) DAYS) AND UC_NURS_STA = 'K08' ) WHERE RANK=1 ) , ICU_CONSULT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_ADM_NUM, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_SERVICE_DT, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN PACU ON CDD_MRN = UC_MRN AND CDD_ADM_NUM = UC_ADM_NUM JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Initial Evaluation, Adult Team - Critical Care', 'Initial Evaluation, Adult Team-Critical Care') AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Reason for Call: Visit Initiated' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' ) , SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, OCV_ADM_NUM, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) SURGEON, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = OCV_ENC_CSN_ID AND SSE_MRN = OCV_MRN JOIN PACU ON OCV_ADM_NUM = UC_ADM_NUM AND SSE_MRN = UC_MRN JOIN ICU_CONSULT ON SSE_MRN = CDD_MRN AND OCV_ADM_NUM = CDD_ADM_NUM WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC <> 'DO NOT CODE' ) SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Patient Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "Patient First Name", VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND "IP/OP", TIME_DEPART "Date/Time SDH PACU Depart", UC_NURS_STA "Unit", UC_BED "Bed", CDO_VALUE_TEXT "Call Type", CDD_SERVICE_DT "Call Date/Time", SSE_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", LISTAGG(TRIM(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC), '; ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) "Surgery Name", SURGEON "Surgeon", SSP_SURG_SVC_CD "Surgery Svc" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN PACU ON PT_MRN = UC_MRN JOIN ICU_CONSULT ON UC_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_ADM_NUM = UC_ADM_NUM JOIN IDB.VISIT ON PT_MRN = VIS_MRN AND VIS_ADM_NUM = UC_ADM_NUM LEFT JOIN SRG ON PT_MRN = SSE_MRN AND CDD_ADM_NUM = OCV_ADM_NUM WHERE TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(CDD_SERVICE_DT - prompt: Provide a list of DLBCL patients who received Bretuximab Vedotin at MSK.
completion: WITH LYM AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY1 = 'Lymphoma' JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9679/3', 'M9680/3', 'M9681/3', 'M9688/3', 'M9714/3', 'M9738/3') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C83.30', 'C83.31', 'C83.32', 'C83.33', 'C83.34', 'C83.35', 'C83.36', 'C83.37', 'C83.38', 'C83.39') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , CTE AS (SELECT MRN AS DX_MRN, DX_DATE, STRIP(DX_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(DX_DESC) AS DX_CODE FROM LYM) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(6000))||' | '||CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(100))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN, RN, DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) , APR AS (SELECT APR_MRN, DX, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_SET_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS APR_START_DTE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS APR_END_DTE, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM (SELECT APR_MRN, DX, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC, APR_SET_NAME FROM T4 JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON MRN = APR_MRN WHERE(UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%BRENTUXIMAB VEDOTIN%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%BRENTUXIMAB VEDOTIN%') UNION SELECT APR_MRN, '' AS DX, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC, APR_SET_NAME FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE(UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%BRENTUXIMAB VEDOTIN%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%BRENTUXIMAB VEDOTIN%') AND(UPPER(APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC) LIKE '%DIFFUSE%' OR UPPER(APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC) LIKE '%DLBCL%' OR UPPER(APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC) LIKE '%LARGE%B%CELL%')) CH GROUP BY APR_MRN, DX, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_SET_NAME, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC ) , DX_MIN AS (SELECT APR_MRN AS MRN, MAX(DX) AS DX1 FROM APR GROUP BY APR_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, DX1, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_SET_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM APR JOIN DX_MIN ON APR_MRN = MRN

prompt: Would like to see Thoracic Surgery outpatient APP clinic volume for independent, shared, and total visits. Delineation between in-person and telehealth as well.
completion: WITH CDD AS (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME DOC_NAME, CDD_MRN MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE SVC_DTE, OCV_IP_OP_IND IP_OP_IND , CDD_SERVICE_DT SERVICE_DT, TRIM(ATH.OP_DISPLAY_NAME)||' - '||ATH.OP_TASK_ROLE_TYPE AUTHOR_NAME , MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_USER_GUID <> CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID AND TRIM(SHR.OP_DISPLAY_NAME) NOT LIKE 'System%' THEN TRIM(SHR.OP_DISPLAY_NAME)||' - '||SHR.OP_TASK_ROLE_TYPE END) COAUTHOR_NAME , MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM) LIKE '%TELE%' AND LENGTH(TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT)) > 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) TELEVISIT_FLAG , CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM) LIKE '%TELE%' AND LENGTH(TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT)) > 1 OR UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE 'TELE%' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) = 'Y' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END IN_PERSON_FLAG , CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_USER_GUID <> CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID AND TRIM(SHR.OP_DISPLAY_NAME) NOT LIKE 'System%' THEN TRIM(SHR.OP_DISPLAY_NAME)||' - '||SHR.OP_TASK_ROLE_TYPE END) IS NOT NULL THEN 'Shared' ELSE 'Independent' END VISIT_TYPE , CASE WHEN ATH.OP_TASK_ROLE_TYPE IN ('NP', 'PA') THEN TRIM(ATH.OP_DISPLAY_NAME)||' - '||ATH.OP_TASK_ROLE_TYPE ELSE MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_USER_GUID <> CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID AND TRIM(SHR.OP_DISPLAY_NAME) NOT LIKE 'System%' THEN TRIM(SHR.OP_DISPLAY_NAME)||' - '||SHR.OP_TASK_ROLE_TYPE END) END PROVIDER_NAME FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ATH ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = ATH.OP_PVDR_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER SHR ON CDO_USER_GUID = SHR.OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'O' WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME NOT LIKE '%Vital Sign%' AND CDD_DOC_NAME NOT LIKE 'Contin%Infusion%' AND CDD_DOC_NAME NOT LIKE '%Donor%' AND CDD_DOC_NAME NOT LIKE 'Operative Report%' AND CDD_DOC_NAME NOT IN ('I & O Flowsheet', 'Death Note') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' AND(CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID IN ('1000005564119029', '9001071188501190', '1444119001', '3000003557119029', '9000292779501190') OR(CDO_USER_GUID IN ('1000005564119029', '9001071188501190', '1444119001', '3000003557119029', '9000292779501190') AND CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID <> CDO_USER_GUID)) GROUP BY CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, OCV_IP_OP_IND, TRIM(ATH.OP_DISPLAY_NAME), ATH.OP_TASK_ROLE_TYPE, CDD_SERVICE_DT) , CDDFNL AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, DOC_NAME, MRN, SVC_DTE, SERVICE_DT, IP_OP_IND, PROVIDER_NAME, AUTHOR_NAME, COAUTHOR_NAME, IN_PERSON_FLAG, TELEVISIT_FLAG, VISIT_TYPE , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PROVIDER_NAME, MRN, SVC_DTE ORDER BY IN_PERSON_FLAG DESC, DOC_GUID, TELEVISIT_FLAG DESC) RN FROM CDD) SELECT PROVIDER_NAME, COUNT(CASE WHEN VISIT_TYPE = 'Independent' THEN DOC_GUID END) TOTAL_INDEPENDENT_VISITS , COUNT(CASE WHEN VISIT_TYPE = 'Shared' THEN DOC_GUID END) TOTAL_SHARED_VISITS , COUNT(CASE WHEN IN_PERSON_FLAG = 'Y' THEN DOC_GUID END) TOTAL_IN_PERSON_VISITS , COUNT(CASE WHEN IN_PERSON_FLAG = 'N' THEN DOC_GUID END) TOTAL_NOT_PERSON_VISITS , COUNT(CASE WHEN TELEVISIT_FLAG = 'Y' THEN DOC_GUID END) TOTAL_TELEVISITS , COUNT(*) TOTAL_VISITS FROM CDDFNL WHERE RN = 1 GROUP BY PROVIDER_NAME

ON OO_ORD_GUID = OSH_ORD_GUID AND OSH_FUNCTION_CD = '105' LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND OO_MRN = VIS_MRN AND OSH_CREATE_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DTE, OSH_CREATE_DTE) WHERE OSH_CREATE_DTE BETWEEN '2018-09-01' AND '2018-09-30' AND OO_ORD_TYPE_CD = 'Diagnostic' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT = 'Laboratory' ) , PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, "Patient Type", "Order Release Date", "Order Release Time", DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY OO_MRN, "Patient Type", "Order Release Date" ORDER BY "Order Release Time") RN FROM PTS_RAW) SELECT OO_MRN, "Patient Type", "Order Release Date", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN "Order Release Time" END) "Order Release Time 1", MAX(CASE Release Time" END) "Order Release Time 12", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 13 THEN "Order Release Time" END) "Order Release Time 13", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 14 THEN "Order Release Time" END) "Order Release Time 14", '||DX1.CDX_DX_NAME DX1 , STRIP(CASE WHEN DX2.CDX_ICD9 > ' ' THEN DX2.CDX_ICD9 ELSE DX2.CDX_ICD10 END)||' - '||DX2.CDX_DX_NAME DX2 FROM SRG JOIN IDB.OR_CASE ON OC_CASE_ID = LOGID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_DX_CODES LN1 ON LN1.OCD_CASE_ID = OC_CASE_ID AND LN1.OCD_LINE_NO = 1 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DX DX1 ON DX1.CDX_DX_ID = LN1.OCD_DX_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_DX_CODES LN2 ON LN2.OCD_CASE_ID = OC_CASE_ID AND LN2.OCD_LINE_NO = 2 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DX DX2 ON DX2.CDX_DX_ID = LN2.OCD_DX_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ANES_TYPES ON OLAT_LOG_ID = LOGID) SELECT DISTINCT LOGID, MRN , PT_NAME, DOB, SVC, SURG_DTE , PRIMARY_SURGEON, LOCATION , CPT_CD, CPT_DESC, PNL_NO , PROCEDURE_NAME, ASST_SURG_ROLE, ASST_SURG_NAME, DX1, DX2 FROM SRG LEFT JOIN ASST ON LOGID = OLAS_LOG_ID AND PNL_NO = OLAS_PNL_NO LEFT JOIN DX ON LOGID = OC_CASE_ID

WITH CTE AS (SELECT CC_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, PT_RACE_DESC, PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C25') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN 2016 AND 2020 GROUP BY CC_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, PT_RACE_DESC, PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC) , APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CASE WHEN UPPER(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1) = 'REG' THEN 'REG' ELSE 'MAIN' END REG_FLAG FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN CTE ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') ) , DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CASE WHEN YEAR(DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) > 89 THEN '90 or Over' ELSE CAST(YEAR(DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS VARCHAR(2)) END AS AGE, PT_SEX, PT_RACE_DESC, PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC, YEAR(DX_DTE) DX_YEAR, REG_FLAG FROM CTE LEFT JOIN APPT ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN) SELECT DX_YEAR, PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT CC_MRN) COUNT FROM DX GROUP BY DX_YEAR, PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC

prompt: This is a project looking at genomics of spine RT in colorectal cancer. We need IMPACT data on patients with rectal cancer (C19, C20) or colon cancer (C18.2, 18.3, 18.4, 18.5, 18.6, 18.7, 18.8, 18.9) who also have metastatic disease to bone (C79.51)
Breast cancer patients with no prior treatments who are 50 and older
completion: WITH PT AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN PRIOR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX WHERE APR_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' UNION SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN PRIOR_MRN FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE UNION SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN PRIOR_MRN FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') UNION SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN PRIOR_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('Z92.21', 'V87.41', 'Z92.3', 'V15.3') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) , CTE AS (SELECT CC_MRN MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C50') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_MRN NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT PRIOR_MRN FROM PT) GROUP BY CC_MRN HAVING MIN(YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE)) >= 2019 UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN, MIN(TM_DX_DTE) DX_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C50%' AND TM_MRN NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT PRIOR_MRN FROM PT) AND TM_HIST_CD NOT IN ('M8500/2', 'M8503/2') AND YEAR(TM_DX_DTE) >= 2019 GROUP BY TM_MRN ) , COMBINED AS (SELECT MRN, MIN(DX_DTE) DX_DTE FROM CTE GROUP BY MRN) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR(DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE, DX_DTE FROM COMBINED JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN WHERE YEAR(DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 50 AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL ) , SCH AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CRE_RES_TYP FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN DX ON MRN = CPE_MRN AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP ) , SCHB AS (SELECT SCH.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) ROWNUM FROM SCH) , PROTOCOL AS (SELECT AC_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE, AC_IRB_NO, PRO_IRB_TITLE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN IDB.PROTOCOL ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN DX ON AC_MRN = MRN) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", AGE "Age at Dx", DX_DTE "Diagnosis Date", CPE_ENC_DTE "Next Appt Date", "Department Name", "Provider Name", AC_IRB_NO "IRB No", AC_CONS_DTE "Consent Date", PRO_IRB_TITLE "IRB Title" FROM DX LEFT JOIN SCHB ON MRN = CPE_MRN AND ROWNUM = 1 LEFT JOIN PROTOCOL ON MRN = AC_MRN ORDER BY MRN DESC

prompt: Provide a report on the specified Follicular Lymphoma patients who have had IMPACT testing.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, GENE, RESULT, METHOD FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE METHOD LIKE '%IMPACT%' AND PT_MRN IN () - WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS WHERE PT_MRN IN () ) , DMP AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession No", MAINPRC.DT_DTE AS "Procedure Date", RTRIM(SUBSTR(CAST(MAINPATH.PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(32000)), POSITION('PHYSICIAN:', UPPER(MAINPATH.PRPT_REPORT), CODEUNITS32) + 11, POSITION('ACCESSION', UPPER(MAINPATH.PRPT_REPORT), CODEUNITS32) - POSITION('PHYSICIAN:', UPPER(MAINPATH.PRPT_REPORT), CODEUNITS32) - 11)) AS "Physician", PDWS_DESCRIPTION, T.* FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V MAINPATH ON MAINPATH.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V MAINPRC ON MAINPRC.DT_DATE_ID = MAINPATH.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS CNV_TYPE VARCHAR(500) PATH 'name()', VARIANT_CLASS VARCHAR(100) PATH 'variant_class', SITE1_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site1_gene', SITE2_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site2_gene', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', EXON_NUM VARCHAR(100) PATH 'exon_num', AA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'aa_change', NORMAL_VFREQ VARCHAR(100) PATH 'normal_vfreq', TUMOR_VFREQ VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_vfreq', MAFREQ_1000G VARCHAR(100) PATH 'mafreq_1000g', CHROMOSOME VARCHAR(100) PATH 'chromosome', CDNA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'cDNA_change', GENE_FOLD_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_fold_change', NORMAL_DP VARCHAR(100) PATH 'normal_dp', TUMOR_DP VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_dp', NORMAL_AD VARCHAR(100) PATH 'normal_ad', TUMOR_AD VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_ad', START_POSITION int PATH 'start_position', ALT_ALLELE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'alt_allele', REF_ALLELE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'ref_allele', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'variant_type', PROJECT VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_alys_task_name', SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id') T WHERE 1=1 AND PDWS_NAME IN ('IMPACT - HEME', 'IMPACT') AND PT_MRN IN (SELECT PT_MRN FROM X) ) , CONSENT_09_141 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE AS "09-141 Consent Date", AC_OFF_STUDY_DTE AS "09-141 Off Date" FROM X JOIN DV.ACCRUALS ACC_1 ON ACC_1.AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PID JOIN DV.PROTOCOL PRO_1 ON PRO_1.PRO_PROTOCOL_ID = ACC_1.AC_PROTOCOL_ID AND PRO_1.PRO_IRB_NO = '09-141') , CONSENT_06_107 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE AS "06-107 Consent Date", AC_OFF_STUDY_DTE AS "06-107 Off Date" FROM X JOIN DV.ACCRUALS ACC_1 ON ACC_1.AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PID JOIN DV.PROTOCOL PRO_1 ON PRO_1.PRO_PROTOCOL_ID = ACC_1.AC_PROTOCOL_ID AND PRO_1.PRO_IRB_NO = '06-107') , CONSENT_12_245 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE AS "12-245 Consent Date", AC_OFF_STUDY_DTE AS "12-245 Off Date" FROM X JOIN DV.ACCRUALS ACC_1 ON ACC_1.AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PID JOIN DV.PROTOCOL PRO_1 ON PRO_1.PRO_PROTOCOL_ID = ACC_1.AC_PROTOCOL_ID AND PRO_1.PRO_IRB_NO = '12-245') , MAIN AS (SELECT DMP.* , "09-141 Consent Date" , "09-141 Off Date" , "06-107 Consent Date" , "06-107 Off Date" , "12-245 Consent Date" , "12-245 Off Date" FROM DMP LEFT JOIN CONSENT_06_107 ON DMP.PT_MRN = CONSENT_06_107.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN CONSENT_09_141 ON DMP.PT_MRN = CONSENT_09_141.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN CONSENT_12_245 ON DMP.PT_MRN = CONSENT_12_245.PT_MRN) SELECT * FROM MAIN ORDER BY PT_MRN, "Accession No", GENE_ID

prompt: we are reviewing feasibility for a new research study and will need to pull the number of patients seen in 2021 that have hormone receptor low (HR 1-9%) status and metastatic Triple Negative Breast Cancer.
completion: WITH CHT AS (SELECT CHT_COHORT_ID FROM DVCMS.COHORT WHERE CHT_COHORT_ID = 9431) , PTS AS (SELECT CHP_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID, PT_MRN AS CHT_MRN, CHT_COHORT_ID, DATE(CHP_CREATED_DT) AS ID_DATE, DAYS(CURRENT date) - DAYS(CHP_CREATED_DT) AS DAYS_ON_COHORT FROM DVCMS.COHORT_PATIENT JOIN CHT ON CHP_COHORT_ID = CHT_COHORT_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON CHP_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID ) SELECT PT_MRN, P_ID, PT_SEX, PT_VITAL_STATUS, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_DEATH_DTE , PLA_LAST_DRVST_DTE, PLA_LAST_CHEMO_DTE, PLA_LAST_RT_DTE, PLA_LAST_SURG_DTE, PLA_LAST_TX_DTE FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN PTS ON P_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = P_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PLA_LAST_DRVST_DTE >= CURRENT date - 1 YEAR

prompt: Schedule a weekly report of the MSK Engage import fields in the Initial Visit, AMB - Surgery-Gastric and Mixed Tumor and Pre-Visit EPACS - Surgery notes in GMT.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(CDD_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", STRIP(CDD_DOC_NAME) AS "Document Name", CASE WHEN CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = 1 THEN 'Y' END AS "Incomplete Note", STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO1.CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) AS "Service", STRIP(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) AS "Author Name", STRIP(OCV_PVDR_NAME) AS "Provider Name", CDO2.CDO_SECTION, CDO2.CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO2.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO2.CDO_ITEM_NAME, REPLACE(STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO2.CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 2000)), CHR(13) || CHR(10), '') AS VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = CDD_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION CDO1 ON CDO1.CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO1.CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO1.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('DOS_SERVICE_RES', 'DOS_EPACS_Services RES') AND(STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO1.CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) like '%GMT%' OR UPPER(STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO1.CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200))) like '%GASTRIC%MIXED TUMOR%') JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION CDO2 ON CDO2.CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO2.CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO2.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('Engage_Survey_Date_FT', 'Engage_Survey_Name_FT', 'engage_import_survey_data_RES') WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND(CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE '%Initial Visit%AMB%Surgery%Gastric and Mixed Tumor%' OR CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Pre-Visit EPACS - Surgery') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 7 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY ) , Y AS (SELECT MRN, "Name", CDD_DOC_GUID, "Service Date", "Document Name", "Incomplete Note", "Service", "Author Name", "Provider Name", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'engage_import_survey_data_RES' THEN STRIP(VALUE_TEXT) END) AS "Engage import", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Engage_Survey_Name_FT' THEN STRIP(VALUE_TEXT) END) AS "Survey Name", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Engage_Survey_Date_FT' THEN STRIP(VALUE_TEXT) END) AS "Survey Date" FROM X GROUP BY MRN, "Name", CDD_DOC_GUID, "Service Date", "Document Name", "Incomplete Note", "Service", "Author Name", "Provider Name") SELECT * FROM Y WHERE "Survey Name" <> '' OR "Survey Date" <> '' OR "Engage import" <> ''

prompt: Need #s for past 5 years of how many patients seen at the RISE program ages 18-42 with any genetic mutations and what mutations(BRCA1/BRCA2/mutations)
completion: WITH APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, YEAR(COALESCE(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, CURRENT DATE) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, CPE_ENC_DTE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN AND YEAR(COALESCE(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, CURRENT DATE) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 18 AND 42 WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2019-01-01' AND UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) like '%RISE%' ) SELECT YEAR(PATH_RPT_DATE) AS PATH_REPORT_YEAR, COUNT(PT_MRN) AS PATIENT_COUNT, GENE AS GENE_TYPE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN APPT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN AND PATH_RPT_DATE >= '2019-01-01' GROUP BY YEAR(PATH_RPT_DATE), GENE ORDER BY YEAR(PATH_RPT_DATE);

prompt: Provide a list of patients with adnexal skin carcinomas that have been treated with radiotherapy.
completion: WITH PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME, UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT, CASE WHEN LOCATE('BUSAM', UPPER(PRPT_REPORT)) > 0 THEN 'Y' END AS "Busam", CASE WHEN LOCATE('PULITZER', UPPER(PRPT_REPORT)) > 0 THEN 'Y' END AS "Pulitzer", CASE WHEN LOCATE('HOLLMANN', UPPER(PRPT_REPORT)) > 0 THEN 'Y' END AS "Hollmann", CASE WHEN LOCATE('MOY', UPPER(PRPT_REPORT)) > 0 THEN 'Y' END AS "Moy", CASE WHEN LOCATE('LEZCANO', UPPER(PRPT_REPORT)) > 0 THEN 'Y' END AS "Lezcano" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" WHERE 1=1 AND "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" LIKE '%Surgical Pathology%' AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("Mucinous carcinoma" | "Tubular carcinoma" | "Porocarcinoma" | "Hidradenocarcinoma" | "Cylindrocarcinoma" | "Eccrine" | "Spiradenocarcinoma" | "Adnexal" | "Microcystic" | "Apocrine" | "Sebaceous" | "Sweat" | "Syringoma")') = 1 AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '( "Busam" | "Pulitzer" | "Hollmann" | "Moy" | "Lezcano" )') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL ) , RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN PATH ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN) SELECT DISTINCT PATH.* FROM PATH JOIN RT ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN

prompt: Provide a list of internal data for completed Neurosurgery new visits.

prompt: we are looking to see our success rate on consenting patients to 06-107 prior to surgery.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT OC_SURG_DTE SURGERY_DATE, OC_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME , OP_PROC_NAME PROCEDURE_NAME, MD.CRE_RES_NAME SURGEON , CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO IS NOT NULL THEN AC_CONS_DTE END "Consent Date IRB 06-107" , CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END "IRB 06-107" FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OC_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE MD ON OCAS_RES_ID = MD.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID AND(OCP_LINE_NO = 1 OR OCAS_SURG_SVC <> 'PLA') LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = OC_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' WHERE OC_SURG_DTE > CURRENT date AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND OCAS_SURG_SVC = 'BRE' AND OCP_LINE_NO = 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT SURGERY_DATE, MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME , PROCEDURE_NAME, SURGEON, "Consent Date IRB 06-107", "IRB 06-107" , EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE SURGERY_CONSENT_DATE , EADT_EMR_DESC SRG_CONSENT_DOC_NAME , DOC_STATUS , MD_NAME, MD_TYPE , DEPT, CENTER FROM CTE LEFT JOIN (SELECT EAD_MRN, EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE, SURGERY_DATE SRG_DTE, EAD_CREATE_DTE, EADT_CATEGORY, EAD_DOCTYPE, EADT_EMR_DESC, 'AUTHORIZED' AS DOC_STATUS, CRE_RES_NAME MD_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP AS MD_TYPE, CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT, CLD_CLD_CENTER CENTER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY EAD_MRN ORDER BY DAYS(SURGERY_DATE)- DAYS(EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE)) RN FROM CTE JOIN IDB.EMR_AA_DOCUMENT ON MRN = EAD_MRN JOIN IDB.EMR_AA_DOCTYPE ON EAD_DOCTYPE = EADT_DOCTYPE LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON EAD_MRN = CPE_MRN AND EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE = CPE_ENC_DTE AND UPPER(CPE_CPE_APPT_STS) IN ('ARRIVED', 'COMP') JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE VALUE(EAD_RIGHT_ID, EADT_RIGHT_ID) = 167 AND EAD_DOCTYPE = 'A29' AND EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE >= SURGERY_DATE - 28 DAYS ) AS A ON EAD_MRN = MRN AND SURGERY_DATE = SRG_DTE AND RN = 1 ;

prompt: Build a Tableau dashboard to manage transfer appointments between NYC and Network Site
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS CTE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS CTE_ENC_DTE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS CTE_SERVICE, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS CTE_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME AS CTE_PROVIDER FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' ) , APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID AS "Encounter ID", CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", TRIM(CLD_CLD_CENTER) AS "Center", TRIM(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8) AS "Service", TRIM(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS "Department Name", TRIM(CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Provider Name", TRIM(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Visit Type", TRIM(CPE_CPE_APPT_STS) AS "Status", CTE_ENC_DTE AS "Previous Appt", TRIM(CTE_DEPT_NAME) AS "Previous Dept", TRIM(CTE_PROVIDER) AS "Previous Provider", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE ORDER BY ABS(DAYS(CPE_ENC_DTE) - DAYS(CTE_ENC_DTE))) AS ROW_NUMBER FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN CTE ON CPE_MRN = CTE_MRN AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = CTE_SERVICE AND CTE_ENC_DTE < CPE_ENC_DTE WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) >= 2019 AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR = 'TFX' ) SELECT "Encounter ID", "MRN", "Appt Date", "Center", "Service", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", "Status", "Previous Appt", "Previous Dept", "Previous Provider" FROM APPT WHERE ROW_NUMBER = 1

prompt: Provide data on post-op ileus (POI) rates at MSK for colorectal surgery service.
Updated SUR18979 including patients scheduled to start BCG 2 weeks away, included  patient's treating physician from Surgery/Urology.
completion: WITH CHEMO AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN , STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)|| ', ' ||PT_FIRST_NAME AS PATIENT_NAME , MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS NEXT_APPT_DTE , REF.CRE_RES_NAME TREATING_MD FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VT ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = VT.CRE_RES_ID AND VT.CRE_RES_TYP = 'Chemotherapy Unit' LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF ON REF.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_REF_RES_ID AND REF.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT X ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPA_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ JOIN IDB.CL_PT_CHEMO ON CPA_CL_PT_ID = CPC_CL_PT_ID AND CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPC_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND CPC_CHEMO_ID IN (88, 552, 634, 1572) JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date + 3 DAYS AND CURRENT date + 17 DAYS AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 AND CPE_MRN NOT IN (SELECT APR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN('BCG', 'BEC2-KLH/BCG,BCG')) GROUP BY CPE_MRN , STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)|| ', ' ||PT_FIRST_NAME , REF.CRE_RES_NAME) , CLINTRAC AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN CHEMO ON MRN = CC_MRN WHERE (SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) = 'C67' OR CC_CLSF_CD IN ('D09.0', 'D41.4', 'D49.4', 'C79.1', 'C79.11')) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) , TUMOR AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN CHEMO ON MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') WHERE SUBSTR(TM_SITE_CD, 1, 3) = 'C67' ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PATIENT_NAME, NEXT_APPT_DTE, TREATING_MD FROM CHEMO LEFT JOIN CLINTRAC ON MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN TUMOR ON MRN = TM_MRN WHERE CC_MRN IS NOT NULL OR TM_MRN IS NOT NULL ORDER BY NEXT_APPT_DTE;

prompt: Provide data on patients who underwent ultrasound guided biopsies and endorectal MRI.
completion: SELECT PBD_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PBC_CPT_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, PBD_SVC_DTE FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('55700', '55705', 'C1710', 'G0416', 'G0417', 'G0418', 'G0419') AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2005-01-01' AND '2010-12-31' AND PT_SEX = 'M' UNION ALL SELECT PBD_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PBC_CPT_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, PBD_SVC_DTE FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('72195', '72196', '72197') AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN IDB.SRG_ADVERSE_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SAE_MRN = SSE_MRN AND SAE_SURG_LOG_ID = SSE_LOG_ID JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('55700', '55705', 'C1710', 'G0416', 'G0417', 'G0418', 'G0419') AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2005-01-01' AND '2010-12-31' AND PT_SEX = 'M' ) AS A ON SSE_MRN = PBD_MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE = PBD_SVC_DTE WITH CTE AS (SELECT PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('55700', '55705', 'C1710', 'G0416', 'G0417', 'G0418', 'G0419') AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2005-01-01' AND '2010-12-31' AND PT_SEX = 'M' UNION SELECT PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('72195', '72196', '72197') AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2005-01-01' AND '2010-12-31' AND PT_SEX = 'M' ) SELECT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, CC_EFF_DTE, CASE WHEN (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS CIC_CODED FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN CTE ON CC_MRN = PBD_MRN
