', '038.42 ', '038.43 ', '038.44 ', '038.49 ', '038.8 ', '038.9 ', '054.5 ', '098.12 ', '098.32 ', '131.03 ', '599.7 ', '599.70 ', '599.71 ', '599.72 ', '601 ', '601.0 ', '601.1 ', '601.4 ', '601.9 ', '604 ', '604.9 ', '604.90 ', '604.99 ', '608.82 ', '569.3 ')

prompt: Provide PHI for a DAVInCI query on travel patients seen 2004-2009.
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT * FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES WHERE ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' ) , "cte2" AS (SELECT EDC_DEPT_ABBREV, EDC_DEPT_DESC FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG WHERE EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS' ) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t2"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Encounter Date", "t4"."ENVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME" AS "Visit Type Name", "t5"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" AS "Generic Drug Name", "t6"."DT_DTE" AS "Dispense Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER" "t7" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t3" ON "t7"."PENC_ENC_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE" "t4" ON "t7"."PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID" = "t4"."ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t8" ON "t7"."PENC_PT_ENC_ID" = "t8"."ENSR_PT_ENC_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE" "t9" ON "t8"."ENSR_RES_ID" = "t9"."ENR_ENC_RES_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte2" "t10" ON "t7"."PENC_APPT_STS" = "t10"."EDC_DEPT_ABBREV" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t11" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t11"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t5" ON "t11"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t5"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t12" ON "t11"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t12"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t11"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t12"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DISPENSE_OCCR" "t13" ON "t12"."POD_PHARMA_ORDER_DETAIL_ID" = "t13"."PDO_PHARMA_ORDER_DETAIL_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t6" ON "t13"."PDO_DISPNS_DATE_ID" = "t6"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE ("t9"."ENR_RES_NAME" IN ('SHAH, MONIKA K', 'ZUCCOTTI, GIANNA') AND ("t10"."EDC_DEPT_DESC" IN ('Arrived', 'Completed') AND ("t3"."DT_DTE" >= '2004-1-1' AND ("t4"."ENVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME" NOT IN ('ID1275 LONG TERM FR') AND ("t5"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" IN ('HEPATITIS A VAC (PEDIATRIC)', 'HEPATITIS A VACCINE (ADULT)', 'HEPATITIS A VIRUS VAC(PED)', 'Hepatitis A Vaccine, Inactivated', 'TYPHOID VACC VI CAPSU POLYSACC', 'TYPHOID VACCINE', 'Typhoid Polysaccharide Vaccine') AND "t6"."DT_DTE" >= '2004-1-1')))))

prompt: A list of H-case numbers with "TET2" AND "SF3B1" AND ("myeloid neoplasms" OR "MDS" OR "MPN" OR "MDS/MPN" OR "CMML" OR "AML") mentioned in report text from 01/01/2013 to present.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT DMP.PRPT_MRN AS MRN , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_VITAL_STATUS, PT_DEATH_DTE , CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) END AS "Current Age" , DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession No" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Report Date" , DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS "Procedure Date" , SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS RELATED_ACC_NO , SRG_DATE.DT_DTE AS RELATED_PROC_DTE , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS "Report Type" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)diag[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', DMP.PRPT_REPORT) AS DIAGNOSIS_TEXT , VARCHAR(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "Report Text (first 32000 characters)" , (SELECT VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXTFROM FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT WHERE PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V DMP LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_REFERENCES ON PRPTR_CHILD_PATH_RPT_ID = DMP.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT SRG ON SRG.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPTR_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V SRG_DATE ON SRG_DATE.DT_DATE_ID = SRG.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = DMP.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'H%' AND (DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '01/01/2013' OR DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE >= '01/01/2013' ) AND CONTAINS(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, '("TET2" AND "SF3B1" AND ("myeloid neoplasms" OR "MDS" OR "MPN" OR "MDS/MPN" OR "CMML" OR "AML"))') = 1 AND DMP.PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1, 9, 8 ;

prompt: Provide a list of pediatric patients who died between January 2019 and January 2021.
completion: WITH PED_PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PED' AND (PT_DATE_OF_DEATH BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2021-01-01') ) , APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN , COUNT , "Service" , AV_DESC , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY COUNT DESC) RANK FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN , COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) AS COUNT , CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service" , AV_DESC FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = AV_CODE AND AV_ELEMENT = 'HOSP_SVC' JOIN PED_PTS ON CPE_MRN = MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, AV_DESC) A GROUP BY CPE_MRN , COUNT , "Service" , AV_DESC) SELECT DISTINCT PT.PT_MRN, PT.PT_FIRST_NAME, PT.PT_LAST_NAME, PT.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT.PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, INTEGER((DAYS(PT.PT_DATE_OF_DEATH) - DAYS(PT.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH)) / 365) AGE_OF_DEATH, PT.PT_ADDR1, PT.PT_ADDR2, PT.PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS, PT.PT_PHONE, PT.PT_PHONE, "Service" FROM PED_PTS JOIN IDB.PATIENT PT ON PED_PTS.MRN = PT.PT_MRN JOIN IDB.VISIT V ON PT.PT_MRN = V.VIS_MRN LEFT JOIN APPTS ON PED_PTS.MRN = CPE_MRN AND RANK = 1 WHERE VIS_ADM_DTE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY PT.PT_MRN ;

prompt: Need MRNs for rare tumor tailgut cyst from 1/1/2000-5/31/2022
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN "MRN" , PT_BIRTH_DTE "DATE OF BIRTH" , PT_DEATH_DTE "DATE OF DEATH" , PT_RACE_DESC "RACE" , CORE_ETHNICITY_DESC "ETHNICITY" , PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "PROCEDURE DATE" , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "ACCESSION NUMBER" , PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC "REPORT TYPE DESC" , CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(24000)) AS "REPORT TEXT" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("Tailgut")') = 1 AND (PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE) BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2021-05-31' ; SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN "MRN" , PT_BIRTH_DTE "DATE OF BIRTH" , PT_DEATH_DTE "DATE OF DEATH" , PT_RACE_DESC "RACE" , CORE_ETHNICITY_DESC "ETHNICITY" , PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "PROCEDURE DATE" , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "ACCESSION NUMBER" , PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC "REPORT TYPE DESC" , CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(24000)) AS "REPORT TEXT" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("Tailgut")') = 1 AND (PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE) BETWEEN '2004-01-01' AND '2021-05-31' ; WITH MAIN AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('Q85.9', 'Q85.89', 'Q85.83', 'Q85.82', 'Q85.81', 'Q85.8', 'Q85.1', 'Q85.09', 'Q85.03', 'Q85.02', 'Q85.01', 'Q85.00', 'Q85.0', 'Q85', 'C41.4', 'K62.89', '569.42', '569.49', '170.6', '237.70', '237.71', '237.72', '237.70', '237.73', '237.79', '759.5', '759.6') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING (MIN(CC_EFF_DTE)) BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2021-05-31') SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN "MRN" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DATE OF BIRTH" , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "DATE OF DEATH" , TRIM(R.AV_DESC) "RACE" , TRIM(E.AV_DESC) "ETHNICITY" , DX_DATE "DIAGNOSIS DATE" , DX_CODE "DIAGNOSIS CODE" , DX_DESC "DIAGNOSIS DESC" FROM MAIN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' ; SELECT SSE_MRN "MRN" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DATE OF BIRTH" , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "DATE OF DEATH" , SSE_SURG_DTE "SURGERY DATE" , SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD "CPT CODE" , SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC "CPT DESC" , TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM)||', '||TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) "SURGEON NAME" , SSP_SURG_SVC_CD "SURGERY SERVICE CODE" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('49215', '27080') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2021-05-31' ;

prompt: Patient data from the Breast Surgery follow up and initial visit ClinDocs.
completion: SELECT CDD_MRN AS "MRN", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Provider", CDO_SECTION "Section", CDO_ITEM_NAME "Item", CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Value" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2023-04-18' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Follow Up – Breast Surgery', 'Follow Up, AMB - Breast Surgery' , 'xInitial Consult/Initial Visit - Breast Surgery') AND ((UPPER(CDO_SECTION) IN ('ASSESSMENT', 'CHIEF COMPLAINT', 'PAST MEDICAL & SURGICAL HISTORY', 'GENETIC TESTING', 'xADJUVANT TREATMENT', 'IMPRESSION & PLAN', 'xFIRST PRIMARY BREAST CANCER') AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Radiation Therapy Start Date', 'Radiation Therapy Stop Date', 'Radiation Therapy', 'Radiation Therapy Laterality', 'Radiation Therapy Sites', 'Rad Therapy stop date', 'Rad Therapy start date', 'Date of Surgical Completion', 'chemo neoadjuvant or adjuvant', 'Regimen:', 'Regimen', 'BRS_FU_Laterality ob', 'Chemotherapy:', 'Endocrine Therapy Regimen', '# nodes', 'T:', 'N:', 'M:', 'Out of Total Nodes Removed:', 'Total Nodes Removed:', 'systemic treatment primary', 'Systemic Therapy', 'Pt diagnosed with distant metastasis', 'Genetic Tests')) OR UPPER(CDO_SECTION) IN ('ADJUVANT TREATMENT', 'FIRST PRIMARY BREAST CANCER'))

prompt: Provide a monthly list of inpatient and outpatient procedures performed (excluding BMM, Anesthesia Services) and presence/absence of Brief Op Note and Operative Report.
completion: WITH SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME)||','||TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, SSE_PT_TYPE, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM)||','||TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) AS SURGEON_NAME, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 31 DAY AND CURRENT DATE -1 DAY AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD NOT IN ('ANES', 'BMM') ), BOP AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS OP_NOTE_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DT AS OP_NOTE_DATE, CDD_SIGNED_DT AS BOP_SIGNED_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME AS OP_NOTE_DOC_NAME, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)Primary:[\w\W]*(?=Procedure Details:)', UPPER(CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT)) AS "Provider" FROM SURG JOIN DV.CLINDOC_FULL_TEXT_V ON SSE_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE 'BRIEF OPERATIVE NOTE%' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE = SSE_SURG_DTE ) , OPR AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS OP_REPORT_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DT AS OP_REPORT_DATE, CDD_SIGNED_DT AS OP_SIGNED_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME AS OP_REPORT_DOC_NAME FROM SURG JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON SSE_MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE 'OPERATIVE REPORT%' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE = SSE_SURG_DTE ) , POR AS (SELECT DISTINCT PATIENT_MRN, CASE_OPERATING_ROOM_ABRV, TOES_OUT_TIME_ACTUAL FROM SURG JOIN IDB.PERIOP_CASE_EVENT_V ON SSE_MRN = PATIENT_MRN AND CASE_SURGERY_DTE = SSE_SURG_DTE) , ENDO AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN ENDO_MRN, MRPT_PERFORMED_DTE ENDOSCOPY_PERFORMED_DATE, RCI_ITEM_NAME ENDOSCOPY_DOC_NAME, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)Attending Participation:[\w\W]*(?=Number of Addenda:)', UPPER(MRPT_MED_REPORT_TXT)) AS "ENDO Report Signed Date/Time", VARCHAR(MRPT_MED_REPORT_TXT, 32000) ENDOSCOPY_REPORT_TEXT FROM DV.MEDICAL_REPORTS JOIN DV.RESULT_CATALOG_ITEM ON MPRT_RESULT_CATALOG_ITEM_ID = RCI_RESULT_CATALOG_ITEM_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON MRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN SURG ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE (RCI_MASTER_CATEGORY = 'Endoscopy' OR RCI_ITEM_NAME = 'Pulm-Bronchoscopy') AND MRPT_PERFORMED_DTE = SSE_SURG_DTE ) , IR AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN IR_MRN, MRPT_PERFORMED_DTE IR_PERFORMED_DATE, RCI_ITEM_NAME IR_DOC_NAME, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)Electronically Signed By:[\w\W]*(?=ACC NUMBER:)', UPPER(MRPT_MED_REPORT_TXT)) AS "IR Report Signed Date/Time", VARCHAR(MRPT_MED_REPORT_TXT, 32000) IR_REPORT_TEXT FROM DV.MEDICAL_REPORTS JOIN DV.RESULT_CATALOG_ITEM ON MPRT_RESULT_CATALOG_ITEM_ID = RCI_RESULT_CATALOG_ITEM_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON MRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN SURG ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE RCI_ITEM_NAME = 'IR' AND MRPT_PERFORMED_DTE = SSE_SURG_DTE ) SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN AS MRN, PATIENT_NAME AS "Patient Name", SSE_PT_TYPE AS "Patient Type", SSE_SURG_DTE AS "Surgery Date", SSP_SURG_SVC_CD AS "Surgery Service Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS "Surgery Procedure Description", SURGEON_NAME AS "Surgeon Name", CASE WHEN OP_NOTE_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Brief Op Note Indicator(Y/N)", OP_NOTE_DATE AS "Brief Op Note Service Date", OP_NOTE_DOC_NAME AS "Brief Op Note Document Name", BOP_SIGNED_DTE AS "Brief Op Note Signed Date/Time", "Provider" AS "Brief Op Note Provider Information", CASE WHEN OP_REPORT_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Operative Report Indicator(Y/N)", OP_REPORT_DATE AS "Operative Report Service Date", OP_REPORT_DOC_NAME AS "Operative Report Document Name", OP_SIGNED_DTE AS "Operative Report Signed Date/Time", CASE_OPERATING_ROOM_ABRV AS "Operating Room Location", TOES_OUT_TIME_ACTUAL AS "Patient out of Room", CASE WHEN ENDO_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Endoscopy Indicator(Y/N)", ENDOSCOPY_PERFORMED_DATE AS "Endoscopy Performed Date", ENDOSCOPY_DOC_NAME AS "Endoscopy Doc Name", "ENDO Report Signed Date/Time", CASE WHEN IR_PERFORMED_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Interventional Radiology Indicator(Y/N)", IR_PERFORMED_DATE AS "Interventional Radiology Performed Date", IR_DOC_NAME AS "Interventional Radiology Doc Name", "IR Report Signed Date/Time" FROM SURG LEFT JOIN BOP ON OP_NOTE_MRN = SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN OPR ON OP_REPORT_MRN = SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN POR ON PATIENT_MRN = SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN ENDO ON ENDO_MRN = SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN IR ON IR_MRN = SSE_MRN ORDER BY SSE_MRN

prompt: Please provide a list of pediatric patients that visited the dental surgical service from 1/1/2001-12/31/2018.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_VITAL_STATUS, MIN(DT_DTE) AS "ICD-9/10 Min Dx Date", DXCC_ICD_CODE AS "ICD-9/10 Dx Code", DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-9/10 Dx Description" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V ON PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON PDX_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG ON PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID WHERE DXCC_ICD_CODE IN ('C74.90') OR DXCC_ICD_CODE IN ('194.0') AND DT_DTE BETWEEN '2011-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' GROUP BY PT_MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_VITAL_STATUS, DXCC_ICD_CODE, DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC ), CPT AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS "CPT_MRN", PCC_CODE AS "CPT OR PBD CODE", PCC_DESC AS "PROCEDURE DESC", MIN(DT_DTE) AS "PROCEDURE DATE" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V JOIN DV.CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON PTX_PROC_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID WHERE PCC_CODE IN ('99201', '99202', '99203', '99204', '99205') AND DT_DTE BETWEEN '2001-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' GROUP BY PT_MRN, PCC_CODE, PCC_DESC) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, "ICD-9/10 Min Dx Date", "ICD-9/10 Dx Code", "ICD-9/10 Dx Description", YEAR("ICD-9/10 Min Dx Date" - PT_BIRTH_DTE) AGE_AT_DX FROM DX JOIN CPT ON CPT_MRN = PT_MRN ; WITH DX AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, MIN(DT_DTE) AS "ICD-9/10 Min Dx Date", DXCC_ICD_CODE AS "ICD-9/10 Dx Code", DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-9/10 Dx Description" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V ON PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON PDX_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG ON PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID WHERE DXCC_ICD_CODE IN ('C74.90') OR DXCC_ICD_CODE IN ('194.0') AND DT_DTE BETWEEN '2011-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' GROUP BY PT_MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, DXCC_ICD_CODE, DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC ), CPT AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, 'FIRST-DENTAL-VISIT' AS "CPT OR PBD CODE", '' AS "PROCEDURE DESC", MIN(DT_DTE) AS "PROCEDURE DATE" FROM DX JOIN DV.CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON PTX_PROC_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID WHERE PCC_CODE IN ('99201', '99202', '99203', '99204', '99205') AND DT_DTE BETWEEN '2001-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' GROUP BY PT_MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID), CPT_ALL AS (SELECT * FROM CPT UNION SELECT PT_MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PCC_CODE AS "CPT OR PBD CODE", PCC_DESC AS "PROCEDURE DESC", DT_DTE AS "PROCEDURE DATE" FROM CPT JOIN DV.CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON PTX_PROC_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID WHERE PCC_CODE IN ('70355', '99212', '99213', '99214', '99215') AND DT_DTE BETWEEN '2001-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' ) SELECT DISTINCT DX.PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, "CPT OR PBD CODE", "PROCEDURE DESC", "PROCEDURE DATE" FROM DX JOIN CPT_ALL ON CPT_ALL.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = DX.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID ;

prompt: Provide HNS LOS data for the specified procedures from 2007-2009 by month (similar to other LOS reports).
completion: SELECT PBD_MRN AS MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE AS SURG_DATE, STRIP(PBC_CPT_CD)||'-'||PBC_PBD_DESC AS SURG_DESC, TIMESTAMP(CS_ADM_DATE, CS_ADM_TIME) AS ADMIT_DT, TIMESTAMP(CS_DSCH_DATE, CS_DSCH_TIME) AS DISCH_DT, DOC_NAME AS SURGEON, SUBSTR(CHAR(PBD_SVC_DTE), 1, 5)|| CASE WHEN MONTH(PBD_SVC_DTE) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 'Q1' WHEN MONTH(PBD_SVC_DTE) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 'Q2' WHEN MONTH(PBD_SVC_DTE) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 'Q3' ELSE 'Q4' END AS SURG_YEAR, CASE WHEN CS_DSCH_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN INT(CS_DAYS_STAY) ELSE DAYS(CURRENT DATE) - DAYS(PBD_SVC_DTE) END LOS, CASE WHEN PBC_CPT_CD BETWEEN '31600' AND '31605' THEN 'Tracheostomy' WHEN PBC_CPT_CD BETWEEN '60210' AND '60271' THEN 'Thyroidectomy' WHEN PBC_CPT_CD BETWEEN '31360' AND '31382' THEN 'Laryngectomy' ELSE 'Oral Cavity' END AS SURG_TYPE FROM IDB.PBD_DTL_CHARGES JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBC_PBD_CD = PBD_PBD_CD AND PBC_PBD_DESC LIKE 'HDNK%' JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = PBC_CPT_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBI_MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBI_ACCT_NO = PBD_ACCT_NO AND PBI_INV_NO = PBD_INV_NO AND PBI_INV_STS = ' ' JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.CASE ON CS_MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN CS_ADM_DATE AND CS_DSCH_DATE AND CS_ACCT_NO LIKE '84%' AND CS_PT_STS <> 'IP' WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE >= CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT DATE) IN (1, 2) THEN DATE(STRIP(CHAR(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1))||'-01-01') ELSE DATE(STRIP(CHAR(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE)))||'-01-01') END AND PBD_SVC_DTE <= DATE(CURRENT_DATE - 1 MONTH - DAY(CURRENT_DATE) DAY) AND PBC_CPT_CD IN ('31600', '31601', '31603', '31605', '60210' , '60212', '60220', '60225', '60240', '60245' , '60246', '60252', '60254', '60260', '60270' , '60271', '31360', '31365', '31367', '31368' , '31370', '31375', '31382', '31390', '31395' , '21047', '31225', '40810', '40812', '40814' , '40816', '40842', '41113', '41116', '41120' , '41130', '41135', '41150', '41153', '41155' , '41599', '41820', '41825', '41826', '41827' , '41830', '41899')

prompt: Requesting all medications given to patients during their 09-090 protocol participation
completion: SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, ACC.AC_CONS_DTE AS "Consent Date", ACC.AC_TX_STRT_DTE AS "Treatment Start Date", ACC.AC_TX_END_DTE AS "Treatment End Date", ACC.AC_OFF_STUDY_DTE AS "Off Study Date" , POD_RX_NO, PINC_GENERIC_NAME AS GENERIC_NAME , POD_ITEM_DESC DRUG_NAME, MAX(INT(POD_NET_ACCUM_DOSE), 1) DISPENSE_CNT , SD.DT_DTE AS START_DATE, SPD.DT_DTE STOP_DATE, POA_ROUTE_ABBR ROUTE, POA_ROUTE_DESC AS ROUTE_DESC , CASE WHEN POD_IV_VOL > 0 THEN POD_IV_VOL ELSE POD_DOSE END DOSE , CASE WHEN POD_IV_VOL > 0 THEN POD_IV_VOL_UNIT ELSE POD_DOSE_UNIT END AS DOSE_UNIT , MAX(INT(POD_NET_ACCUM_DOSE), 1)*(CASE WHEN POD_IV_VOL > 0 THEN POD_IV_VOL ELSE POD_DOSE END) TOTAL_DOSE , CASE WHEN POD_SRX_ORD_GUID > 0 THEN POD_ORD_FREQ ELSE POSA_SCH_CD END AS FREQ , POSA_ORD_DUR_TXT ORD_DUR, POA_DISP_LOC_NAME RX_LOC , CASE WHEN POD_IVVH_ORD_IND = 'Y' THEN 'N' ELSE POD_PRIMARY_IND END PRIMARY_IND , MP_SERVICE_CD SERVICE_CD, MP_SERVICE_DESC SERVICE_DESC , MP_FULL_NM PROVIDER_NAME, MP_SOURCE_PROVIDER_NO PROVIDER_NO , POD_PLACER_ID_TXT CIS_ORDER_ID, POD_SRX_ORD_ID SRX_ORD_ID , POD_VERIF_IND VERIF_IND, POD_VERIF_DTE VERIF_DTE , POD_INFUSE_OVER_TEXT INFUSE_OVER_TEXT, POD_DOSE_SUMMARY AS DOSE_SUMMARY , POD_ORD_NO ORD_NO, POD_ORD_STS ORD_STS, POD_ORD_STS_DESC ORD_STS_DESC , POD_CR_DT ORD_CREATE_DT, POD_ORD_STRT_DT ORD_STRT_DT, POD_STOP_DT STOP_DT , POD_CALC_BSA CALC_BSA, POD_CALC_WT_KG CALC_WT_KG, POD_CALS_HT_CM CALS_HT_CM , POD_CALC_DOSE_INFO CALC_DOSE_INFO, POD_DIRECTIONS DIRECTIONS , CASE WHEN POD_SRX_ORD_ID > 0 THEN POA_MED_FORM_CD ELSE PINC_DOSE_FORM_CD END MED_FORM , CASE WHEN POD_SRX_ORD_ID > 0 THEN POD_CHEMO_ORD_IND ELSE PINC_CHEMO_IND END CHEMO_ORD_IND , POD_HVC_CATEGORY HVC_CATEGORY, POD_SRX_CATEGORY SRX_CATEGORY , CASE WHEN PINC_NDC > ' ' THEN PINC_NDC ELSE POD_NDC_CD END NDC , PINC_AHFS, PINC_THERAPEUTIC_CLASS_CD THERAPEUTIC_CLASS , CASE WHEN PINC_DOSE_JCODE > ' ' THEN PINC_DOSE_JCODE ELSE POD_J_CD END JCODE , PINC_STRENGTH_DESC STRENGTH_DESC, PINC_ATTR_FLAG , CASE WHEN UPPER(POD_ITEM_DESC) LIKE '%INVEST%' OR PINC_ATTR_FLAG LIKE '%INVEST%' THEN 'Y' WHEN PINC_INV_SOURCE_CD = 1 AND PINC_NDC LIKE 'IRB%' AND(PINC_SVC_CD = '00000000' OR PINC_SVC_CD LIKE '748%') THEN 'Y' ELSE PINC_INVESTIGATIONAL_IND END INVESTIGATIONAL_IND , PINC_DRUG_CTLG_KEY DRUG_CTLG_KEY, POA_DISP_SUB_TYP_NAME DISP_SUB_TYP_NAME , CASE WHEN PINC_SVM_CODE = '140000' OR PINC_MNEMONIC IN ('NFUD', 'NFIV', 'NFMD') OR PINC_GENERIC_NAME IN ('non-formulary medication', 'CAB custom epidural') THEN 'Y' END AS NON_FORMULARY_FLAG , CASE WHEN PINC_INV_SOURCE_CD = 1 AND POA_ROUTE_ABBR LIKE 'RX%' OR(POA_ORD_CLSF_CD = 'AMB' AND POA_CARE_CLSF_CD= 'AMB') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END RX_IND FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V PAT JOIN DV.ACCRUALS ACC ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID=ACC.AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PROTOCOL PRO ON ACC.AC_PROTOCOL_ID=PRO.PRO_PROTOCOL_ID JOIN DV.PHM_ORDER_DTL ON POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG ON PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PHM_ORDER_ATTR ON POA_PHARMA_ORDER_ATTR_ID = POD_PHARMA_ORD_ATTR_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PHM_ORDER_SCHED_ATTR ON POSA_PHARMA_ORD_SCH_ATTR_ID = POD_PHARMA_ORD_SCH_ATTR_ID LEFT JOIN DV.MEDPRO ON POD_ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_ID = MP_MEDPRO_ID JOIN DV.DATE SD ON SD.DT_DATE_ID = POD_START_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DATE SPD ON SPD.DT_DATE_ID = POD_STOP_DATE_ID WHERE SD.DT_DTE >= AC_TX_STRT_DTE AND PRO.PRO_IRB_NO = '09-090' ORDER BY PT_MRN

prompt: Provide a one time report for patients with specific hpylori or helicobacter pylori tests, and EGD reports 3 years before and after those tests.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LISTAGG(LTL_TEXT_RESULT, CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY LTL_LINE_NO) AS LTL_TEXT_RESULT FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2020-07-01' AND '2023-08-31' AND LR_TEST_NAME IN ('Helicobacter pylori rRNA and Clarithromycin Resistance Mutation, Stool', 'Helicobacter pylori Culture (Gastric Biopsy)') GROUP BY LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE ORDER BY LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME ; WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, MIN(LR_PERFORMED_DTE) MIN_LAB_DTE, MAX(LR_PERFORMED_DTE) MAX_LAB_DTE FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS WHERE LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2020-07-01' AND '2023-08-31' AND LR_TEST_NAME IN ('Helicobacter pylori rRNA and Clarithromycin Resistance Mutation, Stool', 'Helicobacter pylori Culture (Gastric Biopsy)') GROUP BY LR_MRN) SELECT PRPT_MRN, MIN_LAB_DTE, MAX_LAB_DTE, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN CTE ON PRPT_MRN = LR_MRN AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE BETWEEN MIN_LAB_DTE - 3 YEAR AND MAX_LAB_DTE + 3 YEAR WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE BETWEEN '2004-01-01' AND '2023-08-23' ORDER BY PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC ; WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, MIN(LR_PERFORMED_DTE) MIN_LAB_DTE, MAX(LR_PERFORMED_DTE) MAX_LAB_DTE FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS WHERE LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2020-07-01' AND '2023-08-31' AND LR_TEST_NAME IN ('Helicobacter pylori rRNA and Clarithromycin Resistance Mutation, Stool', 'Helicobacter pylori Culture (Gastric Biopsy)') GROUP BY LR_MRN) SELECT PT_MRN, MIN_LAB_DTE, MAX_LAB_DTE, MRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RCI_ITEM_NAME, MRPT_MED_REPORT_TXT FROM DV.MEDICAL_REPORTS JOIN DV.RESULT_CATALOG_ITEM ON MPRT_RESULT_CATALOG_ITEM_ID = RCI_RESULT_CATALOG_ITEM_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON MRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN CTE ON PT_MRN = LR_MRN AND MRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN MIN_LAB_DTE - 3 YEAR AND MAX_LAB_DTE + 3 YEAR WHERE MRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2004-01-01' AND '2023-08-23' AND RCI_MASTER_CATEGORY = 'Endoscopy' ORDER BY PT_MRN, MRPT_PERFORMED_DTE

prompt: Provide a list of patients who have had surgery at MSK to excise colorectal cancer metastases to liver AND at least 1 additional site (ex lung, brain, ovary, peritoneum), AND have also had their primary colorectal cancer tumors operated on at MSK.
completion: WITH COLONCA AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN AS COLONCA_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS COLONCA_ICD_DATE, CC_CLSF_CD AS COLONCA_ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS COLONCA_ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN prompt: Determine the number of living African American and Hispanic colorectal cancer patients by race, sex, year of diagnosis, and year of last treatment.
completion: SELECT PT_RACE, PT_SEX, DX_YR, LAST_TX_YR, COUNT(PT_MRN) AS PT_COUNT FROM (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_SEX, PT_RACE, YEAR(MIN(COALESCE(TM_DX_DTE, MIN_ICD9_DATE), COALESCE(MIN_ICD9_DATE, TM_DX_DTE))) AS DX_YR, YEAR(PLA_LST_TX_DTE) AS LAST_TX_YR FROM (SELECT TM_MRN, MIN(TM_DX_DTE) AS TM_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR WHERE TM_SITE_CD IN ('C180', 'C181', 'C182', 'C183', 'C184', 'C185', 'C186', 'C187', 'C188', 'C189', 'C199', 'C209') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2007-12-31' GROUP BY TM_MRN ) AS CDB FULL JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_DATE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('153', '153.0', '153.1', '153.2', '153.3', '153.4', '153.5', '153.6', '153.7', '153.8', '153.9') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_CIC_CDR_INITLS <> '' OR SUBSTR(CC_ACCT_NO, 1, 2) IN ('00', '84')) GROUP BY CC_MRN HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2007-12-31') AS CTC ON CDB.TM_MRN = CTC.CC_MRN JOIN (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_SEX, AV_DESC AS PT_RACE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_CODE = PT_RACE AND AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' WHERE PT_RACE IN ('2', '3', '4') ) AS PT ON PT.PT_MRN = COALESCE(CDB.TM_MRN, CTC.CC_MRN) JOIN (SELECT PLA_MRN, PLA_LST_TX_DTE FROM IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY WHERE PLA_LST_TX_DTE IS NOT NULL AND PLA_DECEASED_IND <> 'Y' ) AS PLA ON PT.PT_MRN = PLA.PLA_MRN) AS A GROUP BY PT_RACE, PT_SEX, DX_YR, LAST_TX_YR ORDER BY PT_RACE, PT_SEX, DX_YR, LAST_TX_YR

prompt: Scheduled report of COVID-19 Vaccine Data Quality Issues
completion: SELECT CPVV_MRN, CPVV_CLIENT_VISIT_GUID, CPVV_MSK_VISIT_TYPE, CPVV_VISIT_DT, CPVV_LAST_TOUCHED_WHEN_DT, CEVV_MRN, CEVV_CLIENT_VISIT_GUID, CEVV_MSK_VISIT_TYPE, CEVV_VISIT_DT, CEVV_LAST_TOUCHED_WHEN_DT FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_CP_VACCINE_VISIT FULL OUTER JOIN IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_VISIT ON CPVV_MRN = CEVV_MRN WHERE CPVV_MRN IS NOT NULL AND CEVV_MRN IS NOT NULL AND (CPVV_VISIT_STATUS <> 'CAN' AND CEVV_VISIT_STATUS <> 'CAN') AND (DATE(CPVV_VISIT_DT) >= CURRENT date OR DATE(CEVV_VISIT_DT) >= CURRENT date) ; SELECT CPCVE_MRN, CEVE_EMPLOYEE_ID, CEVE_COHORT_ELIGIBLE_DTE, CPCVE_COHORT_ELIGIBLE_DT, CPCVE_COHORT_NOT_ELIGIBLE_DT FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_CP_VACCINE_ELIGIBLE JOIN (SELECT CMDM_MRN, CEVE_EMPLOYEE_ID, CEVE_COHORT_ELIGIBLE_DTE FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_ELIGIBLE JOIN (SELECT CMDM_EMPLOYEE_ID, MAX(CMDM_MRN) CMDM_MRN FROM IDB.COVID19_MDM_MATCH WHERE CMDM_CIS_ACTIVE_IND = 1 GROUP BY CMDM_EMPLOYEE_ID HAVING COUNT(CMDM_MRN) = 1) MDM ON CMDM_EMPLOYEE_ID = CEVE_EMPLOYEE_ID) ON CMDM_MRN = CPCVE_MRN; SELECT S1.CEVE_EMPLOYEE_ID, S2.CMDM_MRN, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY S1.CEVE_EMPLOYEE_ID) RNK FROM (SELECT CEVE_EMPLOYEE_ID, COUNT(CMDM_MRN) CT FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_ELIGIBLE LEFT JOIN IDB.COVID19_MDM_MATCH ON CEVE_EMPLOYEE_ID = CMDM_EMPLOYEE_ID WHERE CMDM_CIS_ACTIVE_IND = 1 GROUP BY CEVE_EMPLOYEE_ID) S1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT CMDM_EMPLOYEE_ID, CMDM_MRN FROM IDB.COVID19_MDM_MATCH WHERE CMDM_CIS_ACTIVE_IND = 1) S2 ON S1.CEVE_EMPLOYEE_ID = S2.CMDM_EMPLOYEE_ID WHERE CT > 1 ORDER BY RNK DESC; SELECT CEVE_EMPLOYEE_ID, CEVE_COHORT_ELIGIBLE_DTE FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_ELIGIBLE LEFT JOIN (SELECT CMDM_MRN, CMDM_EMPLOYEE_ID FROM IDB.COVID19_MDM_MATCH WHERE CMDM_CIS_ACTIVE_IND = 1 ) ON CEVE_EMPLOYEE_ID = CMDM_EMPLOYEE_ID WHERE CMDM_MRN IS NULL; SELECT DISTINCT CPVE_MRN, CMDM_EMPLOYEE_ID FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_CP_VACCINE_EMAR JOIN IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_EMAR ON CPVE_MRN = CEVE_MRN AND CEVE_TASK_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPVE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.COVID19_MDM_MATCH ON CPVE_MRN = CMDM_MRN WHERE CPVE_TASK_STATUS_CD = 'Performed';

prompt:
Create ongoing monthly report with total number of patient visits per ETC unit, per month, by therapeutic protocol number.  

Provide separate files for 2010 and 2011 – up to date.
completion: SELECT APPT.MRN, APPT.LST_APPT_DT , APPT.DEPT_ID, APPT.DEPT_NAME , IRB.LST_CONS_DTE , CASE WHEN IRB.IRB_NO IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE IRB.IRB_NO END IRB_NO , CASE WHEN IRB.IRB_TITLE IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE IRB.IRB_TITLE END IRB_TITLE FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, MAX(CPE_APPT_DT) AS LST_APPT_DT , CLD_DEPT_ID DEPT_ID , CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', ' Comp') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 AND CPE_DEPT_ID IN (346, 361, 392, 670) AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH - DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTHS)DAYS + 1 DAYS AND CPE_ENC_DTE <= LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTHS) GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CLD_DEPT_ID, CLD_DEPT_NAME) APPT LEFT JOIN (SELECT MRN, LST_CONS_DTE, PRO_IRB_NO IRB_NO , PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE, PRO_IRB_TITLE IRB_TITLE FROM (SELECT MRN , MAX(AC_CONS_DTE) AS LST_CONS_DTE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', ' Comp') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 AND CPE_DEPT_ID IN (346, 361, 392, 670) AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH - DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTHS)DAYS + 1 DAYS AND CPE_ENC_DTE <= LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTHS) ) AS APPT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.PROTOCOL ON AC_IRB_NO = PRO_IRB_NO AND PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE LIKE 'Therapeutic%' GROUP BY MRN) AS CONS JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = MRN AND AC_CONS_DTE = LST_CONS_DTE JOIN IDB.PROTOCOL ON AC_IRB_NO = PRO_IRB_NO AND PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE LIKE 'Therapeutic%') AS IRB ON APPT.MRN = IRB.MRN

prompt: Provide data on "Central Venous Catheterization Removal" notes monthly.
completion: WITH NOTES AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, VARCHAR(CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT, 32000) AS "Note Text" , OU_DISPLAY_NAME, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE , CDD_SERVICE_DT, PACU_IN_TIME_ACTUAL, PACU_OUT_TIME_ACTUAL , CDD_AUTH_PROV_NAME , PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "Date of Birth", PT_DEATH_DTE AS "Deceased Date", CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) END AS "Cur Age", PT_VITAL_STATUS AS "Vital Status", PT_SEX_DESC AS "Gender" , CDD_DOC_NAME , OCV_CURR_LOC LOCATION FROM DV.CLINDOC_FULL_TEXT_V CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OU_USER_GUID = CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CDD_DEID LEFT JOIN IDB.PERIOP_CASE_EVENT_V PER ON PATIENT_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN DATE(PACU_IN_TIME_ACTUAL) AND DATE(PACU_OUT_TIME_ACTUAL) WHERE 1=1 AND OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE IN ('Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 2 MONTHS AND CURRENT date AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Central Venous Catheterization Removal' ) SELECT * FROM NOTES ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE, MRN ;

prompt: Count of Cardiology patients actively using Patient Portal
completion: SELECT COUNT(CPP_MRN) AS "Total", COUNT(PP_MRN) AS "Active Patient Portal Users" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CPP_MRN, CASE WHEN CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE >= CURRENT date - 3 MONTHS THEN CPP_MRN END AS PP_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPP_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2019-01-01' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'CAR' ) A

prompt: SKIN-Q Survey Data collected in MSKEngage
completion: SELECT DISTINCT EF_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) EF_SUBMISSION_DTE, EF_FORM_NAME, EFI_ITEM_ALIAS, EFI_ITEM_TEXT, EFI_VALUE FROM IDB.EF_FORM JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON EF_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID WHERE EF_FORM_NAME = 'Skin-Q' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT EF_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) EF_SUBMISSION_DTE, EF_FORM_NAME, ENCV_ADV_RPT_SURVEY_ALIAS AS EFI_ITEM_ALIAS, ENCV_NAME AS EFI_ITEM_TEXT, ENCV_VALUE AS EFI_VALUE FROM IDB.EF_FORM JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON EF_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.ENAR_CALC_VALUE ON EF_FORM_EXTERNAL_ID = ENCV_ASSESSMENT_ID WHERE EF_FORM_NAME = 'Skin-Q' ORDER BY 1, 6, 8

prompt: Patients with UCC Notification orders from Leukiemia physicians from 1/1/2016 to 8/31/2017
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE AS APPT_DTE, OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS ENTERED_BY, OO_ORD_NAME , OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS PHYSICIAN , DOC_DR_NO, DOC_NAME, DOC_ACDMC_DPT, DOC_ACDMC_SVC FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = OO_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Attendings_AdmitPriv1' JOIN IDB.DOC ON RIGHT(RTRIM(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE), 6) = DOC_DR_NO AND DOC_ACDMC_SVC = 'LEUKEMIA' WHERE OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2017-01-31' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP') AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '3000004803073029'

prompt: Provide one time report for zip code, primary language and insurance status
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT PT_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_ZIP_CD, PT_PRIMARY_LANG, AV_DESC AS PRIMARY_LANG FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_CODE = PT_PRIMARY_LANG AND AV_ELEMENT = 'PRIMARY_LANG' WHERE 1=1 AND PT_MRN IN () ) , INS AS (SELECT MRN AS INS_MRN, FSC_PRIORITY, FSC_REP_CAT_CODE, FSC_REP_CAT_NAME , INS_CODE, INS_COMP_NAME, INS_EFF_DATE, INS_EXP_DATE , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN ORDER BY MSK_ADT_INSURANCE_IND DESC , COALESCE(INS_EXP_DATE, CURRENT DATE) DESC, FSC_PRIORITY ASC) RN FROM IDB.PATIENT_INSURANCE_V PIV JOIN X ON PT_MRN = MRN WHERE COALESCE(INS_EXP_DATE, CURRENT DATE) >= CURRENT DATE AND FSC_PRIORITY IS NOT NULL AND INS_CODE IS NOT NULL ) , INS2 AS (SELECT INS_MRN, FSC_PRIORITY, FSC_REP_CAT_CODE, FSC_REP_CAT_NAME , INS_CODE, INS_COMP_NAME, INS_EFF_DATE, INS_EXP_DATE FROM INS WHERE RN=1 ) , CART AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN X ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND(UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%TISAGENLECLEUCEL%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%AXICABTAGENE CILOLEUCEL%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%BREXUCABTAGENE AUTOLEUCEL%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%LISOCABTAGENE MARALEUCEL%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%IDECABTAGENE VICLEUCEL%') ) SELECT DISTINCT X.*, FSC_REP_CAT_NAME, INS_EXP_DATE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE FROM X LEFT JOIN INS2 ON PT_MRN = INS_MRN LEFT JOIN CART ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN

prompt: Create Tableau Dashboard to track IMPACT statuses for patients seen in the Pediatrics Department who were consented to protocol 12-245.
completion: WITH PED_VIS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN PEDS_MRN, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = ('PED') OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = ('PED') OR CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'ORTHOPEDICS 1275-9') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' UNION SELECT VIS_MRN PEDS_MRN, VIS_HOSP_SVC || ' - Service' AS DEPT FROM IDB.VISIT WHERE VIS_HOSP_SVC IN ('PDB', 'PDG', 'PDP', 'PDR', 'PDU', 'PED', 'PDS') AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') ) , ORD AS (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(OO_MRN) AS ORD_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE AS ORDER_ENTER_DATE, OSH_CREATE_DTE AS ORDER_RELEASE_DATE, OO_ORD_STS_CD AS ORDER_STATUS, OO_SET_NAME AS SET_NAME, OO_ORD_NAME AS ORDER_NAME FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX ON OO_ORD_GUID = OSH_ORD_GUID AND OSH_FUNCTION_CD = '105' JOIN PED_VIS ON OO_MRN = PEDS_MRN WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_ORD_NAME IN ('Diag Molecular Path Blood as Normal Control for MSK-IMPACT', 'Diag Molecular Path Saliva or Nails as Normal Control for MSK-IMPACT', 'Diag Molecular Path (Solid Tumor) Order') ) , CONSENT AS (SELECT AC_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE AS CONSENT_DATE, CASE WHEN AC_CONS_DTE IS NULL AND AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN 'N' WHEN AC_CONS_DTE IS NOT NULL AND AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'NA' END AS CONSENT_STATUS FROM ORD JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON ORD_MRN = AC_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO = '12-245') , PATHR AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC_DESC FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN PED_VIS ON PEDS_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC='Diagnostic Molecular Pathology' ) SELECT PEDS_MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, DEPT, ORDER_NAME, SET_NAME, ORDER_ENTER_DATE, ORDER_STATUS, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS PATHOLOGY_REPORT_DATE FROM PED_VIS P JOIN ORD ON ORD_MRN = PEDS_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = ORD_MRN LEFT JOIN CONSENT C ON AC_MRN = ORD_MRN LEFT JOIN PATHR P ON PRPT_MRN = ORD_MRN AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= ORDER_ENTER_DATE WHERE 1=1 AND ORDER_ENTER_DATE>= '2022-01-01' AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= ORDER_ENTER_DATE;

prompt: Provide a yearly report of New Visits and Treatments for Radiation Oncology patients for the years of 2019 and 2020 and by zip code
completion: SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN , PT_ZIP_CD, CPE_ENC_DTE, PLA_LST_RT_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS ROW FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CPE_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%NEW%' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RDO' AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' ORDER BY 1, 3) AS X WHERE ROW = 1

prompt: Provide the percentage of nephrectomy patients who had no complications information recorded (not even "None").
completion: SELECT SUM(NO_RECORD) AS NO_RECORD, COUNT(*) AS ALL_PROCS FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SSP_LOG_ID, CASE WHEN SAE_SURG_LOG_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS NO_RECORD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_ADVERSE_EVENT ON SSP_LOG_ID = SAE_SURG_LOG_ID AND SSP_PROC_SEQ_NO = SAE_PROC_SEQ_NO WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('50220', '50225', '50230', '50240', '50280', '50290', '50340', '50341', '50543', '50545', '50546') ) AS A

prompt: Provide a monthly report for CTS outpatient and inpatient volume.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT LAST_DAY(CURRENT date - 2 MONTH) + 1 DAY "Report Start Date", LAST_DAY(CURRENT date - 1 MONTH) "Report End Date", 'INPATIENT' INP_OUT , CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_MRN MRN , CDD_DOC_NAME DOCUMENT_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE "Service Date", OS_SVC_DESC "Service", OCV_PVDR_NAME PROVIDER, OCV_CURR_LOC "Location" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'I' JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN LAST_DAY(CURRENT date - 2 MONTH) + 1 DAY AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT date - 1 MONTH) AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE < CURRENT date AND CDD_DOC_NAME like '%CTS%' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Admission Note - BMT/CTS-CTS' , 'Progress Note - BMT/CTS-CTS' , 'Follow Up, AMB - BMT/CTS-CTS' , 'Cell Infusion - BMT/CTS-CTS' , 'Pre-Admission Note - BMT/CTS-CTS') ORDER BY 'INPATIENT', CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_GUID ; SELECT DISTINCT LAST_DAY(CURRENT date - 2 MONTH) + 1 DAY "Report Start Date", LAST_DAY(CURRENT date - 1 MONTH) "Report End Date", 'OUTPATIENT' INP_OUT , CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_MRN MRN , CDD_DOC_NAME DOCUMENT_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE "Service Date", U2.OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS "CIS Final Signer", U2.OU_OCCUPATION AS "Signer Occupation", U2.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE AS "Signer Role" , DS.CECR_REFERENCE_STRING "CIS Document Status", SS.CECR_REFERENCE_STRING "CIS Signature Status" , CLD_DEPT_NAME "Cadence Department", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Cadence Visit Type", CPE_APPT_DT "Cadence Visit Dt", CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CRE_RES_NAME "Cadence Provider", CRE_RES_TYP "Cadence Resource Type", CLD_CLD_CENTER "Cadence Center" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'O' JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT_HISTORY ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDH_CLIENT_DOC_GUID AND CDD_CLIENT_GUID = CDH_CLIENT_GUID AND CDH_DOCUMENT_STATUS_TYPE = '6' JOIN IDB.OMS_USER U2 ON CDH_USER_GUID = U2.OU_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.CIS_ENUMERATED_COLUMN_REF DS ON DS.CECR_ENUM_VALUE = CDH_DOCUMENT_STATUS_TYPE AND DS.CECR_TABLE_NAME = 'CV3ClientDocHistory' AND DS.CECR_COLUMN_NAME = 'DocumentStatus' LEFT JOIN IDB.CIS_ENUMERATED_COLUMN_REF SS ON SS.CECR_ENUM_VALUE = CDH_SIGNATURE_STATUS_TYPE AND SS.CECR_TABLE_NAME = 'CV3ClientDocHistory' AND SS.CECR_COLUMN_NAME = 'SignatureStatus' LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = OCV_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE = CDD_SERVICE_DTE AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist', 'PhD', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID= CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN LAST_DAY(CURRENT date - 2 MONTH) + 1 DAY AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT date - 1 MONTH) AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME like '%CTS%' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Admission Note - BMT/CTS-CTS' , 'Progress Note - BMT/CTS-CTS' , 'Follow Up, AMB - BMT/CTS-CTS' , 'Cell Infusion - BMT/CTS-CTS' , 'Pre-Admission Note - BMT/CTS-CTS') ORDER BY CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_GUID ;

prompt: Provide post-op CA 19-9 and CEA results for a list of patients and surgery dates.
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT * FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES WHERE ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' ), "cte2" AS (SELECT EDC_DEPT_DESC, EDC_DEPT_ABBREV FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG WHERE EDC_GROUP_ID = '8' ), "cte3" AS (SELECT EDC_DEPT_ABBREV, EDC_DEPT_DESC FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG WHERE EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS' ) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t2"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Description", "t3"."TCLSA_CLIN_TNM_T" AS "Clinical Tumor", "t3"."TCLSA_CLIN_TNM_M" AS "Clinical Metastases", "t4"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" AS "Generic Drug Name", "t4"."PINC_CHEMO_IND" AS "Chemo Indicator", "t5"."ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8" AS "Clinical Service (Group 8)", "t6"."EDC_DEPT_DESC" AS "Clinical Service Desc (Group 8)", CASE WHEN "t7"."EDC_DEPT_DESC"IN ('Arrived', 'Completed') THEN 'Completed' WHEN "t7"."EDC_DEPT_DESC" IN ('Scheduled') THEN 'Scheduled' ELSE 'Non-Completed/Scheduled' END AS "Completed/Scheduled Indicator" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t8" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t9" ON "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t2" ON "t9"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_CLINICAL_STAGE_ATTRIBUTES_V" "t3" ON "t9"."CDTM_CLINICAL_STAGE_ATTR_ID" = "t3"."TCLSA_TM_CLIN_STAGE_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t10" ON "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t10"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t11" ON "t10"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t11"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t10"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t11"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t4" ON "t11"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t4"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER" "t12" ON "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t12"."PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT" "t5" ON "t12"."PENC_DEPT_ID" = "t5"."ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t13" ON "t12"."PENC_PT_ENC_ID" = "t13"."ENSR_PT_ENC_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT" "t14" ON "t13"."ENSR_DEPT_ID" = "t14"."ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte2" "t6" ON "t14"."ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8" = "t6"."EDC_DEPT_ABBREV" LEFT JOIN "cte3" "t7" ON "t12"."PENC_APPT_STS" = "t7"."EDC_DEPT_ABBREV" WHERE ("t2"."ICSC_SITE_CD" IN ('C250', 'C251', 'C252', 'C253', 'C254', 'C257', 'C258', 'C259') AND ("t3"."TCLSA_CLIN_TNM_T" IN ('T4', 'T4A', 'T4B', 'T4C', 'T4D') AND ("t3"."TCLSA_CLIN_TNM_M" NOT IN ('M1', 'M1A', 'M1B', 'M1C') AND ("t4"."PINC_CHEMO_IND" = 'Y' AND ("t5"."ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8" = 'HEP' AND (CASE WHEN "t7"."EDC_DEPT_DESC"IN ('Arrived', 'Completed') THEN 'Completed' WHEN "t7"."EDC_DEPT_DESC" IN ('Scheduled') THEN 'Scheduled' ELSE 'Non-Completed/Scheduled' END = 'Completed' AND UPPER("t4"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME") IN ('IRINOTECAN HCL', 'IRINOTECAN')))))))

prompt: Patients who has undergone hip surgery between 1989 and 2018.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", PT_RACE_DESC "Race", PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC "Ethnicity", SSE_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE-PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at Surgery", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD "CPT Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC "CPT Description", TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) "Surgeon", SSP_SURG_SVC_CD "Service" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('27125', '27130', '27132', '27138', '27365') AND YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE-PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 15 ORDER BY 1 DESC ; WITH PROC AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, MIN(SSE_SURG_DTE) SSE_SURG_DTE FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('27125', '27130', '27132', '27138', '27365') AND YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE-PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 15 GROUP BY SSE_MRN ) , DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_RACE_DESC "Race", PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC "Ethnicity", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", SSE_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) "Diagnosis Date", CC_CLSF_CD "ICD9/10 Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "ICD Description" FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN PROC ON CC_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, SSE_SURG_DTE, PT_RACE_DESC, PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, "Last Name", "First Name", "Date of Birth", "Race", "Ethnicity", "Surgery Date", YEAR("Surgery Date"-"Date of Birth") "Age at Surgery", "Diagnosis Date", YEAR("Diagnosis Date" - "Date of Birth") "Age at Diagnosis", "ICD9/10 Code", "ICD Description" FROM DX ORDER BY 1 DESC, 9

prompt: Patients receiving laparoscopy and thoracoscopy procedures
completion: WITH SRG AS (SELECT SSE_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "DOD", SSE_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD "CPT Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "CPT Desc", TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) "Surgeon", CASE WHEN ROBO_LOG_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END "ROBOTICALLY ASSISTED PROCEDURE" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.CLM ON SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT SSP_LOG_ID ROBO_LOG_ID FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD = '999997') A ON SSE_LOG_ID = ROBO_LOG_ID WHERE (UPPER(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) like '%THORACOSCOPY%' OR UPPER(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) like '%LAPAROSCOPY%') ) , PBD AS (SELECT PBD_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "DOD", PBD_SVC_DTE "Surgery Date", PBC_CPT_CD "CPT Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "CPT Desc", DOC_NAME "Surgeon", '' "ROBOTICALLY ASSISTED PROCEDURE" FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE (UPPER(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) like '%THORACOSCOPY%' OR UPPER(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) like '%LAPAROSCOPY%') ) SELECT COALESCE(S."MRN", P."MRN") "MRN", COALESCE(S."Last Name", P."Last Name") "Last Name", COALESCE(S."First Name", P."First Name") "First Name", COALESCE(S."DOB", P."DOB") "DOB", COALESCE(S."DOD", P."DOD") "DOD", COALESCE(S."Surgery Date", P."Surgery Date") "Surgery Date", COALESCE(S."CPT Code", P."CPT Code") "CPT Code", COALESCE(S."CPT Desc", P."CPT Desc") "CPT Desc", COALESCE(S."Surgeon", P."Surgeon") "Surgeon", COALESCE(S."ROBOTICALLY ASSISTED PROCEDURE", P."ROBOTICALLY ASSISTED PROCEDURE") "ROBOTICALLY ASSISTED PROCEDURE" FROM SRG S FULL JOIN PBD P ON S."MRN" = P."MRN" AND S."Surgery Date" = P."Surgery Date" AND S."CPT Code" = P."CPT Code"

prompt: Provide a number of patients referred to our Breast Survivorship program from 3 of our Breast Medicine MDs from January 2020 to November 2021. The 3 medicine MDs we are looking at are Dr. Rachel Sanford, Dr. Devika Gajria and Dr. Ayca Gucalp.
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME , C.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT, C.CLD_CLD_CENTER AS SITE, A.CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER, A.CRE_RES_ID AS PROV_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DATE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VT, B.CRE_RES_NAME AS REF_MD, B.CRE_RES_ID AS REF_MD_ID, D.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS REF_DEPT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT C ON CPE_DEPT_ID = C.CLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT D ON CPE_REF_DEP_ID = D.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE A ON A.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE B ON B.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_REF_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND C.CLD_DEPT_ID = 617 AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2021-11-30' AND (CPE_REF_RES_ID IN ('022004', '017111', '016121') OR B.CRE_RES_NAME IN ('UNKNOWN, PHYSICIAN', 'UNKNOWN PHYSICIAN')) AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%IR%') ) , LAST_DR_APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN , CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME , CRE_RES_NAME , CRE_RES_ID , REF_MD, REF_MD_ID FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_ID, REF_MD, REF_MD_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT DESC) AS ROW FROM APPTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN AND APPT_DATE > CPE_ENC_DTE JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('MED') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' WHERE 1=1 ) AS X WHERE ROW = 1 ) SELECT MRN , SITE, DEPT, PROVIDER, APPT_DATE, VT, CASE WHEN A.REF_MD IN ('UNKNOWN, PHYSICIAN', 'UNKNOWN PHYSICIAN') THEN CRE_RES_NAME ELSE A.REF_MD END AS REFERRING_MD , CPE_ENC_DTE AS LAST_APPT_DATE , CRE_RES_NAME AS LAST_PROV, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS LAST_APPT_DEPT FROM APPTS A JOIN LAST_DR_APPT B ON MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND (B.REF_MD_ID IN ('022004', '017111', '016121') OR (CRE_RES_ID IN ('022004', '017111', '016121') AND B.REF_MD IN ('UNKNOWN, PHYSICIAN', 'UNKNOWN PHYSICIAN')))

prompt: For provided list of patients who had a thyroidectomy in 2008, list the medications that the patient was taking at the time of surgery.
completion: SELECT MRN RX_MRN, SURG_DATE, POD_ITEM_DESC AS DRUG_NAME , SUM(POI_DOSE*MAX(POI_NET_PT_DOSE, 1)) TOTAL_DOSE , POI_DOSE_UNIT DOSE_UNIT , MIN(POD_STRT_DTE) AS START_DATE, MAX(POD_STOP_DTE) AS STOP_DATE FROM SUR4806MRN JOIN IDB.PHM_ORDER ON MRN = PO_MRN JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL ON PO_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_INV X ON POD_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ AND POD_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO JOIN IDB.PHM_INVENTORY ON PIN_INV_SEQ = POI_INV_SEQ AND (PIN_AHFS LIKE '88:16%' FROM SUR4806MRN JOIN IDB.PHM_ORDER ON MRN = PO_MRN JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL ON PO_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_INV X ON POD_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ AND POD_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO JOIN IDB.PHM_INVENTORY ON PIN_INV_SEQ = POI_INV_SEQ AND (PIN_AHFS LIKE '88:16%' OR UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%ALUM%PHATE%' OR UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%ALUM%PHATE%' OR UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%CAL%PHATE%' OR UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE 'POTASSIUM%PHATE%' OR UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE 'MCI %' OR UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE 'SEVELAMAR%' OR UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE 'SODIUM%PHATE%' OR UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%CITALOPRAM%' OR UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%ESCITALOPRAM%' OR UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%PAROXETINE%' OR UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%FLUOXETINE%' OR UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%FLUVOXAMINE%' OR UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%SERTRALINE%' OR UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%OMEPRAZOLE%' OR UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%ESOMEPRAZOLE%' OR UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%LANSOPRAZOLE%' OR UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%RABEPRAZOLE%' OR UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%PANTOPRAZOLE%' OR UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%DEXLANSOPRAZOLE%' OR UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%DRONATE%' OR UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%ZOLEDRON%' OR UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%PLICAMYCIN%' OR UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%CALCITONIN%' OR UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%FLUORIDE%' OR UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%ESTROGEN%' OR UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%CIMETIDINE%' OR UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%PHENYTOIN%' OR UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%PHENOBARBITAL%' OR UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%GADOLINIUM%' OR UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%FLUOROURACIL%' OR UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%LEUCOVORIN%' OR UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%CISPLATIN%' OR UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%PHOSPHOCARNATE%') AND UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) NOT LIKE '%PLACIBO%' AND UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) NOT LIKE '%BLIND DOSE%' WHERE PO_ORD_STS NOT IN ('X', 'P') AND POD_ATT_FLAG NOT LIKE '%IVVEH%' AND(POD_STRT_DTE BETWEEN SURG_DATE - 3 MONTH AND SURG_DATE OR POD_STOP_DTE BETWEEN SURG_DATE - 3 MONTH AND SURG_DATE) GROUP BY MRN, POD_ITEM_DESC, POI_DOSE_UNIT, SURG_DATE

prompt: urgent request to complete compliance communication about electronic health information exchange, need information on identifying international patients so we can identify a way of communication to reach them.
completion: WITH CDD AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, SUBSTR(TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 75) PREF_LANG , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CASE WHEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT IN ('English', 'English,English', 'English,English,English', 'English-speaking', ' ', 'Unknown') THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) RN FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2019-01-01' AND CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000128866902890', '9000078238002890') ) , NXTAPP AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, MIN(CASE WHEN CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CPE_ENC_DTE > CURRENT DATE THEN CPE_ENC_DTE END) NXT_VST_DTE , MAX(CASE WHEN CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%SURVIVORSHIP%' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS <> 'Sch' THEN CPE_ENC_DTE END) LST_SURVIV_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN AND PT_REG_DTE BETWEEN '2/21/2019' AND '11/5/2021' WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2019-01-01' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch', 'Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 GROUP BY CPE_MRN) , DTYPE AS (SELECT DISTINCT EPDA_MRN, 'Y' K87_FLAG FROM IDB.EMR_PT_DOC_AUTHV JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = EPDA_MRN WHERE PT_REG_DTE >= '2/21/2019' AND EPDA_DOCTYPE = 'K87' ) , INS AS (SELECT INS_MRN, FSC_PRIORITY, FSC, FSC_NAME, PRIM_INS_CODE, PRIM_INS_NAME , INS_EFF_DATE, INS_EXP_DATE, FSC_REP_CAT_CODE, FSC_REP_CAT_NAME FROM (SELECT MRN INS_MRN, FSC_PRIORITY, FSC_CODE FSC, FSC_NAME, FSC_REP_CAT_CODE, FSC_REP_CAT_NAME , INS_CODE PRIM_INS_CODE, INS_COMP_NAME PRIM_INS_NAME, INS_EFF_DATE, INS_EXP_DATE , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN ORDER BY MSK_ADT_INSURANCE_IND DESC , COALESCE(INS_EXP_DATE, CURRENT DATE) DESC, FSC_PRIORITY ASC) RN FROM IDB.PATIENT_INSURANCE_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN AND PT_REG_DTE BETWEEN '2/21/2019' AND '11/5/2021' WHERE FSC_PRIORITY IS NOT NULL AND INS_CODE IS NOT NULL ) INS WHERE RN=1 ) SELECT PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name" , PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS "Email Address", PT_ADDR1 "Address 1", PT_ADDR2 "Address 2" , PT_CITY "City", PT_STATE "State", PT_ZIP_CD "Zip Code", PT_COUNTRY "Country" , PT_REG_DTE "Registeration Date", CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE "Last MyMSK logon Date" , CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END "Vital status" , AV_DESC "Primary language", PREF_LANG "Preferred language" , PLA_LST_APPT_DTE "Last MSK Apt Date", NXT_VST_DTE "Next MSK Apt Date" , CASE WHEN PLA_LST_TX_DTE IS NOT NULL AND PLA_LST_ADM_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN MAX(PLA_LST_ADM_DTE, PLA_LST_TX_DTE) ELSE COALESCE(PLA_LST_TX_DTE, PLA_LST_ADM_DTE) END "Last Activity Date" , PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND "Do not mail/contact ind", LST_SURVIV_DTE "Last Survivorship Apt Date" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, YEAR(PT_REG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_REG, K87_FLAG , FSC, FSC_NAME, PRIM_INS_CODE, PRIM_INS_NAME, FSC_REP_CAT_CODE, FSC_REP_CAT_NAME FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'PRIMARY_LANG' AND PT_PRIMARY_LANG = AV_CODE LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN CDD ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN AND RN = 1 LEFT JOIN NXTAPP ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN DTYPE ON PT_MRN = EPDA_MRN LEFT JOIN INS ON PT_MRN = INS_MRN WHERE PT_REG_DTE >= '2/21/2019' AND YEAR(PT_REG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) NOT BETWEEN 10 AND 17 WITH UR

prompt: Provide a list of all bladder cancer patients with a diagnosis indicating history of organ transplant.
completion: WITH TRANSPLANTS AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS "MRN", CC_CLSF_CD AS "Transplant Hx ICD-9 Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "Transplant Hx ICD-9 Code Desc", MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS "Transplant Hx Min Effective Date", MAX(CASE WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y') THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) AS "Transplant Hx Ever CIC-Coded" FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('V42', 'V42.0', 'V42.1', 'V42.2', 'V42.3', 'V42.4', 'V42.5', 'V42.6', 'V42.7', 'V42.8', 'V42.81', 'V42.82', 'V42.83', 'V42.84', 'V42.89', 'V42.9') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK), CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS "Tumor Dx Date", AV_DESC AS "Case Status" FROM TRANSPLANTS JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C670', 'C671', 'C672', 'C673', 'C674', 'C675', 'C676', 'C677', 'C678', 'C679') ), ICD9 AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS "Min Bladder Cancer ICD-9 Dx Date", MAX(CASE WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y') THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) AS "Bladder Cancer Ever CIC-Coded" FROM TRANSPLANTS JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON MRN = CC_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('188', '188.0', '188.1', '188.2', '188.3', '188.4', '188.5', '188.6', '188.7', '188.8', '188.9') GROUP BY CC_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", "Transplant Hx ICD-9 Code", "Transplant Hx ICD-9 Code Desc", "Transplant Hx Min Effective Date", "Transplant Hx Ever CIC-Coded", "Tumor Dx Date", "Case Status", "Min Bladder Cancer ICD-9 Dx Date", "Bladder Cancer Ever CIC-Coded" FROM TRANSPLANTS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN CDB ON MRN = TM_MRN JOIN ICD9 ON MRN = CC_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL

prompt: From a spreadsheet listing policy numbers for a specified health plan, identify which patients are MSK patients.
completion: SELECT PTSS_SSA_NO, PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_AKA, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_ZIP_CD, PT_MRN_CREATE_DATE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_DRVST_DTE, PLA_LST_ACTV_DTE, NDM_LAST_NAME, NDM_FIRST_NAME, NDM_MIDDLE_NAME, NDM_BIRTH_DTE, NDM_RSDNCE_ZIP_CD FROM IDB.PATIENT_SSN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = PTSS_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.NTIS_DEATH_MASTER ON PTSS_SSA_NO = NDM_SSA_NO WHERE PTSS_SSA_NO IN (SELECT PTSS_SSA_NO FROM IDB.PATIENT_SSN WHERE PTSS_SSA_NO <> '' GROUP BY PTSS_SSA_NO HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

prompt:
Provide a daily report of patients scheduled the following day with no covid test result in chart for surgery day - 72 hours.



The OR has a similar report, HA20472 where we would like to add service and only populate patients whith no result surgery day-72 hours
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN "MRN" , PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name" , LOC_LOC_NAME "Location" , OC_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date" , CRE_RES_NAME "Primary Surgeon" , A.RESULT "COVID19 Result" , A.MIN_RESULT_DT "COVID19 Result Date" , OC_OR_CASE_STS "OR Case Status" , DAYS(OC_SURG_DTE) - DAYS(DATE(COALESCE(A.MIN_RESULT_DT, A.MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT))) "Days from Last test" , TIMESTAMPDIFF(8, CHAR(OC_SCH_DT - COALESCE(A.MIN_RESULT_DT, A.MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT))) "Hours from Last test" , OCAS_SURG_SVC "Service" FROM IDB.PATIENT_COVID_INFO_V A RIGHT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN, OC_SURG_DTE, OC_OR_CASE_STS, OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD, OCAS_SURG_SVC , CRE_RES_NAME, CPX_PROC_NAME, OC_CASE_ID, OCAP_OR_PROC_ID, LOC_LOC_NAME, OC_SCH_DT FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION ON OC_SURG_LOC_ID = LOC_LOC_ID WHERE OC_MRN <> '' AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD IN ('1', '2') AND OC_SURG_DTE = CURRENT date + 1 DAY ) B ON A.MRN = OC_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND (A.MRN IS NULL OR DAYS(OC_SURG_DTE) - DAYS(DATE(COALESCE(A.MIN_RESULT_DT, A.MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT))) > 3) ORDER BY OC_SURG_DTE ASC

prompt: Weekly list of patients who have had orders for Erdafitinib and Enfortumab
completion: WITH DRUG AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN HCPR_MRN, APR_START_DTE HCPR_START_DT, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE "Rx Type", APR_PROVIDER_NAME OP_DISPLAY_NAME FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'ERDAFITINIB' ) , DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN DRUG ON HCPR_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) , SCH AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Upcoming Appt Dept", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Upcoming Appt Provider", CRE_RES_TYP FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN DRUG ON HCPR_MRN = CPE_MRN AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP ) , SCHB AS (SELECT SCH.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) ROWNUM FROM SCH) SELECT HCPR_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", CHAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Date of Birth", CHAR(HCPR_START_DT) "Rx Date", OP_DISPLAY_NAME "Ordering Physician", CHAR(TM_DX_DTE) "Dx Date", HIST_DESC "Histology Description", SITE_DESC "Site Description", CHAR(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE) "Last Appt Date", CHAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) "Upcoming Appt Date", "Upcoming Appt Dept", "Upcoming Appt Provider" FROM DRUG JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON HCPR_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON HCPR_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN DX ON HCPR_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN SCHB ON HCPR_MRN = CPE_MRN AND ROWNUM = 1 ORDER BY 1 ; WITH DRUG AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'ENFORTUMAB VEDOTIN' ) , ORDERS AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OSTS_STS_DESC FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000007712300730', '9000013949100730', '9000014483100730') AND OO_MRN NOT IN (SELECT * FROM DRUG) ) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN ORDERS ON OO_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) , SCH AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Upcoming Appt Dept", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Upcoming Appt Provider", CRE_RES_TYP FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN ORDERS ON OO_MRN = CPE_MRN AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP ) , SCHB AS (SELECT SCH.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) ROWNUM FROM SCH) SELECT OO_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", OOC_ITEM_NAME "Order Name", CHAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) "Order Significant Date", OSTS_STS_DESC "Order Status", CHAR(TM_DX_DTE) "Dx Date", HIST_DESC "Histology Description", SITE_DESC "Site Description", CHAR(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE) "Last Appt Date", CHAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) "Upcoming Appt Date", "Upcoming Appt Dept", "Upcoming Appt Provider" FROM ORDERS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON OO_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN DX ON OO_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN SCHB ON OO_MRN = CPE_MRN AND ROWNUM = 1 ORDER BY 1

prompt: Provide a list of osteosarcoma patients aged 5 – 30 years old seen in the last 12 months
completion: WITH CDB AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9180/3', 'M9180/6', 'M9181/3', 'M9181/6', 'M9182/3', 'M9182/6', 'M9183/3', 'M9183/6', 'M9184/3', 'M9184/6', 'M9185/3', 'M9186/3', 'M9187/3', 'M9190/3', 'M9190/6', 'M9192/3', 'M9193/3', 'M9194/3', 'M9195/3') UNION SELECT PRPT_MRN MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("osteosarcoma" OR "osteogenic sarcoma")') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ) , APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_APPT, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT) RN FROM CDB JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2022-05-01' AND '2023-05-01' ) , PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM APPT WHERE AGE_AT_APPT BETWEEN 5 AND 30 ) SELECT PTS.MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, AGE_AT_APPT, "Appt Date", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type" FROM PTS JOIN APPT ON PTS.MRN = APPT.MRN WHERE RN = 1

prompt: Design a Tableau dashboard on CAM ICU compliance rates.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(CDD_MRN) AS MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID AS DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", TIME(CDD_SERVICE_DT) AS "Service Time", STRIP(CDD_DOC_NAME) AS "Note Name", STRIP(CDO_SECTION) AS "Section", STRIP(CDO_ITEM_NAME) AS "Item Name", STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) AS VALUE_TEXT, STRIP(OCV_CURR_LOC) AS OCV_CURR_LOC, STRIP(CASE WHEN OCV_CURR_LOC like '%NACU%' THEN 'NACU' WHEN OCV_CURR_LOC like '%CDU%' OR OCV_CURR_LOC like '%Clinical Decision Unit%' THEN 'CDU' WHEN OCV_CURR_LOC like '%UCC%' THEN 'UCC' WHEN OCV_CURR_LOC like 'ICU%' THEN 'ICU' WHEN OCV_CURR_LOC like '%Koch%' THEN 'Koch' WHEN OCV_CURR_LOC like '%JR%' THEN 'JR' WHEN OCV_CURR_LOC like 'M 10%' THEN 'M 10' WHEN OCV_CURR_LOC like 'M 11%' THEN 'M 11' WHEN OCV_CURR_LOC like 'M 12%' THEN 'M 12' WHEN OCV_CURR_LOC like 'M 14%' THEN 'M 14' WHEN OCV_CURR_LOC like 'M 15%' THEN 'M 15' WHEN OCV_CURR_LOC like 'M 16%' THEN 'M 16' WHEN OCV_CURR_LOC like 'M 17%' THEN 'M 17' WHEN OCV_CURR_LOC like 'M 18%' THEN 'M 18' WHEN OCV_CURR_LOC like 'M 19%' THEN 'M 19' WHEN OCV_CURR_LOC like 'M2%' OR OCV_CURR_LOC like 'M 2%' THEN 'M 2' WHEN OCV_CURR_LOC like 'M 4%' THEN 'M 4' WHEN OCV_CURR_LOC like 'M 5%' THEN 'M 5' WHEN OCV_CURR_LOC like 'M 6%' THEN 'M 6' WHEN OCV_CURR_LOC like '%M6 PACU%' THEN 'PACU' WHEN OCV_CURR_LOC like '%M6 Swing%' THEN 'Swing' WHEN OCV_CURR_LOC like 'M 7%' THEN 'M 7' WHEN OCV_CURR_LOC like 'M 8%' THEN 'M 8' WHEN OCV_CURR_LOC like 'M 9%' THEN 'M 9' WHEN OCV_CURR_LOC like '%PACC%' THEN 'PACC' WHEN OCV_CURR_LOC like '%PICU%' THEN 'PICU' END) AS "Location" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM = 'Delirium Screening' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT IN ('Negative', 'Positive', 'Unable to assess') JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = CDD_VISIT_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND CURRENT date

prompt: Total number of CRC patients we have seen from 2009-2019
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PDID_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PT_DEID, PT_SEX AS GENDER, PT_STATE AS STATE , COALESCE(YEAR (PT_DATE_OF_DEATH - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH),YEAR (CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH)) AS AGE , CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('X', 'D', 'C') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS DEATH_IND FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFY ON PT_MRN = PDID_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C18', 'C18.0', 'C18.2', 'C18.3', 'C18.4', 'C18.5', 'C18.6', 'C18.7', 'C18.8', 'C18.9', 'C7A.021', 'C7A.022', 'C7A.023', 'C7A.024', 'C7A.025', '153', '153', '153.1', '153.2', '153.3', '153.4', '153.6', '153.7', '153.8', '153.9', 'C19', 'C19.', 'C20', 'C20.', '154', '154', '154.1', 'C21', 'C21.0', 'C21.1', 'C21.2', 'C21.8', '154.2', '154.3', '154.8') UNION SELECT DISTINCT PDID_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PT_DEID, PT_SEX AS GENDER, PT_STATE AS STATE , COALESCE(YEAR (PT_DATE_OF_DEATH - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH),YEAR (CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH)) AS AGE , CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('X', 'D', 'C') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS DEATH_IND FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBI_MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBI_ACCT_NO = PBD_ACCT_NO AND PBI_INV_NO = PBD_INV_NO JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PBD_DX ON DX_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO AND DX_MRN = PBI_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = DX_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFY ON PT_MRN = PDID_MRN WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND DX_CLSF_CD IN ('C18', 'C18.0', 'C18.2', 'C18.3', 'C18.4', 'C18.5', 'C18.6', 'C18.7', 'C18.8', 'C18.9', 'C7A.021', 'C7A.022', 'C7A.023', 'C7A.024', 'C7A.025', '153', '153', '153.1', '153.2', '153.3', '153.4', '153.6', '153.7', '153.8', '153.9', 'C19', 'C19.', 'C20', 'C20.', '154', '154', '154.1', 'C21', 'C21.0', 'C21.1', 'C21.2', 'C21.8', '154.2', '154.3', '154.8')

prompt: Upcoming Appointment for Kidney Cancer Patients at 68TH Concourse
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C64') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , FAM_HX AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN FAM_HX_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('Z84.1', 'V18.61', 'V18.69') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN ) , PT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, DX_DTE, ICD_CD, ICD_DESC, CPE_ENC_DTE, CHAR(TIME(CPE_APPT_DT), USA) AS "Appt Time", CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CASE WHEN FAM_HX_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END FAM_HX FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN DX ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN FAM_HX ON CPE_MRN = FAM_HX_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 14 DAYS AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'URO' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = '68TH' AND CLD_CLD_PHY_LOC = 'Concourse' ) , GENE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN GENE_MRN, GENE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN PT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE GENE IN ('BAP1', 'PTEN', 'SDHA', 'SDHB', 'SDHC', 'SDHD', 'SDHAF2', 'FH', 'FLCN', 'MET', 'MITF', 'TSC1', 'TSC2', 'VHL') ) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", DX_DTE "Diagnosis Date", ICD_CD "ICD Code", ICD_DESC "ICD Description", CPE_ENC_DTE "Appointment Date", "Appt Time", CLD_DEPT_NAME "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME "Provider", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Visit Type Name", FAM_HX "Fam Hx of Kidney Disease", GENE, PT_PRIMARY_LANG "Primary Language" FROM PT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN GENE ON CPE_MRN = GENE_MRN WHERE PT_PRIMARY_LANG = 'ENG' ORDER BY CPE_MRN, DX_DTE, CPE_ENC_DTE
