prompt: Inpatient and outpatient psychiatry consults for patients age 65 and older. 2016 - 2020.
completion: WITH ORDERS AS (SELECT OO_MRN MRN, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OOC_ITEM_DESC, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE REQUEST_DTE, OSTS_STS_DESC, P.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE - P.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE, P.PT_SEX GENDER FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Psychiatry Outpatient Consult', 'Psychiatry Inpatient Consult') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) >= 2016 ) SELECT MRN, GENDER, AGE AGE_AT_REQUEST_DTE, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, REQUEST_DTE, OOC_ITEM_NAME FROM ORDERS WHERE AGE >= 65 ;

prompt: Addition of extra columns
completion: WITH BASE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, X.PT_LAST_NAME, X.PT_FIRST_NAME, LANG.AV_DESC AS PRIMARY_LANGUAGE, X.PT_SEX AS GENDER, ETH.AV_DESC AS ETHNICITY, RACE.AV_DESC AS RACE, A.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT, B.CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DTE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VISIT_TYPE, TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS APPT_TIME, CASE WHEN P1.ACD_IRB_NO IS NOT NULL AND P1.ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS STATUS_06_107, DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT date) AS DOW, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PID, P2.ACD_IRB_NO AS PROTOCOL, PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE AS PROTOCOL_TYPE, P2.ACD_REG_DTE AS TX_START_DATE, P2.ACD_TX_END_DTE AS TX_END_DATE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT A ON CPE_DEPT_ID = A.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE B ON B.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT X ON CPE_MRN = X.PT_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V Y ON X.PT_MRN = Y.PT_MRN AND Y.PT_MRN <> '' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS LANG ON PT_PRIMARY_LANG = LANG.AV_CODE AND LANG.AV_ELEMENT = 'PRIMARY_LANG' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ETH ON X.PT_PT_ETHNICITY = ETH.AV_CODE AND ETH.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS RACE ON X.PT_RACE = RACE.AV_CODE AND RACE.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES P1 ON CPE_MRN = P1.ACD_MRN AND P1.ACD_IRB_NO = '06-107' LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES P2 ON CPE_MRN = P2.ACD_MRN AND (P2.ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL OR P2.ACD_TX_END_DTE < CURRENT DATE) AND P2.ACD_IRB_NO <> '06-107' JOIN IDB.PROTOCOL ON PRO_IRB_NO = P2.ACD_IRB_NO WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_ENC_DTE = CURRENT DATE + (CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT DATE) = 6 THEN 3 ELSE 1 END) DAY AND A.CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'NAS' AND A.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' ) , IMPORD AS (SELECT DISTINCT PID, 'Ordered' AS ORDVAL FROM BASE INNER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER IMP ON MRN = IMP.OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ORD_DATA ON (IMP.OO_ORD_GUID=ORD_DATA.OUD_ORD_GUID) JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON IMP.OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON IMP.OO_PVDR_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.DOC ON IMP.OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO AND DOC_SOURCE_DESC = 'SMS' WHERE NOT (IMP.OO_ORD_STS_CD='CANC' OR IMP.OO_ORD_STS_CD='CANP') AND IMP.OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '7000003594073029' ) , IMPRES AS (SELECT DISTINCT PID, 'Resulted' AS RESVAL FROM BASE INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V ON PID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE METHOD = 'IMPACT') , IMPFAIL AS (SELECT DISTINCT BASE.PID, 'Failed' AS FAILVAL FROM BASE LEFT JOIN IMPRES ON BASE.PID = IMPRES.PID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT ON BASE.PID = PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPT_REPORT_TYPE = PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD WHERE IMPRES.PID IS NULL AND ((CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '("TEST FAILURE" & "MSK-IMPACT")') = 1 AND PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC = 'Diagnostic Molecular Pathology') AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL)) , IMPPROCESS AS (SELECT DISTINCT BASE.PID, 'In Process' AS INPVAL FROM BASE LEFT JOIN IMPRES ON BASE.PID = IMPRES.PID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT ON BASE.PID = PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPT_REPORT_TYPE = PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD WHERE IMPRES.PID IS NULL AND ((CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '("MATCHED NORMAL" & "MSK-IMPACT")') = 1 AND PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC = 'Diagnostic Molecular Pathology') AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL) ) , IMPBASE AS (SELECT DISTINCT BASE.PID, 'Registered' AS IMPCONS FROM BASE INNER JOIN DV.ACCRUALS ON AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = BASE.PID INNER JOIN DV.PROTOCOL ON AC_PROTOCOL_ID = PRO_PROTOCOL_ID WHERE PRO_IRB_NO = '12-245' ) , ALLIMP AS (SELECT BASE.PID AS ALLIMPPID, 'Registered' || CASE WHEN IMPRES.PID IS NOT NULL THEN CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ' ' || 'Resulted' WHEN IMPFAIL.PID IS NOT NULL THEN CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ' ' || 'Failed' WHEN IMPPROCESS.PID IS NOT NULL THEN CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ' ' || 'In Process' WHEN IMPORD.PID IS NOT NULL THEN CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ' ' || 'Ordered' ELSE '' END AS IMPSTATUS FROM IMPBASE AS BASE LEFT JOIN IMPPROCESS ON BASE.PID = IMPPROCESS.PID LEFT JOIN IMPFAIL ON BASE.PID = IMPFAIL.PID LEFT JOIN IMPRES ON BASE.PID = IMPRES.PID LEFT JOIN IMPORD ON BASE.PID = IMPORD.PID) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PRIMARY_LANGUAGE AS LANGUAGE , GENDER AS SEX, ETHNICITY, RACE, DEPARTMENT, PROVIDER, APPT_DTE, VISIT_TYPE, APPT_TIME, STATUS_06_107 , IMPSTATUS AS IMPACT_STATUS, PROTOCOL, PROTOCOL_TYPE, TX_START_DATE, TX_END_DATE FROM BASE LEFT JOIN ALLIMP ON BASE.PID = ALLIMPPID WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY APPT_DTE, APPT_TIME

prompt: Provide a list of pediatric patients with 2+ diagnosis, with one of those diagnosis being a sarcoma
completion: WITH SAR AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS DX_AGE, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, CATEGORY1, CATEGORY2, CATEGORY3, CATEGORY4, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = DV.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK like '%SAR%' ) , TM1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS DX_AGE, TM_DX_DTE, CATEGORY1, CATEGORY2, CATEGORY3, CATEGORY4, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = DV.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM SAR) ) , TM2 AS (SELECT MRN, COUNT(*) AS DX_COUNT FROM TM1 GROUP BY MRN HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) , TM3 AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM1.* FROM TM1 WHERE MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM TM2) ) , TM4 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, DX_AGE, TM_DX_DTE, CATEGORY1, SITE_CODE, SITE_DESC, HIST_CODE, HIST_DESC FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN TM3 ON PT_MRN = MRN) , PEDS AS (SELECT P.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RN FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN FROM TM4) T ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PED') P) , PEDS1 AS (SELECT * FROM PEDS WHERE RN = 1 ) SELECT TM4.*, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 FROM TM4 JOIN PEDS1 ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of patient MRNs and healthcare resource utilization for patients diagnosed with rectal cancer and undergoing Low Anterior Resection or Abdominoperineal Resection procedures between 2008-2012.
completion: WITH DIAG AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, CC_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('C19', 'C20') OR CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('154.0', '154.1')) AND CLM_CD_TYPE = 'D' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2012-12-31' ) , PROC AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, MIN(SSE_SURG_DTE) OVER(PARTITION BY SSE_MRN, SSP_PROC_NAME)SURGERY_START_DATE, MAX(SSE_SURG_DTE) OVER(PARTITION BY SSE_MRN, SSP_PROC_NAME) SURGERY_END_DATE, SSP_PROC_NAME, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC FROM DIAG JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON CC_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('45110', '45395', '44145', '44207', '44146', '44208') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2012-12-31' ) , DEMO AS (SELECT C.SSE_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, TM_DX_DTE DIAGNOSIS_DATE, TM_CLIN_TNM_T, TM_CLIN_TNM_N, TM_CLIN_TNM_M , R.AV_DESC AS "Race" , E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", SURGERY_START_DATE, SURGERY_END_DATE, SSP_PROC_NAME SURGERY_NAME, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE FROM PROC C JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON SSE_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY PLA ON SSE_MRN = PLA_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT * FROM DEMO ; WITH DIAG AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('C19', 'C20') OR CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('154.0', '154.1')) AND CLM_CD_TYPE = 'D' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2012-12-31' ), PROC AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, MIN(SSE_SURG_DTE) OVER(PARTITION BY SSE_MRN)SURGERY_START_DATE, MAX(SSE_SURG_DTE) OVER(PARTITION BY SSE_MRN) SURGERY_END_DATE, SSP_PROC_NAME, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM DIAG JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON CC_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('45110', '45395', '44145', '44207', '44146', '44208') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2012-12-31' ) , DEMO AS (SELECT C.*, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, TM_DX_DTE DIAGNOSIS_DATE, TM_CLIN_TNM_T, TM_CLIN_TNM_N, TM_CLIN_TNM_M , R.AV_DESC AS "Race" , E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE FROM PROC C JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON SSE_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY PLA ON SSE_MRN = PLA_MRN) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, MIN (APR_START_DTE) OVER(PARTITION BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) CHEMO_START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) OVER(PARTITION BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) CHEMO_END_DATE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE FROM DEMO D LEFT JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON SSE_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' ) SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, DIAGNOSIS_DATE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, CHEMO_START_DATE, CHEMO_END_DATE, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE FROM DEMO D JOIN CHEMO ON SSE_MRN = APR_MRN ; WITH DIAG AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('C19', 'C20') OR CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('154.0', '154.1')) AND CLM_CD_TYPE = 'D' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2012-12-31' ), PROC AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, MIN(SSE_SURG_DTE) OVER(PARTITION BY SSE_MRN)SURGERY_START_DATE, MAX(SSE_SURG_DTE) OVER(PARTITION BY SSE_MRN) SURGERY_END_DATE, SSP_PROC_NAME, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC FROM DIAG JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON CC_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('45110', '45395', '44145', '44207', '44146', '44208') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2012-12-31' ) , DEMO AS (SELECT C.*, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, TM_DX_DTE DIAGNOSIS_DATE, TM_CLIN_TNM_T, TM_CLIN_TNM_N, TM_CLIN_TNM_M , R.AV_DESC AS "Race" , E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE FROM PROC C JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON SSE_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY PLA ON SSE_MRN = PLA_MRN) , RADIOLOGY AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME FROM PROC JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON SSE_MRN =RTC_TX_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT D.SSE_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, DIAGNOSIS_DATE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME RADIATION_SITE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE RADIATION_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE RADIATION_START_DATE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE RADIATION_END_DATE FROM DEMO D JOIN RADIOLOGY V ON D.SSE_MRN = V.SSE_MRN ;

prompt: Determine the percentage of patients with colorectal cancer who are enrolled in the patient portal.
completion: WITH ETO AS (SELECT CPP_MRN, CPP_PT_NAME, CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE, CPP_PP_INT_CD FROM IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT WHERE CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE IS NOT NULL AND CPP_MRN > '' ) , CA AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_EFF_DTE FROM (SELECT CC_MRN , CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, CC_EFF_DTE , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CC_MRN ORDER BY TIMESTAMP(CC_EFF_DTE, CC_EFF_TME)) RN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = CC_CLSF_CD WHERE (CLM_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C18%' OR CLM_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C19%' OR CLM_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C20%' OR CLM_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C21%' OR CLM_CLSF_CD LIKE '153%' OR CLM_CLSF_CD LIKE '154%') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'D%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) AS A WHERE RN = 1 ) SELECT YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) DX_YEAR, COUNT(CC_MRN) PTS, SUM(CASE WHEN CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) PP_LOGIN, SUM(CASE WHEN CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)*1.00/COUNT(CC_MRN)*1.00 FROM CA LEFT JOIN ETO ON CPP_MRN = CC_MRN GROUP BY YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE)

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with ADRENAL CORTICAL CARCINOMA that received radiation to either liver or adrenal gland.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, AV_DESC AS GRADE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'HIST_CD_GRADE' AND TM_HIST_CD_GRADE = AV_CODE WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8370/3') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2021-01-31' UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS HIST_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, '' AS SITE_CODE, '' AS SITE_DESC, '' AS GRADE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('194.0', 'C74', 'C74.0', 'C74.00', 'C74.01', 'C74.02', 'C74.1', 'C74.10', 'C74.11', 'C74.12', 'C74.9', 'C74.90', 'C74.91', 'C74.92') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, '', '', '' HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2021-01-31') , RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN DX ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN WHERE UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) like '%ADR%' OR UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) like '%LIV%' OR UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) like '%ABD%' OR UPPER(RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT) like '%ADR%' OR UPPER(RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT) like '%LIV%' OR UPPER(RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT) like '%ABD%' ) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT DX.* FROM DX JOIN RT ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN) , CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN AS DX_MRN, DX_DATE, STRIP(HIST_CODE) || ' - ' || STRIP(HIST_DESC) || ' | ' || STRIP(SITE_CODE) || ' - ' || STRIP(SITE_DESC) || ' | ' || STRIP(GRADE) AS DX_CODE FROM X) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(8000))||' | '||CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(200)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(200))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(200))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN, RN, DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) , Y AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_SEX AS GENDER, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, DX FROM T4 JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY') , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS END_DATE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN Y ON APR_MRN = MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ) , CHEMO2 AS (SELECT APR_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(START_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(END_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY APR_MRN, START_DATE, END_DATE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) AS CHEMO FROM CHEMO GROUP BY APR_MRN) , SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM Y JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC like '%EMBOL%' ) , SRG2 AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(SSE_SURG_DTE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) AS SRG FROM SRG GROUP BY SSE_MRN) SELECT Y.*, RT, CHEMO, SRG FROM Y LEFT JOIN RT2 ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN SRG2 ON SSE_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN CHEMO2 ON APR_MRN = MRN

prompt: Provide a list of patients who have received radiation tx (SRS and SBRT) at their CNS.
completion: WITH GUIDS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_DOC_GUID GUID FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION S ON CDD_MRN = S.CDO_MRN AND CDD_DOC_GUID = S.CDO_DOC_GUID AND S.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Treatment Site 1:' AND S.CDO_VALUE_TEXT = 'CNS' JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION T ON CDD_MRN = T.CDO_MRN AND CDD_DOC_GUID = T.CDO_DOC_GUID AND T.CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Subsite 1', 'Treatment Technique:', 'Subsite 4', 'Subsite 3', 'Subsite 2') AND T.CDO_VALUE_TEXT IN ('Stereotactic Body Radiation Therapy (SBRT)', 'Stereotactic Body Radiation Therapy (SRS)', 'Stereotactic Radiosurgery (SRS)') WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME like 'Simulation Order - Rad Onc' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2023-10-23' AND CURRENT date ) SELECT , CDD_MRN , CDD_SERVICE_DTE SERVICE_DATE , MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Treatment Location:' THEN STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) "Treatment Location" , MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Sim Location:' THEN STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) "Sim Location" , MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Estimated Number of PTVs') THEN STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) "Estimated Number of PTVs" , MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Total Dose (cGy): cGy', 'Total Dose (cGy):') THEN STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) "Total dose" , MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Dose/Fraction') THEN STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) "Dose/Fraction" FROM GUIDS JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_MRN = CDO_MRN AND CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Sim Location:', 'Total Dose (cGy): cGy', 'Total Dose (cGy):', 'Dose/Fraction', 'Treatment Location:', 'Estimated Number of PTVs') GROUP BY CDD_DOC_GUID , CDD_MRN , CDD_DOC_NAME , CDD_SERVICE_DTE

prompt: Provide a list of patients scheduled as IRs with Supportive Care APP Andrea Dolan in 2019.
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", RES.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", REF.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Referring Provider Name" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE RES ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = RES.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = REF.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND RES.CRE_RES_NAME = 'DOLAN, ANDREA JEAN' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%')

prompt: Provide surgical pathology reports for patients from previous request.
completion: WITH CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, CS.AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_CA_SURG_DTE, TM_SURG_DEF_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE 1 = 1 AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C019', 'C028', 'C029', 'C050', 'C051', 'C052', 'C058', 'C059', 'C068', 'C069', 'C090', 'C091', 'C099', 'C100', 'C101', 'C102', 'C103', 'C108', 'C109', 'C020', 'C024', 'C028', 'C058', 'C098', 'C104', 'C140', 'C142', 'C148') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2020-12-31'), ICD9 AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS "First ICD-9 Date" FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('141.0', '141.5', '141.8', '141.9', '145.3', '145.4', '145.5', '145.8', '145.9', '146', '146.0', '146.1', '146.2', '146.3', '146.4', '146.5', '146.6', '146.7', '146.8', '146.9', '149', '149.8', '141.1', '141.6', '149.1', 'C01', 'C01.9', 'C02.4', 'C02.8', 'C02.9', 'C05.1', 'C05.2', 'C05.8', 'C05.9', 'C06.80', 'C06.89', 'C06.9', 'C09.8', 'C09.9', 'C09.0', 'C09.1', 'C10.0', 'C10.1', 'C10.8', 'C10.2', 'C10.3', 'C10.4', 'C10.8', 'C10.9', 'C14.0', 'C14.8', 'C11.1') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' GROUP BY CC_MRN), COMBINED_MRNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN FROM CDB UNION SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN AS MRN FROM ICD9), SKI26369_MRNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN COMBINED_MRNS ON PT_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN CDB ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN ICD9 ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN) SELECT PRPT_MRN AS "MRN", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS "REPORT TYPE", PRPT_REPORT AS "REPORT", PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS "DATE" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT AS A ON PRPT_MRN = A.PT_MRN JOIN SKI26369_MRNS AS B ON PRPT_MRN = B.PT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC = 'Surgical Pathology' AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2020-12-31'

prompt: I would like to evaluate pruritus in cutaneous and systemic B and T-cell lymphomas and use of aprepitant in lymphomas
completion: WITH ETO AS (SELECT TM_MRN , STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH DOD, PT_SEX GENDER , TM_DX_DTE DX_DTE , TM_SITE_CD SITE_CD, ST.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD HIST_CD, HT.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ST ON ST.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.CLM HT ON HT.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD WHERE TM_HIST_CD IN('M9702/3', 'M9705/3', 'M9706/3', 'M9707/3', 'M9713/3', 'M9717/3', 'M9718/3', 'M9719/3', 'M9724/3', 'M9729/3', 'M9827/3', 'M9831/1', 'M9831/3', 'M9679/3', 'M9689/3', 'M9699/3', 'M9711/3', 'M9728/3', 'M9833/3') AND TM_CASE_STS = '3' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' ) , PRURITUS AS (SELECT CC_MRN, DX_CD, DX_DESC, FST_DX_DTE FROM (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD DX_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK DX_DESC, CC_EFF_DTE FST_DX_DTE , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CC_MRN ORDER BY CC_EFF_DTE) RN FROM ETO JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON TM_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('L29', 'L29.0', 'L29.1', 'L29.2', 'L29.3', 'L29.8', 'L29.9', '698', '698.0', '698.1') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'D%' AND ((CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE = 'O') OR CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') ) AS A WHERE RN = 1 ) , PHARMA AS (SELECT MRN, DRUG_NAME, MIN(ADMIN_DTE) AS FIRST_DTE, MAX(ADMIN_DTE) AS LAST_DTE, SUM(DOSE) AS TOTAL_DOSE, DOSE_UOM, SUM(DISPENSES) DISPENSES FROM (SELECT MRN, DRUG_NAME, START_DATE ADMIN_DTE, DOSE, DOSE_UOM, DISPENSE_CNT AS DISPENSES FROM ETO JOIN IDB.SRX_PHARMACY_SUM ON MRN = TM_MRN WHERE UPPER(DRUG_NAME) LIKE 'APREPITANT%' UNION ALL SELECT PO_MRN AS MRN, UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) AS DRUG_NAME , PAA_ADMIN_DTE AS ADMIN_DTE , POI_DOSE*SUM(INT(PAA_DOSES)) AS DOSE , POI_DOSE_UNIT AS DOSE_UOM , SUM(INT(PAA_DOSES)) DISPENSES FROM ETO JOIN IDB.PHM_ORDER ON TM_MRN = PO_MRN JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL ON PO_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_INV ON POD_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ AND POD_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO JOIN IDB.PHM_INVENTORY ON POI_INV_SEQ = PIN_INV_SEQ AND PIN_GENERIC_SEQ = 1145 JOIN IDB.PHM_AUD_ADMIN ON PAA_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ AND PAA_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO AND PAA_ORD_INV_SEQ = POI_ORD_INV_SEQ WHERE POD_STRT_DTE <= CURRENT DATE AND PO_ORD_STS NOT IN ('X', 'P') GROUP BY PO_MRN, PIN_GENERIC_NAME, PAA_ADMIN_DTE, POI_DOSE, POI_DOSE_UNIT HAVING SUM(INT(PAA_DOSES)) > 0) CHEMO GROUP BY MRN, DRUG_NAME, DOSE_UOM) SELECT TM_MRN MRN, PT_NAME, DOB, DOD, GENDER, DX_DTE, SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, DX_CD, DX_DESC, FST_DX_DTE , DRUG_NAME, FIRST_DTE, LAST_DTE, TOTAL_DOSE, DOSE_UOM, DISPENSES FROM ETO LEFT JOIN PRURITUS ON TM_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN PHARMA ON TM_MRN = MRN

prompt: IMPACT patients with completed chemo order for drug name like '%parib%'
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT G.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID , PRPT_MRN , LISTAGG(TRIM(PRPT_ACCESSION_NO), ', ') IMPACT_ACCESSION_NOS, MIN(PRPT_REPORT_DTE) FIRST_IMPACT_REPORT_DATE, MAX(PRPT_REPORT_DTE) LAST_IMPACT_REPORT_DATE FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS G JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON G.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DMP_PATIENT_ID VARCHAR(264) PATH 'dmp_patient_id' , DMP_ALYS_TASK_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'dmp_alys_task_name' , DMP_SAMPLE_ID VARCHAR(264) PATH 'dmp_sample_id' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-score' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-type') T WHERE DMP_ALYS_TASK_NAME like 'IMPACTv%' AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC <> 'Diagnostic Molecular Genetics' GROUP BY G.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PRPT_MRN) , CPO AS (SELECT C.*, IMPACT_ACCESSION_NOS, FIRST_IMPACT_REPORT_DATE, LAST_IMPACT_REPORT_DATE FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON P_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN IDB.CHEMO_PERFORMED_ORDERS C ON PT_MRN = CPO_MRN WHERE LOWER(CPO_DRUG_NAME) like '%parib%' AND CPO_DRUG_NAME NOT IN ('BSI-201 (Iniparib) INVEST') ) , CPO2 AS (SELECT MRN , ' | ' || LISTAGG(FIRST_START_DTE || ' - ' || RIGHT(' '||COUNT_OF_ORDERS, 3) || ' - ' || TRIM(CPO_DRUG_NAME) || ' | ', '') "Completed Orders: first start date - count of orders - drug name" FROM (SELECT CPO_MRN MRN, MIN(CPO_START_DTE) FIRST_START_DTE , COUNT(CPO_START_DTE) COUNT_OF_ORDERS , CPO_DRUG_NAME FROM CPO GROUP BY CPO_MRN, CPO_DRUG_NAME ) T GROUP BY MRN ) , HML AS (SELECT P_ID, MRN, MIN(START_DATE) FIRST_START_DATE, LISTAGG(HCPR_DRUG_NAME, ', ') AS DRUGS FROM (SELECT P_ID, HCPR_MRN MRN, HCPR_DRUG_NAME, MIN(DATE(HCPR_START_DT)) START_DATE FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON P_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION B ON HCPR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND (LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) like '%parib%' OR LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) like '%rubraca%' OR LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) like '%talzenna%' OR LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) like '%zejula%' OR LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) like '%lynparza%') GROUP BY P_ID, HCPR_MRN, HCPR_DRUG_NAME) T GROUP BY P_ID, MRN) , FIN AS (SELECT U.MRN, FIRST_START_DATE HOME_MED_FIRST_DATE, DRUGS HOME_MED_DRUGS, "Completed Orders: first start date - count of orders - drug name", IMPACT_ACCESSION_NOS, FIRST_IMPACT_REPORT_DATE, LAST_IMPACT_REPORT_DATE FROM (SELECT MRN FROM HML UNION SELECT MRN FROM CPO2) U JOIN PTS ON U.MRN = PTS.PRPT_MRN LEFT JOIN CPO2 ON CPO2.MRN = U.MRN LEFT JOIN HML ON HML.MRN = U.MRN) SELECT * FROM FIN; WITH PTS AS (SELECT G.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID , PRPT_MRN , LISTAGG(TRIM(PRPT_ACCESSION_NO), ', ') IMPACT_ACCESSION_NOS, MIN(PRPT_REPORT_DTE) FIRST_IMPACT_REPORT_DATE, MAX(PRPT_REPORT_DTE) LAST_IMPACT_REPORT_DATE FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS G JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON G.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DMP_PATIENT_ID VARCHAR(264) PATH 'dmp_patient_id' , DMP_ALYS_TASK_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'dmp_alys_task_name' , DMP_SAMPLE_ID VARCHAR(264) PATH 'dmp_sample_id' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-score' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-type') T WHERE DMP_ALYS_TASK_NAME like 'IMPACTv%' AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC <> 'Diagnostic Molecular Genetics' GROUP BY G.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PRPT_MRN) , CPO AS (SELECT PT_MRN MRN, C.APR_START_DTE START_DTE, C.APR_DRUG_NAME DRUG_NAME, IMPACT_ACCESSION_NOS, FIRST_IMPACT_REPORT_DATE, LAST_IMPACT_REPORT_DATE FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON P_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V C ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE LOWER(APR_DRUG_NAME) like '%parib%' AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME NOT IN ('INIPARIB (BSI-201)') AND APR_GENERIC_NAME NOT IN ('BSI-201') ) , CPO2 AS (SELECT MRN , ' | ' || LISTAGG(FIRST_START_DTE || ' - ' || RIGHT(' '||COUNT_OF_ORDERS, 3) || ' - ' || TRIM(DRUG_NAME) || ' | ', '') "Completed Orders: first start date - count of orders - drug name" FROM (SELECT MRN, MIN(START_DTE) FIRST_START_DTE , COUNT(START_DTE) COUNT_OF_ORDERS , DRUG_NAME FROM CPO GROUP BY MRN, DRUG_NAME ) T GROUP BY MRN ) , HML AS (SELECT P_ID, MRN, MIN(START_DATE) FIRST_START_DATE, LISTAGG(HCPR_DRUG_NAME, ', ') AS DRUGS FROM (SELECT P_ID, HCPR_MRN MRN, HCPR_DRUG_NAME, MIN(DATE(HCPR_START_DT)) START_DATE FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON P_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION B ON HCPR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND (LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) like '%parib%' OR LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) like '%rubraca%' OR LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) like '%talzenna%' OR LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) like '%zejula%' OR LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) like '%lynparza%') GROUP BY P_ID, HCPR_MRN, HCPR_DRUG_NAME) T GROUP BY P_ID, MRN) , FIN AS (SELECT U.MRN, FIRST_START_DATE HOME_MED_FIRST_DATE, DRUGS HOME_MED_DRUGS, "Completed Orders: first start date - count of orders - drug name", IMPACT_ACCESSION_NOS, FIRST_IMPACT_REPORT_DATE, LAST_IMPACT_REPORT_DATE FROM (SELECT MRN FROM HML UNION SELECT MRN FROM CPO2) U JOIN PTS ON U.MRN = PTS.PRPT_MRN LEFT JOIN CPO2 ON CPO2.MRN = U.MRN LEFT JOIN HML ON HML.MRN = U.MRN) SELECT * FROM FIN;

prompt: Volume of central line dressing changes for pre-transplant patients by user. This information will be used to establish staffing model.
completion: WITH ETO AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_DOC_NAME DOCNAME, CDD_DOC_GUID DOCGUID, CDD_MRN MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE DOS, CDD_ENTER_DTE ENTER_DTE, OU_DISPLAY_NAME ENTERED_BY, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE ENTEREDBY_ROLE, OCV_CURR_LOC LOCATION, OCV_IP_OP_IND IP_OP_IND, CDO_SECTION SECTIONNAME, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM CATALOGNAME, CDO_ITEM_NAME ITEMNAME, SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 255) DRESSING FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON CDD_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID WHERE CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-03-31' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND OCV_CURR_LOC LIKE '%1275%' AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'O' AND (CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM = 'CVC Interventions' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN('CVAD Care Provided details', 'CVAD Care Provided')) AND UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%DRESSING%CHANG%' ), HSCT AS (SELECT HSCT_MRN, DOS, HSCT_DOS, HSCT_DATE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS HSCT_MRN, DOS, CDD_SERVICE_DTE HSCT_DOS, SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 22) AS HSCT_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN, DOS ORDER BY ABS(DAYS(DOS) - DAYS(CDD_SERVICE_DTE)) ASC) RN FROM ETO JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON CDD_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID WHERE CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-03-31' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND OCV_CURR_LOC LIKE '%1275%' AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'O' AND (CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM = 'HSCT Date') AND CDO_ITEM_NAME ='HSCT Date' ) AS A WHERE RN = 1) , CVAD AS (SELECT DISTINCT CVAD_MRN, DOS, CVAD_DOS, CVAD_IND FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS CVAD_MRN, DOS, CDD_SERVICE_DTE CVAD_DOS, SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 5) AS CVAD_IND, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN, DOS ORDER BY ABS(DAYS(DOS) - DAYS(CDD_SERVICE_DTE)) ASC) RN FROM ETO JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON CDD_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID WHERE CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-03-31' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND OCV_CURR_LOC LIKE '%1275%' AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'O' AND (CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM = 'CVAD Assessment' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Central Venous Access Device (CVAD) Present') ) AS A WHERE RN = 1 ) SELECT DOCNAME, MRN, ETO.DOS, ENTER_DTE, ENTERED_BY, ENTEREDBY_ROLE, LOCATION, IP_OP_IND, ITEMNAME, DRESSING, HSCT_DATE, CVAD_IND FROM ETO JOIN HSCT ON MRN = HSCT_MRN AND ETO.DOS = HSCT.DOS LEFT JOIN CVAD ON MRN = CVAD_MRN AND ETO.DOS = CVAD.DOS

prompt: The percentage of MSK patients in a year (2019, 2020, 2021,2022) that receive any of the following: radiotherapy (ie. radiation oncology), radiopharmaceutical therapy, and or undergo a diagnostic radiology procedure.
completion: WITH INIT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN AS MRN, YEAR(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) AS YEAR FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' AND RRPT_ORDER_GROUP NOT IN ('MR', 'MR RO') UNION SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN AS MRN, YEAR(RTC_TX_START_DTE) AS YEAR FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE WHERE RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' ), RADIOLOGY AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' AND RRPT_ORDER_GROUP NOT IN ('MR', 'MR RO') ), RADONC AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE WHERE RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' ), FINAL AS (SELECT YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT MRN) AS COUNT_OF_MRN, COUNT(DISTINCT RRPT_MRN) RAD_MRN, COUNT(DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN) RADONC_MRN, COUNT(DISTINCT RRPT_MRN)*100.0 RADIOLOGY_PER, COUNT(DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN)*100.0 RADONC_PER FROM INIT LEFT JOIN RADIOLOGY ON MRN = RRPT_MRN LEFT JOIN RADONC ON MRN = RTC_TX_MRN GROUP BY YEAR ORDER BY YEAR) SELECT YEAR, COUNT_OF_MRN, RAD_MRN, RADONC_MRN, RADIOLOGY_PER/COUNT_OF_MRN PERCENTAGE_RADIOLOGY, RADONC_PER/COUNT_OF_MRN PERCENTAGE_RADONC FROM FINAL ;

prompt: Provide a list of MRNs with documentation containing the string term of 'wound clinic' or 'wound center'
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME , CDD_DOC_NAME AS "DOCUMENT NAME" , CDD_SERVICE_DTE "SERVICE DATE" FROM DV.CLINDOC_FULL_TEXT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' AND (CONTAINS(CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT, '("wound clinic")') = 1 OR CONTAINS(CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT, '("wound center")') = 1) AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0'

prompt: Identify patients with Inflammatory Breast Cancer at MSKCC. Determine their response to therapy. With the advent of new standard approaches to the treatment of early stage disease, we would like to know if these patients have improved responses compared to prior less effective regimens.
completion: WITH SCH AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "NA_MRN", MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS "Next Appt Date" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') GROUP BY CPE_MRN HAVING MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 7 DAY), DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS DX_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN SCH ON TM_MRN = NA_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8530/3') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN SCH ON NA_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('611.0' ,'N61.0' ,'N61.1') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) SELECT DISTINCT COUNT(NA_MRN) AS "COUNT_OF_MRN" FROM SCH JOIN DX ON NA_MRN = DX_MRN

prompt: Provide a lit of pediatric outpatients having labs drawn, to time of result, to Clearance to Treat (CTT) order released to become more operationally efficient and review benefit of CTT order, during 2 different time periods (Nov 2022 - Mar 2023 vs Nov 2023 - Mar 2024).
completion: WITH PACC AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) "Appt Time", TIME(CPE_RM_IN_DT) "Room in Time", TIME(CPE_RM_OUT_DT) "Room out Time", STRIP(D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6) AS "Department", STRIP(D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8) AS "Service", STRIP(D.CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS "Dept Name", STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Provider Name", STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Visit Type", STRIP(REF.CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS "Ref Dept Name" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT D ON CPE_DEPT_ID = D.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT REF ON CPE_REF_DEP_ID = REF.CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2023-11-01' AND '2024-03-31' AND D.CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('PACC BED 1275') AND REF.CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('PEDS LEU LYM 1275', 'PEDS LEU LYM 1275 APP') ) , LAB AS (SELECT LR_MRN, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_STS_CD, LR_PERFORMED_DTE , MIN(CASE WHEN OSH_FUNCTION_CD='12' AND OSH_ORD_STS_CD = 'SPRV' THEN OSH_CREATE_DT END) SPECIMEN_RECEIVED , MIN(CASE WHEN OSH_ORD_STS_CD IN ('RESF', 'RESC') THEN OSH_CREATE_DT END) RESULTS_RECEIVED FROM PACC JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON "MRN" = LR_MRN AND "Appt Date" = LR_PERFORMED_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON LR_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX ON OO_ORD_GUID = OSH_ORD_GUID WHERE LR_TEST_NAME IN ('Complete Blood Count (CBC), Standard', 'Complete Blood Count (CBC), with ANC only', 'Complete Blood Count (CBC), WITH Differential', 'Comp. Metabolic Panel & Direct Bilirubin', 'Comprehensive Metabolic Panel') AND LR_RESULT_STS_CD IN ('F', 'C') GROUP BY LR_MRN, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_STS_CD, LR_PERFORMED_DTE ) , ORD AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ENTER_DT FROM PACC JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON "MRN" = OO_MRN AND "Appt Date" = OO_ENTER_DTE WHERE OO_ORD_NAME IN ('Pediatric Clearance for Chemo Tx') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') ) , X AS (SELECT "MRN", "Appt Date", "Appt Time", "Room in Time", "Room out Time", "Department", "Service", "Dept Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", "Ref Dept Name", STRIP(LR_TEST_NAME) LR_TEST_NAME, TIME(SPECIMEN_RECEIVED) SPECIMEN_RECEIVED, TIME(RESULTS_RECEIVED) RESULTS_RECEIVED, STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME) ORDER_NAME, TIME(OO_ENTER_DT) ORDER_ENTERED_DT FROM PACC LEFT JOIN LAB ON "MRN" = LR_MRN AND "Appt Date" = LR_PERFORMED_DTE LEFT JOIN ORD ON "MRN" = OO_MRN AND "Appt Date" = OO_ENTER_DTE) , CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, STRIP(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) AS CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_ORDER_SOURCE, APR_START_DT, APR_END_DT, APR_ROUTE, APR_TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_DOSE_UOM, APR_DISPENSE_CNT FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND UPPER(CDG_DRUG_TYPE) like 'ANTI%NEOPLASTIC%' AND APR_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM PACC) AND UPPER(APR_ROUTE) not like '%ORAL%' AND UPPER(APR_ROUTE) not like '%TUBE%' AND APR_ORDER_SOURCE = 'CPO' AND APR_DRUG_PROCESS_STAGE <> 'H' ) SELECT DISTINCT X.*, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_END_DT FROM X LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON MRN = APR_MRN AND "Appt Date" = DATE(APR_END_DT) ;

prompt: Provide a report on female patients with a breast MRI and breast MRI biopsy, and a separate report on female patients with a breast MRI and a breast MRI needle localization.
completion: WITH BREAST_MRI AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, 'BREAST MRI' AS TYPE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CLD_DEPT_ID = CPE_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE PT_SEX = 'F' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2002-01-01' AND '2010-08-31' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('MR 3T BREAST BILAT W/O CONTR', 'MR 3T BREAST UNILAT W/O CONT,L', 'MR 3T BREAST UNILAT W/O CONT,R', 'MR 3T BREAST UNILATERAL, LEFT', 'MR 3T BREAST UNILATERAL, RIGHT', 'MR 3T BREAST W/CONTRAST BILAT', 'MR 3T BREAST W/CONTRAST LEFT', 'MR 3T BREAST W/CONTRAST RIGHT', 'MR 3T BREAST, BILATERAL', 'MR BREAST BILATERAL W/O CONTR', 'MR BREAST UNILAT W/O CONTR,L', 'MR BREAST UNILAT W/O CONTR,R', 'MR BREAST UNILATERAL, LEFT', 'MR BREAST UNILATERAL, RIGHT', 'MR BREAST W/CONTRAST BILAT', 'MR BREAST W/CONTRAST LEFT', 'MR BREAST W/CONTRAST RIGHT', 'MR BREAST, BILATERAL') ), BREAST_MRI_BIOPSY AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, 'BREAST MRI BIOPSY' AS TYPE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CLD_DEPT_ID = CPE_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE PT_SEX = 'F' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2002-01-01' AND '2010-08-31' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('MR BREAST BIOPSY, RIGHT', 'MR BREAST BIOPSY, LEFT', 'MR BREAST BIOPSY, BILATERAL', 'MR BREAST BIOPSY 2 SITES LEFT', 'MR BREAST BIOPSY 2 SITES RIGHT', 'BI BREAST BIOPSY BILAT', 'BI BREAST BIOPSY LEFT', 'BI BREAST BIOPSY RIGHT', 'MR BREAST BIOPSY BILAT X3', 'MR BREAST BIOPSY BILAT X4') ) SELECT * FROM BREAST_MRI WHERE PT_MRN IN (SELECT PT_MRN FROM BREAST_MRI_BIOPSY) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM BREAST_MRI_BIOPSY WHERE PT_MRN IN (SELECT PT_MRN FROM BREAST_MRI)

prompt: Please provide a list of all patients who underwent hepatic artery embolization and ablation from 2010 to date and had flow cytometry performed before and after the procedure (within 3 months)
completion: WITH SRG AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC IN ('EMBOLIZATION, ARTERIAL TUMOR HEPATIC', 'ABLTJ 1/> LVR TUM PRQ RF') AND SSE_SURG_DTE >= '2010-01-01' ) , LAB AS (SELECT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS LAB_DRAWN_DATE, LR_TEST_NAME AS TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, LTL_TEXT_RESULT AS TEXT_RESULT FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS JOIN SRG ON LR_MRN = SSE_MRN AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN SSE_SURG_DTE - 91 DAYS AND SSE_SURG_DTE + 91 DAYS LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE LR_TEST_NAME LIKE 'Flow Cytometry%' ) SELECT SSE_MRN AS MRN , SSE_SURG_DTE AS IR_DATE , SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS IR_DESC , LAB_DRAWN_DATE , TEST_NAME , SUBTEST_NAME , RESULT , TEXT_RESULT FROM SRG JOIN LAB ON SSE_MRN = LR_MRN

prompt: Identify all black men with prostate cancer who are linked to the specified providers
completion: WITH CTC AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE PT_RACE = '2' AND PT_SEX = 'M' AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL AND CC_CLSF_CD = '185' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN), CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE PT_RACE = '2' AND PT_SEX = 'M' AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL AND TM_SITE_CD = 'C619' AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') ) SELECT CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS MAX_APPT_DTE, CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, MIN_ICD9_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN CTC ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CRE_RES_NAME IN ('SCHER, HOWARD', 'RATHKOPF, DANA', 'DANILA, DANIEL', 'SLOVIN, SUSAN', 'KAMPEL, LEWIS', 'BASCH, ETHAN M', 'MILOWSKY, MATTHEW IVAN') AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND COALESCE(CC_MRN, TM_MRN) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, MIN_ICD9_DTE

prompt: Provide available IMPACT data for a pre-determined list of patients under IRB 22-267.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_SEX AS GENDER, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity" FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' WHERE PT_MRN IN () ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, DOB, GENDER, "Race", "Ethnicity", PDRX_ACCESSION_NO AS ACC_NO, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED:[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSTIC INTERPRETATION:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED:[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSTIC INTERPRETATION:)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED:[\w\W]*(?=PROCEDURES/ADDENDA)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED:[\w\W]*(?=PROCEDURES/ADDENDA)', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS "SPECIMENS SUBMITTED", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS PRPT_REPORT, T.* FROM X JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN = MRN JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON PDRX_ACCESSION_NO = PRPT_ACCESSION_NO CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH '../meta-data/is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site', DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure', MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'msi-score', MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'msi-type', MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(100) PATH 'msi-comment', VARIANT_CLASS VARCHAR(100) PATH 'variant_class', SITE1_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site1_gene', SITE2_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site2_gene', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', EXON_NUM VARCHAR(100) PATH 'exon_num', AA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'aa_change', CDNA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'cDNA_change', GENE_FOLD_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_fold_change', VARIANT_ID VARCHAR(255) PATH 'snp_indel_variant_id|cnv_variant_id|sv_variant_id', CHROMOSOME VARCHAR(100) PATH 'chromosome', IS_HOTSPOT VARCHAR(100) PATH 'is_hotspot', CONFIDENCE_CV_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'confidence_cv_id', TRANSCRIPT_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'transcript_id', NORMAL_DP VARCHAR(100) PATH 'normal_dp', TUMOR_DP VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_dp', NORMAL_AD VARCHAR(100) PATH 'normal_ad', TUMOR_AD VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_ad', TUMOR_VFREQ VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_vfreq', DBSNP_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'dbSNP_id', START_POSITION int PATH 'start_position', ALT_ALLELE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'alt_allele', REF_ALLELE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'ref_allele', TMB_COHORT_PERCENTILE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_cohort_percentile', TMB_TT_COHORT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_tt_cohort', TMBSCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score', TMB_TT_PERCENTILE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_tt_percentile', TMBCOHORT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_cohort', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/gene-panel', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH '../meta-data/part_description', PROJECT VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_alys_task_name', DT_SIGNOUT VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_signout', DT_ACCESSIONED VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_accessioned', DT_ALYS_END_TIME VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_alys_end_time', DT_DMS_START_TIME VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_dms_start_time') T

prompt: Provide a list of Lymphoma patients from 2002-2016 with FDG PET/CTs and bone marrow biopsies with +/- 6 weeks of each other.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9650/3', 'M9651/3', 'M9652/3', 'M9653/3', 'M9654/3', 'M9655/3', 'M9656/3', 'M9657/3', 'M9658/3', 'M9659/3', 'M9660/3', 'M9661/3', 'M9662/3', 'M9663/3', 'M9664/3', 'M9665/3', 'M9666/3', 'M9667/3', 'M9679/3', 'M9680/3', 'M9681/3', 'M9691/3', 'M9714/3', 'M9738/3', 'M9673/3', 'M9690/3', 'M9698/3') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND(CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '201.%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '200.7%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '200.4%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '202.0%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C81%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C82%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C83.1%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C83.3%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C85.2%') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC ) , CTE AS (SELECT MRN AS DX_MRN, DX_DATE, STRIP(DX_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(DX_DESC) AS DX_CODE FROM DX) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(6000))||' | '||CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(100))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN, DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) , FDG AS (SELECT DTL_MRN AS PA_MRN, DTL_SVC_CD, CDM_SVC_DESC, DTL_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DTE FROM T4 JOIN IDB.PA_DETAIL ON DTL_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CDM ON DTL_SVC_CD = CDM_SVC_CD WHERE DTL_DTL_TYPE = 'C' AND DTL_SVC_CD IN ('16746513', '16788309') AND DTL_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2002-01-01' AND '2016-12-31' GROUP BY DTL_MRN, DTL_SVC_CD, CDM_SVC_DESC, DTL_SVC_DTE, DTL_SVC_CD HAVING SUM(DTL_SVC_QTY) > 0) , FDG2 AS (SELECT DTL_MRN AS PA_MRN, DTL_SVC_CD, CDM_SVC_DESC, DTL_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DTE FROM T4 JOIN IDB.PA_DETAIL ON DTL_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CDM ON DTL_SVC_CD = CDM_SVC_CD WHERE DTL_DTL_TYPE = 'C' AND DTL_SVC_CD IN ('16746513', '16788309') AND DTL_SVC_DTE < '2002-01-01' GROUP BY DTL_MRN, DTL_SVC_CD, CDM_SVC_DESC, DTL_SVC_DTE, DTL_SVC_CD HAVING SUM(DTL_SVC_QTY) > 0) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT T4.*, DTL_SVC_CD, CDM_SVC_DESC, SVC_DTE FROM T4 JOIN FDG ON T4.MRN = PA_MRN WHERE MRN NOT IN (SELECT PA_MRN FROM FDG2) ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT X.*, CLM_CLSF_CD AS BM_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS BM_CPT_DESC, PBD_SVC_DTE AS BM_SVC_DATE FROM X JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON PBD_MRN = MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN SVC_DTE - 42 DAYS AND SVC_DTE + 42 DAYS JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('38221', '85102', '85103', 'G0364') ) , Z AS (SELECT DISTINCT Y.*, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, PBD_SVC_DTE FROM Y LEFT JOIN (SELECT PBD_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, PBD_SVC_DTE FROM Y JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON PBD_MRN = MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN SVC_DTE - 42 DAYS AND SVC_DTE + 42 DAYS JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD AND CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('72141', '72142', '72146', '72147', '72148', '72149', '72156', '72157', '72158', '72159', '72195', '72196', '72197', '72198') ) MRI ON MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN SVC_DTE - 42 DAYS AND SVC_DTE + 42 DAYS) SELECT Z.*, CASE WHEN PBD_SVC_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS MRI FROM Z

prompt: Provide a list of COVID-19 patients and associated clinical data
completion: WITH COVID_POS AS (SELECT MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DATE_OF_BIRTH, RESULT, DATE(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) AS IDENTIFIED_DATE, DATE(MIN_RESULT_DT) AS RESULT_DATE FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_INFO WHERE RESULT IN ('Positive') ) , COVID_NEG AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DATE_OF_BIRTH, RESULT, DATE(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) AS IDENTIFIED_DATE, DATE(MIN_RESULT_DT) AS RESULT_DATE FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_INFO JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND(UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) like 'FLOW CYTOMETRY%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) like '%CI RESEARCH%') ) OO ON MRN = OO_MRN WHERE RESULT IN ('Negative') ) , COVID AS (SELECT * FROM COVID_POS UNION SELECT * FROM COVID_NEG) , CIS AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND(UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) like 'FLOW CYTOMETRY%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) like '%CI RESEARCH%') AND OO_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM COVID) ) , CIS2 AS (SELECT OO_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(OO_ENTER_DTE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME) AS ORDERS FROM CIS GROUP BY OO_MRN) , CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM COVID) ) , CTE AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS DX_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, STRIP(SITE_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(SITE_DESC) || '|' || STRIP(HIST_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(HIST_DESC) AS DX_CODE FROM CDB) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(6000))||' | '||CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(100))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN, RN, DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) , AC AS (SELECT AC_MRN AS MRN, AC_IRB_NO AS IRB_NO FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM COVID) ) , AC1 AS (SELECT MRN AS AC_MRN, STRIP(IRB_NO) AS AC_IRB_NO FROM AC) , AC2 AS (SELECT * FROM AC1 ORDER BY AC_MRN, AC_IRB_NO) , A1 AS (SELECT AC_MRN, AC_IRB_NO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY AC_MRN ORDER BY AC_IRB_NO) AS RN FROM AC2 ORDER BY AC_MRN, AC_IRB_NO) , A2 (MRN, IRB_NO, RN1) AS (SELECT AC_MRN, CAST(AC_IRB_NO AS VARCHAR(400)), RN FROM A1 WHERE A1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT AC_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(IRB_NO AS VARCHAR(6000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(AC_IRB_NO AS VARCHAR(100)) , RN1 + 1 FROM A1, A2 WHERE AC_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , A3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM A2 GROUP BY MRN) , A4 AS (SELECT A2.MRN, RN, IRB_NO FROM A2 JOIN A3 ON A2.MRN = A3.MRN AND A2.RN1 = A3.RN) SELECT COVID.*, DX, IRB_NO, ORDERS FROM COVID LEFT JOIN T4 ON COVID.MRN = T4.MRN LEFT JOIN A4 ON COVID.MRN = A4.MRN LEFT JOIN CIS2 ON COVID.MRN = CIS2.OO_MRN

prompt: Provide a daily report of patients in specified protocols with scheduled MRI appointments added or changed the day before.
completion: SELECT AC_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '09-166' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) AS IND_09_166, MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '09-009' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) AS IND_09_009, CPE_ENC_DTE, TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS APPT_TIME, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER, CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE, CURRENT DATE AS CURRENT_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON AC_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT A ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON AC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('09-166', '09-009') AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('MR BRAIN W/CONTRAST', 'MR BRAIN/ORBITS', 'MR BRAIN W/W/O CONTRAST', 'MR BRAIN W/O CONTRAST', 'MR BRAIN LAB FULL W/WO CON', 'MR BRAIN LAB SHORT STUDY W/CON', 'MR BRAIN 3T W/W/O CONTRAST', 'MR BRAIN 3T W/CONTRAST', 'MR BRAIN 3T W/O CONTRAST', 'MR BRAIN LAB SHORT W/O CON', 'MR BRAIN LAB FULL PERF W/WO CO', 'MR BRAIN LAB SHORT PERF W/CON', 'MR BRAIN PERF W/O CONTRAST', 'MR BRAIN PERF W/ CONTRAST', 'MR BRAIN PERF W/W/O CONTRAST', 'MR BRAIN LAB FULL W/O CONTRAST', 'MR RESEARCH') AND DATE(CPE_IDB_UPD_DT) = CURRENT date GROUP BY AC_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE, TIME(CPE_APPT_DT), CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER, CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE, CURRENT DATE

prompt: Provide a list of H-/S-/C-cases with "primary effusion lymphoma" OR "HHV-8 associated lymphoproliferative disorder" OR "multicentric castleman disease" OR "HHV-8 positive" OR "Kaposi sarcoma" in the Diagnosis section from 01/01/2014 to present.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE, "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=MORPHOLOGY)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=MORPHOLOGY)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS DIAGNOSIS, UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 18000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 18000) AS VARCHAR(18000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 18000) AS VARCHAR(18000)) END) AS TXT FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("primary effusion lymphoma" OR "HHV-8 associated lymphoproliferative disorder" OR "multicentric castleman disease" OR "HHV-8 positive" OR "Kaposi sarcoma")') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND "t4"."DT_DTE" >= '2014-01-01' AND("t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" LIKE 'H%' OR "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" LIKE 'S%' OR "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" LIKE 'C%') ) SELECT * FROM X WHERE UPPER(DIAGNOSIS) like '%PRIMARY EFFUSION LYMPHOMA%' OR UPPER(DIAGNOSIS) like '%HHV-8 ASSOCIATED LYMPHOPROLIFERATIVE DISORDER%' OR UPPER(DIAGNOSIS) like '%MULTICENTRIC CASTLEMAN DISEASE%' OR UPPER(DIAGNOSIS) like '%HHV-8 POSITIVE%' OR UPPER(DIAGNOSIS) like '%KAPOSI SARCOMA%'

prompt: Provide a weekly list admissions with Inpatient Physical and Occupational Therapy CIS Orders.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", UC_HOSP_SVC "Service at Admission", UC_TRANSFER_DTE "Admission Date", OCV_CURR_LOC "Location of Order", OOC_ITEM_NAME "Order Name", OSTS_STS_DESC "Order Status", OO_ENTER_DTE "Order Entered Date", OO_REQUESTED_DTE "Order Requested Date", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Cancer Diagnosis' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) AS "Dx", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Rehab_Reason', 'Rehab_Reason_OT') THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) AS "Reason for Referral", CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.UNIFIED_CENSUS ON OO_ADM_NUM = UC_ADM_NUM AND UC_CNG_TYPE = 'A' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON OO_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_ADM_NUM = UC_ADM_NUM AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Initial/Re-Eval - Physical Therapy' WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Occupational Therapy Inpatient Consult', 'Physical Therapy Inpatient Consult', 'Chest Physical Therapy Inpatient Consult', 'Ortho Physical Therapy Inpatient Consult', 'Physical Therapy Pediatric BMT Inpatient Consult', 'Post Op Pulmonary Program- Colorectal', 'Post Op Pulmonary Program- GYN', 'Post Op Pulmonary Program- H&N', 'Post Op Pulmonary Program- HPB', 'Post Op Pulmonary Program-Thoracic', 'Post Op Pulmonary Program-Urology', 'Post Op Pulmonary Program- GMT', 'Allo/BMT Physical Therapy', 'Physical Therapy Pre/Post-Op Evaluation' ) AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 7 DAYS AND CURRENT date - 1 DAY GROUP BY OO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, UC_HOSP_SVC, UC_TRANSFER_DTE, OCV_CURR_LOC, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OSTS_STS_DESC, OO_REQUESTED_DTE, OO_ENTER_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE ;

prompt: Provide ordering clinician for all vaccines ordered for lymphoma pts from Q1 2017-Present
completion: WITH DETAIL AS (SELECT OO_ENTER_DTE, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OU_DISPLAY_NAME, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, OP_TASK_ROLE_TYPE, DOC_NAME, OO_ORD_GUID, CASE WHEN OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE = 'Physician Assistant' OR OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE = 'Nurse Practitioner' THEN 'APP' WHEN OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE = 'Nurse' OR OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE = 'Chemo Nurse' THEN 'Nurse' WHEN OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE = 'Attending' THEN 'Attending' WHEN OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE = 'Fellow' THEN 'Fellow' ELSE 'Other' END AS ENTERED_BY_ROLE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OO_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE (UPPER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like ('%VACCINE%') OR OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN (SELECT OCCT_MST_ITEM_GUID FROM IDB.OMS_CTLG_CLASS_TYP WHERE OCCT_VALUE like ('%VACCINE%'))) AND OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT = 'Pharmacy' AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2018-07-13' AND CURRENT date - 1 DAY AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND DOC_SVC = 'LYM' ) SELECT OOC_ITEM_NAME AS "Order Name", COUNT (DISTINCT CASE WHEN ENTERED_BY_ROLE = 'Attending' THEN OO_ORD_GUID END) AS "Attending", COUNT (DISTINCT CASE WHEN ENTERED_BY_ROLE = 'APP' THEN OO_ORD_GUID END) AS "APP", COUNT (DISTINCT CASE WHEN ENTERED_BY_ROLE = 'Nurse' THEN OO_ORD_GUID END) AS "Nurse", COUNT (DISTINCT CASE WHEN ENTERED_BY_ROLE = 'Fellow' THEN OO_ORD_GUID END) AS "Fellow", COUNT (DISTINCT CASE WHEN ENTERED_BY_ROLE = 'Other' THEN OO_ORD_GUID END) AS "Other", COUNT (DISTINCT OO_ORD_GUID) AS "Total" FROM DETAIL GROUP BY OOC_ITEM_NAME ;

prompt: Provide a weekly list of allergy outpatient consults requests that have not been scheduled
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OOC_ITEM_DESC, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_ENTER_DTE, OSTS_STS_DESC, OO_ORD_STS_CD FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Allergy and Immunology Consult Request' AND OO_MRN NOT IN (SELECT CPE_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch', 'Can') AND CPE_ENC_DTE > OO_ENTER_DTE) AND OSTS_STS_DESC IN ('Active', 'Completed/Expired', 'Expired') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2023-12-01' AND CURRENT date

prompt: Provide a list of BMT transplants performed in 2019 and admissions within 100 days.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT CDD_MRN BMT_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE TRANSPLANT_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE) RN, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Product Information: Cell Infusion Type') THEN TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) "Cell Infusion Type", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Cell Source', 'BMT_Cell INF_PI_Cell Source RES') THEN TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) "Cell Source", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Recipient Verification: Attending') THEN TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) "Cell Infusion Attending" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_MRN = CDO_MRN AND CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Cell Infusion - BMT') AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Product Information: Cell Infusion Type', 'Recipient Verification: Attending', 'Cell Source', 'BMT_Cell INF_PI_Cell Source RES') GROUP BY CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE ) SELECT DISTINCT BMT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, TRANSPLANT_DTE, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_DAYS_STAY, SV.AV_DESC AS "Admitting Service", ADM_DR_NAME "Admitting Dr", ATN_DR_NAME "Attending Dr" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON BMT_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON BMT_MRN = VIS_MRN AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN TRANSPLANT_DTE - 30 DAYS AND TRANSPLANT_DTE + 100 DAYS LEFT JOIN IDB.UNIFIED_CENSUS ON UC_SMS_ACCT_NO = VIS_SMS_ACCT_NO AND UC_CNG_TYPE = 'A' AND UC_SMS_ACCT_NO <> '' LEFT JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT ON RV_VISIT_ID = VIS_VISIT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.RMS_SERVICE_DICT_DN37 ON RV_ADM_SVC_REC_NO = RSVD_RECORD_NUMBER LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS SV ON COALESCE(RSVD_MSK_ADT_SYNONYM, UC_HOSP_SVC) = SV.AV_CODE AND SV.AV_ELEMENT = 'HOSP_SVC'

prompt: List of patients who were first admitted to M-9 and PICU in 2018 aged 0-3
completion: SELECT DISTINCT UC_MRN "MRN", UC_ADM_NUM "Admission Number", VIS_ADM_DTE "Admission Date", VIS_DSCH_DTE "Discharge Date", VIS_DAYS_STAY "Length of Stay (days)", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", YEAR(VIS_ADM_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at Admission", YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Current Age", UC_NURS_STA "Nursing Station" FROM IDB.UNIFIED_CENSUS JOIN IDB.VISIT ON UC_VISIT_ID = VIS_VISIT_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON UC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND UC_NURS_STA IN ('NS-9', 'PICU', 'UCCP', 'IPAC') AND UC_SEQ_NO = 1 AND YEAR(VIS_ADM_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 0 AND 3 AND VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' ORDER BY UC_MRN, VIS_ADM_DTE

prompt: List of sarcoma patients who received eribulin since 1/1/2015.

completion: WITH MAIN AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS DX_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DATE OF BIRTH", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "DATE OF DEATH", TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_SITE_CD "SITE CODE", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "SITE DESCRIPTION", TM_HIST_CD AS "HIST CODE", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "HIST DESCRIPTION", COALESCE(MAX(PFA_FST_APPT_DTE, PFA_FST_DSCH_DTE), PFA_FST_APPT_DTE, PFA_FST_DSCH_DTE) AS FIRST_FU_DATE, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE, CASE WHEN LIV.CC_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "LIVER TRANSPLANT", CASE WHEN SRG.SSE_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "HIPEC PROC" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PFA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = CC_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD = 'Z94.4' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) AS LIV ON LIV.CC_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT SSE_MRN FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD = '96446' ) SRG ON SRG.SSE_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M8806/3' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2023-05-31' ), DOC AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CAST(CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT AS VARCHAR(32000)) AS CLIN_REPORT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE ASC) AS FIRST_DOC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) AS LAST_DOC FROM DV.CLINDOC_FULL_TEXT_V JOIN MAIN ON CDD_MRN = DX_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Follow Up - PACC Sarcoma' ) SELECT DISTINCT DX_MRN, "DATE OF BIRTH", "DATE OF DEATH", DX_DATE, "SITE CODE", "SITE DESCRIPTION", "HIST CODE", "HIST DESCRIPTION", FIRST_FU_DATE, LAST_FU_DATE, "LIVER TRANSPLANT", "HIPEC PROC", FD.CDD_SERVICE_DTE "FIRST SERVICE DATE", FD.CLIN_REPORT "FIRST CLINDOC NOTES", LD.CDD_SERVICE_DTE "LAST SERVICE DATE", LD.CLIN_REPORT "LAST CLINDOC NOTES" FROM MAIN JOIN DOC FD ON FD.CDD_MRN = DX_MRN AND FD.FIRST_DOC = 1 JOIN DOC LD ON LD.CDD_MRN = DX_MRN AND LD.LAST_DOC = 1 ; WITH MAIN AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DATE OF BIRTH", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "DATE OF DEATH", TM_DX_DTE AS TM_DATE, TM_SITE_CD "SITE CODE", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "SITE DESCRIPTION", TM_HIST_CD AS "HIST CODE", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "HIST DESCRIPTION", COALESCE(MAX(PFA_FST_APPT_DTE, PFA_FST_DSCH_DTE), PFA_FST_APPT_DTE, PFA_FST_DSCH_DTE) AS FIRST_FU_DATE, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PFA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M8806/3' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2023-05-31' ), CDB AS (SELECT TR.TM_MRN AS DX_MRN, TR.TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TR.TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR TR JOIN MAIN MN ON MN.TM_MRN = TR.TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN MAIN MN ON MN.TM_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK), CDB_ALL AS (SELECT DISTINCT DX_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' || ' || COALESCE(STRIP(DX_CODE), '') || ' || ' || COALESCE(STRIP(DX_DESC), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, DX_DESC) AS CANCER_DX FROM CDB GROUP BY DX_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, "DATE OF BIRTH", "DATE OF DEATH", FIRST_FU_DATE, LAST_FU_DATE, CANCER_DX FROM MAIN JOIN CDB_ALL ON TM_MRN = DX_MRN ; WITH MAIN AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DATE OF BIRTH", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "DATE OF DEATH", TM_DX_DTE AS TM_DATE, TM_SITE_CD "SITE CODE", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "SITE DESCRIPTION", TM_HIST_CD AS "HIST CODE", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "HIST DESCRIPTION", COALESCE(MAX(PFA_FST_APPT_DTE, PFA_FST_DSCH_DTE), PFA_FST_APPT_DTE, PFA_FST_DSCH_DTE) AS FIRST_FU_DATE, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PFA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M8806/3' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2023-05-31' ), LB AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY LR_MRN, LR_TEST_NAME ORDER BY LR_PERFORMED_DTE ASC) AS RN FROM MAIN JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE LR_RESULT_VALUE <> '' AND (UPPER(LR_TEST_NAME) LIKE ('CEA%') OR UPPER(LR_TEST_NAME) LIKE ('ALBUMIN%')) ) SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, "DATE OF BIRTH", "DATE OF DEATH", FIRST_FU_DATE, LAST_FU_DATE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_RESULT_VALUE FROM MAIN JOIN LB ON TM_MRN = LR_MRN AND RN = 1 ; WITH MAIN AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DATE OF BIRTH", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "DATE OF DEATH", TM_DX_DTE AS TM_DATE, TM_SITE_CD "SITE CODE", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "SITE DESCRIPTION", TM_HIST_CD AS "HIST CODE", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "HIST DESCRIPTION", COALESCE(MAX(PFA_FST_APPT_DTE, PFA_FST_DSCH_DTE), PFA_FST_APPT_DTE, PFA_FST_DSCH_DTE) AS FIRST_FU_DATE, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PFA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M8806/3' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2023-05-31' ), RAD AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, CAST(RRPT_REPORT_TXT AS VARCHAR(32000)) AS RAD_REPORT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RRPT_MRN ORDER BY RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE ASC) AS FIRST_DOCU, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RRPT_MRN ORDER BY RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE DESC) AS LAST_DOCU FROM MAIN JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V ON RRPT_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE RRPT_ORDER_GROUP IN ('CT', 'MR') AND (UPPER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) LIKE ('%ABDOMEN%') OR UPPER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) LIKE ('%ABDOMEN PELVIS%') OR UPPER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) LIKE ('%CHEST ABDOMEN PELVIS%')) ) SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, "DATE OF BIRTH", "DATE OF DEATH", FIRST_FU_DATE, LAST_FU_DATE, FD.RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE "FIRST PERFORMED DATE", FD.RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME "FIRST REPORT PROCEDURE", FD.RAD_REPORT "FIRST RADIOLOGY REPORT", LD.RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE "LAST PERFORMED DATE", LD.RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME "LAST REPORT PROCEDURE", LD.RAD_REPORT "LAST RADIOLOGY REPORT" FROM MAIN JOIN RAD FD ON FD.RRPT_MRN = TM_MRN AND FD.FIRST_DOCU = 1 JOIN RAD LD ON LD.RRPT_MRN = TM_MRN AND LD.LAST_DOCU = 1 ;

prompt: Provide a count of completed Cardiac Device Interrogation/Programming - Cardiology clinical documents from 2017 to current date.
completion: SELECT "Year", "Month", "Count" FROM (SELECT YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) "Year", MONTH(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) "Mo", CASE WHEN MONTH(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) = 1 THEN 'January' WHEN MONTH(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) = 2 THEN 'February' WHEN MONTH(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) = 3 THEN 'March' WHEN MONTH(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) = 4 THEN 'April' WHEN MONTH(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) = 5 THEN 'May' WHEN MONTH(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) = 6 THEN 'June' WHEN MONTH(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) = 7 THEN 'July' WHEN MONTH(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) = 8 THEN 'August' WHEN MONTH(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) = 9 THEN 'September' WHEN MONTH(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) = 10 THEN 'October' WHEN MONTH(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) = 11 THEN 'November' WHEN MONTH(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) = 12 THEN 'December' END AS "Month", COUNT(*) AS "Count" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Cardiac Device Interrogation/Programming - Cardiology' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND CDO_LARGE_VALUE_TEXT_IND <> 'Y' GROUP BY YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE), MONTH(CDD_SERVICE_DTE), CASE WHEN MONTH(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) = 1 THEN 'January' WHEN MONTH(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) = 2 THEN 'February' WHEN MONTH(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) = 3 THEN 'March' WHEN MONTH(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) = 4 THEN 'April' WHEN MONTH(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) = 5 THEN 'May' WHEN MONTH(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) = 6 THEN 'June' WHEN MONTH(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) = 7 THEN 'July' WHEN MONTH(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) = 8 THEN 'August' WHEN MONTH(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) = 9 THEN 'September' WHEN MONTH(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) = 10 THEN 'October' WHEN MONTH(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) = 11 THEN 'November' WHEN MONTH(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) = 12 THEN 'December' END ORDER BY YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE), MONTH(CDD_SERVICE_DTE)) A ORDER BY "Year", "Mo" ;
