prompt: Please provide data on the number of patients aged 65 and older who were hospitalized at MSK from January 2023-December 2023. Please break the data down by age 65-75, 76-84, 85+ for example.
completion: WITH PATIENT_DATA AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_BIRTH_YEAR, (YEAR (CPE_ENC_DTE) - YEAR(PT_BIRTH_DTE)) AS AGE, VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND, CASE WHEN (YEAR (CPE_ENC_DTE) - YEAR(PT_BIRTH_DTE)) BETWEEN '65' AND '75' THEN '65 to 75' WHEN (YEAR (CPE_ENC_DTE) - YEAR(PT_BIRTH_DTE)) BETWEEN '76' AND '84' THEN '76 to 84' WHEN (YEAR (CPE_ENC_DTE) - YEAR(PT_BIRTH_DTE)) >= '85' THEN '85 and up' ELSE 'Other' END AS AGE_GROUP, ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY PT_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS ROW_NUMBERS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON CPE_MRN = VIS_MRN WHERE 1 = 1 AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND (YEAR (CPE_ENC_DTE) - YEAR(PT_BIRTH_DTE)) >= 65 AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('1', '2', '3', '4') ORDER BY PT_MRN DESC) SELECT AGE_GROUP, COUNT (DISTINCT PT_MRN) AS NO_PATIENTS FROM PATIENT_DATA WHERE ROW_NUMBERS = '1' GROUP BY AGE_GROUP ORDER BY AGE_GROUP

prompt: Provide deidentified diagnosis, order, EMR document, and demographic data for patients who have had a doctor visit at MSK within the past five years.
completion: WITH PTS_PRE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS PLA_MRN, PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PLA_PID, PLA_LAST_DRVST_DTE FROM DV.PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PLA_LAST_DRVST_DTE >= CURRENT date - 5 YEARS AND PT_DEATH_DTE >= CURRENT date - 5 YEARS ) , HOSPICE_REF_INFO AS (SELECT OO_MRN AS HOSP_MRN , MIN(OO_ENTER_DTE) AS MIN_REF_DTE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN PTS_PRE ON PLA_MRN = OO_MRN WHERE OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('1000004375073029' ,'9000006038400730' ,'9000006783100740' ,'9000006859100730' ,'9000014453300730' ) AND OO_ORD_STS_CD not like 'CAN%' GROUP BY OO_MRN) , ICD9DXCODES AS (SELECT DXA_ATTRIBUTE_ID FROM DV.DIAGNOSIS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE DXA_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT = 'YES') , METS_INFO AS (SELECT PLA_PID AS METS_PID , MAX(CASE WHEN "t2".DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD9' AND ("t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" BETWEEN '196' AND '196.99' OR "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" BETWEEN '197' AND '197.99' OR "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" BETWEEN '198' AND '198.99') THEN 1 WHEN "t2".DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD10' AND (DXCC_ICD_CODE like 'C77%' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE like 'C78%' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE like 'C79%' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE like 'C7B%') THEN 1 END) AS METS_IND FROM PTS_PRE JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON PLA_PID = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t4" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG "t2" ON "t4"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_DATES_V" "t6" ON "t4"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t6"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" AND "t4"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "dxd" ON "t6"."FIRST_DIAGNOSIS_DATE_ID" = "dxd"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND (("t2".DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD9' AND ("t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" BETWEEN '196' AND '196.99' OR "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" BETWEEN '197' AND '197.99' OR "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" BETWEEN '198' AND '198.99')) OR ("t2".DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD10' AND (DXCC_ICD_CODE like 'C77%' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE like 'C78%' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE like 'C79%' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE like 'C7B%'))) AND DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT = 'YES' GROUP BY PLA_PID) SELECT DISTINCT PLA_PID AS DEID, YEAR("t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE") AS "Birth Year", YEAR("t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE") AS "Death Year", "t1"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS "Vital Status", "t1"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender", "t1"."PT_RACE_DESC" AS "Race", "t2"."CORE_ETHNICITY_DESC" AS "Ethnicity" , METS_IND , YEAR(MIN_REF_DTE) AS "First Hospice Ref Year" , DAYS(PT_DEATH_DTE) - DAYS(MIN_REF_DTE) AS "Days Ref to Death" FROM PTS_PRE JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t1" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = PLA_PID LEFT JOIN METS_INFO ON METS_PID = PLA_PID LEFT JOIN HOSPICE_REF_INFO ON HOSP_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t2" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE 1=1

prompt: Requesting a Cadence report on any Medicine faculty member that has telemedicine only NV/IR slots templated.
completion: WITH CTE1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_ID, CLD_DEPT_NAME , CLD_DEPT_ID , CAB_SLOT_BEGIN_DT , COUNT(TIME(CAB_SLOT_BEGIN_DT)) AS TIMECOUNT FROM IDB.CL_AVAIL_BLK JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CAB_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CAB_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE 1=1 AND DATE(CAB_SLOT_BEGIN_DT) >= CURRENT date AND CAB_CAB_BLK <> 'WI' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' GROUP BY CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_ID, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_DEPT_ID, CAB_SLOT_BEGIN_DT HAVING COUNT(TIME(CAB_SLOT_BEGIN_DT)) = 1) SELECT DISTINCT CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_ID, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_DEPT_ID , A.CAB_SLOT_BEGIN_DT , DATE(A.CAB_SLOT_BEGIN_DT) AS DATESLOT, TIME(A.CAB_SLOT_BEGIN_DT) AS TIMESLOT, CAB_LINE_NO, CAB_CAB_BLK , CAB_ORIG_AVAIL_BLK , CAB_BLK_USED FROM CTE1 A JOIN IDB.CL_AVAIL_BLK B ON B.CAB_DEPT_ID = A.CLD_DEPT_ID AND B.CAB_SLOT_BEGIN_DT = A.CAB_SLOT_BEGIN_DT AND B.CAB_RES_ID = A.CRE_RES_ID WHERE 1=1 AND B.CAB_CAB_BLK = 'TEL-NV'

prompt: Provide a list of patient with anaplastic thyroid cancer treated at MSKCC between 2013 - present
completion: WITH PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.PRPT_MRN "MRN" , PART_DESCRIPTION "Part Description" , PRIMARY_SITE "Primary Site" , TUMOR_TYPE_NAME "Tumor Type Name" , A.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Accession Number" , A.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "Procedure Date" , CASE WHEN B.PT_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "BRAF (Y/N)" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V A JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML ON A.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID AND A.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH 'dt_procedure', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', PART_DESCRIPTION varchar (264) PATH 'part_description', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('THAP', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = X.TTC LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V B ON A.PRPT_MRN = B.PT_MRN AND (GENE = 'BRAF' OR GENE2 = 'BRAF') WHERE 1=1 AND A.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE >= '2013-01-01' ) SELECT DISTINCT A."MRN" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB" , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "DOD" , "Primary Site" , "Tumor Type Name" , "BRAF (Y/N)" , PLA_LST_APPT_DTE "Last Appt Date" FROM PATH A JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON A."MRN" = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON A."MRN" = PLA_MRN WHERE 1=1 ; WITH PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.PRPT_MRN , PART_DESCRIPTION , PRIMARY_SITE , TUMOR_TYPE_NAME , A.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , A.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V A JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML ON A.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID AND A.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH 'dt_procedure', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', PART_DESCRIPTION varchar (264) PATH 'part_description', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('THAP', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = X.TTC WHERE 1=1 AND A.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE >= '2013-01-01' ) SELECT DISTINCT A.PRPT_MRN "MRN" , RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME "Tx Plan Name" , RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT "Primary Reference Point" , RTC_TX_START_DTE "Start Date" , RTC_TX_STOP_DTE "End Date" , RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE "Delivered Dose" , RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS "Delivered Fraction" FROM PATH A LEFT JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON PRPT_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN AND RTC_TX_START_DTE >= PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE WHERE 1=1 ; WITH PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.PRPT_MRN "MRN" , PART_DESCRIPTION "Part Description" , PRIMARY_SITE "Primary Site" , TUMOR_TYPE_NAME "Tumor Type Name" , A.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Accession Number" , A.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "Procedure Date" , CASE WHEN B.PT_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "BRAF (Y/N)" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V A JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML ON A.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID AND A.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH 'dt_procedure', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', PART_DESCRIPTION varchar (264) PATH 'part_description', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('THAP', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = X.TTC LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V B ON A.PRPT_MRN = B.PT_MRN AND (GENE = 'BRAF' OR GENE2 = 'BRAF') WHERE 1=1 AND A.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE >= '2013-01-01' ) SELECT DISTINCT A."MRN" , APR_START_DTE "Start Date" , APR_END_DTE "End Date" , CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME "Drug Name" FROM PATH A LEFT JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON A."MRN" = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('DABRAFENIB', 'TRAMETINIB') AND APR_START_DTE >= "Procedure Date" WHERE 1=1 ; WITH PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.PRPT_MRN "MRN" , PART_DESCRIPTION "Part Description" , PRIMARY_SITE "Primary Site" , TUMOR_TYPE_NAME "Tumor Type Name" , A.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Accession Number" , A.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "Procedure Date" , CASE WHEN B.PT_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "BRAF (Y/N)" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V A JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML ON A.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID AND A.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH 'dt_procedure', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', PART_DESCRIPTION varchar (264) PATH 'part_description', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('THAP', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = X.TTC LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V B ON A.PRPT_MRN = B.PT_MRN AND (GENE = 'BRAF' OR GENE2 = 'BRAF') WHERE 1=1 AND A.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE >= '2013-01-01' ) SELECT DISTINCT A."MRN" , SSE_SURG_DTE "Procedure Date" , SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD "CPT Code" , SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC "CPT Desc" FROM PATH A LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON A."MRN" = SSE_MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE >= "Procedure Date" LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID AND (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') WHERE 1=1 ;

prompt: Create a read only view IDCR.RADONC_TX_IRBS_V of Radiation Oncology Data of treatments from 1/1/2017 of patients on specific protocols
completion: SELECT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_COURSE_NO, RTC_TX_PLANSETUP_NO, RTC_TX_COURSE_ID, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION, RTC_CREATED_BY, RTC_CREATED_DT, RTC_MODIFIED_DT, RTC_IDB_PROCESS_DTE FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON RTC_TX_MRN = AC_MRN JOIN IDCR.LAB_RESULTS_IDB_IRBS ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO WHERE RTC_TX_START_DTE >='2017-01-01'

prompt: Provide a Darwin cohort of select KRAS patients with the given criteria along and access to the patients in the Darwin Digital Platform.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/msi-score' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/msi-type' , TMB_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH '../meta-data/tmb_score' , TMB_COUNT VARCHAR(25) PATH '../meta-data/tmb-count') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('UCEC,OCNOS,OCNOS,CERVIX,OCS,UCS,VULVA', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = X.TTC WHERE 1=1 AND (INC.GENE IN ('KRAS') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('KRAS')) AND INC.AA_CHANGE IN ('G12C', 'G12D') ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P_ID) FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 )

prompt: Provide a collated PDF of GYN-related pathology reports for a list of MRNs.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT STRIP("t1"."PT_MRN") AS "MRN", STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) AS "Last Name", STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Surgical Accession Number", STRIP("t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC") AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", YEAR("t4"."DT_DTE" - PT_BIRTH_DTE) AS "Age", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND "t5"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2021-11-30' AND(CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '(("ENDOMETRIUM"))') = 1 OR CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '(("ENDOMETRIAL"))') = 1 OR CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '(("UTERUS"))') = 1) AND(UPPER("t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC") LIKE '%SURGICAL PATHOLOGY%' OR UPPER("t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC") LIKE '%SURGICAL%SUBMITTED%SLIDES%') #PROMPTMANY('MRN', 'String', ' ', ' and "t1"."PT_MRN" in (', '', ')')

prompt: Names and MRN of PEDIATRIC patients who received ERWINIA at MSK in the past 3 years.
completion: SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, PT_AGE , ORD_NAME , MIN(START_DATE) START_DATE, MAX(STOP_DATE) STOP_DATE FROM (SELECT CIS_VISIT_NO, VISIT_GUID, MRN, PT_NAME , PT_AGE, CURR_LOC, IP_OP_IND, CIS_SERVICE, SMS_SVC, ORD_NAME, DRUG_NAME, DOSE, DOSE_UOM , INFUSION_RATE, ORDERING_PVDR_NO, ORDERING_PVDR_NAME , TIME_PRIORITY, START_DATE, STOP_DATE, ROUTE, ORD_FREQ , OCV_ADM_DT, OCV_DSCH_DT, OCV_IP_OP_IND, SET_NAME FROM IDB.SRX_PHARMACY_SUM JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON OCV_ADM_NUM = VIS_ADM_NUM WHERE UPPER(DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%ERWINIA%' AND SMS_SVC LIKE 'P%' ) AS A GROUP BY MRN, PT_NAME, PT_AGE , ORD_NAME

prompt: Modify a monthly report for CTS outpatient volume as per provided spreadsheet
completion: SELECT DISTINCT LAST_DAY(CURRENT date - 3 MONTH) + 1 DAY "Report Start Date", LAST_DAY(CURRENT date - 2 MONTH) "Report End Date", 'INPATIENT' INP_OUT , CDD_MRN MRN , CDD_DOC_NAME DOCUMENT_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE "Service Date", OS_SVC_DESC "Service", OCV_PVDR_NAME PROVIDER, OCV_CURR_LOC "Location" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'I' JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN LAST_DAY(CURRENT date - 3 MONTH) + 1 DAY AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT date - 2 MONTH) AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE < CURRENT date AND CDD_DOC_NAME like '%CTS%' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Admission Note - BMT/CTS-CTS' , 'Progress Note - BMT/CTS-CTS' , 'Follow Up, AMB - BMT/CTS-CTS' , 'Cell Infusion - BMT/CTS-CTS' , 'Pre-Admission Note - BMT/CTS-CTS') ORDER BY 'INPATIENT', CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_MRN ; SELECT DISTINCT LAST_DAY(CURRENT date - 3 MONTH) + 1 DAY "Report Start Date", LAST_DAY(CURRENT date - 2 MONTH) "Report End Date", 'OUTPATIENT' INP_OUT , CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_MRN MRN , CDD_DOC_NAME DOCUMENT_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE "Service Date", U2.OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS "CIS Final Signer", U2.OU_OCCUPATION AS "Signer Occupation", U2.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE AS "Signer Role" , DS.CECR_REFERENCE_STRING "CIS Document Status", SS.CECR_REFERENCE_STRING "CIS Signature Status" , CLD_DEPT_NAME "Cadence Department", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Cadence Visit Type", CPE_APPT_DT "Cadence Visit Dt", CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CRE_RES_NAME "Cadence Provider", CRE_RES_TYP "Cadence Resource Type", CLD_CLD_CENTER "Cadence Center" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'O' JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT_HISTORY ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDH_CLIENT_DOC_GUID AND CDD_CLIENT_GUID = CDH_CLIENT_GUID AND CDH_DOCUMENT_STATUS_TYPE = '6' JOIN IDB.OMS_USER U2 ON CDH_USER_GUID = U2.OU_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.CIS_ENUMERATED_COLUMN_REF DS ON DS.CECR_ENUM_VALUE = CDH_DOCUMENT_STATUS_TYPE AND DS.CECR_TABLE_NAME = 'CV3ClientDocHistory' AND DS.CECR_COLUMN_NAME = 'DocumentStatus' LEFT JOIN IDB.CIS_ENUMERATED_COLUMN_REF SS ON SS.CECR_ENUM_VALUE = CDH_SIGNATURE_STATUS_TYPE AND SS.CECR_TABLE_NAME = 'CV3ClientDocHistory' AND SS.CECR_COLUMN_NAME = 'SignatureStatus' LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = OCV_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE = CDD_SERVICE_DTE AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist', 'PhD', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID= CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN LAST_DAY(CURRENT date - 3 MONTH) + 1 DAY AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT date - 2 MONTH) AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME like '%CTS%' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Admission Note - BMT/CTS-CTS' , 'Progress Note - BMT/CTS-CTS' , 'Follow Up, AMB - BMT/CTS-CTS' , 'Cell Infusion - BMT/CTS-CTS' , 'Pre-Admission Note - BMT/CTS-CTS') ORDER BY CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_MRN ;

prompt: Provide a list of each admission (past year and moving forward), by patient, of all changes to the admission med rec. For each change we would like to see the status of med rec (submitted, competed, etc.), timestamp of the change, role of who made the change, and why the change was made
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT ADMIT_ID , MRN , ADMIT_DT , ADM_SOURCE_DESC , SVC_ADMIT , SERVICE_ADMIT FROM IDB.INPATIENT_ADMISSIONS_V WHERE ADMIT_DATE >= CURRENT date - 7 DAYS ) , REC AS (SELECT OCV_MRN , OCV_ADM_NUM , OORSH_REASON , OORSH_UPD_DT , OP_DISPLAY_NAME , OP_PROV_TYPE , OP_TASK_ROLE_TYPE, OORSH_RECONCILE_FUNCTION_DESC FROM PTS JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_MRN= MRN AND OCV_ADM_NUM = ADMIT_ID JOIN IDB.ORM_ORD_RECONCILE ON OREC_CLIENT_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.ORM_ORD_RECONCILE_STS_HX ON OREC_GUID = OORSH_RECONCILE_OR_RQMT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OORSH_RECONCILE_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE OREC_RECONCILE_TYPE_CD = 'Admission' ) SELECT ADMIT_ID , MRN , ADMIT_DT , ADM_SOURCE_DESC , SVC_ADMIT , SERVICE_ADMIT , OORSH_REASON , OORSH_UPD_DT , OP_DISPLAY_NAME , OP_PROV_TYPE , OP_TASK_ROLE_TYPE , CASE WHEN OORSH_RECONCILE_FUNCTION_DESC like '%Reconciliation%' THEN 'ORM' WHEN OORSH_REASON = 'Changes to Outpatient Medication Profile.' THEN 'OP med review' ELSE NULL END AS SYS_CHANGE FROM PTS LEFT JOIN REC ON ADMIT_ID = OCV_ADM_NUM

prompt: Provide patients seen by the peds leuk/lymphoma service from 2014-present
completion: WITH LEULYM AS (SELECT ROW_NUMBER () OVER(PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS "RN", CPE_MRN AS "MRN", IP.PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", IP.PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "DOB", YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Current Age", YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Age at Appointment", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", CASE WHEN IP.PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NOT NULL THEN 'Deceased' ELSE 'Alive' END AS "Vital Status", IP.PT_SEX AS "Sex", CASE WHEN CPE.CPE_CPE_IP_IND = 'INPATIENT' THEN 'Inpatient' ELSE 'Outpatient' END AS "Patient Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER CPE JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT IP ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2014-01-01' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('LYM', 'LEU', 'LEULYM') ) SELECT "MRN", "Last Name", "First Name", "DOB", "Race", "Ethnicity", "Sex", "Vital Status", "Current Age", "Age at Appointment", "Appt Date", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", "Patient Type" FROM LEULYM WHERE RN = 1

prompt: Provide genomic, and demographic data for patients who had their brain metastasis resected and who underwent.
completion: WITH DMP_ATTRIBUTES AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN , T.* , PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID AS PATIENT_ID , PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID AS SAMPLE_ID , PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Report Date" , DV.TODATE(DT_PROCEDURE) AS "Procedure Date" , DV.REGEXSTR('(S|H|C|M|F|B|DMG)[0-9]{2}[\s|-][0-9]*', XMLCAST(XMLQUERY('$x/root/meta-data/part_description' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "x") AS VARCHAR(2000))) AS REF_ACCESSION FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site' , M_ACCESSION_NUM VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/m_accession_num' , GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/gene-panel' , PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/part_description' , DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure') T JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID WHERE GENE_PANEL like '%IMPACT%' AND METASTASIS_SITE IN ('Brain' , 'Brain - Cerebellum' , 'Brain - Dura' , 'Brain and Leptomeninges' , 'Brain, Left occipital' , 'central nervous system' , 'Cerebellum' , 'Cerebrospinal fluid' , 'CNS' , 'CNS leptomeningeal' , 'CSF' , 'CSF cell pellet' , 'CSFpellet' , 'Dura' , 'Epidural' , 'Epidural Mass' , 'Leptomeningeal' , 'Leptomeninges' , 'Meninges' ) ) , DT AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN , PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID FROM DMP_ATTRIBUTES JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN = MRN) SELECT DISTINCT DMP.*, "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", CASE WHEN "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE") END AS "Cur Age", "t1"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS "Vital Status", "t1"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender", "t1"."PT_RACE_DESC" AS "Race", "t2"."CORE_ETHNICITY_DESC" AS "Ethnicity", "t3"."PLA_LAST_DRVST_DTE" AS "Last Dr Visit Date" FROM DT DT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t1" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = DT.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DMP_ATTRIBUTES DMP ON DMP.MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t2" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY "t1"."PT_MRN", "Report Date"

prompt: This request is for Privacy reasons. We are providing this data to Joanna Halperin, please help expediate this request if you can. We are trying to identify a cohort of patients who registered on and after 2/21/2019 and provide them with updated information regarding their patient data exchange.
completion: WITH CDD AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, SUBSTR(TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 75) PREF_LANG , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CASE WHEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT IN ('English', 'English,English', 'English,English,English', 'English-speaking', ' ', 'Unknown') THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) RN FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2019-01-01' AND CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000128866902890', '9000078238002890') ) , NXTAPP AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, MIN(CASE WHEN CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CPE_ENC_DTE > CURRENT DATE THEN CPE_ENC_DTE END) NXT_VST_DTE , MAX(CASE WHEN CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%SURVIVORSHIP%' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS <> 'Sch' THEN CPE_ENC_DTE END) LST_SURVIV_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN AND PT_REG_DTE >= '2/21/2019' WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2019-01-01' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch', 'Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 GROUP BY CPE_MRN) SELECT PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name" , PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS "Email Address", PT_ADDR1 "Address 1", PT_ADDR2 "Address 1" , PT_CITY "City", PT_STATE "State", PT_ZIP_CD "Zip Code", PT_COUNTRY "Country" , PT_REG_DTE "Registeration Date", CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE "Last MyMSK logon Date" , CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END "Vital status" , AV_DESC "Primary language", PREF_LANG "Preferred language" , PLA_LST_APPT_DTE "Last MSK Apt Date", NXT_VST_DTE "Next MSK Apt Date" , CASE WHEN PLA_LST_TX_DTE IS NOT NULL AND PLA_LST_ADM_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN MAX(PLA_LST_ADM_DTE, PLA_LST_TX_DTE) ELSE COALESCE(PLA_LST_TX_DTE, PLA_LST_ADM_DTE) END "Last Activity Date" , PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND "Do not mail/contact ind", LST_SURVIV_DTE "Last Survivorship Apt Date" FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'PRIMARY_LANG' AND PT_PRIMARY_LANG = AV_CODE LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN CDD ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN AND RN = 1 LEFT JOIN NXTAPP ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PT_REG_DTE >= '2/21/2019' WITH UR

prompt: Provide a list of alive patients with a tumor in their pituitary gland
completion: SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CPP_EMAIL_ADDR FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON TM_MRN = CPP_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON TM_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') AND PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND <> 'Y' AND CPP_EMAIL_ADDR <> '' AND TM_SITE_CD = 'C751'

prompt: require inpatient OT/PT referral data
completion: WITH REHAB AS (SELECT OO_MRN MRN, TRIM(OS_SVC_DESC) AS SERVICE , CASE WHEN LEFT(OCV_ADM_NUM, 1) BETWEEN '1' AND '9' THEN OCV_ADM_NUM WHEN LEFT(OO_ADM_NUM, 1) BETWEEN '1' AND '9' THEN OO_ADM_NUM ELSE SUBSTR(OCV_VISIT_ID_CD, 1, 10) END ACCT , CASE WHEN UCASE(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%OCCUPATIONAL%' THEN 'OT' ELSE 'PT' END AS TYPE , TRIM(OO_ORD_NAME) AS ORDER_TITLE, OO_ORD_ID ORD_ID, OO_ENTER_DT ENTER_DT , TRIM(OO_ORD_STS_CD)||' - '||OSTS_STS_DESC ORD_STS , CASE WHEN YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) > 18 THEN 'Adult' ELSE 'Pediatric' END PEDS_IND , CASE WHEN OO_IS_FOR_DSCH = 'N' AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'I' AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID <> '1000004839073029' THEN 'Inpatient' WHEN OCV_CARE_LVL IN ('AXR', 'OR', 'Institution') AND OCV_CURR_LOC LIKE '%JR%' THEN 'JRSC' ELSE CASE WHEN OCV_CARE_LVL IN ('AXR', 'UCO', 'UCC') AND OO_ORD_NAME NOT LIKE '%Outpatient Consult%' THEN 'AXR/UCC Unit' ELSE 'Outpatient' END END PT_IND , TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(TRIM(ST.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE), 1, 55) IS NOT NULL THEN SUBSTR(TRIM(ST.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE), 1, 55) WHEN OCV_CURR_LOC LIKE '%JR%' THEN 'JRSC' WHEN UCASE(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%KOCH%' OR OCV_CURR_LOC LIKE '%Koch%' THEN 'Koch' WHEN OCV_CARE_LVL IN ('AXR', 'UCO', 'UCC') THEN 'AXR/UCC Unit' WHEN UCASE(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%OCCUPATIONAL THERAPY OUTPATIENT%' THEN 'Sillerman Center' ELSE 'Main Campus' END, 'Breast Center', 'BAIC'), 'Harrison', 'Westchester'), 'Manhattan', 'Sillerman Center'), '(515 Madison Ave)', 'Center'), 'Sillerman (515 Madson Avenue)', 'Sillerman Center')) SITE , OO_ENTER_DTE ENTER_DATE, OO_SUMMARY_LINE SUMMARY_LINE, OO_ORD_GUID ORD_GUID , OL_LOC_NAME CURR_LOC, CAST(TRIM(DX.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS CHAR(255)) PRIMARY_DX , OO_REQ_TME_PRIO REQ_TME_PRIO, TRIM(OU_DISPLAY_NAME) REQUESTER, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE REQUESTER_TYPE , CASE WHEN OO_REQ_DR_NO = OCV_ATT_DR_NO AND OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE <> 'Attending' THEN OCV_PVDR_NAME END VST_ATT_NAME, LGR_LOC_GRP LOC_GRP , CAST(TRIM(RSN.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS CHAR(255)) AS REFERRAL_RSN FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND UCASE(OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT) = 'REHABILITATION' AND UCASE(OOC_ITEM_NAME) NOT LIKE '%PRESCRIPTION%' AND UCASE(OOC_ITEM_NAME) NOT LIKE '%GARMENT%' AND UCASE(OOC_ITEM_NAME) NOT LIKE '%RECOMMENDATION%' AND UCASE(OOC_ITEM_NAME) NOT LIKE '%WHEELCHAIR%' AND UCASE(OOC_ITEM_NAME) NOT LIKE '%EQUIPMENT%' AND UCASE(OOC_ITEM_NAME) NOT LIKE '%OT/PT%' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ST ON ST.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND ST.OUD_USER_DI_CD LIKE 'Rehab%Site%' AND ST.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE > ' ' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA DX ON DX.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND DX.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Cancer Diagnosis', 'RDO_Clin Dx', 'Rehab_PT_OP Primary Med Dx', 'Rehab_OT_OP Primary Medical Dx', 'Rehab_Lymph_TypeofGroup') JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA RSN ON OO_ORD_GUID = RSN.OUD_ORD_GUID AND RSN.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Rehab_Lymph_Bergen', 'Rehab_Lymph_BAIC', 'Rehab_Lymph_BSK', 'Rehab_Lymph_CMK', 'Rehab_Lymph_Monmouth', 'Rehab_Lymph_Nassau', 'Rehab_Lymph_WEST', 'Rehab_Lymph_515', 'Rehab_Lymphed_Referral', 'Rehab_OT_Koch Reason', 'Rehab_OT_OP Reason', 'Rehab_PT_Koch Reason', 'Rehab_PT_OP Reason', 'Rehab_Reason', 'Rehab_Reason_Chest_PT', 'Rehab_Reason_Lymph_PT', 'Rehab_Reason_OT') AND RSN.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE > ' ' AND OO_ORD_NAME like '%Consult%' JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON OCV_CURR_LOC_GUID = OL_LOC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.LOCATION_GROUPS_REFERENCE ON OCV_CURR_LOC_GUID = LGR_LOC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OU_USER_GUID = OO_PVDR_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD IN ('AUC1', 'COMP', 'AUA2', 'DISC', 'DISCD') AND(OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT LIKE 'DISC%' OR(OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'I' AND OO_IS_FOR_DSCH = 'N')) AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '1/1/2013' AND CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY AND UPPER(RSN.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%EARLY MOBIL%' AND OO_REQ_TME_PRIO NOT IN ('Outside Order', 'Medicaid') ) SELECT MRN, PEDS_IND, PT_IND, ACCT, SERVICE, TYPE, PRIMARY_DX AS "Primary DX", ENTER_DATE AS "Order Enter Date", ORD_ID AS "Order ID", ORDER_TITLE AS "Order Title", ORD_STS AS "Order Status", CURR_LOC AS "Order Location", LOC_GRP AS "Location Group", REFERRAL_RSN AS "Referral Reason", REQ_TME_PRIO, REQUESTER, REQUESTER_TYPE, VST_ATT_NAME, SUMMARY_LINE FROM REHAB

prompt: Provide a Darwin cohort of prostate patients with BRCA1/2  along with notifications and access to the patients in the Darwin Digital Platform.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/msi-score' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/msi-type' , TMB_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH '../meta-data/tmb_score' , TMB_COUNT VARCHAR(25) PATH '../meta-data/tmb-count') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('PROSTATE', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = X.TTC WHERE 1=1 AND (INC.GENE IN ('BRCA1', 'BRCA2') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('BRCA1', 'BRCA2')) ) , DT_3 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P_ID) FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3 )

prompt: Provide a list of Westchester appointments with GI physicians for patients at least 5 years from diagnosis.
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE "Last Chemo Date", PLA_LST_RT_DTE "Last RT Date", PLA_LST_SURG_DTE "Last Surg Date", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CPE_CPE_APPT_STS "Appt Status", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND CRE_RES_NAME IN ('ZERVOUDAKIS, ALICE', 'WON, ELIZABETH S') AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'WES' ) , TM AS (SELECT A."MRN", TM_DX_DTE, CATEGORY1, CATEGORY2, CATEGORY3, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A."MRN" ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE DESC) RN FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN" FROM APPTS) A JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON A."MRN" = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7') AND CATEGORY1 = 'Digestive System' ) , MOST_RECENT AS (SELECT * FROM TM WHERE RN = 1 AND YEAR(CURRENT date - TM_DX_DTE) > 5 ) SELECT * FROM APPTS A JOIN MOST_RECENT T ON A."MRN" = T."MRN"

prompt: A list of patients who have prostate cancer and identify as transgender.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN AS MRN, PT_GENDER AS GENDER, DX_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE , CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC, MIN(PBD_SVC_DTE) AS DX_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON PT_MRN = PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBI_MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBI_INV_NO = PBD_INV_NO JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_DX ON DX_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO AND DX_MRN = PBI_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = DX_CLSF_CD AND CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('C61', 'C61.', '185') WHERE PT_GENDER IN ('TRANSGENDER MAN', 'TRANSGENDER WOMAN') GROUP BY PBD_MRN, PT_GENDER, DX_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK
