prompt: Provide a report of the specified radiology procedures, to help determine the effects of suprapapillary versus transpapillary biliary stent placement on infectious complications after locoregional therapy.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."RRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Radiology Accession Number", "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" AS "Radiology Performed Date", "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS "Radiology Order Group", RRPT_ANC_CODE, "t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" AS "Radiology Procedure Name", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(RRPT_REPORT_TXT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS "PRPT_REPORT" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND(RRPT_ANC_CODE IN ('ABLBODY', 'ABLBODYPET', 'ABLBONEPET', 'ABLLIVER', 'ABLLIVERMR', 'ABLLIVPET', 'ABLLUNG', 'BXLIV', 'DART', 'EMBO', 'EMBOH', 'EMBOTUM', 'ETOHINJTUM', 'MRABL', 'NBLIVPET', 'SIR1', 'SIR2', 'SIRNM2', 'STENTART', 'TARTCHEMEM', 'THERATREAT') OR RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME IN ('ABLATION LIVER MRI', 'ABLATION LIVER PET', 'ABLATION LIVER', 'EMBOLIZATION, ARTERIAL TUMOR HEPATIC', 'IR 2 DOSE THERASPHERE TREATMENT', 'IR 3 DOSE THERASPHERE TREATMENT', 'IR ABLATION LIVER MRI', 'IR ABLATION LIVER PET', 'IR ABLATION LIVER', 'IR ALCOHOL INJECTION TUMOR', 'IR EMBOLIZATION, ARTERIAL TUMOR HEPATIC', 'IR SIRSPHERE TREATMENT SINGLE DOSE', 'IR SIRSPHERE TREATMENT WITH 2 DOSES', 'IR SIRT TREATMENT', 'IR THERASPHERE TREATMENT', 'IR TRANS-ARTERIAL CHEMO EMBOLIZATION', 'MR GUIDED ABLATION', 'SIRSPHERE TREATMENT SINGLE DOSE', 'SIRT TREATMENT'))

prompt: Provide data on patients who have had multiple diagnostic radioactive iodine dispensations for thyroid cancer follow up.
completion: WITH BASEPTS AS (SELECT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" INNER JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t10" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t10"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" INNER JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t11" ON "t10"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t11"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" INNER JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t12" ON "t11"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t12"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t11"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t12"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" INNER JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t2" ON "t12"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t2"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" INNER JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DISPENSE_OCCR" "t7" ON "t12"."POD_PHARMA_ORDER_DETAIL_ID" = "t7"."PDO_PHARMA_ORDER_DETAIL_ID" INNER JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t7"."PDO_DISPNS_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" INNER JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t13" ON "t10"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t13"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" INNER JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t3" ON "t13"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t3"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" INNER JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LAB_RESULT" "t9" ON "t10"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."PLR_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" INNER JOIN "DV"."LAB_TEST_CATALOG_V" "t5" ON "t9"."PLR_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID" = "t5"."LTC_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID" INNER JOIN "DV"."LAB_TEST_CATALOG_V" "t6" ON "t9"."PLR_LAB_SUBTEST_CATALOG_ID" = "t6"."LTC_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID" INNER JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t8" ON "t9"."PLR_PERFORMED_DATE_ID" = "t8"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE (UPPER("t2"."PINC_ITEM_NAME") IN ('IODINE I-131 3F8', 'IODINE I-131 3F8 MOAB', 'IODINE I-131 8H9', 'IODINE I-131 8H9 MOAB', 'IODINE I-131 ANTI-B1 ANTIBODY', 'IODINE I-131 CHIMERIC G250 MOAB', 'IODINE I-131 DOSE', 'IODINE I-131 HU A33 MOAB', 'IODINE I-131 MIBG', 'IODINE I-131 NP-59', 'IODINE I-131 TOSITUMOMAB', 'IODINE I-131 B1 MOAB INJ.', 'IODINE I-131 DOSE (IN MCI)') AND "t3"."ICSC_SITE_CD" IN ('C739') AND UPPER("t5"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME") IN ('ANTI-THYROGLOB AB/ANTI-THYROID MICRO', 'ANTI-THYROGLOBULIN AB', 'ANTI-THYROID MICROSOMAL AB', 'THYROGLOBULIN', 'THYROGLOBULIN .', 'THYROGLOBULIN AB', 'THYROGLOBULIN ANTIBODY SCREEN', 'THYROGLOBULIN TOTAL AND ANTIBODY', 'THYROGLOBULIN-BILL ONLY', 'THYROGLOBULIN.') AND ABS(DAYS("t4"."DT_DTE")-DAYS("t8"."DT_DTE")) <= 7) GROUP BY "t1"."PT_MRN" HAVING COUNT("t4"."DT_DTE") > 1) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PINC_ITEM_NAME" AS "Drug Name", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Dispense Date", "t7"."PDO_DOSE" AS "Dosage", "t7"."PDO_DOSE_UNIT" AS "Dose Unit", "t7"."PDO_INV_QTY" AS "Dispensed Quantity", "t5"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" AS "Lab-Test Name", "t6"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" AS "Lab-Subtest Name", "t8"."DT_DTE" AS "Lab-Performed Date", "t9"."PLR_RESULT_VALUE" AS "Lab-Test Result Value" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" INNER JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t10" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t10"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" INNER JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t11" ON "t10"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t11"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" INNER JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t12" ON "t11"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t12"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t11"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t12"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" INNER JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t2" ON "t12"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t2"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" INNER JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DISPENSE_OCCR" "t7" ON "t12"."POD_PHARMA_ORDER_DETAIL_ID" = "t7"."PDO_PHARMA_ORDER_DETAIL_ID" INNER JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t7"."PDO_DISPNS_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" INNER JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LAB_RESULT" "t9" ON "t10"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."PLR_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" INNER JOIN "DV"."LAB_TEST_CATALOG_V" "t5" ON "t9"."PLR_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID" = "t5"."LTC_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID" INNER JOIN "DV"."LAB_TEST_CATALOG_V" "t6" ON "t9"."PLR_LAB_SUBTEST_CATALOG_ID" = "t6"."LTC_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID" INNER JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t8" ON "t9"."PLR_PERFORMED_DATE_ID" = "t8"."DT_DATE_ID" INNER JOIN BASEPTS ON "t1"."PT_MRN" = BASEPTS.MRN WHERE (UPPER("t2"."PINC_ITEM_NAME") IN ('IODINE I-131 3F8', 'IODINE I-131 3F8 MOAB', 'IODINE I-131 8H9', 'IODINE I-131 8H9 MOAB', 'IODINE I-131 ANTI-B1 ANTIBODY', 'IODINE I-131 CHIMERIC G250 MOAB', 'IODINE I-131 DOSE', 'IODINE I-131 HU A33 MOAB', 'IODINE I-131 MIBG', 'IODINE I-131 NP-59', 'IODINE I-131 TOSITUMOMAB', 'IODINE I-131 B1 MOAB INJ.', 'IODINE I-131 DOSE (IN MCI)') AND UPPER("t5"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME") IN ('ANTI-THYROGLOB AB/ANTI-THYROID MICRO', 'ANTI-THYROGLOBULIN AB', 'ANTI-THYROID MICROSOMAL AB', 'THYROGLOBULIN', 'THYROGLOBULIN .', 'THYROGLOBULIN AB', 'THYROGLOBULIN ANTIBODY SCREEN', 'THYROGLOBULIN TOTAL AND ANTIBODY', 'THYROGLOBULIN-BILL ONLY', 'THYROGLOBULIN.') AND (ABS(DAYS("t4"."DT_DTE")-DAYS("t8"."DT_DTE")) <= 7))

prompt: New Visit and Internal Referral Volume in Urology by diagnosis (diagnosis code on PBD bill) for the year of 2012.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE APPTDATE, CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT, CRE_RES_NAME PHYSICIAN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID CSN, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR VT, DX_CLSF_CD DXCODE, DX_CLSF_PRIO PRIO, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK DESCRIPTION FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD') JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'URO' JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON CPE_MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE = CPE_ENC_DTE JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBI_MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBI_INV_NO = PBD_INV_NO AND PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.PBD_DX ON DX_MRN = PBI_MRN AND DX_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.CLM ON DX_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2012-12-31'

prompt: Patients who have had diagnostic molecular pathology indicated for specific genes with confirmation of leukemia
completion: WITH CONFIG AS (SELECT '(?i)....' AS DMP_SITE_PTR, '(?i)leukem|myelodys|mds|myeloid|aml' AS DMP_TUMOR_PTR FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1) , CHT AS (SELECT CHT_COHORT_ID FROM DVCMS.COHORT WHERE CHT_COHORT_ID = 9018) , PTS AS (SELECT CHP_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS COHORT_PID, PT_MRN AS CHT_MRN, CHT_COHORT_ID, DATE(CHP_CREATED_DT) ID_DATE, DAYS(CURRENT date) - DAYS(CHP_CREATED_DT) AS DAYS_ON_COHORT FROM DVCMS.COHORT_PATIENT JOIN CHT ON CHP_COHORT_ID = CHT_COHORT_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON CHP_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID ) , GENE_MATCH AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS GENE_PID , PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AS GENE_RID , PRPT_MODIFIED_DT, PATH_RPT_DATE , PT_MRN, GENE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, ABERRATIONTYPE, LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, NUCLEOTIDE, SEARCH_HIT2, METHOD, SEARCH_HIT1 FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE 1=1 AND GENE IN ('NPM1', 'FLT3', 'IDH1', 'IDH2', 'TP53' ,'U2AF1' , 'SRSF2' , 'ZRSR2' , 'SF3B1' , 'EIF1AX' , 'PHF5A' , 'PCBP1' , 'HNRNPCL1' , 'RBM10' , 'FUBP1' ) AND (PATH_RPT_DATE >= CURRENT date - 8 DAYS OR DATE(PRPT_MODIFIED_DT) >= CURRENT date - 7 DAYS) ) , DMP_DX_PRE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID, T.*, GENE_RID , PRPT_MODIFIED_DT, PATH_RPT_DATE , PT_MRN AS MRN, GENE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, ABERRATIONTYPE, LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, NUCLEOTIDE, SEARCH_HIT2, METHOD, SEARCH_HIT1 , PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name' , GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/gene-panel' , PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/part_description' , DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure') T JOIN GENE_MATCH ON GENE_RID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID) , DMP_DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT DMP.* FROM DMP_DX_PRE DMP JOIN CONFIG ON DV.REGEX(DMP_TUMOR_PTR, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, 'start') > 0) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) AS "Last Name", TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "First Name", TRIM(PT_BIRTH_DTE) AS "Date of Birth", TRIM(PT_DEATH_DTE) AS "Deceased Date", TRIM(PT_VITAL_STATUS) AS "Vital Status", TRIM(PT_SEX_DESC) AS "Gender" , PATH_RPT_DATE AS "Report Date" , DATE(PRPT_MODIFIED_DT) AS "Modified Date" , TRIM(GENE) AS "Gene" , TRIM(PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) AS "Accession No" , TRIM(ABERRATIONTYPE) AS "Aberration Type" , TRIM(LOCUS) AS "Locus" , TRIM(AA_CHANGE) AS "Amino Acid Change" , TRIM(NUCLEOTIDE) AS "Nucleotide" , TRIM(SEARCH_HIT2) AS "Search Hit2" , TRIM(PART_DESCRIPTION) AS "Part Description" , TRIM(GENE_PANEL) AS "Gene Panel" , TRIM(DT_PROCEDURE) AS "dt_procedure" , TRIM(METHOD) AS "Method" , TRIM(SEARCH_HIT1) AS "Search Hit1" , PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID AS DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID AS DMP_SAMPLE_ID , DAYS_ON_COHORT AS "Days Pt on Cohort" FROM DMP_DX JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = P_ID LEFT JOIN PTS ON COHORT_PID = P_ID ORDER BY MRN, PATH_RPT_DATE, DATE(PRPT_MODIFIED_DT), "Gene", "Locus", "Amino Acid Change" ;

prompt: Number of patients diagnosed with intravascular large b cell lymphoma between 1/1/2000 and 4/1/2022.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE, "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", YEAR("t4"."DT_DTE") AS "Year of Pathology Procedure Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_DEID_REPORT) <= 18000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_DEID_REPORT, 1, 18000) AS VARCHAR(18000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_DEID_REPORT, 1, 18000) AS VARCHAR(18000)) END) AS TXT FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '( "intravascular lbcl" OR "intravascular lbcl lymphoma" OR "intravascular lbcl lymphoma" OR "intravascular lbcl lymphoma" OR "intravascular large bcl" OR "intravascular large bcl lymphoma" OR "intravascular large bcl lymphoma" OR "intravascular large bcl lymphoma" OR "intravascular large b cell lymphoma" OR "intravascular large b-cell lymphoma" OR "intravascular diffuse large b cell lymphoma" OR "intravascular diffuse large b-cell lymphoma" OR "intravascular diffuse" )') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2022-04-01' UNION SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE, "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", YEAR("t4"."DT_DTE") AS "Year of Pathology Procedure Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_DEID_REPORT) <= 18000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_DEID_REPORT, 1, 18000) AS VARCHAR(18000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_DEID_REPORT, 1, 18000) AS VARCHAR(18000)) END) AS TXT FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '(("intravascular pattern" OR "Intravascular component") AND ("lymphoma" OR "lbcl" OR "bcl"))') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2022-04-01' ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MRN) FROM X

prompt: Provide hospital mortality rates for in-house patients and the count of patients with a diagnosis of lung cancer who were admitted to the ICU, both for 2009.
completion: SELECT CASE WHEN SUBSTR(CS_DSCH_DISP, 1, 1) IN ('C', 'D') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS DEATH_IND, COUNT(*) FROM IDB.CASE C WHERE CS_DSCH_DATE BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2009-12-31' AND CS_PT_STS LIKE 'I%' AND CS_PT_STS <> 'IP' GROUP BY CASE WHEN SUBSTR(CS_DSCH_DISP, 1, 1) IN ('C', 'D') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END WITH CTE1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT SCH_MRN, SCH_ACCT_NO, SCH_SCU_ADM_DTE FROM IDB.SCU_CENSUS WHERE SCH_SCU_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2009-12-31') SELECT DISTINCT SCH_MRN FROM CTE1 JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON SCH_MRN = CC_MRN AND (SCH_ACCT_NO = CC_ACCT_NO OR SCH_SCU_ADM_DTE >= CC_EFF_DTE) AND CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '162' AND '162.99' AND LEFT(CC_CLSF_TYPE, 2) = 'DF' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y'

prompt: patients seen in the Pediatrics Neuro Oncology Service who have had MSK-IMPACT run on their specimens plus the related IMPACT results.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, GENE, RESULT, LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, NUCLEOTIDE, SEARCH_HIT1, SEARCH_HIT2, METHOD, ABERRATIONTYPE, FOLD_CHANGE, GENE2 FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'NOC' AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2020-03-01'

prompt: Physician Billing and RMS Charges for Robotic Cases in JRSC
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, SSE_SURG_LOC FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSE_SURG_LOC LIKE 'JR%' AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD = '999997' AND YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE) IN (2019, 2020, 2021) ) SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN "MRN", PBD_SVC_DTE "Service Date", PBI_INV_NO "Invoice No", PBC_CPT_CD "CPT Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "CPT Description", DOC_NAME "Surgeon", PBI_TOT_CHG_AMT "Total Charge", PBD_SVC_AMT "Service Amount", PBD_SVC_QTY "Service Qty", PBI_SVC_LOC "Service Loc", SSE_SURG_LOC "Surgery Location" FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN CTE ON PBD_MRN = SSE_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE = SSE_SURG_DTE ORDER BY PBD_SVC_DTE, PBD_MRN, PBI_INV_NO, PBC_CPT_CD ; WITH CTE AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_LOG_ID, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSE_SURG_LOC, VIS_VISIT_ID, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_DAYS_STAY FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.VISIT ON VIS_MRN = SSE_MRN AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_ADM_DTE <= SSE_SURG_DTE AND COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DTE, '2999-12-31') >= SSE_SURG_DTE WHERE SSE_SURG_LOC LIKE 'JR%' AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD = '999997' AND YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE) IN (2019, 2020, 2021) ) SELECT DISTINCT RVCD_MRN "MRN", SSE_LOG_ID "Log ID", VIS_PATIENT_TYPE "Patient Type", RVCD_SVC_DTE "Service Date", DEPARTMENT_NAME "Department Name", CHARGE_DESCRIPTION "Charge Description", REV_CODE_DESC "Rev Code Desc", RVCD_AMT "Amount", RVCD_UNITS "Units", SSE_SURG_LOC "Surgery Location" FROM IDB.RMS_VISIT_CHARGE_DTL_V JOIN CTE ON VIS_VISIT_ID = RVCD_VISIT_ID ORDER BY RVCD_SVC_DTE, RVCD_MRN, DEPARTMENT_NAME

prompt: Adult ( = 18 years) oncology patients who tested positive for COVID-19 (via nasal swab or saliva) between 3/1/20 and 9/1/21 at any MSK site who have a documented serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D level up to 6 months prior to positive COVID-19 test.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT COR_MRN MRN, COR_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, COR_PATIENT_NAME PATIENT_NAME , COR_PATIENT_TYPE PATIENT_TYPE , YEAR(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) - YEAR(COR_DATE_OF_BIRTH) PT_AGE , COR_ORDER_NAME ORDER_NAME, COR_ITEM_NAME ITEM_NAME, COR_RESULT_TEXT RESULT_TEXT , COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT COVID_PERFORMED_DT , COR_ORDER_STATUS_CODE ORDER_STATUS FROM IDB.COVID19_ORDER_AND_RESULT WHERE DATE(COR_RESULT_ARRIVAL_DT) BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2021-09-01' AND COR_ITEM_NAME IN('COVID-19 Rapid Qualitative RNA Result', 'COVID-19 RNA Result') AND (COR_RESULT_TEXT like 'Detected%' OR COR_RESULT_TEXT LIKE 'Positive%') AND COR_PATIENT_TYPE <> 'Employee' AND COR_PATIENT_TYPE <> 'Plasma Donor' AND YEAR(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) - YEAR(COR_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PATIENT_NAME, DOB, PT_AGE "Age at COVID Test" , COVID_PERFORMED_DT, ITEM_NAME, RESULT_TEXT , LR_PERFORMED_DTE "Vit D 25 Hydroxy Date" , LR_ACCESSION_NO, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE "Vit D 25 Hydroxy Result" , LR_UNIT_MEASURE "Vit D 25 Hydroxy UOM" FROM CTE JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON MRN = LR_MRN WHERE LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Vitamin D 25 Hydroxy' AND (LR_PERFORMED_DTE) BETWEEN DATE(COVID_PERFORMED_DT) - 6 MONTH AND DATE(COVID_PERFORMED_DT) ;

prompt: Provide Engage BMT Survivorship pt self assessment insomnia question responses
completion: WITH ENGAGE_R AS (SELECT CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME, EF_SUBMISSION_DT, EF_FORM_ID, EF_MRN, EF_FORM_NAME, EFI_ITEM_TEXT, EFI_ITEM_ALIAS, EFI_VALUE FROM IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM ON EF_FORM_EXTERNAL_ID = EA_ASSESS_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CHAR(EA_SOURCE_ID) = CPE_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE EF_FORM_NAME = 'Survivorship Patient Self Assessment - Bone Marrow Transplant' AND DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) BETWEEN '2019-08-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND EFI_ITEM_ALIAS IN ('difficultysleeping_y_n', 'insomnia_severity', 'insomnia_interfere') ) , ENGAGE AS (SELECT EF_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE "SVP APPT DATE", EF_SUBMISSION_DT, MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS IN ('difficultysleeping_y_n') THEN EFI_VALUE END) "Have you had trouble sleeping", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS IN ('insomnia_severity') THEN EFI_VALUE END) "What was the severity of your insomnia", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS IN ('insomnia_interfere') THEN EFI_VALUE END) "How much did insomnia interfere" FROM ENGAGE_R GROUP BY EF_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, EF_SUBMISSION_DT) , BMT AS (SELECT CBM_MRN, CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE, CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE FROM ENGAGE JOIN IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE ON EF_MRN = CBM_MRN) , COMORBID AS (SELECT CC_MRN, LISTAGG(CHAR(FIRSTEFFDTE) || ': ' || DX, CHR(13)||CHR(10)) DX FROM (SELECT CC_MRN, CASE WHEN CCS_MULTI_LEVEL_2_DESC IN ('Hypertension') THEN 'Hypertension' WHEN CCS_SINGLE_LEVEL_DESC IN ('Coronary atherosclerosis and other heart disease') THEN 'Coronary heart disease' WHEN CCS_ICD_DESC IN ('Cardiac arrhythmia, unspecified') THEN 'Arrhythmia' WHEN CCS_ICD_DESC IN ('Atrial fibrillation') THEN 'Atrial fibrillation' WHEN CCS_ICD_DESC IN ('Obstructive sleep apnea (adult) (pediatric)') THEN 'Obstructive sleep apnea' END DX, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS FIRSTEFFDTE FROM IDB.CCS_HIER LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM ON CCS_ICD_CODE = CLM_CLSF_CD AND CLM_CD_TYPE = 'D' JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CLM_CLSF_CD = CC_CLSF_CD JOIN ENGAGE ON EF_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND (CCS_MULTI_LEVEL_2_DESC IN ('Hypertension') OR CCS_SINGLE_LEVEL_DESC IN ('Coronary atherosclerosis and other heart disease') OR CCS_ICD_DESC IN ('Cardiac arrhythmia, unspecified', 'Atrial fibrillation', 'Obstructive sleep apnea (adult) (pediatric)')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CASE WHEN CCS_MULTI_LEVEL_2_DESC IN ('Hypertension') THEN 'Hypertension' WHEN CCS_SINGLE_LEVEL_DESC IN ('Coronary atherosclerosis and other heart disease') THEN 'Coronary heart disease' WHEN CCS_ICD_DESC IN ('Cardiac arrhythmia, unspecified') THEN 'Arrhythmia' WHEN CCS_ICD_DESC IN ('Atrial fibrillation') THEN 'Atrial fibrillation' WHEN CCS_ICD_DESC IN ('Obstructive sleep apnea (adult) (pediatric)') THEN 'Obstructive sleep apnea' END ) GROUP BY CC_MRN) SELECT EF_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE, CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE, YEAR(CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_TRANSPLANT, BMT_BMI.PMH_BMI BMI_AT_TRANSPLANT, "SVP APPT DATE", EF_SUBMISSION_DT, YEAR(DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_SURVEY, SURVEY_BMI.PMH_BMI BMI_AT_SURVEY, "Have you had trouble sleeping", "What was the severity of your insomnia", "How much did insomnia interfere", DX COMORBIDITIES FROM ENGAGE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON EF_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN BMT ON EF_MRN = CBM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX BMT_BMI ON EF_MRN = BMT_BMI.PMH_MRN AND CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE = BMT_BMI.PMH_MEASURE_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX SURVEY_BMI ON EF_MRN = SURVEY_BMI.PMH_MRN AND DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) = SURVEY_BMI.PMH_MEASURE_DTE LEFT JOIN COMORBID ON EF_MRN = CC_MRN

prompt: Patients who either took Pentosan/Elmiron or have been diagnosed with Interstitial Cystitis and have had ophthalmic visits or EMR documents.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT HCPR_MRN MRN, HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_ID RX_ID , HCPR_CREATED_DTE RX_CREATE_DATE , DATE(HCPR_START_DT) AS START_DATE, DATE(HCPR_END_DT) AS END_DATE , HCPR_DRUG_NAME DRUG_NAME, HGN_GENERIC_NAME GENERIC_NAME , HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE_DESC RX_TYPE , HCPR_DOSE_AMT DOSE_AMT, HCPR_ROUTE ROUTE , UOM.HRUM_NAME UOM , HSF_ABBREVIATIION FREQ_ABBR , REQ.OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Requester", REQ.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE AS "Requester Role" , OCV_PVDR_NAME FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = HCPR_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER USR ON USR.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER REQ ON REQ.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE UOM ON UOM.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE PKG ON PKG.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_INNER_PACKAGE_SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_SCRIPT_FREQUENCY ON HSF_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID = HCPR_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID WHERE HCPR_STATUS_TYPE NOT IN (4, 8) AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE IS NOT NULL AND((HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 2, 5)) OR HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3) AND(UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%PENTOSAN%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%ELMIRON%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%PENTOSAN%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%ELMIRON%') ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE ENTER_DATE, OO_ORD_ID ORDID, 'Take home' AS RX_TYPE , OCV_CURR_LOC LOCATION, OS_SVC_DESC AS SERVICE , CASE WHEN NFN.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE IS NOT NULL THEN NFN.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME)||' '||STRIP(OO_ORD_MODIFIER) END DRUG_NAME , OMD_DOSE_LOW DOSE, OMD_DOSE_UNIT DOSE_UOM , OMD_ORD_ROUTE ROUTE, OO_ORD_FREQ FREQ , NFI.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE NF_INDICATION , OU_DISPLAY_NAME REQUESTER_NAME, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE REQUESTER_ROLE , OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS ATN_NAME , DOC_SVC SMS_SVC , DATE(CASE WHEN OSD_STOP_AFTER_OPT IN (1, 4) THEN OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT + (OSD_STOP_AFTER_VALUE - 1) DAY WHEN OSD_STOP_AFTER_OPT = 2 THEN OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT + OSD_STOP_AFTER_VALUE HOUR ELSE OO_STOP_DT END) AS STOPDT , COALESCE(LGR_LOC_GRP, 'Other') LOC_GRP , STRIP(QTY.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS RX_QTY FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = OCV_ATT_PVDR_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.LOCATION_GROUPS_REFERENCE ON LGR_LOC_GUID = OCV_CURR_LOC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OU_USER_GUID = OO_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_SYS_DATA ON OSD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OMD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA QTY ON QTY.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND QTY.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Rx - Quantity' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_FORM_FIELD ON OO_ENTRY_FRM_GUID = OFF_ENTRY_FRM_GUID AND OFF_FLD_LABEL IN ('Non-Formulary Medication Name:', 'Medication Name:') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA NFN ON NFN.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OFF_DI_CD = NFN.OUD_USER_DI_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA INS ON INS.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND INS.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Rx - Instructions' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA MST ON MST.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND MST.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Rx - Med Strength' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA NFI ON NFI.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND NFI.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Rx - NonForm Indication' LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2003-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3', 'DISC', 'DISCD') AND CASE WHEN OO_REQ_TME_PRIO IN ('NYS Paper', 'Outside Order', 'Fill at MSK', 'Medicaid') OR OO_IS_FOR_DSCH = 'Y' OR(OO_REQ_TME_PRIO = 'Routine' AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'O' AND OCV_CARE_LVL NOT IN ('AXR', 'UCO', 'OR', 'UCC')) THEN 'Rx' ELSE OCV_IP_OP_IND||'P' END = 'Rx' AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '3000001133073001' AND(UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE '%PENTOSAN%' OR UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE '%ELMIRON%') ) , Z AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC AS DX_DESC, 'Dx' AS RX_TYPE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('N30.1', 'N30.10', 'N30.11', '595.1') ) , CPE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'OPH' AND CPE_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM Z) ) , EMR AS (SELECT DISTINCT EAD_MRN AS MRN, EADT_DOCTYPE AS "Doc Type", EADT_EMR_DESC AS "Document Description", EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE AS "Document Date", DOC_NAME FROM IDB.EMR_AA_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.EMR_AA_DOCTYPE ON EADT_DOCTYPE = EAD_DOCTYPE LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON EAD_DOCTOR_NUM = DOC_DR_NO WHERE EAD_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM Z) AND UPPER(EADT_EMR_DESC) LIKE '%OPHT%' ) , FINAL AS (SELECT MRN, RX_TYPE AS GRP FROM X UNION SELECT MRN, RX_TYPE AS GRP FROM Y UNION SELECT MRN, 'Cadence' AS GRP FROM CPE UNION SELECT MRN, 'EMR Doc' AS GRP FROM EMR) SELECT MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, MAX(CASE WHEN GRP = 'eRx' THEN 'Y' END) AS "eRx", MAX(CASE WHEN GRP = 'HML' THEN 'Y' END) AS "HML", MAX(CASE WHEN GRP = 'Take home' THEN 'Y' END) AS "Take home", MAX(CASE WHEN GRP = 'Cadence' THEN 'Y' END) AS "Cadence", MAX(CASE WHEN GRP = 'EMR Doc' THEN 'Y' END) AS "EMR Doc" FROM FINAL JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN GROUP BY MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME), PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH

prompt: Provide dashboard for PPBC Biobank to display inventory of samples (reserved or not) filtered by protocol, type, gender, DOB, gene status etc.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.TBA_PROCUREMENT_DTE "Procurement Date" , TRIM(B.PT_MRN) "MRN" , TRIM(B.PT_LAST_NAME) "Last Name" , TRIM(B.PT_FIRST_NAME) "First Name" , TRIM(B.PT_SEX_DESC) "Gender" , B.PT_BIRTH_DTE "Date of Birth" , B.PT_DEATH_DTE "Date of Death" , B.PT_RACE_DESC "Race" , A.TBA_PROCUREMENT_AGE "Age" , D.TBPC_PROTOCOL "Protocol Consent" , TRIM(TBD_BANK_SUB_CD) "Campus" , TRIM(A.TBA_ACCESSION_NUM) "Accession Number" , TRIM(A.TBA_PART_NUM) "Part Number" , TRIM(A.TBA_SUB_PART_NUM) "Sub Part Number" , TRIM(TBD_BANK_NUM) "Bank Number" , TRIM(TBD_BANK_NOTE) "Bank Note" , TRIM(TBD_BANK_SEQ_NUM) "Aliquot Number" , TRIM(TRIM(TBD_OCT_T) || ' ' || TRIM(TBD_OCT_N) || ' ' || TRIM(TBD_NUN_T) || ' ' || TRIM(TBD_NUN_N)) "OCT NUN" , TRIM(A.TBA_DISEASE_DESC) "Disease" , TRIM(A.TBA_HISTOLOGY_DESC) || ' ' || TRIM(A.TBA_HISTOLOGY_SUB_DESC) || ' ' || TRIM(A.TBA_HISTOLOGY_SUB2_DESC) || ' ' || TRIM(A.TBA_HISTOLOGY_SUB3_DESC) "Histology" , TRIM(TBA_DIAGNOSIS_NOTE) "Diagnosis Note" , TRIM(TRIM(A.TBA_SITE_DESC) || ' ' || TRIM(A.TBA_SUB_SITE_DESC) || ' ' || TRIM(A.TBA_SUB2_SITE_DESC)) "Site" , TRIM(A.TBA_SITE_TEXT) "Site Text" , TRIM(TBD_CATEGORY_DESC) "Specimen Category" , TRIM(TBA_TISSUE_TYPE_DESC) "Tissue Type" , TRIM(TBD_UNIT_DESC) "Specimen Quality" , TRIM(TBD_SPECIMEN_TYPE_DESC) "Specimen Type" , TRIM(TBD_TIME_LAPSE_MIN) "Time Lapse" , TRIM(TBD_TRAY_NO)"Tray" , TRIM(TBD_BOX_NO) "Box" , TRIM(TBD_SHELF_NO) "Shelf" , TRIM(TBD_SLOT_NO) "Slot" , TRIM(TBD_RACK_NO) "Rack" , TRIM(TBD_FREEZER_NO) "Freezer" , TRIM(TBD_BIOBANK_TECH_NAME) "Biobank Tech Name" , CASE WHEN (TBD_RESERVED_REQUEST_ID IS NULL OR TBD_RESERVED_REQUEST_ID = '') AND (TBD_DISTRIBUTION_DT IS NULL) THEN 'No' ELSE 'Yes' END "Reserved" , TRIM(TBD_RESERVED_REQUEST_ID) "Reserved Request ID" , CASE WHEN TRIM(TBD_RESERVED_PROTOCOL_ID) = '' THEN NULL ELSE TRIM(TBD_RESERVED_PROTOCOL_ID) END "Reserved Protocol ID" , CASE WHEN TBD_DISTRIBUTION_DT IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END "Distributed" FROM DV.TISSUE_BANK_ACCESSION A JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS B ON TBA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = B.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.TISSUE_BANK_DETAIL ON TBA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = TBD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND TBA_ACCESSION_NUM = TBD_ACCESSION_NUM AND TBA_PART_NUM = TBD_PART_NUM AND TBA_SUB_PART_NUM = TBD_SUB_PART_NUM LEFT JOIN (SELECT PT_MRN, CASE WHEN TBPC_PROTOCOL = 'SPC-POE' AND TBPC_PROTOCOL_CONSENT = '1 - CANCER - Yes' THEN '00-000 06-107 1.Cancer' WHEN TBPC_PROTOCOL = 'SPC-POE' AND TBPC_PROTOCOL_CONSENT = '2 - OTHER - Yes' THEN '00-000 06-107 2.Other' WHEN TBPC_PROTOCOL = 'SPC-POE' AND TBPC_PROTOCOL_CONSENT = '3 - INHERIT GENETIC - Yes' THEN '00-000 06-107 3.Inherit Genetic' WHEN TBPC_PROTOCOL = 'SPC-POE' AND TBPC_PROTOCOL_CONSENT = '4 - GENETIC ANALYSIS - Yes' THEN '00-000 06-107 4.Genetic Analysis' WHEN TBPC_PROTOCOL = 'SPC-POE' AND (TBPC_PROTOCOL_CONSENT <> '1 - CANCER - Yes' OR TBPC_PROTOCOL_CONSENT <> '2 - OTHER - Yes' OR TBPC_PROTOCOL_CONSENT <> '3 - INHERIT GENETIC - Yes' OR TBPC_PROTOCOL_CONSENT <> '4 - GENETIC ANALYSIS - Yes') THEN '' ELSE TBPC_PROTOCOL END TBPC_PROTOCOL FROM DV.TISSUE_BANK_SPECIMEN_PATIENT_CONSENT JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON TBPC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON DT_DATE_ID = TBPC_LATEST_CONSENT_DATE_ID WHERE NOT (TBPC_PROTOCOL = 'SPC-POE' AND LEFT(TBPC_PROTOCOL_CONSENT, 1) NOT IN ('1', '2', '3', '4')) AND TBPC_PROTOCOL <> '06-107' ) D ON B.PT_MRN = D.PT_MRN ) SELECT DISTINCT A.* , TRIM(C.GENE) "Gene" , TRIM(C.ABERRATIONTYPE) "Aberration Type" , TRIM(C.AA_CHANGE) "AA Change" , TRIM(C.METHOD) "Method" , SITE_LIST "Site List" , DISEASE_LIST "Disease List" FROM CTE A LEFT JOIN (SELECT B."MRN", LISTAGG(B.SITE, ', ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY B.SITE) AS SITE_LIST FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN", "Site" SITE FROM CTE WHERE "Site" <> '' OR "Site" IS NOT NULL ) B GROUP BY MRN) SITE ON A."MRN" = SITE."MRN" LEFT JOIN (SELECT B."MRN", LISTAGG(B.DISEASE, ', ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY B.DISEASE) AS DISEASE_LIST FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN", TRIM("Disease") DISEASE FROM CTE WHERE "Disease" <> '' OR "Disease" IS NOT NULL OR "Disease" <> 'No Description' ) B GROUP BY MRN) DIS ON A."MRN" = DIS."MRN" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" , "t2"."TBA_DISEASE_DESC" , "t3"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" , CASE WHEN "t4"."RESULT" = 'POSITIVE' THEN "t4"."GENE" ELSE NULL END AS "GENE" , "t4"."RESULT" , "t4"."ABERRATIONTYPE" , "t4".AA_CHANGE , "t4"."METHOD" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t3" ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = "t3"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TISSUE_BANK_ACCESSION" "t2" ON "t3"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" = "t2"."TBA_REPORT_ID" LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_REFERENCES "t6" ON "t3"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" = "t6"."PRPTR_PATH_RPT_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t7" ON "t6"."PRPTR_CHILD_PATH_RPT_ID" = "t7"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V "t4" ON "t7"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" = "t4".PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID) C ON A.MRN = C.PT_MRN AND A."Accession Number" = C.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO

prompt: Create a Darwin cohort of patients with DLBCL, CLL and MCL with specified mutations.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN, SITE1_GENE, SITE2_GENE, GENE_ID, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS A ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = A.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE DTRPT ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = DTRPT.DT_DATE_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS VARIANT_CLASS VARCHAR(100) PATH 'variant_class', ONCOKB_INTERPRETATION VARCHAR(1000) PATH 'oncokb_interpretation', ONCOKB_REPORTED varchar (100) PATH 'oncokb_reported', ONCOKB_VER varchar (100) PATH 'oncokb_ver', SITE1_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site1_gene', SITE2_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site2_gene', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', EXON_NUM VARCHAR(100) PATH 'exon_num', AA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'aa_change', CDNA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'cDNA_change', GENE_FOLD_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_fold_change', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', PROJECT VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_alys_task_name', SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH '../meta-data/is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site') T WHERE TUMOR_TYPE_CODE IN ('DLBCL', 'DLBCLNOS') AND (SITE1_GENE IN ('CD79A', 'CD79B', 'CARD11', 'MALT', 'BCL10') OR SITE2_GENE IN ('CD79A', 'CD79B', 'CARD11', 'MALT', 'BCL10') OR GENE_ID IN ('CD79A', 'CD79B', 'CARD11', 'MALT', 'BCL10')) AND VARIANT_TYPE <> 'meta-data' AND A.PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL UNION SELECT PT_MRN, SITE1_GENE, SITE2_GENE, GENE_ID, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS A ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = A.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE DTRPT ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = DTRPT.DT_DATE_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS SITE1_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site1_gene', SITE2_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site2_gene', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name') T WHERE TUMOR_TYPE_CODE IN ('CLL', 'CLLSLL') AND (SITE1_GENE IN ('BTK', 'PLCG2', 'MALT', 'BCL10') OR SITE2_GENE IN ('BTK', 'PLCG2', 'MALT', 'BCL10') OR GENE_ID IN ('BTK', 'PLCG2', 'MALT', 'BCL10')) AND VARIANT_TYPE <> 'meta-data' AND A.PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL UNION SELECT PT_MRN, SITE1_GENE, SITE2_GENE, GENE_ID, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS A ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = A.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE DTRPT ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = DTRPT.DT_DATE_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS VARIANT_CLASS VARCHAR(100) PATH 'variant_class', ONCOKB_INTERPRETATION VARCHAR(1000) PATH 'oncokb_interpretation', ONCOKB_REPORTED varchar (100) PATH 'oncokb_reported', ONCOKB_VER varchar (100) PATH 'oncokb_ver', SITE1_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site1_gene', SITE2_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site2_gene', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', EXON_NUM VARCHAR(100) PATH 'exon_num', AA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'aa_change', CDNA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'cDNA_change', GENE_FOLD_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_fold_change', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', PROJECT VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_alys_task_name', SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH '../meta-data/is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site') T WHERE TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = 'MCL' AND (SITE1_GENE IN ('CARD11', 'MALT', 'BCL10') OR SITE2_GENE IN ('CARD11', 'MALT', 'BCL10') OR GENE_ID IN ('CARD11', 'MALT', 'BCL10')) AND VARIANT_TYPE <> 'meta-data' AND A.PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL

prompt: Blood utilization report on blood issued/used per physician and service for a date range.
completion: SELECT CIS.*, BB_PRODUCT, SEQ_NO, BB_QTY FROM (SELECT OP_DISPLAY_NAME REQUESTED_BY, OO_ENTER_DTE ENTER_DTE, OS_SVC_DESC SERVICE, OO_ORD_NAME ORD_NAME, OO_MRN MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT AS PERFORMED_DT, OO_ORD_ID ORD_ID, OO_ANCIL_REF_CD ANCIL_REF_CD, CASE WHEN OO_ACCT_NO LIKE '84%' THEN 'IP' ELSE 'OP' END AS PT_STS, LR_ACCESSION_NO ACCESSION_NO, CASE WHEN LR_RESULT_VALUE > '' THEN SUBSTR(LR_RESULT_VALUE, 1, 10) ELSE SUBSTR(LTL_TEXT_RESULT, 1, 10) END LAB_RESULT FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND UCASE(OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT)='BLOOD BANK' AND OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Cryoprecipitate Issued', 'FFP Issued', 'Granulocytes Issued', 'Platelets Issued', 'RBC Issued') JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OS_SVC_GUID = OCV_SVC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON OO_MRN = LR_MRN AND LR_ACCT_NO = OO_ACCT_NO AND LR_PERFORMED_DT = OO_PERFORMED_DT AND LR_ORD_ID = OO_ORD_ID AND OCV_VISIT_GUID = LR_CL_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LR_RESULT_GUID = LTL_RESULT_GUID AND LTL_LINE_NO = 1 WHERE OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN DATE(SUBSTR(CHAR(CURRENT DATE), 1, 8)||'01') - 1 MONTH AND DATE(CURRENT_DATE - DAY(CURRENT_DATE) DAYS) AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'REJCT') AND UCASE(OO_ORD_TYPE_CD) = 'OTHER' ) CIS LEFT JOIN (SELECT DTL_MRN, DTL_SVC_DTE, DTL_ACCT_NO, SUM(DTL_SVC_QTY) AS BB_QTY, DTL_SVC_CD||'-'||RTRIM(CDM_SVC_DESC) AS BB_PRODUCT, MIN(DTL_SEQ_NO) SEQ_NO, CASE WHEN DTL_SVC_CD = '54002001' THEN 'Cryoprecipitate Issued' WHEN DTL_SVC_CD = '54010913' THEN 'Granulocytes Issued' WHEN CDM_SVC_DESC LIKE '%PLAT%' THEN 'Platelets Issued' WHEN CDM_SVC_DESC LIKE '%PLASMA%' THEN 'FFP Issued' ELSE 'RBC Issued' END AS BB_MAPPING FROM IDB.PA_DETAIL JOIN IDB.CDM ON CDM_SVC_CD = DTL_SVC_CD AND CDM_SVC_CD IN ('54002001', '54010202', '54010301', '54010400', '54010913', '54010509', '54010608', '54011002', '54011010', '54011028') WHERE DTL_DTL_TYPE = 'C' AND DTL_SVC_DTE BETWEEN DATE(SUBSTR(CHAR(CURRENT DATE), 1, 8)||'01') - 1 MONTH AND DATE(CURRENT_DATE - DAY(CURRENT_DATE) DAYS) GROUP BY DTL_MRN, DTL_SVC_DTE, DTL_ACCT_NO, DTL_SVC_CD, CDM_SVC_DESC HAVING SUM(DTL_SVC_QTY) > 0) AS BB ON DTL_MRN = MRN AND DTL_SVC_DTE = DATE(PERFORMED_DT) AND BB_MAPPING = ORD_NAME

prompt: Provide a list of upcoming pediatric appointments for pediatric patients with mixed chimerism listed as a health issue
completion: WITH PEDS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN PEDS_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = ('PED') OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = ('PED') OR CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'ORTHOPEDICS 1275-9') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' UNION SELECT VIS_MRN PEDS_MRN FROM IDB.VISIT WHERE VIS_HOSP_SVC IN ('PDB', 'PDG', 'PDP', 'PDR', 'PDU', 'PED', 'PDS') AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') ) , PTS AS (SELECT PEDS_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FROM PEDS JOIN IDB.OMS_HEALTH_ISSUE ON PEDS_MRN = OHI_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PEDS_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE LOWER(OHI_HI_TEXT) like '%mixed chimerism%' AND PT_DEATH_IND NOT IN ('X', 'C', 'D') ) SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", CHAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PEDS_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date + 4 DAYS AND CURRENT date + 8 DAYS AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = ('PED') OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = ('PED') OR CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'ORTHOPEDICS 1275-9') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT'

prompt: Provide weekly report of appointment data for patients enrolled to protocol 18-035.
completion: WITH SCHED AS (SELECT AC_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RANK FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = AC_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('18-035') AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' ) , NXTMD AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RANK FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CPE_MRN IN (SELECT AC_MRN FROM SCHED) ) , SCAN AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RANK FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('RAD', 'NUC') AND (CRE_RES_NAME like '%MRI %' OR CRE_RES_NAME like '%CT %' OR CRE_RES_NAME like '%PET %') AND CPE_MRN IN (SELECT AC_MRN FROM SCHED) ) SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME FIRST, PT_FIRST_NAME LAST, CHAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) DOB, CHAR(A.CPE_ENC_DTE) NEXT_THR_APPT, CHAR(B.CPE_ENC_DTE) NEXT_MSK_MD_APPT, CHAR(C.CPE_ENC_DTE) NEXT_SCAN_APPT FROM SCHED A JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON AC_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN NXTMD B ON AC_MRN = B.CPE_MRN AND B.RANK = 1 LEFT JOIN SCAN C ON AC_MRN = C.CPE_MRN AND C.RANK = 1 WHERE A.RANK = 1 UNION SELECT '' MRN, '' FIRST, '' LAST, '' DOB, '' NEXT_THR_APPT, '' NEXT_MSK_MD_APPT, '' NEXT_SCAN_APPT FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1

prompt: Provide a report of all patient who had a PICC line placed at another institution which needed to be removed between 2019 and 2022
completion: WITH ETO AS (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID DOCGUID, CDD_MRN MRN, CDD_DOC_NAME DOCUMENT_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE SERVICE_DTE, OCV_IP_OP_IND IP_OP_IND, OCV_CURR_LOC CURR_LOCATION, OCV_ADM_DT, OCV_DSCH_DT, OS_SVC_DESC FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND (CDD_DOC_NAME) = 'Central Venous Catheterization Procedure' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' ), ADM AS (SELECT VIS_MRN, TRIM(CC_CLSF_CD)||' - '||TRIM(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) ADMIT_DX , VIS_ADM_DTE ADMIT_DATE, VIS_DSCH_DTE DISCH_DATE FROM ETO JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON VIS_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON VIS_MRN = CC_MRN AND VIS_ADM_NUM = CC_ADM_NUM AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE VIS_ADM_DTE = SERVICE_DTE AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, ADMIT_DX "ADMISSION DIAGNOSIS", DISCH_DATE "DATE OF DISCHARGE", OS_SVC_DESC "SERVICE", MAX(CASE WHEN OO_ORD_NAME = 'Central Venous Catheter (Nursing)' AND OO_ORD_MODIFIER = 'Placement Confirmed' THEN OO.OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE END) "DATE OF CATHETER PLACEMENT CONFIRMED", MAX(CASE WHEN OO_ORD_NAME = 'PICC Line (Nursing)' AND OO_ORD_MODIFIER = 'Discontinue' THEN OO.OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE END) "DATE OF DISCONTINUE PICC" FROM ETO JOIN ADM ON VIS_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER OO ON MRN = OO_MRN AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_ORD_NAME IN ('Central Venous Catheter (Nursing)', 'PICC Line (Nursing)') GROUP BY MRN, ADMIT_DX, DISCH_DATE, OS_SVC_DESC ;

prompt: Provide NSCLC patients either positive for ALK+ Fusion treated with Brigatinib or positive for EGFR Exon 20 insertions treated with Mobocertinib.
completion: WITH NSCLC AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2017-01-01' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8013/3', 'M8014/3', 'M8022/3', 'M8030/3', 'M8031/3', 'M8032/3', 'M8033/3', 'M8046/3', 'M8052/2', 'M8052/3', 'M8070/2', 'M8070/3', 'M8071/2', 'M8071/3', 'M8072/3', 'M8073/3', 'M8074/2', 'M8074/3', 'M8083/3', 'M8140/2', 'M8140/3', 'M8250/2', 'M8250/3', 'M8251/3', 'M8252/3', 'M8253/3', 'M8254/3', 'M8255/3', 'M8260/2', 'M8260/3', 'M8310/3', 'M8333/3', 'M8480/2', 'M8480/3', 'M8481/3', 'M8490/2', 'M8490/3', 'M8560/2', 'M8560/3', 'M8572/3', 'M8574/3', 'M8972/3', 'M8973/3', 'M8980/3') ) , ALK AS (SELECT PT_MRN ALK_MRN, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE AS PROCEDURE_DATE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS ACCESSION_NO, PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC AS REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE 1=1 AND (GENE = 'ALK' OR GENE2 = 'ALK') AND LOWER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%fusion%' AND PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE >= '2017-01-01' ), NSCLCWITHALK AS (SELECT ALK_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, PROCEDURE_DATE, ACCESSION_NO, REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_REPORT FROM NSCLC JOIN ALK ON TM_MRN = ALK_MRN) , DRUG AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE FROM NSCLCWITHALK JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON APR_MRN = ALK_MRN WHERE APR_START_DTE >= '2017-01-01' AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'BRIGATINIB' ) SELECT CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS "Vital Status", COUNT(DISTINCT ALK_MRN) AS "Count of Patients" FROM NSCLCWITHALK JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = ALK_MRN JOIN DRUG ON APR_MRN = ALK_MRN GROUP BY CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END ; WITH NSCLC AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2017-01-01' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8013/3', 'M8014/3', 'M8022/3', 'M8030/3', 'M8031/3', 'M8032/3', 'M8033/3', 'M8046/3', 'M8052/2', 'M8052/3', 'M8070/2', 'M8070/3', 'M8071/2', 'M8071/3', 'M8072/3', 'M8073/3', 'M8074/2', 'M8074/3', 'M8083/3', 'M8140/2', 'M8140/3', 'M8250/2', 'M8250/3', 'M8251/3', 'M8252/3', 'M8253/3', 'M8254/3', 'M8255/3', 'M8260/2', 'M8260/3', 'M8310/3', 'M8333/3', 'M8480/2', 'M8480/3', 'M8481/3', 'M8490/2', 'M8490/3', 'M8560/2', 'M8560/3', 'M8572/3', 'M8574/3', 'M8972/3', 'M8973/3', 'M8980/3') ) , EGFR AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS EGFR_MRN, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE 1=1 AND (GENE = 'EGFR' OR GENE2 = 'EGFR') AND UPPER(LOCUS) like 'EXON%20%' AND PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE >= '2017-01-01' ) , NSCLCWITHEGFR AS (SELECT EGFR_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_REPORT FROM NSCLC JOIN EGFR ON TM_MRN = EGFR_MRN) , DRUG AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE FROM NSCLCWITHEGFR JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON APR_MRN = EGFR_MRN WHERE APR_START_DTE >= '2017-01-01' AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'MOBOCERTINIB' ) SELECT CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS "Vital Status", COUNT(DISTINCT EGFR_MRN) AS "Count of Patients" FROM NSCLCWITHEGFR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = EGFR_MRN JOIN DRUG ON APR_MRN = EGFR_MRN GROUP BY CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END ;

prompt:
Provide high level stats for the institution: 

Number of patients/ visit per month/ year

Number of new patients per year.

Breakdown of patients seen per year by disease category.
completion: SELECT YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) || CASE WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(MONTH(CPE_ENC_DTE))) = 1 THEN '0' || TRIM(MONTH(CPE_ENC_DTE)) ELSE TRIM(MONTH(CPE_ENC_DTE)) END PERIOD, COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) PT_CNT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2019-01-01' GROUP BY YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) || CASE WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(MONTH(CPE_ENC_DTE))) = 1 THEN '0' || TRIM(MONTH(CPE_ENC_DTE)) ELSE TRIM(MONTH(CPE_ENC_DTE)) END ; SELECT YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE), COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) PT_CNT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2019-01-01' GROUP BY YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) ; SELECT YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) || CASE WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(MONTH(CPE_ENC_DTE))) = 1 THEN '0' || TRIM(MONTH(CPE_ENC_DTE)) ELSE TRIM(MONTH(CPE_ENC_DTE)) END PERIOD, COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) PT_CNT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2019-01-01' AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') GROUP BY YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) || CASE WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(MONTH(CPE_ENC_DTE))) = 1 THEN '0' || TRIM(MONTH(CPE_ENC_DTE)) ELSE TRIM(MONTH(CPE_ENC_DTE)) END ; SELECT YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE), COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) PT_CNT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2019-01-01' AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') GROUP BY YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' ) SELECT CATEGORY1, COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) CNT FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3') GROUP BY CATEGORY1

prompt: Provide a list of patients with buccal cancer diagnosis between 2000- present.
completion: WITH TUMOR AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, AV_DESC AS LATERALITY, TM_SITE_TXT FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'LATERALITY_CD' AND AV_CODE = TM_LATERALITY_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD = 'C060' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2001-01-01' AND '2019-11-14' ) , CC AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS CC_EFF_DTE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD = 'C06.0' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-11-14') SELECT PT_MRN MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB , COALESCE(TM_DX_DTE, CC_EFF_DTE) AS BUCCAL_DX_DTE , HIST_DESC , LATERALITY , TM_SITE_TXT FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN TUMOR ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN CC ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ; WITH TUMOR AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, AV_DESC AS LATERALITY, TM_SITE_TXT FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'LATERALITY_CD' AND AV_CODE = TM_LATERALITY_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD = 'C060' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2001-01-01' AND '2019-11-14' ) , CC AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS CC_EFF_DTE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD = 'C06.0' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-11-14') SELECT PT_MRN MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB , COALESCE(TM_DX_DTE, CC_EFF_DTE) AS BUCCAL_DX_DTE , HIST_DESC , LATERALITY , TM_SITE_TXT , RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME , RTC_TX_START_DTE , RTC_TX_STOP_DTE , RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON PT_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN AND RTC_TX_START_DTE >= '2001-01-01' AND RTC_TX_STOP_DTE <= '2019-11-14' LEFT JOIN TUMOR ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN CC ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ; WITH TUMOR AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, AV_DESC AS LATERALITY, TM_SITE_TXT FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'LATERALITY_CD' AND AV_CODE = TM_LATERALITY_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD = 'C060' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2001-01-01' AND '2019-11-14' ) , CC AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS CC_EFF_DTE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD = 'C06.0' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-11-14') SELECT PT_MRN MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB , COALESCE(TM_DX_DTE, CC_EFF_DTE) AS BUCCAL_DX_DTE , HIST_DESC , LATERALITY , TM_SITE_TXT FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN TUMOR ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN CC ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON PT_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL AND RTC_TX_MRN IS NULL

prompt: CIS Outpatient Blood Product order details
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OUO_MRN MRN, OUO_VISIT_GUID "Visit GUID", OUO_ORD_ID "Order ID", OOC_ITEM_NAME "Order Item Name", OUO_REQUESTED_DT "Requested Date", RL.OSH_CREATE_DT RELEASED_DT, CT.OSH_CREATE_DT COMPLETED_DT, DS.OSH_CREATE_DT DISCONTINUED_DT, DS.OSH_REASON_TXT DISC_REASON, CN.OSH_CREATE_DT CANCELLED_DT, CN.OSH_REASON_TXT CANCEL_REASON, EX.OSH_CREATE_DT EXPIRED_DT, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE "Transfusion Site", OCV_CURR_LOC "Visit Location" FROM IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OUO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID=OUO_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID=OUO_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD='BB_Product OP Transfusion Site' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX RL ON OUO_ORD_GUID = RL.OSH_ORD_GUID AND RL.OSH_FUNCTION_CD = '105' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX CT ON OUO_ORD_GUID = CT.OSH_ORD_GUID AND CT.OSH_ORD_STS_CD = 'COMP' AND CT.OSH_FUNCTION_CD = '109' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX DS ON OUO_ORD_GUID = DS.OSH_ORD_GUID AND DS.OSH_ORD_STS_CD = 'DISC' AND DS.OSH_FUNCTION_CD BETWEEN '56' AND '59' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX CN ON OUO_ORD_GUID = CN.OSH_ORD_GUID AND CN.OSH_ORD_STS_CD = 'CANC' AND CN.OSH_FUNCTION_CD BETWEEN '54' AND '55' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX EX ON OUO_ORD_GUID = EX.OSH_ORD_GUID AND EX.OSH_ORD_STS_CD = 'AUC3' WHERE OUO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2017-09-01' AND '2018-01-22' AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'O' AND (OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Red Blood Cells' OR OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Red Blood Cells.' OR OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Platelets') ORDER BY 1

prompt: We aim to assess factors that contribute to differences in monitoring and drops in ejection fraction for people treated with trastuzumab.
completion: WITH DRUG AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN DRUG_MRN, MIN(OO_ENTER_DTE) "Date Prescribed" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER WHERE UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) like 'TRASTUZUMAB%' AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= '2005-01-01' GROUP BY OO_MRN), PTS AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS "MRN" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7') AND TM_SSF15 = '010' AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C500' ,'C501' ,'C502' ,'C503' ,'C504' ,'C505' ,'C506' ,'C508' ,'C509') UNION SELECT CDD_MRN "MRN" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Follow Up - Breast Surgery' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('HER2:') AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT = 'Positive' ) , PTS_AND_DRUG AS (SELECT "MRN" FROM PTS JOIN DRUG ON DRUG_MRN = MRN ) , APPOINTMENTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 MAIN_REG FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN=CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' ) SELECT PT_MRN, PT_RACE, PT_PT_ETHNICITY, MAIN_REG FROM PTS_AND_DRUG JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=MRN LEFT JOIN APPOINTMENTS ON CPE_MRN = MRN ; SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_NAME, C.CDD_DOC_GUID, C.CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Temperature F' THEN TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END "Temperature F", CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Pulse/Heart Rate' THEN TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END "Pulse/Heart Rate", CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Blood Pressure BP Systolic' THEN TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END "Blood Pressure BP Systolic", CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Blood Pressure Diastolic' THEN TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END "Blood Pressure Diastolic" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT C JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like '%VITAL SIGNS%' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Blood Pressure BP Systolic', 'Blood Pressure Diastolic', 'Blood Pressure Systolic', 'Temperature F', 'Pulse/Heart Rate') AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE > CURRENT date - 7 DAYS

prompt: Provide a list of patients who had an FDG-PET scan performed within +/-6 weeks of a lymphoma diagnosis.
completion: WITH CTE AS ( SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t2"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t2"."PT_SEX" AS "Gender", "t2"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t2"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", "t6"."CDTM_CDB_SEQ_NO" AS "Tumor Sequence", "t7"."TCA_CASE_STS_DESC" AS "Case Status", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "CDB Tumor Diagnosis Date", "t4"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t4"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Desc", "t5"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t5"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Desc", "t6"." "T8"."PLA_LAST_CHEMO_DTE" AS "LAST MSK CHEMO Date", "T8"."PLA_LAST_RT_DTE" AS "LAST MSK RADIATION THERAPY Date", "T8"."PLA_LAST_CONTACT_DTE" AS "LAST CONTACT Date", "T10"."DT_DTE" AS "PET DTE", ABS(days("T10"."DT_DTE")-days("T3"."DT_DTE")) AS DIFF FROM /* ddqb://Application/Entities/PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED */ "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "T1" LEFT JOIN /* ddqb://Application/Entities/PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS */ "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "T2" ON "T1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "T2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN /* ddqb://Application/Entities/CDB_TUMOR */ "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "T6" ON "T1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "T6"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN /* ddqb://Application/Entities/ADE.CDB_TUMOR_DIAGNOSIS_DATE */ "DV"."DATE" "T3" ON "T6"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "T3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN /* ddqb://Application/Entities/ADE.CDB_TUMOR_HISTOLOGY_CATALOG */ "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "T4" ON "T6"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "T4"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN /* ddqb://Application/Entities/ADE.CDB_TUMOR_SITE_CATALOG */ "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "T5" ON "T6"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "T5"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN /* ddqb://Application/Entities/TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES */ "DV"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES" "T7" ON "T6"."CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID" = "T7"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN /* ddqb://Application/Entities/PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY */ "DV"."PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY" "T8" ON "T1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "T8"."PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN /* ddqb://Application/Entities/CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE */ "DV"."CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "T9" ON "T1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "T9"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN /* ddqb://Application/Entities/ADE.CPT_PBD_PROCEDURE_DATE */ "DV"."DATE" "T10" ON "T9"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "T10"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE "T4"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ( 'M9590/3', 'M9591/3', 'M9592/3', 'M9593/3', 'M9594/3', 'M9595/3', 'M9596/3', 'M9600/3', 'M9601/3', 'M9602/3', 'M9610/3', 'M9611/3', 'M9612/3', 'M9613/3', 'M9614/3', 'M9615/3', 'M9620/3', 'M9621/3', 'M9622/3', 'M9623/3', 'M9630/3', 'M9631/3', 'M9632/3', 'M9633/3', 'M9640/3', 'M9641/3', 'M9642/3', 'M9650/3', 'M9651/3', 'M9652/3', 'M9653/3', 'M9654/3', 'M9655/3', 'M9656/3', 'M9657/3', 'M9658/3', 'M9659/3', 'M9660/3', 'M9661/3', 'M9662/3', 'M9663/3', 'M9664/3', 'M9665/3', 'M9666/3', 'M9667/3', 'M9670/3', 'M9671/3', 'M9672/3', 'M9673/3', 'M9674/3', 'M9675/3', 'M9676/3', 'M9677/3', 'M9678/3', 'M9679/3', 'M9680/3', 'M9681/3', 'M9682/3', 'M9683/3', 'M9684/3', 'M9685/3', 'M9686/3', 'M9687/3', 'M9688/3', 'M9689/3', 'M9690/3', 'M9691/3', 'M9692/3', 'M9693/3', 'M9694/3', 'M9695/3', 'M9696/3', 'M9697/3', 'M9698/3', 'M9699/3', 'M9700/3', 'M9701/3', 'M9702/3', 'M9703/3', 'M9704/3', 'M9705/3', 'M9706/3', 'M9707/3', 'M9708/3', 'M9709/3', 'M9710/3', 'M9711/3', 'M9712/3', 'M9713/3', 'M9714/3', 'M9715/3', 'M9716/3', 'M9717/3', 'M9718/3', 'M9719/3', 'M9720/3', 'M9721/3', 'M9722/3', 'M9723/3', 'M9727/3', 'M9728/3', 'M9729/3') AND "T9"."PROC_ID" IN ( 11544, 11894, 11560, 11907, 11573, 11593, 23304, 22970, 23305, 22971, 23306, 22972, 18441, 18107, 18442, 18108, 18443, 18109, 18444, 18110, 18445, 18111, 18446, 18112, 18447, 18113, 18448, 18114, 18449, 18115, 231, 566, 18153, 571, 237, 572, 238, 573, 239, 574, 240, 575, 241, 576, 242, 577, 243, 578, 244, 579, 245, 580, 246, 581, 18171, 18506, 18172, 18507, 23009, 586, 251, 289, 18197, 23205, 22871, 23206) AND "T10"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN ("T3"."DT_DTE" - 42 DAYS) AND ("T3"."DT_DTE" + 42 DAYS) ), MIN as ( SELECT "DEIDENT PT #", "TUMOR SEQUENCE", MIN(DIFF) AS MIN_DIFF FROM CTE GROUP BY "DEIDENT PT #", "TUMOR SEQUENCE" ), CT_CTE as ( SELECT DISTINCT "T1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "DEIDENT PT #", "TUMOR SEQUENCE", -- "T2"."PCC_CODE" AS "CPT PROCEDURE CODE - PBD", -- "T2"."PCC_DESC" AS "CPT PROCEDURE DESC - PBD", "T3"."DT_DTE" AS "CT DTE" , ABS(days("CDB TUMOR DIAGNOSIS Date")-days("T3"."DT_DTE")) AS CT_DIFF FROM CTE JOIN /* ddqb://Application/Entities/PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED */ "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "T1" ON "T1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "DEIDENT PT #" LEFT JOIN /* ddqb://Application/Entities/CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE */ "DV"."CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "T2" ON "T1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "T2"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN /* ddqb://Application/Entities/ADE.CPT_PBD_PROCEDURE_DATE */ "DV"."DATE" "T3" ON "T2"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "T3"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE "T2"."PCC_DESC" LIKE 'CT%' OR "T2"."PCC_CODE" IN ('78816', '78814', '78815') ), CT_MIN as ( SELECT "DEIDENT PT #", "TUMOR SEQUENCE", MIN(CT_DIFF) AS CT_MIN_DIFF FROM CT_CTE GROUP BY "DEIDENT PT #", "TUMOR SEQUENCE" ), CT_MIN_DIFF as ( SELECT A."DEIDENT PT #", B."TUMOR SEQUENCE", "CT DTE" FROM CT_CTE A JOIN CT_MIN B ON A."DEIDENT PT #" = B."DEIDENT PT #" AND A."TUMOR SEQUENCE" = B."TUMOR SEQUENCE" AND CT_DIFF = CT_MIN_DIFF ) SELECT A.*, "CT DTE" FROM CTE A JOIN MIN B ON A."DEIDENT PT #" = B."DEIDENT PT #" AND A."TUMOR SEQUENCE" = B."TUMOR SEQUENCE" AND DIFF = MIN_DIFF LEFT JOIN CT_MIN_DIFF C ON A."DEIDENT PT #" = C."DEIDENT PT #" AND A."TUMOR SEQUENCE" = C."TUMOR SEQUENCE"

prompt: Provide a list of patients who have completed an in-person clinic (acupuncture and outpatient consult)visit with Dr. Jun J. Mao at BAIC 300 East 66th Street since 10/1/2019.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_ADDR1, PT_ADDR2, PT_CITY, PT_STATE , PT_ZIP_CD, PT_COUNTRY, PT_PHONE, PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS, YEAR (CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT, CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DTE, CASE WHEN CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Arrived' THEN 'Comp' ELSE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS END AS STATUS, CPE_APPT_DT AS APPT_DT, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VT_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AS VT_ID, CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE AS LAST_PORTAL_LOG_IN_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AND NOT (UPPER(CVT_EXT_NAME) LIKE '%TELEMEDICINE%' OR UPPER(CVT_EXT_NAME) LIKE '%PHONE%') JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN AND PT_DEATH_IND NOT IN ('C', 'D', 'X') JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPP_CL_PT_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_VST_RES_ID IN ('021154') AND ((CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY) OR (CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE))) , LAST_APPT AS (SELECT MRN, APPT_DTE AS LAST_APPT_DTE, VT_NAME AS LAST_VT, DEPT AS LAST_DEPT, PROVIDER AS LAST_PROVIDER FROM PTS JOIN (SELECT MRN AS MRN_L, MAX(APPT_DT) AS LAST_APPT_DT FROM PTS WHERE STATUS = 'Comp' GROUP BY MRN) AS X ON MRN = MRN_L AND APPT_DT = LAST_APPT_DT) , NEXT_APPT AS (SELECT MRN, APPT_DTE AS NEXT_APPT_DTE, VT_NAME AS NEXT_VT, DEPT AS NEXT_DEPT, PROVIDER AS NEXT_PROVIDER FROM PTS JOIN (SELECT MRN AS MRN_N, MIN(APPT_DT) AS NEXT_APPT_DT FROM PTS WHERE STATUS = 'Sch' GROUP BY MRN) AS X ON MRN = MRN_N AND APPT_DT = NEXT_APPT_DT) SELECT DISTINCT A.MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, AGE, DOB, PT_ADDR1, PT_ADDR2, PT_CITY, PT_STATE , PT_ZIP_CD, PT_COUNTRY, PT_PHONE, PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS, LAST_APPT_DTE, LAST_VT, LAST_DEPT, LAST_PROVIDER, NEXT_APPT_DTE, NEXT_VT, NEXT_DEPT, NEXT_PROVIDER , LAST_PORTAL_LOG_IN_DTE FROM PTS A LEFT JOIN LAST_APPT B ON A.MRN = B.MRN LEFT JOIN NEXT_APPT C ON A.MRN = C.MRN WHERE 1=1

prompt: Lab Visits from January 2023 through May 2023
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", DEPT.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", DEPT.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", PVDR.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", REF_PVDR.CRE_RES_NAME AS REF_PVDR, REF_DEPT.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS REF_DEPT_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE PVDR ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = PVDR.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = DEPT.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF_PVDR ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = REF_PVDR.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT REF_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = REF_DEPT.CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND (DEPT.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('LAB', 'CHM') OR DEPT.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = 'CHM') AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'LAB%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'MEDIPORT BLOOD%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'INJ ONLY%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'PORT FLUSH%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'DISCONNECT ONLY%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'EKG%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'PICC DRESSING CHANGE%') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-05-31'

prompt: Provide O.R. list from 2000 to 2010 of patients that have had free fibular flap maxillary and/or mandibular reconstructive surgery.
completion: SELECT SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('20969', '20955', '21196') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'

prompt: Provide a list of Dr. Patrick Boland's active patients seen in NYC clinic within the past 3 years.
completion: WITH LAST_VISIT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT DESC) AS LAST_VIS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-05-31' AND CRE_RES_ID = '004093' ) , NEXT_VISIT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) AS NEXT_VIS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_ID = '004093' ) , SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT OC_SURG_DTE, OC_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME, LISTAGG(CPX_PROC_NAME, CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY OC_MRN) VISIT_TYPE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OC_MRN ORDER BY OC_SURG_DTE DESC) AS FOR_LAST FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE_CD = '1' AND OCAS_PNL_NO = '1' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON OCAS_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('004093') GROUP BY OC_SURG_DTE, OC_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME) , ICD910 AS (SELECT CC_MRN, SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(NAME "c", CC_CLSF_CD || CHR(13) || CHR(10)) ORDER BY CC_MRN) AS CLOB(32000)) AS VARCHAR(32000)), '<c>', ','), '</c>', ''), '', ''), '<c/>', ''), ',', ''), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), 1) AS CC_CLSF_CD FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 6) IN ('C41.0', 'C41.2', 'C41.3', 'C41.4', 'C41.9', 'C49.20', 'C79.51', 'D48.0', 'D48.1', '170.0', '170.2', '170.3', '170.4', '170.9', '171.3', '198.5', '238.0', '238.1') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%') GROUP BY CC_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT A.PT_MRN "MRN", A.PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", A.PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", A.PT_SEX "Gender", A.PT_ADDR1 "Address 1", A.PT_ADDR2 "Address 2", A.PT_CITY "City", A.PT_STATE "State", A.PT_ZIP_CD "Zip Code", B.CPE_ENC_DTE "Last Visit Date", B.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Last Visit Type", C.CPE_ENC_DTE "Next Scheduled Visit Date", C.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Next Scheduled Visit Type", S.OC_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", S.VISIT_TYPE "Surgery Details", CC_CLSF_CD "ICD9/10 Code", LAD_DONOT_CON_IND "Do Not Contact Indicator", PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND "Do Not Mail Indicator" FROM IDB.PATIENT A JOIN LAST_VISIT B ON PT_MRN = B.CPE_MRN AND B.LAST_VIS = 1 LEFT JOIN NEXT_VISIT C ON PT_MRN = C.CPE_MRN AND C.NEXT_VIS = 1 JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTV_DTL ON PT_MRN = LAD_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN SURG S ON PT_MRN = S.OC_MRN AND FOR_LAST = 1 LEFT JOIN ICD910 ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE COALESCE(B.CPE_MRN, C.CPE_MRN) IS NOT NULL AND PT_DEATH_IND IN ('A', '') ORDER BY B.CPE_ENC_DTE DESC ;

prompt: Add providers to NEU14650
completion: SELECT CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'BSK' THEN 'Basking Ridge' WHEN CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'WES' THEN 'Westchester' WHEN CLD_CLD_CENTER = '300 E66' THEN 'BAIC' WHEN CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'OT 515' THEN 'OT515' WHEN CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'PT 515' THEN 'PT515' WHEN CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'BER' THEN 'Bergen' WHEN CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'CMK' THEN 'Commack' WHEN CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'MON' THEN 'Monmouth' WHEN CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'NAS' THEN 'Nassau' WHEN CRE_RES_NAME LIKE 'SOUVER%' THEN 'Reg Management' WHEN CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'KOCH' THEN 'Koch' ELSE CLD_CLD_CENTER END AS REPORTING_DEPT, CRE_EXT_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER_NAME , CRE_RES_NAME, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER AS CENTER, CRE_RES_ID, CLD_DEPT_ID FROM IDB.CL_RES_DEPT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPD_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_STS = 'Active' JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPD_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_REC_STS <> 'Inactive' AND (CRE_RES_NAME LIKE 'FORREST%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE 'SANFIL%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE 'PT FLOAT KOCH%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE 'OT FLOAT KOCH%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE 'ZARZ%' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'BER' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE 'ANDREWS, A%' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'BER' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE 'POTESTIO%' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'KOCH' OR (CRE_RES_NAME LIKE 'COTRON%' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'KOCH') OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE 'BAMDAD%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE 'SOUVER%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE 'KIM, E%' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = '300 E66' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE 'GORDON, J%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE 'BOULOS%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE 'OT FLOAT BSK%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE 'SWIFT%')

prompt: Provide a weekly list of patients with lung cancer with MDM2 amplification.
completion: WITH GENE_ALIVE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PSR.PT_MRN AS GENE_MRN, PSR.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS GENE_PID, PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AS GENE_RID, GENE, GENE2, AA_CHANGE , LOCUS, NUCLEOTIDE, ABERRATIONTYPE, FOLD_CHANGE, SEARCH_HIT1, SEARCH_HIT2 FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V PSR JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS PD ON PD.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PSR.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND PT_VITAL_STATUS = 'ALIVE' WHERE (GENE = 'MDM2' OR GENE2 = 'MDM2') AND ABERRATIONTYPE = 'copy number gain' ) , DMP_DX_PRE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID, RPT.DT_DTE AS REPORT_DATE , PT_MRN AS DMP_MRN , DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID AS R_ID, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID , DV.TODATE(DT_PROCEDURE) AS "Procedure Date" , DT_PROCEDURE , PRIMARY_SITE , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE , TUMOR_TYPE_NAME , METASTASIS_SITE , PDWS_NAME, PDWS_DESCRIPTION , GENE_PANEL , PART_DESCRIPTION , GENE, GENE2, AA_CHANGE , LOCUS, NUCLEOTIDE, ABERRATIONTYPE, FOLD_CHANGE, SEARCH_HIT1, SEARCH_HIT2 FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT JOIN GENE_ALIVE ON GENE_RID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'fn:string-join(../meta-data/primary_site,",")' , DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'fn:string-join(../meta-data/dt_procedure,",")' , TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(100) PATH 'fn:string-join(../meta-data/tumor_type_name,",")' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'fn:string-join(../meta-data/tumor_type_code,",")' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'fn:string-join(../meta-data/metastasis_site,",")' , GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(100) PATH 'fn:string-join(../meta-data/gene_panel,",")' , PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(264) PATH 'fn:string-join(../meta-data/part_description,",")') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE AS TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('LUNG', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = X.TTC JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V PRV ON PRV.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V RPT ON RPT.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID WHERE 1=1 ) SELECT * FROM DMP_DX_PRE ;

prompt:
Create ongoing monthly report with total number of patient visits per ETC unit, per month, by therapeutic protocol number.  

Provide separate files for 2010 and 2011 – up to date.
