completion: SELECT APPT.MRN, APPT.LST_APPT_DT , APPT.DEPT_ID, APPT.DEPT_NAME , IRB.LST_CONS_DTE , CASE WHEN IRB.IRB_NO IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE IRB.IRB_NO END IRB_NO , CASE WHEN IRB.IRB_TITLE IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE IRB.IRB_TITLE END IRB_TITLE FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, MAX(CPE_APPT_DT) AS LST_APPT_DT , CLD_DEPT_ID DEPT_ID , CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', ' Comp') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 AND CPE_DEPT_ID IN (346, 361, 392, 670) AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH - DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTHS)DAYS + 1 DAYS AND CPE_ENC_DTE <= LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTHS) GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CLD_DEPT_ID, CLD_DEPT_NAME) APPT LEFT JOIN (SELECT MRN, LST_CONS_DTE, PRO_IRB_NO IRB_NO , PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE, PRO_IRB_TITLE IRB_TITLE FROM (SELECT MRN , MAX(AC_CONS_DTE) AS LST_CONS_DTE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', ' Comp') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 AND CPE_DEPT_ID IN (346, 361, 392, 670) AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH - DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTHS)DAYS + 1 DAYS AND CPE_ENC_DTE <= LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTHS) ) AS APPT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.PROTOCOL ON AC_IRB_NO = PRO_IRB_NO AND PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE LIKE 'Therapeutic%' GROUP BY MRN) AS CONS JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = MRN AND AC_CONS_DTE = LST_CONS_DTE JOIN IDB.PROTOCOL ON AC_IRB_NO = PRO_IRB_NO AND PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE LIKE 'Therapeutic%') AS IRB ON APPT.MRN = IRB.MRN

prompt: Multi Panel OR Cases for Plastic
completion: WITH PLA AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_LOG_ID PLA_LOG_ID FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'PLA' AND YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE) = YEAR(CURRENT DATE - 1 DAYS) ) , MULTIPANEL AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_LOG_ID MULTIPANEL_LOG_ID FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN PLA ON SSE_LOG_ID = PLA_LOG_ID WHERE SSP_PNL_NO <> 1 ) SELECT SSE_MRN MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", SSE_LOG_ID "Log ID", SSP_PNL_NO "Panel No", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD "CPT Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC "CPT Description", TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) "Surgeon", SSP_SURG_SVC_CD "Surgery Service", VIS_ADM_NUM "Admit Number", VIS_ADM_DTE "Admit Date", VIS_DSCH_DTE "Discharge Date", VIS_DAYS_STAY "Length of Stay", VIS_HOSP_SVC "Hospital Service" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN MULTIPANEL ON SSE_LOG_ID = MULTIPANEL_LOG_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT ON VIS_MRN = SSE_MRN AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_ADM_DTE <= SSE_SURG_DTE AND COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DTE, '2999-12-31') >= SSE_SURG_DTE ORDER BY SSE_MRN DESC, SSE_LOG_ID, SSP_PNL_NO

prompt: Create a Tableau dashboard to track current inpatients placed under COVID quarantine
completion: WITH IP AS (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(CPL_MRN) CPL_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CPL_PROBLEM_DESC, DATE(CPL_PROBLEM_CREATED_WHEN_DT) PROBLEM_CREATE_DTE, CPL_PROBLEM_ENTERED_BY, CCV_ADMIT_DT, CCV_PROVIDER_NAME, CCV_SERVICE_DESC, OL_LOC_NAME, CCV_CURRENT_LOCATION FROM IDB.COVID19_PROBLEM_LIST JOIN IDB.COVID19_CLIENT_VISIT ON CPL_MRN = CCV_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON CCV_CURRENT_LOCATION_GUID = OL_LOC_GUID AND CCV_CARE_LEVEL_CODE <> 'Inpt Schedule' AND CCV_VISIT_STATUS IN ('ADM') AND CCV_VISIT_TYPE = 'Inpatient' LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPL_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPL_PROBLEM_STATUS = 'Active' AND CPL_PROBLEM_DESC IN ('Droplet-Rule Out Quarantine', 'Airborne-Contact-Rule Out COVID-19') ) , COVID_TEST AS (SELECT DISTINCT COR_MRN, DATE(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) TEST_DATE, COR_ORDER_NAME, CASE WHEN UPPER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'DETECTED%' OR UPPER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'POSITIVE%' THEN 'Positive' WHEN UPPER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) LIKE 'NEGATIVE%' OR UPPER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) LIKE 'NOT DETECTED%' THEN 'Negative' WHEN LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'inconclusive%' THEN 'Inconclusive' WHEN LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like '%invalid%' OR LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'presumptive%' OR COR_ABNORMALITY_CODE IS NULL THEN 'Pending' ELSE 'Pending' END AS TEST_RESULT FROM IDB.COVID19_ORDER_AND_RESULT JOIN IP ON COR_MRN = CPL_MRN AND DATE(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) BETWEEN PROBLEM_CREATE_DTE - 3 DAY AND PROBLEM_CREATE_DTE + 15 DAY WHERE COR_ORDER_NAME IN ('COVID-19 Qualitative RNA', 'COVID-19 Rapid Qualitative RNA', 'COVID-19/Flu A B/RSV Qual RNA Panel', 'Respiratory NAT Panel with SARS-CoV-2') AND COR_ORDER_STATUS_CODE IN ('RESC', 'RESF') ) SELECT A.*, TEST_DATE, COR_ORDER_NAME, TEST_RESULT FROM IP A LEFT JOIN COVID_TEST B ON CPL_MRN = COR_MRN

prompt: Provide the IMPACT and ARCHER sample IDs for myxoid/round cell liposarcoma patients who underwent surgery at MSK.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT X.PT_MRN, PATIENTID, T.* FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS X JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML Y ON X.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = Y.PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING Y.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/gene-panel', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name') T WHERE PT_MRN IN ()

prompt: Provide On Demand Report for MD sign-off information for "Pre-Admission Note - BMT/CTS" assessments in EMR since 2008
completion: WITH CLINDOC AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDO_DOC_GUID AS DOCGUID, CDO_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME, TRIM(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) AS PROVIDER, CDO_ENTER_DTE AS DOC_ENT_DTE, ENT.OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS ENTREDBY, ENT.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE AS ENTBY_ROLE, AUTH.OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS AUTH, AUTH.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE AS SVC_PVDR_ROLE, CDD_AUTHORED_DT AS AUTH_DT, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS SVC_DATE, CDO_LAST_UPD_DT FROM IDB.CD_OBSERVATION JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ENT ON CDD_USER_GUID = ENT.OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER AUTH ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = AUTH.OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Pre-Admission Note - BMT/CTS-BMT', 'Pre-Admission Note - BMT/CTS-CTS') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2008-01-01' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDO_LARGE_VALUE_TEXT_IND <> 'Y' ) , AUTHORS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS A_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID AS A_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS A_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME AS A_DOC_NAME, TRIM(U1.OU_DISPLAY_NAME) || ' ( ' || TRIM(U1.OU_OCCUPATION) || '-' || TRIM(U1.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE) || ' )' AS "Author", TRIM(U2.OU_DISPLAY_NAME) || ' ( ' || TRIM(U2.OU_OCCUPATION) || '-' || TRIM(U2.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE) || ' )' AS "Co-Author", CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID, CDH_USER_GUID FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT D JOIN CLINDOC C ON D.CDD_DOC_GUID = DOCGUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER U1 ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = U1.OU_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT_HISTORY ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDH_CLIENT_DOC_GUID AND CDD_CLIENT_GUID = CDH_CLIENT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER U2 ON CDH_USER_GUID = U2.OU_USER_GUID) SELECT C.MRN, C.PT_NAME, C.SVC_DATE, C.PROVIDER, "Author", "Co-Author" FROM CLINDOC C LEFT JOIN AUTHORS ON DOCGUID = A_DOC_GUID AND "Author" <> "Co-Author" GROUP BY C.MRN, C.PT_NAME, C.SVC_DATE, C.PROVIDER, "Author", "Co-Author"

prompt: Six months of data to look at anion gap and corrected anion gap to see what cutoff is appropriate to best catch ketoacidosis in cancer patients.
completion: WITH COHORT AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_ABNORMALITY_CD, LR_RESULT_VALUE FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS WHERE (LR_TEST_NAME IN ('pH', 'pH, Fluid', 'pH, Urine', 'pH, Venous') AND LR_ABNORMALITY_CD NOT IN ('U', 'N')) OR (LR_TEST_NAME IN ('Ketones', 'Ketones, Serum', 'NYCBS Urinalysis without microscopic', 'Urinalysis, Dipstick', 'Urinalysis, Microscopic', 'Urinalysis, Routine', 'Urinalysis, Routine.') AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('Ketones', 'Ketones, Serum', 'Urinalysis - Ketone, NYCBS', 'Ketones, Urine', 'Ketone')) AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 6 MONTH AND CURRENT DATE ) SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DATE_OF_DEATH, PT_SEX AS SEX_AT_BIRTH, PT_GENDER AS GENDER_IDENTITY, TRIM(G.AV_DESC) AS GENDER, TRIM(R.AV_DESC) AS RACE, TRIM(E.AV_DESC) AS ETHNICITY FROM COHORT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON LR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_CODE = PT_SEX AND G.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' ;

prompt: Identify patients seen at MSK for testis cancer who had a CT of the chest, abdomen or pelvis.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE, MIN_DX_DTE, MIN(COALESCE(TM_DX_DTE, MIN_DX_DTE), COALESCE(MIN_DX_DTE, TM_DX_DTE)) AS INIT_DX_DTE, EVER_CIC_CODED, TM_CLIN_STG_GRP FROM (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_CLIN_STG_GRP FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR WHERE TM_SITE_CD IN ('C620', 'C621', 'C629') AND TM_CASE_STS = '3' AND TM_CLIN_STG_GRP IN ('1', '1A', '1A1', '1A2', '1B', '1B1', '1B2', '2A')) AS A FULL JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_DX_DTE, MAX(CASE WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y') THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) AS EVER_CIC_CODED FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('186', '186.0', '186.9') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN) AS B ON A.TM_MRN = B.CC_MRN), CT AS (SELECT PBD_MRN AS CT_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE AS CT_DTE FROM IDB.PBD_DTL INNER JOIN CTE ON PBD_MRN = MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE >= INIT_DX_DTE INNER JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('71250', '71260', '71270', '72128', '72129', '72130', '72192', '72193', '72194', '74150', '74160', '74170', '74175', '74176', '74177', '74178') UNION SELECT DTL_MRN AS CT_MRN, DTL_SVC_DTE AS CT_DTE FROM IDB.PA_DTL INNER JOIN CTE ON DTL_MRN = MRN AND DTL_SVC_DTE >= INIT_DX_DTE WHERE DTL_SVC_CD IN ('28171254', '28712503', '28712602', '28712701', '28721918', '28721926', '28721934', '28721942', '28740769', '28740777', '28740785', '28741502', '28741510', '28741601', '28741619', '28741700', '28741759', '28741783') GROUP BY DTL_MRN, DTL_SVC_DTE, DTL_SVC_CD HAVING SUM(DTL_SVC_QTY) > 0 UNION SELECT HXD_MRN AS CT_MRN, HXD_SVC_DTE AS CT_DTE FROM IDB.HX_PA_DTL INNER JOIN CTE ON HXD_MRN = MRN AND HXD_SVC_DTE >= INIT_DX_DTE WHERE HXD_SVC_CD IN ('28171254', '28712503', '28712602', '28712701', '28721918', '28721926', '28721934', '28721942', '28740769', '28740777', '28740785', '28741502', '28741510', '28741601', '28741619', '28741700', '28741759', '28741783') GROUP BY HXD_MRN, HXD_SVC_DTE, HXD_SVC_CD HAVING SUM(HXD_SVC_QTY) > 0) SELECT MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM CTE) AS A INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CT_MRN FROM CT) AS B ON MRN = CT_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON MRN = PBD_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD INNER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PBC_CPT_CD = '38780' AND PT_SEX = 'M'

prompt: List of patients with radiation oncology visits in 2019
completion: SELECT MRN , SVC_DTE FROM IDB.RADIATION_CHARGES_V WHERE YEAR(SVC_DTE) = 2019

prompt: For a list of patients who underwent radioembolization for the treatment of their liver metastases from breast cancer please provide molecular pathology reports.
Design a Tableau dashboard that tracks patients getting called by advanced practice providers for the EPACS.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID AS DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Service", OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Author" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'DOS_EPACS_Services RES' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Pre-Visit EPACS - Surgery' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE ) SELECT DISTINCT X.*, PRF_DIAG_SITE "Referral Diagnosis/Site", PRF_INIT_ON_DTE FROM X JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPP_PRK = CPE_PRK LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_USER ON CPE_ENTER_USER_ID = CLE_USER_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY D ON D.CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_6' AND D.CAV_ABBR = CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY S ON S.CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_8' AND S.CAV_ABBR = CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 LEFT JOIN IDB.PAS_REFERRAL ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = PRF_CL_PT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('COL', 'GYN', 'GMT', 'HEP', 'THR') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV1%' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 <> 'REG' AND(("Service" = 'Gastric Mixed Tumor (GMT)' AND (UPPER(PRF_DIAG_SITE) like '%SARCOMA%' OR UPPER(PRF_DIAG_SITE) like '%STOMACH%')) OR ("Service" = 'Gynecologic Surgery (GYN)' AND (UPPER(PRF_DIAG_SITE) like '%OVARIAN%' OR UPPER(PRF_DIAG_SITE) like '%ENDOMETRIAL%' OR UPPER(PRF_DIAG_SITE) like '%UTERUS%' OR UPPER(PRF_DIAG_SITE) like '%UTERINE%')) OR ("Service" = 'Hepatopancreatobiliary (HPB)' AND (UPPER(PRF_DIAG_SITE) like '%LIVER%' OR UPPER(PRF_DIAG_SITE) like '%PANCREAS%')) OR ("Service" = 'Colorectal Surgery (CRC)' AND (UPPER(PRF_DIAG_SITE) like '%RECTAL%' OR UPPER(PRF_DIAG_SITE) like '%COLON%' OR UPPER(PRF_DIAG_SITE) like '%ANAL%')))

prompt:
To obtain smoking history documentation from Clin Doc notes and measure reliability for patients seen at the Ralph Lauren Center from:

1/1/20 - 2/29/20
completion: WITH LATEST_APPT AS (SELECT E.CPE_MRN, E.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY E.CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) APPT_RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER E JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-02-29' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = '1919') , PT AS (SELECT LA.CPE_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || PT_FIRST_NAME AS PATIENT_NAME, LA.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CRE_RES_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CRE_RES_NAME ORDER BY LA.CPE_MRN) RN FROM LATEST_APPT LA JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER CPE ON LA.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID = CPE.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON LA.CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CRE_RES_NAME IN ('GODFREY, HENRY G.', 'KAMPEL, LEWIS', 'KILLORAN, KATHLEEN A.', 'NOUVINI, ROSA', 'ORTIZ, CLAUDIA MARIA', 'SALES, MARTA')) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PATIENT_NAME AS "Patient Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider", RN FROM PT WHERE RN <= 20 ORDER BY CRE_RES_NAME ; WITH LATEST_APPT AS (SELECT E.CPE_MRN, E.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY E.CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) APPT_RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER E JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-02-29' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = '1919') , PT AS (SELECT LA.CPE_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || PT_FIRST_NAME AS PATIENT_NAME, LA.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CRE_RES_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CRE_RES_NAME ORDER BY LA.CPE_MRN) RN FROM LATEST_APPT LA JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER CPE ON LA.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID = CPE.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE.CPE_MRN = PT_MRN AND CRE_RES_NAME IN ('GODFREY, HENRY G.', 'KAMPEL, LEWIS', 'KILLORAN, KATHLEEN A.', 'NOUVINI, ROSA', 'ORTIZ, CLAUDIA MARIA', 'SALES, MARTA')) SELECT CPE.CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PATIENT_NAME AS "Patient Name", CRE.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CPE.CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER CPE JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE CRE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN PT ON CPE.CPE_MRN = PT.CPE_MRN AND PT.CRE_RES_NAME = CRE.CRE_RES_NAME WHERE CPE.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE.CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-02-29' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = '1919' AND RN <= 20 ; WITH LATEST_APPT AS (SELECT E.CPE_MRN, E.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY E.CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) APPT_RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER E JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-02-29' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = '1919') , PT AS (SELECT LA.CPE_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || PT_FIRST_NAME AS PATIENT_NAME, LA.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CRE_RES_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CRE_RES_NAME ORDER BY LA.CPE_MRN) RN FROM LATEST_APPT LA JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER CPE ON LA.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID = CPE.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON LA.CPE_MRN = PT_MRN AND CRE_RES_NAME IN ('GODFREY, HENRY G.', 'KAMPEL, LEWIS', 'KILLORAN, KATHLEEN A.', 'NOUVINI, ROSA', 'ORTIZ, CLAUDIA MARIA', 'SALES, MARTA')) , CLINDOC AS (SELECT CDD_MRN AS "CD_MRN", PT.PATIENT_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE "Service date", CDD_DOC_NAME "Document name", CDO_SECTION "Section", CAST(CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS VARCHAR(95)) "Text", DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) AS RN_CD FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE JOIN PT ON CPE_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME NOT IN ('Telephone/Electronic Comm, Tobacco Treatment - Psychiatry', 'Follow Up, Tobacco Treatment - Psychiatry', 'Intake, Tobacco Treatment - Psychiatry') AND (UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) like '%SMOK%' OR UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) like '%TOBACCO%') AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> 'Current tobacco use reviewed' ), LIST AS (SELECT DISTINCT CD_MRN AS "MRN", PT.PATIENT_NAME AS "Patient name", "Service date", "Document name", "Section", "Text", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider name", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CD_MRN ORDER BY "Service date" DESC) AS RN FROM CLINDOC JOIN PT ON CD_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE RN <= 20 AND RN_CD = 1 ) SELECT "MRN", "Patient name", "Provider name", "Service date", "Document name", "Section", "Text" FROM LIST WHERE RN = 1

prompt: Monthly report of patients with Central Venous Catheterization Procedures completed on the same day as outpatient Koch appointments.
completion: WITH NOTES AS (SELECT CDD_MRN AS "MRN", CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Clindoc Service Date", CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Provider", CDD_DOC_GUID AS "Document Guid", CDO_SECTION AS "Section", CDO_ITEM_NAME AS "Item", CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Value", OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Author" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OU_USER_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Central Venous Catheterization Procedure' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 2 MONTHS) AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE < (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 1 MONTHS) ) , APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CLD_CLD_CENTER FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 2 MONTHS) AND CPE_ENC_DTE < (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 1 MONTHS) AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'KOCH' ) SELECT DISTINCT A."MRN" , "Clindoc Service Date" , "Document Name" , "Appt Date" , "Department" , "Service" , "Provider Name" , "Visit Type" , "Author" FROM NOTES A JOIN APPTS B ON A."MRN" = B."MRN" AND "Clindoc Service Date" = "Appt Date" ORDER BY "Clindoc Service Date" ASC, A."MRN" ;

prompt: We would like to see a correlation of the following lab values and genes to prognosis of certain cancer types.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN MRN FROM DV.PATIENT_LAB_RESULT JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PLR_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.LAB_TEST_CATALOG_V AS TEST ON PLR_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID = TEST.LTC_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.LAB_TEST_CATALOG_V AS SUBTEST ON PLR_LAB_SUBTEST_CATALOG_ID = SUBTEST.LTC_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON PLR_PERFORMED_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE TEST.LTC_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Type and Screen-' AND SUBTEST.LTC_SUBTEST_NAME = 'ABORH' AND DT_DTE >= '2011-01-01' UNION SELECT PT_MRN MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V) SELECT MRN, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_RACE_DESC, PT_DEATH_DTE, BMI_EARLIEST.PMH_MEASURE_DTE "Earliest BMI Date", BMI_EARLIEST.PMH_BMI "Earliest BMI Value", BMI_LATEST.PMH_MEASURE_DTE "Latest BMI Date", BMI_LATEST.PMH_BMI "Latest BMI Value", PLA_LAST_APPT_DTE "Last Appt Date" FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON MRN=PT_MRN LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID=PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT PMH_MRN, PMH_BMI, PMH_MEASURE_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PMH_MRN ORDER BY PMH_MEASURE_DTE DESC) RN FROM IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX) BMI_EARLIEST ON BMI_EARLIEST.PMH_MRN = PT_MRN AND BMI_EARLIEST.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT PMH_MRN, PMH_BMI, PMH_MEASURE_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PMH_MRN ORDER BY PMH_MEASURE_DTE DESC) RN FROM IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX) BMI_LATEST ON BMI_LATEST.PMH_MRN = PT_MRN AND BMI_LATEST.RN = 1 ; SELECT PT_MRN, DT_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", DXCC_ICD_CODE AS "ICD-O Histology Code", DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-O Histology Description", ICSC_SITE_CD AS "ICD-O Site Code", ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-O Site Description", TCA_CASE_STS_DESC AS "Case Status" FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR_V ON CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V ON CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID = TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID ; SELECT PT_MRN, DT_DTE AS "Performed Date", TEST.LTC_SUBTEST_NAME AS "Test or Panel Name", SUBTEST.LTC_SUBTEST_NAME AS "Subtest Name", PLR_RESULT_VALUE AS "Result Value", PLR_UNIT_MEASURE AS "Units", PLR_ABNORMALITY_CD AS "Abnormal Code", PLR_TEST_LOW_LIMIT AS "Lower Limit", PLR_TEST_UP_LIMIT AS "Upper Limit", PLR_TEXT_RESULT AS "Text Result" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V JOIN PTS ON MRN=PT_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_LAB_RESULT ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PLR_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.LAB_TEST_CATALOG_V AS TEST ON PLR_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID = TEST.LTC_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.LAB_TEST_CATALOG_V AS SUBTEST ON PLR_LAB_SUBTEST_CATALOG_ID = SUBTEST.LTC_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON PLR_PERFORMED_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE SUBTEST.LTC_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('ABORH', 'von Willebrand Factor Antigen', 'von Willebrand Factor Activity-', 'von Willebrand Factor Activity', 'Factor V Leiden Mutation', 'Prothrombin Gene Mutation', 'Prothrombin Gene Mutation.', 'Result Prothrombin G20210A', 'Factor II', 'Factor V', 'Factor VIII', 'Fibrinogen', 'Fibrinogen.', 'D-Dimer') ; SELECT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_ACCESSION_NO, RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, RRPT_ANC_CODE, RRPT_REPORT_TXT FROM PTS JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V ON MRN= RRPT_MRN WHERE CONTAINS("RRPT_REPORT_TXT", '("embolism" | "clot")') = 1 AND RRPT_REPORT_TXT IS NOT NULL ; SELECT TRIM(CRDB.PT_MRN) MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '300' THEN CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE END) "Part C Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN (REG_ID = '300' AND (PT.REG_NETWORK_DSCRP = 'Memorial Sloan-Kettering Cancer Center' OR PT.REG_NETWORK_DSCRP IS NULL)) THEN 'MSK Main' WHEN REG_ID = '300' AND NOT(PT.REG_NETWORK_DSCRP = 'Memorial Sloan-Kettering Cancer Center' OR PT.REG_NETWORK_DSCRP IS NULL) THEN SUBSTR(PT.REG_NETWORK_DSCRP, LOCATE('at', PT.REG_NETWORK_DSCRP) + 3) ELSE NULL END) "Part C Registration Site", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '300' THEN CRDB.CONSENT_PRFSNL END) "Part C Consenting Professional" FROM NN.CRDB_DASH_PT_REG CRDB JOIN NN.CRDB_DASH_PT PT ON CRDB.PRT_ID = PT.PRT_ID AND CRDB.PT_MRN = PT.PT_MRN WHERE CRDB.PRT_ID = '12-245' AND REG_ID IN ('300') AND CRNT_ELGBL_STATUS_DSCRP NOT IN ('Ineligible', 'Cancel') AND CRDB.PT_MRN IN (SELECT * FROM PTS) GROUP BY TRIM(CRDB.PT_MRN) ; SELECT TRIM(PT_MRN) MRN, GENE, RESULT FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V ON PT_MRN=MRN ; SELECT PT_MRN MRN, CASE WHEN PINC_CHEMO_IND = 'Y' THEN LISTAGG(CAST(PINC_GENERIC_NAME || ': ' || MIN_START_DTE || ' to ' || MAX_START_DTE AS VARCHAR(32000)), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MIN_START_DTE, PINC_GENERIC_NAME) ELSE '' END AS CHEMO_MEDS, CASE WHEN PINC_CHEMO_IND <> 'Y' THEN LISTAGG(CAST(PINC_GENERIC_NAME || ': ' || MIN_START_DTE || ' to ' || MAX_START_DTE AS VARCHAR(32000)), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MIN_START_DTE, PINC_GENERIC_NAME) ELSE '' END AS NON_CHEMO_MEDS FROM ( SELECT TRIM(PT_MRN) AS PT_MRN, TRIM(PINC_GENERIC_NAME) AS PINC_GENERIC_NAME, TRIM(PINC_CHEMO_IND) AS PINC_CHEMO_IND, MIN(DT_DTE) AS MIN_START_DTE, MAX(DT_DTE) AS MAX_START_DTE FROM DV.PHM_ORDER_DTL DTL JOIN DV.PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG CAT ON DTL.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON DTL.POD_START_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE PT_MRN IN (SELECT P_MRN FROM PTS) ;

prompt: Provide every dermatology surgical pathology report from 7-1-2021 to 8-10-2021.
completion: WITH COHORT AS (SELECT OO_MRN , OO_ANCIL_REF_CD , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER WHERE OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000009659100730' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND TRIM(OO_ANCIL_REF_CD) <> '' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2021-07-01' AND '2021-08-10' ) SELECT OO_MRN MRN , PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME ORD_DR_NAME , PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC ORD_DR_SVC , PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC_DESC ORD_DR_SVC_DESC , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO ACCESSION_NO , PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE PROCEDURE_DTE , PRPT_REPORT_DTE REPORT_DTE , PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC REPORT_TYPE_DESC , PRPT_REPORT REPORT_TEXT FROM COHORT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON OO_MRN = PRPT_MRN AND OO_ANCIL_REF_CD = PRPT_ACCESSION_NO

prompt: Provide a report on patient’s education level.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DT, CDO_ITEM_NAME, STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) AS CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN, CDO_ITEM_NAME ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DT DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND UPPER(CDO_SECTION) LIKE '%SOCIAL HISTORY%' AND(UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%EDUCATION%') AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' AND CDD_MRN IN () ) , Y AS (SELECT * FROM X WHERE RN = 1 ) SELECT CDD_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Education Level' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS "Education Level" FROM Y JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN GROUP BY CDD_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME

prompt: Identify all patients with pancreatic cancer who underwent 18F-FDG PET-CT from January 2007 until November 2011.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FROM IDB.PA_DTL INNER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = DTL_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.CDM ON DTL_SVC_CD = CDM_SVC_CD INNER JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON DTL_MRN = OO_MRN AND DTL_SVC_DTE = OO_PERFORMED_DTE AND OO_ORD_NAME like '%PET%' WHERE DTL_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2007-01-01' AND '2011-11-30' AND DTL_SVC_CD IN ('16746513', '16788309') AND CC_CLSF_CD like '157%' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y'))

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with and treated for hypopharyngeal or cervical esophageal cancer.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, D.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK SURG_PROC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM D ON TM_CA_SURG_03 = D.CLM_CLSF_CD AND D.CLM_CLSF_DESC <> 'NO CLM ENTRY' JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = TM_MRN AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E' LEFT JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON RTC_TX_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND (TM_SITE_CD = 'C153' OR TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C12%' OR TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C13%') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND (COALESCE (SSE_MRN, RTC_TX_MRN) IS NOT NULL OR D.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK IS NOT NULL)

prompt: Provide survey responses for Survivorship Patient Self Assessment
completion: SELECT EF_MRN MRN, YEAR(DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at time of Submission", PT_SEX "Sex", M.AV_DESC AS "Marital Status", R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", EF_FORM_NAME "Survey Name", EFI_ITEM_ALIAS "Item Alias", EFI_ITEM_SHORT_NAME "Item Short Name", EFI_VALUE_ALIAS "Value Alias", EFI_VALUE_SHORT_NAME "Value Short Name", DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) "Submission Date", EFI_ITEM_TEXT "Survery Question", EFI_VALUE "Survey Response", PMH_BMI FROM IDB.EF_FORM LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON EF_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS M ON PT_MARITAL_STS = M.AV_CODE AND M.AV_ELEMENT = 'MARITAL_STS' JOIN IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX ON EF_MRN = PMH_MRN AND DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) = PMH_MEASURE_DTE WHERE EF_FORM_NAME IN ('Survivorship Patient Self Assessment - Breast Cancer', 'Survivorship Patient Self Assessment - Gynecologic Cancer', 'Survivorship Patient Self Assessment - Thoracic Cancer') AND DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) BETWEEN '2017-07-01' AND '2018-12-31' ; WITH EF_FORM AS (SELECT EF_MRN MRN, YEAR(DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at time of Submission", PT_SEX "Sex", M.AV_DESC AS "Marital Status", R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", EF_FORM_NAME "Survey Name", EFI_ITEM_ALIAS "Item Alias", EFI_ITEM_SHORT_NAME "Item Short Name", EFI_VALUE_ALIAS "Value Alias", EFI_VALUE_SHORT_NAME "Value Short Name", DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) "Submission Date", EFI_ITEM_TEXT "Survery Question", EFI_VALUE "Survey Response", PMH_BMI FROM IDB.EF_FORM LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON EF_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS M ON PT_MARITAL_STS = M.AV_CODE AND M.AV_ELEMENT = 'MARITAL_STS' JOIN IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX ON EF_MRN = PMH_MRN AND DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) = PMH_MEASURE_DTE WHERE EF_FORM_NAME IN ('Survivorship Patient Self Assessment - Breast Cancer', 'Survivorship Patient Self Assessment - Gynecologic Cancer', 'Survivorship Patient Self Assessment - Thoracic Cancer') AND DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) BETWEEN '2017-07-01' AND '2018-12-31' ) SELECT TM_MRN, "Submission Date", YEAR("Submission Date" - TM_DX_DTE) "Years since submission from dx date", TM_SITE_CD AS "Tumor Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Tumor Site Desc", TM_HIST_CD AS "Tumor Histology Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Tumor Histology Desc" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, "Submission Date" FROM EF_FORM) A JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8')

prompt: Kidney Cyst Patient Visits in the last 3 years
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('N28.89', 'N28.1') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN ) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE "Diagnosis Date", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM DX JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_NAME IN ('CHA, EUGENE K', 'COLEMAN, JONATHAN A', 'DALBAGNI, GUIDO', 'HAKIMI, ABRAHAM', 'RUSSO, PAUL', 'TOUIJER, KARIM A', 'DONAHUE, TIMOTHY FRANCIS', 'SMITH, ROBERT CHARLES', 'PIETZAK, EUGENE') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2016-01-01' ORDER BY 7, 1 DESC

prompt: Unique number of pts who received checkpoint inhibitors per year per location at first drug administration regardless of pt diagnosis.
Patients with stage IV pancreatic adenocarcinoma diagnosed between the dates of 1/1/2014 and 9/30/2020, who also had a documented episode of cholangitis at some point in time.
completion: WITH DX1 AS (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C25%' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2020-09-30' AND TM_BEST_AJCC_STG = '4' AND TM_HIST_CD NOT IN ('M8246/3') ) , DX2 AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('K83.0', '576.1', 'K83.09') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2020-09-30') SELECT PT_MRN MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || PT_FIRST_NAME AS PT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, DX1.TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, DX1.TM_HIST_CD HIST_CD, DX1.HIST_DESC, DX1.TM_SITE_CD SITE_CD, DX1.SITE_DESC, YEAR(DATE(DX1.TM_DX_DTE) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE_AT_DX, PT_SEX AS SEX, DX2.MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE AS CHOLANGITIS_DX_DTE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH FROM DX1 JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN DX2 ON TM_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE YEAR(DATE(DX1.TM_DX_DTE) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 ;

prompt: Provide a monthly report of RBC product orders
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Patient Name", OO_ORD_ID AS "Order ID", OO_ANCIL_REF_CD "Order ANCIL Ref Code", OO_ENTER_DTE AS "Order Enter Date", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS "Order Significant Date", OSTS_ORD_STS_CD AS "Order Status Code", OSTS_STS_DESC AS "Order Status Desc", OOC_ITEM_NAME AS "Order Item Name", OOC_ITEM_DESC AS "Order Item Description", OCV_CURR_LOC AS "Location", OS_SVC_DESC AS "Service", OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Requester name", OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE "Requester role", OO_ORD_MODIFIER AS "Modifier", BBNB.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "BBNB Notes", OP_TRANS.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "BB Product OP Transfusion Site Notes", BB_CONSENT.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "BB Consent Status Notes", RBC_CRITERIA.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "BB RBC Criteria Notes", REACTION_RBC.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "Transfusion Reaction RBC Notes", RBC_BLEED.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "BB RBC Bleed Site/Loc", BB_RBC_OTHER.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "BB RBC Other Notes", BLEEDING_CRITERIA.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "BB RBC Bleeding criteria Notes", CARDIO1.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "PBB RBC CARDIO1 Notes", CARDIO2.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "PBB RBC CARDIO2 Notes", HEALTHISSUES.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "Health Issues Notes", PRIOR_TRANS.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "Prior Transfusion Reaction Notes", BB_UNITS.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "BB Units Requested Notes", BB_CC.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "BB_CC Notes", COMMENT_NOTES.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "Comment", RE_BILLING.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "Research Billing Notes", BEEP.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "Beep", REQU_FOR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "Requested For", REQU_TIME.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "Requested Time", LAB_SPECIMEN_COLLECTED.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "Lab Specimen Collected", LAB_SPECIMEN_COLLECTED_ON.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "Lab Specimen Collected On", LAB_SPECIMEN_DRAWN.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "Lab_Specimen Drawn By", TRANS_NOTE.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "Transfusion Note" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OSTS_ORD_STS_CD = OO_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OU_USER_GUID = OO_PVDR_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA BBNB ON OO_ORD_GUID = BBNB.OUD_ORD_GUID AND BBNB.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BBNB' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA CARDIO1 ON CARDIO1.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND CARDIO1.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'PBB_RBC_cardio1' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA OP_TRANS ON OP_TRANS.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OP_TRANS.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BB_Product OP Transfusion Site' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA BB_CONSENT ON BB_CONSENT.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND BB_CONSENT.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BB_Consent Status' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA RBC_CRITERIA ON RBC_CRITERIA.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND RBC_CRITERIA.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BB_RBC Criteria' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA REACTION_RBC ON REACTION_RBC.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND REACTION_RBC.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Transfusion Reaction RBC' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA RBC_BLEED ON RBC_BLEED.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND RBC_BLEED.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BB_RBC_Bleed Site/Loc' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA BB_RBC_OTHER ON BB_RBC_OTHER.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND BB_RBC_OTHER.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BB_RBC_Other' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA BLEEDING_CRITERIA ON BLEEDING_CRITERIA.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND BLEEDING_CRITERIA.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BB_RBC_Bleeding criteria' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA CARDIO2 ON CARDIO2.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND CARDIO2.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'PBB_RBC_cardio2' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA HEALTHISSUES ON HEALTHISSUES.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND HEALTHISSUES.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'HealthIssues' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA PRIOR_TRANS ON PRIOR_TRANS.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND PRIOR_TRANS.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Prior Transfusion Reaction' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA BB_UNITS ON BB_UNITS.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND BB_UNITS.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BB_Units_Requested' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA BB_CC ON BB_CC.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND BB_CC.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BB_CC' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA COMMENT_NOTES ON COMMENT_NOTES.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND COMMENT_NOTES.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Comment' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA RE_BILLING ON RE_BILLING.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND RE_BILLING.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Research Billing' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA BEEP ON BEEP.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND BEEP.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Beep' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA REQU_FOR ON REQU_FOR.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND REQU_FOR.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Requested For' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA REQU_TIME ON REQU_TIME.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND REQU_TIME.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RequestedTime' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA LAB_SPECIMEN_COLLECTED ON LAB_SPECIMEN_COLLECTED.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND LAB_SPECIMEN_COLLECTED.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Lab_Specimen Collected' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA LAB_SPECIMEN_COLLECTED_ON ON LAB_SPECIMEN_COLLECTED_ON.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND LAB_SPECIMEN_COLLECTED_ON.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Lab_Specimen Collected On' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA LAB_SPECIMEN_DRAWN ON LAB_SPECIMEN_DRAWN.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND LAB_SPECIMEN_DRAWN.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Lab_Specimen Drawn By' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA TRANS_NOTE ON TRANS_NOTE.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND TRANS_NOTE.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Transfusion Note' WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Red Blood Cells.', 'Red Blood Cells', 'RBC Transfused') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date -31 DAY AND CURRENT date -1 DAY ORDER BY OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE

prompt:
Provide total volume of outpatient visits during inpatient stay for the specified services as well as determining what volume is Peds (12 and under and 13 and up) and adults between 2016-2018.

Pulmonary 1275
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CRE_RES_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 "Service", S.CAV_TITLE AS "Service Desc", CLD_DEPT_NAME "Department" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY S ON S.CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_8' AND S.CAV_ABBR = CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 WHERE CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('PULMONARY 1275', 'CARDIOLOGY 1275', 'RENAL 1275', 'RENAL 205 EAST65-LC', 'RENAL 205 E64-LC APP', 'OPHTHALMIC ONC 1275', 'ANESTHESIA PAIN 1275', 'NUC MED CLINIC 1275', 'SPEECH & HEARING 1275', 'DENTAL 1275 ', 'INF DISEASE 1275', 'INF DISEASE 205 E65', 'INF DISEASE 205 E64-LC', 'GASTRO 1275', 'GASTRO 1275 APP', 'PULMONARY 1275 APP', 'HEAD & NECK 1275 ', 'NEUROSURGERY 1275', 'RAD ONC 1275 ') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') ) SELECT "Service", "Service Desc", "Department", CDD_SERVICE_DTE "Service Date" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN APPTS ON CRE_RES_ID = OP_PVDR_NO AND CPE_ENC_DTE = CDD_SERVICE_DTE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'I' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) > 18

prompt: Create a report of patients who have had spinal SRS and PET imaging from January 1, 2004 to December 31, 2011.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT PBD_MRN AS MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE AS SRS_DTE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS SRS_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SRS_DESC FROM IDB.PBD_DETAIL INNER JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD INNER JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2004-01-01' AND '2011-12-31' AND CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('63620', '63621') ) SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_DRVST_DTE, PBD_SVC_DTE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK FROM CTE INNER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = PBD_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = PBD_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.PBD_DETAIL ON MRN = PBD_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD INNER JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2004-01-01' AND '2011-12-31' AND CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%PET%' AND CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK NOT LIKE '%TRANSPETROSAL APPROACH/SKULL%'

prompt: The Pediatric Surgery team would like to perform a retrospective review of our experience with NUT midline carcinoma in children
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN AS MRN, PT_BIRTH_DTE "DATE OF BIRTH", COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS "DATE OF LAST FOLLOW UP", PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "DATE OF SURGERY" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC IN ('Cytology-submitted slides', 'Diagnostic Molecular Genetics', 'Diagnostic Molecular Pathology', 'Surgical Pathology', 'Surgical Pathology Molecular Genetics', 'Surgical Submitted Slides') AND (CONTAINS (PRPT_REPORT, 'NUT midline carcinoma') = 1 OR CONTAINS (PRPT_REPORT, 'BRD-NUT') = 1 OR CONTAINS (PRPT_REPORT, 'NMC') = 1 OR CONTAINS (PRPT_REPORT, 'NUT tumor') = 1 OR CONTAINS (PRPT_REPORT, 'NUT carcinoma') = 1 OR CONTAINS (PRPT_REPORT, 'NUT variant') = 1 OR CONTAINS (PRPT_REPORT, 'NUT-BRD4') = 1 OR CONTAINS (PRPT_REPORT, 'NUT-BRD') = 1 OR CONTAINS (PRPT_REPORT, 'NUT-BRD3') = 1 OR CONTAINS (PRPT_REPORT, 'BRD4-NUT') = 1) AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE BETWEEN '1999-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL

prompt: Patients who received the VATS wedge procedure (CPT 32657 Thoracoscopy w/wedge single or multiple) on the Thoracic service. Data per year (2006, 2007, 2008): counts, LOS data in days and in hours (Ave, Median, Max, Min).
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN AS MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE AS SURG_DATE, STRIP(PBC_CPT_CD)||'-'||PBC_PBD_DESC AS SURG_DESC, TIMESTAMP(CS_ADM_DATE, CS_ADM_TIME) AS ADMIT_DT, TIMESTAMP(CS_DSCH_DATE, CS_DSCH_TIME) AS DISCH_DT, DOC_NAME AS SURGEON, YEAR(PBD_SVC_DTE) AS SURG_YEAR, CASE WHEN CS_DSCH_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN INT(CS_DAYS_STAY) ELSE DAYS(CURRENT DATE) - DAYS(PBD_SVC_DTE) END LOS FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBC_PBD_CD = PBD_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = PBC_CPT_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBI_MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBI_ACCT_NO = PBD_ACCT_NO AND PBI_INV_NO = PBD_INV_NO JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.CASE ON CS_MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBD_ACCT_NO = CS_ACCT_NO AND CS_ACCT_NO LIKE '84%' AND CS_PT_STS <> 'IP' WHERE YEAR(PBD_SVC_DTE) IN (2006, 2007, 2008) AND PBC_CPT_CD = '32657' AND PBC_PBD_DESC LIKE 'THOR%'

prompt: Provide a list of patients with Darier disease who have been treated with MEK inhibitors(trametinib, Cobimetinib, binimetinib, Selumetinib)
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('Q82.8', '757.2', '757.39') AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2023-04-01'), FN AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS MIN_START, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS MAX_END FROM DX JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON APR_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('TRAMETINIB', 'COBIMETINIB', 'BINIMETINIB', 'SELUMETINIB') GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME HAVING MIN(APR_START_DTE) BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2023-04-01') SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) ||', '||TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, TRIM(G.AV_DESC) AS GENDER, TRIM(R.AV_DESC) AS RACE, TRIM(E.AV_DESC) AS ETHNICITY, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME "MEK Therapy", MIN_START "MEK Therapy Start", MAX_END "MEK Therapy End" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN FN ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_CODE = PT_SEX AND G.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' ; WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD IN ('Z85.820', 'V10.82', 'Q82.8', '757.2', '757.39') OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C43%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '172%') AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2023-04-01'), FN AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS MIN_START, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS MAX_END FROM DX JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON APR_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('TRAMETINIB', 'COBIMETINIB', 'BINIMETINIB', 'SELUMETINIB') GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME HAVING MIN(APR_START_DTE) BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2023-04-01') SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) ||', '||TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, TRIM(G.AV_DESC) AS GENDER, TRIM(R.AV_DESC) AS RACE, TRIM(E.AV_DESC) AS ETHNICITY, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME "MEK Therapy", MIN_START "MEK Therapy Start", MAX_END "MEK Therapy End" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN FN ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_CODE = PT_SEX AND G.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' ; SELECT PRPT_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) ||', '||TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, TRIM(G.AV_DESC) AS GENDER, TRIM(R.AV_DESC) AS RACE, TRIM(E.AV_DESC) AS ETHNICITY, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT, PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME, PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC_DESC FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = PRPT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_CODE = PT_SEX AND G.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2023-04-01' AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("DARIER")') = 1 ; SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '0' AND (UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%DARIER%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%DARIER%') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2023-04-01' ;

prompt: Provide list of patients with colon and rectal cancer from 1/1/2000 -12/31/2021
completion: WITH DIAGNOSIS_0 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_DEID, SUBJECT_ID, DIAGNOSIS_DATE, ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC FROM (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, MIN(DIAGNOSIS_DATE."DT_DTE") AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE, TRIM(ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, TRIM(ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE") || '-' || TRIM(ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG" AS ICD_CODE_DESC ON "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE ON "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_DATE_ID" = DIAGNOSIS_DATE."DT_DATE_ID" GROUP BY "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID", CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID") AS VARCHAR), ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE", ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC") WHERE DIAGNOSIS_DATE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE IN ('C7A.026', 'C7A.022', '209.16', '153.3', 'C19', '153.1', '209.11', 'C18.0', 'C7A.023', '153.2', 'C18.8', 'C18.6', 'C7A.020', '153.7', '153.5', 'C20', 'C18.4', 'C7A.024', 'C18.2', '209.17', 'C18.1', 'C18.9', 'C18.5', 'C18.7', '154.1', '154.0', '153.9', '209.14', '153.6', 'C7A.021', '209.12', '153.0', '209.13', 'C21.8', 'C18.3', 'C7A.029', 'C7A.025', '209.15', '153.4')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_0)), COHORT_DIAGNOSIS AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, DIAGNOSIS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_DIAGNOSIS ON COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"), DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_DEID, SUBJECT_ID, DIAGNOSIS_DATE, ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC FROM (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, MIN(DIAGNOSIS_DATE."DT_DTE") AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE, TRIM(ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, TRIM(ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE") || '-' || TRIM(ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG" AS ICD_CODE_DESC ON "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE ON "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_DATE_ID" = DIAGNOSIS_DATE."DT_DATE_ID" GROUP BY "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID", CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID") AS VARCHAR), ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE", ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC", ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE", ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC")) SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.DIAGNOSIS_DATE AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE, DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE AS ICD_CODE, DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC AS ICD_CODE_DESCRIPTION FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID LEFT OUTER JOIN DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS ON DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.SUBJECT_ID = KEYS.COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_SUBJECT_ID

prompt: Provide smoking history for patients consented to 12-245
completion: WITH CONSENT_PT AS (SELECT PT_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE END) "Part A Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '300' THEN CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE END) "Part C Consent Date" FROM NN.CRDB_DASH_PT_REG CRDB WHERE CRDB.PRT_ID = '12-245' AND REG_ID IN ('100', '300') AND CRNT_ELGBL_STATUS_DSCRP NOT IN ('Ineligible', 'Cancel') GROUP BY PT_MRN) , CLINDOC_SM AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_ITEM_NAME, STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) AS SMOKING_HIST , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) AS LATEST_RANK_CD FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND(CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Smoking Status RES' OR CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'D_UCC_Tobacco use' OR CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'D_UCC_Tobacco products') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2012-01-01' ) , CDB_SM AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, SM.AV_DESC AS "Smoking Hx", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TM_MRN ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE DESC) AS LATEST_RANK_CDB FROM CONSENT_PT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS SM ON SM.AV_ELEMENT = 'SMOKING_HX' AND SM.AV_CODE = TM_SMOKING_HX WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') ) SELECT PT_MRN "MRN", "Part A Consent Date", "Part C Consent Date", CDD_SERVICE_DTE "Clinical Notes Smoking: Service Dte", SMOKING_HIST "Clinical Notes Smoking", DX_DATE "Tumor Registry Smoking: Service Dte", "Smoking Hx" "Tumor Registry Smoking" FROM CONSENT_PT LEFT JOIN CLINDOC_SM ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN AND LATEST_RANK_CD = 1 LEFT JOIN CDB_SM ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN AND LATEST_RANK_CDB = 1

prompt: Provide proportion of patients with Spanish as the preferred language at MSK Ralph Lauren, MSK Nassau, and MSK Evelyn Lauder Breast Cancer. Provide proportion of patient insurance type (e.g., emergency Medicaid, Medicaid, commercial insurance) at each site.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS BREAST_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1=1 AND SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C50', '174', '175') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "MRN") AS "Visit Count" , "Language" , "Insurance Type" , "Location" FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CLD_CLD_CENTER AS "Location", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", FSC_REP_CAT_NAME AS "Insurance Type", AV_DESC AS "Language" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DX ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON PT_PRIMARY_LANG = AV_CODE AND AV_ELEMENT = 'PRIMARY_LANG' JOIN IDB.PATIENT_INSURANCE_V ON CPE_MRN = MRN AND FSC_PRIORITY = 1 WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER IN ('NAS', '1919', '300 E66') ) A GROUP BY "Language", "Insurance Type", "Location" ORDER BY "Language", "Insurance Type", "Location" ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CLD_CLD_CENTER AS "Location", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", FSC_REP_CAT_NAME AS "Insurance Type", AV_DESC AS "Language" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON PT_PRIMARY_LANG = AV_CODE AND AV_ELEMENT = 'PRIMARY_LANG' JOIN IDB.PATIENT_INSURANCE_V ON CPE_MRN = MRN AND FSC_PRIORITY = 1 WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER IN ('NAS', '1919', '300 E66') ) , TNBC AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS TNBC_MRN FROM DVCMS.COHORT_PATIENT JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON CHP_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE CHP_COHORT_ID = 9431 ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "MRN") AS "Visit Count" , "Language" , "Insurance Type" , "Location" FROM (SELECT A.* FROM PTS A JOIN TNBC ON "MRN" = TNBC_MRN) A GROUP BY "Language", "Insurance Type", "Location" ORDER BY "Language", "Insurance Type", "Location" ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients with a diagnosis of mesothelioma who have consented to germline testing.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C45.1', 'C45.0', 'C45.2', 'C45.7', 'C45.9') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2023-10-15'), PROTOCOL AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN, PRO_IRB_NO, PRO_IRB_TITLE, PRO_IRB_STS, PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE, AC_NON_MSK_INST, AC_LAST_NAME, AC_FIRST_NAME, AC_PVDR_OF_RECORD_NAME, ACD_REG_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE FROM DX JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON CC_MRN = AC_MRN JOIN IDB.PROTOCOL ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO WHERE PRO_IRB_NO = '12-245' AND ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL ) SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE AS "ICD Date", ICD9_CD AS "ICD Code", ICD9_DESC AS "ICD Description", PRO_IRB_NO AS "IRB Number", ACD_CONS_DTE AS "Consented Date", PRO_IRB_TITLE AS "IRB Title", PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE AS "Protocol Type" FROM DX JOIN PROTOCOL ON CC_MRN = AC_MRN ORDER BY CC_MRN

prompt: Would like a weekly list of our patients with upcoming scans, receive on Monday for the upcoming week
completion: WITH ETO AS (SELECT ACD_IRB_NO, ACD_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB , PT_RACE_DESC, PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC, PT_RELIGION_DESC, PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS, PT_LAST_KNOWN_ALIVE_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON ACD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO IN('19-100', '19-282') ) , SCH_RAD AS (SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, DOB, CPE_ENC_DTE VST_DATE , REF.CRE_RES_NAME TREATING_MD, CPE_APPT_DT APPT_DT , CVT_EXT_NAME VISIT_TYPE , VD.CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME VISIT_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN ETO ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT VD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = VD.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VT ON VT.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF ON REF.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_REF_RES_ID AND REF.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist', 'PhD', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPA_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND CPA_LINE_NO = 2 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT SD ON CPA_DEPT_ID = SD.CLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE SR ON SR.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS ='Sch' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY AND CURRENT DATE + 25 DAY AND VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('NUC', 'RAD') AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 ) , PAST_CHEMO AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, PRIOR_CHEMO_DTE , CHEMO_DEPT, CHEMO_REF_MD, CHEMO_VST FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE PRIOR_CHEMO_DTE , VD.CLD_DEPT_NAME CHEMO_DEPT , REF.CRE_RES_NAME CHEMO_REF_MD , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME CHEMO_VST , ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_CSN_ID DESC) RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN SCH_RAD ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID AND CVT_EXT_NAME = 'Treatment' JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT VD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = VD.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VT ON VT.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF ON REF.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_REF_RES_ID AND REF.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist', 'PhD', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPA_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND CPA_LINE_NO = 2 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT SD ON CPA_DEPT_ID = SD.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE SR ON SR.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 1 YEAR AND CURRENT date AND (CPE_CPE_APPT_STS ='Comp' OR CPE_CPE_APPT_STS ='Arrived') AND VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'CHM' AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 ) AS A WHERE RN = 1 ) , PAST_RT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN RT_MRN, PRIOR_RT_DTE , RDO_DEPT, RT_REF_MD, RDO_VST FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE PRIOR_RT_DTE , VD.CLD_DEPT_NAME RDO_DEPT , REF.CRE_RES_NAME RT_REF_MD , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME RDO_VST , CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_EXT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_CSN_ID DESC) RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN SCH_RAD ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID AND CVT_EXT_NAME = 'Treatment' JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT VD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = VD.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VT ON VT.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF ON REF.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_REF_RES_ID AND REF.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist', 'PhD', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPA_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND CPA_LINE_NO = 2 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT SD ON CPA_DEPT_ID = SD.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE SR ON SR.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 1 YEAR AND CURRENT date AND (CPE_CPE_APPT_STS ='Comp' OR CPE_CPE_APPT_STS ='Arrived') AND VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RDO' AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 ) AS A WHERE RN = 1 ) SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, DOB, VST_DATE , TREATING_MD, APPT_DT, VISIT_TYPE, DEPT_NAME, VISIT_NAME , PRIOR_CHEMO_DTE , CHEMO_DEPT, CHEMO_REF_MD, CHEMO_VST FROM SCH_RAD LEFT JOIN PAST_CHEMO ON MRN = CPE_MRN ORDER BY MRN, VST_DATE

prompt: Review what providers are currently billing for Reflectance Confocal Microscopy
completion: SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS "DE-ID", MP_FULL_NM "Provider Name", PCC_CODE AS "CPT Code", PCC_DESC AS "CPT Desc", DT_DTE AS "Procedure Date" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V JOIN DV.CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON PTX_PROC_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.MEDPRO ON PTX_MEDPRO_ID = MP_MEDPRO_ID WHERE PCC_CODE IN ('96931', '96934', '96932', '96935', '96933', '96936') AND DT_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND CURRENT date ;

prompt: We would like to request a list of patients that were referred to Radiation Oncology from Thoracic Surgery.
completion: SELECT CDD_MRN AS "MRN", CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Provider", CDO_SECTION AS "Section", CDO_ITEM_NAME AS "Item", CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Value" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND (UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%PROVIDER%' OR UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%STATUS%') AND ((UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE'%REF%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE'%PROVI%') AND (LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%bott%' OR LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%bains%' OR LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%downey%' OR LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%park%' OR LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%rusch%' OR LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%adusumilli%' OR LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%huang%' OR LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%jones%' OR LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%molena%' OR LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%isbell%' OR LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%sihag%' OR LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%rocco%'))

prompt: Create a report listing patients who died in the hospital the day before, to replace the SMS report that provided this information.
completion: SELECT TRIM(PT_MRN) AS "MRN", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Patient Name", VIS_DSCH_DTE AS "Discharge Date", YEAR(VIS_DSCH_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Age at Discharge", TRIM(VIS_BED) AS "Bed", TRIM(PT_RELIGION) || ' - ' || TRIM(R.AV_DESC) AS "Religion", TRIM(VIS_HOSP_SVC) || ' - ' || TRIM(HOSP_SVC_DESC) AS "Service" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON PT_MRN = VIS_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RELIGION' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RELIGION WHERE VIS_DSCH_DTE >= CURRENT date - 2 DAY AND SUBSTR(VIS_DSCH_DISP, 1, 1) IN ('C', 'D') AND PT_DEATH_IND NOT IN ('', 'A')

prompt: Provide diagnostic molecular, pathology, lab, antineoplastic, HOTB, ClinDoc, and demographic data for a list of MRNs who have had a Heme visit, or a have a positive gene from a list of genes from Heme diagnostic molecular panels.
completion: WITH PTS_HEME_APPTS_PRE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS HEME_MRN, PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS HEME_PID, CAST(RTRIM("t3"."ENVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME") AS VARCHAR(1000)) AS "Visit Type Name", CAST(RTRIM("t7"."ENR_RES_NAME") AS VARCHAR(1000)) AS "Primary Resource Name", "t6"."DT_DTE" AS "Encounter Date" , CASE WHEN "t2"."EDC_DEPT_DESC"IN ('Arrived', 'Completed') THEN 'Completed' WHEN "t2"."EDC_DEPT_DESC" IN ('Scheduled') THEN 'Scheduled' ELSE 'Non-Completed/Scheduled' END AS "Completed/Scheduled Indicator" , "t3"."ENVT_EXT_NAME" , "t10"."EDC_DEPT_ABBREV" , "t5"."EDC_DEPT_ABBREV" AS GRP6 , "t9"."EDC_DEPT_ABBREV" AS GRP7 , ENR_RES_NAME, ENR_EXT_RES_NAME, ENR_RES_TYP, ENR_RES_ABBR , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID ORDER BY PENC_ENC_DT DESC) AS HEME_RN FROM "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER" "t11" JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT EDC_DEPT_ABBREV, EDC_DEPT_DESC FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG WHERE EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS') "t2" ON "t11"."PENC_APPT_STS" = "t2"."EDC_DEPT_ABBREV" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE" "t3" ON "t11"."PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID" = "t3"."ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID" LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES WHERE ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' ) "t12" ON "t11"."PENC_PT_ENC_ID" = "t12"."ENSR_PT_ENC_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT" "t8" ON "t12"."ENSR_DEPT_ID" = "t8"."ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID" LEFT JOIN (SELECT EDC_DEPT_DESC, EDC_DEPT_ABBREV FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG WHERE EDC_GROUP_ID = '6' )"t5" ON "t8"."ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6" = "t5"."EDC_DEPT_ABBREV" LEFT JOIN (SELECT EDC_DEPT_DESC, EDC_DEPT_ABBREV FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG WHERE EDC_GROUP_ID = '7' ) "t9" ON "t8"."ENDP_SVC_CLINIC_SUB_DEPT_GRP_7" = "t9"."EDC_DEPT_ABBREV" LEFT JOIN (SELECT EDC_DEPT_DESC, EDC_DEPT_ABBREV FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG WHERE EDC_GROUP_ID = '8' ) "t10" ON "t8"."ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8" = "t10"."EDC_DEPT_ABBREV" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE" "t7" ON "t12"."ENSR_RES_ID" = "t7"."ENR_ENC_RES_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t6" ON "t11"."PENC_ENC_DATE_ID" = "t6"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND PT_MRN IN ('00383886', '35115844') AND "t9"."EDC_DEPT_ABBREV" = 'HEM' AND ENR_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CASE WHEN "t2"."EDC_DEPT_DESC"IN ('Arrived', 'Completed') THEN 'Completed' WHEN "t2"."EDC_DEPT_DESC" IN ('Scheduled') THEN 'Scheduled' ELSE 'Non-Completed/Scheduled' END = 'Completed' ) , HEME_PTS AS (SELECT HEME_MRN, HEME_PID, "Encounter Date" AS "Last Heme Appt", ENR_RES_NAME AS "Heme Provider" FROM PTS_HEME_APPTS_PRE WHERE HEME_RN = 1 ) , TARGET_GENES AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PID, GENE, GENE2, LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, NUCLEOTIDE, FOLD_CHANGE, ABERRATIONTYPE, PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AS RID, METHOD FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE 1=1 AND (GENE = 'BCR' OR GENE2 = 'BCR') AND (METHOD IN ('RDTB', 'RDTS') OR UPPER(METHOD) like '%HEME%' ) ) , TARGET_REPORTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS TARGET_MRN, PID, RID, METHOD FROM TARGET_GENES) , VARIANTS_TO_OMIT (CNV_TYPE_OMIT) AS ( VALUES ('snp-indel-silent-np'),('snp-indel-silent')) , VARIANT_CLASS_TO_OMIT (VARIANT_CLASS_OMIT) AS ( VALUES ('Unknown'),('UTR3'),('UTR5'),('intronic'),('synonymous_SNV')) , DMP_PRE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS DMP_MRN , PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name" , PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "Date of Birth" , PT_DEATH_DTE AS "Deceased Date" , PT_SEX_DESC AS "Gender" , PT_VITAL_STATUS AS "Vital Status" , MAINPRC.DT_DTE AS "Procedure Date" , PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID , PDRX_ACCESSION_NO , PDWS_DESCRIPTION , T.* , PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PID , PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID AS SAMPLEID, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID AS PATIENTID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML JOIN TARGET_REPORTS ON RID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V MAINPATH ON MAINPATH.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V MAINPRC ON MAINPRC.DT_DATE_ID = MAINPATH.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS CNV_TYPE VARCHAR(500) PATH 'name()', VARIANT_CLASS VARCHAR(100) PATH 'variant_class') T LEFT JOIN VARIANTS_TO_OMIT ON CNV_TYPE = CNV_TYPE_OMIT LEFT JOIN VARIANT_CLASS_TO_OMIT ON VARIANT_CLASS = VARIANT_CLASS_OMIT WHERE 1=1 AND CNV_TYPE_OMIT IS NULL AND VARIANT_CLASS_OMIT IS NULL AND PDWS_NAME IN ('RAINDANCE THUNDERBOLTS', 'IMPACT - HEME', 'RAINDANCE THUNDERSTORM', 'ARCHER - HEME') ) , TARGET_DMP AS (SELECT DISTINCT DMP_MRN, PID, PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID AS RID FROM DMP_PRE) , ALL_QUAL_PTS AS (SELECT HEME_MRN AS MRN , HEME_PID AS PID FROM HEME_PTS UNION SELECT DMP_MRN AS MRN , PID FROM TARGET_DMP) , PATHOLOGY AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", PID, PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", YEAR("t3"."DT_DTE") AS "Pathology Report Year", "t4"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date" , YEAR("t3"."DT_DTE" - PT_BIRTH_DTE) AS "Age at Path Report" FROM DMP_PRE JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = PID LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t4"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t4"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" IN ('Cytogenetics', 'Flow Cytometry Report', 'Hematopathology Consult', 'Hematopathology Departmental Consult', 'Hematopathology Report', 'Pathology-Bone Marrow', 'Surgical Pathology', 'Diagnostic Molecular Pathology') AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL OR "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" IN (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_ACCESSION_NO FROM DMP_PRE) ) , PATH_BASED_PROCEDURE_DATES AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PID, "Last Name", "Pathology Procedure Date" FROM PATHOLOGY) , CLINDOC_PRE AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN , ABS(DAYS("Pathology Procedure Date") - DAYS(CDD_SERVICE_DTE)) AS ABS_DAYS , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_DEID, "Pathology Procedure Date" ORDER BY ABS(DAYS("Pathology Procedure Date") - DAYS(CDD_SERVICE_DTE)) ASC) AS RN , CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE , "Pathology Procedure Date" , CDD_AUTH_PROV_NAME , CDD_AUTH_PROV_MEDPRO_ID , MP_SERVICE_DESC, MP_ACADEMIC_SVC_DESC , MP_HOSP_ROLE, MP_PROVIDER_TYPE_DESC , VARCHAR(CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT, 32000) AS "Note Text" FROM DV.CLINDOC_FULL_TEXT_V CDOC JOIN PATH_BASED_PROCEDURE_DATES ON PID = CDD_DEID LEFT JOIN DV.MEDPRO_V ON MP_MEDPRO_ID = CDD_AUTH_PROV_MEDPRO_ID WHERE 1=1 AND (UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE '%INIT%CON%DOM%' OR UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE 'ADMI%NOT%BMT%' OR UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like 'PROG%NOTE%MED%' OR UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like 'PROG%NOTE%DOM%' OR UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like 'FOL%CONS%MED%' ) AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> 1 AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> 1 ) SELECT * FROM CLINDOC_PRE WHERE RN = 1 ;

prompt: Provide data on patients with large cell neuroendocrine tumors of the lung that were treated at MSKCC from 2006 till 2013.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t1"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS "Vital Status", "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", "t2"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t2"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Description", "t3"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t3"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Description", "t4"."TCA_CASE_STS_DESC" AS "Case Status", "t5"."TOSA_MSK_STG_DESC" AS "MSK Stage", "t6"."DT_YEAR" AS "Tumor Diagnosis Year", "t7"."CDTM_CA_SURG_DTE" AS "Tumor Surgery Date", "t8"."PLA_LAST_SURG_YEAR" AS "Last MSK Surgery Year", "t8"."PLA_LAST_TX_DTE" AS "Last MSK Treatment Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t9" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t7" ON "t9"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t2" ON "t7"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t3" ON "t7"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t3"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V" "t4" ON "t7"."CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID" = "t4"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_OTHER_STAGE_ATTRIBUTES_V" "t5" ON "t7"."CDTM_TM_OTHER_STAGE_ATTR_ID" = "t5"."TOSA_TM_OTHER_STAGE_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t6" ON "t7"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t6"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY" "t8" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE ("t2"."ICSC_SITE_CD" IN ('C340', 'C341', 'C342', 'C343', 'C348', 'C349') AND ("t3"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('M8013/3') AND ("t6"."DT_YEAR" >= 2006 AND "t4"."TCA_CASE_STS_DESC" IN ('Completed', 'Consult only'))))

prompt: Potential patients fitting criteria seen in the previous year, 2019
completion: SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS DEID, CASE WHEN PFA_FST_MSK_TX_DTE >= TM_DX_DTE THEN 'Y' END AS "Tx aft Dx", YEAR(PFA_FST_MSK_TX_DTE) AS "Yr 1st Tx", CASE WHEN TM_DX_DTE IS NULL THEN '01/01/1900' ELSE YEAR(TM_DX_DTE) END AS DX_YEAR, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CD, HIST.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_CD_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CD, SITE.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_CD_DESC, CS.AV_DESC AS CASE_STATUS, CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS "Best Stage" , TM_PATH_TNM_T AS PATH_TNM_T, TM_PATH_TNM_N AS PATH_TNM_N, TM_PATH_TNM_M AS PATH_TNM_M, TM_PATH_STG_GRP, TM_CLIN_TNM_T, TM_CLIN_TNM_N, TM_CLIN_TNM_M, TM_CLIN_STG_GRP, TM_HIST_CD_GRADE AS GRADE, GR.AV_DESC AS GRADE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR TM JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS PD ON PD.PT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTIVITY ON PFA_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GR ON GR.AV_ELEMENT = 'HIST_CD_GRADE' AND GR.AV_CODE = TM_HIST_CD_GRADE LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM HIST ON HIST.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM SITE ON SITE.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS A ON A.AV_ELEMENT='AJCC_7' AND A.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE 1=1 AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND TM_SITE_CD like 'C50%' AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') WITH UR

prompt: Provide a weekly list of patients undergoing lung or hilar lymph node fine needle aspirations (with pulmonology, thoracic surgery, or interventional radiology), with signed 06-107 or 12-245 consents.
completion: WITH PROC AS (SELECT OC_CASE_ID, OC_MRN, OC_SURG_DTE AS PROCEDURE_SCH_DATE, OP_PROC_NAME AS PROCEDURE_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OC_MRN, OP_OR_PROC_ID ORDER BY OC_SURG_DTE ASC) FRST FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND OP_OR_PROC_ID IN ('11100054', '11100218', 'M-10547', 'M-10548', 'M-10549', 'M-13632', 'M-13633', 'M-14101', 'M-14102', 'M-7902', 'M-844', '11001126', '11001128', '11001129', '11006196', '11006197', '5490', '5492',
