'5493') AND OP_INACTV_IND = 'N' AND OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE + 7 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE + 14 DAYS) , IRB1 AS (SELECT AC_MRN, AC_IRB_NO, CASE WHEN AC_CONS_DTE IS NULL AND AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN 'N' WHEN AC_CONS_DTE IS NOT NULL AND AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'NA' END AS CONSENT FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN PROC ON OC_MRN = AC_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO = '06-107') , IRB2 AS (SELECT AC_MRN, AC_IRB_NO, CASE WHEN AC_CONS_DTE IS NULL AND AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN 'N' WHEN AC_CONS_DTE IS NOT NULL AND AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'NA' END AS CONSENT FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN PROC ON OC_MRN = AC_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO = '12-245') , IRB_BOTH AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT P.OC_MRN AS IRB_MRN, A.AC_IRB_NO AS IRB1, A.CONSENT AS IRB1_CONSENT, B.AC_IRB_NO AS IRB2, B.CONSENT AS IRB2_CONSENT FROM PROC P LEFT JOIN IRB1 A ON A.AC_MRN = P.OC_MRN LEFT JOIN IRB2 B ON B.AC_MRN = P.OC_MRN WHERE FRST = 1 ) WHERE IRB1_CONSENT ='Y' OR IRB2_CONSENT ='Y' ) , SMHIST AS (SELECT TM_MRN, SMOKING_HISTORY FROM (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS SMOKING_HISTORY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TM_MRN ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE) RN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'SMOKING_HX' AND AV_CODE = TM_SMOKING_HX JOIN PROC ON OC_MRN = TM_MRN AND TM_CASE_STS = '3' ) WHERE RN =1 ) , PATHOL AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN IRB_BOTH R ON PRPT_MRN = IRB_MRN AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC LIKE 'Cytology%') SELECT R.OC_MRN AS MRN, TRIM (PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, YEAR (R.PROCEDURE_SCH_DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AS_ON_PROC_DATE, SMOKING_HISTORY, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, R.PROCEDURE_SCH_DATE, PROCEDURE_NAME, PRPT_REPORT FROM PROC R JOIN IRB_BOTH ON OC_MRN = IRB_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OC_MRN LEFT JOIN PATHOL ON PRPT_MRN = OC_MRN LEFT JOIN SMHIST ON TM_MRN = OC_MRN ORDER BY R.PROCEDURE_SCH_DATE, MRN, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO

prompt: A report which captures the ClinDoc volumes for nursing staff working in the outpatient setting to help manage workload.
completion: SELECT CDD_MRN "MRN", LOWER(OU_EMAIL_ADDR) "Email", OU_DISPLAY_NAME "Nurse" , CPCD_NAME "Document Name" , CDD_SERVICE_DTE "Service Date" , (CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CDD_SERVICE_DT)=1 THEN 'Sunday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CDD_SERVICE_DT)=2 THEN 'Monday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CDD_SERVICE_DT)=3 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CDD_SERVICE_DT)=4 THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CDD_SERVICE_DT)=5 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CDD_SERVICE_DT)=6 THEN 'Friday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CDD_SERVICE_DT)=7 THEN 'Saturday' END) AS "Day Name" , TIME(CDD_SERVICE_DT) AS "Time" , (CASE WHEN HOUR(CDD_SERVICE_DT) = 0 THEN '12 am' WHEN HOUR(CDD_SERVICE_DT) > 12 THEN TRIM(CAST(HOUR(CDD_SERVICE_DT) - 12 AS CHAR(2))) || ' pm' WHEN HOUR(CDD_SERVICE_DT) = 12 THEN '12 pm' ELSE TRIM(CAST(HOUR(CDD_SERVICE_DT) AS CHAR(2))) || ' am' END) AS "Hour" , (CASE WHEN CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '1' THEN 'Incomplete' ELSE 'Complete' END) AS "Document Status" , MEI_CC_ID AS "Dept ID" , MEI_CC_DESC AS "Dept Name" , LOWER(MEI_EMAIL_ADDR) AS "MAIL" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OP_USER_GUID=OU_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_CNFG_PAT_CARE_DOCUMENT ON CPCD_GUID = CDD_PTCAREDOC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.MSKCC_EMPLOYEE_INFO ON LOWER(MEI_EMAIL_ADDR)=CASE WHEN LOWER(OU_EMAIL_ADDR) = 'fishmand@mskcc.org' THEN 'goldblad@mskcc.org' ELSE LOWER(OU_EMAIL_ADDR) END AND LENGTH(TRIM(MEI_EMAIL_ADDR)) > 10 WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) >= YEAR(CURRENT date) - 1 AND OP_PROV_TYPE = 'Nurse' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE < CURRENT date

prompt: MSK email via CRM to staff currently eligible/not yet eligible to receive COVID-19 booster dose
completion: SELECT EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID, CVP_NAME, VACCINE_STATUS, CEVE_CATEGORY, CVP_STATUS, CVP_SHORT_TERM_DIS_FLAG ON_LEAVE, CASE WHEN DOSE_ADDL_APPT_STATUS = 'PRE' THEN DATE(DOSE_ADDL_APPT_DT) ELSE NULL END AS ADDL_DOSE_APPT_DTE, FIRST_BOOSTER_ELIGIBLE_DTE, SUPV_NAME FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO LEFT JOIN IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_EXEMPT_V ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = EXEMPT_EMPLOYEE_ID JOIN IDB.COVID19_VACCINE_PERSON ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = CVP_EMPLOYEE_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT CVP_EMPLOYEE_ID SUPV_ID, CVP_NAME SUPV_NAME FROM IDB.COVID19_VACCINE_PERSON) ON CVP_SUPERVISOR_ID = SUPV_ID WHERE CVP_STATUS = 'Active' AND CEVE_CATEGORY = 'Employees' AND COALESCE(CVP_SHORT_TERM_DIS_FLAG, '') <> 'Y' AND COALESCE(MEDICAL_EXEMPT, '') <> 'Y' AND COALESCE(REMOTE_EXEMPT, '') <> 'Y' AND FIRST_BOOSTER_COMPLIANT <> 'Y' AND FIRST_BOOSTER_ELIGIBLE_DTE <= CURRENT_DATE ; SELECT EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID, CVP_NAME, VACCINE_STATUS, CEVE_CATEGORY, CVP_STATUS, CVP_SHORT_TERM_DIS_FLAG ON_LEAVE, CASE WHEN DOSE_ADDL_APPT_STATUS = 'PRE' THEN DATE(DOSE_ADDL_APPT_DT) ELSE NULL END AS ADDL_DOSE_APPT_DTE, FIRST_BOOSTER_ELIGIBLE_DTE, SUPV_NAME FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO LEFT JOIN IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_EXEMPT_V ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = EXEMPT_EMPLOYEE_ID JOIN IDB.COVID19_VACCINE_PERSON ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = CVP_EMPLOYEE_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT CVP_EMPLOYEE_ID SUPV_ID, CVP_NAME SUPV_NAME FROM IDB.COVID19_VACCINE_PERSON) ON CVP_SUPERVISOR_ID = SUPV_ID WHERE CVP_STATUS = 'Active' AND CEVE_CATEGORY = 'Employees' AND COALESCE(CVP_SHORT_TERM_DIS_FLAG, '') <> 'Y' AND COALESCE(MEDICAL_EXEMPT, '') <> 'Y' AND COALESCE(REMOTE_EXEMPT, '') <> 'Y' AND FIRST_BOOSTER_COMPLIANT <> 'Y' AND FIRST_BOOSTER_ELIGIBLE_DTE > CURRENT_DATE ;

prompt: List of IMPACT patients with Tumor vFreq > 0.02 who received Chemo or Radiation since 2010
completion: WITH CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, MAX(APR_START_DTE) LAST_CHEMO_START FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE APR_START_DTE >= '2010-01-01' AND CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY APR_MRN ) , RAD AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, MAX(DT_DTE) LAST_RAD_START FROM DV.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN DV.DATE ON RTC_TX_START_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID WHERE DT_DTE >= '2010-01-01' GROUP BY RTC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID ) , PROTOCOL AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, AC_CONS_DTE FROM DV.ACCRUALS JOIN DV.PROTOCOL ON AC_PROTOCOL_ID = PRO_PROTOCOL_ID WHERE PRO_IRB_NO = '12-245' ) , GENE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_CITY, PT_STATE, PT_ZIP_CD, LAST_CHEMO_START, LAST_RAD_START, PRIMARY_SITE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID INNER JOIN DV.DATE DTRPT ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = DTRPT.DT_DATE_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS int PATH 'count(../*[not(name()=''meta-data'')])', TUMOR_VFREQ VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_vfreq', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site') T LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN RAD ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = RTC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' AND (TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS =0 OR VARIANT_TYPE <> 'meta-data') AND TUMOR_VFREQ > .02 AND PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL AND PT_STATE IN ('NY', 'NJ', 'CT') AND YEAR(DTRPT.DT_DTE - PT_BIRTH_DTE) >= 19 AND COALESCE(LAST_CHEMO_START, LAST_RAD_START) IS NOT NULL AND DTRPT.DT_DTE >= '2015-01-01' ) , DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, AV_DESC AS SMOKING_HX FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN GENE ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON TM_SMOKING_HX = AV_CODE AND AV_ELEMENT = 'SMOKING_HX' WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE "Date of Birth", PT_CITY "City", PT_STATE "State", PT_ZIP_CD "Zip", PRIMARY_SITE "IMPACT Site", AC_CONS_DTE "IMPACT Consent Date", TM_DX_DTE "Tumor Dx Date", TM_HIST_CD "Histology Code", HIST_DESC "Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD "Site Code", SITE_DESC "Site Description", SMOKING_HX "Smoking History", LAST_CHEMO_START "Last Chemo Start Date", LAST_RAD_START "Last Rad Start Date" FROM GENE LEFT JOIN DX ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN PROTOCOL ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID ORDER BY 1 DESC, 8, TM_DX_DTE

prompt: Weekly report of patients with Fungal Diseases.
completion: WITH FUNGAL AS (SELECT LR_MRN, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LTL_TEXT_RESULT, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_IDB_PRCS_DTE FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LR_MRN = LTL_MRN AND LR_RESULT_GUID = LTL_RESULT_GUID WHERE LR_TEST_NAME IN ('Aspergillus Galactomannan Ag (Serum)', 'Aspergillus Galactomannan (BAL)', 'Beta-D-Glucan Serum', 'BD Glucans (Serum)', 'BD Glucans(Other)', 'BD Glucans', 'Histoplasma Antigen', 'Coccidioides AntiBODY Confirm', 'IgG/IgM/Titer', 'Coccidioides AntiBODY IgG/IgM Screen', 'w/Reflex Confirm') AND LR_IDB_PRCS_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 7 DAYS - DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT date) DAYS + 2 DAY AND CURRENT date - 1 DAYS - DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT date) DAYS + 2 DAY AND LTL_TEXT_RESULT not like '%Not Detected%' ), STEMCELL AS ( (SELECT LR_MRN AS "BMTMRN", CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS "Transplant Type", CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS "Transplant Date" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN FROM FUNGAL) AS "FungalMRN" JOIN IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE ON LR_MRN = CBM_MRN UNION SELECT LR_MRN AS "BMTMRN", CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS "Transplant Type", CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS "Transplant Date" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN FROM FUNGAL) AS "FungalMRN" JOIN IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS ON LR_MRN = CBP_MRN)), MALAGNANCIES AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, CLM_CLSF_TYPE, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS "First Effective Date" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN FROM FUNGAL) AS "FungalMRN" JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON LR_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = CC_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '140' AND '239.99' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'D49.99') AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, CLM_CLSF_TYPE), PT AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_SEX AS "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN FROM FUNGAL) AS "FungalMRN" JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON LR_MRN = PT_MRN) SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", "Last Name", "First Name", "Gender", "Date of Birth", AGE, LR_TEST_NAME AS "Lab Test Name", LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS "Lab Subtest Name", LTL_TEXT_RESULT AS "Lab Text Result", LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS "Lab Performed Date", "Transplant Type", "Transplant Date", CC_CLSF_CD AS "ICD Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "ICD Description", CASE CLM_CLSF_TYPE WHEN 'I9' THEN 'ICD-9' WHEN 'I0' THEN 'ICD-10' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS "ICD Version", "First Effective Date", CURRENT date - 7 DAYS - DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT date) DAYS + 2 DAY AS "Report Start Date", CURRENT date - 1 DAYS - DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT date) DAYS + 2 DAY AS "Report End Date" FROM PT JOIN FUNGAL ON LR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN STEMCELL ON "BMTMRN" = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN MALAGNANCIES ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN

prompt: Census Results For a Specific MRN
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CH_ACCT_NO, CH_SEQ_NO, CH_BED, TIMESTAMP(CH_EFF_DATE, CH_EFF_TIME) START_DT, TIMESTAMP(CS_DSCH_DATE, CS_DSCH_TIME) AS DSCH_DT FROM IDB.CENSUS JOIN IDB.CASE ON CH_ACCT_NO = CS_ACCT_NO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CH_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CH_MRN = '35035640' ) , CTE2 AS (SELECT A.PT_MRN AS "MRN", A.PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", A.PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", A.CH_ACCT_NO AS "Account Number", A.CH_BED AS "Bed", A.START_DT AS "Start Timestamp", MIN(COALESCE(B.START_DT, A.DSCH_DT)) AS "End Timestamp" FROM CTE A LEFT JOIN CTE B ON A.CH_ACCT_NO = B.CH_ACCT_NO AND A.CH_SEQ_NO < B.CH_SEQ_NO AND A.CH_BED <> B.CH_BED LEFT JOIN CTE C ON A.CH_ACCT_NO = C.CH_ACCT_NO AND A.CH_SEQ_NO = C.CH_SEQ_NO + 1 AND A.CH_BED = C.CH_BED WHERE C.CH_ACCT_NO IS NULL GROUP BY A.PT_MRN, A.PT_LAST_NAME, A.PT_FIRST_NAME, A.CH_ACCT_NO, A.CH_BED, A.START_DT) SELECT * FROM CTE2 WHERE "Bed" not like '%OV%' ORDER BY 4, 6

prompt: Provide a list of patients who have had a stem cell transplant at MSK in the last 1-5 years.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT CBM_MRN AS MRN, CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS BMT_TYPE, CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS BMT_DATE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CBM_MRN = PT_MRN AND YEAR(CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 WHERE CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 5 YEARS AND CURRENT date - 1 YEARS UNION SELECT CBP_MRN AS MRN, CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS BMT_TYPE, CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS BMT_DATE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CBP_MRN = PT_MRN AND YEAR(CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 WHERE CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 5 YEARS AND CURRENT date - 1 YEARS ) SELECT DISTINCT X.*, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_PRIMARY_LANG, CPP_EMAIL_ADDR, CPP_HOME_PHONE, CPP_MOBILE_PHONE FROM X JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON X.MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON MRN = CPP_MRN WHERE PT_PRIMARY_LANG = 'ENG'

prompt: Provide a report of drug orders for OP transplant, and Chemo BMT visits in May 2012.
completion: WITH VST AS (SELECT CPE_MRN MRN , STRIP(CL_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(CL_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME , CPE_ENC_DTE VST_DTE , CPE_CPE_APPT_STS VST_STS , CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME, CPE_REF_RES_ID , VST_REF.CRE_RES_NAME RES, VST_REF.CRE_RES_TYP , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME VST_TYPE, CVT_EXT_NAME VST_NAME , VST_RES.CRE_RES_NAME VST_MD FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2012-05-01' AND '2012-05-31' JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = CL_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VST_RES ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = VST_RES.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VST_REF ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = VST_REF.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE (CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'OP TRPT%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'CHBMT%') AND CVT_EXT_NAME = 'Treatment') , PHM AS (SELECT DISTINCT PO_MRN MRN, PO_ACCT_NO AS ACCT_NO , UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) AS DRUG_NAME, PO_DR_NO, PO_DR_NAME , POI_DOSE AS DOSE, POI_DOSE_UNIT AS DOSE_UNIT, POD_STRT_DTE , PAA_ADMIN_DTE AS ADMIN_DATE , PO_ROUTE_ABBR AS ROUTE, POD_SCH_CD AS DRUG_FREQ FROM VST JOIN IDB.PHM_ORDER ON MRN = PO_MRN JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL ON PO_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_INV ON POD_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ AND POD_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO JOIN IDB.PHM_INVENTORY ON POI_INV_SEQ = PIN_INV_SEQ LEFT JOIN IDB.PHM_AUD_ADMIN ON PAA_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ AND PAA_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO AND PAA_ORD_INV_SEQ = POI_ORD_INV_SEQ WHERE PO_ORD_STS <>'X' AND POD_STRT_DTE BETWEEN '2012-05-01' AND '2012-05-31') SELECT * FROM PHM

prompt: Daily list of patients who have/have not completed assigned questionnaire and responses to survey questions.
completion: WITH SURG AS (SELECT PATIENT_MRN, CASE_NUMBER, CASE_STATUS, CASE_SURGERY_DTE , CASE_PRIMARY_SURGEON_ID, CASE_PRIMARY_SURGEON, CASE_VISIT_TYPE FROM IDB.PERIOP_CASE_EVENT_V WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Scheduled' AND CASE_SURGERY_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date + 3 DAYS AND CURRENT date + 10 DAYS ) SELECT DISTINCT PATIENT_MRN AS MRN, CASE_PRIMARY_SURGEON AS SURGEON_NAME, CASE_SURGERY_DTE PLANNED_SURGERY_DATE, EA_ASSIGN_DT ASSIGNED_DATE, EF_SUBMISSION_DT SUBMISSION_DATE, CASE WHEN EF_MRN <> '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS FORM_COMPLETED_FLAG FROM SURG LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT ON CHAR(EA_SOURCE_ID) = CASE_NUMBER LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM ON EF_FORM_EXTERNAL_ID = EA_ASSESS_ID AND EF_FORM_NAME = 'PreAnesthesia Screening Questionnaire' AND DATE(EA_ASSIGN_DT) BETWEEN CASE_SURGERY_DTE - 7 DAYS AND CASE_SURGERY_DTE ; WITH SRV AS (SELECT DISTINCT PATIENT_MRN, CASE_SURGERY_DTE FROM (SELECT PATIENT_MRN, CASE_NUMBER, CASE_STATUS, CASE_SURGERY_DTE , CASE_PRIMARY_SURGEON_ID, CASE_PRIMARY_SURGEON, CASE_VISIT_TYPE FROM IDB.PERIOP_CASE_EVENT_V WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Scheduled' AND CASE_SURGERY_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date + 3 DAYS AND CURRENT date + 10 DAYS ) S JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT ON CHAR(EA_SOURCE_ID) = S.CASE_NUMBER JOIN IDB.EF_FORM ON EF_FORM_EXTERNAL_ID = EA_ASSESS_ID AND EF_MRN = PATIENT_MRN AND EF_FORM_NAME = 'PreAnesthesia Screening Questionnaire' AND DATE(EA_ASSIGN_DT) BETWEEN S.CASE_SURGERY_DTE - 7 DAYS AND S.CASE_SURGERY_DTE) SELECT EF_MRN, EF_SUBMISSION_DT, MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'tiaq' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "Have you ever been told you had a transient ischemic attack (TIA), also known as a mini-stroke?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'heart_device' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "Do you have an implanted permanent pacemaker or any other implanted cardiac device?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'headneck_surgeryans' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "Have you had surgery or radiation to your head and neck area that made it hard to open your mouth or move your neck?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'chestq' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "Have you ever been told that you have a problem with your heart, or have been treated for heart disease or chest pain (angina)?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'hemodialysis_ans' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "Do you go for hemodialysis?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'insulin_device' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "Do you have an implanted insulin pump?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'SOB_lyingflat' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "Have you had trouble breathing or shortness of breath while lying flat?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'faint_6mo' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "Have you fainted (passed out) in the past 6 months?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'strokeq' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "Have you ever had a stroke (other than a TIA)?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'difficultopenmouth_y_n' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "Have you had trouble opening your mouth?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'anes_meds' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "Do you take any of the below medications?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'anginaq' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "Have you ever had chest pain, also known as angina?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'aortq' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "Have you ever been told you have a problem with a valve in your heart ?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'atrfibq' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "Have you ever been told you have atrial fibrillation (A Fib) or an irregular heartbeat?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'baq' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "Have you ever had heart surgery or a heart stent placed to treat a blocked artery?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'blockedartery_year' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "What year? 7 DAYS - DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT date) DAYS + 2 DAY AND CURRENT date - 1 DAYS - DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT date) DAYS + 2 DAY AND LTL_TEXT_RESULT not like '%Not Detected%' ), STEMCELL AS ( (SELECT LR_MRN AS "BMTMRN", CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS "Transplant Type", CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS "Transplant Date" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN FROM HSV) AS "HSVMRN" JOIN IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE ON LR_MRN = CBM_MRN UNION SELECT LR_MRN AS "BMTMRN", CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS "Transplant Type", CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS "Transplant Date" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN FROM HSV) AS "HSVMRN" JOIN IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS ON LR_MRN = CBP_MRN)), MALAGNANCIES AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, CLM_CLSF_TYPE, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS "First Effective Date" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN FROM HSV) AS "HSVMRN" JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON LR_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = CC_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '140' AND '239.99' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'D49.99') AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, CLM_CLSF_TYPE), PT AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_SEX AS "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN FROM HSV) AS "HSVMRN" JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON LR_MRN = PT_MRN) SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", "Last Name", "First Name", "Gender", "Date of Birth", AGE, LR_TEST_NAME AS "Lab Test Name", LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS "Lab Subtest Name", LTL_TEXT_RESULT AS "Lab Text Result", LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS "Lab Performed Date", "Transplant Type", "Transplant Date", CC_CLSF_CD AS "ICD Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "ICD Description", CASE CLM_CLSF_TYPE WHEN 'I9' THEN 'ICD-9' WHEN 'I0' THEN 'ICD-10' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS "ICD Version", "First Effective Date", CURRENT date - 7 DAYS - DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT date) DAYS + 2 DAY AS "Report Start Date", CURRENT date - 1 DAYS - DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT date) DAYS + 2 DAY AS "Report End Date" FROM PT JOIN HSV ON LR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN STEMCELL ON "BMTMRN" = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN MALAGNANCIES ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN

WITH HML AS (SELECT DISTINCT HCPR_MRN, COALESCE(DATE(HCPR_START_DT), HCPR_CREATED_DTE) HCPR_START_DTE, CASE WHEN HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 THEN 'eRx' WHEN HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3 THEN 'HML' ELSE 'Oth' END AS RX_TYPE, OP_DISPLAY_NAME ORDERING_PROVIDER FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE HGN_GENERIC_NAME = 'erdafitinib' AND COALESCE(DATE(HCPR_START_DT), HCPR_CREATED_DTE) BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2021-08-13' ) , PROTOCOL AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE, AC_IRB_NO, PRO_IRB_TITLE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN IDB.PROTOCOL ON AC_IRB_NO = PRO_IRB_NO JOIN HML ON AC_MRN = HCPR_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT HCPR_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, AC_IRB_NO, PRO_IRB_TITLE, AC_CONS_DTE FROM HML LEFT JOIN PROTOCOL ON HCPR_MRN = AC_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON HCPR_MRN = PT_MRN ORDER BY HCPR_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE

prompt:
Retrospective Research study to assess electronic vs paper patient-reported outcomes. Patient-reported outcomes (PRO) are increasingly valued in medical care and research, as PRO data can provide insight into a patient's health status, treatment effects, and, for certain outcomes, can provide a more accurate assessment than that of a clinician. 



We will use descriptive statistics to summarize patient characteristics (frequency reports, median, mean) and associations (crosstabulations, chi-square tests) relative to method of survey completion (portal vs. in-clinic). If appropriate, we will construct binary logistic regression models to determine the robustness of association between portal use/nonuse and variables that show significance in bivariate testing.

prompt: Provide a listing of patients with Small Cell Lung Cancer and/or Pulmonary Neuroendocrine diagnoses. First report will be data from 1/1/2015 to current date.  Weekly reports for the last seven days moving forward
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8041/3', 'M8042/3', 'M8043/3', 'M8044/3', 'M8045/3', 'M8013/3', 'M8246/3', 'M8574/3') AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2015-01-01' AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' ) , MD AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY APPT_CNT DESC) RN FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) APPT_CNT FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON TM_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME ) A) A WHERE RN=1 ) , IRB AS (SELECT AC_MRN , LISTAGG(TRIM(AC_IRB_NO), ', ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY AC_IRB_NO) PROTOCOLS FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN PTS ON TM_MRN = AC_MRN GROUP BY AC_MRN) , MAX_VIS AS (SELECT OCV_MRN MV_MRN, MAX(OCV_VISIT_DTE) AS MAX_DTE FROM IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT JOIN PTS ON OCV_MRN = TM_MRN GROUP BY OCV_MRN) , SITE AS (SELECT OCV_MRN , MIN(LGR_LOC_GRP) MSK_SITE FROM IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT JOIN MAX_VIS ON OCV_MRN = MV_MRN AND OCV_VISIT_DTE = MAX_DTE JOIN IDB.LOCATION_GROUPS_REFERENCE ON OCV_CURR_LOC_GUID = LGR_LOC_GUID GROUP BY OCV_MRN) SELECT PT_MRN MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENT_NAME , PT_BIRTH_DTE DOB , PT_DEATH_DTE DOD , PLA_LST_APPT_DTE LAST_OUTPATIENT_APPT , PLA_LST_ADM_DTE LAST_ADMISSION , PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE LAST_DISCHARGE , PLA_LST_CON_DTE LAST_CONTACT_DTE , PT_ADDR1, PT_ADDR2, PT_CITY, PT_STATE, PT_ZIP_CD, PT_COUNTRY , CRE_RES_NAME AS TREATING_MD , MSK_SITE , PROTOCOLS FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN MD ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN IRB ON PT_MRN = AC_MRN LEFT JOIN SITE ON PT_MRN = OCV_MRN ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8041/3', 'M8042/3', 'M8043/3', 'M8044/3', 'M8045/3', 'M8013/3', 'M8246/3', 'M8574/3') AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2015-01-01' AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' ) SELECT PRPT_MRN MRN , PRPT_REPORT PATH_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN PTS ON TM_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '(("small cell" AND "lung") OR ("neuroendocrine" AND "lung"))') = 1

prompt: 1 time report/list of all documents entered titled "Therapy Treatment Plan Agreement - Rehabilitation" entered by Physical Therapy and Occupational Therapy in 2019, 2020, and 2021.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME, CDD_ENTER_DT AS DATE_OF_NOTE_ENTRY, CDD_DOC_NAME AS DOC_NAME, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.PATIENT P JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Therapy Treatment Plan Agreement - Rehabilitation' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Discipline:' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT IN ('Occupational Therapy', 'OTR/L', 'OTR/L, CLT', 'Physical Therapy', 'PT', 'PT, DPT') AND YEAR(CDD_ENTER_DT) IN ('2019', '2020', '2021'); SELECT MRN , LAST_NAME , FIRST_NAME , DATE_OF_NOTE_ENTRY , DATE_OF_SIGNED , DOC_NAME , ITEM_NAME , VALUE_TEXT FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS DATE_OF_NOTE_ENTRY, CDD_DOC_NAME AS DOC_NAME, TRIM(CDO_ITEM_NAME) AS ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS VALUE_TEXT, CDD_SIGNED_DTE AS DATE_OF_SIGNED, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CASE WHEN CDD_SIGNED_DT < CDD_SERVICE_DT + 30 DAYS OR CDD_SIGNED_DT < CDD_SERVICE_DT THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS COND FROM IDB.PATIENT P JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_RSLT_PEND_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Therapy Treatment Plan Agreement - Rehabilitation' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Discipline:' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT IN ('Occupational Therapy', 'OTR/L', 'OTR/L, CLT', 'Physical Therapy', 'PT', 'PT, DPT') AND YEAR(CDD_ENTER_DT) IN ('2019', '2020', '2021') AND CDD_SIGNED_DT > CDD_SERVICE_DT + 30 DAYS ) WHERE COND = 0 ; WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, YEAR(CDD_ENTER_DT) AS YEAR_NOTE_ENTRY, CASE WHEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT IN ('Occupational Therapy', 'OTR/L', 'OTR/L, CLT') THEN 'OT' WHEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT IN ('Physical Therapy', 'PT', 'PT, DPT') THEN 'PT' END AS DISC FROM IDB.PATIENT P JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Therapy Treatment Plan Agreement - Rehabilitation' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Discipline:' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT IN ('Occupational Therapy', 'OTR/L', 'OTR/L, CLT', 'Physical Therapy', 'PT', 'PT, DPT') AND YEAR(CDD_ENTER_DT)= '2019' ) SELECT DISTINCT YEAR_NOTE_ENTRY, DISC, COUNT (MRN) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR_NOTE_ENTRY, DISC) AS CNT_MRN FROM CTE; WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, YEAR(CDD_ENTER_DT) AS YEAR_NOTE_ENTRY, CASE WHEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT IN ('Occupational Therapy', 'OTR/L', 'OTR/L, CLT') THEN 'OT' WHEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT IN ('Physical Therapy', 'PT', 'PT, DPT') THEN 'PT' END AS DISC FROM IDB.PATIENT P JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Therapy Treatment Plan Agreement - Rehabilitation' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Discipline:' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT IN ('Occupational Therapy', 'OTR/L', 'OTR/L, CLT', 'Physical Therapy', 'PT', 'PT, DPT') AND YEAR(CDD_ENTER_DT)= '2020' ) SELECT DISTINCT YEAR_NOTE_ENTRY, DISC, COUNT (MRN) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR_NOTE_ENTRY, DISC) AS CNT_MRN FROM CTE; WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, YEAR(CDD_ENTER_DT) AS YEAR_NOTE_ENTRY, CASE WHEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT IN ('Occupational Therapy', 'OTR/L', 'OTR/L, CLT') THEN 'OT' WHEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT IN ('Physical Therapy', 'PT', 'PT, DPT') THEN 'PT' END AS DISC FROM IDB.PATIENT P JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Therapy Treatment Plan Agreement - Rehabilitation' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Discipline:' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT IN ('Occupational Therapy', 'OTR/L', 'OTR/L, CLT', 'Physical Therapy', 'PT', 'PT, DPT') AND YEAR(CDD_ENTER_DT)= '2021' ) SELECT DISTINCT YEAR_NOTE_ENTRY, DISC, COUNT (MRN) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR_NOTE_ENTRY, DISC) AS CNT_MRN FROM CTE;

prompt: Count of patients by department that were COVID positive and had appointments after 2/1/2020
completion: WITH COVID AS (SELECT MRN, CAST(MIN_RESULT_DT AS DATE) AS MIN_RESULT_DTE, RESULT FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_INFO WHERE RESULT IN ('Positive', 'Resolved') ) , APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", OS_SVC_DESC, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", MIN_RESULT_DTE AS COVID_DX_DTE, RESULT AS COVID_RESULT, CRE_RES_TYP, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = OS_SVC_GRP_CD JOIN COVID ON CPE_MRN = MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Psychologist', 'Dentist', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2020-02-01' ) , JOINED AS (SELECT DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY MRN) AS "Patient number", COVID_DX_DTE AS "COVID DX Date", "Appt Date", "Department", "Department Name", "Service", OS_SVC_DESC AS "Service Description", CRE_RES_TYP AS "Resource type" FROM APPTS WHERE RN = 1 ) SELECT "Department", "Service", "Service Description", COUNT(DISTINCT "Patient number") AS COUNT FROM JOINED GROUP BY "Department", "Service", "Service Description" ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "Patient number") DESC

prompt: List of patients for whom an "Endocrine Outpatient Consult" order was submitted from 1/1/17 until now that included the term "insulin pump" in "Additional Comments" and the answer to "Surgery planned within the next 6 mo?" was "Yes."
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT OO_MRN MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_GUID , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE , YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) ORD_YEAR, OO_ORD_STS_CD, OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_NAME, OU_DISPLAY_NAME, OU_OCCUPATION, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_Endo_OP_Comments' THEN SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 225) END) INSULIN_PUMP, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_Endo OP_TX' THEN SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 25) END) PLANNED_SURG, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD LIKE 'Consult_Endo OP_MD%' THEN SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 55) END) REQUESTED_MD FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID WHERE OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000010684100730' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD IN ('COMP', 'DISC', 'HOLD', 'AUA2', 'AUC1') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= '2017-01-01' GROUP BY OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_GUID , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE , YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) , OO_ORD_STS_CD, OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_NAME, OU_DISPLAY_NAME, OU_OCCUPATION) SELECT MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE "Order Enter Date" , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE "Order Performed Date", ORD_YEAR "Order Year", OO_ORD_STS_CD "Order Status", OO_ORD_ID "Order ID", OO_ORD_NAME "Order Name", OU_DISPLAY_NAME "Requested By", OU_OCCUPATION "Occupation", INSULIN_PUMP "Insulin Pump", PLANNED_SURG "Planned Surgery within 6 Months" FROM CTE WHERE (LOWER(INSULIN_PUMP) like '%insulin%' AND LOWER(INSULIN_PUMP) like '%pump%') AND RTRIM(LTRIM(LOWER(PLANNED_SURG))) = 'yes'

prompt: Can you please provide the demographic and insurance data of all MSK pediatric patients seen in 2022? Ages 0-21
completion: WITH OPS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS OP_MRN, 'OP' AS OP, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 , YEAR (CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CLD_DEPT_ID = CPE_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 <> 'EHS' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 NOT IN ('MSKACCESS', 'PFS') JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN AND YEAR (CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 22 WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 ) , IPS AS (SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN AS IP_MRN, 'IP' AS IP, YEAR (VIS_ADM_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE FROM IDB.VISIT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON VIS_MRN = PT_MRN AND YEAR (VIS_ADM_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 22 WHERE 1=1 AND VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' ) , ALLPTS AS (SELECT OP_MRN AS MRN FROM OPS UNION SELECT IP_MRN AS MRN FROM IPS) , PTAGE AS (SELECT MRN AS MRNAGE, MAX(AGE) AS MAXAGE FROM (SELECT OP_MRN AS MRN, AGE FROM OPS UNION SELECT IP_MRN AS MRN, AGE FROM IPS) AS X GROUP BY MRN) , FCDATE AS (SELECT MRN AS MRNFC, MAX(VIS_ADM_DTE) AS MAXADMDTE FROM ALLPTS JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON MRN = VIS_MRN AND VIS_PATIENT_TYPE <> 'OPRE' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') GROUP BY MRN) , FC AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRNFC, MAXADMDTE, CASE WHEN RVPM_FSC_CAT_NAME = 'SELF PAY' THEN 'SELFPAY' WHEN RVPM_FSC_CAT_NAME LIKE 'MEDICAID%' THEN 'MEDICAID' WHEN RVPM_FSC_CAT_NAME LIKE 'MEDICARE%' THEN 'MEDICARE' WHEN RVPM_FSC_CAT_NAME IN ('ADMIN', 'MSK EMPLOYEE', 'PAT REP ADMIN') THEN 'OTHER' ELSE 'PRIVATE' END AS INSURANCE FROM FCDATE JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT_FSC_CAT_MAP_V ON RVPM_MRN = MRNFC AND RVPM_ADM_DTE = MAXADMDTE) , MAXFC AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.MRNFC, MAXADMDTE, INSURANCE FROM FC A JOIN (SELECT MRNFC, MAX(MAXADMDTE) AS MAXMAXADMDTE FROM FC GROUP BY MRNFC) AS X ON A.MRNFC = X.MRNFC AND MAXADMDTE = MAXMAXADMDTE) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, OP, IP, MAXAGE AS AGE, PT_SEX AS GENDER, R.AV_DESC AS RACE, E.AV_DESC AS ETHNIC, INSURANCE, PT_COUNTRY, PT_STATE , CASE WHEN ZC_COUNTY IN ('Kings', 'Queens', 'Bronx', 'New York', 'Richmond') THEN ZC_COUNTY ELSE '' END AS NY_BORO FROM ALLPTS LEFT JOIN OPS ON MRN = OP_MRN LEFT JOIN IPS ON MRN = IP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN AND PT_MRN <> '' LEFT JOIN PTAGE ON MRN = MRNAGE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.ZIPCODE ON ZC_ZIP = SUBSTR(PT_ZIP_CD, 1, 5) LEFT JOIN MAXFC ON MRN = MRNFC ;

prompt: I am looking for serial chemo exposures for a cohort of patients (data was previously requested for this project under dataline proejct ski18052)
completion: WITH DIAGNOSIS_0 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_DEID, SUBJECT_ID, ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC FROM (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, TRIM(ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, TRIM(ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE") || '-' || TRIM(ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG" AS ICD_CODE_DESC ON "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE ON "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_DATE_ID" = DIAGNOSIS_DATE."DT_DATE_ID" GROUP BY "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID", CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID") AS VARCHAR), ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE", ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC") WHERE ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE IN ('198.81', 'C44.511', 'C50.011', 'C50.012', 'C50.019', 'C50.021', 'C50.022', 'C50.121', 'C50.122', 'C50.211', 'C50.212', 'C50.219', 'C50.221', 'C50.222', 'C50.321', 'C50.322', 'C50.421', 'C50.422', 'C50.521', 'C50.522', 'C50.622', 'C50.811', 'C50.812', 'C50.819', 'C50.821', 'C50.822', 'C50.911', 'C50.912', 'C50.919', 'C50.921', 'C50.922', 'C50.929', 'C79.81')), ANTINEOPLASTICS_1 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX"."APR_ORDER_SOURCE_ID") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX"."APR_MRN") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC"."CDG_CHEMO_FLAG" AS CHEMO_FLAG_CHEMO, "IDB"."CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC"."CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME" AS CHEMO_DRUG_NAME FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX"."APR_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC" ON "IDB"."ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX"."APR_GENERIC_NAME" = "IDB"."CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC"."CDG_GENERIC_NAME" WHERE "IDB"."CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC"."CDG_CHEMO_FLAG" = 'Y' AND "IDB"."CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC"."CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME" IN ('BR96-DOXORUBICIN', 'CYCLOPHOSPHAMIDE', 'DOXORUBICIN', 'DOXORUBICIN LIPOSOMAL', 'INDOXIMOD', 'PACLITAXEL', 'PACLITAXEL PROTEIN-BOUND')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_0 INTERSECT SELECT ANTINEOPLASTICS_1.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM ANTINEOPLASTICS_1)), COHORT_DIAGNOSIS AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, DIAGNOSIS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_0)), COHORT_ANTINEOPLASTICS AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT ANTINEOPLASTICS_1.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, ANTINEOPLASTICS_1.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM ANTINEOPLASTICS_1)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_PT_DEID, COHORT_ANTINEOPLASTICS.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_ANTINEOPLASTICS_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_ANTINEOPLASTICS.PT_DEID AS COHORT_ANTINEOPLASTICS_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_DIAGNOSIS ON COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_ANTINEOPLASTICS ON COHORT_ANTINEOPLASTICS.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), ANTINEOPLASTICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX"."APR_ORDER_SOURCE_ID") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX"."APR_MRN") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC"."CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME" AS CHEMO_DRUG_NAME, "IDB"."CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC"."CDG_DRUG_TYPE" AS CHEMO_DRUG_TYPE, "IDB"."ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX"."APR_START_DTE" AS CHEMO_START_DATE, "IDB"."ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX"."APR_END_DTE" AS CHEMO_END_DATE, "IDB"."ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX"."APR_ORD_RX_TYPE" AS CHEMO_RX_TYPE, "IDB"."CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC"."CDG_CHEMO_FLAG" AS CHEMO_FLAG_CHEMO FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX"."APR_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC" ON "IDB"."ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX"."APR_GENERIC_NAME" = "IDB"."CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC"."CDG_GENERIC_NAME"), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, ANTINEOPLASTICS_COLUMNS.CHEMO_DRUG_NAME AS CHEMO_DRUG_NAME, ANTINEOPLASTICS_COLUMNS.CHEMO_DRUG_TYPE AS CHEMO_DRUG_TYPE, ANTINEOPLASTICS_COLUMNS.CHEMO_START_DATE AS CHEMO_START_DATE, ANTINEOPLASTICS_COLUMNS.CHEMO_END_DATE AS CHEMO_END_DATE, ANTINEOPLASTICS_COLUMNS.CHEMO_RX_TYPE AS CHEMO_RX_TYPE, ANTINEOPLASTICS_COLUMNS.CHEMO_FLAG_CHEMO AS CHEMO_FLAG_CHEMO FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN ANTINEOPLASTICS_COLUMNS ON ANTINEOPLASTICS_COLUMNS.SUBJECT_ID = KEYS.COHORT_ANTINEOPLASTICS_SUBJECT_ID LEFT OUTER CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = 'NRS' GROUP BY RFL_MRN) SELECT NRS.*, RFL1_SVC, RFL1_APPT_MADE_DTE, RFL1_VST_DATE, DAYS_TO_RFL1, RFL2_SVC, RFL2_APPT_MADE_DTE, RFL2_VST_DATE, DAYS_TO_RFL2 , RFL3_SVC, RFL3_APPT_MADE_DTE, RFL3_VST_DATE, DAYS_TO_RFL3 FROM NRS JOIN RFLFNL ON RFL_MRN = NRS_MRN LEFT JOIN FU ON RFL_MRN = FU_MRN WHERE FU_MRN IS NULL

prompt: Provide a weekly list of all newly diagnosed gynecologic cancer patients.
completion: WITH NEWVISIT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CRE_RES_NAME RESOURCE, CRE_RES_TYP, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_EXT_NAME, CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPARTMENT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 GROUP FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 14 DAY AND CURRENT date AND(CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%GYN%' ), SURG AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM NEWVISIT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON CPE_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSE_SURG_DTE >CPE_ENC_DTE ), CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE FROM NEWVISIT JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON CPE_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE APR_START_DTE > CPE_ENC_DTE ) , MRI AS (SELECT B.CPE_MRN, B.CPE_ENC_DTE, B.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, R.CRE_RES_NAME RESOURCE, R.CRE_RES_TYP, J.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, J.CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, J.CVT_EXT_NAME, D.CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPARTMENT, D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 GROUP FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER B JOIN NEWVISIT V ON V.CPE_MRN = B.CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT D ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE J ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE B.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND J.CVT_EXT_NAME LIKE 'MRI%' AND D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RAD' ) SELECT DISTINCT V.CPE_MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, V.CPE_ENC_DTE FIRST_VIS_DATE , C.CPE_ENC_DTE MRI_DTE, C.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS VISIT_STS , C.RESOURCE, C.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME VISIT_TYPE FROM NEWVISIT V LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN MRI C ON V.CPE_MRN = C.CPE_MRN WHERE V.CPE_MRN NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN FROM SURG) AND V.CPE_MRN NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM CHEMO) ;

prompt: Provide a weekly list of patients scheduled for MIBG injection and scans in Nuclear Medicine Clinic
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN=PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND (CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE 'NUCLEAR%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE 'NUC MED%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE 'NM CLINIC%') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date + 7 DAYS AND CURRENT date + 14 DAYS ), LAST_MIBG AS (SELECT CPE_MRN LST_MRN, MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) LST_ENC_DTE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN=CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('NM MIBG SCAN 24HRS I123', 'NM MIBG 123 Injection') AND CPE_ENC_DTE < CURRENT date GROUP BY CPE_MRN) SELECT "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_SEX "Sex", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE, VARCHAR_FORMAT(CPE_APPT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "Appt Date", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", VARCHAR_FORMAT(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') "Last Appointment Date", VARCHAR_FORMAT(PLA_LST_SURG_DTE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') "Last Surgery Date", VARCHAR_FORMAT(PLA_LST_PED_APPT_DTE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') "Last PED Appointment Date", VARCHAR_FORMAT(LST_ENC_DTE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') "Last MIBG Scan Date", TRIM(A.CPAN_NOTE) "Note Line 1", TRIM(B.CPAN_NOTE) "Note Line 2", TRIM(C.CPAN_NOTE) "Note Line 3" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN=CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN=PT_MRN LEFT JOIN LAST_MIBG ON LST_MRN=MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES A ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = A.CPAN_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = A.CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND A.CPAN_LINE_NO = 1 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES B ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = B.CPAN_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = B.CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND B.CPAN_LINE_NO = 2 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES C ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = C.CPAN_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = C.CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND C.CPAN_LINE_NO = 3 WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('NM MIBG SCAN 24HRS I123', 'NM MIBG 123 Injection') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date + 7 DAYS AND CURRENT date + 14 DAYS ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT, PT_LAST_NAME

prompt: Provide a Darwin cohort of patients with select BRAF mutations and metastatic solid tumor diagnosis.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') ) , DT_2_1 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V EX ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = EX.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AND EX.GENE IN ('BRAF') AND EX.AA_CHANGE like 'V600%' JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site') T WHERE 1=1 AND CASE WHEN LOWER(METASTASIS_SITE) IN ('null', 'not available', 'not applicable') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END = 1 AND (INC.GENE IN ('BRAF') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('BRAF')) AND INC.AA_CHANGE IN ('P367L', 'P367S', 'G464V', 'G464E', 'G469A', 'G469V', 'G469R', 'L485W', 'N486_A489delinsK', 'N486_P490del', 'E586K', 'L597Q', 'L597R', 'L597S', 'L597V', 'T599TT', 'T599TS', 'T599I', 'T599K', 'K601E', 'K601N', 'K601T', 'K601_S602delinsNT') AND EX.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID IS NULL ) , DT_2_2 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V EX ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = EX.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AND EX.GENE IN ('BRAF') AND EX.AA_CHANGE like 'V600%' JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site') T WHERE 1=1 AND CASE WHEN LOWER(METASTASIS_SITE) IN ('null', 'not available', 'not applicable') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END = 1 AND (INC.GENE IN ('BRAF') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('BRAF')) AND LOWER(INC.SEARCH_HIT2) like LOWER('%kina%') AND EX.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID IS NULL ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT P_ID FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2_1 UNION ALL SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2_2 ))) SELECT * FROM DEID

prompt: Design a daily burst to the GI oncology clinics of all patients with an appointment scheduled that day and their Patient Values Assessment survey responses.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT EPI_MRN, STRIP(EPI_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(EPI_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", A.EA_ASSESS_ID AS "Assessment ID", EA_SURV_ID AS "Survery ID", STRIP(ES_SURV_NAME) AS "Survey Name", STRIP(EAS_ASSESS_STS) AS "Assessment Status", STRIP(EC_COHORT_DESC) AS "Cohort Description", DATE(EA_SUBM_DT) AS "Submission Date", DATE(EA_ASSIGN_DT) AS "Assignment Date", DATE(EA_EXPIRY_DT) AS "Expiry Date" FROM IDB.EF_PATIENT_INFO PT JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT A ON A.EA_PT_INFO_ID = PT.EPI_PT_INFO_ID JOIN IDB.EF_SURVEY S ON A.EA_SURV_ID = S.ES_SURV_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT_DTL AD ON A.EA_ASSESS_DTL_ID = AD.EAD_ASSESS_DTL_ID JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT_STS AS STS ON A.EA_STS_ID = STS.EAS_ASSESS_STS_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_SCHEDULING_RULE B ON ESR_SCHED_RULE_ID = EA_SCHED_RULE_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_COHORT C ON ESR_COHORT_ID = EC_COHORT_ID WHERE 1=1 AND EA_SURV_ID = '147' AND DATE(EA_ASSIGN_DT) >= '2023-07-24' ) , Y AS (SELECT EPI_MRN, "Name", "Submission Date", "Assignment Date", "Expiry Date", EF_SUBMISSION_DT, EF_FORM_ID, "Survery ID", "Survey Name", "Assessment ID", "Assessment Status", "Cohort Description", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'acknowledgement' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "acknowledgement", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'you_as_a_person' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "you_as_a_person", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'threethings_hope' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "threethings_hope", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'valuesworksheet_strength' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "valuesworksheet_strength", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'critical_abilities' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "critical_abilities", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'values_goals_wishes' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "values_goals_wishes", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'patientvalues_livingwell' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "patientvalues_livingwell", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'concerns_you_most' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "concerns_you_most" FROM X LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM ON EF_FORM_EXTERNAL_ID = "Assessment ID" LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY EPI_MRN, "Name", "Submission Date", "Assignment Date", "Expiry Date", EF_SUBMISSION_DT, EF_FORM_ID, "Survery ID", "Survey Name", "Assessment ID", "Assessment Status", "Cohort Description" ) , CPE AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(CPE_MRN) AS MRN, "Name", STRIP(CPP_PT_NAME) AS "Name2", CASE WHEN STRIP(CPE_MRN) = '' AND "Name" <> '' AND "Name" <> ',' THEN "Name" WHEN STRIP(CPE_MRN) = '' AND("Name" = '' OR "Name" = ',') THEN STRIP(CPP_PT_NAME) WHEN STRIP(CPE_MRN) <> '' AND "Name" <> '' AND "Name" <> ',' THEN "Name" || ' (' || STRIP(CPE_MRN) || ')' WHEN STRIP(CPE_MRN) <> '' AND("Name" = '' OR "Name" = ',') THEN STRIP(CPP_PT_NAME) || ' (' || STRIP(CPE_MRN) || ')' END AS "Name (MRN)", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS "Appt Time", STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Provider Name", STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Visit Type", "Submission Date", "Survery ID", "Survey Name", "Assessment ID", "Assessment Status", "Cohort Description", STRIP("acknowledgement") AS "Acknowledgement", STRIP("you_as_a_person") AS "What should I know about you as a person (not only as a patient) to take best care of you?", STRIP("threethings_hope") AS "Three things you hope for at this time in your life", STRIP("valuesworksheet_strength") AS "Facing cancer, what gives you strength", STRIP("critical_abilities") AS "Critical abilities in your life that you can't imagine living without", STRIP("values_goals_wishes") AS "Have you discussed values, goals and wishes with the person making decisions for you if unable to yourself", STRIP("patientvalues_livingwell") AS "What does living well mean at this time in your life", STRIP("concerns_you_most") AS "What concerns you the most" FROM Y JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON EPI_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPP_PRK = CPE_PRK JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE = CURRENT date AND CRE_RES_NAME IN ('EPSTEIN, ANDREW SAUL', 'REIDY, DIANE', 'RAJ, NITYA PRABHAKAR') ) SELECT * FROM CPE WHERE "Assessment Status" = 'Completed'

prompt: These reports were not received
completion: WITH HIM AS (SELECT 'him' SRC_NAME, MRN, DOS, SVC, SITE, 'n/a' FMS_CDM, 'n/a' RMS_SVCCD, 'n/a' SVC_DESC, QTY, CG_CD, 'n/a' DX1, 'n/a' DX2, 'n/a' DX3, 'n/a' DX4, 'n/a' DX5, HCPCS, MOD1, MOD2, MOD3, MOD4, MOD5, 'n/a' OCC1, CAST(NULL AS date) OCC1_DTE, 'n/a' OCC2, CAST(NULL AS date) OCC2_DTE, 'n/a' OCC3, CAST(NULL AS date) OCC3_DTE, CAST(NULL AS date) POSTDTE, 'n/a' ALERT FROM IDCIC.HIMECC_HIM_D_PY WHERE DOS >= CURRENT date - 30 DAY ), PBD AS (SELECT 'pbd' SRC_NAME, MRN, DOS, SVC, SITE, 'n/a' FMS_CDM, 'n/a' RMS_SVCCD, SVC_DESC, QTY, CG_CD, DX1, DX2, DX3, DX4, DX5, HCPCS, MOD1, MOD2, MOD3, MOD4, MOD5, 'n/a' OCC1, CAST(NULL AS date) OCC1_DTE, 'n/a' OCC2, CAST(NULL AS date) OCC2_DTE, 'n/a' OCC3, CAST(NULL AS date) OCC3_DTE, CAST(NULL AS date) POSTDTE, 'n/a' ALERT FROM IDCIC.HIMECC_PBD_D_PY WHERE DOS >= CURRENT date - 30 DAY ), CTC_CLSF AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, CC_VISIT_DTE, CRH_CTC_CNG_USER, CC_CLSF_CD FROM HIM LEFT JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = MRN AND DOS = CC_VISIT_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.CTC_VISIT ON CC_VISIT_ID = CV_VISIT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CTC_REC_HX ON CRH_VISIT_ID = CV_VISIT_ID WHERE CRH_CTC_CNG_USER IS NOT NULL AND CC_CLSF_CD NOT LIKE '%.%' AND LENGTH(TRIM(CC_CLSF_CD)) = 5 ) , USERS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CU_USER USER_ID, MAX(CU_LAST_NAME) CU_LAST_NAME, MAX(CU_FIRST_NAME) CU_FIRST_NAME, MAX(CU_EMAIL_ADDR) CODER_ID FROM IDB.CTC_USERS GROUP BY CU_USER) SELECT HIM.*, CU_LAST_NAME, CU_FIRST_NAME, CODER_ID FROM HIM JOIN PBD ON HIM.MRN = PBD.MRN AND HIM.DOS = PBD.DOS AND HIM.HCPCS = PBD.HCPCS LEFT JOIN CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = HIM.MRN AND HIM.DOS = CC_VISIT_DTE AND HIM.HCPCS = CC_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN USERS ON USER_ID=CRH_CTC_CNG_USER UNION SELECT PBD.*, 'n/a' CU_LAST_NAME, 'n/a' CU_FIRST_NAME, 'n/a' CODER_ID FROM PBD JOIN HIM ON HIM.MRN = PBD.MRN AND HIM.DOS = PBD.DOS AND HIM.HCPCS = PBD.HCPCS ORDER BY DOS, MRN, HCPCS, QTY ;

prompt: Admissions of Pediatric patients from 2019 to 2021
completion: SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN AS IP_MRN, 'IP' AS IP, YEAR (VIS_ADM_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS ADMIT_AGE, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE , VIS_HOSP_SVC, HOSP_SVC_DESC, ADM_DR_NAME , VIS_NURS_STA, NURS_STA_DESC, VIS_BED FROM IDB.VISIT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON VIS_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND (YEAR (VIS_ADM_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 18 OR VIS_ADM_DR_NO IN ('015297', '021428', '006007'))

prompt: Provide a daily email if a patient has had an ICU length of stay >27 days. No email needed if no patient meets qualifications.
completion: WITH T1 AS (SELECT VIS_VISIT_ID, VIS_MRN , TRIM(UC_BED) AS BED , TRIM(SUBSTR(LTRIM(UC_BED), 1, CASE WHEN LOCATE('_', UC_BED) > 0 THEN LOCATE('_', UC_BED) - 1 WHEN LOCATE(' ', LTRIM(UC_BED)) > 0 THEN LOCATE(' ', LTRIM(UC_BED)) - 1 ELSE LENGTH(TRIM(UC_BED)) END)) AS ROOM , TIMESTAMP(A.UC_TRANSFER_DTE, A.UC_TRANSFER_TME) AS TRANS_DT , UC_TRANSFER_DTE AS TRANS_DTE , COALESCE(TIMESTAMP(A.UC_END_DTE, A.UC_END_TME), TIMESTAMP(CURRENT date,'00:00:00')) AS END_DT , COALESCE(UC_END_DTE, CURRENT date) AS END_DTE , VIS_ADM_DTE , COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DTE, CURRENT date) DSCH_DTE FROM IDB.VISIT V JOIN IDB.UNIFIED_CENSUS A ON V.VIS_VISIT_ID = A.UC_VISIT_ID AND A.UC_TRANSFER_DTE <= CURRENT_DATE WHERE (VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' OR VIS_PATIENT_TYPE IN ('OAXR', 'OUCO')) AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND UC_BED <> '' AND (VIS_DSCH_DTE IS NULL) ) , DT AS (SELECT T1.* , CASE WHEN BED like 'ICU%' OR LOCATE('OR_', BED) > 0 OR LOCATE('IR_', BED) > 0 OR LOCATE('CIGI_', BED) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IS_ICU , TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(END_DT - TRANS_DT)) MINS_IN_ROOM FROM T1 WHERE 1=1 AND END_DTE = CURRENT date ) , LL AS (SELECT DT1.VIS_VISIT_ID, DT1.VIS_MRN , DT1.TRANS_DT AS IN_DT, DT1.END_DT AS OUT_DT , LAG(END_DT) OVER (PARTITION BY VIS_VISIT_ID ORDER BY TRANS_DT) LAG , LEAD(TRANS_DT) OVER (PARTITION BY VIS_VISIT_ID ORDER BY TRANS_DT) LEAD , IS_ICU, ROOM FROM DT DT1 WHERE IS_ICU = 1 ) , INS AS (SELECT RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY VIS_VISIT_ID ORDER BY TIMESTAMP(IN_DT)) RN , LL.* FROM LL WHERE (LL.LAG IS NULL OR LL.LAG <> LL.IN_DT) ) , OUTS AS (SELECT RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY VIS_VISIT_ID ORDER BY TIMESTAMP(IN_DT)) RN , LL.* FROM LL WHERE (LL.LEAD IS NULL OR LL.LEAD <> LL.OUT_DT) ) , ROOM_STAYS AS (SELECT INS.VIS_VISIT_ID, INS.VIS_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, INS.IN_DT, OUTS.OUT_DT, INS.ROOM ROOM_FIRST, OUTS.ROOM ROOM_LAST , CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(8, CHAR(OUTS.OUT_DT - INS.IN_DT)) AS decimal) / 24 AS decimal) DAYS_IN_ICU FROM INS JOIN OUTS ON INS.VIS_VISIT_ID = OUTS.VIS_VISIT_ID AND INS.RN = OUTS.RN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = INS.VIS_MRN) SELECT * FROM ROOM_STAYS WHERE DAYS_IN_ICU > 27 AND MOD(DAYS_IN_ICU, 28) = 0 ;

prompt: Patients seen by pre-surgical testing and referred to medical consult. 2018 and 2019.
completion: WITH PST AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of birth", PT_ADDR1 "Patient address", PT_CITY "Patient city", PT_STATE "Patient state", PT_ZIP_CD "Patient zip code", PT_COUNTRY "Patient country", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR AS "Visit type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PST' ), CLINDOC AS (SELECT CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Provider", CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", CDD_MRN AS "MRN", CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Referral info" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Screening Note - Pre-Surgical' AND CDO_SECTION = 'Referred To' AND (CDO_ITEM_NAME like '%Medical%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT like '%Medical%') ) SELECT PST."MRN", "Date of birth", "Patient address", "Patient city", "Patient state", "Patient zip code", "Patient country", "Appt Date", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit type", "Document Name", "Provider", "Service Date", "Referral info" FROM PST LEFT JOIN CLINDOC ON PST.MRN = CLINDOC.MRN AND "Appt Date" = "Service Date" WHERE "Document Name" IS NOT NULL ;

prompt: Provide a list of all the COVID-19 test requests and results for pediatric patients and their caregivers.
completion: WITH PEDS_R AS (SELECT CPE_MRN PEDS_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE APPT_DATE, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS STATUS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1=1 AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = ('PED') OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = ('PED') OR CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'ORTHOPEDICS 1275-9') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' UNION SELECT VIS_MRN PEDS_MRN, VIS_ADM_DTE APPT_DATE, 'Inpatient' STATUS FROM IDB.VISIT WHERE VIS_HOSP_SVC IN ('PDB', 'PDG', 'PDP', 'PDR', 'PDU', 'PED', 'PDS') AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') ) , PEDS AS (SELECT PEDS_MRN, STATUS FROM (SELECT PEDS_MRN, STATUS, APPT_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PEDS_MRN ORDER BY APPT_DATE DESC) RN FROM PEDS_R) WHERE RN = 1 ) , ORD AS (SELECT PEDS_MRN, STATUS, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OUD_USER_DI_CD, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, OSTS_STS_DESC, OCV_CURR_LOC LOCATION FROM PEDS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON PEDS_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Micro-COVID Questions', 'Micro-COVID Screening', 'LBRZ_COVID_PatientType', 'LBRZ_CMICRO_COVID', 'LBRZ_COVID_Indicator', 'Lab_Specimen Collected On', 'Micro-COVID Surveillance', 'LBRZ_SREQ') WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE = CURRENT date - 1 DAY AND OO_ORD_NAME IN ('COVID-19 antiBODY Qualitative IgG', 'COVID-19 Blood Collection', 'COVID-19 Other Patient Type', 'COVID-19 Patient Type', 'COVID-19 Qualitative RNA', 'COVID-19 Rapid Qualitative RNA', 'COVID-19 Rapid Qualitative RNA Result', 'COVID-19 Rapid Qualitative RNA Specimen Type', 'COVID-19 RNA Result', 'COVID-19 Screening (NO)', 'COVID-19 Specimen Type') ) , ORD_PIVOT AS (SELECT PEDS_MRN, STATUS, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OSTS_STS_DESC, LOCATION, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Micro-COVID Questions' AND LOWER(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) like '%within the last 14 days patient has been in close contact with a person confirmed to have novel coronavirus%' THEN 'Y' END) "14 days close contact", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Micro-COVID Questions' AND LOWER(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) like '%currently patient has fever, cough, sob, body aches and/or chills%' THEN 'Y' END) "Current Fever/Cough/SOB/Body Aches/Chills", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Micro-COVID Screening' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) "Pre-screening", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'LBRZ_COVID_PatientType' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) "Patient Type", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'LBRZ_CMICRO_COVID' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) "Specimen Desc", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'LBRZ_COVID_Indicator' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) "Isolation Indicator", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Lab_Specimen Collected On' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) "Specimen collected on date", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Micro-COVID Surveillance' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) "Surveillance Type", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'LBRZ_SREQ' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) "Special Requests" FROM ORD GROUP BY PEDS_MRN, STATUS, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OSTS_STS_DESC, LOCATION) , CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, LISTAGG(CHAR(TM_DX_DTE) || ': ' || TRIM(TM_SITE_CD) || ' ' || TRIM(S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) || ' ' || TRIM(TM_HIST_CD) || ' ' || TRIM(H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK), CHR(13)||CHR(10)) TUMOR FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PEDS_MRN FROM ORD_PIVOT) JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON PEDS_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') GROUP BY TM_MRN ) , LAST_APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT DESC) RN FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PEDS_MRN FROM ORD_PIVOT) JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PEDS_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE H ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' ) SELECT PEDS_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, STATUS, PT_PLACE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_SEX GENDER, YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) CURRENT_AGE, TUMOR, CRE_RES_NAME "MD last seen by", OO_ORD_NAME ORDER_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE ORDER_SIGNIFICANT_DATE, LOCATION, OSTS_STS_DESC ORDER_STATUS, "14 days close contact", "Current Fever/Cough/SOB/Body Aches/Chills", "Pre-screening", "Patient Type", "Specimen Desc", "Isolation Indicator", "Specimen collected on date", "Surveillance Type", "Special Requests", COR_ABNORMALITY_CODE "Abnormality Code", L.COR_RESULT_TEXT "Result" FROM ORD_PIVOT OP JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PEDS_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.COVID19_ORDER_AND_RESULT L ON PEDS_MRN = COR_MRN AND OO_ORD_GUID = COR_ORDER_GUID LEFT JOIN CDB ON PEDS_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN LAST_APPT ON PEDS_MRN = CPE_MRN AND RN = 1 WHERE COALESCE(COR_PATIENT_TYPE, '') <> 'Employee' ORDER BY 1, 7

prompt: Provide data on Hodgkin lymphoma patients with a CT coronary angiogram performed here, a carotid ultrasound performed here, or both.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7') AND TM_HIST_CD BETWEEN 'M9650/3' AND 'M9669/3' AND TM_HIST_CD <> 'M9659/3' UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD like '201%' AND CC_CLSF_CD <> '201.4' ) SELECT MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", PT_SEX AS "Sex", R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", PBD_SVC_DTE AS "Procedure Date", PBC_CPT_CD AS "CPT Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "CPT Description" FROM CTE JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON MRN = PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('0145T', '75571', '75572', '75573', '75574', '93880', '93882')

VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_TUMOR_SEQ") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_DX_DTE") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_DX_DTE" AS DX_TR_DX_DATE, "IDB"."ALLOWVALS"."AV_DESC" AS DX_TR_CASE_STATUS, TRIM("IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_HIST_CD") || ' - ' || TRIM(CLM_HIST."CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK") AS DX_TR_HISTOLOGY FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_TR_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_TR_0)), COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_TR_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, DIAGNOSIS_TR_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_TR_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR_SUBJECT_ID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML" AS DMP_ID_TBL ON DMP_ID_TBL."PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_SEX ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_SEX" = ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_ELEMENT" = 'SEX' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_RACE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_RACE" = ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_ELEMENT" = 'RACE' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_PT_ETHNICITY" = ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_ELEMENT" = 'PT_ETHNICITY' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB".PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE."PLA_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB".PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = LAST_CONTACT_DATE."PLA_MRN") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DMP_ID AS DMP_ID, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_NAME AS PT_NAME, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.SEX AS SEX, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.VITAL_STATS AS VITAL_STATUS, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_DEATH AS DATE_OF_DEATH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.RACE AS RACE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.ETHNICITY AS ETHNICITY, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.LAST_CONTACT_DATE AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID; WITH DIAGNOSIS_TR_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" ON "IDB"."ALLOWVALS"."AV_CODE" = "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_CASE_STS" AND "IDB"."ALLOWVALS"."AV_ELEMENT" = 'CASE_STS' JOIN "IDB"."CLM" AS CLM_HIST ON CLM_HIST."CLM_CLSF_CD" = "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_HIST_CD" WHERE "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_DX_DTE" BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '2023-02-07' AND "IDB"."ALLOWVALS"."AV_DESC" IN ('COMPLETED', 'CONSULT ONLY', 'INCOMPLETE', 'NON-INDEX', 'PATHOLOGY ONLY') AND "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_HIST_CD" IN ('M9243/3')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_TR_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_TR_0)), COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_TR_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, DIAGNOSIS_TR_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_TR_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID,
