DEMO_AGE."PT_BIRTH_DTE") AS AGE_AT_CANCER_DIAGNOSIS_DATE FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" ON "IDB"."ALLOWVALS"."AV_CODE" = "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_CASE_STS" AND "IDB"."ALLOWVALS"."AV_ELEMENT" = 'CASE_STS' JOIN "IDB"."CLM" AS CLM_SITE ON CLM_SITE."CLM_CLSF_CD" = "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_SITE_CD" JOIN "IDB"."CLM" AS CLM_HIST ON CLM_HIST."CLM_CLSF_CD" = "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_HIST_CD" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" AS DEMO_AGE ON "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_MRN" = DEMO_AGE."PT_MRN") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, DIAGNOSIS_TR_COLUMNS.DX_TR_CASE_STATUS AS DX_TR_CASE_STATUS, DIAGNOSIS_TR_COLUMNS.DX_TR_STAGE AS DX_TR_STAGE, DIAGNOSIS_TR_COLUMNS.DX_TR_SITE AS DX_TR_SITE, DIAGNOSIS_TR_COLUMNS.DX_TR_HISTOLOGY AS DX_TR_HISTOLOGY, DIAGNOSIS_TR_COLUMNS.DX_TR_DX_DATE AS DX_TR_DX_DATE, DIAGNOSIS_TR_COLUMNS.AGE_AT_CANCER_DIAGNOSIS_DATE AS AGE_AT_CANCER_DIAGNOSIS_DATE FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID LEFT OUTER JOIN DIAGNOSIS_TR_COLUMNS ON DIAGNOSIS_TR_COLUMNS.SUBJECT_ID = KEYS.COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR_SUBJECT_ID;

prompt: Provide a report on patients who have received two pelvic radiation courses at MSK for rectal or anal cancer.
completion: WITH PT AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE PT_MRN IN () ) , RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN AS MRN, DOB, DOD, LAST_FU_DATE, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RTC_TX_MRN ORDER BY RTC_TX_START_DTE DESC, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM PT JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN WHERE UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) like '%PEL%' OR RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME IN ('Presacral BID', 'RECT_BOOST', 'RECT_REV_53_', 'RECTAL', 'Rectum', 'RECTUM', 'Rectum CD', 'RECTUM CD', 'Rectum ReTx', 'Rectum Retxt', 'RECTUM_15_', 'RECTUM_16_', 'RECTUM_28_', 'RECTUM_36_', 'RECTUM_4_', 'RECTUM_BOOST', 'Rectum_CD', 'RECTUM_CD', 'RECTUM_D_28_', 'rectum_FiF', 'Rectum_Groin', 'RECTUM_NO_29_', 'RECTUM_NODES', 'RETUM_RETX', 'RGORIN + LGORIN', 'SACRUM', 'SACRUM5_') ) , AGE AS (SELECT MRN, YEAR(RTC_TX_START_DTE - DOB) AS AGE_LAST_RT FROM (SELECT MRN, RTC_TX_START_DTE, DOB FROM RT WHERE RN = 1) A1) , X AS (SELECT RT.MRN, DOB, AGE_LAST_RT, DOD, LAST_FU_DATE, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM RT JOIN AGE ON RT.MRN = AGE.MRN) SELECT * FROM X , IBD AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS INIT_EFF_DATE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND (CC_CLSF_CD like 'K50%' OR CC_CLSF_CD like 'K51%' OR CC_CLSF_CD like '555%' OR CC_CLSF_CD like '556%' OR CC_CLSF_CD like '558%') AND CC_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) ) , APR AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_CHEMO_FLAG, CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG, CDG_TARGETED_FLAG FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE(CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' OR CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG = 'Y' OR CDG_TARGETED_FLAG = 'Y') AND APR_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X)) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, GENE, RESULT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE PT_MRN IN () AND(GENE like '%MMR%' OR GENE like '%BRAF%' OR GENE like '%KRAS%')

prompt: Provide ad hoc report with the number of distinct patients who met criteria of OPC3837 project., and their visit dates with specific MDs from 1/1 to 5/27/2011.
completion: SELECT BMT_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME , APPT_DTE, APPT_MD, APPT_MD_NAME FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN AS BMT_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DTE , CPE_VST_RES_ID AS APPT_MD, CRE_RES_NAME AS APPT_MD_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2011-01-01' AND '2011-05-27' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND (CPE_VST_RES_ID = '000828' OR CPE_VST_RES_ID='002212' OR CPE_VST_RES_ID='002352' OR CPE_VST_RES_ID='002972' OR CPE_VST_RES_ID='009894' OR CPE_VST_RES_ID='012286' OR CPE_VST_RES_ID='013755' OR CPE_VST_RES_ID='015404' OR CPE_VST_RES_ID= '015552' OR CPE_VST_RES_ID= '015560' OR CPE_VST_RES_ID='015255') ) AS X JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF AS B ON BMT_MRN = CC_MRN AND CC_CLSF_TYPE='PC' AND(CC_CLSF_CD = '41.02' OR CC_CLSF_CD = '41.03' OR CC_CLSF_CD = '41.05' OR CC_CLSF_CD = '41.06' OR CC_CLSF_CD = '41.08' OR CC_CLSF_CD = '41.00') AND CC_EFF_DTE <= APPT_DTE - 1 YEAR AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = BMT_MRN

prompt: Patients who signed 06-107 and underwent salpingectomy with or without oral contraceptives
completion: WITH PROTOCOL AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON AC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' AND AC_NON_MSK_INST = '' AND PT_SEX = 'F' ) , CONTRACEPTIVES AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS ICD_CODING_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESCRIPTION FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN PROTOCOL ON AC_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('Z30', 'V25') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", SSE_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD "CPT Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC "CPT Description", ICD_CODING_DTE "ICD Coding Date", ICD_CODE "ICD Code", ICD_DESCRIPTION "ICD Description" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN PROTOCOL ON SSE_MRN = AC_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN CONTRACEPTIVES ON SSE_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('58661', '56307', '58720', '58700')

prompt: Provide follow-up data for 96-051 patients.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PRO_IRB_NO" AS "IRB Number", "t3"."PLA_LAST_APPT_YEAR" AS "Last Appointment Year", "t3"."PLA_LAST_DSCH_YEAR" AS "Last Inpatient Discharge Year", "t4"."PT_DEATH_YEAR" AS "Deceased Year" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ACCRUALS" "t5" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PROTOCOL" "t2" ON "t5"."AC_PROTOCOL_ID" = "t2"."PRO_PROTOCOL_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY" "t3" ON "t4"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE "t2"."PRO_IRB_NO" = '96-051'

prompt: Identify all patients with the diagnosis of peritoneal carcinomatosis and colorectal cancer from 01-01-93 to 02-16-09.
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT TEXTTABLE.*, CONTAINS("PRPT_DEID_REPORT", '("carcinomatosis%" & "peritoneal%")') AS "HitCol1" FROM "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" TEXTTABLE) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."DT_DTE" AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", "t3"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t3"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Desc", "t3"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t3"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Desc", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "ICD-9 Diagnosis Date", "t5"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-9 Code", "t5"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-9 MSK code description", "t6"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t6"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t6"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t6"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t6"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_ICDO_DIAGNOSIS_V" "t3" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DATE" "t2" ON "t3"."PDX_DX_DATE_ID" = "t2"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t7" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DATE" "t4" ON "t7"."PDX_DX_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICD9_V" "t5" ON "t7"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t5"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t6" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t8" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE ("t3"."ICSC_SITE_CD" IN ('C182', 'C183', 'C184', 'C185', 'C186', 'C187', 'C188', 'C189', 'C199', 'C209', 'C218') AND ((("t7"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" IN (5856) AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '1993-1-1' AND '2009-2-16') OR "t8"."HitCol1" <> 0) AND "t2"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '1993-1-1' AND '2009-2-16'))

prompt: Provide IMPACT testing results for patients previously identified in report SKI18291.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_DEATH_DTE "Death Date", PLA_LST_APPT_DTE "Last Appt", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", ACD_CONS_DTE "Consent Date", TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PRIMARY_SITE, PART_DESCRIPTION, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, GENE, GENE2, LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, NUCLEOTIDE, ABERRATIONTYPE, FOLD_CHANGE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON ACD_MRN = CPE_MRN AND ACD_IRB_NO = '12-245' LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = CPE_MRN AND (TM_SITE_CD like 'C18%' OR TM_SITE_CD like 'C19%' OR TM_SITE_CD like 'C20%') LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V ON PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH 'tumor_type_name', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'primary_site', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH 'part_description') T WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'COL' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') AND PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT'

prompt: Modify MED7244 to include patients with a breast cancer diagnosis on a pathology report
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_CODE)) DXCC_ICD_CODE, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC)) DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_CODE)) || ' - ' || LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC)) AS DXCC_CODE_AND_MSK_DESC, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_NATIONAL_DESC)) DXCC_ICD_NATIONAL_DESC, DXCC_DESC_LONG, CASE WHEN DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '196' AND '196.99' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '197' AND '197.99' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '198' AND '198.99' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS DXCC_METS_INDICATOR, DXCC_CREATED_DT, DXCC_CREATED_BY, DXCC_MODIFIED_DT FROM DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG WHERE DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD9' ), "cte2" AS (SELECT * FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES WHERE ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' ), "cte3" AS (SELECT EDC_DEPT_ABBREV, EDC_DEPT_DESC FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG WHERE EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS') , CADENCE AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" PID, "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Encounter Date", "t4"."ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR" AS "Visit Type Abbrev", "t5"."ENDP_DEPT_NAME" AS "Department Name", "t6"."ENR_RES_NAME" AS "Primary Resource Name", "t7"."PLA_LAST_CHEMO_DTE" AS "Last MSK Chemo Date", "t7"."PLA_LAST_SURG_DTE" AS "Last MSK Surgery Date", CASE WHEN CPP_LANG IS NULL THEN 'ENGLISH' WHEN CPP_LANG = '' THEN 'ENGLISH' ELSE CAV_TITLE END AS LANG, YEAR("t3"."DT_DTE" - PT_BIRTH_DTE) AS AGE FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t8" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER" "t11" ON "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t11"."PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t11"."PENC_ENC_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE" "t4" ON "t11"."PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID" = "t4"."ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT" "t5" ON "t11"."PENC_DEPT_ID" = "t5"."ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte2" "t12" ON "t11"."PENC_PT_ENC_ID" = "t12"."ENSR_PT_ENC_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE" "t6" ON "t12"."ENSR_RES_ID" = "t6"."ENR_ENC_RES_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte3" "t13" ON "t11"."PENC_APPT_STS" = "t13"."EDC_DEPT_ABBREV" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY" "t7" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPP_CL_PT_ID = PENC_CL_PT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY ON CPP_LANG = CAV_ABBR AND CAV_CATEGORY = 'LANG' LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2a" ON "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2a"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3a" ON "t2a"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3a"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4a" ON "t2a"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4a"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE "t13"."EDC_DEPT_DESC" = 'Scheduled' AND YEAR("t3"."DT_DTE" - PT_BIRTH_DTE) >= 65 AND "t3"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN CURRENT DATE + 4 DAY AND CURRENT DATE + 11 DAY AND CASE WHEN "t4"."ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR" like '%NV%' THEN 'New Visit' WHEN "t4"."ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR" like '%IR%' THEN 'Internal Referral' ELSE 'Non-New Visit/Interal Referral' END IN ('Internal Referral', 'New Visit') AND "t6"."ENR_RES_TYP" IN ('PhD', 'Physician') AND "t5"."ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6" = 'MED' AND "t5"."ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8" = 'BRE' ) , ICD9 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PID, "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-9 Final Dx Code", "t2"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-9 Final Dx Description" FROM CADENCE LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t9" ON PID = "t9"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t2" ON "t9"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t10" ON "t9"."PDX_DX_DATE_ID" = "t10"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE "t9"."DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT" = 'YES' AND "t10"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 365 DAY AND CURRENT DATE AND "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('174', '174.1', '174.2', '174.3', '174.4', '174.5', '174.8', '174.9', '175', '175.9', '233.0') ) , PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT PID, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO FROM CADENCE LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2a" ON PID = "t2a"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3a" ON "t2a"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3a"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4a" ON "t2a"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4a"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE CONTAINS("t2a"."PRPT_REPORT", '"breast"') = 1 AND "t2a"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL ) , PATH_FIN AS (SELECT PID, LISTAGG(RTRIM(PRPT_ACCESSION_NO), ', ') "Accession Numbers" FROM PATH GROUP BY PID) SELECT CADENCE.*, ICD9."ICD-9 Final Dx Code", "ICD-9 Final Dx Description", PATH_FIN."Accession Numbers" FROM CADENCE LEFT JOIN ICD9 ON CADENCE.PID = ICD9.PID LEFT JOIN PATH_FIN ON CADENCE.PID = PATH_FIN.PID WHERE ICD9.PID IS NOT NULL OR PATH_FIN.PID IS NOT NULL

prompt: Provide a list of patients who received allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplant (HCT) and received phototherapy after the date of their transplant
completion: WITH HCT AS (SELECT CBM_MRN AS MRN, CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS BMT_TYPE, CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS BMT_DATE, ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY CBM_MRN, CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE ORDER BY CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE) RN FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE WHERE CBM_MRN<> 'ZZZZZZZZ' AND CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2022-10-01' UNION SELECT CBP_MRN AS MRN, CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS BMT_TYPE, CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS BMT_DATE, ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY CBP_MRN, CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE ORDER BY CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE) RN FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS WHERE CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2022-10-01' ), HCT1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM HCT WHERE RN=1 ), ICD AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('D89.810', '279.50') AND CLM_CD_TYPE = 'D' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2022-10-01' ), OVERALL AS (SELECT MRN, BMT_TYPE, BMT_DATE FROM HCT1 UNION SELECT CC_MRN, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(80)) AS BMT_TYPE, CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS BMT_DATE FROM ICD) , ICD1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_RELIGION_ID, PT_RACE_ID, PT_GENDER, BMT_DATE, BMT_TYPE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_PROC_NAME FROM OVERALL LEFT JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON CC_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('D89.810', '279.50') AND CLM_CD_TYPE = 'D' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2022-10-01' ) , X3 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, P.BMT_DATE HCT_DATE, P.BMT_TYPE HCT_TYPE, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Provider", CDD_DOC_GUID AS "Document Guid", CDO_SECTION AS "Section", CDO_ITEM_NAME AS "Item", CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Value" FROM OVERALL N JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON N.MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID LEFT JOIN HCT1 P ON N.MRN = P.MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE > P.BMT_DATE AND UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE 'FOLLOW%UP%CONSULTATION%' AND (UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%PHOTOTX%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%PHOTOTHERAPY%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%NBUVB%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%NARROW BAND UVB%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%NARROWBAND UVB%' OR (CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%UVB%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%LIGHT TREATMENT%' OR (CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%UV tx%' OR (CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%UV treatment%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%PHOTO THERAPY%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%ULTRAVIOLET B%' OR (CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%UVA%' OR (CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%UVA1%' OR (CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%PUVA%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%LIGHT THERAPY%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%LIGHT TX%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%DAAVLIN%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%DAVLIN%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%NAT BIO%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%NATIONAL BIOLOGICAL%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%UV THERAPHY%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%NATBIO%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%ULTRAVIOLET%') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND CURRENT date ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, MIN(APR_START_DTE) CHEMO_START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) CHEMO_END_DATE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME FROM OVERALL JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME), CHEMO_INFO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, LISTAGG(CHEMO_START_DATE||'- '||CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, '|| ') WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY CHEMO_START_DATE||'- '||CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) CHEMO_INFO FROM CHEMO GROUP BY APR_MRN), RAD AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, MIN(RTC_TX_START_DTE) RAD_START_DATE, MAX(RTC_TX_STOP_DTE) RAD_STOP_DATE, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM OVERALL JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON MRN = RTC_TX_MRN GROUP BY RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT), RAD_INFO AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN, LISTAGG(RAD_START_DATE||'- '||RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, '|| ') WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY RAD_START_DATE||'- '||RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) RAD_INFO FROM RAD GROUP BY RTC_TX_MRN) , X4 AS (SELECT DISTINCT N.MRN, P.PT_LAST_NAME, P.PT_FIRST_NAME, YEAR(CURRENT DATE-P.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE, P.PT_SEX, P.PT_RELIGION_ID, P.PT_RACE_ID, P.PT_GENDER, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC, T.BMT_DATE HCT_DATE, T.BMT_TYPE HCT_TYPE, "Service Date", "Document Name", "Provider", "Section", "Item", "Value", CASE WHEN CDD_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM CHEMO) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS CHEMO_IND, CASE WHEN CDD_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN FROM RAD) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS RAD_IND FROM OVERALL N LEFT JOIN X3 ON N.MRN = X3. CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN HCT1 T ON N.MRN = T.MRN LEFT JOIN ICD1 ON N.MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN CHEMO_INFO ON N.MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN RAD_INFO ON N.MRN = RTC_TX_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON N.MRN = P.PT_MRN ) , FINAL AS (SELECT DISTINCT X4.*, CASE WHEN CHEMO_IND= 'Y' THEN CHEMO_INFO ELSE NULL END AS CHEMO_DATA, CASE WHEN RAD_IND= 'Y' THEN RAD_INFO ELSE NULL END AS RAD_DATA FROM X4 LEFT JOIN CHEMO_INFO ON MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN RAD_INFO ON MRN = RTC_TX_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT * FROM FINAL

prompt: Provide a comprehensive analysis of 12-289 patients.
Create a report which will provide the number of chest CTs done for PE in urgent care. The report should be grouped by service and attending for a three month period of time.
completion: SELECT OO_MRN MRN, OO_ACCT_NO, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_GUID , SUBSTR(OO_ORD_NAME, 1, 35) NAME, SUBSTR(OO_SUMMARY_LINE, 1, 90) ORD_SUMMARY , OCV_CURR_LOC CURR_LOC, OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS REQUESTED_BY , OO_ORD_STS_CD ORD_STS, OS_SVC_DESC LOC_SVC , SUBSTR(CASE WHEN OO_ORD_NAME = 'CT' THEN STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME)||' (' ||STRIP(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE)||')' ELSE OO_ORD_NAME END, 1, 55) AS ORD_NAME , CASE WHEN MONTH(OO_PERFORMED_DT) = 5 THEN 'May' WHEN MONTH(OO_PERFORMED_DT) = 6 THEN 'Jun' WHEN MONTH(OO_PERFORMED_DT) = 7 THEN 'Jul' ELSE 'Aug' END AS RPT_MONTH , CASE WHEN OO_ACCT_NO LIKE '84%' THEN 'IP' ELSE 'OP' END PT_STS , CASE WHEN OO_ACCT_NO LIKE '84%' THEN 'Inpatient' WHEN OCV_CURR_LOC = 'UCC 1275' THEN 'UCC Outpatient' ELSE 'Outpatient' END ORD_TYPE , DATE(OO_PERFORMED_DT) PERF_DATE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT = 'Radiology' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Order - Current' JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OS_SVC_GUID = OCV_SVC_GUID WHERE OO_ENTER_DTE >= '2009-01-01' AND DATE(OO_PERFORMED_DT) BETWEEN '2009-05-01' AND '2009-08-31' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP') AND UCASE(OO_ORD_NAME) NOT LIKE '%W/ ABD%' AND UCASE(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) NOT LIKE '%W/ ABD%' AND(OO_ORD_NAME LIKE 'CT:Chest %' OR UCASE(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE 'CT:CHEST %' OR OUD_USER_DI_VALUE LIKE 'CT:Chest %')

prompt: A list of patients who underwent lymphovenous bypass
completion: SELECT PBD_MRN MRN , PBD_SVC_DTE SVC_DTE , PBC_CPT_CD CPT_CODE , DOC_NAME FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD AND PBC_CPT_CD IN ('38999', '38380') JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO ; SELECT SSE_MRN MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE AS SURGERY_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD CPT_CODE, TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) SURGEON FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('38999', '38380')

prompt: Provide survival data for a cohort of esophageal adenocarcinoma patients.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT TM_MRN MRN , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH DATE_OF_DEATH , PLA_LST_CON_DTE LAST_CONTACT_DTE , TM_DX_DTE DX_DTE , H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC , S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC , TM_BEST_AJCC_STG , TM_CLIN_STG_GRP , TM_PATH_STG_GRP FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON TM_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND LEFT(TM_SITE_CD, 3) = 'C15' AND LOWER(H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) like '%adenocarc%' ) , METS AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS METS_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN PTS ON CC_MRN = MRN WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C77', 'C79', '196', '198') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_EFF_DTE >= DX_DTE GROUP BY CC_MRN ) SELECT P.* , METS_EFF_DTE FROM PTS P LEFT JOIN METS ON MRN = CC_MRN AND METS_EFF_DTE >= DX_DTE

prompt: Provide the date and number of times each Submitted Films order was entered or requested by a STBRE Medical Oncologist between March 1, 2010 and March 31, 2011 for the following orders types: Submitted Films FR Mammo Bilat - CD, Submitted Films FR Mammo Bilat - Film, Submitted Films FR Mammo Uni- CD, Submitted Films FR Mammo Uni- Film.
completion: SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ACCT_NO, OO_ORD_ID , OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_MODIFIER ORD_MODIFIER , DOC_NAME AS PVDR_NAME , PVDR.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE PVDR_TYPE , USR.OU_DISPLAY_NAME ENTERED_BY, USR.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE ENTERED_BY_ROLE , OO_CREATE_BY FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER USR ON OO_USER_GUID = USR.OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OCV_PVDR_NAME = OP_DISPLAY_NAME JOIN IDB.OMS_USER PVDR ON PVDR.OU_USER_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.DOC ON OP_PVDR_NO = DOC_DR_NO AND DOC_SVC IN('BRM') AND DOC_DR_STS = 'A' AND DOC_SOURCE_DESC = 'SMS' WHERE OO_ORD_NAME = 'Submitted Films' AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2010-03-01' AND '2011-03-31' AND OO_ORD_MODIFIER IN ('FR Mammo Bilat - CD' , 'FR Mammo Bilat - Film' , 'FR Mammo Uni - CD' , 'FR Mammo Uni - Film') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT LIKE 'CA%' UNION SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ACCT_NO, OO_ORD_ID , OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME , COALESCE(MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS ORD_MODIFIER , DOC_NAME AS PVDR_NAME , PVDR.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE PVDR_TYPE , USR.OU_DISPLAY_NAME ENTERED_BY, USR.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE ENTERED_BY_ROLE , OO_CREATE_BY FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER USR ON OO_USER_GUID = USR.OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OCV_PVDR_NAME = OP_DISPLAY_NAME JOIN IDB.OMS_USER PVDR ON PVDR.OU_USER_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.DOC ON OP_PVDR_NO = DOC_DR_NO AND DOC_SVC IN('BRM') AND DOC_DR_STS = 'A' AND DOC_SOURCE_DESC = 'SMS' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA CR ON CR.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND CR.OUD_USER_DI_CD ='RIS_Order - Current' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA MD ON MD.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND CR.OUD_USER_DI_CD ='RIS_Order - Modified' WHERE OO_ORD_NAME = 'Submitted Films' AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2010-03-01' AND '2011-03-31' AND OO_ORD_MODIFIER = ' '

prompt: Datapoints for conducting survival analysis using machine learning.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('WHITE', 'WHITE HISPANIC') THEN 'White' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN', 'BLACK', 'BLACK HISPANIC') THEN 'Black' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('ASIAN-FAR EAST/INDIAN SUBCONT', 'KAMPUCHEAN', 'LAOTIAN', 'VIETNAMESE', 'HMONG', 'CHINESE', 'ASIAN INDIAN PAKISTANI', 'JAPANESE', 'KOREAN', 'OTHER ASIAN', 'THAI') THEN 'Asian' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('NATIVE AMERICAN-AM IND/ALASKA', 'AMER IND ALEUT ESKIMO') THEN 'Native American or Alaska Native' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('NATIVE HAWAIIAN OR PACIFIC ISL', 'HAWAIIAN', 'MELANESIAN', 'MICRONESIAN', 'FIJI ISLANDER', 'FILIPINO', 'GUAMANIAN', 'PACIFIC ISLANDER') THEN 'Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander' ELSE 'Unspecified' END AS PT_RACE, CASE WHEN COALESCE(CE.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC) IN ('SPANISH NOS; HISPANIC NOS, LATINO NOS', 'HISPANIC OR LATINO', 'PUERTO RICAN', 'SOUTH/CENTRAL AMERICA (EXCEPT BRAZIL)', 'DOMINICAN REPUBLIC', 'OTHER SPANISH/HISPANIC(INCL EUROPEAN; EXCL DOM REP)', 'CUBAN', 'MEXICAN (INCLUDES CHICANO)') OR COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('WHITE HISPANIC', 'BLACK HISPANIC') THEN 'Hispanic' WHEN COALESCE(CE.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC) IN ('NOT HISPANIC', 'SPANISH SURNAME ONLY', 'NON-SPANISH; NON-HISPANIC') THEN 'Non-Hispanic' ELSE 'Unspecified' END AS PT_ETHNICITY FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CR ON CR.AV_ELEMENT = 'CDB_RACE' AND CR.AV_CODE = CP_CDB_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CE ON CE.AV_ELEMENT = 'ETHNICITY' AND CE.AV_CODE = CP_ETHNICITY WHERE PT_MRN IN ({}) ) , TM AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_SMOKING_HX, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG, TM_CLIN_TNM_T, TM_CLIN_TNM_N, TM_CLIN_TNM_M, TM_CA_SURG_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN PTS ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) , RAD AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN , RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE , RRPT_ORDER_GROUP , RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME , RRPT_REPORT_TXT FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN PTS ON RRPT_MRN = PT_MRN) , APR AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG, MIN(APR_START_DTE) FIRST_START_DATE, MAX(APR_START_DTE) LAST_START_DATE, COUNT(*) DOSES FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN PTS ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG) , RT AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN PTS ON RTC_TX_MRN = PT_MRN) , METS AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS METS_MIN_ICD_DX_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS METS_ICD_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS METS_ICD_DESCRIPTION FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN PTS ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C7B', 'C77', 'C78', 'C79', '196', '197', '198') OR SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) = '209.7') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT PT_MRN MRN , PT_SEX , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH , PLA_LST_APPT_DTE , PT_RACE , PT_ETHNICITY , TM_DX_DTE , TM_HIST_CD , HIST_DESC , TM_SITE_CD , SITE_DESC , TM_SMOKING_HX , TM_BEST_AJCC_STG , TM_CLIN_TNM_T , TM_CLIN_TNM_N , TM_CLIN_TNM_M , TM_CA_SURG_DTE , RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE , RRPT_ORDER_GROUP , RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME , RRPT_REPORT_TXT , CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME , CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG , FIRST_START_DATE , LAST_START_DATE , DOSES , RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME , RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT , RTC_TX_START_DTE , RTC_TX_STOP_DTE , RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS , RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS , RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE , RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE , METS_MIN_ICD_DX_DTE , METS_ICD_CODE , METS_ICD_DESCRIPTION FROM PTS LEFT JOIN TM ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN RAD ON PT_MRN = RRPT_MRN LEFT JOIN APR ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN RT ON PT_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN LEFT JOIN METS ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN

prompt: Provide a weekly list of patients undergoing a Colectomy or Resection, Rectum, Low Anterior, Robot-Assisted.
completion: SELECT OC_SURG_DTE SURGERY_DATE, OC_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME , OP_PROC_NAME PROCEDURE_NAME, MD.CRE_RES_NAME SURGEON , MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) IRB_06_107 , MAX(CASE WHEN CDX_ICD9 > ' ' THEN STRIP(CDX_ICD9) ELSE STRIP(CDX_ICD10) END ||' - '||CDX_DX_NAME) ICD10_DX , MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) IRB_12_245 , MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) NEXT_APPT_DTE FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OC_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE MD ON OCAS_RES_ID = MD.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID AND(OCP_LINE_NO = 1 OR OCAS_SURG_SVC <> 'PLA') LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS A ON A.AC_MRN = OC_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON ACD_MRN = AC_MRN AND ACD_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO AND AC_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '12-245') LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_DX_CODES ON OCD_CASE_ID = OC_CASE_ID AND OCD_LINE_NO = 1 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DX ON CDX_DX_ID = OCD_DX_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON OC_MRN = CPE_MRN AND CPE_VST_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE > OC_SURG_DTE AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 WHERE OC_SURG_DTE > CURRENT DATE AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND OCAS_SURG_SVC = 'CRS' AND(OP_PROC_NAME LIKE 'COLECTOMY%' OR OP_PROC_NAME LIKE 'RESECTION, RECTUM%') AND OCP_LINE_NO = 1 GROUP BY OC_SURG_DTE, OC_MRN, OP_PROC_NAME, OCAS_RES_ID, MD.CRE_RES_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME

prompt: Provide a list of outpatient procedures performed by the primary surgeon during June 2011 and the medications prescribed that were started on the surgery date.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OL_SURG_DTE SURG_DATE, OL_MRN MRN, OL_LOG_ID LOG_ID , RTRIM(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||RTRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME , OLAS_PNL_NO PNL_NO, OLAP_LINE_NO LINE_NO , SUBSTR(CRE_RES_NAME, 1, 35) SURGEON, OLAS_SURG_SVC SVC , SUBSTR(CASE WHEN OLAS_SURG_SVC = 'IR' THEN STRIP(CPX_PROC_CD)||' - '||OP_PROC_NAME ELSE STRIP(CPX_PROC_CD)||' - '||CPX_PROC_NAME END, 1, 255) CPT_DESC , PO_RX_NO RX_NO, PO_DR_NO, PO_DR_NAME PRESCRIBER , POD_STRT_DTE RX_START_DATE , PO_DISP_LOC_NAME DISP_LOCATION, PIN_MNEMONIC MNEMONIC , POD_ITEM_DESC DRUG_NAME, POI_DOSE DOSE, POI_DOSE_UNIT DOSE_UNIT FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_PROC ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OLAP_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID AND OLAS_PNL_NO = OLAP_PNL_NO AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OLAS_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CASE ON OL_MRN = CS_MRN AND OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CS_ADM_DATE AND COALESCE(CS_DSCH_DATE, CURRENT DATE) AND CS_ACCT_NO LIKE '84%' AND CS_PT_STS <> 'IP' JOIN IDB.PHM_ORDER ON OL_MRN = PO_MRN AND OL_SURG_DTE = PO_FIRST_FILL_DTE JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL ON PO_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ AND POD_STRT_DTE = OL_SURG_DTE JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_INV ON POI_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ AND POI_ITEM_NO = POD_ITEM_NO JOIN IDB.PHM_INVENTORY ON PIN_INV_SEQ = POI_INV_SEQ JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OL_MRN WHERE OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2011-06-01' AND '2011-06-30' AND OL_LOG_STS_CD NOT IN ('4', '6') AND CS_MRN IS NULL AND PO_ORD_STS NOT IN ('X', 'P') AND POD_ATT_FLAG NOT LIKE '%IVVEH%'

prompt: Total psychiatry and physical therapy referrals made from the Plastics Service in 2019.
completion: WITH CTE1 AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_VISIT_GUID , OO_ORD_NAME, CASE WHEN OO_ORD_NAME = 'Psychiatry Outpatient Consult' THEN 'PSYCH' ELSE OO_ORD_NAME END AS REF_SVC, OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID , CR.OUD_USER_DI_CD, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE , SUBSTR(CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, LOCATE('/', VARCHAR(CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE)) + 1) AS REFMDID, OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT DEPT, STRIP(OO_ORD_STS_CD)||'-'||STRIP(OSTS_STS_DESC) STATUS FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = OO_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA CR ON CR.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND CR.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_PsychOP_Referring MD' WHERE 1=1 AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) IN ('psychiatry outpatient consult') ) SELECT RPD_NAME AS PLASTIC_MD, REF_SVC, COUNT(OO_VISIT_GUID) AS TOTAL FROM (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_VISIT_GUID , OO_ORD_NAME, REF_SVC, OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID , OUD_USER_DI_CD, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, REFMDID , RPD_NUMERIC_CODE, RPD_NAME, RPD_MSK_ACADEMIC_SERVICE, RPD_MSK_ACADEMIC_DEPARTMENT FROM CTE1 JOIN IDB.RMS_PHYSICIAN_DICT_DN3 ON RPD_NUMERIC_CODE = REFMDID WHERE RPD_MSK_ACADEMIC_SERVICE IN ('PLASTIC & RECONSTRUCTIVE', 'PLASTIC AND RECONSTRUCTIVE') ) AS X GROUP BY RPD_NAME, REF_SVC UNION SELECT PLASTIC_MD, REF_SVC, SUM(SUBTOTAL) AS TOTAL FROM (SELECT RPD_NAME AS PLASTIC_MD , CASE WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like 'OT%' THEN 'OT' WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like 'PT%' THEN 'PT' ELSE 'OTHER' END AS REF_SVC, COUNT(CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) AS SUBTOTAL FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT C ON CPE_DEPT_ID = C.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE D ON D.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REFMD ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = REFMD.CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.RMS_PHYSICIAN_DICT_DN3 ON RPD_NUMERIC_CODE = REFMD.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT REFDPT ON CPE_REF_DEP_ID = REFDPT.CLD_DEPT_ID AND REFDPT.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('PLA') WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND (C.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('OT', 'PT') OR C.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PSY') AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') GROUP BY RPD_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS X GROUP BY PLASTIC_MD, REF_SVC

prompt: Diagnosis and treatment data for breast cancer patients at MSKCC from 2004-2014.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C50%' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2004-01-01' AND '2015-12-31' ) , SURG AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN DX ON SSE_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2004-01-01' AND '2015-12-31' AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'BRE' AND (SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC LIKE '%MAST%' OR SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('19125')) ) SELECT APR_MRN AS "MRN", APR_START_DTE AS "Start date", CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS "Common generic name", APR_GENERIC_NAME AS "Generic name" FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN SURG ON APR_MRN = SSE_MRN WHERE APR_START_DTE >= '2014-01-01' ; WITH DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C50%' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2004-01-01' AND '2015-12-31' ) , SURG AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN DX ON SSE_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2004-01-01' AND '2015-12-31' AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'BRE' AND (SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC LIKE '%MAST%' OR SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('19125')) ) SELECT RTC_TX_MRN AS "MRN", RTC_TX_START_DTE AS "Radonc start date", RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT AS "Primary reference point" FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN SURG ON SSE_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN

prompt: Would it be possible to get total procedure volume for each of these quarters(2, 3 4 in 2019 and 1 in 2020)?
completion: SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, QUARTER(SSE_SURG_DTE) QTR, YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE) YR, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD SVC, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD CPT, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC CPT_DESC, SSP_PROC_NAME PROC_NAME, SSE_SURG_LOC , CASE WHEN SSE_SURG_LOC like 'IR%' THEN 'IR' ELSE 'KOCH' END LOCATION_GRP, SSE_LOG_STS, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, CASE WHEN SSP_PROC_NAME IN('NBB NEEDLE BIOPSY BODY LUNG/PLEURA CT', 'NBB NEEDLE BIOPSY BODY LUNG/PLEURA FLUORO', 'NBB NEEDLE BIOPSY BODY LUNG/PLEURA PET') THEN 'LUNG AND PLEURA BIOPSY' WHEN SSP_PROC_NAME IN('KYPHOPLASTY FOUR LEVELS', 'KYPHOPLASTY IR', 'KYPHOPLASTY THREE LEVELS', 'KYPHOPLASTY TWO LEVELS') THEN 'KYHOPLASTY' WHEN SSP_PROC_NAME IN ('GU PLACE NEPHROSTOMY', 'GU PLACE NEPHROURETEROSTOMY') THEN 'NEPHROSTOMY NEPHROUTERESTOMY' WHEN SSP_PROC_NAME = 'EMBOLIZATION, ARTERIAL TUMOR HEPATIC' THEN SSP_PROC_NAME WHEN SSP_PROC_NAME LIKE '%ABLATION%' THEN 'ABLATION' WHEN SSP_PROC_NAME LIKE 'VA PLACE MEDIPORT%' OR SSP_PROC_NAME LIKE 'VA PLACE HICKMAN%' OR SSP_PROC_NAME LIKE 'VA PLACE TLC%' THEN 'VA PLACE' WHEN SSP_PROC_NAME LIKE 'SIRSPHERE TREATMENT%' THEN 'SIRT' END PROCEDURE_TYPE FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSP_LOG_ID = SSE_LOG_ID AND SSP_SOURCE_TYPE = SSE_SOURCE_TYPE AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2019-04-01' AND '2020-03-31' WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC like 'IR%' OR (SSE_SURG_LOC like 'KOCH%' AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'IR')) ; ;

prompt: Create an on demand report for treatment information for PEDS and PTMP cohorts
completion: WITH PEDS AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, PT_VITAL_STATUS, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_DEATH_DTE FROM DVCMS.COHORT JOIN DVCMS.COHORT_PATIENT ON CHT_COHORT_ID = CHP_COHORT_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON CHP_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE CHT_COHORT_ID = 230 UNION SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, PT_VITAL_STATUS, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_DEATH_DTE FROM DVCMS.COHORT JOIN DVCMS.COHORT_PATIENT ON CHT_COHORT_ID = CHP_COHORT_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON CHP_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE CHT_COHORT_ID = 6819 ) SELECT PEDS.*, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_DRUG_NAME FROM PEDS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' ; WITH PEDS AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, PT_VITAL_STATUS, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_DEATH_DTE FROM DVCMS.COHORT JOIN DVCMS.COHORT_PATIENT ON CHT_COHORT_ID = CHP_COHORT_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON CHP_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE CHT_COHORT_ID = 230 UNION SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, PT_VITAL_STATUS, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_DEATH_DTE FROM DVCMS.COHORT JOIN DVCMS.COHORT_PATIENT ON CHT_COHORT_ID = CHP_COHORT_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON CHP_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE CHT_COHORT_ID = 6819 ) SELECT PEDS.*, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, YEAR(RTC_TX_START_DTE - PT_BIRTH_DTE) AGE_AT_RT RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE FROM PEDS JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON PT_MRN = RTC_MRN

prompt: Create a Tableau dashboard for Neurology Appointments
completion: WITH CLINDOC AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, OP_PROV_TYPE, UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(CRE_RES_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME))) PROVIDER, CASE WHEN DX_OTHER IS NOT NULL THEN 'Other' ELSE DX END DX, SITE, DX_DATE FROM (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, OP_PROV_TYPE, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Brain Tumor Description' THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) END) DX, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Other Brain Tumor' THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) END) DX_OTHER, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Brain Tumor Location' THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) END) SITE, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Date of Diagnosis' THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) END) DX_DATE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON OP_PVDR_NO = CRE_RES_ID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Brain Tumor Description', 'Brain Tumor Location', 'Date of Diagnosis', 'Other Brain Tumor') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2017-01-01' GROUP BY CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, OP_PROV_TYPE, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME ) A) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) "Last Name", TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Visit Date", CPE_ENC_CSN_ID AS "Encounter ID", TRIM(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8) AS "Service", TRIM(CLD_CLD_CENTER) AS "Center", TRIM(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS "Department Name", TRIM(CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Provider Name", TRIM(CRE_RES_TYP) AS "Provider Type", TRIM(CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR) AS "Visit Type Abbr", TRIM(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Visit Type Name", CASE WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' THEN 'NV' WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%' THEN 'IR' WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%MDTX%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE 'PR%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR IN ('EMG', 'EMG FR') THEN 'Treatment/Procedure' WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('ACTIVE FR', 'ACTIVE FX', 'AD HOC ACTIVE FR', 'AD HOC ACTIVE FX', 'AD HOC FR', 'AD HOC LONG TERM FR', 'NEU ACTIVE FR', 'NEU ACTIVE FX', 'NEU LONG TERM FR', 'NEU LONG TERM FX', 'NEU RES AFR', 'RES ACTIVE FR', 'LONG TERM FR', 'AD HOC COVERING MD AFR', 'AD HOC COVERING MD FR', 'AD HOC COVERING MD LFR', 'AD HOC LONG TERM FR', 'ANS ACTIVE FR', 'IR ACTIVE FR', 'PAL53 ACTIVE FR', 'PAL53 LONG TERM FR', 'REHAB68 LONG TERM FU', 'REHAB ACTIVE FR', 'REHAB ACTIVE FX', 'REHAB FELLOW/PA ONLY', 'REHAB LONG TERM FR', 'REHAB LONG TERM FX', 'REHAB515 ACTIVE FR', 'REHAB515 LONG TERM FR', 'REHAB53 ACTIVE FR', 'REHAB53 ACTIVE FX', 'REHAB53 LONG TERM FR', 'REHAB53 LONG TERM FX', 'REHAB68 ACTIVE FU', 'STGU ACTIVE FR', 'SUP ACTIVE FR', 'SUP LONG TERM FR', 'SUP LONG TERM FX') THEN 'Follow Up' ELSE 'Other' END AS "Visit Type", CPE_CPE_APPT_STS AS "Encounter Status", CASE WHEN (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') AND FU_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "Had Follow-Up", DX "Diagnosis", SITE "Site", DX_DATE "Diagnosis Date", PROVIDER "Note Author" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN FU_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'NEU' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2017-01-01' AND NOT (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%IR%') ) A ON CPE_MRN = FU_MRN LEFT JOIN CLINDOC ON CPE_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE = CDD_SERVICE_DTE WHERE CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'NEU' AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2017-01-01'

prompt: Provide a list of diagnoses and number of patients to whom Dr Jonathan Schatz administered intrathecal chemotherapy (in-patient or outpatient) since July 1, 2010.
completion: WITH INTR AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN MRN, OO_ACCT_NO ACCT_NO, OO_ENTER_DTE , OCV_VISIT_DTE VST_DTE, OO_ORD_STS_CD, OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_NAME, OOS_VERIFY_POLICY_CD, OCV_PVDR_NAME VST_PVDR, USR.OU_DISPLAY_NAME ENTRED_BY, USR.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE ENTERED_ROLE, VRF.OU_DISPLAY_NAME VRF_BY, VRF.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE VRF_ROLE, OP_DISPLAY_NAME PVDR_NAME, OP_TASK_ROLE_TYPE PVDR_ROLE, OMD_ORD_ROUTE, OO_IS_FOR_DSCH, OO_ORD_TYPE_CD FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER_SET ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OOS_VISIT_GUID AND OOS_VERIFY_POLICY_CD = 'Chemo Order Set Verif Policy' JOIN IDB.OMS_USER USR ON OO_USER_GUID = USR.OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER VRF ON OOS_VERIFY_USER_GUID = VRF.OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OO_ORD_GUID = OMD_ORD_GUID WHERE UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE '%INTRATHECAL%' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT LIKE 'CA%' AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= '2010-06-01' AND (USR.OU_DISPLAY_NAME = 'Schatz, Jonathan' OR OP_DISPLAY_NAME = 'Schatz, Jonathan' OR OCV_PVDR_NAME = 'Schatz, Jonathan' ) ) , VST AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE VST_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_VST_RES_ID = '015586' AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2010-07-01' ) , INTR_DX AS (SELECT MRN, VST_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD DX_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK DX_DESC , DOC_NAME FROM INTR JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON MRN = CC_MRN AND ACCT_NO = CC_ACCT_NO AND VST_DTE = CC_EFF_DTE JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.DOC ON CC_RESP_PARTY = DOC_DR_NO AND CC_RESP_PARTY = '015586' WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'D%' AND (CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' OR CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') ) , VST_DX AS (SELECT MRN, VST_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD DX_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK DX_DESC , DOC_NAME FROM VST JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON MRN = CC_MRN AND VST_DTE = CC_EFF_DTE JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.DOC ON CC_RESP_PARTY = DOC_DR_NO AND CC_RESP_PARTY = '015586' WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'D%' AND (CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' OR CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') ) , PBD_VST AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN MRN, PBD_ACCT_NO ACCT_NO, PBD_SVC_DTE SVC_DTE FROM IDB.PBD_DETAIL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD WHERE PBD_DR_NO = '015586' AND PBD_SVC_DTE >= '2010-07-01' ) , PBD_DX AS (SELECT MRN, SVC_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD DX_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK DX_DESC , DOC_NAME FROM PBD_VST JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON MRN = CC_MRN AND ACCT_NO = CC_ACCT_NO AND SVC_DTE = CC_EFF_DTE JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.DOC ON CC_RESP_PARTY = DOC_DR_NO AND CC_RESP_PARTY = '015586' WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'D%' AND (CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' OR CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') ) , ALL_DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT DX_CD, DX_DESC FROM PBD_DX UNION SELECT DISTINCT DX_CD, DX_DESC FROM VST_DX UNION SELECT DISTINCT DX_CD, DX_DESC FROM INTR_DX) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MRN), 'INTRATHECAL_ORD' AS SRC FROM INTR UNION SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MRN), 'OUTPATIENT_VST' AS SRC FROM VST UNION SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MRN), 'PHYS_BILL' AS SRC FROM PBD_VST SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MRN) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM INTR UNION SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM VST UNION SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM PBD_VST) A

prompt: Provide a list of patients who have had postponed/delayed/upcoming surgeries
completion: WITH OPTIME AS (SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN , OC_SURG_DTE , OC_CASE_ID CASE_ID , OC_OR_CASE_STS CASE_STS , OP_PROC_DESC AS PROC_NAME , CASE WHEN OC_PT_CLASS IN ('IP', 'PSC', 'SDA', 'PDH', 'EI', 'FSI') THEN 'IP' ELSE 'OP' END AS PT_TYPE , OCAS_SURG_SVC , TRIM(MD.CRE_RES_NAME) AS SURGEON , OC_REC_CR_DTE CASE_CREATE_DTE FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE MD ON OCAS_RES_ID = MD.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_SCHED_HX ON OC_CASE_ID = OCSH_CASE_ID AND OC_CL_PT_ID = OCSH_CL_PT_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_AUDIT_TRL ON OCSH_CASE_ID = OCAT_CASE_ID AND OCSH_LINE_NO = OCAT_LINE_NO AND OCSH_CL_PT_ID = OCAT_CL_PT_ID WHERE DATE(OCSH_SCHED_HX_DT) >= '2020-02-01' AND OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2020-02-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('5', '8') AND OCAT_AUDIT_ACTN IN ('Canceled', 'Scheduled', 'Removed') AND OCAS_SURG_SVC IN ('BRE', 'CRS', 'DENT', 'GMT', 'GYN', 'HNS', 'HEP', 'NEURO', 'OPTH', 'ORTHO', 'PEDS', 'PLA', 'THO', 'URO') ) , BREAST AS (SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN BRE_MRN FROM OPTIME WHERE OCAS_SURG_SVC = 'BRE' ) , CADENCE AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NANME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, CPP_EMAIL_ADDR EMAIL, CAV_NAME LANGUAGE, MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS MIN_APPT_DATE, MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS MAX_APPT_DATE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CPE_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = CPP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY ON CAV_CATEGORY = 'LANG' AND CPP_LANG = CAV_ABBR WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-02-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('SRG') AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' GROUP BY CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CPP_EMAIL_ADDR, CAV_NAME ) , FINAL AS (SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN MRN FROM OPTIME UNION SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM CADENCE) SELECT MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CPP_EMAIL_ADDR, CAV_NAME, CASE WHEN B.BRE_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END BREAST_PT FROM FINAL JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON MRN = CPP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY ON CAV_CATEGORY = 'LANG' AND CPP_LANG = CAV_ABBR LEFT JOIN BREAST B ON MRN = B.BRE_MRN WHERE PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') AND PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND <> 'Y' AND CPP_EMAIL_ADDR <> '' AND YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18

prompt: Provide a weekly list of patients on-study for 17-445 who are scheduled to undergo a surgery or procedure.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT ACD_MRN , ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE , ACD_CONS_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '17-445' AND ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN AS MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , OC_OR_CASE_STS CASE_STATUS , OC_SURG_DTE AS PROC_DATE , OC_SCH_DT SCH_DT , LOC.CRE_RES_NAME ROOM , OCAP_PNL_NO PNL_NO , MD.CRE_RES_NAME SURGEON , OCAS_SURG_SVC SVC , OCAP_LINE_NO PROC_SEQ , OP_PROC_NAME PROC_DESC , RF.CRE_RES_NAME REF_MD FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OC_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN PTS ON OC_MRN = ACD_MRN AND ACD_CONS_DTE <= OC_SURG_DTE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID=OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE MD ON OCAS_RES_ID = MD.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE RF ON OC_REF_RES_ID = RF.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE LOC ON LOC.CRE_RES_ID = OC_ROOM_RES_ID WHERE OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 7 DAY AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND(CPX_PROC_CD BETWEEN '10000' AND '69999' OR OCAS_SURG_SVC = 'IR')

prompt: Provide a weekly list of patients who are scheduled for a breast surgery appointment, and have had a med onc appt within the past year.
completion: SELECT CPE.CPE_MRN AS MRN , CL_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", CL_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name" , CL_PLACE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth" , DEPT.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service" , DEPT.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Dept" , CVT.CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR AS "Visit Abbr" , CVT.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Name" , CPE.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS AS "Appt Status", CPE.CPE_APPT_DT AS "Appt DateTime", CPE.CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CR.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Resource Name" , DEPT1.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service1" , DEPT1.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Dept1" , CVT1.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Abbr1" , CVT1.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Name1" , CPE1.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS AS "Appt Status1", CPE1.CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date1", CR1.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Resource Name1" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER CPE INNER JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER CPE1 ON CPE.CPE_MRN=CPE1.CPE_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE CR ON CPE.CPE_VST_RES_ID=CR.CRE_RES_ID INNER JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE CVT ON CPE.CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID=CVT.CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID INNER JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT CL_PATIENT ON CPE.CPE_PRK=CL_PATIENT.CL_PRK JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT DEPT ON CPE.CPE_DEPT_ID = DEPT.CLD_DEPT_ID INNER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE CR1 ON CPE1.CPE_VST_RES_ID=CR1.CRE_RES_ID INNER JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE CVT1 ON CPE1.CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID=CVT1.CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT DEPT1 ON CPE1.CPE_DEPT_ID = DEPT1.CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CR1.CRE_RES_TYP='Physician' AND (CVT1.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%AD HOC%' OR CVT1.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%CONSULT%' OR CVT1.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%IR%' OR CVT1.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%NV%') AND DEPT1.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND DEPT1.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE' AND CPE1.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE1.CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 360 DAY AND CURRENT date AND CPE.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS ='Sch' AND (CVT.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%AD HOC%' OR CVT.CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%CONSULT%' OR CVT.CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%' OR CVT.CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%') AND DEPT.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND DEPT.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE' AND CPE.CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date ORDER BY CR.CRE_RES_NAME, CPE.CPE_APPT_DT

prompt: I'm submitting the queries that are related to the financial toxicity data that researchers request.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH , PT_MARITAL_STS , PT_RELIGION , PT_SEX , PT_RACE , PT_PT_ETHNICITY , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , LEFT(PT_ZIP_CD, 5) AS ZIP_CD , PT_PRIMARY_LANG , PT_PHONE FROM IDB.PATIENT SELECT DISTINCT EAD_MRN , EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE , TRIM(EADT_EMR_DESC) AS FORM_DESC FROM IDB.EMR_AA_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.EMR_AA_DOCTYPE ON EAD_DOCTYPE = EADT_DOCTYPE WHERE LOWER(TRIM(EADT_EMR_DESC)) LIKE '%%death%%' SELECT VIS_MRN , VIS_PATIENT_TYPE , VIS_DTE , VIS_HOSP_SVC , RPTD_PT_TYPE_DESCRIPTION , RVP_PLAN_DESCRIPTION , RFD_FSC_NAME , RFD_FSC_NUMBER , RFD_FSC_MNEMONIC , RFD_DEACTIVATION_FLAG , RTCD_TRANSACTION_NUMBER , RTCD_TRANS_CODE_DESCRIPTION FROM IDB.VISIT INNER JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT ON VIS_VISIT_ID = RV_VISIT_ID INNER JOIN IDB.RMS_PATIENT ON RV_MRN = RPT_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT_RECEIVABLES ON VIS_VISIT_ID = RVR_VISIT_ID INNER JOIN IDB.RMS_PATIENT_TYPE_DICT_DN1260 ON RV_PATIENT_TYPE_REC_NO = RPTD_RECORD_NUMBER INNER JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT_RECEIVABLES_TX ON RV_VISIT_ID = RVRT_VISIT_ID INNER JOIN IDB.RMS_TRANSACTION_CODE_DICT_DN1241 ON RVRT_TX_CD_REC_NO = RTCD_RECORD_NUMBER INNER JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT_PLAN ON VIS_VISIT_ID = RVP_VISIT_ID INNER JOIN IDB.RMS_FSC_DICT_DN19 ON RVP_PLAN_FSC_REC_NO = RFD_RECORD_NUMBER WHERE (RFD_FSC_MNEMONIC IN ('CL1', 'CL2', 'CL3', 'EC1', 'EC2', 'EC3', 'SK1', 'SK2', 'SK3', 'CLF', 'CLP', 'DNE', 'C1T', 'C2T', 'C3T', 'CFC', 'CPC', 'CPW', 'PCP', 'PMC', 'CFW', 'CFP', 'GMC', 'TPP', 'STL', 'STP', 'CST', 'CSB', 'CBP', 'BKP', 'BKR', 'BKG', 'FE', 'FEP', 'FES') OR RTCD_TRANSACTION_NUMBER IN ('4002', '40021')) SELECT CS_MRN , CS_ACCT_NO , CS_ADM_DATE , CS_DAYS_STAY , CS_DSCH_DATE , CS_FC , CS_PT_STS , CS_HOSP_SVC , CS_RESP_CD , CS_CR_RATING , DTL_SVC_CD , CDM_SVC_DESC , PA_ACCT_TYPE , PA_RESP_BL_CD , PA_UNIT_STS , PA_UNIT_BD_IND , PA_UNIT_BD_BAL , PA_CR_BL_CD FROM IDB.CASE LEFT JOIN IDB.PA_DETAIL ON CS_MRN = DTL_MRN AND CS_ACCT_NO = DTL_ACCT_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.CDM ON DTL_SVC_CD = CDM_SVC_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCOUNT ON CS_MRN = PA_MRN AND CS_ACCT_NO = PA_ACCT_NO WHERE CS_PT_STS IN('IA', 'IC', 'ID', 'IP') AND (CS_FC IN ('4', '7', '8', '9') OR PA_RESP_BL_CD IN ('K', 'P', 'D', 'J', 'U') OR DTL_SVC_CD IN ('00115006', '00115030', '00195032', '00852020', '00853028', '00855007', '00855023', '00885038')) SELECT UT_MRN , UT_ACCT_NO , UT_UNIT_CLOSE_DTE , UT_UNIT_NO , UT_ACCT_TYPE , UT_XFR_TO_BD_DTE , UT_XFR_FROM_BD_DTE , UT_FC , DTL_SVC_CD , CDM_SVC_DESC , PA_ACCT_TYPE , PA_RESP_BL_CD , PA_UNIT_STS , PA_UNIT_BD_IND , PA_UNIT_BD_BAL , PA_CR_BL_CD FROM IDB.UNIT LEFT JOIN IDB.PA_DETAIL ON UT_MRN = DTL_MRN AND UT_ACCT_NO = DTL_ACCT_NO AND UT_UNIT_CLOSE_DTE = DTL_UNIT_CLOSE_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.CDM ON DTL_SVC_CD = CDM_SVC_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCOUNT ON UT_MRN = PA_MRN AND UT_ACCT_NO = PA_ACCT_NO WHERE (UT_FC IN ('4', '7', '8', '9') OR PA_RESP_BL_CD IN ('K', 'P', 'D', 'J', 'U') OR DTL_SVC_CD IN ('00115006', '00115030', '00195032', '00852020', '00853028', '00855007', '00855023', '00885038')) SELECT CDD_DOC_NAME , OP_DISPLAY_NAME , CDD_SERVICE_DTE , CDD_MRN , CDD_DOC_GUID , CDO_SECTION , CDO_ITEM_NAME , CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT != '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND != '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND != '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE '%%Social Work%%' AND CDO_SECTION IN ('Psychosocial Assessment and Plan', 'Mental Health Treatment', 'Plan/Interventions', 'Plan') AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Practical:', 'SW Initial IP Practical res', 'Plan/Interventions:', 'Plan/Intervention', 'Referral:', 'sw_initial_plan referrals_obs', 'Referral', 'Philanthropy:', 'SW Initial IP Prac Philanth res', 'Referrals')

prompt: Create an On-Demand Darwin report to review the completion of genetics data from the RISE clinic.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN "MRN" , CDD_SERVICE_DTE "DOS" , MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Genetic Testing' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 2555) END) AS "Genetic Testing" , MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Genetic Mutation' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 2555) END) AS "Genetic Mutation" , MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Genetic mutation details' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 2555) END) AS "Genetic Mutation Details" , MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Known family member with genetic mutation', 'Known Family Member with Genetic Mutation') THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 2555) END) AS "Known Family Member with Genetic Mutation" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_DOC_NAME like '%(RISE)%' AND LOWER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) like '%gene%' #PROMPT('StartDate', '', ' ', ' and cdd_service_dte >= ', '', '') #PROMPT('EndDate', '', ' ', ' and cdd_service_dte <= ', '', '') #PROMPTMANY('MRN', 'String', ' ', ' and cdd_mrn in (', '', ')')# GROUP BY CDD_MRN , CDD_SERVICE_DTE

prompt: All patients with a "Cell Infusion - BMT" note written over the last month.
completion: WITH CLINDOC AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS "MRN", OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Provider", CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Recipient Verification: Attending' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT ELSE '' END) AS "Recipient Verification: Attending", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Diagnosis' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT ELSE '' END)AS "Diagnosis", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Product Information: Cell Infusion Type' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT ELSE '' END)AS "Cell Infusion Type" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Cell Infusion - BMT' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Diagnosis', 'Product Information: Cell Infusion Type', 'Recipient Verification: Attending') GROUP BY CDD_MRN, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE) , PREVIOUS AS (SELECT B.CPE_MRN "lmrn", B.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CHAR(B.CPE_ENC_DTE) "Last Visit", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY B.CPE_MRN ORDER BY B.CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RANK FROM CLINDOC JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER B ON "MRN" = B.CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON B.CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON B.CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE B.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND (CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') OR CRE_RES_NAME IN ('KENNY, SHEILA A', 'GORELOV, JENNIFER SUSAN', 'SUPAN, CHRISTIANNE CANDA')) AND UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) NOT LIKE '%JOFFE%' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BMT' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND B.CPE_ENC_DTE < CURRENT date ORDER BY MRN, RANK) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last", PT_FIRST_NAME "First", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", "Provider", "Service Date", "Diagnosis", "Cell Infusion Type", "Recipient Verification: Attending", "Last Visit" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN CLINDOC ON "MRN" = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN PREVIOUS ON "lmrn" = PT_MRN AND RANK = 1 ; WITH CLINDOC AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS "MRN", OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Provider", CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Recipient Verification: Attending' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT ELSE '' END) AS "Recipient Verification: Attending", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Diagnosis' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT ELSE '' END)AS "Diagnosis", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Product Information: Cell Infusion Type' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT ELSE '' END)AS "Cell Infusion Type" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Cell Infusion - BMT' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-06-01' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Diagnosis', 'Product Information: Cell Infusion Type', 'Recipient Verification: Attending') GROUP BY CDD_MRN, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE) , PREVIOUS AS (SELECT B.CPE_MRN "lmrn", B.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CHAR(B.CPE_ENC_DTE) "Last Visit", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY B.CPE_MRN ORDER BY B.CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RANK FROM CLINDOC JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER B ON "MRN" = B.CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON B.CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON B.CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE B.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND (CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') OR CRE_RES_NAME IN ('KENNY, SHEILA A', 'GORELOV, JENNIFER SUSAN', 'SUPAN, CHRISTIANNE CANDA')) AND UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) NOT LIKE '%JOFFE%' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BMT' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND B.CPE_ENC_DTE < CURRENT date ORDER BY MRN, RANK) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last", PT_FIRST_NAME "First", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", "Provider", "Service Date", "Diagnosis", "Cell Infusion Type", "Recipient Verification: Attending", "Last Visit" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN CLINDOC ON "MRN" = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN PREVIOUS ON "lmrn" = PT_MRN AND RANK = 1

prompt: Provide a Darwin cohort of patients for the given criteria along with access to the patients in the Darwin Digital Platform.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-score' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-type' , TMB_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score' , TMB_COUNT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb-count', COSMIC_ID VARCHAR(5000) PATH 'cosmic_id') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('SCLC,PRNE,HGNEE,HGNES,LUNE,NECNOS', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = TRIM(X.TTC) WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_3 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT P_ID FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3 ))

prompt: Patients admitted to M7 that received high-dose methotrexate from 3/5/14 to 12/1/14.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."DT_DTE" AS "Admission Date", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Adm Effective Date", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Dispense Date", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Discharge Date", "t6"."POD_DOSE" AS "Normalized Dose", "t6"."POD_TOTAL_DOSE" AS "Total Dose", "t6"."POD_TOTAL_DOSE_UNIT" AS "Total Dose Unit", "t7"."NS_NURS_STA" AS "Adm Nursing Station", "t8"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" AS "Generic Drug Name", "t9"."HS_ACCT_NO" AS "Account Number" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t10" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t10"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."HOSPITAL_STAY" "t9" ON "t10"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."HS_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t2" ON "t9"."HS_ADM_DATE_ID" = "t2"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."COMBINED_ADMISSION_CENSUS_V" "t11" ON "t9"."HS_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t11"."CAC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t9"."HS_ACCT_NO" = "t11"."CAC_ACCT_NO" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t11"."CAC_EFFECTIVE_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."NURSING_STATION_V" "t7" ON "t11"."CAC_NURSING_STATION_ID" = "t7"."NS_NURSING_STATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t9"."HS_DSCH_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t12" ON "t10"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t12"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t6" prompt: Provide a list of consults received by the thoracic surgery service through CIS, as well as primary reason for consult
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OO_ORD_ID AS "Order ID", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT AS "Order Timestamp", MAX(CASE WHEN OFF_FLD_LABEL = 'Reason for Referral:' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) AS "Reason for Consult" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OUO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_FORM_FIELD A ON OO_ENTRY_FRM_GUID = OFF_ENTRY_FRM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA NFN ON NFN.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OFF_DI_CD = NFN.OUD_USER_DI_CD WHERE 1=1 AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Thoracic/Surgery Consult') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' GROUP BY OO_MRN, OO_ORD_ID, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT ORDER BY OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT ; SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT OO_ORD_ID) AS "Order Count", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS "Order Date" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OUO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_FORM_FIELD A ON OO_ENTRY_FRM_GUID = OFF_ENTRY_FRM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA NFN ON NFN.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OFF_DI_CD = NFN.OUD_USER_DI_CD WHERE 1=1 AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Thoracic/Surgery Consult') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' GROUP BY OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE ORDER BY OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE ASC ;

prompt: Request of Pancreatic cancer patients who have had their tumors metastasize to the skin (skin mets) for last 20 years
completion: WITH PRIMARY_DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS SEER_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C25%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '157%' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2020-06-01' AND CURRENT date) , SECONDARY_MRN AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('198.2', 'C79.2') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2020-06-01' AND CURRENT date) , MRN_LIST AS (SELECT DISTINCT SL.SEER_MRN AS MRN_L FROM PRIMARY_DX SL JOIN SECONDARY_MRN SM ON SL.SEER_MRN = SM.CC_MRN) SELECT DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY MRN_L) AS "Patient Count", MRN_L AS MRN, PD.ICD9_CD AS "ICD Code (Pancreas)", PD.ICD9_DESC AS "ICD Description (Pancreas)", SM.ICD9_CD AS "ICD Code (Skin mets)", SM.ICD9_DESC AS "ICD Description (Skin mets)" FROM MRN_LIST ML LEFT JOIN SECONDARY_MRN SM ON ML.MRN_L = SM.CC_MRN LEFT JOIN PRIMARY_DX PD ON ML.MRN_L = PD.SEER_MRN

prompt: Count of unique encounters and patient demographics for the various screening services at RLC: breast, cervical, colon, lung, prostate
completion: WITH DEMO AS (SELECT PT_MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_SEX , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH , R.AV_DESC RACE , E.AV_DESC ETHNICITY , PT_ZIP_CD , CPP_PRIM_INS , YEAR(DATE(CURRENT date)-PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT WHERE CPP_MRN <> '') ON PT_MRN = CPP_MRN) , SCREENING AS (SELECT OO_MRN "MRN", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE "Date", OOC_ITEM_NAME "Test", CASE WHEN OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'CT' THEN 'Lung' WHEN OOC_ITEM_NAME like '%(FIT)%' THEN 'Colon' WHEN OOC_ITEM_NAME like '%PSA%' THEN 'Prostate' WHEN (OOC_ITEM_NAME like 'RLC Screening%' OR (OO_SUMMARY_LINE like '%Screen%' AND LOWER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) like '%mammo%')) THEN 'Breast' WHEN OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Cytology-GYN' THEN 'Cervical' ELSE NULL END AS "Service", OU_DISPLAY_NAME "User" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OU_USER_GUID = OO_PVDR_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3', 'PEND') AND OU_DISPLAY_NAME IN ('Sales, Marta', 'Ortiz, Claudia', 'Kampel, Lewis', 'Nouvini, Rosa', 'Godfrey, Henry', 'Killoran, Kathleen') AND OSTS_ORD_STS_CD IN ('RESF', 'AUA1') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2019-04-01' AND CURRENT date UNION SELECT DISTINCT OCV_MRN AS "MRN", CAST(CDD_CREATE_DT AS DATE) "Date", CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Test", 'Prostate' AS "Service", OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "User" FROM IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = CDD_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE OCV_VISIT_STS NOT IN ('CAN') AND CAST(CDD_CREATE_DT AS DATE) >= '2019-04-01' AND OCV_CURR_LOC like '%1919%' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Screening, Prostate - Urology') ) SELECT "MRN", "Date", "Test", "Service", "User", PT_SEX , AGE , RACE, ETHNICITY, PT_ZIP_CD, CPP_PRIM_INS FROM SCREENING LEFT JOIN DEMO ON "MRN" = PT_MRN

DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM Y JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'URO' ) , LAST_APPT2 AS (SELECT * FROM LAST_APPT1 WHERE RN = 1 ) , NEXT_APPT1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM Y JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'URO' ) , NEXT_APPT2 AS (SELECT * FROM NEXT_APPT1 WHERE RN = 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT Y.*, LA2.CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Last URO Appt Date", STRIP(LA2.CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Last URO Physician", NA2.CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Next URO Appt Date", STRIP(NA2.CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Next URO Physician" FROM Y LEFT JOIN LAST_APPT2 LA2 ON MRN = LA2.CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN NEXT_APPT2 NA2 ON MRN = NA2.CPE_MRN
