prompt: Update a Darwin structured report (SKI26832) to include drug exposures.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(OO_MRN) AS MRN , STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME) "Order Name", OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE AS "Administration Date" , OOTO_TASK_DOSE AS "Dose", STRIP(OOTO_TASK_UOM) AS "Unit", STRIP(OOTO_TASK_ROUTE_CD) AS "Route" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OO_ORD_GUID = OMD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID AND OCIT_LEVEL_NO = 0 WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_MRN IN (#PROMPTMANY('MRN', 'STRING')#) SELECT STRIP(HCPR_MRN) AS MRN , HCPR_CREATED_DTE AS RX_CREATE_DATE , DATE(HCPR_START_DT) AS START_DATE , DATE(HCPR_END_DT) AS END_DATE , DATE(HCPR_DISCONTINUE_DT) AS DISCONTINUE_DATE , STRIP(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) AS DRUG_NAME , STRIP(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) AS GENERIC_NAME , STRIP(HCPR_STATUS_TYPE_DESC) AS PRESCRIPTION_STATUS , STRIP(HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE_DESC) AS RX_TYPE , STRIP(HCPR_ROUTE) AS ROUTE FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = HCPR_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER USR ON USR.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER REQ ON REQ.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE UOM ON UOM.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE PKG ON PKG.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_INNER_PACKAGE_SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_SCRIPT_FREQUENCY ON HSF_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID = HCPR_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID WHERE HCPR_STATUS_TYPE NOT IN (4, 5, 8) AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE IS NOT NULL AND((HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 2, 5) ) OR HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3) AND HCPR_MRN IN (#PROMPTMANY('MRN', 'STRING')#)

prompt: I would like to get a list of patients with two or more IMPACT samples with corresponding clinical data.
completion: WITH CH AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS CH_MRN, COUNT(DISTINCT SAMPLEID) AS SAMP_CNT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE DTRPT ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = DTRPT.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE DTPROCPATHRPT ON PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID = DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DATE_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS int PATH 'count(../*[not(name()=''meta-data'')])', VARIANT_CLASS VARCHAR(100) PATH 'variant_class', TUMOR_DP VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_dp', TUMOR_AD VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_ad', START_POSITION int PATH 'start_position', ALT_ALLELE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'alt_allele', REF_ALLELE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'ref_allele', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id') T CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.DMP_XML_MAF(VARIANT_TYPE, REF_ALLELE, ALT_ALLELE, START_POSITION, TUMOR_DP, TUMOR_AD, VARIANT_CLASS)) WHERE 1=1 AND PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' AND PDRX_MODIFIED_DT BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2022-10-01' AND (TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS =0 OR VARIANT_TYPE <> 'meta-data') GROUP BY PT_MRN HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT SAMPLEID) >= 2) SELECT PDWS_NAME, DV.PT_MRN, TRIM(G.AV_DESC) AS GENDER, TRIM(R.AV_DESC) AS RACE, TRIM(E.AV_DESC) AS ETHNICITY, YEAR(DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, DTRPT.DT_DTE AS REPORTDATE_PATHCLIN, DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DTE AS PROCEDUREDATE_PATHCLIN, TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS, VARIANT_CLASS, SITE1_GENE, SITE2_GENE, GENE_ID, EXON_NUM, AA_CHANGE, CDNA_CHANGE, GENE_FOLD_CHANGE, CASE WHEN GENE_FOLD_CHANGE IS NULL THEN 'N/A' WHEN LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(GENE_FOLD_CHANGE)), 1) = '-' THEN 'Deletion' ELSE 'Amplification' END AS AMPLIFICATION_DELETION_INDICATOR, CHROMOSOME, IS_HOTSPOT, CONFIDENCE_CV_ID, TRANSCRIPT_ID, NORMAL_DP, TUMOR_DP, NORMAL_AD, TUMOR_AD, TUMOR_VFREQ, DBSNP_ID, START_POSITION, ALT_ALLELE, REF_ALLELE, MAF_VARIANT_TYPE, MAF_NP_COUNT, MAF_START_POSITION, MAF_END_POSITION, MAF_REF_ALLELE, MAF_ALT_ALLELE, MAF_T_REF_COUNT, MAF_VARIANT_CLASSIFICATION, TMB_COHORT_PERCENTILE, TMB_TT_COHORT, TMBSCORE, TMB_TT_PERCENTILE, TMBCOHORT, VARIANT_TYPE, GENE_PANEL, PART_DESCRIPTION, DV.REGEXSTR('(S|H|C|M|F|B|DMG)[0-9]{2}[\s|-][0-9]*', XMLCAST(XMLQUERY('$x/root/meta-data/part_description' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "x") AS VARCHAR(2000))) AS REFERENCEDACCESSION, PROJECT, SAMPLEID, PATIENTID, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, IS_METASTASIS, PRIMARY_SITE, METASTASIS_SITE, DT_PROCEDURE, DT_SIGNOUT, DT_ACCESSIONED, DT_ALYS_END_TIME, DT_DMS_START_TIME FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE DTRPT ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = DTRPT.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE DTPROCPATHRPT ON PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID = DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DATE_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS DV ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ID ON ID.PT_MRN = DV.PT_MRN JOIN CH ON CH_MRN = ID.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_CODE = ID.PT_SEX AND G.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_CODE = ID.PT_RACE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_CODE = ID.PT_PT_ETHNICITY AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY', XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS int PATH 'count(../*[not(name()=''meta-data'')])', VARIANT_CLASS VARCHAR(100) PATH 'variant_class', SITE1_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site1_gene', SITE2_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site2_gene', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', EXON_NUM VARCHAR(100) PATH 'exon_num', AA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'aa_change', CDNA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'cDNA_change', GENE_FOLD_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_fold_change', VARIANT_ID VARCHAR(255) PATH 'snp_indel_variant_id|cnv_variant_id|sv_variant_id', CHROMOSOME VARCHAR(100) PATH 'chromosome', IS_HOTSPOT VARCHAR(100) PATH 'is_hotspot', CONFIDENCE_CV_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'confidence_cv_id', TRANSCRIPT_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'transcript_id', NORMAL_DP VARCHAR(100) PATH 'normal_dp', TUMOR_DP VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_dp', NORMAL_AD VARCHAR(100) PATH 'normal_ad', TUMOR_AD VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_ad', TUMOR_VFREQ VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_vfreq', DBSNP_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'dbSNP_id', START_POSITION int PATH 'start_position', ALT_ALLELE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'alt_allele', REF_ALLELE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'ref_allele', TMB_COHORT_PERCENTILE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_cohort_percentile', TMB_TT_COHORT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_tt_cohort', TMBSCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score', TMB_TT_PERCENTILE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_tt_percentile', TMBCOHORT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_cohort', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/gene-panel', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH '../meta-data/part_description', PROJECT VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_alys_task_name', SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH '../meta-data/is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site', DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure', DT_SIGNOUT VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_signout', DT_ACCESSIONED VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_accessioned', DT_ALYS_END_TIME VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_alys_end_time', DT_DMS_START_TIME VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_dms_start_time') T CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.DMP_XML_MAF(VARIANT_TYPE, REF_ALLELE, ALT_ALLELE, START_POSITION, TUMOR_DP, TUMOR_AD, VARIANT_CLASS)) WHERE 1=1 AND PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' AND PDRX_MODIFIED_DT BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2022-10-01' AND (TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS =0 OR VARIANT_TYPE <> 'meta-data')

prompt: report of the unscheduled visit received in the MCO, Telemed case management inbox in a spreadsheet format for data roll up. The date range I am thinking is from September 1, 2021-December 31, 2021
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN , STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS FIRST_NAME , STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) AS LAST_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH , STRIP(OCV_PVDR_NAME) AS PROVIDER_NAME , CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS SERVICE_DT , STRIP(CDD_DOC_NAME) AS DOCUMENT_NAME , STRIP(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS DEPT_NAME , STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS VISIT_TYPE , STRIP(CPE_CPE_APPT_STS) AS APPOINTMENT_STATUS , CDD_CREATE_DT AS CREATED_ON , CDD_LAST_UPD_DT AS LAST_UP_DT , SUM(H.RVCD_AMT) OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME) AS HOSP_CHARG , SUM(H.RVCD_PRO_AMT) OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN, OCV_PVDR_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME) AS PROV_CHARG FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON OCV_ENC_CSN_ID = CPE_ENC_CSN_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT_CHARGE_DTL H ON CPE_MRN =H.RVCD_MRN AND H.RVCD_SVC_DTE = CDD_SERVICE_DTE WHERE CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2021-11-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Unscheduled Visit:' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT = 'Unscheduled' ) SELECT * FROM CTE WHERE HOSP_CHARG >0

PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AS GENE_RID, GENE, GENE2, AA_CHANGE , LOCUS, NUCLEOTIDE, ABERRATIONTYPE, FOLD_CHANGE, SEARCH_HIT1, SEARCH_HIT2 FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V PSR JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS PD ON PD.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PSR.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND (GENE IN ('POT1', 'CDKN2A', 'MITF', 'BAP1', 'POLE') OR GENE2 IN ('POT1', 'CDKN2A', 'MITF', 'BAP1', 'POLE')) ) , WITH GENE_QUAL AS (SELECT DISTINCT PSR.PT_MRN AS GENE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_DEATH_DTE, PSR.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS GENE_PID, PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AS GENE_RID, GENE, GENE2, AA_CHANGE , LOCUS, NUCLEOTIDE, ABERRATIONTYPE, FOLD_CHANGE, SEARCH_HIT1, SEARCH_HIT2 FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V PSR JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS PD ON PD.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PSR.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND (GENE IN ('POT1', 'CDKN2A', 'MITF', 'BAP1', 'POLE') OR GENE2 IN ('POT1', 'CDKN2A', 'MITF', 'BAP1', 'POLE')) ) , APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_DEATH_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" , CPE_ENC_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN GENE_QUAL ON GENE_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND (UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) LIKE '%DERM%TOTAL%BODY%' OR UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) LIKE '%DERM%3D%PHOTO%' OR UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) LIKE '%DERM%TBI%FR%' OR UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) LIKE '%DERM%TBI%SIMPLE%' OR UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) LIKE '%TBI%' OR UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) LIKE '%DERM205%E64%TOTAL%BODY%' OR UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) IN ('AD HOC TOTAL BODY', 'DERM53 PHOTO FR VISIT', 'DERM53 PHOTO FX VISIT') OR UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) LIKE '%3D%') ) SELECT * FROM APPTS ORDER BY CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE ;

prompt:
Provide Pathology reports for patients have report like  infundibulocystic AND ["BCC" or "Basal cell carcinoma" or "Basal-cell carcinoma" or "Skin cancer"] 

at Time range >= 01-01-2010.
completion: SELECT PRPT_MRN AS MRN, PT_BIRTH_DTE AS BIRTH_DATE, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS PROCEDURE_DATE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS REPORT_DATE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS REPORT_TYPE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT AS REPORT_TEXT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '2010-01-01' AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("INFUNDIBULOCYSTIC" AND ("BCC" OR "BASAL CELL CARCINOMA" OR "BASAL-CELL CARCINOMA" OR "SKIN CANCER"))') = 1 ;

prompt: Retrospective data on all patients who received cisplatin while on dialysis between Jan 1 2000 - Jan 31 2023
completion: WITH APR AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DT, APR_END_DT, APR_TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'CISPLATIN' AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2023-01-31' ), ICD AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, CC_EFF_DTE AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN APR ON APR_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD IN ('V56.0', 'V45.11', 'Z99.2', '585.6', 'N18.6') OR CC_CLSF_CD IN ('90935', '90936', '90937', '90938', '90939', '90940', '90945', '90946', '90947', '90951', '90952', '90953', '90954', '90955', '90956', '90957', '90958', '90959', '90960', '90961', '90962', '90963', '90964', '90965', '90966', '90967', '90968', '90969', '90970', '90971', '90989', '90990', '90991', '90992', '90993', '90994', '90995', '90996', '90997', '90998', '90999', 'Z99.2', '585.6', '39.95')) AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2023-01-31' ), FN AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM APR JOIN ICD ON APR_MRN = DX_MRN), CDD AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", CDO_SECTION AS "Section", CDO_ITEM_NAME AS "Item", CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Value" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN FN ON CDD_MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%ECOG%' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2023-01-31' ) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, "Service Date", "Document Name", "Section", "Item", "Value" FROM FN JOIN CDD ON APR_MRN = CDD_MRN ;

prompt: Provide a report of all new visits with breast surgeons and related data.
completion: WITH NV AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CPE_ENC_DTE AS NV_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2011-01-01' AND CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'BREAST 300 E66' ), MAST AS (SELECT PT_MRN, NV_DTE, SSE_SURG_DTE AS MAST_DTE, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM NV JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON PT_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('19303', '19304', '19305', '19307') AND SSE_SURG_DTE >= NV_DTE ), IR AS (SELECT PT_MRN, NV_DTE, B.CPE_ENC_DTE AS IR_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM MAST A JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER B ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%' AND CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'ST BRE 300 E66' AND B.CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN NV_DTE AND MAST_DTE ) SELECT A.PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, A.NV_DTE, A.CRE_RES_NAME AS NV_PROVIDER, A.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS NV_VISIT_TYPE, IR_DTE, B.CRE_RES_NAME AS IR_PROVIDER, B.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS IR_VISIT_TYPE, MAST_DTE, STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || STRIP(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) AS MAST_SURGEON, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM NV A LEFT JOIN IR B ON A.PT_MRN = B.PT_MRN AND A.NV_DTE = B.NV_DTE LEFT JOIN MAST C ON A.PT_MRN = C.PT_MRN AND A.NV_DTE = C.NV_DTE

prompt: Provide a list of Stage I-III sigmoid, rectosigmoid or rectal cancer who had Lymphadenectomy procedure.
completion: WITH SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSE_LOG_ID FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_SOURCE_TYPE = SSP_SOURCE_TYPE AND SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('38562', '38564', '38747', '38780', '38570', '38572') WHERE 1=1 AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE ) , SRG_CNT AS (SELECT B.SSE_MRN, B.SSE_SURG_DTE, COUNT(DISTINCT B.SSE_LOG_ID) AS CNT FROM SRG A JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT B ON A.SSE_MRN = B.SSE_MRN AND A.SSE_SURG_DTE = B.SSE_SURG_DTE GROUP BY B.SSE_MRN, B.SSE_SURG_DTE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT B.SSE_LOG_ID) = 1) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PFA_FST_CHEMO_MSK_DTE, PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE, PFA_FST_RT_MSK_DTE, PLA_LST_RT_DTE, PLA_LST_DRVST_DTE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS FIRST_DX_DTE FROM SRG JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PFA_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C18.4', 'C18.5', 'C18.6', 'C18.7', 'C18.9', 'C19', 'C20', 'C77.2') AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY PT_MRN, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PFA_FST_CHEMO_MSK_DTE, PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE, PFA_FST_RT_MSK_DTE, PLA_LST_RT_DTE, PLA_LST_DRVST_DTE, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) , PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.SSE_MRN, A.SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSE_LOG_ID , PT_MRN, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PFA_FST_CHEMO_MSK_DTE, PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE, PFA_FST_RT_MSK_DTE, PLA_LST_RT_DTE, PLA_LST_DRVST_DTE, DX_CD, DX_DESC, FIRST_DX_DTE FROM SRG A JOIN SRG_CNT B ON A.SSE_MRN = B.SSE_MRN AND A.SSE_SURG_DTE = B.SSE_SURG_DTE JOIN DX ON PT_MRN = A.SSE_MRN) , DIAG AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, SG.CATEGORY2, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG, TM_BEST_CS_AJCC_STG, TM_BEST_SUMM_STG, TM_DX_DTE "Tumor Dx Date", YEAR(TM_DX_DTE) AS "Dx Yr", TM_BEST_AJCC_STG "Stage", CASE WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS "Best Stage", CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS "Orig Best Stage", TM_SITE_CD AS "Tumor Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Tumor Site Desc", TM_HIST_CD AS "Tumor Histology Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Tumor Histology Desc", TM_CASE_STS "Tumor Case Status Code", CS.AV_DESC AS "Tumor Case Status Desc", L.AV_DESC AS "Laterality", TM_CLIN_TNM_T AS "Clinical T Stage", TM_CLIN_TNM_N AS "Clinical N Stage", TM_CLIN_TNM_M AS "Clinical M Stage", TM_CLIN_STG_GRP AS "Clinical Group Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_T AS "Pathologic T Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_N AS "Pathologic N Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_M AS "Pathologic M Stage", TM_PATH_STG_GRP AS "Pathologic Group Stage" FROM PTS LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING SG ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = SG.RECODE JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS L ON L.AV_ELEMENT = 'LATERALITY_CD' AND L.AV_CODE = TM_LATERALITY_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS T ON T.AV_ELEMENT='TSTAGE_7' AND T.AV_CODE = TM_TSTAGE_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS N ON N.AV_ELEMENT='NSTAGE_7' AND N.AV_CODE = TM_NSTAGE_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS M ON M.AV_ELEMENT='MSTAGE_7' AND M.AV_CODE = TM_MSTAGE_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS A ON A.AV_ELEMENT='AJCC_7' WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) SELECT * FROM DIAG ;

prompt: Provide Sample IDs / DMP IDs associated with tumor sequenced via IMPACT, date of IMPACT report, and the accompanying diagnosis associated with that tumor.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS WHERE PT_MRN IN () ) , DMP AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PID, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession No", MAINPRC.DT_DTE AS "Procedure Date", RTRIM(SUBSTR(CAST(MAINPATH.PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(32000)), POSITION('PHYSICIAN:', UPPER(MAINPATH.PRPT_REPORT), CODEUNITS32) + 11, POSITION('ACCESSION', UPPER(MAINPATH.PRPT_REPORT), CODEUNITS32) - POSITION('PHYSICIAN:', UPPER(MAINPATH.PRPT_REPORT), CODEUNITS32) - 11)) AS "Physician", PDWS_DESCRIPTION, T.* FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V MAINPATH ON MAINPATH.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V MAINPRC ON MAINPRC.DT_DATE_ID = MAINPATH.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS CNV_TYPE VARCHAR(500) PATH 'name()', VARIANT_CLASS VARCHAR(100) PATH 'variant_class', SITE1_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site1_gene', SITE2_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site2_gene', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', EXON_NUM VARCHAR(100) PATH 'exon_num', AA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'aa_change', NORMAL_VFREQ VARCHAR(100) PATH 'normal_vfreq', TUMOR_VFREQ VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_vfreq', MAFREQ_1000G VARCHAR(100) PATH 'mafreq_1000g', CHROMOSOME VARCHAR(100) PATH 'chromosome', CDNA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'cDNA_change', GENE_FOLD_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_fold_change', NORMAL_DP VARCHAR(100) PATH 'normal_dp', TUMOR_DP VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_dp', NORMAL_AD VARCHAR(100) PATH 'normal_ad', TUMOR_AD VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_ad', START_POSITION int PATH 'start_position', ALT_ALLELE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'alt_allele', REF_ALLELE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'ref_allele', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'variant_type', PROJECT VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_alys_task_name', SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id') T WHERE 1=1 AND PDWS_NAME IN ('IMPACT - HEME', 'IMPACT') AND PT_MRN IN (SELECT PT_MRN FROM X) ) , CONSENT_09_141 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE AS "09-141 Consent Date", AC_OFF_STUDY_DTE AS "09-141 Off Date" FROM DMP JOIN DV.ACCRUALS ACC_1 ON ACC_1.AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PID JOIN DV.PROTOCOL PRO_1 ON PRO_1.PRO_PROTOCOL_ID = ACC_1.AC_PROTOCOL_ID AND PRO_1.PRO_IRB_NO = '09-141') , CONSENT_06_107 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE AS "06-107 Consent Date", AC_OFF_STUDY_DTE AS "06-107 Off Date" FROM DMP JOIN DV.ACCRUALS ACC_1 ON ACC_1.AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PID JOIN DV.PROTOCOL PRO_1 ON PRO_1.PRO_PROTOCOL_ID = ACC_1.AC_PROTOCOL_ID AND PRO_1.PRO_IRB_NO = '06-107') , CONSENT_12_245 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE AS "12-245 Consent Date", AC_OFF_STUDY_DTE AS "12-245 Off Date" FROM DMP JOIN DV.ACCRUALS ACC_1 ON ACC_1.AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PID JOIN DV.PROTOCOL PRO_1 ON PRO_1.PRO_PROTOCOL_ID = ACC_1.AC_PROTOCOL_ID AND PRO_1.PRO_IRB_NO = '12-245') , MAIN AS (SELECT DMP.* , "09-141 Consent Date" , "09-141 Off Date" , "06-107 Consent Date" , "06-107 Off Date" , "12-245 Consent Date" , "12-245 Off Date" FROM DMP LEFT JOIN CONSENT_06_107 ON DMP.PT_MRN = CONSENT_06_107.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN CONSENT_09_141 ON DMP.PT_MRN = CONSENT_09_141.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN CONSENT_12_245 ON DMP.PT_MRN = CONSENT_12_245.PT_MRN) SELECT * FROM MAIN ORDER BY PT_MRN, "Accession No", GENE_ID

prompt: MRN for a list of de-ID MRNs generated in Darwin.
Please provide a list of all patients initiated on therapeutic anticoagulation (oral or injection)including (Enoxaparin, Apixaban, Rivaroxaban) in all of the SCC sites from June 2020 to August 2020.
completion: WITH VISIT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN , OCV_VISIT_GUID , CPE_ENC_DTE , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CPE_ENC_CSN_ID = OCV_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE 'SCC%' OR CLD_DEPT_ABBR LIKE 'SCC%') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-06-01' AND '2020-08-31' ) , AG AS (SELECT HCPR_MRN MRN , HCPR_VISIT_GUID VISIT_GUID , HGN_GENERIC_NAME ANTICOAG , CAST(HCPR_DOSE_AMT AS VARCHAR(255)) DOSE , HRUM_NAME DOSE_UNIT, HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID PVDR_GUID FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE ON HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID = HRUM_RXUOM_ID JOIN VISIT ON HCPR_MRN = CPE_MRN AND HCPR_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID WHERE HGN_GENERIC_NAME IN ('enoxaparin', 'rivaroxaban', 'apixaban', 'fondaparinux', 'edoxaban', 'dabigatran', 'heparin', 'heparin flush', 'warfarin') AND HCPR_STATUS_TYPE_DESC <> 'Cancelled' AND HGN_GENERIC_NAME NOT IN ('heparin flush') UNION SELECT OO_MRN MRN , OO_VISIT_GUID VISIT_GUID , OO_ORD_NAME ANTICOAG , OMD_DOSE_LOW DOSE , OMD_DOSE_UNIT DOSE_UNIT, OO_PVDR_GUID PVDR_GUID FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OO_ORD_GUID = OMD_ORD_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND (UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) like '%ENOXAPARIN%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) like '%RIVAROXABAN%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) like '%APIXABAN%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) like '%FONDAPARINUX%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) like '%EDOXABAN%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) like '%DABIGATRAN%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) like '%HEPARIN%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) like '%WARFARIN%') AND LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) not like 'heparin irrigation%' AND LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) not like 'heparins contraindicated%' AND LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) not like 'heparin 5000%' ) , PTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN PT_MRN FROM VISIT UNION SELECT MRN PT_MRN FROM AG) SELECT CPE_MRN MRN , PT_NAME , CPE_ENC_DTE VISIT_DTE , ANTICOAG , DOSE , DOSE_UNIT , OP_DISPLAY_NAME ORD_PROVIDER , OP_PROV_TYPE PROVIDER_TYPE FROM VISIT JOIN AG ON CPE_MRN = MRN AND OCV_VISIT_GUID = VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID

prompt: Provide data for saved query "Bladder: Nested Variant".
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t2"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Description", "t3"."DT_YEAR" AS "Pathology Report Year", "t4"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t4"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t4"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t5"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t6"."TCA_CASE_STS_DESC" AS "Case Status" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t7" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t2" ON "t7"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V" "t6" ON "t7"."CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID" = "t6"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT" "t5" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t5"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE (("t2"."ICSC_SITE_CD" IN ('C670', 'C671', 'C672', 'C673', 'C674', 'C675', 'C678', 'C679') AND CONTAINS("t5"."PRPT_DEID_REPORT", '"nested"') = 1) AND "t5"."PRPT_DEID_REPORT" IS NOT NULL)

prompt: We are looking to quantify referral information for ancillary services at 53rd Street.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, A.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT, B.CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DATE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VT_NAME, C.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS REF_DEPT, D.CRE_RES_NAME AS REF_PROVIDER FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT A ON CPE_DEPT_ID = A.CLD_DEPT_ID AND A.CLD_DEPT_ID IN (154, 318, 239, 26, 253, 267, 605, 723, 185) JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE B ON B.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT C ON CPE_REF_DEP_ID = C.CLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE D ON D.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_REF_RES_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2018-12-31'

prompt: test summary
completion: SELECT * FROM IDB.DRUG_TYPES LIMIT 10;

prompt: Would like a report to be scheduled weekly and formatted
completion: SELECT CV_MRN, RPT_PAT_NAME, CV_ADM_DTE, CV_DSCH_DTE, CV_FINALIZED_IND, CV_SVC, CC_CLSF_CD, CC_ENTRY_SEQ_NO, SVC_CD, HCPCS FROM (SELECT CV_MRN, RPT_PAT_NAME, CV_ADM_DTE, CV_DSCH_DTE, CV_FINALIZED_IND, CV_SVC, CC_CLSF_CD, CC_ENTRY_SEQ_NO, DATE(CV_CTC_CHANGE_DT) CTC_FINALIZIED_DTE, RVCD_POST_DTE RMS_POST_DATE, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(RCDD_CHARGE_CD, 1, 3) IN ('SDH', 'ORS') THEN RCDD_CHARGE_CD END) , MAX(CASE WHEN RTRIM(RMHD_MEDICARE_HCPCS_CODE) = RTRIM(CC_CLSF_CD) THEN RCDD_CHARGE_CD END)) SVC_CD, MAX(RMHD_MEDICARE_HCPCS_CODE) HCPCS FROM IDB.CTC_VISIT JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_VISIT_ID = CV_VISIT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT_CHARGE_DTL ON RVCD_MRN = CC_MRN AND RVCD_SVC_DTE = CC_EFF_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.RMS_PATIENT ON RVCD_MRN = RPT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.RMS_CHARGE_CODE_DICT_DN1240 CHG ON RVCD_CHARGE_CODE_REC_NO = RCDD_RECORD_NUMBER LEFT JOIN IDB.RMS_MEDICARE_HCPCS_DICT_DN1280 ON RMHD_RECORD_NUMBER = RCDD_CPT4_HCPCS_CD_REC_NO AND (SUBSTR(RCDD_CHARGE_CD, 1, 3) IN ('SDH', 'ORS') OR RTRIM(RMHD_MEDICARE_HCPCS_CODE) = RTRIM(CC_CLSF_CD)) WHERE CV_ADM_DTE >= '2022-01-01' AND CC_EFF_DTE >= '2023-01-01' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE = 'PHH' AND CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '38220' AND '38222' GROUP BY CV_MRN, CV_ADM_DTE, CV_DSCH_DTE, CV_FINALIZED_IND, CV_SVC, CC_CLSF_CD, CC_ENTRY_SEQ_NO, RPT_PAT_NAME, RVCD_POST_DTE, DATE(CV_CTC_CHANGE_DT) ) A WHERE CTC_FINALIZIED_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 7 DAY OR RMS_POST_DATE >= CURRENT DATE - 7 DAY

prompt: Create Darwin cohort notification for patients with small cell lung cancer admitted to the hospital, referred to neurology, or ordered for an MRI or CT brain to prospectively try to identify patients undergoing lumbar punctures.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID, PT_MRN, PRIMARY_SITE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS PT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site' , TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name') T WHERE LOWER(PRIMARY_SITE) IN ('lung') AND (LOWER(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) like '%small%' AND LOWER(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) not like '%non-small%' AND LOWER(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) not like '%non small%') AND PT_VITAL_STATUS = 'ALIVE' ) , PRE_DX AS (SELECT P_ID, PT_MRN, DT_DTE, DXCC_ICD_CODE, DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC, ICSC_SITE_CD, ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC, TCA_CASE_STS_DESC FROM PTS JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR_V ON CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = P_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V ON CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID = TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID WHERE ICSC_SITE_CD like 'C34%' AND DXCC_ICD_CODE IN('M8041/2', 'M8041/3', 'M8042/3', 'M8043/3', 'M8045/3') ) , DX AS (SELECT P_ID AS P_ID, PT_MRN AS PT_MRN FROM PRE_DX UNION SELECT P_ID AS P_ID, PT_MRN AS PT_MRN FROM PTS) , ORDERS AS (SELECT DISTINCT P_ID, OOC_ITEM_NAME AS ORDER_NAME FROM DX JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Neurosurgery External Consult', 'Neurosurgery Inpatient Consult', 'Brain Ambulatory Consult', 'Brain Metastasis Team Consult', 'UCC ..Assessment', 'UCC Inpatient Consult Orders', 'UCC Inpatient Transfer to CDU Inpatient', 'UCC Intake Standard Orders', 'UCC Notification', 'UCC Notification (NO)', 'UCC TeleTriage Notification (NO)', 'UCC_TeleTriage_Assessment', 'UCC Observation', 'Symptomatic Care Clinic', 'Body Fluid Cell Count and Differential CSF', 'Circulating Tumor Cells, CSF', 'LP/Intrathecal tests_by LIP', 'Bacterial/Fungal Cult, CSF', 'IP_CSF_Evaluation', 'Body Fluid Cell Count and Differential CSF', 'Glucose, CSF', 'CSF Order Set', 'LP/Intrathecal tests_in_Radiology', 'IP_.Neuro_CSF/Lumbar Puncture/Ommaya', 'ICU_Lumbar Puncture', 'XR:Lumbar Puncture For Diagnosis', 'Circulating Tumor Cells, CSF', 'Cytology-Non GYN', 'Cytology-Non GYN Order') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') UNION SELECT DISTINCT P_ID, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME AS ORDER_NAME FROM DX JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V ON RRPT_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME IN ('MR BRAIN HGG PERF W/WO CON', 'MR BRAIN W/WO CON', 'MR ANGIOGRAPHY OF HEAD W/O CON', 'CT BRAIN W/O CON', 'MR TOTAL SPINE SURVEY W/WO') ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.P_ID FROM ORDERS A)

prompt: List of all submitted slides orders that are released by Dr. Eli Diamond or any submitted slides orders with diagnosis of "Histiocytosis", "Langerhans Cell Histiocytosis", or "ECD"
completion: WITH ORDERS AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, DOC_NAME, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Cancer Dx' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) AS "Cancer Dx", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'PPATH_SUBSL_Collect Date1' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) AS "Collection Date 1", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'PPATH_SUBSL_Collect Date2' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) AS "Collection Date 2" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Cancer Dx', 'PPATH_SUBSL_Collect Date1', 'PPATH_SUBSL_Collect Date2') WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Surgical Pathology Submitted Slides Order' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= '2018-01-01' GROUP BY OO_MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, DOC_NAME) SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE "Released Date", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", "Cancer Dx", "Collection Date 1", "Collection Date 2" FROM ORDERS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE DOC_NAME = 'DIAMOND MD,ELI L' OR LOWER(TRIM("Cancer Dx")) IN ('histiocytosis', 'langerhans cell histiocytosis', 'ecd', 'langerhans cell histiocytosis (lch in cerebellum)', 'lch')

prompt: Provide a list of patients treated with mogamulizumab
completion: WITH CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS FIRST_CHEMO_START, MAX(APR_START_DTE) AS LAST_CHEMO_START FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON APR_MRN = AC_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO IN ('12-245', '06-107', '09-141') WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'MOGAMULIZUMAB' GROUP BY APR_MRN) SELECT TM_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, FIRST_CHEMO_START, LAST_CHEMO_START, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN CHEMO ON TM_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON TM_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ; WITH CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS FIRST_CHEMO_START, MAX(APR_START_DTE) AS LAST_CHEMO_START FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON APR_MRN = AC_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO IN ('12-245', '06-107', '09-141') WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'MOGAMULIZUMAB' GROUP BY APR_MRN) SELECT LR_MRN, FIRST_CHEMO_START, LAST_CHEMO_START, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LTL_TEXT_RESULT, LR_ABNORMALITY_CD FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID JOIN CHEMO ON LR_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%EBV%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%CMV%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%HTLV%'

prompt: Generate a cohort on the Darwin digital platform of all patients on 18-254 who had tx of nivolumab
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS) , PROTOCOL AS (SELECT AC_MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID FROM IDB.PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO JOIN PTS ON PT_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE PRO_IRB_NO = '18-254' ) , NIVOLUMAB AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE 1=1 AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'NIVOLUMAB' ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM PROTOCOL JOIN NIVOLUMAB ON APR_MRN = AC_MRN)

prompt: Provide a report of clinical information on a list of patients with oligometastatic esophageal and gastric cancer.
completion: WITH PT AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.PATIENT WHERE PT_MRN IN () ) , CDB AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, CATEGORY2, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_CLIN_TNM_T, TM_CLIN_TNM_N, TM_CLIN_TNM_M, TM_PATH_TNM_T, TM_PATH_TNM_N, TM_PATH_TNM_M FROM PT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY2 IN ('Esophagus', 'Stomach') JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) , KPS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM PT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND(UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%KPS%' OR UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%KARNOFSKY%') ) , APR AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_CHEMO_FLAG, CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG, CDG_TARGETED_FLAG FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE(CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' OR CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG = 'Y' OR CDG_TARGETED_FLAG = 'Y') AND APR_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM PT)) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, GENE, RESULT, METHOD FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE PT_MRN IN () AND(GENE like '%ERBB%' OR GENE like '%MSI%') WITH X AS (SELECT PT_MRN FROM IDB.PATIENT WHERE PT_MRN IN () ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, T.* FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'msi-score', MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'msi-type', MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(100) PATH 'msi-comment') T WHERE PT_MRN IN (SELECT PT_MRN FROM X) ) SELECT * FROM Y WHERE MSI_TYPE IS NOT NULL

prompt: Monitor referrals to newly launched CATCH program.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS MRN , RTRIM(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME AS PATIENT_NAME, OUO_CURR_LOC AS LOCATION, OO_ORD_NAME AS ORDER_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS START_DATE , REPLACE (CHAR(TIME(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT)), '.', ':') AS REQ_TIME, OUO_USER_NAME AS ENTER_USER, OUO_PVDR_NAME AS REQUESTER, RTRIM(OO_ORD_STS_CD)||' - '||OUO_STS_DESC AS CURR_STS, OO_SUMMARY_LINE , DX.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS GENETIC_DX, TX.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS ACTIVE_TX, HX.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS CANCER_HX FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA DX ON DX.OUD_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID AND DX.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'CONSULT_Here Surv_Dx' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA HX ON HX.OUD_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID AND HX.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'CONSULT_Here Surv_Hx' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA TX ON TX.OUD_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID AND TX.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'CONSULT_Here Surv_Tx' WHERE 1=1 AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANCD', 'AUC3') AND (UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%CATCH%' OR OO_ORD_NAME = 'Hereditary Surveillance Clinic Referral') ) , APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN , CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER , CRE_RES_ID AS PROV_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DTE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR AS VT_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID AS CSN, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS AS APPT_STS , CPE_APPT_DT AS APPT_DT FROM PTS LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= START_DATE AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Sch', 'Arrived') AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('024075' , '082610' , '019950') ) SELECT MRN, PATIENT_NAME , ORDER_NAME, START_DATE , LOCATION, REQ_TIME, ENTER_USER, REQUESTER, CURR_STS, OO_SUMMARY_LINE, GENETIC_DX, ACTIVE_TX, CANCER_HX , DEPT_NAME, PROVIDER , PROV_ID, APPT_DTE, VT_ABBR, VT_NAME , CSN, APPT_STS , APPT_DT FROM PTS LEFT JOIN APPT ON CPE_MRN = MRN AND APPT_DTE >= START_DATE AND NOT CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GNT'

prompt: Create report that displays daily IP and OP discharges from GMT Service.
completion: SELECT OCV_MRN, OCV_ACCT_NO, OCV_VISIT_DTE, OCV_ADM_DT, OCV_DSCH_DT , OCV_VISIT_STS, OCV_IP_OP_IND, OCV_CARE_LVL , OCV_CURR_LOC, OCV_PVDR_NAME, OS_SVC_GRP_CD, OS_SVC_DESC , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FROM IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON OCV_MRN = SSE_MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE = OCV_VISIT_DTE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OCV_MRN WHERE OCV_VISIT_DTE = CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY AND OS_SVC_GRP_CD = 'GMT' AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'O' UNION ALL SELECT OCV_MRN, OCV_ACCT_NO, OCV_VISIT_DTE, OCV_ADM_DT, OCV_DSCH_DT , OCV_VISIT_STS, OCV_IP_OP_IND, OCV_CARE_LVL , OCV_CURR_LOC, OCV_PVDR_NAME, OS_SVC_GRP_CD, OS_SVC_DESC , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FROM (SELECT OCV_MRN, OCV_ACCT_NO, OCV_VISIT_DTE, OCV_ADM_DT, OCV_DSCH_DT , OCV_VISIT_STS, OCV_IP_OP_IND, OCV_CARE_LVL , OCV_CURR_LOC, OCV_PVDR_NAME, OS_SVC_GRP_CD, OS_SVC_DESC , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OCV_MRN, OCV_ACCT_NO, OCV_VISIT_DTE ORDER BY OCV_MRN, OCV_ACCT_NO, OCV_VISIT_DTE, OCV_DSCH_DT DESC) RN FROM IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OCV_MRN WHERE OCV_VISIT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 6 MONTH AND CURRENT DATE AND OS_SVC_GRP_CD = 'GMT' AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'I' AND DATE(OCV_DSCH_DT) = CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY ) IP WHERE RN = 1

prompt: Provide count of patients with Multiple Myeloma who have received an autologous stem cell transplant during the year 2011, how many of these patients are Russian and Spanish speaking.
completion: SELECT CAV_NAME AS LANG, COUNT(DISTINCT D.CC_MRN) AS COUNT FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF D JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF P ON P.CC_MRN = D.CC_MRN AND P.CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2011-01-01' AND '2011-12-31' AND P.CC_CLSF_CD IN ('41.0', '41.00', '41.01', '41.03', '41.04', '41.07', '41.09') AND P.CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'P%' AND P.CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON D.CC_MRN = CPP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY ON CPP_LANG = CAV_ABBR AND CAV_CATEGORY = 'LANG' WHERE D.CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND D.CC_CLSF_CD IN ('203', '203.0', '203.00', '203.01', '203.02') AND (D.CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (D.CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND D.CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CAV_NAME

prompt: Provide a report of all neutropenia patients with ANC values < 1 or WBC values <=.5 within 1 day of a UCC visit from 1/1/2016 - 12/31/2020.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "UCC Visit Date", LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME AS TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS SUBTEST_NAME, CAST(LR_RESULT_VALUE AS REAL) AS RESULT_VALUE_REAL FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_MRN = CPE_MRN AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN CPE_ENC_DTE - 1 DAY AND CPE_ENC_DTE + 1 DAY LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_DEPT_ID = 230 AND UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%ABS NEUT%' AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND LR_RESULT_VALUE < '1' AND LR_RESULT_VALUE <> '' AND LR_RESULT_VALUE NOT IN ('----', 'CLOTTED', 'CLOTTED.', 'Cancel', 'Clotted', 'Footnote', 'N/A', 'NA', 'NM', 'NOT MEASURED', 'PREVIOUS DIFF PERFORMED.', 'QNS', 'SEE COMMENTS', 'SEE NOTE', 'See Manual Diff', 'WRONG PT', 'canceled', 'clotted', 'na', 'wrong pt') SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "UCC Visit Date", LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME AS TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT_VALUE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_MRN = CPE_MRN AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN CPE_ENC_DTE - 1 DAY AND CPE_ENC_DTE + 1 DAY LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_DEPT_ID = 230 AND UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%WBC%' AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND(LR_RESULT_VALUE like '0.0%' OR LR_RESULT_VALUE like '0.1%' OR LR_RESULT_VALUE like '0.2%' OR LR_RESULT_VALUE like '0.3%' OR LR_RESULT_VALUE like '0.4%' OR LR_RESULT_VALUE = '0' OR LR_RESULT_VALUE = '0.5' OR LR_RESULT_VALUE = '0.50') AND LR_RESULT_VALUE <> '' AND LR_RESULT_VALUE not like '%-%' AND LR_RESULT_VALUE NOT IN ('<0.1', '<0.10', '#V', '<CLOTTED', '>50', 'clotted', 'Clotted', 'CLOTTED', 'CLOTTED.', 'N/A', 'None Seen', 'NONE SEEN', 'Not Performed', 'Rare', 'SEE COMMENTS') UNION SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "UCC Visit Date", LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME AS TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT_VALUE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_MRN = CPE_MRN AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN CPE_ENC_DTE - 1 DAY AND CPE_ENC_DTE + 1 DAY LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_DEPT_ID = 230 AND UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%WBC%' AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND LR_RESULT_VALUE IN ('<0.1', '<0.10') AND LR_RESULT_VALUE <> '' AND LR_RESULT_VALUE NOT IN ('#V', '<CLOTTED', '>50', 'clotted', 'Clotted', 'CLOTTED', 'CLOTTED.', 'N/A', 'None Seen', 'NONE SEEN', 'Not Performed', 'Rare', 'SEE COMMENTS')

prompt: Quality of life survey results for the given set of MRNs
completion: WITH SURVEY AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT.EPI_MRN AS MRN, PT.EPI_BIRTH_DTE AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, 'Quality of Life Symptom Survey' AS SURVEY_NAME , ASS.EA_SUBM_DT AS SUBMISSION_DATE, ASS.EA_ASSIGN_DT AS ASSIGNMENT_DATE , EQ_SHORT_NAME AS QUESTION , A.EA_SHORT_NAME AS ANSWER , TR.ETBR_TEXT AS TEXTBLOCK_RESPONSE , NR.ENR_NO AS NUMBER_RESPONSE FROM IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT AS ASS JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT_DTL AS AD ON AD.EAD_ASSESS_DTL_ID = ASS.EA_ASSESS_DTL_ID JOIN IDB.EF_PATIENT_INFO PT ON ASS.EA_PT_INFO_ID = PT.EPI_PT_INFO_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_RESPONSE R ON R.ERESP_ASSESS_ID = ASS.EA_ASSESS_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_ANSWER A ON A.EA_ANSWER_ID = R.ERESP_ANSWER_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_QUESTION Q ON Q.EQ_QUESTION_ID = A.EA_QUESTION_ID JOIN IDB.EF_SURVEY_ELEMENT SE ON A.EA_QUESTION_ID = SE.ESE_IDENTITY_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.EF_TEXT_BOX_RESPONSE TR ON TR.ETBR_ID =R.ERESP_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.EF_NUMERIC_RESPONSE NR ON NR.ENR_ID =R.ERESP_ID WHERE ASS.EA_SURV_ID ='106' AND ASS.EA_STS_ID = 3 AND DATE(ASS.EA_ASSIGN_DT) >= '2022-05-01' AND EPI_MRN IN ('38141148', '35282509', '38086130', '38083843', '35423469', '38118166', '35503074', '38058728', '38194399', '38202587', '38205488', '38206105', '38085198', '38205986', '35570873', '35565667', '38215797', '38204149', '38218445', '35545289', '38219095', '38233049') ) SELECT S.*, AC_CONS_DTE AS "Consent Date(21-135)", CASE WHEN AC_CONS_DTE IS NULL AND AC_IRB_NO = '21-135' THEN 'N' WHEN AC_CONS_DTE IS NOT NULL AND AC_IRB_NO = '21-135' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'NA' END AS CONSENT_21_135 FROM SURVEY S LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON S.MRN = AC_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO = '21-135'

prompt: I would like to request a data line search with regards to one of the dental fellows treatment room (room# 4).
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, PT_SEX_DESC SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, CPE_ENC_DTE SCH_VST_DATE, VD.CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME, CPE_APPT_DT APPT_DT, VT.CRE_RES_NAME VST_MD, LISTAGG(TRIM(CPAN_NOTE), ' , ') AS "Visit Notes" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT ON CPA_CL_PT_ID = CPE_CL_PT_ID AND CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VT ON VT.CRE_RES_ID = CPA_RES_ID AND VT.CRE_RES_ID = '300248' JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT VD ON CPA_DEPT_ID = VD.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES ON CPAN_CL_PT_ID = CPA_CL_PT_ID AND CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-07-01' AND '2020-05-31' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') GROUP BY CPE_MRN , STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) , PT_SEX_DESC, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE , CPE_ENC_DTE , VD.CLD_DEPT_NAME , CPE_APPT_DT , VT.CRE_RES_NAME

prompt: On demand list for patient diagnosis
completion: SELECT TRIM(CC_MRN) "MRN", MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS "Diagnosis Date", TRIM(CC_CLSF_CD) AS "ICD COde", TRIM(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS "ICD Description" FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_MRN = '38039803' GROUP BY TRIM(CC_MRN), TRIM(CC_CLSF_CD), TRIM(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK)

prompt: Provide a list of patients with the listed disease names in a pathology free text search plus the related clinical data points
completion: SELECT PRPT_MRN, CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END AS AGE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DATE_OF_DEATH, TRIM(G.AV_DESC) AS GENDER, TRIM(R.AV_DESC) AS RACE, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_CODE = PT_SEX AND G.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("choledochal cyst" OR "bile duct cyst" OR "caroli disease" OR "choledochal" OR "bile duct dilation")') = 1 ; WITH COHORT AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END AS AGE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DATE_OF_DEATH, TRIM(G.AV_DESC) AS GENDER, TRIM(R.AV_DESC) AS RACE, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_CODE = PT_SEX AND G.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("choledochal cyst" OR "bile duct cyst" OR "caroli disease" OR "choledochal" OR "bile duct dilation")') = 1 ), LAB AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS JOIN COHORT ON PRPT_MRN = LR_MRN WHERE LR_TEST_NAME IN ('Carcinoembryonic Antigen (CEA)', 'CEA', 'Cancer Antigen 19-9', 'Cancer Antigen 19-9 (CA 19-9)', 'Bilirubin, Direct', 'Bilirubin, Total') ) SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE FROM COHORT JOIN LAB ON PRPT_MRN = LR_MRN ; WITH COHORT AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END AS AGE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DATE_OF_DEATH, TRIM(G.AV_DESC) AS GENDER, TRIM(R.AV_DESC) AS RACE, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT, PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME, PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC_DESC FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_CODE = PT_SEX AND G.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("choledochal cyst" OR "bile duct cyst" OR "caroli disease" OR "choledochal" OR "bile duct dilation")') = 1 ), PROC AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN COHORT ON PRPT_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID) SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM COHORT JOIN PROC ON PRPT_MRN = SSE_MRN ; WITH COHORT AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END AS AGE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DATE_OF_DEATH, TRIM(G.AV_DESC) AS GENDER, TRIM(R.AV_DESC) AS RACE, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT, PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME, PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC_DESC FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_CODE = PT_SEX AND G.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("choledochal cyst" OR "bile duct cyst" OR "caroli disease" OR "choledochal" OR "bile duct dilation")') = 1 ), RAD AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_RPT_ID, RRPT_ACCESSION_NO, RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, CAST(RRPT_REPORT_TXT AS VARCHAR(32000)) AS RAD_REPORT FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN COHORT ON PRPT_MRN = RRPT_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_ACCESSION_NO, RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, RAD_REPORT FROM COHORT JOIN RAD ON PRPT_MRN = RRPT_MRN ; WITH COHORT AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END AS AGE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DATE_OF_DEATH, TRIM(G.AV_DESC) AS GENDER, TRIM(R.AV_DESC) AS RACE, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT, PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME, PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC_DESC FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_CODE = PT_SEX AND G.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("choledochal cyst" OR "bile duct cyst" OR "caroli disease" OR "choledochal" OR "bile duct dilation")') = 1 ), SUR_COMP AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN COMP_MRN , SAE_TOXICITY_NAME AS COMP_NAME FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN COHORT ON SSE_MRN = PRPT_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.SRG_ADVERSE_EVENT ON SSE_LOG_ID = SAE_SURG_LOG_ID AND SAE_PROC_SEQ_NO = SSP_PROC_SEQ_NO AND SAE_TOX_GRADE > '0') SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN, COMP_NAME FROM COHORT JOIN SUR_COMP ON PRPT_MRN = COMP_MRN ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients seen by the supportive care inpatient team that get discharged without a SUPP outpatient appointment.
completion: WITH VIS AS (SELECT VIS_MRN, VIS_ADM_DTE AS ADM_DATE, VIS_DSCH_DTE AS DISCH_DATE, ADM_DR_NAME AS VIS_PROVIDER, OO_ENTER_DTE AS ORDER_ENTERED, OO_MRN, DATE(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT) ORD_DATE FROM IDB.VISIT_V LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN = VIS_MRN AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000018057100730' AND DATE(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT) BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND VIS_DSCH_DTE WHERE VIS_PATIENT_TYPE = 'IP' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_DSCH_TYPE = 'DSCH' AND VIS_DSCH_DTE = CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY ) , CDD AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_DOC_NAME , CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID AS DOCGUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS PROVIDER_NOTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN VIS ON VIS_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Follow Up Consultation - DOM-Supportive Care', 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, IP - DOM-Supportive Care') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN ADM_DATE AND DISCH_DATE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' ), AUTHORS AS (SELECT DISTINCT C.CDD_MRN AS A_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID AS A_DOC_GUID, C.CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS A_SERVICE_DTE, C.CDD_DOC_NAME AS A_DOC_NAME, TRIM(U1.OU_DISPLAY_NAME) || ' ( ' || TRIM(U1.OU_OCCUPATION) || '-' || TRIM(U1.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE) || ' )' AS "Author", TRIM(U2.OU_DISPLAY_NAME) || ' ( ' || TRIM(U2.OU_OCCUPATION) || '-' || TRIM(U2.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE) || ' )' AS "Co-Author", CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID, CDH_USER_GUID FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT D JOIN CDD C ON D.CDD_DOC_GUID = DOCGUID AND RN =1 JOIN IDB.OMS_USER U1 ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = U1.OU_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT_HISTORY ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDH_CLIENT_DOC_GUID AND CDD_CLIENT_GUID = CDH_CLIENT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER U2 ON CDH_USER_GUID = U2.OU_USER_GUID) , APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN , CPE_ENC_DTE , CLD_CLD_CENTER AS CENTER, CLD_DEPT_NAME , CRE_RES_NAME , CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'SUP' THEN 'SUP' ELSE 'NON-SUP' END SVC_FLAG, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN , CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'SUP' THEN 'SUP' ELSE 'NON-SUP' END ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) FST, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VISIT_TYPE, CVT_EXT_NAME AS "Visit Type External" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN VIS ON VIS_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' ) SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN AS MRN, DISCH_DATE AS "Discharge Date", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Patient Name", A_SERVICE_DTE AS "Note Date", "Author", "Co-Author", S.CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Upcoming Supp care Appt", TRIM(S.CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Supp care Provider Name", S.VISIT_TYPE AS "Supp care Visit Type", S.CENTER AS "Supp care Appt location", N.CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Upcoming MD Appt", TRIM(N.CRE_RES_NAME) AS "MD Appt Provider Name", N.VISIT_TYPE AS "MD Appt Visit Type", N.CENTER AS "MD Appt Location", N.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CASE WHEN OO_MRN <> '' THEN 'Y' END AS "Supp Care OP AFX Visit- Order Flag", ORDER_ENTERED AS "Order Entered Date" FROM VIS V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = VIS_MRN LEFT JOIN AUTHORS ON A_MRN = VIS_MRN LEFT JOIN APPT S ON S.CPE_MRN = VIS_MRN AND S.FST =1 AND S.SVC_FLAG = 'SUP' LEFT JOIN APPT N ON N.CPE_MRN = VIS_MRN AND N.FST =1 AND N.SVC_FLAG = 'NON-SUP' ;

prompt: Provide ClinDoc exercise-related data for assessments completed by pts in IRB #19-486.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '19-486') SELECT EF_MRN , EF_FORM_NAME , DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) AS SUBMIT_DTE , EFI_ITEM_EXTERNAL_ID AS QUES_ID , EFI_ITEM_TEXT AS QUESTION , EFI_VALUE AS ANSWER , EF_FORM_ID FROM IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM ON EF_FORM_EXTERNAL_ID = EA_ASSESS_ID JOIN PTS ON MRN = EF_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID WHERE 1=1 AND EF_FORM_NAME = 'Lifestyle Questionnaire' AND EFI_VALUE_TYPE NOT IN ('TableRow', 'Table') ORDER BY EF_MRN, EF_FORM_NAME, EF_FORM_ID, EFI_ITEM_EXTERNAL_ID ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '19-486') SELECT CDD_MRN , CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_ITEM_NAME , CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID , CDD_DOC_GUID , CDO_DSCRMNT_LABEL , VARCHAR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 500) AS VALUE_TEXT , CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM , CDD_PTCAREDOC_GUID , CDO_DSCRMNT_SEQ , CDD_DOC_NAME , CDO_SECTION , OP_DISPLAY_NAME FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN PTS ON MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = CDD_USER_GUID WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_PTCAREDOC_GUID IN ('xyz' , '9000001705102020' , '9000001796102020' , '9000001818202020' , '9000001642202020' , '9000001884202020' , '9000001740202020' , '9000001630302020' , '9000001685102020') ORDER BY CDD_MRN , CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_ITEM_NAME , CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID ;

prompt: Provide count and reason for PET scan cancelations within the last 3 years.
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN" , CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date" , MONTH(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS "MM" , YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS "YY" , VARCHAR_FORMAT(CPE_ENC_DTE, 'YYYY-MM') AS "YYYY-MM" , CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department" , CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name" , CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name" , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" , CVT_EXT_NAME AS "Visit Type External" , CPE_CPE_APPT_STS AS "Status" , CPE_CPE_CANCEL_RSN AS "Cancelation Reason" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Can', 'CxlSameDay') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND = 'INPATIENT' AND CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%PET%' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'NUC' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME <> 'NM INJECTION - NO SCAN' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2024-01-01'

prompt: Provide a list of patients who have had or are scheduled to have an appointment with Dr. Abramson or Dr. Marr and have consented to IRB# 12-245 or IRB# 06-107.
completion: WITH CPE AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(CPE_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, STRIP(PT_SEX) AS GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, STRIP(R.AV_DESC) AS "Race", STRIP(E.AV_DESC) AS "Ethnicity" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived', 'Sch') AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('011593', '014076') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2006-01-01' ) , AC AS (SELECT AC_MRN AS MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "06-107", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "12-245" FROM CPE JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS AC ON MRN = AC_MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '12-245') GROUP BY AC_MRN ) , CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, AV_DESC AS LATERALITY FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'LATERALITY_CD' AND AV_CODE = TM_LATERALITY_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM AC) UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS TM_DX_DTE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS SITE_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, '' AS HIST_CODE, '' AS HIST_DESC, '' AS LATERALITY FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND(CC_CLSF_CD IN ('190.5', 'C69.2', 'C69.20', 'C69.21', 'C69.22') OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'H35%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '362%') AND CC_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM AC) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , CTE AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS DX_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, STRIP(SITE_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(SITE_DESC) || '|' || STRIP(HIST_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(HIST_DESC) || ' : ' ||STRIP(LATERALITY) AS DX_CODE FROM CDB) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(2500))||' | '||CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(500))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(100))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN, RN, REPLACE(DX, '|- :', '') AS DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) , SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM AC JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('65103', '65105', '67208', '67210', '67218', '67412', '92226') ) , SRG1 AS (SELECT SSE_MRN AS SRG_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE prompt: COVID-19 Patient Detail dashboard for clinical staff
completion: WITH IP AS (SELECT CCV_MRN, CCV_ADMIT_DT, CCV_PROVIDER_NAME, CCV_DISCHARGE_DT, CCV_SERVICE_GROUP_CODE, CCV_SERVICE_DESC, OL_LOC_NAME, CCV_CURRENT_LOCATION FROM IDB.PATIENT_COVID_INFO_V JOIN IDB.COVID19_CLIENT_VISIT ON MRN = CCV_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON CCV_CURRENT_LOCATION_GUID = OL_LOC_GUID WHERE CCV_CARE_LEVEL_CODE <> 'Inpt Schedule' AND CCV_VISIT_STATUS IN ('ADM', 'DSC') AND CCV_VISIT_TYPE = 'Inpatient' AND COALESCE(CCV_DISCHARGE_DT, MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) >= MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT ) SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(MRN) "MRN", TRIM(LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(FIRST_NAME) "Name", DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of Death", RESULT "Result", MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT "Identified Date", MIN_RESULT_DT "Result Date", TRIM(OL_LOC_NAME) "In Hospital Nursing Station", TRIM(CCV_CURRENT_LOCATION) "In Hospital Bed", CASE WHEN OL_LOC_NAME IS NOT NULL AND CCV_DISCHARGE_DT IS NULL THEN 'Yes' WHEN CCV_DISCHARGE_DT IS NOT NULL THEN 'Discharged' ELSE 'No' END "In Hospital Flag", TRIM(CCV_SERVICE_GROUP_CODE) "Service Code", TRIM(CCV_SERVICE_DESC) "Service Description", CASE WHEN LEFT(TRIM(CCV_SERVICE_GROUP_CODE), 2) IN ('IC', 'AI') THEN 'Critical Care' ELSE TRIM(CCV_SERVICE_DESC) END AS "Service Description CC", CCV_ADMIT_DT "Admit Date", CCV_DISCHARGE_DT "Discharge Date", TRIM(CCV_PROVIDER_NAME) "Attending Provider", TRIM(POSITIVE_SOURCES) "Positive Source", TRIM(NEGATIVE_SOURCES) "Negative Source", TRIM(PENDING_SOURCES) "Pending Source", CASE WHEN UPPER(POSITIVE_SOURCES) LIKE '%ORDER_AND_RESULT%' AND RESULT IN ('Positive', 'Resolved') THEN 'MSK Lab' WHEN UPPER(POSITIVE_SOURCES) NOT LIKE '%ORDER_AND_RESULT%' AND RESULT IN ('Positive', 'Resolved') THEN 'Non-MSK Lab' END "Lab Flag" FROM IDB.PATIENT_COVID_INFO_V LEFT JOIN IP ON MRN = CCV_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of patients with Axicabtagene Ciloleucel or Tisagenlecleucel orders and corresponding follow up ClinDoc notes
completion: WITH CD AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Immune Effector Toxicity and Status Assessment - BMT' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' ) , PEDS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN PEDS_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PED' OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = 'PED' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'ORTHOPEDICS 1275-9') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' AND DVCMS.GET_DEIDENT(CPE_MRN) IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT VIS_MRN PEDS_MRN FROM IDB.VISIT WHERE VIS_HOSP_SVC IN ('PDB', 'PDG', 'PDP', 'PDR', 'PDU', 'PED') AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND DVCMS.GET_DEIDENT(VIS_MRN) IS NOT NULL ) , MEDS AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_STS_CD, OO_SUMMARY_LINE, OO_ORD_TYPE_CD FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER WHERE OO_ORD_NAME IN ('Axicabtagene Ciloleucel INJ', 'Tisagenlecleucel INJ') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3', 'DISC') AND OO_MRN NOT IN (SELECT PEDS_MRN FROM PEDS) ) , IRB AS (SELECT AC_MRN, LISTAGG(TRIM(AC_IRB_NO), '; ') PROTOCOLS FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN FROM MEDS) JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON OO_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('08-047', '06-107', '09-141') GROUP BY AC_MRN ) SELECT OO_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", OO_ENTER_DTE "Order Entered Date", OO_ORD_NAME "Order Name", PROTOCOLS "Protocols", MAX(CASE WHEN CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN OO_ENTER_DTE + 7 DAYS - 3 DAYS AND OO_ENTER_DTE + 7 DAYS + 3 DAYS THEN CDD_SERVICE_DTE END) "1 Week ClinDoc Service Date", MAX(CASE WHEN CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN OO_ENTER_DTE + 14 DAYS - 3 DAYS AND OO_ENTER_DTE + 14 DAYS + 3 DAYS THEN CDD_SERVICE_DTE END) "2 Week ClinDoc Service Date", MAX(CASE WHEN CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN OO_ENTER_DTE + 21 DAYS - 3 DAYS AND OO_ENTER_DTE + 21 DAYS + 3 DAYS THEN CDD_SERVICE_DTE END) "3 Week ClinDoc Service Date", MAX(CASE WHEN CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN OO_ENTER_DTE + 30 DAYS - 3 DAYS AND OO_ENTER_DTE + 30 DAYS + 3 DAYS THEN CDD_SERVICE_DTE END) "4 Week ClinDoc Service Date", MAX(CASE WHEN CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN OO_ENTER_DTE + 2 MONTHS - 15 DAYS AND OO_ENTER_DTE + 2 MONTHS + 15 DAYS THEN CDD_SERVICE_DTE END) "2 Month ClinDoc Service Date", MAX(CASE WHEN CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN OO_ENTER_DTE + 100 DAYS - 15 DAYS AND OO_ENTER_DTE + 100 DAYS + 15 DAYS THEN CDD_SERVICE_DTE END) "100 Days ClinDoc Service Date", MAX(CASE WHEN CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN OO_ENTER_DTE + 6 MONTHS - 1 MONTH AND OO_ENTER_DTE + 6 MONTHS + 1 MONTH THEN CDD_SERVICE_DTE END) "6 Months ClinDoc Service Date", MAX(CASE WHEN CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN OO_ENTER_DTE + 1 YEAR - 2 MONTHS AND OO_ENTER_DTE + 1 YEAR + 2 MONTHS THEN CDD_SERVICE_DTE END) "1 Year ClinDoc Service Date", MAX(CASE WHEN CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN OO_ENTER_DTE + 2 YEAR - 2 MONTHS AND OO_ENTER_DTE + 2 YEAR + 2 MONTHS THEN CDD_SERVICE_DTE END) "2 Year ClinDoc Service Date" FROM MEDS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN CD ON OO_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= OO_ENTER_DTE LEFT JOIN IRB ON OO_MRN = AC_MRN GROUP BY OO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME, PROTOCOLS
