IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT PAT ON ENC.CPE_PRK = PAT.CPP_PRK LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.PAS_REFERRAL RFL ON ENC.CPE_CL_PT_ID = RFL.PRF_CL_PT_ID AND ENC.CPE_RFL_ID = RFL.PRF_RFL_ID AND RFL.PRF_RFL_STATUS = 'NEW' JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT DEP ON ENC.CPE_DEPT_ID = DEP.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE RES ON ENC.CPE_VST_RES_ID = RES.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE VT ON ENC.CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = VT.CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY MAIL ON ENC.CPE_MRN = MAIL.PLA_MRN LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.PAS_RFL_COMMENT CLIN1 ON RFL.PRF_RFL_ID = CLIN1.PRC_RFL_ID AND CLIN1.PRC_LINE_NO = 1 LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.PAS_RFL_COMMENT CLIN2 ON RFL.PRF_RFL_ID = CLIN2.PRC_RFL_ID AND CLIN2.PRC_LINE_NO = 2 LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.PAS_RFL_COMMENT CLIN3 ON RFL.PRF_RFL_ID = CLIN3.PRC_RFL_ID AND CLIN3.PRC_LINE_NO = 3 LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.PAS_RFL_COMMENT CLIN4 ON RFL.PRF_RFL_ID = CLIN4.PRC_RFL_ID AND CLIN4.PRC_LINE_NO = 4 LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.PAS_RFL_COMMENT CLIN5 ON RFL.PRF_RFL_ID = CLIN5.PRC_RFL_ID AND CLIN5.PRC_LINE_NO = 5 LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.PAS_RFL_REQ_MDS REQ1 ON RFL.PRF_RFL_ID = REQ1.PRRM_RFL_ID AND REQ1.PRRM_LINE_NO = 1 LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.PAS_RFL_REQ_MDS REQ2 ON RFL.PRF_RFL_ID = REQ2.PRRM_RFL_ID AND REQ2.PRRM_LINE_NO = 2 LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.PAS_RFL_REQ_MDS REQ3 ON RFL.PRF_RFL_ID = REQ3.PRRM_RFL_ID AND REQ3.PRRM_LINE_NO = 3 LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REQMD1 ON REQ1.PRRM_REQ_MD_ID = REQMD1.CRE_RES_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REQMD2 ON REQ2.PRRM_REQ_MD_ID = REQMD2.CRE_RES_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REQMD3 ON REQ3.PRRM_REQ_MD_ID = REQMD3.CRE_RES_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES NOTES1 ON ENC.CPE_CL_PT_ID = NOTES1.CPAN_CL_PT_ID AND ENC.CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = NOTES1.CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND NOTES1.CPAN_LINE_NO = 1 LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES NOTES2 ON ENC.CPE_CL_PT_ID = NOTES2.CPAN_CL_PT_ID AND ENC.CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = NOTES2.CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND NOTES2.CPAN_LINE_NO = 2 LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES NOTES3 ON ENC.CPE_CL_PT_ID = NOTES3.CPAN_CL_PT_ID AND ENC.CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = NOTES3.CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND NOTES3.CPAN_LINE_NO = 3 LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES NOTES4 ON ENC.CPE_CL_PT_ID = NOTES4.CPAN_CL_PT_ID AND ENC.CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = NOTES4.CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND NOTES4.CPAN_LINE_NO = 4 LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES NOTES5 ON ENC.CPE_CL_PT_ID = NOTES5.CPAN_CL_PT_ID AND ENC.CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = NOTES5.CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND NOTES5.CPAN_LINE_NO = 5 JOIN IDB.CL_USER U ON ENC.CPE_ENTER_USER_ID = U.CLE_USER_ID WHERE ENC.CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE BETWEEN '2020-04-01' AND '2023-05-10' AND YEAR(ENC.CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE - CPP_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 15 AND 39 AND (VT.CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%' OR VT.CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%') AND DEP.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('PED', 'MED') AND RES.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Psychologist', 'Dentist') AND ENC.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch', 'Arrived', 'Comp') AND (DEP.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('LEU', 'LYM', 'SAR', 'LEULYM') OR ENC.CPE_DEPT_ID IN (1523, 1532, 278, 118, 1570)) AND CASE WHEN ENC.CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE BETWEEN '2020-04-01' AND '2023-05-10' AND DEP.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('SAR') THEN 1 WHEN ENC.CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE BETWEEN '2021-07-01' AND '2023-05-10' AND (DEP.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('LEULYM', 'LYM') OR ENC.CPE_DEPT_ID IN (1523, 1532, 278)) THEN 1 WHEN ENC.CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE BETWEEN '2021-10-01' AND '2023-05-10' AND (DEP.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('LEU') OR ENC.CPE_DEPT_ID IN (118, 1570)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 1

prompt: Provide a list of patients with pancreatic cancer that were consented under the generalized biobanking protocol 06-107
completion: WITH PAN AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN, AC_NON_MSK_INST, AC_LAST_NAME, AC_FIRST_NAME, AC_CONS_DTE, AC_PVDR_OF_RECORD_NAME, AC_IRB_NO FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON AC_MRN = TM_MRN AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE ('C25%') WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' ), KRAS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, GENE, RESULT, METHOD, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC, CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 25000) AS VARCHAR(25000)) AS REPORT_TEXT FROM PAN JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V ON AC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE GENE like '%KRAS%'), SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN" , "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Accession Number" , "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE" AS "Procedure Date" , CAST(SUBSTR("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", 1, 25000) AS VARCHAR(25000)) AS "Report Text" FROM KRAS JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON "t1"."PT_MRN" = KRAS.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC" IN ('Surgical Pathology', 'Surgical Submitted Slides') AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", 'KRAS MUTATION') = 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN, "Accession Number", "Procedure Date", "Report Text" FROM PAN JOIN KRAS ON AC_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN SURG ON PT_MRN = "MRN"

prompt: We are looking for all patients who were treated with botox to the bladder for overactive bladder syndrome.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME AS RADIATION_SITE, RTC_TX_START_DTE AS RADIATION_START_DATE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE AS RADIATION_END_DATE, TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) AS SURGEON, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS PROCEDURE_CODE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS SURG_PROCEDURE, APR_START_DTE AS MED_START_DATE, APR_END_DTE AS MED_END_DATE, APR_GENERIC_NAME AS MED_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON RTC_TX_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON RTC_TX_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON RTC_TX_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1 = 1 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('51715', '52287') AND SSP_SURG_LAST_NM IN ('LEDDY', 'SANDHU', 'CHEUNG', 'AJAY') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR = 'CY'; SELECT OO_MRN, OOC_ITEM_NAME FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Botulinum Toxin Type A INJ');

prompt: Provide a weekly list of outpatient cardiology orders along with the next cardiology appointments for 22-260 screening. Ideally we would like to capture them once the order is entered in the system and before the officially scheduled appointments.
completion: WITH ORDERS AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_SEX AS "Gender", OO_ENTER_DT AS "Enter DT", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS "Significant Date", OO_REQUESTED_DTE, STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME) AS "Order Name", OO_ORD_STS_CD AS "Order Status", OO_ORD_PRIO AS "Priority", OO_ORD_TYPE_CD, OUO_ORG_NAME, OUO_REV_CAT_DEPT, OO_SUMMARY_LINE AS "Summary Line", OUO_ATN_PVDR_NAME AS "Order Attending Name", OUO_PVDR_NAME AS "Order Provider Name", OUO_PVDR_ROLE_TYPE AS "Provider Role", OUO_USER_NAME AS "User Name", OUO_USER_ROLE_TYPE AS "User Role", OCV_CURR_LOC AS "Visit Location", OCV_PVDR_NAME FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER OO JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO.OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS OUO ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID WHERE 1=1 AND UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) like '%CARD%CONS%' AND OO_ORD_NAME <> 'Cardiology Inpatient Consult' AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO.OO_ENTER_DTE >= CURRENT date - 10 DAYS ) , ORDER_ATTRIBS AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OUD_ENTER_DTE, OUD_ORD_GUID, OUD_USER_DI_CD, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, OUD_UDDI_GUID FROM ORDERS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID WHERE 1=1 ) , ORDERS_LISTAGG AS (SELECT OO_MRN AS OO_LISTAGG_MRN, OUD_ORD_GUID, LISTAGG(COALESCE(TRIM(OUD_USER_DI_CD), '') || ' - ' || COALESCE(TRIM(CAST(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY OO_MRN, OUD_USER_DI_CD) AS "Order Attributes" FROM ORDER_ATTRIBS GROUP BY OO_MRN, OUD_ORD_GUID) , NEXT_CAR_APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN , CPE_ENC_DTE , CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department" , CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service" , CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name" , CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name" , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) AS RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN ORDERS_LISTAGG ON OO_LISTAGG_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'CAR' AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date ) , AFIB_BILLING AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN ORDERS_LISTAGG ON OO_LISTAGG_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1=1 AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('I48' , 'I48.0' , 'I48.1' , 'I48.11' , 'I48.19' , 'I48.2' , 'I48.20' , 'I48.21' , 'I48.3' , 'I48.4' , 'I48.9' , 'I48.91' , 'I48.92') ) , MAIN AS (SELECT OO_MRN AS MRN, "Name", DOB, "Gender", "Enter DT", "Order Name", "Order Attributes", CASE WHEN LOCATE('ARRHY', UPPER("Order Attributes")) > 0 THEN 'Y' END AS "Arrhy", CASE WHEN LOCATE('ATRIAL FIB', UPPER("Order Attributes")) > 0 THEN 'Y' END AS "Atrial Fib", CASE WHEN CC_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS "aFib Billing", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Next Card Appt Date", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", "Order Status", "Priority", OO_ORD_TYPE_CD "Type", "Significant Date", OO_REQUESTED_DTE AS "Req Date", "Summary Line", "Order Attending Name", "Order Provider Name", "Provider Role", "User Name", "User Role", "Visit Location" FROM ORDERS LEFT JOIN ORDERS_LISTAGG ON OO_LISTAGG_MRN = OO_MRN AND OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN NEXT_CAR_APPT ON OO_LISTAGG_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN AFIB_BILLING ON CC_MRN = OO_MRN) SELECT * FROM MAIN ORDER BY "Arrhy", "Atrial Fib", "aFib Billing", "Enter DT", MRN

prompt: Patients referred to the BMT service YTD in 2019
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", D.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", R.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CPE_CPE_APPT_STS AS "Appt Status", RP.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Referring Provider", RD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Referring Dept" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = R.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT D ON CPE_DEPT_ID = D.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT RD ON CPE_REF_DEP_ID = RD.CLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE RP ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = RP.CRE_RES_ID WHERE D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BMT' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE UNION ALL SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", D.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", R.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CPE_CPE_APPT_STS AS "Appt Status", RP.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Referring Provider", PER_EXT_REF_DEPT AS "Referring Dept" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = R.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT D ON CPE_DEPT_ID = D.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PAS_EXT_REFERRING ON PER_CL_PT_ID = CPE_CL_PT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE RP ON PER_RES_ID = RP.CRE_RES_ID WHERE D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BMT' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND UPPER(PER_EXT_REF_DEPT) LIKE '%BMT%' AND UPPER(PER_RES_ROLE) LIKE '%REFERRING%' ) SELECT PT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", "Appt Date", "Department", "Service", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", "Appt Status", "Referring Provider", "Referring Dept" FROM CTE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN ORDER BY 1, 5

prompt: Review of ID consult order history for triage workflow
completion: WITH ORDERS_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ORD_GUID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ENTER_DTE" AS ORDER_ENTER_DATE, "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ORD_NAME" AS ORDER_NAME FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."OMS_ORDER" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_MRN" WHERE "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ORD_STS_CD" NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ENTER_DTE" BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-05-17' AND "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ORD_NAME" IN ('Infectious Disease Inpatient Consult')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT ORDERS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM ORDERS_0)), COHORT_ORDERS AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT ORDERS_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, ORDERS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM ORDERS_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_ORDERS.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_ORDERS_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_ORDERS.PT_DEID AS COHORT_ORDERS_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_ORDERS ON COHORT_ORDERS.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN"), ORDERS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ORD_GUID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ENTER_DTE" AS ORDER_ENTER_DATE, "IDB"."OMS_STATUS"."OSTS_STS_DESC" AS ORDER_STATUS, "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ORD_NAME" AS ORDER_NAME, "IDB"."OMS_ORD_CATALOG"."OOC_ITEM_NAME" AS ORDER_ITEM_NAME, "IDB"."OMS_ORD_CATALOG"."OOC_ITEM_DESC" AS ORDER_ITEM_DESCRIPTION, "IDB"."OMS_PROVIDER"."OP_DISPLAY_NAME" AS ORDER_PROVIDER, "IDB"."OMS_PROVIDER"."OP_PROV_TYPE" AS ORDER_PROVIDER_TYPE FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."OMS_ORDER" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."OMS_STATUS" ON "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ORD_STS_CD" = "IDB"."OMS_STATUS"."OSTS_ORD_STS_CD" JOIN "IDB"."OMS_ORD_CATALOG" ON "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID" = "IDB"."OMS_ORD_CATALOG"."OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."OMS_PROVIDER" ON "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_PVDR_GUID" = "IDB"."OMS_PROVIDER"."OP_PVDR_GUID") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, ORDERS_COLUMNS.ORDER_ENTER_DATE AS ORDER_ENTER_DATE, ORDERS_COLUMNS.ORDER_STATUS AS ORDER_STATUS, ORDERS_COLUMNS.ORDER_NAME AS ORDER_NAME, ORDERS_COLUMNS.ORDER_ITEM_NAME AS ORDER_ITEM_NAME, ORDERS_COLUMNS.ORDER_ITEM_DESCRIPTION AS ORDER_ITEM_DESCRIPTION, ORDERS_COLUMNS.ORDER_PROVIDER AS ORDER_PROVIDER, ORDERS_COLUMNS.ORDER_PROVIDER_TYPE AS ORDER_PROVIDER_TYPE FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID LEFT OUTER JOIN ORDERS_COLUMNS ON ORDERS_COLUMNS.SUBJECT_ID = KEYS.COHORT_ORDERS_SUBJECT_ID

prompt: Provide a list of patients who were transplanted with Unrelated Donors from 2015-2019
completion: SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(OO_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME) AS "Order Name", OO_ORD_STS_CD, OSTS_STS_DESC, STRIP(X3.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Relationship to Patient", STRIP(X2.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "If unrelated NMDP#", DATE(STRIP(X1.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE)) AS "Proposed Start Date" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA X1 ON OO_ORD_GUID = X1.OUD_ORD_GUID AND X1.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Requested For' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA X2 ON OO_ORD_GUID = X2.OUD_ORD_GUID AND X2.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Stem Cell NMDP#') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA X3 ON OO_ORD_GUID = X3.OUD_ORD_GUID AND X3.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Stem Cell Relationship') WHERE 1=1 AND OO_ORD_NAME IN ('ALLO - HPC-A Thaw Infusion Order', 'ALLO - HPC-M Thaw Infusion Order') AND DATE(STRIP(X1.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE)) BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND OO_MRN <> '11111111' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3', 'DISC')

prompt: Provide one time  list of patients included in the Connected Care auto-enrollment Engage cohort.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT EPI_MRN, EPI_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME, EPI_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, EA_ASSIGN_DT ASSIGNED_DATE, EAS_ASSESS_STS SURVEY_STATUS, EF_SUBMISSION_DT AS SUBMISSION_DATE, EC_COHORT_DESC COHORT_DESC FROM IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT_STS ON EA_STS_ID = EAS_ASSESS_STS_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM ON EF_FORM_EXTERNAL_ID = EA_ASSESS_ID JOIN IDB.EF_SCHEDULING_RULE ON EA_SCHED_RULE_ID = ESR_SCHED_RULE_ID JOIN IDB.EF_COHORT ON ESR_COHORT_ID = EC_COHORT_ID JOIN IDB.EF_PATIENT_INFO ON EA_PT_INFO_ID = EPI_PT_INFO_ID WHERE EA_SURV_ID = 84 AND DATE(EA_ASSIGN_DT) >= '2023-02-22' AND EAS_ASSESS_STS NOT IN ('Cancelled') AND EC_COHORT_ID =196; WITH COHORT AS (SELECT DISTINCT EA_ASSIGN_DT, EAS_ASSESS_STS, EF_FORM_ID , EPI_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME, EPI_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, EF_MRN , EF_SUBMISSION_DT, EC_COHORT_ID FROM IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT_STS ON EA_STS_ID = EAS_ASSESS_STS_ID JOIN IDB.EF_FORM ON EF_FORM_EXTERNAL_ID = EA_ASSESS_ID JOIN IDB.EF_SCHEDULING_RULE ON EA_SCHED_RULE_ID = ESR_SCHED_RULE_ID JOIN IDB.EF_COHORT ON ESR_COHORT_ID = EC_COHORT_ID JOIN IDB.EF_PATIENT_INFO ON EA_PT_INFO_ID = EPI_PT_INFO_ID WHERE EA_SURV_ID = 84 AND DATE(EA_ASSIGN_DT) >= '2023-02-22' AND EF_FORM_NAME = 'Connected Care Questionnaire' AND EAS_ASSESS_STS NOT IN ('Cancelled') AND EC_COHORT_ID =196 ) SELECT EF_MRN AS MRN, FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, EF_SUBMISSION_DT AS SUBMISSION_DATE, EA_ASSIGN_DT ASSIGNED_DATE, EAS_ASSESS_STS SURVEY_STATUS, MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'CC_anyproblems' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "CC_anyproblems", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'CC_bowelmovement' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "CC_bowelmovement", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'CC_drinking' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "CC_drinking", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'CC_eating' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "CC_eating", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'CC_nauseaoften' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "CC_nauseaoften", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'CC_othersymptoms' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "CC_othersymptoms", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'CC_painoften' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "CC_painoften", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'RTCC_SOB' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "RTCC_SOB", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'RTCC_SOBactivities' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "RTCC_SOBactivities", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'RTCC_constipationdescribe' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "RTCC_constipationdescribe", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'RTCC_describepain' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "RTCC_describepain", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'RTCC_diarrheaoften' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "RTCC_diarrheaoften", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'RTCC_fatigue_dailyact' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "RTCC_fatigue_dailyact", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'RTCC_fatiguedescribe' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "RTCC_fatiguedescribe", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'RTCC_nausea' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "RTCC_nausea", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'RTCC_painactivities' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "RTCC_painactivities", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'RTCC_vomit' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "RTCC_vomit", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'covidsymp_hospital' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "covidsymp_hospital", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'othersymptoms_24hrsFT' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "othersymptoms_24hrsFT", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'pain_bodymap_all' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "pain_bodymap_all", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'ptcare_who_completed' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "ptcare_who_completed", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'ptcare_who_completed_other' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "ptcare_who_completed_other" FROM COHORT LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID GROUP BY EF_MRN, FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, EF_SUBMISSION_DT, EA_ASSIGN_DT, EAS_ASSESS_STS ;

prompt: IDBDW table access request for Laboratory Medicine

prompt: Provide demographics, cancer diagnosis and pathology data about  patients with MDS/AML that will be included in this study.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('204.1', 'C91.1') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2020-05-18') , APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CRE_RES_NAME, MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) LAST_APPT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN DX ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2020-05-18' AND CRE_RES_NAME IN ('MATO, ANTHONY ROCCO', 'ZELENETZ, ANDREW') GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME) SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN" , PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name" , PT_SEX AS "Gender" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth" , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death" , R.AV_DESC AS "Race (Reg)" , E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity (Reg)" , PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AS "Last PT Activity Date" , LAST_APPT AS "Last Appt with provider" , CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider name" FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CP_MRN JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN FROM DX) ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN APPTS ON PT_MRN = MRN ; WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('204.1', 'C91.1') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2020-05-18') , APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CRE_RES_NAME, MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) LAST_APPT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN DX ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2020-05-18' AND CRE_RES_NAME IN ('MATO, ANTHONY ROCCO', 'ZELENETZ, ANDREW') GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME) SELECT * FROM DX LEFT JOIN APPTS ON CC_MRN = MRN ; WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('204.1', 'C91.1') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2020-05-18') , APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CRE_RES_NAME, MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) LAST_APPT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN DX ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2020-05-18' AND CRE_RES_NAME IN ('MATO, ANTHONY ROCCO', 'ZELENETZ, ANDREW') GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME) SELECT PRO_IRB_NO, PRO_IRB_TITLE, PRO_IRB_STS, PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE, AC_MRN, AC_NON_MSK_INST, AC_LAST_NAME, AC_FIRST_NAME, AC_PVDR_OF_RECORD_NAME, ACD_REG_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider name", CASE WHEN ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL THEN 'on-study' ELSE 'off-study' END AS "On off study" FROM IDB.PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN FROM DX) ON AC_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN APPTS ON AC_MRN = MRN ; SELECT PRPT_MRN AS "MRN", PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS "Procedure date", PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Report date", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS "Report type", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession number", PRPT_REPORT AS "Report text", PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME AS "Ordering doctor", PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC_DESC AS "Service" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC IN ('Cytogenetics', 'Hematopathology Report') AND PRPT_MRN IN ();

prompt: Provide diagnosis, appointment, and demographic data for patients coded for angiomyolipoma and seen by Urology.
completion: WITH PHI (PHI) AS ( VALUES ('Y')) , ICD9DXCODES AS (SELECT DXA_ATTRIBUTE_ID FROM DV.DIAGNOSIS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE DXA_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT = 'YES') , ICD9_10_DXS AS (SELECT PD.PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PID, MIN(DXD.DT_DTE) AS MIN_DX_DTE FROM DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS PD INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS D ON PD.PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = D.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN DV.DATE_V DXD ON PD.PDX_DX_DATE_ID = DXD.DT_DATE_ID INNER JOIN ICD9DXCODES DA ON PD.PDX_DIAGNOSIS_ATTRIBUTE_ID = DA.DXA_ATTRIBUTE_ID INNER JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG DCC ON PD.PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DCC.DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID AND DCC.DXCC_DX_TYPE IN ('ICD9', 'ICD10') WHERE 1=1 AND DCC.DXCC_ICD_CODE IN ('D17.71' ,'D17.9' ,'214.3' ,'214.9' ,'223.0' ) GROUP BY PD.PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID HAVING MIN(DXD.DT_DTE) BETWEEN '1993-01-01' AND '2021-05-31') , QUALIF_APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT T1.PT_MRN AS "MRN", PID, MIN_DX_DTE, T2.DT_DTE AS "Encounter Date", T3.EDC_DEPT_DESC AS "Encounter Status", T4.ENDP_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", T5.ENDP_DEPT_NAME AS "Primary Resource Dept Name", T4.ENDP_CENTER_ABBR AS "Department Site", T6.ENR_RES_NAME AS "Primary Resource Name", T6.ENR_RES_TYP AS "Primary Resource Type", T7.ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR AS "Visit Type Abbrev", T7.ENVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type Name", T7.ENVT_EXT_NAME AS "Visit Type External Name", CASE WHEN UPPER(T4.ENDP_REG_DEPT_GRP1) IN ('REG') THEN 'Regional' ELSE 'New York City' END AS "Regional Site Indicator", T4.ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6 AS "Clin Dept (Group 6)", T8.EDC_DEPT_DESC AS "Clin Dept Desc (Group 6)", T4.ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8 AS "Clin Svc (Group 8)", T10.EDC_DEPT_DESC AS "Clin Svc Desc (Group 8)", T4.ENDP_PHY_LOC AS "Physical Location" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS T1 JOIN ICD9_10_DXS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PID LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER T11 ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = T11.PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V T2 ON T11.PENC_ENC_DATE_ID = T2.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG T3 ON T11.PENC_APPT_STS = T3.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV AND T3.EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS' LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT T4 ON T11.PENC_DEPT_ID = T4.ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES T15 ON T11.PENC_PT_ENC_ID = T15.ENSR_PT_ENC_ID AND T15.ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' LEFT JOIN DV.MEDPRO_V T13A ON T15.ENSR_MEDPRO_ID = T13A.MP_MEDPRO_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC IDOC ON T13A.MP_SOURCE_PROVIDER_NO = IDOC.DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT T5 ON T15.ENSR_DEPT_ID = T5.ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG T8 ON T5.ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6 = T8.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV AND T8.EDC_GROUP_ID = '6' LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG T10 ON T5.ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8 = T10.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV AND T10.EDC_GROUP_ID = '8' LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE T6 ON T15.ENSR_RES_ID = T6.ENR_ENC_RES_ID LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE T7 ON T11.PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID = T7.ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID WHERE 1=1 AND T3.EDC_DEPT_DESC IN ('Arrived', 'Completed') AND T6.ENR_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND ((T4.ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8 = 'URO' AND T5.ENDP_DEPT_NAME IN ('UROLOGY 68-C' , 'CMK UROLOGY' , 'BER UROLOGY-2' , 'BSK UROLOGY' , 'MON UROLOGY-C' , 'UROLOGY WES' , 'NAS UROLOGY-2' , 'MON UROLOGY-2')) OR T4.ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6 = 'URO' ) ) , DT AS (SELECT MRN , PID AS PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID , MIN_DX_DTE , MAX("Encounter Date") AS MAX_APPT_DTE FROM QUALIF_APPTS GROUP BY MRN , PID , MIN_DX_DTE) , ICD9S AS (SELECT DISTINCT DT."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" PID, CAST(RTRIM("t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE") AS VARCHAR(1000)) AS "ICD-9 Final Dx Code", CAST(RTRIM("t2"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC") AS VARCHAR(1000)) AS "ICD-9 Final Dx Description" , CASE WHEN PHI.PHI = 'Y' THEN CAST("dxd"."DT_DTE" AS VARCHAR(1000)) ELSE CAST("dxd"."DT_YEAR" AS VARCHAR(1000)) END AS "ICD-9 Dx Date" , CASE WHEN "t2".DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD9' AND ("t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" BETWEEN '196' AND '196.99' OR "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" BETWEEN '197' AND '197.99' OR "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" BETWEEN '198' AND '198.99') THEN 'METS' WHEN "t2".DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD10' AND (DXCC_ICD_CODE like 'C77%' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE like 'C78%' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE like 'C79%' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE like 'C7B%') THEN 'METS' ELSE 'CA' END AS "METs Ind" FROM DT DT INNER JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON DT."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t4" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG "t2" ON "t4"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_DATES_V" "t6" ON "t4"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t6"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" AND "t4"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "dxd" ON "t6"."FIRST_DIAGNOSIS_DATE_ID" = "dxd"."DT_DATE_ID" , PHI WHERE (("t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" BETWEEN '140' AND '239.99' AND "t2".DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD9') OR (("DXCC_ICD_CODE" BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'D49.99') AND DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD10')) AND DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT = 'YES' ) , ICD9X AS (SELECT PID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PID) RN, "ICD-9 Dx Date" || ' | ' || "ICD-9 Final Dx Code" || '-' || "ICD-9 Final Dx Description" ICD9_DX FROM ICD9S WHERE "METs Ind" = 'CA' ORDER BY PID, "ICD-9 Dx Date", "ICD-9 Final Dx Code" ASC) , ICD9 (PID, RN, ICD9_DXS) AS (SELECT ICD9X.PID, ICD9X.RN, ICD9X.ICD9_DX FROM ICD9X WHERE RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT T1.PID, T1.RN, ICD9_DXS || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ICD9_DX FROM ICD9 T0, ICD9X T1 WHERE T0.PID = T1.PID AND T0.RN + 1 = T1.RN AND T1.RN < 10000 ) , ICD9_MX AS (SELECT PID, MAX(RN) MX FROM ICD9X GROUP BY PID), ICD9_FIN AS (SELECT F.* FROM ICD9 F INNER JOIN ICD9_MX M ON F.PID = M.PID AND F.RN = M.MX ) , SURGERY AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE AS "Surgery Date", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS "CPT Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS "CPT Description", SSP_SURG_LAST_NM AS "Surgeon Last Name" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN DT ON MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SUBSTR(SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, 1, 1) NOT IN ('0', '7', '8', '9') ) , SURGERY_LISTAGG AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE("Surgery Date", '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(CAST("Surgeon Last Name" AS VARCHAR(32000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM("CPT Code"), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM("CPT Description"), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY SSE_MRN, "Surgery Date", "CPT Code") AS "Surgeries" FROM SURGERY GROUP BY SSE_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", CASE WHEN "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE") END AS "Cur Age", "t1"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS "Vital Status", "t1"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender", "t1"."PT_RACE_DESC" AS "Race", "t2"."CORE_ETHNICITY_DESC" AS "Ethnicity" , MIN_DX_DTE AS "Min Dx Date" , MAX_APPT_DTE AS "Max URO Date" , ICD9_FIN.ICD9_DXS "ICD-9-10 CA DXs" , "Surgeries" FROM DT DT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t1" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = DT.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN ICD9_FIN ON DT.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = ICD9_FIN.PID LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t2" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN SURGERY_LISTAGG ON SSE_MRN = DT.MRN WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY "t1"."PT_MRN"

prompt: Provide a one time list of patients diagnosed from 2018-2021 with intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma (ICD 10 C22.1, ICD 9 155.1)
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS DX_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD = 'C221' AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M8160/3' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, (MIN(CC_EFF_DTE)) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C22.1', '155.1') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2021-12-31'), COHORT AS (SELECT DISTINCT DX_MRN , DX_DATE , DX_CODE , DX_DESC FROM (SELECT DISTINCT DX_MRN , DX_DATE , DX_CODE , DX_DESC , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE ASC) AS RN FROM DX) WHERE RN = 1 ) , ANTINEO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS APR_START_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY APR_MRN ORDER BY MIN(APR_START_DTE) ASC) AS RN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN COHORT ON APR_MRN = DX_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE), CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN , LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(APR_START_DTE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' : ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME), '') || ' : ' || COALESCE(STRIP(APR_GENERIC_NAME), '') || ' : ' || COALESCE(STRIP(APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE), '') || ' : ' || COALESCE(STRIP(APR_ROUTE), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE) AS CHEMO_REGIMEN FROM ANTINEO GROUP BY APR_MRN), SRG_ALL AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN COHORT ON SSE_MRN = DX_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSE_SURG_DTE > DX_DATE ), SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, LISTAGG (COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(SSE_SURG_DTE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' : ' || COALESCE(STRIP(SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD), '') || DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_NAME AS PT_NAME, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.GENDER AS GENDER, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.VITAL_STATS AS VITAL_STATUS, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_DEATH AS DATE_OF_DEATH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID;

prompt: Identify patients with myxofibrosarcoma and MRI, along with control patients with other specified diseases and MRI.
completion: WITH PATH AS (SELECT PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '"Myxofibrosarcoma"') <> 0) SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "Date of Birth", PT_SEX AS "Gender", MAX(A.DT_DTE) AS "MRI Date", B.DT_DTE AS "Path Report Date", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Path Accession No." FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE ON PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE A ON PTX_PROC_DATE_ID = A.DT_DATE_ID JOIN PATH ON PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE B ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = B.DT_DATE_ID WHERE A.DT_DTE >= '2002-1-1' AND A.DT_DTE BETWEEN B.DT_DTE - 4 MONTHS AND B.DT_DTE AND PCC_CODE IN ('71552', '72197', '73220', '73223', '73719', '73720', '73723') GROUP BY PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_SEX, B.DT_DTE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO ORDER BY B.DT_DTE, PT_MRN, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO

prompt: List of patients with Adenomyoepithelioma of the breast
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE "Date of Birth", PLA_LAST_APPT_DTE "Last Appt Date", PT_VITAL_STATUS "Vital Status", PRPT_REPORT_DTE "Path Report Date", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC "Path Report Type", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Accession No" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '1990-01-01' AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("adenomyoepithelioma" & "breast")') = 1

prompt: Provide On Demand Report for MD sign-off information for "Pre-Admission Note - BMT/CTS" assessments in EMR since 2008
completion: WITH CLINDOC AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDO_DOC_GUID AS DOCGUID, CDO_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME, TRIM(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) AS PROVIDER, CDO_ENTER_DTE AS DOC_ENT_DTE, ENT.OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS ENTREDBY, ENT.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE AS ENTBY_ROLE, AUTH.OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS AUTH, AUTH.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE AS SVC_PVDR_ROLE, CDD_AUTHORED_DT AS AUTH_DT, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS SVC_DATE, CDO_LAST_UPD_DT FROM IDB.CD_OBSERVATION JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ENT ON CDD_USER_GUID = ENT.OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER AUTH ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = AUTH.OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Pre-Admission Note - BMT/CTS-BMT', 'Pre-Admission Note - BMT/CTS-CTS') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2008-01-01' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDO_LARGE_VALUE_TEXT_IND <> 'Y' ) , AUTHORS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS A_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID AS A_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS A_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME AS A_DOC_NAME, TRIM(U1.OU_DISPLAY_NAME) || ' ( ' || TRIM(U1.OU_OCCUPATION) || '-' || TRIM(U1.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE) || ' )' AS "Author", TRIM(U2.OU_DISPLAY_NAME) || ' ( ' || TRIM(U2.OU_OCCUPATION) || '-' || TRIM(U2.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE) || ' )' AS "Co-Author", CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID, CDH_USER_GUID FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT D JOIN CLINDOC C ON D.CDD_DOC_GUID = DOCGUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER U1 ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = U1.OU_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT_HISTORY ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDH_CLIENT_DOC_GUID AND CDD_CLIENT_GUID = CDH_CLIENT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER U2 ON CDH_USER_GUID = U2.OU_USER_GUID) SELECT C.MRN, C.PT_NAME, C.SVC_DATE, C.PROVIDER, "Author", "Co-Author" FROM CLINDOC C LEFT JOIN AUTHORS ON DOCGUID = A_DOC_GUID AND "Author" <> "Co-Author" GROUP BY C.MRN, C.PT_NAME, C.SVC_DATE, C.PROVIDER, "Author", "Co-Author"

prompt: Design a Darwin on-demand report to pull data from the "Immune Effector Cells (IEC) - MNC - A - Collection - Processing" CIS order.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(OO_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME) AS "Order Name", STRIP(OO_ORD_ID) AS "Order ID", OO_ENTER_DTE AS "Order Date", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Age", OUO_PVDR_NAME AS "Requested By", OUO_USER_NAME "Electronically Signed By", STRIP(X1.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Source", STRIP(X2.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Anticipated Start Date", STRIP(X3.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Protocol", STRIP(X4.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Production Facility", STRIP(X5.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Product", STRIP(X6.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Collection Site", STRIP(X7.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Targeted Total #TN/TMC", STRIP(X8.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Amount (Flat)", STRIP(X9.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Targeted Total #CD3 Cells", STRIP(X10.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Amount (Flat)2 " FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA X1 ON OO_ORD_GUID = X1.OUD_ORD_GUID AND X1.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'IEC_Source' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA X2 ON OO_ORD_GUID = X2.OUD_ORD_GUID AND X2.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Requested For' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA X3 ON OO_ORD_GUID = X3.OUD_ORD_GUID AND X3.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'IEC_Protocol' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA X4 ON OO_ORD_GUID = X4.OUD_ORD_GUID AND X4.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'IEC_Production Facility 2' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA X5 ON OO_ORD_GUID = X5.OUD_ORD_GUID AND X5.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'IEC_Product' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA X6 ON OO_ORD_GUID = X6.OUD_ORD_GUID AND X6.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'IEC_Collection Site' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA X7 ON OO_ORD_GUID = X7.OUD_ORD_GUID AND X7.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Target Number of TNC/kg' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA X8 ON OO_ORD_GUID = X8.OUD_ORD_GUID AND X8.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'IEC_Flat TNC' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA X9 ON OO_ORD_GUID = X9.OUD_ORD_GUID AND X9.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BM Targeted Total #CD34' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA X10 ON OO_ORD_GUID = X10.OUD_ORD_GUID AND X10.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'IEC_Flat CD3' WHERE 1=1 AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000011712100730' AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= '2020-01-01' ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, "Order Date", CHAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE, USA) AS CDD_SERVICE_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN, "Order Date" ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE) AS RN FROM X JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN "Order Date" AND "Order Date" + 28 DAYS WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Procedure Note - Lab Medicine' ) , YY AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, "Order Date", LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY CDD_MRN, "Order Date", CDD_SERVICE_DTE) AS SVC_DATE FROM Y WHERE RN = 1 GROUP BY CDD_MRN, "Order Date") SELECT X.*, SVC_DATE AS "Actual Date" FROM X LEFT JOIN YY ON X.MRN = YY.CDD_MRN AND X."Order Date" = YY."Order Date"

prompt: Clinical Activity Request (no PHI) for Dr. Stephen Roberts in preparation for departure of MSK
completion: SELECT PBC_CPT_CD CPT_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK CPT_DESC, COUNT(*) COUNT FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-07-01' AND '2022-06-30' AND DOC_NAME = 'ROBERTS MD,STEPHEN S' GROUP BY PBC_CPT_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK

prompt: Please provide a weekly of patient's who have completed neoadjuvant therapy (NAC) and have a MRI biopsy scheduled (0-60 days after NAC). These patients must also have operable breast cancer or breast surgery scheduled.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || PT_FIRST_NAME AS PATIENT_NAME, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE AS REPORT_DATE, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME AS PROCEDURE_NAME, RRPT_REPORT_TXT AS REPORT_TEXT FROM (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, RRPT_REPORT_TXT, RN_NC, CAST(TRIM(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, L1, 300))AS VARCHAR(1500)) AS CLINICAL_TEXT FROM (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY RRPT_MRN ORDER BY RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE DESC) AS RN_NC, VARCHAR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 32000) AS RRPT_REPORT_TXT, CASE WHEN LOCATE('CLINICAL STATEMENT', CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 32000) AS VARCHAR(32000))) > 1 THEN LOCATE('CLINICAL STATEMENT', CAST(UPPER(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 32000)) AS VARCHAR(32000))) END AS L1 FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = RRPT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND (CONTAINS(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 'neo-adjuvant') = 1 OR CONTAINS(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 'neoadjuvant') = 1) AND (LOWER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) LIKE '%breast%' OR LOWER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) LIKE '%brst%') AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 30 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE AND RRPT_ORDER_GROUP= 'MR' )) WHERE RN_NC =1 AND (LOWER(CLINICAL_TEXT) LIKE '%post%neo%adjuvant%therapy%' OR LOWER(CLINICAL_TEXT) LIKE '%after%neo%adjuvant%therapy%' OR LOWER(CLINICAL_TEXT) LIKE '%post%neo%adjuvant%treatment%' OR LOWER(CLINICAL_TEXT) LIKE '%after%neo%adjuvant%treatment%');

prompt: Provide a Tableau Dashboard that displays a list of patients diagnosed with a fusion-positive sarcoma subtype who have outpatient appointments for the upcoming week.
completion: WITH DX_EWING AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 'Ewing Sarcoma' AS DX FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("Ewing")') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE IN ('DS_R', 'S_R', 'S_BRSSL', 'S_CO', 'S_SSL', 'S_SP') ) , DX_DESMOPLASTIC AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 'Desmoplastic Sarcoma' AS DX FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("desmoplastic")') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE IN ('DS_R', 'S_R', 'S_BRSSL', 'S_CO', 'S_SSL', 'S_SP') ) , DX_SYNOVIAL AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 'Synovial Sarcoma' AS DX FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("synovial")') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE IN ('DS_R', 'S_R', 'S_BRSSL', 'S_CO', 'S_SSL', 'S_SP') ) , DX_MYXOID AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 'Myxoid Liposarcoma' AS DX FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("myxoid liposarcoma" )') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE IN ('DS_R', 'S_R', 'S_BRSSL', 'S_CO', 'S_SSL', 'S_SP') ) , DX_ALVEOLAR AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 'Alveolar Sarcoma' AS DX FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("alveolar soft parts")') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE IN ('DS_R', 'S_R', 'S_BRSSL', 'S_CO', 'S_SSL', 'S_SP') ) , DX_ALVEOLAR_RHABDOMYOSARCOMA AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 'Alveolar Rhabdomyosarcoma' AS DX FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma")') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE IN ('DS_R', 'S_R', 'S_BRSSL', 'S_CO', 'S_SSL', 'S_SP') ) , DX_CIC AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 'CIC Sarcoma' AS DX FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("sarcoma" & ("CIC"))') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE IN ('DS_R', 'S_R', 'S_BRSSL', 'S_CO', 'S_SSL', 'S_SP') ) , DX_BCOR AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 'BCOR Sarcoma' AS DX FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("sarcoma" & ("BCOR"))') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE IN ('DS_R', 'S_R', 'S_BRSSL', 'S_CO', 'S_SSL', 'S_SP') ) , DX_FINAL AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN, DX FROM DX_EWING UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN, DX FROM DX_DESMOPLASTIC UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN, DX FROM DX_SYNOVIAL UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN, DX FROM DX_MYXOID UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN, DX FROM DX_ALVEOLAR UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN, DX FROM DX_ALVEOLAR_RHABDOMYOSARCOMA UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN, DX FROM DX_CIC UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN, DX FROM DX_BCOR) , APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN APPT_MRN, TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) APPT_TIME, CPE_ENC_DTE APPT_DTE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME APPT_RESOURCE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME APPT_TYPE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) APPT_RANK FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Nurse') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = '53RD' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('MED', 'NUR') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'SAR' ) , SCANS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN SCAN_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE SCAN_DTE, TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) SCAN_TIME, CRE_RES_NAME SCAN_RESOURCE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME SCAN_TYPE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) SCAN_RANK FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT D ON CPE_DEPT_ID = D.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN APPTS ON APPT_MRN = CPE_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= APPT_DTE WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_NAME IN ('CT 53-1', 'CT 53-2', 'CT 53-3', 'MRI 53-1', 'MRI 53-2', 'MRI 1275-53') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date ) , IRB_06107 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRO_IRB_NO, AC_MRN, ACD_CONS_DTE FROM IDB.PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO WHERE PRO_IRB_NO = '06-107' ) , IRB_12245 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRO_IRB_NO, AC_MRN, ACD_CONS_DTE FROM IDB.PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO WHERE PRO_IRB_NO = '12-245' ) SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN "MRN" , DX "Diagnosis" , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_PHONE , APPT_DTE , APPT_TIME , APPT_RESOURCE , APPT_TYPE , SCAN_DTE , SCAN_TIME , SCAN_RESOURCE , SCAN_TYPE , A.ACD_CONS_DTE "06-107 Consent Date" , B.ACD_CONS_DTE "12-245 Consent Date" FROM DX_FINAL JOIN APPTS ON PRPT_MRN = APPT_MRN AND APPT_RANK = 1 JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN SCANS ON APPT_MRN = SCAN_MRN AND SCAN_RANK = 1 LEFT JOIN IRB_06107 A ON PRPT_MRN = A.AC_MRN LEFT JOIN IRB_12245 B ON PRPT_MRN = B.AC_MRN ;
