completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_LOG_ID LOG_ID FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) = 'ISBELL, JAMES MICHAEL' AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND SSP_PROC_SEQ_NO = 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", SSE_LOG_ID "Log ID", SSP_PROC_SEQ_NO "Panel", SSE_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD "CPT Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC "CPT Description", TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) "Surgeon" FROM CTE JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_LOG_ID = LOG_ID JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN ORDER BY 5 DESC, 6

prompt: For research project on continuous pulse oximetry for evidence based project.
completion: WITH ORD AS (SELECT OO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE, OCV_IP_OP_IND, OO_ORD_ID, OSTS_STS_DESC FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_SYS_DATA B ON OO_ORD_GUID = OSD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OO_ORD_NAME = 'Check O2 Saturation (Nursing)' AND OSD_FREQ_SUMLNE = 'continuous' AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD <> 'CANC' ) , O2 AS (SELECT OO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, MIN(OO_ENTER_DTE) AS "First 2018 Order Date", MAX(OO_ENTER_DTE) AS "Last 2018 Order Date", MAX(CASE WHEN OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'I' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) AS "Has Inpatient Order", MAX(CASE WHEN OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'O' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) AS "Has Outpatient Order", COUNT(*) AS "Order Count" FROM ORD GROUP BY OO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME) , APNEA AS (SELECT OO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE, OCV_IP_OP_IND, OSTS_STS_DESC, OO_ORD_ID, S.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "Status", LISTAGG(COALESCE(O.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, ''), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) AS "O2/Oximetry" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA S ON OO_ORD_GUID = S.OUD_ORD_GUID AND S.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'OSA_Status' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA O ON OO_ORD_GUID = O.OUD_ORD_GUID AND (O.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE like '%O2%' OR LOWER(O.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) like '%oximetry%') JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OO_ORD_NAME = 'Obstructive Sleep Apnea' AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD <> 'CANC' GROUP BY OO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE, OCV_IP_OP_IND, OSTS_STS_DESC, OO_ORD_ID, S.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) SELECT A.*, CASE WHEN B.OO_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Has Check O2 Order" FROM APNEA A LEFT JOIN O2 B ON A.OO_MRN = B.OO_MRN

prompt: Pediatric inpatients on gabapentin between 1/1/2016 and 5/31/2018
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT VIS_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_HOSP_SVC, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME, OMD_DOSE_LOW, OMD_ORD_ROUTE FROM IDB.VISIT_V JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON VIS_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OMD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) like '%gabapentin%' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2018-05-31' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND VIS_DSCH_DTE AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_HOSP_SVC IN ('PDB', 'PDG', 'PDP', 'PDR', 'PDU', 'PED') ) , CDB AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM (SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN FROM PTS) A JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON VIS_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) SELECT VIS_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_SEX "Gender", TM_DX_DTE"Tumor Dx Date", SITE_CODE "Tumor Site Code", SITE_DESC "Tumor Site Desc", HIST_CODE "Tumor Histology Code", HIST_DESC "Tumor Histology Desc", VIS_ADM_DTE "Admission Date", VIS_DSCH_DTE "Discharge Date", VIS_HOSP_SVC "Service", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE "Gabapentin Date", OO_ORD_NAME "Order Name", OMD_DOSE_LOW "Gabapentin Dose", OMD_ORD_ROUTE "Gabapentin Route" FROM PTS LEFT JOIN CDB ON VIS_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE 1=1 ; ) , FINAL AS (SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", YEAR(APR_START_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at Chemo" , APR_GENERIC_NAME "Chemo", APR_START_DTE "Start Date", TIME(APR_START_DT) "Start Time", APR_END_DTE "End Date", APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE "Dose", APR_DOSE_UOM "UOM" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON VIS_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE 1=1 AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND VIS_DSCH_DTE AND APR_START_DTE >= OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AND CDG_CHEMO_IND = 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", APR_START_DTE "Start Date", APR_GENERIC_NAME "Chemo", OO_SET_NAME "Set Name", OO_ORD_NAME "Order Name", OMD_DOSE_LOW "Dose", OMD_ORD_ROUTE "Route", OOT_TASK_START_DTE "Start Date", OOT_TASK_START_TME "Start Time" FROM FINAL F JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON VIS_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OMD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OAS_ORDER_TASK ON OO_ORD_GUID = OOT_ORD_GUID WHERE OO_SET_NAME IN ('SRx-Peds Chemo Premeds', 'SRx_Peds Chemo Supt') AND APR_START_DTE = OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE

prompt: Please provide a list of patients seen by neurology oncologists that are taking anti-epileptic drug between 2010-2015.
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT * FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES WHERE ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' ), "cte2" AS (SELECT EDC_DEPT_ABBREV, EDC_DEPT_DESC FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG WHERE EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS' ), "cte3" AS (SELECT DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_CODE)) DXCC_ICD_CODE, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC)) DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_CODE)) || ' - ' || LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC)) AS DXCC_CODE_AND_MSK_DESC, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_NATIONAL_DESC)) DXCC_ICD_NATIONAL_DESC, DXCC_DESC_LONG, CASE WHEN DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '196' AND '196.99' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '197' AND '197.99' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '198' AND '198.99' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS DXCC_METS_INDICATOR, DXCC_CREATED_DT, DXCC_CREATED_BY, DXCC_MODIFIED_DT FROM DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG WHERE DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD9' ) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PINC_ITEM_NAME" AS "Drug Name", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "First Order Start Date", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Last Order Stop Date", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Encounter Date", "t6"."ENR_RES_NAME" AS "Primary Resource Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t7"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-9 Final Dx Code", "t7"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-9 Final Dx Description", "t8"."DT_DTE" AS "ICD-9 First Final Diagnosis Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t9" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t10" ON "t9"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t10"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t11" ON "t10"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t11"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t10"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t11"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t2" ON "t11"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t2"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t10"."FIST_START_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t10"."LAST_STOP_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER" "t12" ON "t9"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t12"."PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t12"."PENC_ENC_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t13" ON "t12"."PENC_PT_ENC_ID" = "t13"."ENSR_PT_ENC_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE" "t6" ON "t13"."ENSR_RES_ID" = "t6"."ENR_ENC_RES_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT" "t14" ON "t12"."PENC_DEPT_ID" = "t14"."ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte2" "t15" ON "t12"."PENC_APPT_STS" = "t15"."EDC_DEPT_ABBREV" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t16" ON "t9"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t16"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte3" "t7" ON "t16"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t7"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_DATES_V" "t17" ON "t16"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t17"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" AND "t16"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t17"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t8" ON "t17"."FIRST_DIAGNOSIS_DATE_ID" = "t8"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t18" ON "t16"."PDX_DX_DATE_ID" = "t18"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t19" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t19"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE (UPPER("t2"."PINC_ITEM_NAME") IN ('CARBAMAZEPINE', 'ATRETOL', 'CARBAGEN SR', 'EPITOL', 'MAZEPINE', 'TEGRETOL', 'TEGRITAL', 'TERIL', 'TIMONIL', 'CARBATROL', 'CLOBAZAM', 'FRISIUM', 'ONFI', 'CLONAZEPAM', 'EPITRIL', 'KLONOPIN', 'RIVOTRIL', 'DIAZEPAM', 'DIASTAT', 'VALIUM', 'DIVALPROEX SODIUM', 'DEPACON', 'DEPAKOTE', 'EPIVAL', 'DIVALPROEX SODIUM', 'ESLICARBAZEPINE ACETATE', 'APTIOM', 'ETHOSUXIMIDE', 'ZARONTIN', 'EZOGABINE', 'POTIGA', 'FELBAMATE', 'FELBATOL', 'GABAPENTIN', 'NEURONTIN', 'LACOSAMIDE', 'VIMPAT', 'LAMOTRIGINE', 'LAMICTAL', 'LEVETIRACETAM', 'KEPPRA', 'LORAZEPAM', 'ATIVAN', 'OXCARBAZEPINE', 'OXTELLAR', 'TRILEPTAL', 'PERAMPANEL', 'FYCOMPA', 'PHENOBARBITAL', 'PHENYTOIN', 'DILANTIN', 'EPANUTIN', 'PHENYTEK', 'PREGABALIN', 'LYRICA', 'PRIMIDONE', 'MYSOLINE', 'RUFINAMIDE', 'BANZEL', 'INOVELON', 'TIAGABINE HYDROCHLORIDE', 'GABITRIL', 'TOPIRAMATE', 'TOPAMAX', 'QUDEXY', 'TROKENDI', 'VALPROIC ACID', 'CONVULEX', 'DEPAKENE', 'DEPAKINE', 'ORFIRIL', 'VALPORAL', 'VALPROSID', 'VIGABATRIN', 'SABRIL', 'ZONISAMIDE', 'ZONEGRAN') AND ("t14"."ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6" = 'NEU' AND ("t6"."ENR_RES_TYP" IN ('PhD', 'Physician') AND (CASE WHEN "t15"."EDC_DEPT_DESC"IN ('Arrived', 'Completed') THEN 'Completed' WHEN "t15"."EDC_DEPT_DESC" IN ('Scheduled') THEN 'Scheduled' ELSE 'Non-Completed/Scheduled' END = 'Completed' AND ("t5"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2015-1-1' AND '2015-8-31' AND ("t14"."ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8" = 'NEU' AND ("t16"."DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT" = 'YES' AND ("t18"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2010-1-1' AND '2015-8-31' AND ("t7"."DXCC_METS_INDICATOR" = 'Yes' AND "t19"."PI_SOURCE_SYSTEM_PT_ID" = '00171509')))))))))

prompt: Tableau dashboard to show Quick Treat RN and Phlebotomy activity
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_EXT_RES_NAME "Location", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CVT_EXT_NAME AS "Visit Type Category", CLE_NAME AS "User Name", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE AS CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT AS CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE AS CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_USER ON CPE_ENTER_USER_ID = CLE_USER_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2019-01-01' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('LAB', 'CHM') AND (CRE_RES_NAME LIKE 'LAB%' OR ((CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%RN%' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%TX%') OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%TX%'))

prompt: Search pathology reports from for specific diagnostic terms. To be used by Dr. Jessica Chapman-Lim.
completion: SELECT PRPT_MRN "MRN", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of birth", RTRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) || ', ' || PT_LAST_NAME AS "Patient name", PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "Procedure date", PRPT_REPORT_DTE "Report date", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC "Report type", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Accession no", PRPT_REPORT "Path report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND LEFT(PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 1) IN ('H', 'S') AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' AND CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '("phosphaturic mesenchymal tumor")') = 1 ;

prompt: Provide a list of inpatient days for adolescent and young adult patients aged 15 to 39 in 2019.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, ADMIT_DATE, SERVICE_ADMIT, LOS FROM IDB.INPATIENT_ADMISSIONS_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN WHERE ADMIT_DATE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND YEAR(ADMIT_DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 15 AND 39

prompt: Patients who received IVAC (ifosfamide, etoposide, and cytarabine) 1/1/2004 or later.
completion: WITH IVAC AS (SELECT DISTINCT I.APR_MRN IVAC_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V I JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V E ON I.APR_MRN = E.APR_MRN AND E.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'ETOPOSIDE' AND I.APR_START_DTE = E.APR_START_DTE JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V C ON I.APR_MRN = C.APR_MRN AND C.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'CYTARABINE' AND I.APR_START_DTE = C.APR_START_DTE WHERE I.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'IFOSFAMIDE' AND YEAR(I.APR_START_DTE) >= 2004 ) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN "MRN", YEAR(APR_START_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age", CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME "Chemo Name", APR_START_DTE "Start Date", APR_END_DTE "End Date", APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE "Prescribed Dose", APR_TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE "Total Give Dose" FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IVAC ON APR_MRN = IVAC_MRN WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('IFOSFAMIDE', 'ETOPOSIDE', 'CYTARABINE', 'RITUXIMAB', 'DOXORUBICIN') AND YEAR(APR_START_DTE) >= 2004 ORDER BY 1 DESC, 4, 3

prompt: Supportive Care Outpatient visit frequency and time interval between appointments in 2021
completion: WITH RAW AS (SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "DOD", CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_CENTER "Location", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_TYP AS "Provider Type", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND (CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME like '%APP%') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'SUP' ) , CNT AS (SELECT MRN, COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) "Appt Count" FROM RAW GROUP BY MRN) , FINAL AS (SELECT RAW.MRN, RAW."Last Name", RAW."First Name", "DOD", "Appt Count", RAW.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, RAW."Appt Date", RAW."Location", RAW."Department", RAW."Service", RAW."Department Name", RAW."Provider Type", RAW."Provider Name", RAW."Visit Type", RAW.RN FROM RAW JOIN CNT ON RAW.MRN = CNT.MRN) , PIVOT AS (SELECT MRN, "Last Name", "First Name", "DOD", "Appt Count", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN "Appt Date" END) "Appt Date 1", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN "Visit Type" END) "Visit Type 1", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN "Location" END) "Location 1", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN "Provider Name" END) "Provider Name 1", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 2 THEN "Appt Date" END) "Appt Date 2", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 2 THEN "Visit Type" END) "Visit Type 2", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 2 THEN "Location" END) "Location 2", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 2 THEN "Provider Name" END) "Provider Name 2", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 3 THEN "Appt Date" END) "Appt Date 3", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 3 THEN "Visit Type" END) "Visit Type 3", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 3 THEN "Location" END) "Location 3", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 3 THEN "Provider Name" END) "Provider Name 3", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 4 THEN "Appt Date" END) "Appt Date 4", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 4 THEN "Visit Type" END) "Visit Type 4", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 4 THEN "Location" END) "Location 4", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 4 THEN "Provider Name" END) "Provider Name 4", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 5 THEN "Appt Date" END) "Appt Date 5", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 5 THEN "Visit Type" END) "Visit Type 5", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 5 THEN "Location" END) "Location 5", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 5 THEN "Provider Name" END) "Provider Name 5", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 6 THEN "Appt Date" END) "Appt Date 6", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 6 THEN "Visit Type" END) "Visit Type 6", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 6 THEN "Location" END) "Location 6", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 6 THEN "Provider Name" END) "Provider Name 6", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 7 THEN "Appt Date" END) "Appt Date 7", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 7 THEN "Visit Type" END) "Visit Type 7", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 7 THEN "Location" END) "Location 7", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 7 THEN "Provider Name" END) "Provider Name 7", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 8 THEN "Appt Date" END) "Appt Date 8", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 8 THEN "Visit Type" END) "Visit Type 8", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 8 THEN "Location" END) "Location 8", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 8 THEN "Provider Name" END) "Provider Name 8", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 9 THEN "Appt Date" END) "Appt Date 9", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 9 THEN "Visit Type" END) "Visit Type 9", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 9 THEN "Location" END) "Location 9", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 9 THEN "Provider Name" END) "Provider Name 9", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 10 THEN "Appt Date" END) "Appt Date 10", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 10 THEN "Visit Type" END) "Visit Type 10", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 10 THEN "Location" END) "Location 10", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 10 THEN "Provider Name" END) "Provider Name 10", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 11 THEN "Appt Date" END) "Appt Date 11", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 11 THEN "Visit Type" END) "Visit Type 11", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 11 THEN "Location" END) "Location 11", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 11 THEN "Provider Name" END) "Provider Name 11" FROM FINAL GROUP BY MRN, "Last Name", "First Name", "DOD", "Appt Count") SELECT MRN, "Last Name", "First Name", "DOD", "Appt Count", "Appt Date 1", "Visit Type 1", "Location 1", "Provider Name 1", "Appt Date 2", DAYS("Appt Date 2") - DAYS("Appt Date 1") DAYS_BETWEEN_APPT2_AND_APPT1, "Visit Type 2", "Location 2", "Provider Name 2", "Appt Date 3", DAYS("Appt Date 3") - DAYS("Appt Date 2") DAYS_BETWEEN_APPT3_AND_APPT2, "Visit Type 3", "Location 3", "Provider Name 3", "Appt Date 4", DAYS("Appt Date 4") - DAYS("Appt Date 3") DAYS_BETWEEN_APPT4_AND_APPT3, "Visit Type 4", "Location 4", "Provider Name 4", "Appt Date 5", DAYS("Appt Date 5") - DAYS("Appt Date 4") DAYS_BETWEEN_APPT5_AND_APPT4, "Visit Type 5", "Location 5", "Provider Name 5", "Appt Date 6", DAYS("Appt Date 6") - DAYS("Appt Date 5") DAYS_BETWEEN_APPT6_AND_APPT5, "Visit Type 6", "Location 6", "Provider Name 6", "Appt Date 7", DAYS("Appt Date 7") - DAYS("Appt Date 6") DAYS_BETWEEN_APPT7_AND_APPT6, "Visit Type 7", "Location 7", "Provider Name 7", "Appt Date 8", DAYS("Appt Date 8") - DAYS("Appt Date 7") DAYS_BETWEEN_APPT8_AND_APPT7, "Visit Type 8", "Location 8", "Provider Name 8", "Appt Date 9", DAYS("Appt Date 9") - DAYS("Appt Date 8") DAYS_BETWEEN_APPT9_AND_APPT8, "Visit Type 9", "Location 9", "Provider Name 9", "Appt Date 10", DAYS("Appt Date 10") - DAYS("Appt Date 9") DAYS_BETWEEN_APPT10_AND_APPT9, "Visit Type 10", "Location 10", "Provider Name 10", "Appt Date 11", DAYS("Appt Date 11") - DAYS("Appt Date 10") DAYS_BETWEEN_APPT11_AND_APPT10, "Visit Type 11", "Location 11", "Provider Name 11" FROM PIVOT

prompt: Provide diagnostic molecular pathology panel data for a list of MRNs.
completion: WITH VARIANTS_TO_OMIT (CNV_TYPE_OMIT) AS ( VALUES ('snp-indel-silent-np'),('snp-indel-silent')) , VARIANT_CLASS_TO_OMIT (VARIANT_CLASS_OMIT) AS ( VALUES ('Unknown'),('UTR3'),('UTR5'),('intronic'),('synonymous_SNV')) , PTS AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS P_MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS WHERE 1=1 AND PT_MRN IN ('38184092', '38184648', '38184500', '38100887', '00012914', '00031681') ) , PART_A_C AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS PART_A_C_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE END) "Part A Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '300' THEN CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE END) "Part C Consent Date" FROM NN.CRDB_DASH_PT_REG CRDB JOIN PTS ON P_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CRDB.PRT_ID = '12-245' AND COALESCE(REG_ID, '') IN ('100', '300') AND CRNT_ELGBL_STATUS_DSCRP NOT IN ('Ineligible', 'Cancel') GROUP BY PT_MRN ) , CONSENT_06_107 AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN AS MRN_06_107, AC_CONS_DTE AS "06-107 Consent Date", ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE AS "06-107 Off Date" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = P_MRN JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON ACD_MRN = AC_MRN AND ACD_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO AND AC_IRB_NO = '06-107') , CONSENT_12_245 AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN AS MRN_12_245, AC_CONS_DTE AS "12-245 Consent Date", ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE AS "12-245 Off Date" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = P_MRN JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON ACD_MRN = AC_MRN AND ACD_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO AND AC_IRB_NO = '12-245') , DMP AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS DMP_MRN , MAINRPT.DT_DTE AS "Report Date" , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , PDWS_NAME , T.* , DV.TODATE(DT_PROCEDURE) AS "Procedure Date" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML JOIN PTS ON P_ID = PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V MAINPATH ON MAINPATH.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V MAINRPT ON MAINRPT.DT_DATE_ID = MAINPATH.PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS CNV_TYPE VARCHAR(500) PATH 'name()', VARIANT_CLASS VARCHAR(100) PATH 'variant_class', DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure', SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site', SUBMITTING_PHYSICIAN VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/submitting_physician', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/part_description') T LEFT JOIN VARIANTS_TO_OMIT ON CNV_TYPE = CNV_TYPE_OMIT LEFT JOIN VARIANT_CLASS_TO_OMIT ON VARIANT_CLASS = VARIANT_CLASS_OMIT WHERE 1=1 AND CNV_TYPE_OMIT IS NULL AND VARIANT_CLASS_OMIT IS NULL ) , PATH_REFERENCES AS (SELECT DISTINCT DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS DMP_ACC_NO , SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS SRG_ACC_NO , SRG_DATE.DT_DTE AS SRG_PROC_DTE , CASE SUBSTR(SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 1, 1) WHEN 'S' THEN 1 WHEN 'C' THEN 2 WHEN 'M' THEN 3 WHEN 'D' THEN 4 ELSE 9 END AS CUST_ORDER , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO ORDER BY CASE SUBSTR(SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 1, 1) WHEN 'S' THEN 1 WHEN 'C' THEN 2 WHEN 'M' THEN 3 WHEN 'D' THEN 4 ELSE 9 END) AS RN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V DMP JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_ACCESSION_NO FROM DMP) DIAG ON DIAG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_REFERENCES ON PRPTR_CHILD_PATH_RPT_ID = DMP.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V SRG ON SRG.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPTR_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V SRG_DATE ON SRG_DATE.DT_DATE_ID = SRG.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID WHERE 1=1 ) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", CASE WHEN "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE") END AS "Cur Age", "t1"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS "Vital Status", "t1"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender", "t1"."PT_RACE_DESC" AS "Race", "t2"."CORE_ETHNICITY_DESC" AS "Ethnicity", "t3"."PLA_LAST_DRVST_DTE" AS "Last Dr Visit Date" , PDWS_NAME AS "Panel" , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession No" , "Report Date" , "Procedure Date" , DT_PROCEDURE , SRG_ACC_NO AS "Assoc Path" , SRG_PROC_DTE AS "Assoc Proc Date" , DV.REGEXSTR('[CGMS]\d{1,2}-\d{1,6}', PART_DESCRIPTION) AS "Assoc Path from Part" , PATIENTID , SAMPLEID , PRIMARY_SITE , TUMOR_TYPE_NAME , METASTASIS_SITE , PART_DESCRIPTION , "06-107 Consent Date" , "06-107 Off Date" , "12-245 Consent Date" , "12-245 Off Date" , "Part A Consent Date" , "Part C Consent Date" FROM PTS JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t1" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = P_ID LEFT JOIN DMP ON DMP_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t2" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN PATH_REFERENCES ON DMP_ACC_NO = PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AND RN = 1 LEFT JOIN CONSENT_06_107 ON MRN_06_107 = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN CONSENT_12_245 ON MRN_12_245 = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN PART_A_C ON PART_A_C_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY PT_MRN, "Accession No"

prompt: Provide all patients under the age of 21 with a diagnosis of melanoma or atypical spitzoid melanocytic lesions from 2016 to present.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB, PT_DEATH_DTE AS DOD, PT_VITAL_STATUS, YEAR("t4"."DT_DTE" - PT_BIRTH_DTE) AS AGE, "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT, CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS DIAGNOSIS, CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENSSUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENSSUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS "SPECIMENS SUBMITTED" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("melanoma" OR "malignant melanoma" OR "atypical spitzoid melanocytic lesion" OR " spitz nevus" OR "spitzoid melanoma" OR "atypical spitz nevus" OR "spitz" OR "spitzoid")') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND UPPER("t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC") like '%SURGICAL PATHOLOGY%' AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND YEAR("t4"."DT_DTE" - PT_BIRTH_DTE) < 21

prompt: Provide a daily csv file, derived from a CIS note called the "Shared Care Note" to entail list of patients that have recently been discharged from partner hospitals.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CL_MRN , CL_LAST_NAME, CL_FIRST_NAME, CL_MOBILE_PHONE, CL_PHONE, CL_EMAIL_ADDRESS, CL_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CL_SEX, CL_ZIP, PREF_LANG, UNIQUE_VISIT_ID, REFERRING_MD, REFERRING_MD AS PROVIDER_ID, ADM_DATE, DSCH_DATE, DISPOSITION, HOSPITAL FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CL_MRN , CL_LAST_NAME, CL_FIRST_NAME, CL_MOBILE_PHONE, CL_PHONE, CL_EMAIL_ADDRESS, CL_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CL_SEX, CL_ZIP, CAV_TITLE AS PREF_LANG, CDD_DOC_GUID AS UNIQUE_VISIT_ID, REFMD.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS REFERRING_MD , CAST(RTRIM(ADM_DTE.CDO_VALUE_TEXT) AS date) AS ADM_DATE , CAST (RTRIM(DSCH_DTE.CDO_VALUE_TEXT) AS date) AS DSCH_DATE, DSCH.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS DISPOSITION , HOSP.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS HOSPITAL , PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND, PLA_DECEASED_IND FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION DSCH ON DSCH.CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION DSCH_DTE ON DSCH_DTE.CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND DSCH_DTE.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Actual Inpatient Discharge Date' LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ADM_DTE ON ADM_DTE.CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND ADM_DTE.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'ED Admission' LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION DR ON DR.CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND DR.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'MSK Comm Primary LIP' LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION HOSP ON HOSP.CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND HOSP.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Hospitals' LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION REFMD ON REFMD.CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND REFMD.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'MSK Comm Primary LIP' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON DSCH.CDO_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OP_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OP_PVDR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = CL_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CDD_MRN = PLA_MRN AND (PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND <> 'Y' OR PLA_DECEASED_IND <> 'Y') LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY ON CL_PRIMARY_LANG = CAV_ABBR WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_ENTER_DTE = CURRENT DATE - 1 AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'External Communication - Shared Care-Discharge Summary' AND DSCH.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Discharged to' AND DSCH.CDO_VALUE_TEXT IN ('Home', 'Home with home services') ) AS X WHERE 1=1 AND DSCH_DATE IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT CL_MRN , CL_LAST_NAME, CL_FIRST_NAME, CL_MOBILE_PHONE, CL_PHONE, CL_EMAIL_ADDRESS, CL_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CL_SEX, CL_ZIP, CAV_TITLE AS PREF_LANG, OUO_ORD_GUID AS UNIQUE_VISIT_ID, REFERRING_MD, REFERRING_MD AS PROVIDER_ID, ADM_DTE, DISCH_DTE, DISPOSITION, HOSPITAL FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OUO_MRN, OUO_ENTER_DTE , OUO_ORD_GUID , OUO_ORD_NAME , HOSP.OUD_USER_DI_CD, HOSP.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS HOSP, DSCH.OUD_USER_DI_CD, CAST (RTRIM(DSCH.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS date) AS DSCH_DTE FROM IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OUO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA HOSP ON HOSP.OUD_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA DSCH ON DSCH.OUD_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID AND DSCH.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'External_Hospital_Discharge_Date' WHERE 1=1 AND OUO_ENTER_DTE = CURRENT DATE - 1 AND OUO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP') AND OUO_ORD_NAME = 'External Hospital Discharge' AND HOSP.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'External_Hospital_Location' ) AS X JOIN IDACS.PARTNER_HOSP_ADMISSIONS ON OUO_MRN = MRN AND DSCH_DTE = DISCH_DTE AND UPPER(DISPOSITION) IN ('HOME', 'HOME WITH HOME SERVICES', 'HOME WITH OUTPATIENT SERVICES') JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON MRN = CL_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON MRN = PLA_MRN AND (PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND <> 'Y' OR PLA_DECEASED_IND <> 'Y') LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY ON CL_PRIMARY_LANG = CAV_ABBR

prompt: Provide appointment data on patients enrolled to protocol 14-035.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = AC_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON AC_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 7 DAYS AND AC_IRB_NO = '14-035'

prompt: Perform similar query to prior project (MED19044), except only in 1 sarcoma subtype: angiosarcoma
completion: WITH ANGIO AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("angiosarcoma")') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '1960-04-01' AND '2020-12-31' ) , PTS AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN TM_MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PT_SEX, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", PLA_LST_CON_DTE "Last Contact Date", TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_DX_DTE, APR_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) "Drug Start Date", MAX(APR_END_DTE) "Drug End Date" FROM ANGIO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON APR_MRN = PRPT_MRN AND APR_GENERIC_NAME IN ('ATEZOLIZUMAB', 'AVELUMAB', 'BMS-936558', 'CEMIPLIMAB', 'DURVALUMAB', 'MDX-1106', 'MEDI4736', 'MK-3475', 'MPDL3280A', 'MSB0010718C', 'NIVOLUMAB', 'PEMBROLIZUMAB', 'REGN2810', 'IPILIMUMAB', 'MDX-010', 'TREMELIMUMAB', 'TICILIMUMAB (CP-675,206)', 'PDR001') AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '1960-04-01' AND '2020-12-31' JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PRPT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON PRPT_MRN = TM_MRN AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1960-04-01' AND '2020-12-31' LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY GROUP BY PRPT_MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PT_SEX, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, TM_DX_DTE, APR_GENERIC_NAME, PLA_LST_CON_DTE, R.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC) , PROTOCOLS AS (SELECT AC_MRN, LISTAGG(TRIM(AC_IRB_NO), ', ') "Protocols" FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN IDB.PROTOCOL ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO WHERE PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE = 'Therapeutic' AND AC_MRN IN (SELECT TM_MRN FROM PTS) AND AC_CONS_DTE BETWEEN '1960-04-01' AND '2020-12-31' GROUP BY AC_MRN) , PS AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_AUTHORED_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_AUTHORED_DTE DESC) AS RANK FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT T1 INNER JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION T2 ON T1.CDD_DOC_GUID=T2.CDO_DOC_GUID AND T1.CDD_MRN=T2.CDO_MRN JOIN PTS ON CDD_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE (CDO_ITEM_NAME like '%ECOG%' OR CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM like '%ECOG%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT like '%ECOG%' OR CDO_ITEM_NAME like '%KPS%' OR CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM like '%KPS%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT like '%KPS%' OR LCASE(CDO_ITEM_NAME) like '%karnofsky%' OR LCASE(CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM) like '%karnofsky%' OR LCASE(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%karnofsky%') AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE BETWEEN "Drug Start Date" - 30 DAYS AND "Drug Start Date" AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE BETWEEN '1960-04-01' AND '2020-12-31' ) A WHERE RANK = 1 ) SELECT PTS.*, YEAR("Drug Start Date" - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at Tx", CDD_AUTHORED_DTE "PFS Date", CDO_VALUE_TEXT "PFS", "Protocols" FROM PTS LEFT JOIN PS ON CDD_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN PROTOCOLS ON AC_MRN = TM_MRN ; WITH ANGIO AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("angiosarcoma")') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '1960-04-01' AND '2020-12-31' ) , PTS AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN TM_MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PT_SEX, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", PLA_LST_CON_DTE "Last Contact Date", TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_DX_DTE, APR_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) "Drug Start Date", MAX(APR_END_DTE) "Drug End Date" FROM ANGIO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON APR_MRN = PRPT_MRN AND APR_GENERIC_NAME IN ('ATEZOLIZUMAB', 'AVELUMAB', 'BMS-936558', 'CEMIPLIMAB', 'DURVALUMAB', 'MDX-1106', 'MEDI4736', 'MK-3475', 'MPDL3280A', 'MSB0010718C', 'NIVOLUMAB', 'PEMBROLIZUMAB', 'REGN2810', 'IPILIMUMAB', 'MDX-010', 'TREMELIMUMAB', 'TICILIMUMAB (CP-675,206)', 'PDR001') AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '1960-04-01' AND '2020-12-31' JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PRPT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON PRPT_MRN = TM_MRN AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1960-04-01' AND '2020-12-31' LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY GROUP BY PRPT_MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PT_SEX, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, TM_DX_DTE, APR_GENERIC_NAME, PLA_LST_CON_DTE, R.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC) SELECT PTS.*, PDWS_NAME, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, TMBSCORE, MSI_SCORE, MSI_TYPE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID INNER JOIN DV.DATE DTPROCPATHRPT ON PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID = DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DATE_ID AND DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DTE BETWEEN '1960-04-01' AND '2020-12-31' JOIN PTS ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN, XMLTABLE('$x/root/meta-data' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "x" COLUMNS TMBSCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score', MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'msi-score', MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'msi-type') T

prompt: Provide a list of patients who received pneumococcal vaccination pre- and post- implementation of pneumococcal vaccination orderset on 4/27/2015
completion: WITH ORD AS (SELECT OO_MRN AS MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE PLACED_DATE , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE START_DATE, OOC_ITEM_NAME ORD_NAME , OMD_DOSE_LOW DOSE, OMD_DOSE_UNIT UOM, OCV_CURR_LOC CURR_LOC , OO_ORD_ID ORDID, STRIP(OO_ORD_STS_CD)||' - '|| OSTS_STS_DESC CIS_STATUS , REQ.OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS REQUESTER, REQ.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE REQST_ROLE , SUBSTR(OO_SET_NAME, 1, 55) SETNAME, OO_SUMMARY_LINE SUMMARYLINE , OO_ORD_GUID ORD_GUID, OMD_ORD_ROUTE ROUTE , OO_ORD_FREQ ORD_FREQ, OO_REQ_TME_PRIO TIME_PRIORITY , CASE WHEN OO_REQ_TME_PRIO IN ('NYS Paper', 'Outside Order', 'Fill at MSK', 'Medicaid') OR OO_IS_FOR_DSCH = 'Y' OR(OO_REQ_TME_PRIO = 'Routine' AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'O' AND OCV_CARE_LVL NOT IN ('AXR', 'UCO', 'OR', 'UCC')) THEN 'Rx' ELSE OCV_IP_OP_IND||'P' END AS ORD_TYPE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON OL_LOC_GUID = OCV_CURR_LOC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OMD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER REQ ON OO_PVDR_GUID = REQ.OU_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD IN ('COMP', 'COMPT', 'DISC', 'DISCD', 'AUA2', 'AUC1') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '5/1/2014' AND '7/31/2016' AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000001171073001', '9000006177100730', '9000006283200730', '9000006283300730') ) , EMAR AS (SELECT OOTO_ORD_GUID, 'Y' EMAR_PERF_IND , MAX(OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DT) LST_ADMIN , COUNT(*) ADMIN_CNT, SUM(OOTO_TASK_DOSE) EMAR_TTL_DOSE FROM ORD JOIN IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = ORD_GUID AND OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID AND OCIT_LEVEL_NO = 0 GROUP BY OOTO_ORD_GUID, OCIT_PERF_POL_NAME, OCIT_REV_CAT_CD) SELECT MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME PT_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, YEAR(START_DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE , PLACED_DATE, ORD_NAME, START_DATE, DOSE, UOM, CURR_LOC , ORDID, CIS_STATUS, REQUESTER, REQST_ROLE, SETNAME , SUMMARYLINE, ROUTE, ORD_FREQ, TIME_PRIORITY, ORD_TYPE , EMAR_PERF_IND, CHAR(DATE(LST_ADMIN))||' '|| REPLACE(CHAR(TIME(LST_ADMIN)), '.', ':') LST_ADMIN , ADMIN_CNT, EMAR_TTL_DOSE , CASE WHEN(ORD_TYPE = 'Rx' AND CIS_STATUS NOT LIKE 'DISC%') OR EMAR_PERF_IND = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END PERFORMED_IND FROM ORD LEFT JOIN EMAR ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of patients who presented at MSKCC with lymphoma after or while treated with dupilumab / dupixent  since  2017
completion: WITH PROV AS (SELECT DISTINCT CRE_RES_ID AS PROV_ID, CRE_RES_NAME AS PROV_NAME, 'cat2' AS CATEGORY, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS SVC FROM IDB.CL_DEPT JOIN IDB.CL_RES_DEPT ON CPD_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPD_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Physician Assistant') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'LYM' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' UNION SELECT DISTINCT CRE_RES_ID AS PROV_ID, CRE_RES_NAME AS PROV_NAME, 'cat1' AS CATEGORY, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS SVC FROM IDB.CL_DEPT JOIN IDB.CL_RES_DEPT ON CPD_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPD_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE CRE_RES_ID IN ('000612', '427412', '024380', '019927' ) ) , VIS AS (SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN, VIS_DTE, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, VIS_ATN_DR_NO, X.DOC_NAME AS ATTENDING_DR FROM IDB.VISIT JOIN IDB.DOC X ON X.DOC_DR_NO = VIS_ATN_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = VIS_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND VIS_ATN_DR_NO IN (SELECT PROV_ID FROM PROV) AND VIS_PATIENT_TYPE IN ('IP', 'OP') AND VIS_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2024-01-01' ) , CDD AS (SELECT CDD_MRN , PATIENT_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE ASC) CDD_RN, CDO_SECTION , CDO_ITEM_NAME , CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN VIS ON VIS_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE = VIS_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2024-01-01' AND REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), '(upadacitinib|rinvoq|baricitinib|olumiant|abrocitinib|cibinqo|ruxolitinib|jakafi|opzelura|tofacitinib|xeljanz|vonjo|pacritinib|inrebic|fedratinib)', 'i') ) , DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, LISTAGG (ICD, ',') AS ICD9_DESC FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, SUBSTR (CC_CLSF_CD || '-' || TRIM(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK), 1, 100) AS ICD FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN CDD ON CDD_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE INSTR(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, 'LYMPHOMA') > 0 AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) GROUP BY CC_MRN) , PDX AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN AS MRN, PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS PATH_REPORT_DATE, UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) AS DIAG_1, UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=COMMENT:)', PRPT_REPORT)) AS DIAG_2, UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) AS DIAG_3, UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=IATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) AS DIAG_4, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PRPT_MRN ORDER BY PRPT_REPORT_DTE DESC) RN_P FROM CDD JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V T2 ON PRPT_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC = 'LYM' AND T2.PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ) SELECT CDD_MRN, PATIENT_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, ICD9_DESC, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, CASE WHEN DIAG_1 <> '' THEN DIAG_1 ELSE CASE WHEN DIAG_2 <> '' THEN DIAG_2 ELSE CASE WHEN DIAG_3 <> '' THEN DIAG_3 ELSE CASE WHEN DIAG_4 <> '' THEN DIAG_4 END END END END AS PATH_DX FROM CDD D LEFT JOIN DX ON CC_MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN PDX ON CDD_MRN = MRN AND RN_P =1 WHERE CDD_RN =1

prompt: Provide a spreadsheet of patients who had conventional spine RT and also received chemotherapy that is known to be associated with increased risk of RT recall phenomenon (doxorubicin, docetaxel, paclitaxel, gemcitabine, capecitabine)
completion: WITH CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS END_DATE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND(UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) like '%DOXORUBICIN%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) like '%DOCETAXEL%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) like '%PACLITAXEL%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) like '%GEMCITABINE%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) like '%CAPECITABINE%') GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE ) , RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN AS MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN CHEMO ON APR_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN ) , TM AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, CASE WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS STAGE FROM RT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) , MAIN AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_SEX AS GENDER, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE, HIST_CODE, HIST_DESC, SITE_CODE, SITE_DESC, DX_DATE, STAGE FROM RT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' LEFT JOIN TM ON MRN = TM_MRN) , SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM RT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 ) SELECT * FROM SRG

prompt: Provide three lists of patients, one with the diagnosis of Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL) and Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma (DLBCL), one with the diagnosis of CLL and Hodgkin's Lymphoma, and one with CLL and Richter's Transformation.
completion: WITH CLL AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN CLL_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C91.1%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '204.1%' ) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2020-08-13' UNION SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN CLL_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7') AND CATEGORY3 IN ('Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2020-08-13' ) , DLBCL AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN DLBCL_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C83.3%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '200.0%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '200.5%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '200.7%' ) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2020-08-13' UNION SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN DLBCL_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M9680/3' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2020-08-13' ) , HODGKINS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN HODGKINS_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C81.%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '201.%' ) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2020-08-13' UNION SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN HODGKINS_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7') AND CATEGORY2 IN ('Hodgkin Lymphoma') AND CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%richter%' ) SELECT PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('X', 'C', 'D') THEN 'Deceased' ELSE 'Alive' END VITAL_STATUS, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH DOD, PLA_LST_DRVST_DTE LAST_DR_VISIT_DATE, PLA_LST_RT_DTE LAST_RT_DATE FROM RICHTERS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CDD_MRN = PLA_MRN ; WITH CLL AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN CLL_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C91.1%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '204.1%' ) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2020-08-13' UNION SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN CLL_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7') AND CATEGORY3 IN ('Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2020-08-13' ) , DLBCL AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN DLBCL_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C83.3%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '200.0%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '200.5%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '200.7%' ) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2020-08-13' UNION SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN DLBCL_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M9680/3' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2020-08-13' ) , HODGKINS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN HODGKINS_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C81.%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '201.%' ) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2020-08-13' UNION SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN HODGKINS_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7') AND CATEGORY2 IN ('Hodgkin Lymphoma') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN 'C91.1%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '204.1%' ) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2020-08-13' UNION LIKE 'C83.3%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '200.0%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '200.5%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '200.7%' ) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2020-08-13' UNION SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN DLBCL_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M9680/3' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2020-08-13' ) , HODGKINS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN HODGKINS_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C81.%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '201.%' ) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND prompt: Requesting list of patients investigating kidney function in the setting of cancer treatment/toxicity.  This is for a forthcoming project under IRB#16-834,
completion: WITH PROCEDURES_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_LOG_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD") AS VARCHAR) || ' - ' || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC") AS VARCHAR) AS PROC_CODE_DESC FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE" ON "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_LOG_ID" = "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_LOG_ID" WHERE "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD" IN ('50200', '50205')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM ( (SELECT PROCEDURES_0.PT_DEID FROM PROCEDURES_0))), COHORT_PROCEDURES AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM ( (SELECT PROCEDURES_0.SUBJECT_ID, PROCEDURES_0.PT_DEID FROM PROCEDURES_0))), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_PROCEDURES.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_PROCEDURES_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_PROCEDURES.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PROCEDURES_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_PROCEDURES ON COHORT_PROCEDURES.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN"), PROCEDURES_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_LOG_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_SURG_DTE" AS PROC_SURG_DATE, "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD" AS PROC_CODE, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD") AS VARCHAR) || ' - ' || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC") AS VARCHAR) AS PROC_CODE_DESC, "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_LOG_STS" AS SSE_LOG_STS, "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_SURG_SVC_CD" AS PROC_SURG_SERVICE, "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_SURG_LOC" AS SSE_SURG_LOC, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_SURG_LAST_NM") AS VARCHAR) || ', ' || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM") AS VARCHAR) AS SURGEON, "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_LOG_ID" AS SSE_LOG_ID, "IDB"."VISIT"."VIS_ADM_DTE" AS SRG_ADM_DTE, "IDB"."VISIT"."VIS_DSCH_DTE" AS SRG_DSCH_DTE, DAYS("IDB"."VISIT"."VIS_DSCH_DTE") - DAYS("IDB"."VISIT"."VIS_ADM_DTE") AS SRG_LOS FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE" ON "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_LOG_ID" = "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_LOG_ID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."VISIT" ON "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_MRN" = "IDB"."VISIT"."VIS_MRN" AND "IDB"."VISIT"."VIS_VISIT_STATUS" IN ('2', '3') AND "IDB"."VISIT"."VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND" = 'I' AND "IDB"."VISIT"."VIS_ADM_DTE" <= "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_SURG_DTE" AND COALESCE("IDB"."VISIT"."VIS_DSCH_DTE", '2999-12-31') >= "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_SURG_DTE") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, PROCEDURES_COLUMNS.PROC_SURG_DATE AS PROC_SURG_DATE, PROCEDURES_COLUMNS.PROC_CODE AS PROC_CODE, PROCEDURES_COLUMNS.PROC_CODE_DESC AS PROC_CODE_DESC, PROCEDURES_COLUMNS.SSE_LOG_STS AS SSE_LOG_STS, PROCEDURES_COLUMNS.PROC_SURG_SERVICE AS PROC_SURG_SERVICE, PROCEDURES_COLUMNS.SSE_SURG_LOC AS SSE_SURG_LOC, PROCEDURES_COLUMNS.SURGEON AS SURGEON, PROCEDURES_COLUMNS.SSE_LOG_ID AS SSE_LOG_ID, PROCEDURES_COLUMNS.SRG_ADM_DTE AS SRG_ADM_DTE, PROCEDURES_COLUMNS.SRG_DSCH_DTE AS SRG_DSCH_DTE, PROCEDURES_COLUMNS.SRG_LOS AS SRG_LOS FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID LEFT OUTER JOIN PROCEDURES_COLUMNS ON PROCEDURES_COLUMNS.SUBJECT_ID = KEYS.COHORT_PROCEDURES_SUBJECT_ID;

prompt: Daily Report identifying all patients who are scheduled in OpTime with the selected hysterectomy codes for the next two weeks.
completion: SELECT MRN, PATIENT_NAME, AGE, SURG_DATE, PROCEDURE, SURGEON, MAX(CASE WHEN CL_FC = 'M' OR INS_PLAN_CD LIKE 'M%' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS MEDICAID_NY, MIN(CASE WHEN INS_PLAN_PRIO = '1' THEN RTRIM(INS_PLAN_CD)||' - '||RTRIM(INS_PLAN_DESC) END) AS INS1, MIN(CASE WHEN INS_PLAN_PRIO = '2' THEN RTRIM(INS_PLAN_CD)||' - '||RTRIM(INS_PLAN_DESC) END) AS INS2, MIN(CASE WHEN INS_PLAN_PRIO = '3' THEN RTRIM(INS_PLAN_CD)||' - '||RTRIM(INS_PLAN_DESC) END) AS INS3, MIN(CASE WHEN INS_PLAN_PRIO = '4' THEN RTRIM(INS_PLAN_CD)||' - '||RTRIM(INS_PLAN_DESC) END) AS INS4, CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY AS DAYEND FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OC_CASE_ID, OC_MRN AS MRN, RTRIM(CL_LAST_NAME)||', '||RTRIM(CL_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, YEAR(CURRENT DATE - CL_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, CL_FC, OC_SURG_DTE AS SURG_DATE, RTRIM(CPX_PROC_CD)||' - '||RTRIM(CPX_PROC_NAME) AS PROCEDURE, RTRIM(CRE_RES_NAME) AS SURGEON FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON OC_MRN = CL_MRN JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON OCAS_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID WHERE OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND (CPX_PROC_CD BETWEEN '58150' AND '58294' OR CPX_PROC_CD = '58550' OR CPX_PROC_CD BETWEEN '58552' AND '58554' OR CPX_PROC_CD = '58578' OR CPX_PROC_CD = '58951' OR CPX_PROC_CD BETWEEN '58953' AND '58956' OR CPX_PROC_NAME LIKE '%HYSTERECTOMY%') AND OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 13 DAY AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' AND OCAS_PNL_NO = 1) AS A LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.INSURANCE ON MRN = INS_MRN GROUP BY MRN, PATIENT_NAME, AGE, SURG_DATE, PROCEDURE, SURGEON

prompt: Provide a list of the patient referral source and appointment visit type
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", D1.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Referring Department", D1.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Referring Service", R.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", R1.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Referring Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = R.CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R1 ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = R1.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT D ON CPE_DEPT_ID = D.CLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT D1 ON CPE_REF_DEP_ID = D1.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'DEN' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-12-31'

prompt: Provide immunofixation and protein electrophoresis lab values for the specified list of patients
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN AS MRN, LR_ORD_ID AS ORD_ID, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME AS TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, LTL_LINE_NO AS LINE_NO, LTL_TEXT_RESULT AS TEXT_RESULT FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE 1=1 AND(UPPER(LR_TEST_NAME) LIKE '%PROTEIN%ELECTROPHORESIS%' OR UPPER(LR_TEST_NAME) LIKE '%IMMUNOFIXATION%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%PROTEIN%ELECTROPHORESIS%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%IMMUNOFIXATION%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%IMMUNOELECTROPHERESIS%') AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '1998-12-01' AND '2016-08-31' AND LR_MRN IN () ) SELECT MRN, ORD_ID, PERFORMED_DTE, TEST_NAME, SUBTEST_NAME, RESULT_VALUE, UNIT_MEASURE, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(TEXT_RESULT), '') , '') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY LINE_NO) AS LABS FROM X GROUP BY MRN, ORD_ID, PERFORMED_DTE, TEST_NAME, SUBTEST_NAME, RESULT_VALUE, UNIT_MEASURE

prompt: Employees tested covid positive in the last 30 days who have not received a booster
completion: WITH COVID AS (SELECT EMPLOYEE_ID, RESULT, DATE(LATEST_MIN_INF_ID_DT) LATEST_MIN_INF_ID_DTE FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_INFO WHERE RESULT IN ('Positive', 'Resolved') AND DATE(LATEST_MIN_INF_ID_DT) >= CURRENT DATE - 30 DAYS ) SELECT EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID, CVP_FIRST_NAME, CVP_LAST_NAME, FIRST_BOOSTER_ELIGIBLE_DTE, RESULT, LATEST_MIN_INF_ID_DTE FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO JOIN IDB.COVID19_VACCINE_PERSON ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = CVP_EMPLOYEE_ID AND CVP_STATUS <> 'Terminated' JOIN COVID ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = EMPLOYEE_ID WHERE FIRST_BOOSTER_COMPLIANT <> 'Y' AND FIRST_BOOSTER_ELIGIBLE_DTE <= CURRENT DATE

prompt: Provide a list of patients who underwent degenerative surgery performed by Neurosurgery (Drs. Barzilai, Bilsky, Laufer) and the length of their hospital stay.
completion: SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_DAYS_STAY FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT ON VIS_MRN = SSE_MRN AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_ADM_DTE <= SSE_SURG_DTE AND COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DTE, '2999-12-31') >= SSE_SURG_DTE WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('22845', '22551', '63001', '63003', '63005', '63030', '63020', '62380', '64772', '22630', '20205', '64795', '37609') AND SSP_SURG_LAST_NM IN ('BARZILAI', 'BILSKY', 'LAUFER') AND SSE_SURG_DTE > '2017-01-01';

prompt: Provide a list of patients operated on by Marc Cohen and Viviane Tabar (co-surgeons on same procedure) from 2013 to present.
completion: WITH ETO AS (SELECT DISTINCT LOG_NUMBER , PATIENT_MRN, PATIENT_NAME, PATIENT_AGE, PATIENT_SEX, LOG_SURGERY_DTE, LOG_OPERATING_ROOM, TOES_IN_TIME_ACTUAL ROOM_IN, TOES_OUT_TIME_ACTUAL ROOM_OUT, SURGERY_DURATION, FIRST_PROCED_START_TIME_ACTUAL, LAST_PROCEDURE_END_TIME_ACTUAL, LOG_LOCATION, LOG_PRIMARY_SERVICE, T1.OL_SURG_DTE , T1.OL_LOG_SVC, A.OLAS_SURG_SVC, T4.CRE_RES_NAME SURGEON1, T5.CRE_RES_NAME SURGEON2, CPX_PROC_CD CPT_CD, CPX_PROC_NAME CPT_PROC_NAME FROM IDB.OR_LOG T1 JOIN IDB.PERIOP_CASE_EVENT_V ON LOG_NUMBER = T1.OL_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_PROC ON T1.OL_LOG_ID = OLAP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG A ON T1.OL_LOG_ID = A.OLAS_LOG_ID AND OLAP_PNL_NO = A.OLAS_PNL_NO JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OCP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON CPX_PROC_ID = OCP_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE T4 ON A.OLAS_RES_ID = T4.CRE_RES_ID AND T4.CRE_RES_ID IN ('009910') JOIN IDB.OR_LOG T2 ON T1.OL_LOG_ID = T2.OL_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG B ON T1.OL_LOG_ID = B.OLAS_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE T5 ON B.OLAS_RES_ID = T5.CRE_RES_ID AND T5.CRE_RES_ID IN ('017996') WHERE T1.OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN DATE('2013-01-01') AND CURRENT DATE AND NOT (T1.OL_LOG_STS_CD IN ('4 ', '6 ')) ) , IP AS (SELECT DISTINCT VIS_VISIT_ID, VIS_MRN , VIS_ADM_DTE ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE DSCH_DTE, VIS_DAYS_STAY DAYS_STAY FROM ETO JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON PATIENT_MRN = VIS_MRN WHERE LOG_SURGERY_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND VIS_DSCH_DTE AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') ) , ADV AS (SELECT DISTINCT LOG_NUMBER , PATIENT_MRN, PATIENT_NAME, LOG_SURGERY_DTE, SAE_ADV_EVENT_NO ADV_EVENT_NO , SAE_TOX_OCCR_DT TOX_OCCR_DT , SAE_PROC_SEQ_NO, SAE_TOX_GRADE_ID, SAE_TOXICITY_ID TOXICITY_ID , SAE_TOXICITY_NAME TOXICITY_NAME, SAE_TOX_CLASS TOX_CLASS, SAE_TOX_CAT_NAME TOX_CAT_NAME, SAE_TOX_GRADE TOX_GRADE, SAE_TOX_GRADE_NAME TOX_GRADE_NAME FROM ETO JOIN IDB.A_SRG_ADVERSE_EVNT ON SAE_SURG_LOG_ID = LOG_NUMBER) SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, OP_DISPLAY_NAME AUTH_MD , MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Intradural Placement of:' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 255) ELSE '' END) AS INTRADURAL_PLC, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Image Guidance:' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 255) ELSE '' END) AS IMAGE_GUIDANCE, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Resection:' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 255) ELSE '' END) AS RESECTION, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Intraoperative CSF Leak:' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 255) ELSE '' END) AS INTRAOP_CSF_LEAK, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Leak Flow:' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 255) ELSE '' END) AS LEAK_FLOW, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Resection Comments:' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 255) ELSE '' END) AS RESECTION_COMMENT, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Intradural Placement of:' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 255) ELSE '' END) AS INTRADURAL_PLC, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Extradural Placement of:' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 255) ELSE '' END) AS EXTRADURAL_PLC, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Placement of Lumbar Drain:' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 255) ELSE '' END) AS PLC_LUMBAR_DRAIN, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Placement of Merocel Packs:' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 255) ELSE '' END) AS PLC_MEROCEL_PK, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Placement of Splints:' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 255) ELSE '' END) AS PLC_SPLINT, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Closure Presence' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 255) ELSE '' END) AS CLOSURE_PRESENCE, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Operative Time (mins.):' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 255) ELSE '' END) AS OR_TIME_MIN FROM ETO JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON PATIENT_MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND OP_DISPLAY_NAME IN ('Cohen, Marc A', 'Tabar, Viviane') GROUP BY CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, OP_DISPLAY_NAME

prompt: Update criteria to PED25869 to only include patients who have completed 5 or more MD appointments in Pediatrics
completion: WITH TABLE1 AS (SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_SEX GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE_OF_DEATH, MIN(YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH)) AS "AGE_INITIAL_ENCOUNTER", PT_ADDR1, PT_ADDR2, PT_CITY, PT_STATE, PT_ZIP_CD, PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS, PT_PHONE, CPP_MOBILE_PHONE, CPP_LANG AS "LANGUAGE", PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPP_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CPE_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = ('PED') OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = ('PED') OR CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'ORTHOPEDICS 1275-9') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH BETWEEN LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 2 MONTH) + 1 DAY AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH) GROUP BY CPE_MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH), PT_ADDR1, PT_ADDR2, PT_CITY, PT_STATE, PT_ZIP_CD, PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS, PT_PHONE, CPP_MOBILE_PHONE, CPP_LANG, PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND ORDER BY CPE_MRN), APPT_5PLUS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = ('PED') OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = ('PED') OR CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'ORTHOPEDICS 1275-9') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' ORDER BY CPE_MRN), PRIM_DOC AS (SELECT CPE_MRN PRIM_MRN, SERVICE PRIM_SERVICE, CRE_RES_NAME PRIM_DR FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN, SERVICE, CRE_RES_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CNT DESC) RN FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN, CAV_TITLE SERVICE, CRE_RES_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) CNT FROM TABLE1 JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY ON CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = CAV_ABBR AND CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_8' WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CAV_TITLE, CRE_RES_NAME ) A) B WHERE RN = 1 ), SW AS (SELECT OCV_MRN, OP_DISPLAY_NAME SOCIAL_WORKER FROM (SELECT OCV_MRN, OCV_VISIT_DTE, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, OP_DISCIPLINE, OP_PROV_TYPE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OCV_MRN ORDER BY OCV_VISIT_DTE DESC) RN FROM IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT JOIN IDB.OMS_CARE_PROV_VISIT_ROLE CP ON OCPVR_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = OCPVR_PVDR_GUID WHERE OP_PROV_TYPE = 'Social Worker' ) WHERE RN = 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT TABLE1.MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, AGE_OF_DEATH, AGE_INITIAL_ENCOUNTER, PT_ADDR1, PT_ADDR2, PT_CITY, PT_STATE, PT_ZIP_CD, PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS, PT_PHONE, CPP_MOBILE_PHONE MOBILE_PHONE, LANGUAGE, PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND DO_NOT_MAIL_IND, PRIM_SERVICE, SOCIAL_WORKER FROM TABLE1 JOIN APPT_5PLUS ON TABLE1.MRN = APPT_5PLUS."MRN" LEFT JOIN PRIM_DOC ON TABLE1.MRN = PRIM_MRN LEFT JOIN SW ON TABLE1.MRN = OCV_MRN WHERE RN >= 5

prompt: Provide a list of upcoming appointments for patients who have had CAR T Cell injection orders in CIS.
completion: WITH CART1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(OO_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", OO_ENTER_DTE AS "Order Date", OO_REQUESTED_DTE AS "Requested Date", STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME) AS "Order Name", STRIP(OO_SET_NAME) AS "Set Name", STRIP(OO_ORD_ID) AS "Order ID", OO_ORD_GUID, OUD_USER_DI_CD, STRIP(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Indication" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD like '%Rx%CART%Ind%' WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3', 'DISC') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND OO_SET_NAME IN ('Axicabtagene_Ciloleucel_INJ_Orderset', 'Brexucabtagene_Autoleucel_INJ_Orderset', 'Tisagenlecleucel_INJ_Orderset') AND OO_ORD_NAME IN ('Axicabtagene Ciloleucel INJ', 'Brexucabtagene Autoleucel INJ', 'Tisagenlecleucel INJ') ) , CPE1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(CPE_MRN) AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS "Appt Time", STRIP(R1.CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Provider Name", STRIP(R1.CRE_RES_TYP) AS "Provider Type", STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Visit Type", STRIP(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS "Dept Name", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 FROM CART1 JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R1 ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = R1.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') ) , CPE2 AS (SELECT CPE1.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN ORDER BY "Appt Date", "Appt Time") AS RN FROM CPE1) SELECT DISTINCT CART1.*, "Appt Date", "Appt Time", "Provider Name", "Provider Type", "Visit Type", "Dept Name", RN FROM CART1 LEFT JOIN CPE2 ON CART1.MRN = CPE2.MRN

prompt: Create a Tableau dashboard on median wait times in a Pain clinic.
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS VISIT_DATE, CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 1 THEN 'Sun' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 2 THEN 'Mon' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 3 THEN 'Tue' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 4 THEN 'Wed' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 5 THEN 'Thu' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 6 THEN 'Fri' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 7 THEN 'Sat' ELSE '' END AS "DoW", CPE_CHK_IN_DT, CPE_RM_IN_DT, CPE_RM_OUT_DT, TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(CPE_RM_IN_DT - CPE_CHK_IN_DT)) AS CLINIC_WAIT_TIME, TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(CPE_RM_OUT_DT - CPE_RM_IN_DT)) AS IN_ROOM_TIME, CLD_DEPT_ID AS DEPT_ID, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, CLD_DEPT_ABBR AS DEPT_ABBR, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS GRP6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS GRP8, CRE_RES_NAME AS ATTENDING, CRE_RES_TYP AS RES_TYPE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VISIT_TYPE, CASE WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%IR%' THEN 'NV/IR' ELSE 'Follow-Up' END AS VISIT_TYPE_ABBREV, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS AS VISIT_STATUS, CPE_WALK_IN_IND AS WALK_IN_IND FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Nurse Practitioner') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND(CLD_DEPT_ID IN (7, 515, 870) OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'ANS' OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('PAL', 'SUP', 'PAIN')) AND CPE_RM_IN_DT IS NOT NULL AND CPE_CHK_IN_DT IS NOT NULL

prompt: Identify patients living in the attached zip code areas who had Colonoscopy and Endoscopy procedures performed at MSKCC.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT ZIPCD, COUNTY, PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE, DOC_NAME, DOC_SVC , PBC_CPT_CD CPT_CD, PBC_PBD_DESC CPT_PBD_DESC FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN RNW4846ZIP ON PT_ZIP_CD = ZIPCD JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL_CHARGES ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO AND PBD_MRN = PBI_MRN AND PBD_ACCT_NO = PBI_ACCT_NO AND PBI_INV_STS = ' ' JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.CASE ON PBD_MRN = CS_MRN AND CS_ACCT_NO LIKE '84%' AND CS_PT_STS <> 'IP' WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE >= '2009-01-01' AND(PBC_CPT_CD BETWEEN '43200' AND '43272' OR PBC_CPT_CD BETWEEN '44360' AND '44394' OR PBC_CPT_CD BETWEEN '45355' AND '45391' OR PBC_PBD_DESC LIKE '%COLON%PY%') AND CS_ACCT_NO IS NULL

prompt: Provide the number of Pleurx catheters placed in 2008 and 2011 by Year.
completion: SELECT STRIP(CPT_CD)||'-'||PBC_PBD_DESC AS CPT_DESC, RPT_YEAR , COUNT(*) CNT FROM (SELECT PBD_MRN, PBD_ACCT_NO, PBD_SVC_DTE, PBC_CPT_CD AS CPT_CD , DOC_NAME, SUBSTR(CHAR(PBD_SVC_DTE), 1, 4) RPT_YEAR , PBD_LINE_NO , PBD_LINE_NO FROM IDB.PBD_DTL_CHARGES JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBI_MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBI_ACCT_NO = PBD_ACCT_NO AND PBI_INV_NO = PBD_INV_NO - AND PBI_INV_STS = ' ' JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.DOC ON DOC_DR_NO = PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS M1 ON M1.AV_ELEMENT = 'MODIFIER1' AND M1.AV_CODE = PBD_MODIFIER1 WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE >= '2008-01-01' AND PBC_CPT_CD = '32550' AND PBC_PBD_DESC LIKE 'IMAG%' AND PBD_MODIFIER1 <> '53' ) X JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBC_CPT_CD = CPT_CD AND PBC_INACTV_DTE IS NULL AND PBC_PBD_DESC LIKE 'IMAG%' GROUP BY CPT_CD, PBC_PBD_DESC, RPT_YEAR

prompt:
