completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') ) , DT_3_1 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-score' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-type' , TMB_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score' , TMB_COUNT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb-count', COSMIC_ID VARCHAR(5000) PATH 'cosmic_id') T WHERE 1=1 AND LOWER(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) like '%' || LOWER('sarcoma') || '%' AND (INC.GENE IN ('MTAP', 'CDKN2A') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('MTAP', 'CDKN2A')) AND INC.FOLD_CHANGE <= -2 ) , DT_3_2 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-score' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-type' , TMB_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score' , TMB_COUNT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb-count', COSMIC_ID VARCHAR(5000) PATH 'cosmic_id') T WHERE 1=1 AND LOWER(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) like '%' || LOWER('mesothelioma') || '%' AND (INC.GENE IN ('MTAP') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('MTAP')) AND INC.FOLD_CHANGE <= -2 ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT P_ID FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 INTERSECT (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3_1 UNION ALL SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3_2 ))) SELECT * FROM DEID

prompt: Request to further stratify results of DataLine Request MED19432, specifically to determine which patients are ages 65-74, and diagnosis data.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_DAYS_STAY, CASE WHEN CDD_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Seen by GIM Pre-Op", CASE WHEN VIS_ADM_DTE = SSE_SURG_DTE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "adm_surg_same_day", ADM_TYPE_DESC, ADM_SOURCE_DESC, TREATMENT_PLAN_DESC FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON VIS_MRN = SSE_MRN AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_ADM_DTE <= SSE_SURG_DTE AND COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DTE, '2999-12-31') >= SSE_SURG_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = SSE_MRN AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Initial Consult PreOp, IP - General Internal Medicine', 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, IP - DOM-General Internal Med', 'Follow Up Consultation - DOM-General Internal Medicine', 'Follow Up - DOM-General Internal Medicine', 'Initial Consult PreOp, Amb - General Internal Medicine', 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, AMB - DOM-General Internal Me') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN SSE_SURG_DTE - 28 DAYS AND SSE_SURG_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'NEURO' AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2018-12-20' AND '2019-12-20' AND (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND VIS_DSCH_DTE >= SSE_SURG_DTE + 1 DAY AND YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 65 AND 74 ) , PRIMARY AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN PTS ON SSE_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND (SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C70', 'C71', 'C72') OR CC_CLSF_CD IN ('D43.2', 'D35.2', 'D33.4', 'D32.0', 'D43.4', 'C41.2')) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , METS AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN PTS ON SSE_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C79.3', 'C79.31', 'C79.32', 'C79.4', 'C79.40', 'C79.49', 'C79.51') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN "MRN", SSE_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", SSP_SURG_LAST_NM "Surgeon Last Name", SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM "Surgeon First Name", AGE "Age", VIS_ADM_DTE "Admit Date", VIS_DSCH_DTE "Discharge Date", VIS_DAYS_STAY "Days Stayed", "adm_surg_same_day" AS "Admit Surg on same date", ADM_TYPE_DESC "Admit Type", ADM_SOURCE_DESC "Admit Description", TREATMENT_PLAN_DESC "Treatment Plan", P.ICD_CD "Primary Dx ICD", M.ICD_CD "Metastatic Dx ICD" FROM PTS LEFT JOIN PRIMARY P ON SSE_MRN = P.CC_MRN LEFT JOIN METS M ON SSE_MRN = M.CC_MRN WHERE P.CC_MRN IS NOT NULL OR M.CC_MRN IS NOT NULL ;

prompt: Provide list of all patients referred for a lung cancer screening from 1/1/2019.
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Visit/Order Date", CPE_CPE_APPT_STS "Status", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Visit Type/Order Name" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT A ON CPE_DEPT_ID = A.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2019-01-01' AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN('THR APP LUNG SCREENING FR', 'THR APP LUNG SCREENING NV', 'THR LUNG SCREENING FR', 'THR LUNG SCREENING NV') OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN('CT CHEST LDCT REGISTRY', 'CT CHEST SCREENING ANNUAL F/U', 'CT CHEST SCREENING LOW DOSE', 'CT CHEST SCREENING W/O CON', 'CT CHEST SCREENING W/O CON F/U', 'CT RESEARCH', 'CT RESEARCH EXAM')) AND CPE_MRN <> '' ) , ORD AS (SELECT OO_MRN MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE "Visit/Order Date", OSTS_STS_DESC "Status", STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME)||'-'||STRIP(OO_ORD_MODIFIER) "Visit Type/Order Name" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= '2019-01-01' AND OO_ORD_NAME = 'CT' AND OO_ORD_MODIFIER LIKE '%Low Dose%' AND OO_MRN <> '' ) , PTS AS (SELECT * FROM APPTS UNION SELECT * FROM ORD) , SMOKING AS (SELECT CDD_MRN AS SMOKING_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE , CAST(CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS VARCHAR(95)) AS NOTE_TEXT , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DT DESC) RN FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN PTS ON MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000003515102890', '9000095149102890') ) SELECT "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, "Visit/Order Date", "Status", "Visit Type/Order Name", CDD_SERVICE_DTE "Smoking Status Date", NOTE_TEXT "Smoking Status" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON "MRN" = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN SMOKING ON "MRN" = SMOKING_MRN AND RN = 1 ORDER BY 1, 4

prompt: Provide a weekly report of patients on Special Contact-Candida Auris Precautions with scheduled appointments.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(OHI_MRN) AS MRN , STRIP(CL_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(CL_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name" , CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date" , STRIP(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS "Department Name" , STRIP(CRE_RES_TYP) AS "Resource Type" , STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Provider" , STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Visit Type" , STRIP(CLD_CLD_CENTER) AS "Site" FROM IDB.OMS_HEALTH_ISSUE JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON OHI_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CL_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND OHI_STS_CD = 'Active' AND OHI_HI_DESCRIPTION = 'Special Contact-Candida Auris'

prompt: Would like to look at Large Cell Neuroendocrine Lung cases treated with IMPACT analysis to add additional cases to an existing project.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M8013/3' AND S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%LUNG%' AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2016-01-01' AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT PT_MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V)) SELECT MRN, P.PT_LAST_NAME, P.PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, R.AV_DESC RACE, PT_DEATH_IND, PLA_LST_CON_DTE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON PT_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON AV_ELEMENT='RACE' AND P.PT_RACE=AV_CODE JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN=PT_MRN ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M8013/3' AND S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%LUNG%' AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2016-01-01' AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT PT_MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V)) SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M8013/3' AND S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%LUNG%' AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2016-01-01' AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT PT_MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V)) SELECT PT_MRN, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE, PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID, PATH_RPT_DATE, PATH_RPT_YR, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, PATH_PROCEDURE_YR, GEN_PROC_RPT_DATE_ID, GEN_PROC_RPT_DATE, GEN_PROC_RPT_YR, PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_REPORT, PRPT_ORDERING_MEDPRO_ID, PRPT_CREATED_DT, PRPT_MODIFIED_DT, TEST_ID, GENE, RESULT, LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, NUCLEOTIDE, SEARCH_HIT1, SEARCH_HIT2, METHOD, ABERRATIONTYPE, FOLD_CHANGE, GENE2, PDMR_CREATED_DT, PDMR_MODIFIED_DT FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V GENE ON MRN=PT_MRN ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M8013/3' AND S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%LUNG%' AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2016-01-01' AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT PT_MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V)) SELECT MRN, PRO_IRB_NO, PRO_IRB_TITLE, PRO_IRB_STS, PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE, ACD_CONS_DTE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.PROTOCOL ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO WHERE PRO_IRB_NO IN ('12-245', '06-107', '14-192') ;

prompt: List of Unrelated Donor Search - Formal
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT OOC_ITEM_NAME, OFF_FLD_LABEL FLD_LABEL, OFF_DI_CD DI_CD, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY OFF_FLD_SEQ, OFF_DI_GUID) RN FROM IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG INNER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_ENTRY_FORM ON OOC_FORM_GUID = OEF_FORM_GUID INNER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_FORM_FIELD ON OEF_ENTRY_FRM_GUID = OFF_ENTRY_FRM_GUID WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME= 'Unrelated Donor Search- Formal' AND OEF_CURRENT_IND='Y' ) , ORD AS (SELECT YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) ORD_YEAR, MONTH(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) ORD_MONTH, OO_MRN MRN, OO_VISIT_GUID, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_REQUESTED_DTE REQUESTED_DTE, OO_ENTER_DTE ORD_ENTER_DTE , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT PERFORMED_DTE, OO_ORD_STS_CD ORD_STATUS, OO_ORD_ID ORDID, OO_ORD_NAME ORDNAME, ENT.OU_DISPLAY_NAME ENTERED_BY, PVDR.OU_DISPLAY_NAME PVDR_NAME, RN AS ORD_RN, FLD_LABEL ORD_LABEL, SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 255) DI_VALUE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID JOIN CTE ON DI_CD = OUD_USER_DI_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ENT ON OO_USER_GUID = ENT.OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER PVDR ON OO_PVDR_GUID = PVDR.OU_USER_GUID WHERE OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 2 MONTH) + 1 DAY AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH) AND OO_ORD_NAME = 'Unrelated Donor Search- Formal' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CAN', 'DISC') ) SELECT ORD_YEAR, ORD_MONTH, MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME PT_NAME, REQUESTED_DTE, ORD_ENTER_DTE, PERFORMED_DTE, ORD_STATUS, ORDID, ORDNAME, ENTERED_BY, PVDR_NAME, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN TRIM(DI_VALUE) END)"Diagnosis:", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 2 THEN TRIM(DI_VALUE) END)"Height/Weight:", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 3 THEN TRIM(DI_VALUE) END)"Weight (kg)" , MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 5 THEN TRIM(DI_VALUE) END)"Relevant Results:", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 6 THEN TRIM(DI_VALUE) END)"Transplant Urgency:", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 7 THEN TRIM(DI_VALUE) END)"Ancestry (Broad Race Category):", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 8 THEN TRIM(DI_VALUE) END)"Consented IRB_16-024 (BMT/Leukemia Reg):", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 9 THEN TRIM(DI_VALUE) END)"'Aware of Formal Search Request:", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 10 THEN TRIM(DI_VALUE) END)"History of Previous Transplant", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 11 THEN TRIM(DI_VALUE) END)"Candidate for Cord Transplant:", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 12 THEN TRIM(DI_VALUE) END)"Candidate for 7/8 URD", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 13 THEN TRIM(DI_VALUE) END) "Candidate for Auto:", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 14 THEN TRIM(DI_VALUE) END) "Candidate for Haplo:", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 15 THEN TRIM(DI_VALUE) END)"Priority HSC Source if No 8/8 URD:", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 16 THEN TRIM(DI_VALUE) END)"Likely transplant protocol(s):", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 17 THEN TRIM(DI_VALUE) END)"Significant Comorbidities:", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 18 THEN TRIM(DI_VALUE) END)"Requested For:", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 19 THEN TRIM(DI_VALUE) END)"Time/Priority:" FROM CTE LEFT JOIN ORD ON FLD_LABEL = ORD_LABEL AND RN = ORD_RN LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN GROUP BY ORD_YEAR, ORD_MONTH, MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME , REQUESTED_DTE, ORD_ENTER_DTE, PERFORMED_DTE, ORD_STATUS, ORDID, ORDNAME, ENTERED_BY, PVDR_NAME HAVING MRN IS NOT NULL

prompt: Requesting to know the number of patients that are diagnosed with leptomeningeal metastasis annually at MSK
completion: WITH CDB AS (SELECT COUNT(TM_MRN) AS CDB_COUNT, TM_DX_YEAR FROM (SELECT TM_MRN, YEAR(TM_DX_DTE) AS TM_DX_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY TM_MRN ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE) RN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND (TM_ICD10_CD LIKE 'C79.31%' OR TM_ICD10_CD LIKE 'C79.32%' OR TM_ICD10_CD LIKE 'C79.49%') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND CURRENT date ) WHERE RN =1 GROUP BY TM_DX_YEAR) , CLINTRAC AS (SELECT COUNT(CC_MRN) AS CLIN_COUNT, DX_YEAR FROM (SELECT CC_MRN, YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) DX_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CC_MRN ORDER BY CC_EFF_DTE) RN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1=1 AND (CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C79.31%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C79.32%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C79.49%') AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) WHERE RN =1 GROUP BY DX_YEAR ) SELECT DX_YEAR, COALESCE (CDB_COUNT, 0), COALESCE (CLIN_COUNT, 0), CDB_COUNT + CLIN_COUNT AS NO_OF_PATIENTS FROM CLINTRAC LEFT JOIN CDB ON TM_DX_YEAR = DX_YEAR

prompt: Provide a list of patients who had breast cancer in an accessory nipple.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, MAX(COALESCE(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), COALESCE(PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE)) "Last Follow Up Date" FROM (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT, CDD_AUTH_PROV_NAME FROM DV.CLINDOC_FULL_TEXT_V WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2020-07-17' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Follow Up - Breast Surgery' AND CONTAINS(CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT, '("supernumerary nipple" | "accessory nipple" | "third nipple")') = 1 ) A LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CDD_MRN = PLA_MRN ;

prompt: Provide a list of new internal or external Surgery, Urology and Radiation Oncology visits of Bladder Cancer patients between 2018 and 2021
completion: WITH VISITS AS (SELECT CASE WHEN PBC_PBD_DESC like 'UROL%' THEN 'Urology' WHEN B.AV_DESC like '%UROLOGY%' THEN 'Urology' WHEN B.AV_DESC like '%RAD ONC%' THEN 'Radiation Oncology' WHEN B.AV_DESC like '%RADIATION ONCOLOGY%' THEN 'Radiation Oncology' ELSE 'Surgery' END AS "Billing Area", PBC_PBD_DESC AS "Charge Description", PBD_SVC_DTE AS "Visit Date", COALESCE(RLD_NAME, PBI_SVC_LOC) AS CAMPUS, DOC_NAME AS "Visit Provider", CLM_CLSF_CD AS "ICD-10 Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "ICD-10 Description" FROM IDB.PBD_INVOICE JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBC_PBD_CD = PBD_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.DOC ON DOC_DR_NO = PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PBD_DX ON PBD_INV_NO = DX_INV_NO AND DX_CLSF_CD like 'C67.%' JOIN IDB.CLM ON DX_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS B ON B.AV_CODE = PBI_BILLING_AREA AND B.AV_ELEMENT = 'BILLING_AREA' LEFT JOIN IDB.RMS_LOCATIONS_DICT_DN100 ON RLD_MNEMONIC = PBI_SVC_LOC WHERE PBI_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' AND LOWER(PBC_PBD_DESC) like '%visit%new%' AND PBI_BILLING_AREA IN ('505206', '505099', '505305', '505552', '504357', '505081', '505073', '505533', '507002', '575852', '575002', '581001', '574351', '574002', '576002', '510790', '505859', '505810', '505818', '505586', '505735', '505842', '500002', '505750', '503037', '574850', '576852', '510768', '581851', '505628', '510727', '510675', '575693', '581036', '576483', '574173') ) SELECT * FROM VISITS WHERE "Billing Area" = 'Urology'; WITH VISITS AS (SELECT CASE WHEN PBC_PBD_DESC like 'UROL%' THEN 'Urology' WHEN B.AV_DESC like '%UROLOGY%' THEN 'Urology' WHEN B.AV_DESC like '%RAD ONC%' THEN 'Radiation Oncology' WHEN B.AV_DESC like '%RADIATION ONCOLOGY%' THEN 'Radiation Oncology' ELSE 'Surgery' END AS "Billing Area", PBC_PBD_DESC AS "Charge Description", PBD_SVC_DTE AS "Visit Date", COALESCE(RLD_NAME, PBI_SVC_LOC) AS CAMPUS, DOC_NAME AS "Visit Provider", CLM_CLSF_CD AS "ICD-10 Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "ICD-10 Description" FROM IDB.PBD_INVOICE JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBC_PBD_CD = PBD_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.DOC ON DOC_DR_NO = PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PBD_DX ON PBD_INV_NO = DX_INV_NO AND DX_CLSF_CD like 'C67.%' JOIN IDB.CLM ON DX_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS B ON B.AV_CODE = PBI_BILLING_AREA AND B.AV_ELEMENT = 'BILLING_AREA' LEFT JOIN IDB.RMS_LOCATIONS_DICT_DN100 ON RLD_MNEMONIC = PBI_SVC_LOC WHERE PBI_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' AND LOWER(PBC_PBD_DESC) like '%visit%new%' AND PBI_BILLING_AREA IN ('505206', '505099', '505305', '505552', '504357', '505081', '505073', '505533', '507002', '575852', '575002', '581001', '574351', '574002', '576002', '510790', '505859', '505810', '505818', '505586', '505735', '505842', '500002', '505750', '503037', '574850', '576852', '510768', '581851', '505628', '510727', '510675', '575693', '581036', '576483', '574173') ) SELECT * FROM VISITS WHERE "Billing Area" = 'Radiation Oncology'; WITH VISITS AS (SELECT CASE WHEN PBC_PBD_DESC like 'UROL%' THEN 'Urology' WHEN B.AV_DESC like '%UROLOGY%' THEN 'Urology' WHEN B.AV_DESC like '%RAD ONC%' THEN 'Radiation Oncology' WHEN B.AV_DESC like '%RADIATION ONCOLOGY%' THEN 'Radiation Oncology' ELSE 'Surgery' END AS "Billing Area", PBC_PBD_DESC AS "Charge Description", PBD_SVC_DTE AS "Visit Date", COALESCE(RLD_NAME, PBI_SVC_LOC) AS CAMPUS, DOC_NAME AS "Visit Provider", CLM_CLSF_CD AS "ICD-10 Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "ICD-10 Description" FROM IDB.PBD_INVOICE JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBC_PBD_CD = PBD_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.DOC ON DOC_DR_NO = PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PBD_DX ON PBD_INV_NO = DX_INV_NO AND DX_CLSF_CD like 'C67.%' JOIN IDB.CLM ON DX_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS B ON B.AV_CODE = PBI_BILLING_AREA AND B.AV_ELEMENT = 'BILLING_AREA' LEFT JOIN IDB.RMS_LOCATIONS_DICT_DN100 ON RLD_MNEMONIC = PBI_SVC_LOC WHERE PBI_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' AND LOWER(PBC_PBD_DESC) like '%visit%new%' AND PBI_BILLING_AREA IN ('505206', '505099', '505305', '505552', '504357', '505081', '505073', '505533', '507002', '575852', '575002', '581001', '574351', '574002', '576002', '510790', '505859', '505810', '505818', '505586', '505735', '505842', '500002', '505750', '503037', '574850', '576852', '510768', '581851', '505628', '510727', '510675', '575693', '581036', '576483', '574173') ) SELECT * FROM VISITS WHERE "Billing Area" = 'Surgery'

prompt: Provide a list of upcoming appointments for eligible patients to complete Psychosocial Assessment Tool (PAT)
completion: WITH PEDS_DEF AS (SELECT CPE_MRN PED_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = ('PED') OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = ('PED') OR CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'ORTHOPEDICS 1275-9') UNION SELECT VIS_MRN PED_MRN FROM IDB.VISIT_V WHERE VIS_HOSP_SVC IN ('PDB', 'PDG', 'PDP', 'PDU', 'PED') AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') ) , SCH AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP ='Physician' AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = ('PED') OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = ('PED') OR CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'ORTHOPEDICS 1275-9') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 7 DAYS - (DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT DATE + 7 DAYS) - 7) DAYS AND DATE(CPE_IDB_UPD_DT) >= CURRENT date ) , PTS AS (SELECT PED_MRN FROM SCH JOIN PEDS_DEF ON CPE_MRN = PED_MRN) , VISITS AS (SELECT C.CPE_MRN, CPE_CL_PT_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ, CPE_ENC_DTE, TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) "Appt Time", CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_CLD_CENTER, CRE_RES_NAME, CPE_IDB_UPD_DT, PFA_FST_APPT_DTE "First Appt Date", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY C.CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) RN FROM PTS JOIN IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTIVITY ON PED_MRN = PFA_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER C ON PED_MRN = C.CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP ='Physician' AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PED' OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = 'PED' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'ORTHOPEDICS 1275-9') ) , REF AS (SELECT PRF_MRN, PRC_COMMENT_TYP, LISTAGG(CHAR(STRIP(PRC_RFL_COMMENT)), CHR(13)||CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY PRC_LINE_NO) REFERRAL_COMMENT FROM PTS JOIN IDB.PAS_REFERRAL ON PED_MRN = PRF_MRN JOIN IDB.PAS_RFL_COMMENT ON PRF_RFL_ID = PRC_RFL_ID WHERE PRF_MRN <> '' AND PRC_RFL_COMMENT <> '' GROUP BY PRF_MRN, PRC_COMMENT_TYP ) SELECT STRIP(V.CPE_MRN) MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) "Last Name", STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Current Age", "First Appt Date", CPE_ENC_DTE "Sch Appt Date", "Appt Time" "Sch Appt Time", CHAR(CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ) "Sch Visit Number", STRIP(CPE_CPE_APPT_STS) "Appt Status", STRIP(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6) "Dept", STRIP(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8) "Service", STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) "Resource", STRIP(CLD_CLD_CENTER) "Location", REFERRAL_COMMENT "Referral Comment", LISTAGG(CHAR(STRIP(CPAN_NOTE)), CHR(13)||CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY CPAN_LINE_NO) "Appt Note", CURRENT date "Report Date" FROM VISITS V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON V.CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1 ON 1=1 LEFT JOIN REF ON V.CPE_MRN = PRF_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPAN_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ WHERE RN <= 2 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 7 DAYS - (DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT DATE + 7 DAYS) - 7) DAYS AND DATE(CPE_IDB_UPD_DT) >= CURRENT date GROUP BY STRIP(V.CPE_MRN), STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME), STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME), PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH), "First Appt Date", CPE_ENC_DTE, "Appt Time", CHAR(CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ), STRIP(CPE_CPE_APPT_STS), STRIP(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6), STRIP(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8), STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME), STRIP(CLD_CLD_CENTER), REFERRAL_COMMENT, CURRENT date

prompt: Create database view providing information on MSK doctors
completion: WITH ETO AS (SELECT OP_PVDR_GUID PVDR_GUID, OP_PVDR_NO PVDR_NO, OP_DISPLAY_NAME FULL_NAME, OU_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, OU_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, OU_EMAIL_ADDR EMAIL_ADDR, OU_OCCUPATION OCCUPATION, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE ORD_ROLE_TYPE, OP_DISCIPLINE SERVICE, OU_EFF_DT EFF_DT, OU_EXP_DT EXP_DT FROM IDB.OMS_PROVIDER JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = OU_USER_GUID WHERE OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE IN ('Research Fellow', 'Physician Assistant', 'Physician', 'PhD', 'Pediatric Fellow', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'NP Chemo', 'Genetic Counselor', 'Fellow', 'Dietitian', 'Attending', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') AND OP_PVDR_NO NOT IN ('ADMOVERRIDEACTIONBY', 'ADMOVERRIDEACTIONFOR', 'BACKLOADMD', 'ADMOVERRIDEPERFORMED', 'CDSYSTEMPROFILE', 'CISPHYSICIAN', 'CLEANUPPROFILE', 'CONSULTCARDMD', 'CONSULTCARDM18', 'CONSULTCARDPOSTOP', 'CONSULTCARDTELEMETRY', 'CONSULTCARDWEEKEND', 'CONSULTRODAYCALLMD', 'CONSULTRONP', 'MDTESTPROFILE', 'MEDGYNGRAY', 'MUCCDA', 'TMD') AND OP_PVDR_NO not like 'CPID%' AND OP_PVDR_NO not like 'xxInactive%' AND UPPER(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) not like '%UNKNOWN%' AND UPPER(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) not like '%OUTSIDE ORDERING%' AND UPPER(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) not like '%CONSULT%' ) , RES AS (SELECT DOC_DR_NO, DOC_NAME, DOC_SVC, DOC_CLINIC, DOC_ACDMC_DPT , DOC_ACDMC_SVC, DOC_SOURCE_DESC, DOC_INACTIVE_DTE, CRE_EMP_STATUS, CRE_EMAIL_ADDR, CRE_RES_STS FROM IDB.DOC LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON DOC_DR_NO = CRE_RES_ID WHERE DOC_NAME NOT LIKE '%UNKNOWN%' ) SELECT PVDR_GUID, PVDR_NO, FULL_NAME, FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, COALESCE(EMAIL_ADDR, CRE_EMAIL_ADDR) EMAIL_ADDR, OCCUPATION, ORD_ROLE_TYPE, SERVICE , DOC_NAME, DOC_SVC, DOC_CLINIC, DOC_ACDMC_DPT ACADEMIC_DPT , DOC_ACDMC_SVC ACAMEDIC_SVC, CASE WHEN EXP_DT < CURRENT TIMESTAMP THEN 'INACTIVE' ELSE '' END INACTIVE_STS, EFF_DT, EXP_DT INACTIVITY_DT FROM ETO LEFT OUTER JOIN RES ON DOC_DR_NO = PVDR_NO

prompt: To obtain the list of patients diagnosed with squamous cell carcinoma of head and neck from 1992 to 2019 with parotidectomy
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" DEID, "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t1"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender", "t1"."PT_RACE_DESC" AS "Race", "t2"."CORE_ETHNICITY_DESC" AS "Ethnicity", "t1"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS "Vital Status", "t3"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t6"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t2" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t7" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t3" ON "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t3"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t5" ON "t3"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t6" ON "t3"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t6"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE ((CONTAINS("t3"."PRPT_REPORT", '("parotidectomy")') = 1 AND CONTAINS("t3"."PRPT_REPORT", '("squamous")') = 1 AND "t3"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL)) ;

prompt: New Visits to Peds Neurology Oncology in 2018
completion: SELECT CASE WHEN PT_ZIP_CD IN ('', '99999', 'YYYYY') THEN 'Unknown' ELSE PT_ZIP_CD END "Zip Code", COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) "Distinct MRN Count" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'NOC' GROUP BY CASE WHEN PT_ZIP_CD IN ('', '99999', 'YYYYY') THEN 'Unknown' ELSE PT_ZIP_CD END

prompt: Provide a weekly list of patients with Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma (PCNSL) or Secondary Central Nervous System Lymphoma (SCNSL) with upcoming appointments to the Department of Neurology, or the Department of Medicine- (Bone Marrow Transplant services)
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_SEX AS "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, TIMESTAMPDIFF(256, CHAR(TIMESTAMP(CPE_ENC_DTE) - TIMESTAMP(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH))) AS "Age as of Appt Date", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Next Appt Date", TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS "Appt Time", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_CLD_CENTER AS "Location", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CRE_RES_TYP AS "Resource Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('019091', '018010', '016345', '023911', '022665', '016337', '021766', '020248', '023721', '020214', '027961', '022012', '018846', '022806', '015255', '018770', '015404', '018176', '022731', '017426') JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C85.89', 'C83.31', 'C83.38', 'C83.39 ', 'C83.80', 'C83.81', 'C83.88', 'C83.89', 'Z01.818') JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date + 3 DAYS AND CURRENT date + 8 DAYS ;

completion: WITH ETO AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_DOC_GUID DOCGUID, CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID DEID, CDD_DOC_NAME DOC_NAME, YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) SVC_YEAR, QUARTER(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) SVC_QTR, CDD_SERVICE_DTE SERVICE_DTE, CDD_AUTHORED_DTE AUTHORED_DTE, CDD_SIGNED_DTE SIGNED_DTE, OCV_CARE_LVL CARE_LVL, OS_SVC_GRP_CD, OS_SVC_DESC, OCV_PVDR_NAME VST_PVDR_NAME, ATT.DOC_SVC VST_PVDR_SERVICE, ENT.OU_DISPLAY_NAME ENTEREDBY, ENT.OU_OCCUPATION ENTEREDBY_ROLE, PROV.OP_DISPLAY_NAME SVC_PROVIDER, PROV.OP_PROV_TYPE, PROV.OP_DISCIPLINE SVC_PROVIDER_ROLE, SVC_PDVR.DOC_SVC SVC_PVDR_SERVICE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID= CDO_DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.DOC ATT ON OCV_ATT_DR_NO = ATT.DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ENT ON CDD_USER_GUID = ENT.OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER PROV ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = PROV.OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.DOC SVC_PDVR ON PROV.OP_PVDR_NO = SVC_PDVR.DOC_DR_NO WHERE (CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE '%Urology' OR CDD_DOC_NAME like 'Attending Summary%Surgery%' OR CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit - Surgery-Surgery') AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2018-01-01' ) SELECT * FROM ETO WHERE SVC_PVDR_SERVICE = 'URO'

completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC WHERE 1=1 AND (INC.GENE IN ('PTCH1') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('PTCH1')) AND CASE WHEN INC.METHOD = 'IMPACT' THEN 'IMPACT' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'IMPACTv%' THEN 'IMPACT' WHEN INC.METHOD = 'ArcherHeme' THEN 'ArcherHeme' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'ArcherHemeV%' THEN 'ArcherHeme' WHEN LOWER(INC.METHOD) like LOWER('ArcherPanHemeV%') THEN 'ArcherPanHeme' WHEN INC.METHOD = 'Archer' THEN 'Archer' WHEN LOWER(INC.METHOD) like 'archerv%' THEN 'Archer' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'ACCESSv%' THEN 'ACCESS' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'IMPACTHv%' THEN 'IMPACTHeme' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'RDTB%' THEN 'RDTB' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'RDTS%' THEN 'RDTS' ELSE INC.METHOD END IN ('IMPACT') ) , DT_3 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT P_ID FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3 ))

prompt: Would like to request the number of patients who have been seen at MSKCC in the last 4 years with Fibrolamellar carcincoma (FLC). This is part of the data analysis for IRB 20-543.
completion: WITH CLINICAL AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS "MRN" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE 'Follow%DOM%Gastro%Oncology%' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= CURRENT date - 4 YEARS AND (INSTR (LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 'fibrolamellar') > 0 OR INSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 'FLC') >0) ), PRPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 4 YEARS AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("Fibrolamellar" OR "FLC")') = 1), PRIM_PHYSICIAN AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "PP_MRN", CRE_RES_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) DESC) RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_ID) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_FIRST_NAME "FIRST NAME", PT_LAST_NAME "LAST NAME", CRE_RES_NAME AS "PRIMARY_PHYSICIAN" FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD = 'C220' AND TM_DX_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 4 YEARS) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD = 'C22.0' AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' AND CC_EFF_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 4 YEARS GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN PRIM_PHYSICIAN ON PT_MRN = PP_MRN JOIN CLINICAL ON PT_MRN = MRN JOIN PRPT ON PT_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL AND RN = 1

prompt: Urachal cancer patients who have had a PET scan.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN "MRN", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, TM_DX_DTE "Dx Date", RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE "Date of Scan", RRPT_ANC_CODE "Scan Type" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V ON TM_MRN = RRPT_MRN AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD = 'C677' AND RRPT_ANC_CODE like '%PET%' ; SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN "MRN", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, TM_DX_DTE "Dx Date" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD = 'C677'

prompt: Provide a list of patients with Head and Neck Cancer (C76) treated with Pembrolizumab/Keytruda/MK-3475 in 2021.
completion: WITH APR AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, APR_PROVIDER_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CDG_IMMUNOTHERAPY_FLAG = 'Y' AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'PEMBROLIZUMAB' AND APR_DRUG_NAME NOT IN ('PEMBROlizumab (MK-3475) INVEST', 'PEMBROlizumab INJ (Pt Free Supply)') AND(APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' OR APR_END_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-12-31') AND(APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC like '%HNSCC%' OR APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC like '%HEAD%NECK%') ) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS DX_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_SITE_CD AS DX_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = DV.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM APR) UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = MIN(DV.SEERF_ICD9(CLM_CLSF_CD), DV.SEERF_ICD10(CLM_CLSF_CD)) WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND(CLM_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C' AND 'C99.99') AND CLM_CLSF_CD NOT BETWEEN 'C77' AND 'C79.99' AND CC_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM APR) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , DX2 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' : ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) AS DX_CODES FROM DX GROUP BY DX_MRN) SELECT APR.*, DX_CODES FROM APR LEFT JOIN DX2 ON APR_MRN = DX_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of all KRAS mutated lung cancer patients diagnosed here since we started testing for kras.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t6".PT_MRN "MRN", "t6".PT_SEX "Gender", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", CASE WHEN LOCATE('KRAS mutation is', "t2".PRPT_REPORT) > 0 THEN SUBSTR(CAST("t2".PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(7000)), LOCATE('KRAS mutation is', "t2".PRPT_REPORT), LOCATE('.', "t2".PRPT_REPORT, LOCATE('KRAS mutation is', "t2".PRPT_REPORT)) - LOCATE('KRAS mutation is', "t2".PRPT_REPORT)) ELSE SUBSTR(CAST("t2".PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(7000)), LOCATE('Positive for KRAS', "t2".PRPT_REPORT), 200) END "Point Mutation", REPLACE(CASE WHEN LOCATE('KRAS mutation is', "t2".PRPT_REPORT) > 0 THEN SUBSTR(CAST("t2".PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(7000)), LOCATE('KRAS mutation is', "t2".PRPT_REPORT), LOCATE('.', "t2".PRPT_REPORT, LOCATE('KRAS mutation is', "t2".PRPT_REPORT)) - LOCATE('KRAS mutation is', "t2".PRPT_REPORT)) ELSE SUBSTR(CAST("t2".PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(7000)), LOCATE('Positive for KRAS', "t2".PRPT_REPORT), 200) END, 'KRAS mutation is ', '') "Point Mutation v2", "t2".PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID, "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t4"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Desc", "t4a"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t4a"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Desc", "t2s"."TCLSA_CLIN_STG_GRP_DESC" AS "Clinical Group", "t3s"."TPSA_PATH_STG_GRP_DESC" AS "Path Group", "t4s"."TCSA_TM_AJCC_DESC" AS "Collaborative Group", "t5s"."TOSA_SEER_SUM_STAGE_DESC" AS "Summary Stage", "t5s"."TOSA_MSK_STG_DESC" AS "MSK Stage", DAYS(COALESCE("t6"."PT_DEATH_DTE", P.PLA_LAST_CONTACT_DTE)) - DAYS("t5"."DT_DTE") AS "Days btw Dx and Death", (DAYS(COALESCE("t6"."PT_DEATH_DTE", P.PLA_LAST_CONTACT_DTE)) - DAYS("t5"."DT_DTE")) / 365 AS DAYS_DIV, YEAR(COALESCE("t6"."PT_DEATH_DTE", P.PLA_LAST_CONTACT_DTE) - "t5"."DT_DTE") YRS, CASE WHEN YEAR(COALESCE("t6"."PT_DEATH_DTE", P.PLA_LAST_CONTACT_DTE) - "t5"."DT_DTE") > 3 THEN 'Over 3' WHEN YEAR(COALESCE("t6"."PT_DEATH_DTE", P.PLA_LAST_CONTACT_DTE) - "t5"."DT_DTE") <= 3 THEN '3 years and Under' ELSE 'error' END AS SURVIVAL, "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "CDB Tumor Diagnosis Date", "d"."DT_DTE" AS "DM Path Report Date", "t6".PT_BIRTH_DTE "Date of Birth", "t6"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", P.PLA_LAST_CONTACT_DTE AS "Last Contact Date", "t6"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS "Vital Status" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY P ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = P."PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" INNER JOIN "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "d"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t7" ON prompt: Provide a one time list of patients diagnosed with Cutaneous T-cell Lymphoma or Adult T-cell Leukemia/Lymphoma and have been treated with Mogamulizumab
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9700/3', 'M9701/3', 'M9709/3', 'M9827/3') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('202.10', '202.11', '202.12', '202.13', '202.14', '202.15', '202.16', '202.17', '202.18', '202.20', '202.21', '202.22', '202.23', '202.24', '202.25', '202.26', '202.27', '202.28', 'C84.00', 'C84.01', 'C84.02', 'C84.03', 'C84.04', 'C84.05', 'C84.06', 'C84.07', 'C84.08', 'C84.09', 'C84.10', 'C84.11', 'C84.12', 'C84.13', 'C84.14', 'C84.15', 'C84.16', 'C84.17', 'C84.18', 'C84.19', 'C84.A0', 'C84.A1', 'C84.A2', 'C84.A3', 'C84.A4', 'C84.A5', 'C84.A6', 'C84.A7', 'C84.A8', 'C84.A9') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , APR AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS END_DATE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN DX ON APR_MRN = MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND(UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%MOGAMULIZUMAB%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%MOGAMULIZUMAB%') GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ) , X AS (SELECT DX.* FROM DX JOIN APR ON MRN = APR_MRN) , AC AS (SELECT AC_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN 'Y' END) AS "06-107 Consent", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "06-107 Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '09-141' THEN 'Y' END) AS "09-141 Consent", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '09-141' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "09-141 Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN 'Y' END) AS "12-245 Consent", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "12-245 Consent Date" FROM X JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '09-141', '12-245') GROUP BY AC_MRN ) , CTE AS (SELECT MRN AS DX_MRN, DX_DATE, STRIP(DX_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(DX_DESC) AS DX_CODE FROM X) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(6000))||' | '||CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(100))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN, RN, DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE, DX, "06-107 Consent", "06-107 Consent Date", "09-141 Consent", "09-141 Consent Date", "12-245 Consent", "12-245 Consent Date", CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, START_DATE, END_DATE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN T4 ON T4.MRN = PT_MRN JOIN APR ON T4.MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN AC ON T4.MRN = AC_MRN

'2020-08-01' ) , CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN SRG ON TM_MRN = PBD_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2002-01-01' AND '2020-08-01' ) SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of Death", TM_DX_DTE "Tumor Diagnosis Date", TM_HIST_CD PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_DEID_REPORT, PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME, PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC_DESC FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN SRG ON PRPT_MRN = PBD_MRN AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE = CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician') Q ON PHY_ID = OO_REQ_DR_NO WHERE 1=1 AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('APTT. (Activated Partial Thromboplastin Time (APTT))', 'Basic Metabolic Panel', 'Cancer Antigen 125 (CA 125)', 'Cancer Antigen 15-3 (CA 15-3)', 'Cancer Antigen 19-9 (CA 19-9)', 'Calcium', 'CBC, Standard (Complete Blood Count (CBC), Standard)', 'CBC with ANC only (Complete Blood Count (CBC), with ANC only)', 'CBC (Complete Blood Count (CBC) WITH Differential', 'Carcinoembryonic Antigen (CEA)', 'CMP (Comprehensive Metabolic Panel)', 'Creat. (Creatinine)', 'Electrolytes', 'Ferritin', 'Glucose', 'IgG / IgA / IgM', 'Lactate Dehydrogenase (LDH)', 'Lipase', 'Magnesium', 'Phosphorus', 'Prostate Specific AntiGEN (PSA)', 'Prothrombin Time (PT), International Normalized Ratio (INR)', 'Thyroxine (T4), Free', 'Testosterone', 'Thyroid Stimulating Hormone (TSH)', 'Uric Acid', 'Urinalysis, Routine') ) , CLIN AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND (CDO_SECTION = 'Implanted Devices' OR CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Implanted Devices') AND INSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 'Mediport') >0 ) SELECT DISTINCT A.CPE_MRN AS MRN, PATIENT_NAME AS "Patient Name" , ZIP_CODE AS "Zip Code", CLD_CLD_CENTER AS "Lab Location", ORDER_NAME AS "Order Name", ORDER_ID AS "Order ID", ORDER_STATUS AS "Order Status", ORDER_ENTERED_DATE AS "Order Enter Date", ORDER_REQUESTED_DATE AS "Order Requested Date", ORDER_REQ_TIME_PRIORITY AS "Time Priority", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Lab Appt Date", COORD_APPT_FLAG AS "Co-ordinated Appt?", REQUESTED_BY AS "Order Requested By", PROVIDER, REQUESTING_DR_SERVICE "Requesting Dr Service", PHY_DEPT AS "Physician Dept", PHY_DEPT_NAME AS "Physician Dept Name", NOTES AS "Appointment Notes", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM APPT A JOIN ORDR O ON OO_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN APPT_NOTES ON CPAN_MRN = A.CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_MRN NOT IN (SELECT CDD_MRN FROM CLIN)

prompt: Grant IDB access to the 'Spinal Oncology Outcomes Questionnaire' from MSK Engage for the IDGU group.
completion: SELECT EF_FORM_ID, EF_MRN, EF_FORM_NAME, EF_FORM_ALIAS, EF_SUBMISSION_DT, EF_PATIENT_ID, EFI_ITEM_ID, EFI_FORM_ID, EFI_ITEM_SEQUENCE, EFI_PARENT_ITEM_ID, EFI_IDB_INS_DT, EFI_IDB_UPD_DT, EFI_IDB_UPD_BY, EFI_IDB_PRCS_DTE, EFI_ITEM_ALIAS, EFI_ITEM_SHORT_NAME, EFI_VALUE_ALIAS, EFI_VALUE_SHORT_NAME, EFI_ITEM_TEXT, EFI_VALUE FROM IDB.EF_FORM JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID WHERE EF_FORM_NAME = 'Spinal Oncology Outcomes Questionnaire'

prompt: List of cardiac sarcoma patients, including RT and surgery info
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C38.0', '164.1') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH ) , RAD AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN DX ON RTC_TX_MRN = CC_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", DX_DTE "Diagnosis Date", RTC_TX_START_DTE "Rad Start Date", RTC_TX_STOP_DTE "Rad Stop Date", RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME "Rad Site", RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT "Rad Primary Ref Point", RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS "Delivered Fraction", RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE "Delivered Dose" FROM DX LEFT JOIN RAD ON CC_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN ORDER BY 1, 6 ; WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C38.0', '164.1') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH ) , SRG AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN DX ON SSE_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'THO' ) SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", DX_DTE "Diagnosis Date", SSE_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD "CPT Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC "CPT Description" FROM DX LEFT JOIN SRG ON CC_MRN = SSE_MRN ORDER BY 1, 6

prompt: Provide a one-time Excel sheet of eligible patients for 18-176. Please expedite the request to account for grant application. Thank you!
completion: WITH TUMOR AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, SITE_CODE, SITE_DESC, HIST_CODE, HIST_DESC, TM_CASE_STS, TM_CLASS_OF_CASE, BEST_STAGE, BEST_STAGE_SOURCE FROM (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_CDB_SEQ_NO, TM_TUMOR_SEQ, TM_CASE_REF_NO, TM_DX_DTE, TM_FIRST_TX_DTE , TM_FIRST_MSK_DTE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE , H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, SUBSTR(CS.AV_DESC, 1, 15) AS TM_CASE_STS , COALESCE(CLOC7.AV_DESC, CLOC.AV_DESC) TM_CLASS_OF_CASE , GR.AV_DESC AS TM_HIST_CD_GRADE, GS.AV_DESC AS TM_GENERAL_STG_DESC, TM_PATH_TEXT , REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN LEFT(TM_BEST_AJCC_STG, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '4' THEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG BETWEEN '0' AND '1' THEN '1' WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG BETWEEN '2' AND '3' THEN '2' WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG BETWEEN '4' AND '5' THEN '3' WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG = '7' THEN '4' WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('99', '88', '') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP WHEN TM_CLIN_STG_GRP NOT IN ('99', '88', '') THEN TM_CLIN_STG_GRP WHEN TM_CLIN_STG_GRP = '88' THEN 'NA' WHEN TM_CLIN_STG_GRP IN ('9', '99') THEN 'UNK' WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG = '8' THEN 'NA' WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG = '9' THEN 'UNK' ELSE 'UNK' END, 'IV', '4'), 'III', '3'), 'II', '2'), 'I', '1') AS BEST_STAGE , CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN('', '888', '999') THEN 'AJCC_7' WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN('', '88', '99') THEN 'AJCC' WHEN LEFT(TM_BEST_AJCC_STG, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '4' THEN 'Best AJCC' WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN('', '8', '9') THEN 'GeneralStage' WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN('', '88', '9', '99') THEN 'PathStage' WHEN TM_CLIN_STG_GRP NOT IN ('99', '88', '') THEN 'ClinicalStage' ELSE 'NA' END AS BEST_STAGE_SOURCE , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TM_MRN ORDER BY CASE WHEN TM_CASE_STS = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, TM_DX_DTE, TM_CDB_SEQ_NO) RN , AJCC7.AV_DESC AJCC7, AJCC.AV_DESC AJCC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG, TM_GENERAL_STG, TM_PATH_STG_GRP, TM_CLIN_STG_GRP FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLOC7 ON CLOC7.AV_CODE=TM_CLASS_OF_CASE_7 AND CLOC7.AV_ELEMENT='CLASS_OF_CASE_7' AND CLOC7.AV_CD_STS = 'A' AND CLOC7.AV_DESC > '' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLOC ON CLOC.AV_CODE=TM_CLASS_OF_CASE AND CLOC.AV_ELEMENT='CLASS_OF_CASE' AND CLOC.AV_CD_STS = 'A' AND CLOC.AV_DESC > '' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GR ON GR.AV_ELEMENT = 'HIST_CD_GRADE' AND GR.AV_CODE = TM_HIST_CD_GRADE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 AND TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC AND TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_ALLOWVALS MSKSUM ON MSKSUM.CDB_AV_ELEMENT = 'MSK_STAGE' AND MSKSUM.CDB_AV_CODE = TM_MSK_STG WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2000-01-01' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9490/3', 'M9500/3', 'M9522/3', 'M9500/6', 'M9504/3', 'M9504/6') ) TM WHERE LEFT(BEST_STAGE, 1) IN ('3', '4') ) , DEMO AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, HIST_DESC , R.AV_DESC AS "Race" , E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", TM_DX_DTE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, BEST_STAGE , CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS "Vital Status" FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY JOIN TUMOR ON PT_MRN=TM_MRN WHERE PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') OR PT_DATE_OF_DEATH >TM_DX_DTE+ 5 YEARS ) , BMT AS (SELECT CBM_MRN BMT_MRN, CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE TRANSPLANT_DTE, CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE UNION ALL SELECT CBP_MRN BMT_MRN, CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE TRANSPLANT_DTE, CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS) , GENE AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PHLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID, YEAR(PATH_RPT_DATE) AS PATH_REPORT_YR, GENE, GENE2, RESULT, LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, NUCLEOTIDE, METHOD, ABERRATIONTYPE, SEARCH_HIT1, SEARCH_HIT2 FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_HLA ON PHLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND (GENE IN ('MYCN', 'NMYC') OR GENE2 IN ('MYCN', 'NMYC'))) SELECT DISTINCT D.PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_SEX AS SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, "Race", "Ethnicity", HIST_DESC, TM_DX_DTE AS "Tumor Dx Date", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, "Vital Status", BEST_STAGE AS STAGE, CASE WHEN TRANSPLANT_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Stem Cell Transplant", GENE, GENE2 FROM DEMO D LEFT JOIN BMT ON BMT_MRN= D.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN GENE G ON D.PT_MRN=G.PT_MRN

prompt: Please provide MRN, first name, last name, procedure date, report date, report type, and full report text for all patients with a pathology report, surgical pathology report, or dermatology surgical pathology report with the terms listed below in criteria.
completion: SELECT PRPT_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, COALESCE(PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, DV.REGEXSTR('(?<=Date of Collection\/Procedure\/Outside Report: ).*', PRPT_REPORT)) PATH_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS PATH_TYPE, REPLACE(PRPT_REPORT, DV.REGEXSTR('Accession #.*', PRPT_REPORT), 'xxxxxxxx') AS PATH_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("sebaceous carcinoma")') = 1 ; SELECT PRPT_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, COALESCE(PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, DV.REGEXSTR('(?<=Date of Collection\/Procedure\/Outside Report: ).*', PRPT_REPORT)) PATH_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS PATH_TYPE, REPLACE(PRPT_REPORT, DV.REGEXSTR('Accession #.*', PRPT_REPORT), 'xxxxxxxx') AS PATH_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("sebaceous adenoma")') = 1 ; SELECT PRPT_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, COALESCE(PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, DV.REGEXSTR('(?<=Date of Collection\/Procedure\/Outside Report: ).*', PRPT_REPORT)) PATH_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS PATH_TYPE, REPLACE(PRPT_REPORT, DV.REGEXSTR('Accession #.*', PRPT_REPORT), 'xxxxxxxx') AS PATH_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("sebaceoma")') = 1 ; SELECT PRPT_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, COALESCE(PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, DV.REGEXSTR('(?<=Date of Collection\/Procedure\/Outside Report: ).*', PRPT_REPORT)) PATH_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS PATH_TYPE, REPLACE(PRPT_REPORT, DV.REGEXSTR('Accession #.*', PRPT_REPORT), 'xxxxxxxx') AS PATH_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("sebaceous epithelioma")') = 1

prompt: Generate a list of Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL) for specific providers.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('204.1', 'C91.1') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2020-05-18') , APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CRE_RES_NAME, MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) LAST_APPT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN DX ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2020-05-18' AND CRE_RES_NAME IN ('MATO, ANTHONY ROCCO', 'ZELENETZ, ANDREW') GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME) SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN" , PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name" , PT_SEX AS "Gender" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth" , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death" , R.AV_DESC AS "Race (Reg)" , E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity (Reg)" , PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AS "Last PT Activity Date" , LAST_APPT AS "Last Appt with provider" , CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider name" FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CP_MRN JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN FROM DX) ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN APPTS ON PT_MRN = MRN ; WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('204.1', 'C91.1') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2020-05-18') , APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CRE_RES_NAME, MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) LAST_APPT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN DX ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2020-05-18' AND CRE_RES_NAME IN ('MATO, ANTHONY ROCCO', 'ZELENETZ, ANDREW') GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME) SELECT * FROM DX LEFT JOIN APPTS ON CC_MRN = MRN ; WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('204.1', 'C91.1') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2020-05-18') , APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CRE_RES_NAME, MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) LAST_APPT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN DX ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2020-05-18' AND CRE_RES_NAME IN ('MATO, ANTHONY ROCCO', 'ZELENETZ, ANDREW') GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME) SELECT PRO_IRB_NO, PRO_IRB_TITLE, PRO_IRB_STS, PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE, AC_MRN, AC_NON_MSK_INST, AC_LAST_NAME, AC_FIRST_NAME, AC_PVDR_OF_RECORD_NAME, ACD_REG_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider name", CASE WHEN ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL THEN 'on-study' ELSE 'off-study' END AS "On off study" FROM IDB.PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN FROM DX) ON AC_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN APPTS ON AC_MRN = MRN

prompt: Provide a list of English speaking patients, ages 21 - 55, diagnosed with stage 0,1, or 2 breast cancer, with no current evidence of disease.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, CASE WHEN PT_PRIMARY_LANG = '' THEN CPP_LANG ELSE PT_PRIMARY_LANG END AS LANG, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG, CASE WHEN TM_SSF1 = '000' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '010' THEN 'Positive/elevated' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '020' THEN 'Negative/normal; within normal limits' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '030' THEN 'Borderline; undetermined whether positive or negative' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '080' THEN 'Ordered, but results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '988' THEN 'Not applicable: Information not collected for this case' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '996' THEN 'Test ordered, results not interpretable' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '997' THEN 'Test ordered, results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '998' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '999' THEN 'Unknown or no information; not documented in patient record' ELSE '' END AS "ER", CASE WHEN TM_SSF2 = '000' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '010' THEN 'Positive/elevated' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '020' THEN 'Negative/normal; within normal limits' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '030' THEN 'Borderline; undetermined whether positive or negative' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '080' THEN 'Ordered, but results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '988' THEN 'Not applicable: Information not collected for this case' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '996' THEN 'Test ordered, results not interpretable' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '997' THEN 'Test ordered, results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '998' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '999' THEN 'Unknown or no information; not documented in patient record' ELSE '' END AS "PR" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN AND YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 21 AND 55 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPP_MRN JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND CATEGORY1 = 'Breast' AND TM_BEST_AJCC_STG IN ('0', '1', '1A', '1B', '2', '2A', '2B') AND (PT_PRIMARY_LANG = 'ENG' OR CPP_LANG = 'ENG') ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT X.*, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE, APR_ORDER_SOURCE FROM X JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V V ON APR_MRN = MRN WHERE(UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%TAMOXIFEN%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%TAMOXIFEN%') AND(APR_END_DTE IS NULL OR APR_END_DTE >= CURRENT DATE)) ,
